articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Construction of Strategic HRM for Small & Medium -Sized Tech-Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Online Shopping Intention of Chinese Consumers and its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper utilizes 587 sample data collected from three cities-Shanghai, Nanjing and Wuxi, adopts the theory of planned behavior(TPB) to study consumers' online shopping behaviors and builds the Logit model, then based on which Eviews5.0 statistical software is employed to process sample data by Logit regression. The result of our study indicates that online shopping intention of consumers is more affected by factors like income, network usage capability and the security of online shopping and less affected by such factors as consumers' age, education level and convenience.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Scheduling Algorithms for Downlink Zero-Forcing Beamforming Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the downlink zero-forcing beamforming strategy under perfect channel state information at the transmitter (CSIT) for the case of random packet arrivals is investigated. Under this setting, the relevant fairness criterion is the stabilization of all buffer queues which guarantees a bounded average delay for all users. In case of queue stability is the goal, it can be shown that allocating resources to maximize a queue-length-weighted sum of the rates which are feasible in the current time slot is a stabilizing policy. However, the high complexity of user selection or the feasible rates determination for optimal scheme may prevent the real-time scheduling operation. Two simplified algorithms were provided taking the channel state, queue state and orthogonality into to account. In particular, we pick the first user with the largest product between channel gain and queueing lengths, and select the remaining N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>-1 users to form the user set based on the greedy user selection method or takeing channel orientations into account as well. Simulation results show that the average delay performance of the simplified algorithms are reduced by less than 10% compared to optimal schemes.

articleTitle: Assessment of Supplier Performance Based on TFN-AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to ensure the uninterrupted supply of items, the suppliers' performance needs to be evaluated periodically. But the evaluation process is complex. Linguistic assessment of suppliers may be carried out based on several criteria. Much of the data are difficult to obtain and ambiguous or vague to interpret. In this paper, a model based on the AHP and basic theory of the trigonometrical fuzzy number (TFN) was given and corresponding evaluation process was described. The importance weights of various criteria and the ratings of qualitative criteria are considered as linguistic variables. These linguistic ratings can be expressed in triangular fuzzy numbers. Compared with the AHP, the proposed model combines subjective analysis with quantitative analysis more reasonably, synthesizes group opinions more adequately. Finally a case was applied to qualify its scientific and feasibility.

articleTitle: An Efficient Identity Based Anonymous Identification Scheme for Ad-Hoc Groups from Pairings
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ad hoc anonymous identification scheme is a multi-user cryptographic primitive that allows participants from a user population to form ad hoc groups, and then prove membership anonymously in such groups. This paper proposes a new ID-based ad-hoc anonymous identification scheme from pairings. The new scheme is efficient both in computation and communication compared to previous works.

articleTitle: A Distributed Clustering Algorithm Based on Cluster Stability for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new distributed clustering algorithm for mobile ad hoc networks, named as DCCS (Distributed Clustering Algorithm Based on delta- Cluster Stability) is proposed. The cluster stability of node, which is defined in this paper, is applied to clustering for mobile ad hoc networks. This algorithm is implemented on the ns2 environment, and compared with classical Lowest-ID clustering algorithm and Highest Degrees clustering algorithm. The results of simulation on ns2 simulator show that the proposed algorithm can improve efficiently clustering performances in terms of the number of clusterhead, and the number of reaffiliations per unit time.

articleTitle: A New Method for Evaluating the Risk of Engineering Project: DHGF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The risk management to the construction engineering plays an ever increasing role in modern engineering project management. In this study, a new risk evaluation method of engineering project is proposed - the DHGF algorithm, its character is to choose certain evaluation methods at different stages of the evaluation process. During the evaluation, the improved Delphi method is used to establish the comprehensive evaluation index system; AHP is used to determine the weight of every evaluation index; the fuzzy evaluation method which introduced grey correlation analysis is used to determine the risk grade and make the comprehensive evaluation. DHGF algorithm brings together the merits of Delphi, AHP, grey correlation analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and provides a scientific and rational approach to evaluate the owner of engineering project.

articleTitle: Network Coding Aware Joint Routing for Multiple Unicast Flows in Wireless Multihop Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, joint routing scheme is proposed and studied in network coding aware circumstances. The idea of joint routing is enlightened by observation that mutual influence exists between flows. The defining aspect of joint routing is to treat all flows in the network as a whole and to make use of interactions between flows to optimize system performance. Formal description of joint routing problem is presented and an iterative algorithm is proposed. Simulation results show that JR offers 22.3% and 10% improvement over traditional separated and semi joint routing scheme.

articleTitle: A New RF Predistortion Scheme for High-Power Amplifier in Shortwave Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new digital RF predistortion scheme for high-power amplifiers (HPAs), which can completely meet the requirements of precision and bandwidth (BW) in modern shortwave communications systems and does not use nonlinear active RF devices. Simultaneously it realizes multichannel broadband digital predistortion and all-digitalization for actuator. Simulation results show that the proposed predistortion scheme is very effective in reducing the nonlinear distortion of HPAs, allowing small output backoff as low as 4.2 dB.

articleTitle: Emergency Rescue Decision Method Based on CBR in Coal Mine Accidents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Emergency rescue decision for accidents is related to the accidents losing. For the characters of emergency rescue decision, a decision method based on CBR supporting emergence rescue is proposed for coal mine accidents. The method involves describing historic accidents and rescue experience regularly, and retrieving the source case for the target case by calculating similarity degree. At last, a numerical example is presented to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Optimal Portfolio Model Based on Value-at-Risk and Two-Fund Separation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper uses value-at-risk to measure the risk of portfolios and develop an optimal portfolio model by minimizing the VaR subject to the constraint that the final wealth should meet the minimal acceptable limits. And we find that the optimal portfolio model based on VaR generates two-fund separation, so the portfolio can be replaced with two mutual funds, a risky asset and a risk-free asset. Finally we use the simplified model that only exists two assets to have empirical studies on how investors make his optimal portfolio choice between the two mutual funds in Shanghai stock market. The results show that as the acceptable return rises, the investor saves less, and the amount of wealth invested in stocks increases.

articleTitle: QoS Routing Based On Service Differentiation Supported Bandwidth Estimation for MANET
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is assumed that the available bandwidth is known in the existing QoS routing protocols for mobile ad hoc networks. And the QoS routing protocols focus mainly on how to discover QoS satisfied route and minimize overheads when setting up the route. The existing bandwidth estimation methods haven't taken flow types into consideration, so the estimated results are not accurate. In this paper, we propose a service differentiation supported bandwidth estimation model, which considers not only the interference of neighbor nodes but also the flow type. Based on this bandwidth estimation model, we further extend the AODV protocol, making it QoS supportive. The simulation results show that our bandwidth estimation model can effectively estimate the available bandwidth and the extended AODV protocol also achieves better QoS performance.

articleTitle: Research on Support Technologies of the Management Informationisation for Water Conservancy Project Construction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on analyzing the necessity for the development of the information management of water conservancy project construction, the content and task about the informationisation construction were dissertated. The support technologies for the information construction of the water conservancy project were analyzed in this paper. These new computer technologies were used in water conservancy project management informationisation construction, such as the geography information system, network technology, database technology and intermediate technology.

articleTitle: A Unitary Space-Time Cooperative Diversity Based on Detect and Forward Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A unitary space-time cooperative diversity algorithm based on detect and forward method is proposed in this paper. It can be well-tailored for flat-fading channels where neither the transmitter nor the receiver knows the fading coefficients. We can know that the bit error rate (BER) is dependent on the characteristics of the user's individual channel and the inter-user channel between them from the computer simulation.

articleTitle: The Simulation of Technology Diffusion in Industrial Clusters Based on Cellular Automaton
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Cellular Automaton model is applied to study the technology diffusion in industrial clusters. A cellular automaton model for technology diffusion in industrial clusters is formulated through equipping "the ability of memory" to cells and considering various influent factors in industrial clusters. Based on this model, the simulation experiments are carried on to find out the relative influence of different factors and to definite the key factors on technology diffusion.

articleTitle: Task-Based Government Organization Business Collaboration Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, while the modeling of business process in inter-organizational collaboration is researched, the coordination mechanism and relationships between the elements of organization are not clear. For this reason, this paper analyzes the characteristics of the government organization collaboration and presents a task-based government organization business collaboration model. On this basis, further development work is done. The model reflects business process of the government organization and provides support in coordination control which is lacking in previous models. It is the general framework for the business collaboration of the organization under e-government environment.

articleTitle: An Ad Hoc Network Clustering Algorithm for IDS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since Ad hoc network is vulnerable to attack, it's imperative to carry out intrusion detection research on ad hoc network In this paper, according to the requirement of cluster based intrusion detection system, we propose a new Algorithm of Clustering for IDS. Analyse and simulation results show that our method can decrease the number of cluster head and extend network survival time.

articleTitle: FSK Signal Demodulation Method Based on DSTFT
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a BFSK demodulation method using discrete short-time Fourier transform (DSTFT). The method discusses the BFSK signal in time-frequency domain, which is different from conventional demodulation methods. The principle of demodulation and a new code synchronization algorithm are given in the paper, different window functions are tried during the simulation, which bring different demodulated performance. And the test results indicates the demodulation is all right.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Control Technology of Capacity Flexibility Oriented to Multi-Specification & Small Batch
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Facing the production mode of the multi-specification & small batch, if enterprises want to win competition and achieve the request of high quality, lower cost,and meet the individual demand of customers,they must improve its capacity flexibility and their products quality. This paper produces the concept of capacity flexibility and its meaning, analyzes the relevant technology of product quality control at present, builds the compositive quality control policy oriented to capacity flexibility, and carries on the example analysis based on DOE.

articleTitle: Dynamic Joint Code and Slot Allocation in Time-Division CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dynamic Channel Allocation is an important part of the Radio Resource Management in CDMA/CDD systems. In this paper we propose a new algorithm for code and time-slot allocation method when a new user applies for resources. The new algorithm consists of 2-dimensional searching. A set of candidate slots is first selected from the available slots. Then the spreading code with smallest spreading factor in the candidate slots is selected and assigned to the new user. By the scheme, the algorithm jointly optimizes the allocation of code and time slot.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Research on Risk Evaluation of International Petroleum Engineering Services Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of international petroleum engineering service market, it's unavoidable for Chinese petroleum enterprises to encounter kinds of risks when exploring overseas market, so it becomes important to require the risks evaluation of overseas market. Through risks recognition, considering five aspects including petroleum industry economy and legal environment, general social and political environment, marketing workload, client risk and competition environment, the index system of risk evaluation of international petroleum engineering market is established. After the value assess with expert subjective evaluation method, AHP method was adopted to evaluate representative countries. The evaluation result is important for understanding country risks, considering market entry mode, pricing and overseas market decision-making.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Cell Search Algorithm for Mobile OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a low complexity cell search algorithm (ML-ACL algorithm) for mobile OFDMA systems is proposed, with IEEE 802.16e as the example. The main problem on cell search is the huge computational complexity due to the long pseudo-noise (PN) series. Based on the maximum-likelihood (ML) detection theory, the ML-ACL algorithm uses an adaptive correlation length (ACL) to greatly reduce computational complexity with nearly no degradation of detection performance. Furthermore, to compensate the channel impairments, a cell search structure based on the differential demodulation in frequency domain is proposed to accomplish cell search and the integer frequency offset estimation jointly. The system simulation results show that the ML-ACL algorithm is efficient and of low complexity for OFDMA cellular systems, especially for IEEE 802.16e OFDMA systems.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Turbo Decoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The extrinsic information and the received systematic observations exert different influence on decision-making with the change of SNR values for turbo iterative decoding. By multipling a weighted coefficient for the priori information, this paper proposed a novel adaptive iterative soft decoding algorithm for turbo codes, which alters the proportion of the extrinsic information and the received systematic observations in the soft output values of turbo decoding. In this way, turbo decoding can trace the changes of channel and obtain improved performance. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can lower the error floor of turbo codes.

articleTitle: Study on Game Among Engineer and Contractor in Engineering Quality Supervision Based on Static Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Engineering quality has always been an important objective of the project, however, at present, in China's market economy conditions, high-quality engineering requires the effective supervision of the engineer. In order to increase the probability of contractor's guarantee of quality, this paper makes some hypotheses, and based on these hypotheses, a static game model among engineer and contractor is established by using the static game theory, and the equilibrium strategies are deduced later. Then, some hypotheses are changed, in the long run, the equilibrium results will also be changed. Based on the different equilibrium results, suggestions to heighten engineering quality effectively are made though affecting the behaviors of the engineer by enlarging his responsibilities, but not though punishing the contractor's jerry-building.

articleTitle: Client Classification on Credit Risk Using Rough Set Theory and ACO-Based Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the analysis of client classification based on support vector machine (SVM), redundant variables in the samples spoil the performance of the SVM classifier, two SVM parameters, C and sigma , must be carefully predetermined in establishing an efficient SVM model. This paper used rough sets as a preprocessor of SVM to select a subset of input variables and employed the ant colony optimization algorithm (ACO) to optimize the parameters of SVM. Additionally, the proposed ACO-SVM model that can automatically determine the optimal parameters was tested on the classification of the credit risk bank of listed companies in China. Then, we compared the accuracies of the proposed ACO-SVM model with those of other models of multivariate statistics and other artificial intelligence (BPN and fix-SVM). Experimental results showed that the ACO-SVM model performed the best classifying accuracy and generalization, implying that integrating the ACO with traditional SVM model is very successful.

articleTitle: Key Capabilities for Chinese Software Services Vendors in IT Offshore Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The research investigates IT offshore outsourcing from U.S/European or Japanese clients to Chinese software services vendors. We take the vendor's perspective and identify six key capabilities by adopting Wade(2004) 's typology, and build the model to describe the relationship between vendor capabilities and market competitive advantage. We have conducted a pilot study based on 30 software vendors in Beijing, and primarily validate the theoretical model by cluster analysis. This paper contributes to the literature by examining the development of key internal capabilities in indigenous Chinese software vendor organizations.

articleTitle: Sparse Multi-Path Channel Estimation for OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sparse multi-path is encountered in OFDM and Ultra-wideBand (UWB) communications. Conventional channel estimation methods ignore the prior knowledge of the sparseness, and estimates have higher MSE. We introduced two approaches: Lp norm constraint method and LASSO method which are related to Bayesian model. The two approaches exploit the sparse a priori and obtain better performance.

articleTitle: Novel Power Loading Algorithm for Downlink Multiple Streams MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In downlink multiple streams multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system, adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) is used to increase spectrum efficiency (SE) due to selecting the modulation and coding rate scheme (MCS) dynamically. However, there is a gap between UE's signal to interference plus noise ratio (SINR) and that required by the MCS. In this paper, we propose a novel power loading algorithm using the SINR gap. The algorithm converts the SINR gap into the transmit power gap among different streams. Thus BS adjusts transmit power allocation for different streams and selects higher MCS than that without adjusting power. The results demonstrate that this proposed algorithm contributes large gain of SE for single user (SU-) MIMO based on singular value decomposition (SVD) preceding.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Enterprise Informationization Based on Linguistic Index and Projection Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the main body of current economic society, enterprise informationization level is an important symbol of national strength and the competitive ability. This paper, first, elaborates objectively the present situation of research on evaluation of enterprise informationization both at home and abroad; Then, it establishes the index system for evaluation of enterprise informationization through analyzing the influential factor for evaluation of enterprise informationization based on concerned literatures. Furthermore, combining with linguistic index, it introduces using projection method to determine the distance between each enterprise informationization level and positive ideal scheme, and rank the order of enterprise informationization level. Finally, through calculating and analyzing on a case, it illustrates the rationalization of projection method based on the linguistic index.

articleTitle: The Research on Telecommunication Industry Business Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the transformation of China's telecommunication operators, this paper builds a structure of the industry's ecosystem and value-net model, and further identifies key resources in this ecosystem, including standardization, core technology, customer base and brand names. The conclusion is that an operator's competitive advantage not only depends on its own strength, but also on its capability of collaboration. That is, whichever operator can best collaborate with others in the ecosystem, will also be able to best integrate resources, and thus establish a self-centered ecosystem and obtain a sustainable advantage.

articleTitle: NHCR: A Novel Hierarchical Clustering Routing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the energy constrained nature of wireless sensors, it is a substantial design issue to make efficient use of battery power in order to increase their lifetime. An optimal routing approach is critical to prolong the lifetime of the network. This paper presents a novel clustering scheme integrating hierarchical method on the basis of classical routing algorithm. Simulation results show that the new scheme efficiently mitigates the hot spot problem in WSN and achieves much improvement in network lifetime and load balance compared to the old algorithm LEACH, which is the most promising hierarchical routing algorithm to date.

articleTitle: Extracting Structure of Web Site Based on Hyperlink Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Structure of a Web site usually reflects the implicit logical relationship among Web pages, and is widely applied to Web mining and Web information retrieval. However, it is difficult for machine to extract structure of a Web site automatically out of varied noise hyperlinks. This paper proposes an algorithm to extract the structure of a Web site automatically based on hyperlink analysis. The algorithm identifies and filters noise hyperlinks by patterns of Web pages these hyperlinks connected, instead of patterns of the hyperlinks. It promises better performances than previous approaches. The preliminary results show that the proposed algorithm has a great improvement on both precision and recall ratio.

articleTitle: Ontology Construction from Semi-Structured Text
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ontology is effective in supporting text mining, information retrieval and knowledge engineering on semantic level. However, ontology construction is pretty time-consuming; hence, some automatic or semi-automatic methods are proposed to try to solve the problem. In this paper, a model is issued to construct a medical ontology from semi-structured text after three steps: PAT-Tree based phrase extraction, document structure analysis and ontology construction based on hierarchy structure of text. This model has found some applications in medical emergency aid system in China. Practical experiment results show that this model can create a practical medical ontology from syllabus of medical school efficiently and effectively.

articleTitle: Functional Ontology of Routing Reputation for MANET
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The nature of mobile ad hoc networks make the routing is highly dependent on cooperate behavior between nodes, and using reputation mechanism can enforce cooperation among the nodes to prevent selfish behavior. This article proposes a functional ontology for reputation routing mechanisms base on node behavior. In this ontology, the functional structures and conceptualize that compose the reputation routing mechanism are identified. At the end of this paper, an ontological view of routing reputation query also has been proposed to describe the inner relationships of the reputation routing discovery, which try to prove the dependability of routing relationships that established between independent nodes based on their routing reputation.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Acquisition Strategy in Opportunistic Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: First we introduce the characteristics of the opportunistic networks, and analyze the shortcomings of the main acquisition strategy in this kind of network, such as low success rate and low efficiency. With this in mind, we propose a hybrid strategy called "Pull-Push" Based Algorithm (PPBA). In this algorithm, not only the source node actively disseminates some copies of service information, but also the user nodes actively send their search message. Then we analyze the acquisition success rate in different strategy, and give the guide to choose the important parameter in PPBA. Finally, the simulation results show that the performance of the PPBA with different parameter in different situation, and compared with other two strategies, it also shows a better performance on acquisition success rate in opportunistic networks.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Case-Based Ontology Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve on the efficiency of traditional information retrieval, system architecture of retrieval-oriented, case-based ontology reasoning has been designed and implemented in this paper, by which the traditional information retrieval, CBR and ontology can be integrated. In this architecture, OWL was employed as the description language for ontology model; ontology cases were extracted from ontology library and stored in the case library. Consequently, the inquiry about ontology from the ontology library can be switched to the inquiry about case from the case library. The experimental results reveal that the precision and recall of domain-oriented knowledge retrieval has been obviously improved by virtue of powerful reasoning function of OWL and superior capability of CBR.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Hierarchical Service Management Method using Bloom Filters for Large MANETs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) conveniently complement infrastructure-based networks, allowing mobile nodes to spontaneously form a network and share their services, including bridging with other networks, either infrastructure-based or ad hoc. However, distributed sensor provisioning over MANETs requires adequate support for service discovery and invocation, due to the network's dynamics and resource constraints of wireless nodes. We propose a hierarchical service management method using bloom filters for large MANETs. In this paper, a MANET is comprised of logical grid hierarchy, and each mobile node within the lowest service region multicasts the attenuated bloom filter (ABF) for services itself to other nodes within the region. To advertise and discover a service efficiently, the server node of the lowest server region sends the summary bloom filter (SBF) for the ABFs to the server node of upper server region. Each upper server has the set of SBFs for lower vicinity service regions. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated by an analytical model, and is compared with that of two alternative advertisement solutions.

articleTitle: Frequency Synchronization for MIMO OFDM-Based High Throughput Wireless LAN Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a post-FFT frequency synchronization algorithm for IEEE 802.11n based MIMO OFDM (multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) wireless LAN systems. The proposed synchronization algorithm uses preamble for rapid synchronization, and is thus suitable for burst mode transmission. The proposed method exploits receive diversity, which significantly improves the accuracy of the frequency offset estimation. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm operates close to Cramer-Rao lower bound at high SNR, and is robust against multipath fading channels.

articleTitle: Relaying Node Selection Algorithm Based on Channel Capacity for Cooperative System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperative communication is a promising technique that uses many relaying nodes to combat channel fading. To achieve better communication and lower computational cost, some relays in good condition should be selected from all available relays. However, the original algorithm to select m' relays from m relays will need to compute C( m, m' )times, which has high complexity. In this paper, two lower complexity relay selection algorithms are proposed based on maximization of channel capacity for two-hop large scale non-regenerative relay system under the constraint of energy consumption. The simulation results show that the proposed two algorithms not only have almost the same channel capacity but have the lower computational complexity to the original algorithm when the selected relay nodes are same. These two algorithms also perform better than the way of random selection and direct transmission in channel capacity.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Analysis upon the Knowledge Dissemination within an Organization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of science and technology, knowledge has become one of the key factors for enterprises in gaining competition advantages. Therefore, the study on the characteristics of knowledge dissemination within an organization will facilitate the organization to manage knowledge effectively. Based upon the research on the characteristics of knowledge dissemination, this paper puts forward a new perspective of sorting knowledge: the long-term knowledge and the short-term knowledge. Furthermore, this paper sets up a system dynamic model of knowledge dissemination within an organization and makes necessary analysis. Meanwhile, the threshold condition is presented to judge whether knowledge can be disseminated freely within an organization. According to the outcome of the analysis, management methods aiming at the two kinds of knowledge are also suggested.

articleTitle: Sampling Frequency Offset Estimation for MIMO OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a pilot-assisted sampling frequency offset (SFO) estimation algorithm for MIMO OFDM (multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) systems. The sampling frequency offset is estimated from phase errors in the received pilot subcarrier symbols between two transmitted OFDM blocks. The optimal weight for each SFO estimate is derived. The proposed weighted method is remarkably superior to the unweighted method, and the receive diversity exploited by the proposed method can significantly reduce the MSE (mean square error) of the SFO estimator. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can accurately estimate the SFO in both AWGN channels and multipath fading channels.

articleTitle: Optimization for Time Consumption on Channel Searching in Cognitive Radio System with Markov Decision Processes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the demand for spectrum resources becomes more and more strong, and some spectrum has been underutilized for years, the concept "Cognitive Radio" becomes popular and is widely applied in practice. In a cognitive radio system, one of the important capabilities of cognitive users is that, they should or we may say they "have to" be able to search for a better channel to keep the users' data on transfer with acceptable quality when the interference in the current channel exceeds the limit they can live with. But practically the procedure of channel searching takes time and too much time consumption on that will definitely delay users' data transfer so that the system performance will get degraded, this is what a cognitive user has to be confronted with inevitably. From this perspective, as far as a cognitive user is concerned, how to decrease time consumption for channel searching as possible as we can becomes a critical technical problem. In this paper, we propose that this problem be modeled as a Markov decision processes (which is also referred to as MDP throughout this paper) such that we can solve this problem by the existing algorithms derived from the previous research on Markov decision processes and the results show that by using the algorithm of policy improvement, the long-term average time consumption for channel searching can be effectively minimized.

articleTitle: Priority Assessing Method for Aviation Multi-Project Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To support the decision-making on coordination process for aviation projects, a multi-project priority assessing method based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is presented. A bi-layered hierarchy model is introduced to determine the set of factors for priority assessment at first. Then the weight of each involved factor is calculated through analytic hierarchy process (AHP), which merges human experts' know-how into the computation. On the other hand, the fuzzy weighted average operator is chosen and improved to maintain the information completeness covered by those inner and outer factors. Based on the weight and operator, the matrix for priority comprehensive evaluation is constructed following the two-step fuzzy operation strategy, by which the project precedence is obtained. Finally, algorithm verification based on two aircraft assembly projects is carried out step by step, proving the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Mitigating Outsourcing Risk through Relational Contract
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzed the risk management under the uncertain outsourcing environment and put forward a relational contract model. Applying agency theory and cooperative game theory, a relational contract model with incentive bonus was explored for outsourcing in a double-moral-hazard setting. Vendors are often a major risk factor of outsourcing. Firms usually resort to incentive contracts against vendor's moral hazard and imperfect commitment. Relational contract involving discretionary bonus based on combination of objective and subjective performance could reduce the distorted incentives that would be created by the contract only based on objective performance. According to repeated game theory, the relational contracts must be self-enforcing when the value of the future relationship must be sufficiently large that neither party wishes to renege and vendor would choose optimal action improving the outsourcing profits. The results showed that the validity of relational incentive contracts correlated with the discount rate of the contractors. Finally, the range of available bonus for outsourcing vendors was calculated. This analysis may help firms deciding adequate incentive bonus without excessive cost.

articleTitle: Research on Product Configuration Knowledge Representation and Sharing Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Valid product knowledge representation is crucial for knowledge sharing and reuse in product configuration. An ontology-based knowledge representation approach on product configuration was proposed aimed at solving some problems on product configuration knowledge representation and sharing at present. Representation hierarchy of product knowledge ontology was analyzed, configuration knowledge classified levels and some relative concepts were presented such as component, function, port, resource, relation and constraint etc. Then product configuration knowledge ontology model was established and ontology modeling language DAML+OIL was used for representing configuration knowledge. Finally, water pump was used as an example to demonstrate the modeling approach. As a result, the configuration model is easy to representation and sharing.

articleTitle: The Optimal Multi-Attribute Auction Mechanism and Analysis of Price Fixing Based on Venture Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Venture enterprise is the product of venture capital and high technology with the characteristic of both high risk and high revenue distinguished from other common enterprises. Therefore, those conventional methods of assets evaluation fail to demonstrate the authentic value of the venture enterprise. This paper, from the perspective of auction mechanism design, provides a new method to fix the real price of venture enterprise by employing the first-price-sealed multi-attribute auction. The optimal payoff of the venture entrepreneur is obtained through setting reserve prices and mechanic design, and a first-score multi-attribute practical process is presented to demonstrate the feasibility of the mechanism.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing Model for Flight Based on Passenger Behavior Choice and its Solution of Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dynamic pricing model is the core content of revenue management of airline companies. The paper conducts comparison and analysis on both domestic and foreign pricing models and points out some deficiencies existing in the current researches. Through introducing logit model in consumer choice theory, the paper establishes dynamic pricing model based on passenger choice behavior and adopts particle swarm algorithm to seek optimized solution for the model. Finally, through instance analysis, the passage introduces the process of figuring out solutions for the model.

articleTitle: Taxi O/D Charging System Based on Mobile Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with the development of electronic commerce and mobile communication technology, the mobile electronic commerce is becoming the most important content of mobile application. This article advances a new taxi charging system based on mobile electronic commerce, that is to locate the origin and destination of a taxi trip by GSM and then calculate the taxi fee by a new charging model , and realize the mobile payment, so that achieve the goal of reducing the traffic pressure.

articleTitle: An Efficient Rate One STBC Scheme with 3 Transmit Antennas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient rate one quasi-orthogonal space-time block code for three antenna system. In order to compensate the performance degradation due to quasi-orthogonal scheme, in this proposed scheme, we incorporate a selective receiver for decoding. The receiver divides the received signals into two groups, and two receiving antennas alternatively operate to receive the divided signals. By this way, we can eliminate the interference from the neighboring signals in the same symbol almost by half. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme can provide improved performance.

articleTitle: The Performance Measurement Model for ICT Service Quality (ICTSQ)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a study on developing a performance measurement model for information and communication technology service quality (ICTSQ). Based on most previous literature within ICT studies, many models have been developed in the concern of service quality (SQ). However, most of these models have not investigated the performance measurement for their service quality (SQ). So far, studies have only focused on analyzing and identifying various factors and attributes based on the context involved. Therefore, this study tries to fill this gap by identifying the related key performance indicators involved in measuring ICTSQ. For this study purposes, it will investigate the performance measurement area and component to measure the performance of ICTSQ within the current context of Malaysian Universities (MUs). Besides, this study will list the related factors and KPIs based on the component involved. The findings of this study is hoped to derive an appropriate performance measurement model for measuring ICTSQ based on the context of MUs. Literature review has been done and survey in preliminary study is conducted to the selected MU to gather the empirical data for this study.

articleTitle: Experiment on Multiple Video Streaming in Wireless Home Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Goal of the reported experiment was to determine in which way wirelessly transmitted video streams influence each other. Former experiments gave the impression that the behavior of video streams is unpredictable, e.g. due to unstable play-back and uncertain starts. To transport two video streams simultaneously over a wireless/wired network, the video servers use different network protocols (TCP and RTP) and variants of video bandwidth adaptation algorithms; none, random drop and I-frame Delay (IFD), a special scheduling algorithm for MPEG streams. The access point was operating in congestion mode. Even under these extremely bad network conditions, IFD still offers the highest flexibility in combination with TCP. In contrast, the performance of the server using RTP was topology dependent. The servers with no adaptation showed the infeasibility of complete TCP transmission for real-time media. The TCP/random drop server opened the possibility of a non-complete TCP transmission which was exploited in the TCP/IFD server.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm in IEEE 802.16e Sleep Mode Operation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In IEEE 802.16e system, mobile station (MS) is usually powered by battery. To save the limited power, IEEE 802.16e standard specifies sleep mode operation for power management. There are two significant performance metrics in sleep mode operation, one is energy consumption, the other is waiting delay. Our research is to shorten energy consumption and waiting delay. In this paper, a hybrid algorithm is proposed to reduce energy consumption and waiting delay. The proposed algorithm decreases the energy consumption and waiting delay efficiently, when data frame from base station (BS) to MS is in low traffic.

articleTitle: Investor Sentiment in the Financial Market with Small World Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper argues the dynamic evolution issue of investor sentiment based on the small world network theory, by reviewing the micro-mechanism of financial network. On the stochastic multi-agent platform of Nagurney's financial market, it takes the relative wealth and habit formation utility functions as the motive mechanism of this network structure evolution. With the degree distributions, mean geodetic distance between vertex pairs, and clustering coefficient as the evolving criterion of this network structure, it describes the dynamic evolution attributes of investor sentiment. Results of simulation indicate that investor sentiment evolution process has significant robustness with the set motive mechanism.

articleTitle: TLEO: Time Limited Energy Optimal Algorithm for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks (UASNs) is an important and ideal information-gathering paradigm for aqueous environments. However the harsh acoustic traffic condition makes the task of efficient transmission difficult. This paper presents the bit error rate guided time limited energy optimal algorithm (TLEO) for UASNs, which resides between the network layer and the MAC layer. The main feather of TLEO is the packet length is dynamically set to the optimal value according to the current bit error rate of the acoustic channel. To ensure the transmission in a time sensitive manner, this scheme affords limited waiting times for each node according to different channel conditions. Our simulations show 50%-70% reductions in transmission energy consumption and the scheme is more efficient when bit error rate is higher.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Government Financial Support for Scientific and Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Scientific and technological innovation is a key factor that promotes economic growth. As the investment of scientific and technological innovation has the nature and characteristic of public products or semi-public products in certain extent, governments are required to offer policies and funds to support scientific and technological innovation to solve the problem that the market is unable to dispose the scientific and technological innovation resources effectively. The thesis has analyzed the policy of scientific and technological innovation for some countries and summarized their successful experiences. Through a comparative analysis on the policies that affect economy, and the analysis for quantity and structure of Chinese scientific and technological innovation support, the thesis concludes that the quantity is insufficient and the structure is not compatible with Chinese scientific and technological innovation support. The thesis proposes some fiscal policies that will strengthen fiscal level, construct and improve the management system, it selects important scopes and enrich the methods which are based on the current condition and character of Chinese scientific and technological innovation.

articleTitle: Real Estate Investment Risk Analysis Based on Fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Hierarchy model of real estate investment risk is established. Through using triangular fuzzy numbers and analytic hierarchy process, we have evaluated the risk of real estate, and identified the risk factors for the overall impact on real estate investment project.

articleTitle: The Research on Power Supply Enterprises' Customer Satisfaction Model Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Effective customer satisfaction evaluation is an important prerequisite for power supply enterprises to win in competitive market. In this paper, we establish the power customer satisfaction evaluation index system based on previous studies. Then we prove the validity of this method through field investigations by using AMOS. Finally, path coefficient analysis is conducted to get key factors to improve the service quality. The conclusions have been used in Sichuan province in China to improve the quality of services with some reference value.

articleTitle: Double-Sided Bow-Tie Antenna for 2G/3G/WiFi and Mobile WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A double-sided dual-band bow-tie antenna with two arms printed on top and bottom of dielectric substrate of epsiv<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>=2.2 is proposed to operate at both the CDMA/GSM band ranging from 800 MHz to 960 MHz and the mobile 3G /WiFi/WiMAX band ranging from 1.7 GHz to 2.69 GHz. The two arms of the bow-tie are overlapped to tune the operation band and designed to be asymmetrical for beam tilt. To cover the potential mobile 2.6 GHz WiMAX band, the impedance matching structure is carefully improved and optimized by numerical simulation software. Quasi-omnidirectional radiation patterns, reasonable gain values and beam tilt as required in the GSM/CDMA and 3G/WiFi/WiMAX repeater are proposed.

articleTitle: Economical Incentive Contract Design with Asymmetric Information in Building Energy Efficiency Retrofit
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Existing Building energy efficiency retrofit is an important component of Chinese building energy efficiency strategy. There are several factors determining the level of inputs and the effect are asymmetric information within the energy efficiency regeneration process, such as endeavor of the owners of existing buildings, etc. Using the principle-agent theory to establish a cooperative game model of the Government and the owners of existing buildings, and then educe bilateral strategies of this cooperative game. Under the assumption of risk-neutral agent, analyze the risk contracting, incentive costs and agent cost ulterior. The conclusion is that the level of efforts made by existing buildings owners plays a key role to the process of energy efficiency retrofit.

articleTitle: Implementing Cooperative Diversity by Using LDPC Code and Space-Time Code
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Spatial diversity is an effective method to resist fading effect in wireless channel. Due to the limitation of size, weight and cost, it is difficult to use the multi-antenna technique on the terminal of wireless communication. Cooperative communication allows the sharing of antennas among the single antenna mobile terminals to create a virtual multi-antenna, which further leads to the realization of transmitting diversity. Because of the coherence among the symbols of the LDPC code word, we can create a virtual MIMO system and obtain diversity gain by making space-time coding in the part of the symbols and transmitting them via different users' antennas. Once diversity gain is obtained, the system performance can be improved effectively, without any rise in the system bandwidth and transmitting power.

articleTitle: Apply HITS Algorithm to Measuring Class's Authoritative Complexity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The research, development and applications of software measurement have been carried out for more than forty years. It can help software developers analyze reliability, maintainability and complexity of systems. Till now, researchers have proposed lots of cohesion and couple metrics. However very little work is involved in measuring classes' authority. This paper put forward a method of measuring class authoritative complexity by famous HITS algorithm in web structure mining. Furthermore, it has minimum and maximum values by virtue of linear algebra. Finally, a small but realistic example is illustrated.

articleTitle: The Research of On-line Real-time Automatic Detector on Communication Fiber-Optic Diameter
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article expounds linear array Charge Coupled Device (CCD) 's characteristics, working theory, driving time sequence and the design of the linear array CCD driving board for binarization. A kind of on-line real-time automatic detector with high precision was developed on this base. The device mainly includes: beam collimational system; linear array CCD driving board for binarization; constant current source power supply; the main circuit board system and so on.. The article analyses the choice of light source and illumination's matching, the design of beam collimational system; the detailed TCD 1206 driving sequence and a series of questions such as linear array CCD binarization, the main circuit board system's design and so on. Furthermore, discusses and prospects the device's application.

articleTitle: Queuing Analysis of Priority Multi-Connection and Multi-Path Architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Internet has evolved greatly from its original incarnation. For instance, at the time TCP was designed, network interface devices were expensive components, and hence multi-path of end hosts was beyond the ken of research. Along with growth and changed in economy, increasing emphasis on end-to-end transfer efficiency has brought multi-path within the purview of transport layer, thus transforming transport layer multi-path into a feature worth supporting and investigating. On the other hand, the original Internet used single TCP connection for an application, but now applications that require good network performance often use parallel TCP connections to improve the effectiveness of TCP. To adapt to these changes, we propose priority multi-connection and multi-path architecture (PMMA), which will utilize above new technologies of Internet to improve Internet users' satisfaction. We use queueing models to analyze current multi-connection multi-path implements and our PMMA. The NS2 simulations prove the efficiency of PMMA.

articleTitle: A New Multi-Access Scheme for PCTH UWB System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Pseudo Chaotic Time Hoping (PCTH) is a recently proposed modulation scheme for UWB impulse radio. Unlike a typical TH-UWB, the PCTH-UWB system exploits concepts from symbolic dynamics to generate aperiodic sequences which modulate the position of pulses. The use of aperiodic TH sequence can enhance the spread-spectrum characteristics of UWB system by removing the spectral feature of the transmitted signal. In this paper, in order to improve the performance of conventional MA-PCTH-UWB system, we propose a new scheme for the multi-access communication of PCTH UWB system by transmitting specific training sequences which initialize the conditions of the shift registers for each user in each N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> frames. The performance of BER of this system is analyzed.

articleTitle: A Suppressing NBI Technique of DSSS Based on the Linear Estimator in Time-Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on analyzing the spectrum of narrowband interference, a method of suppressing narrow interference, which makes use of cyclostationary character of interference, is proposed in DSSS system in this thesis. The results of simulation indicate that this technique can suppress narrowband interference better than the estimator/subtracter filter in the time domain.

articleTitle: A New Multiple Routing Algorithm for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Design and analysis of routing protocols are the key issues for a mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs). In this paper, we propose a new multiple routing algorithm - the shortest multiple source routing (SMSR) algorithm for MANETs. SMSR is based on dynamic source routing (DSR), but which makes the destination nodes get the shortest unattached routes correspondingly is that only the destination nodes can respond to the routing request (RREQ), and the intermediate hosts rebroadcast the shorter RREQ packets with some conditions, besides, there are also some changes done for the route maintenance. The DSR protocol is compared with the SMSR algorithm under OPNET in routing overhead ratio, packets delivery ratio and average end-to-end delay. The simulation results show that the performance of the SMSR algorithm is better than the DSR protocol.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Supply Chain Incentive Contract under Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the game between one supplier and one retailer. The supplier offer an incentive contract to inspire the retailer to sell the products through different effort level. We construct the discrete principal-agent model, which is reformulated as a stochastic bi-level programming problem. By analysis of the solution, we get how the asymmetrical information affects the supplier's utility and retailer's effort level.

articleTitle: A Bit Allocation Algorithm for MB-OFDM UWB with Spectral Mask Constraint
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a competitive solution to the short-range high data-rate communication, Multi-Band Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (MB-OFDM) Ultra-wideband (UWB) technique can obtain further performance improvement with the use of adaptive resource allocation schemes. In this paper, an incremental bit allocation algorithm is proposed for MB-OFDM UWB system, which aims at minimum bit error rate (BER) under constant rate constraint while complying with the spectral mask limit. The BER performance improvement and transmission distance extension due to this algorithm is evaluated by employing a simulation model based on MB-OFDM proposal.

articleTitle: Incremental Data Prefetching for Map Service in Mobile Navigation Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Map service, the most frequently used service in mobile navigation application, is always the bottle-neck due to the continual map refresh, limitation capacity of wireless network and the vast data volume of the vector map. Data prefetching, responsible for fetching data from Map Server forehand, is considered to be an efficient way to increase map refresh. However, the sticking point is to decrease the data participant in transfer and display. Other than treat all the data objects equally, this paper take the objects' display level into account during prefetching, and presents a hierarchical data management and incremental prefetching strategy based on Hierarchical Hilbert grid, which extends traditional Hilbert grid and curve to multi-level map space, and uses a binary serial number to serialize sub-grids for the sake of describing both spatial and neighborhood relationship among objects.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of E-Government Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-government is a power to promote building a service-oriented government. By reference perceptual quality model and SERVQUAL evaluation model, this paper designs the model and the indicator system of E-government service quality evaluation, in order to provide a reference for E-government service evaluation.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Remote Fault Diagnosis System with Hiberarchy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The characteristics of the remote fault diagnosis (RFD) is analyzed, the levels of the diagnostic participators, diagnostic processes, system structure, and the responsibilities and obligations for founding and maintaining RFD system are pointed out. The multi-level RFD system with the local, remote and domain fault diagnosis subsystem is designed. The system fully accords with RFD's characteristics, supports the graded fault diagnosis and is convenient to ensure the diagnosed equipment. The system is realized with Internet, LAN, PSTN, GSM communication network and database techniques, which is in favor of exerting the excellence of various communication networks, founding and widely applying RFD system.

articleTitle: A Context-Aware Access Control Model for Pervasive Computing in Enterprise Environments
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the enterprise applications being integrated into the pervasive computing environment, the traditional access control models based on the identity of the user and object have not been suitable to the new requirements of dynamic access authorization to enterprise resources. In this paper, we integrate business and pervasive computing requirements in a single model by extending the Task-Role Based Access model to provide dynamic context-aware access control for pervasive computing in enterprise environments. Unlike traditional approaches for access control, access decisions in will depend on the combination of the required credentials of users, their working environment and context of tasks. It provides a simple and efficient solution to integrate the business applications such as workflow systems into pervasive computing environment.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm-Based Rules Discovery for Networked Manufacturing Resources Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To choose and manage networked manufacturing resources efficiently, a fuzzy association rules mining technique was proposed. According to the analysis of all data types, a specialized data preprocessing method was applied to extract, wash and transform networked manufacturing resources data, and a self-contained data warehouse on networked manufacturing resources was established for data preprocessing. To deal with the fuzzy association rules mining on manufacturing resources platform, a novel genetic algorithm (GA) based mining method was introduced. Considering the characteristics of networked manufacturing resources, double-level encoding and label-bit switching operator were designed to make the improved GA available to networked manufacturing resources. Finally, a case was employed to demonstrate the practicality of applying fuzzy association rules mining based on GA in networked manufacturing resources management.

articleTitle: Study on Directional Reliable Multi-hop Clustering Routing Protocol in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: WSN's reliability plays an extraordinary role in certain applications. Among the reliability related solutions, the reliability of the network largely dependent on the routing reliability which mainly dependents on both aspects of the cluster-heads' reliability and gateways' reliability. This paper proposes a novel redundancy-based directional reliable multi-hop clustering routing algorithm (DRMC) for wireless sensor network. DRMC integrates the diffused clustering with the mechanism of multiple backup of the cluster-head and gateway node, this mechanism not only keeps the proper lifetime, the stability and expansibility of the network, but also improves the speed and reliability of the routing process. The efficiency of the algorithm is verified through the simulation results.

articleTitle: Static Game Analysis on Different Strategies Adopted by Ports
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The competition or cooperation strategy adopted by ports is a dilemma. When a few ports are in face of the same customers, they naturally form a ports-group system. Thus it is necessary for each port to choose the optimal strategy to survive in competitive environment, such as competition, cooperation or co-opetition strategy. In this paper, we build a competition- cooperation static game model with complete information and research for Nash equilibriums. Research indicates the main factor influencing decision of port is the rate of service substitution of ports. Finally we discuss how the changes of model parameters affect the results and present the future work.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Traffic Zoning Base on the HPP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the running of traffic control system needing the road topological framework and the settlement of the traffic flow data modeling, this paper gives the conception of the traffic dynamic zones and designs the framework of the traffic dynamic zoning model. The basic measure criterions of traffic dynamic zoning are put forward, which are the saturation, the connectivity and the order degree. The rational range of the saturation, the connectivity and the order degree are discussed. This research provides the precondition and foundation for the dynamic traffic control. The dynamic traffic zoning process and constraints of zoning are proposed according to the basic thought of hierarchical production planning and the performance requirements of the traffic zones.

articleTitle: ZF Code-Aided Narrow-Band Interference Suppression for Synchronous DS-CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes zero-forcing (ZF) code-aided narrow-band interference (NBI) rejection in synchronous direct-sequence code-division multiple access (DS-CDMA) systems of complex channel circumstance. The performance of decoding is badly affected based on general ZF code-aided techniques because of the phase of complex gain accounting for channel effects. The system based on modified ZF code-aided technique could cancellate or relieve the effects but attend by high computational complexity. So this paper designs a new optimal restrictive ZF code-aided technique to solve this problem without the increasing of computational complexity. The conclusion is approved by experiments.

Index Terms: Direct Sequence Code Division Multiple Access

articleTitle: Eco-efficiency Analysis of Residential Development: The Case of Nanjing, China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since huge natural price has been paid for Chinese real estate industry development including residential development, the economic value added and environmental impact added should be considered synchronously to evaluate the development roundly and impersonally, which is the concept and methodology of eco-efficiency. In this paper, the product of Floor Space of Residential Building Completed and Selling Price of Residential Building, indicators from annual China Statistical Yearbook, and the ecological footprint are selected as the economic value added and the environmental impact added of residential development respectively, which are also the numerator and denominator in calculating the eco-efficiency value. Then the ecological footprint and eco-efficiency model of residential development are established successively, and based on which Nanjing's residential development in 2005 is analyzed empirically. Results show that the ecological footprint and eco- efficiency are 459786.88 gha and 48399 RMB yuan per gha respectively, and the latter should be improved greatly due to its smallness.

articleTitle: Engineering Construction Accident Prediction and Controlling Technology Based on Grade of Likelihood of Accident Occurrence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper discusses the classification on the grade of likelihood of accident occurrence in prediction and severity of the consequences of accidents, based on construction characteristics of large and medium-sized projects and questions put forward in site safety management. Practically, the likelihood of accident occurrence is classified into five fuzzy grades. Under the premise conditions of probable occurrence of low probability accidents, the paper modifies the theory of "probable occurrence" and "improbable occurrence". And it classifies severity of the consequences of accident into four grades and introduces the identification of grade and accident control technology in detail.

articleTitle: Self-Motivator Factors of Senior Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the greatest turning period coming-the dominance of the community changing from the monetary and physical capital to the knowledge resource and human capital, knowledge workers has become the halo group of the society, who are considered as the most valuable asset of the organizations in the 21st century. The senior knowledge workers are workers who engage in productions, creations, expansions and applications of the knowledge with scientific research skills and managerial capabilities. They work extensively in scientific research institutes, higher education organizations like universities and colleges, as well as technological enterprises. Since the nature of the work, the senior knowledge workers are highly autonomous, strong self-worth, thirst for achievements and capabilities improvements. The aim of the research is to find a new motivational way to improve the work effectiveness of the senior knowledge workers. According to the analysis on the academic background and research fruits of 116 Chinese Chang Jiang Scholars awarded by the Chinese Ministry of Education, we anatomize the individual characters of the senior knowledge workers and find that five factors, namely achievements and challenges, individual growth, autonomy, recognition and oriented-goals, influence the motivational effect of the senior knowledge workers, which are called self-motivator factors. The true meaning of the motivation is not the external excitation, but the self-excitation. We build an individual incentive model based on self-motivator factors, which is a combination of the core circle of senior knowledge workers, the chain of self-motivator factors and the ring of individual characters.

articleTitle: Testing for Invariance of Employee Turnover Intention Model: Multi-Group Comparison Between Knowledge Workers and Traditional Staff
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Employee turnover is one of the most durable issues in both organizational behavior research and human resource management practice. Although a great deal of employee turnover models has been well established, much of these researches have not considered the differences between occupation groups. In an effort to fill this theoretical gap, the present study attempted to provide an examination of a turnover intention model and some of the predictors across two groups: knowledge workers and traditional staff, and then distinguished their different influencing mechanisms on employee turnover intention. This study used multi-group structural equation modeling techniques as a cross-validation procedure to investigate whether the proposed model remained stable across two samples. The empirical examination was also conducted. The results based on 606 employees' responses from two occupational categories indicate that four antecedents are significantly associated with employee turnover intention mediated by job satisfaction and organizational commitment. This study finds the model with an adequate level of configural invariance across two groups. However, the corresponding regression weights are significantly different. The findings suggest that both researchers and practitioners should take into consideration not only the organizational factors, but also the occupational type while exploring the process of employee turnover.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply and Demand Side Risk Management: Options Analyses on the Interruptible Load and Risk Insurance Contract
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In circumstances of the deregulated electric power industry, risks are directly brought to the power supply or demand side by impacts from natural disasters, technology faults, or supply and demand variations. This paper analyzes the effective risk management measures through trading participated by the power supply company, power customer and financial institution. Based on the options relations analyses, the structural characteristic, the function of insurance, the incentive and compensative mechanism, and the pricing model of the interruptible load contract are mainly discussed, together with further discussion on the structure and application of exterior power supply insurance.

articleTitle: Automatic Vehicle Classification Based on Video with BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The classification and statistics of the vehicles type in the road section are important parameters for the traffic management and control. The paper put forward the vehicle classification using image invariant moment and BP neural networks.
