articleTitle: Comparative Study on Technology Standardization of Civil Engineering between China and Europe
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Civil Engineering standards are the technical principles, targets and principles of the limits of the application in field of Civil Engineering. And they are the basic principles to engage in Civil Engineering. Comparatively studying on standards system, management system for standards and operation system for standards in the field of civil engineering between China and Europe , we can learn the advantages of European on civil engineering standards in the field of standards level, standardized organization, the drafting, adoption conversion of standards, and the relationship between European standards and the standards of European countries. And the development direction is suggested in the aspect that how to reform and improve technology standards of civil engineering in China, so that the foundation for effective management for civil engineering industry will be made solid in China.

articleTitle: An Improved Peeling Decoder Scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the channel coding over binary erasure channel (BEC), peeling decoder (PD) is one of the most powerful and efficient decoder, especially suitable for the transmission of multimedia streams. In this paper, an improved PD scheme is proposed that can recover some or all lost information bits that a traditional PD fails. Simulation results show that the performance of the decoder is improved effectively with a small increase in computational complexity.

articleTitle: Applications of SOM2W Network for Stock Companies Comprehensive Assessment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An improved model based on Kohonen neural network, called self-organizing map neural network with two winners (SOM2W), is applied to assess stock companies in this paper. In addition, in order to improve the precision of solutions, tabu-mapping method is also used to avoid that the same output node is mapped by more than one input. The clustering analysis for the stock is also done by using SOM2W neural network in this paper. The financial indexes reflecting the comprehensive capability of stock company as main research objects including income per thigh, clean asset per thigh, profit rate of clean asset. Experimental results show that SOM2W network is feasible and effective to assess and select stocks, it could provide a new reference basis for government and investors, which has potential applications in the financial field.

articleTitle: EL-MAC Protocol for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: EL-MAC, a contention-based MAC protocol, is proposed in this paper. EL-MAC is efficient and low-latency for the WSN. By cross-layer operating, nodes build the data forwarding chain (DFC) by contending means and staggered wake up in proper time so that packets could be duly forwarded as more hops as possible in a cycle and the latency decline greatly. The simulation results show that EL-MAC has lower latency and higher throughput with less energy consumption on the same environment condition than S-MAC.

articleTitle: Web Service Discovery Based on the Cooperation of UDDI and DF
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present Web services are thought as the revolution of the next generation e-commerce and its technical architectures include UDDI, WSDL, SOAP, XML and so on. Web service discovery is one of the most important parts in the web service architectures. The paper first compares current service retrieval technologies, and then shows the problem that UDDI, which is the current discovery mechanism, cannot understand the content of web service. The paper presents two discovery mechanisms based on the cooperation of UDDI and DF based on the standard of FIPA and gives the system composition and DF registry work flow to show how to realize web discovery. At last the paper verifies the feasibility of the two given methods through two examples and some figures and tables. With the help of agent and ontology, the problem can be tackled by the cooperation of UDDI and ontology query mechanism DF based on the standard of FIPA. It can make up for UDDI and improve the efficiency of web service discovery.

articleTitle: The Application of Power Plant Construction Investment Estimation Based on Improved Neural Network by PSO
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using BP neural network estimate the investment of the power plant construction project is this paper's innovative points. First we give the engineering characteristic factors of power plant construction project, then give the value of each qualitative index. Then use improved BP neural network by PSO to estimate the investment. From the result, we can see that is more accuracy and speedily than BP neural network algorithm. Lastly, we can get a satisfaction result. This can be guiding the project construction investment.

articleTitle: The Study of Multi-User Diversity Technology Over the MIMO-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently, orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) has become a popular technique for transmission of signals over wireless channels. Also, multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is one of the most promising technologies for assisting fading and improving link reliability without sacrificing bandwidth efficiency. The combination of OFDM and MIMO seems to be the key technology in next generation high-rate wireless mobile systems. First, this paper introduces the MIMO technology, point out that the combination of OFDM and MIMO seems to be very promising when aiming at the design of very high-rate wireless mobile systems. Secondly, describes the application of OFDM and outlines the block diagrams of an OFDM modulator and demodulator and a MIMO-OFDM system. Then, study several methods for combining the different diversity at the receiver, analyze the performances of diversity in OFDM-MIMO system with simulation results. Finally, achieves the conclusions.

articleTitle: Global Dynamic Modular Innovation Networks: A New Industrial Architecture Supporting Global Dispersive Innovation Synergy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the age of globalization and innovation dispersing, globalization of manufacturing and innovation has changed the global innovation paradigm, industrial structure and enterprise competition roadmap dramatically. The amalgamation trend of global innovation networks is transforming the global and local innovation trajectory from centralized control orientation to orderly dispersive collaboration orientation. So it is vital for nations, local industrial clusters and enterprises to build the core competences for sustainable development through efficiently catching, utilizing and integrating global dispersive innovation resources. Global modular innovation mechanism is a more and more significant pattern for linking global manufacturing networks and dispersive local innovation resources such as creative design, R&D, valuable marketing originality, effective synergic innovation mechanism in local clusters, and so on. This paper develops a conceptual framework that explore the concept, structure, advantages and characters of a new emerged global innovation pattern, namely global dynamic modular innovation network GDMIN, and explain an the mechanism and structure of GDMIN pattern.

articleTitle: The Evaluation and Warning of Human Resource Management Risk in Engineering Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Evaluation and warning of human resource management risk can reduce potential risk in engineering management. On the basis of consulting a lot of relevant reference and investigating projects, it was built that evaluation index system and warning model of project human resource management with fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and classification and genetic analysis of project human resource management risk The research data and analysis result can give a warning, which help organization to take effective pertinent measures, and avoid or reduce loss brought by human resource management risk to a greater extent.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Competitiveness of Construction Projects from the Perspective of Construction Main Bodies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper firstly presents the concept, the competitiveness of construction projects, from the competition's perspective and the difference between construction projects competitiveness and competitiveness of the construction units. Secondly, the article describes the how the competitiveness of construction projects come out and analyzes the relationship between the competitiveness of construction projects and the competitiveness of the main body to evaluate the competitiveness of construction projects. Finally, by applying combination of fuzzy mathematics, the actual competitiveness of the construction projects could be evaluated.

articleTitle: Conceptual Framework of Technology Commercial Perspective Analysis Based on Patent
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The new technical commercial prospective analysis contains the commercial potential of new technology and successful factors of new technology with commercial potential. The conceptual framework for analyzing the commercial potential of new technology has been not gotten though people work on the questions for a long time. This paper put forward a new conceptual framework for analyzing the commercial potential of new technology based on patent analysis in evaluating stage of technology development, the quality of technology, the technology opportunities and the key problems being worked upon in technology development.

articleTitle: Research of Free Rides in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A consumer "free rides" when the customer uses services at one retailer (e.g., test or examines clothing), but purchases the merchandise at another retailer (for example, an online store). This paper examines the impact of free riding and E-commerce on the provision of retail services by focusing on two types of consumer heterogeneity. Consumers are heterogeneous with regard to: location and their preferences for purchasing online vs. offline. In a sense, consumer riding is analogous to a theft of services. It is difficult to see how the retailer providing services could benefit from consumer free riding. None the less, we established models to analyze this phenomenon and find that, under certain circumstances, the retailer providing services does benefit from consumer free riding. As consumer free increases, the E-commerce retailer becomes more competitive and raises prices, thereby reducing competition with the conventional retailer. Consumer free riding softens competition between the conventional retailer (who provides the services) and the E- commerce retailer (who sometimes makes the sale).

articleTitle: Where to Find New Business Opportunity: Strategic Field Enlarging and Shrinking
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Two methods are given about where to find new business opportunity in this paper, one is based on environment analysis and the other one is based on resource and competence analysis. These two methods are needed to be combined, We should cope with the problems the field of opportunities is too small or too large. In this study we use the concept of set and field of Maths.

articleTitle: Research on the Implementation of Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem Based on Object-Oriented Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the fast development of cryptography research and computer technology, the cryptosystems of RSA and Diffe-HelIman are getting more and more unsafe, and Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem is becoming the trend of public cryptography in the future. This paper mainly uses object-oriented technology as tools, and divides Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem into several layers, every of which corresponds a class. The properties and methods of these classes are discussed, and some methods are implemented. In the end, the advantages are analyzed, and the cryptosystem implemented with advanced programming language is easy to transplant.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Layer Resource Allocation Algorithm for Heterogeneous Services in OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new cross-layer urgent bit first (CLUBF) scheduling mechanism is proposed and analyzed in the paper. The proposed algorithm focuses on cross-layer resource allocation scheme for heterogeneous services in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing access (OFDMA) downlink systems. And the CLUBF scheduling mechanism is operated over four steps: (1) traffic mapping: dividing traffic into UB (urgent bit) part, which represents the quality of service (QoS) and has service differentiation, and non-UB part, which means that no QoS is required and doesn't have service differentiation. (2) Resource allocation procedures for traffics' UB part and non-UB part, which aims to satisfy traffic QoS, maximize the system throughput and keep fairness among users. (3) Power and bit adjustment jointly to improve further performance. Besides, as fully indicated by simulation results, the proposed algorithm can improve system throughput and can reduce the compute complexity, which means that the proposed algorithm is a better choice for downlink scheduling.

articleTitle: Program Security Inspection: Model and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Current approaches for malicious code defense are mostly signature-scanning and execution-monitoring. Limited by the undecidability of malicious codes, they can't defend against unknown attacks effectively. This paper investigates an integrity measurement and access control combined program security inspection model. On initial system setup, it indexes all known and trusted programs by both the identifiers and the integrity signatures of them in a white list (WL). During system running time, it measures integrity signature of each program file to be loaded and verifies it with WL. By disallowing unknown or unexpectedly modified programs from running, the model guarantees that only trusted programs can be invoked. Not relying on signatures of malicious codes, it is not limited by their undecidability and therefore is able to combat both known and unknown attacks with no false results. The model is implemented in Windows 2000/XP with neither source code nor binary level modifications to the Windows OS is required by using the technology of kernel mode file system filter driver. To improve the usability of the implementation, an administrative utility is created to censor new programs which came after the initial system setup. Those from trusted origins and not altered after release are thought to be secure and are added to WL for them to work normally.

articleTitle: A Study on Random Autonomous Algorithm for Service Survivability Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present in this paper a scheduling algorithm towards the service migration uncertainty that aims to enhance the service survivability in the server cluster system. Survivable scheduling algorithm is one of the important aspects of survivability study. This paper introduced the stochastic mechanism in the server cluster systems, which made it uncertain of the services migration among the servers, so as to increase the difficulty for the intruders penetrating the systems, and enhanced the system survivability. In this work, we introduced the layers of survivability study, illustrated the function of the survivable scheduling algorithm; then, analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of the exist scheduling algorithms; promoted a pseudo-random autonomous algorithm for service survivability scheduling, including generating the scheduling sequence and the Markov-based autonomous competition mechanism, the performance of the algorithm is investigated at last.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Filtering of OWL Text Based on Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to overcome the defects of traditional-method filtering which based on keywords, the OWL text filtering is presented in the semantic Web environment, which makes information filtering, has been raised to the level of semantics. Through distinguishing the information between the title and text, and then calculating the semantic similarity of semantic, using the integrated filtering methods, the effect of filtering would be more efficient and accurate.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Fuzzy Assessment Model for Selecting Shipping Operation Organization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There are so many factors whose assessment is fuzzy needed to be taken into account when the shipping operation organization is selected. A fuzzy hierarchical model is presented in this paper based on analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy logic on consideration of technical parameters, technical program. By calculation comparison of indicators from 8 shipping technical programs, shipping operation organizations are prioritized from their comprehensive assessment where ships are classified into proper usage scopes and suitable shipping operation organizations are recommended, in the end an optimization operation organization is suggested.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Model of Regional Logistics Environment Based on Multi-Level Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, governments take more attention on the regional logistics industry. But the regional logistics plan is very difficult to implement, because it lacks the scientific and effective evaluation on current situation of the regional logistics environment. This paper designs the following indexes, including logistics line, logistics center construction, logistics information platform construction, logistics policy, modern logistics market, modern logistics education training and profession standard etc 7 second-class evaluation indexes and 29 third-class indexes, So we set up 4 layers system of evaluation index and make use of multi-level fuzzy synthetic evaluation method, combining AHP and Delphi to evaluate performance of regional logistics environment.

articleTitle: A New Game Model of Nodes' Strategies in P2P Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The heterogeneity of P2P nodes' strategies has serious affect on the service performance of P2P network. Many incentive mechanisms based on game models of nodes' strategies are proposed to limit node's malicious actions. However, most of them don't take the diversity of nodes' types and the complexity of nodes' strategies into account, as well as the asymmetry of nodes' information. So the game models wouldn't imitate actual behavior and the incentive mechanisms based on them are not effective. This paper presents a new game model of nodes' strategies in P2P network, referring to the perspective of human society. The model classifies nodes' strategies to several sets according to their types, and analyzes the transfer conditions of different strategies. Finally, this paper simulates the evolution of the game model and the evolutionary results show similarity with real P2P network environment.

articleTitle: Fast Adaptive Algorithms for Updating Variable Length Equalizer Based on Exponential
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Adaptive linear equalizers are commonly used in wireless systems to reduce the distorting effects of the channel. One of the key parameters to be determined is the length of the equalizer. In a time varying scenario, the optimum length may vary as a result of changes in the environment. Two fast convergence adaptive length updating algorithms based on exponential function are proposed to regulate the length of the equalizer according to the instantaneous channel conditions. Simulation results show that the algorithms can track even a very fast changing channel.

articleTitle: Building an Experimental Teaching Platform of IS Development Factory Based on Virtual Company
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Experimental teaching is considered to become more and more important in economics and management, at present, there are some problem in information and management laboratories. In this article, a new experimental teaching system is proposed, which is based on virtual company, and students are encouraged to think lonely in the system, there are simulation of environment of IS development and jobs roles. Student through role playing, regard actual project as original version, launch omni-directional simulation about information system project set up, consulting, planning, analyzing, designing, implement and testing etc., form an intact information system development factory. During the past two years of testing the practice teaching system, it has a good impact on improving students' ability of innovative practice.

articleTitle: A Cost Decision Model for Choosing JIT Purchasing or EOQ Purchasing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Whether to use JIT or EOQ purchasing for a manufacturer is affected by many factors. The total purchasing cost and their cost item is detailed respectively and a difference cost function presented between the EOQ and JIT purchasing. Then the solution and its numerical description are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on The Model of Concession Pricing of BOT Project of Sewage Treatment: Based on Real Option and Time Series
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Empirical study of sewage treatment projects in Dalian reflects that concession price is a critical factor in the negotiation of BOT (build-operation-transfer) . Aimed to the flaws of the existing models, relevant elements of a contractual package are treated as a form of real option. At the same time, a model called ARMA (an autoregressive-moving average process of order) is used to estimate one key variable of the Black-Scholes model. After calculating, the result is smaller than that calculated by other traditional models. So, using this method, governments' guarantees or alternative forms are evaluated quantitatively, which means this method strikes a balance between risk and benefit.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation in IP/MPLS Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper shows the results from a study on data transmission with different characterization (best-effort, high-priority best-effort and two types of real time traffic) through the switching protocol for multi-protocol labels in IP networks, compared to the IP data transmission using the asynchronous transfer mode. This study illustrates the best performance the MPLS shows under a network congestion. The NS_2 discrete event simulator was used as experimentation tool.

articleTitle: A Reflection-Based Approach for Reusing Software Architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Reusing software architecture, which is a kind of coarse-grained software resources at design time, is always a very difficult problem in the realm of software engineer. We consider that the lack of information and techniques, which support the process of reusing software architecture, may result in this problem. So this paper proposes an approach, called ArchBean, which can provide information and technical support for the reuse of architectural level design. ArchBean includes two important basic constituents: RIM4RSA-reflective information model for reusing software architecture and R-ADL. In this paper, we firstly introduce RIM4RSA which can provide information support for creation of reusable architecture resource by modeling architectural information and meta- information. Then we illustrate an architecture description language, called R-ADL, which can provide technical support for description of the reusable software architecture constructed in term of RIM4RSA. Moreover, we demonstrate the main implementation processes of ArchBean.

articleTitle: Improving Logistical Performance through Supply Chain Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There is an abundance of information that outlines every new concept and idea on how to improve supply chain performance. But what works for one customer or company/industry will not necessarily work for another. In the world of supply chain, the one-size-fits-all tools no longer exist now. Companies that indiscriminately adopt new supply chain strategies many find their efforts failed. So the key to supply chain success lies in flexibly providing with customers tailed supply chains and matching the right strategies with right situation. The paper describes a framework for how to identify distinct supply chains and provide tailor-made supply chain solutions to customers to improve the total supply chain performance.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Manufacturing Execution System Based on Events
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a reconfigurable manufacturing execution system (RMES) based on events is researched. The system can acquire real-time information from control system. The basic infrastructure of the RMES is proposed. The key idea of the RMES is to define several meta-events according to the characteristics of production process. Many events are composed of several meta-events. All function modules can integrate together through events. Because of events, reconfigurability of the system can be achieved.

articleTitle: Clipping Noise Mitigation for OFDM System with Large Clipping Ratio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel clipping noise mitigation algorithm for OFDM system with large clipping ratio is proposed. We notice that the situation that there is only one sample above the clipping level appears with a large probability and the clipping noise on each subcarrier can be estimated in this case. Simulation result shows that the proposed algorithm can mitigate the clipping noise effectively.

articleTitle: A Provable-Security Mutual Authenticated Key Agreement Protocol for Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the area of mobile communication security, a key agreement protocol with mutual authentication is very essential to the following secure sessions between communicators and more attentions are paid to the provability of the protocol security. Based on Blake-Wilson's work, the new notions of secure AK and AKC protocols are defined. An efficient authenticated key agreement protocol for mobile communication setting is proposed, which can be proved a secure AK protocol in Bellare-Rogaway's model with the new notions of secure AK and AKC protocols. Additionally, compared with other protocols, this protocol only spends moderate computation cost, so it is quite practical.

articleTitle: Low Complexity Soft Decision-Aided Equalizer for Turbo Equalization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This letter presents a soft decision-aided equalizer (SDAE), which combines linear equalizer and soft feedback interference canceller. In contrast to common turbo principle which only uses the extrinsic information from the decoder, the SDAE uses the full soft output channel decoding information and the equalizer outputs as a-prior input for the equalizer. The filter parameters of the SDAE are updated based on the minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion. Its coefficients depend on the quality of the feedback information which changes with each iteration. The complexity is only linear with the length of the filters. Simulation results show that SDAE outperforms another similar structure of approximately same complexity for severely intersymbol interference (ISI) channel and can compare favorably with linear equalization (LE) with time varying filter coefficients.

articleTitle: Multi-Region Negotiation Game for Water Resource Management of River Basin
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Water resource environment conflict becomes the important factors of endangering the peace and stability of regions and restricting the sustainable development of theirs. Many cross area issues of water resources environment are the game outcomes among regional governments who compete for resources and environment for their own regional benefit. It has become one of the important duties of water resources management to alleviate the water resources conflict of river basin and to promote the negotiation and cooperation between regions. From the macro-perspective, combined with the management of water resources environment in China, a model of multi-region game is constructed in this paper. The interactive compromise procedure for multi-region game is given to solve the multi-region game, in which the theory of negotiation for multi-objective game and the method of interactive multi-objective decision making are integrated and the public decision-making is considered. This procedure provides an efficient method of preventing from and alleviating water resources conflict in a river basin and a feasible realized platform for public participation and group decision-making in water resources management.

articleTitle: Modeling for Facility Location Optimization of Spent Computers' Reverse Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In spent computers reverse logistics, an important planning problem is the location optimization of landfills or treatment facilities for recovering/reusing used products or materials. Combining with the spent computers' taking-back characteristics, after a brief introduction to the basic concepts of reverse logistics, we present a two-level location problem with three types of facility to be located in a specific reverse logistics system. For this problem, we propose a 0-1 mixed integer programming model. Then, an algorithm based on Lagrangian heuristics is developed. Finally, it takes Tai'an city in Shandong Province in China as a case to prove the availability of the model.

articleTitle: The Research on Simulation Method of PHS Network Capacity Enlargement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: High traffic always leads to descending quality of communication, higher lost call rate and increased complaints with the expansion of regional customer scale. Therefore, it is necessary to improve communication quality by enlarging the capacity of base station with the consideration of utilization efficiency of network resources. The difficulty of decision on PHS network capacity enlargement increases for the stochastic characteristic of traffic. The traffic and the base station capacity in a region are simulated by modeling and simulation experiment in this paper. Considering the economy in network resources, a reasonable enlargement plan is given after the effect comparison of different ones. The conclusion shows that multi-objective optimization plan, which also takes the stochastic characteristic of traffic into account, can be obtained by Monte Carlo simulation in the decision on PHS network capacity enlargement.

articleTitle: A New Method for Signal Path NLOS Effect Mitigating
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a three base stations position method based on signal path non-line-of-sight (NLOS) effect mitigating is presented. Under this condition, only two paths of signal transmission are line-of sight propagation and the other is non-line-of sight propagation. Because the position equation is nonlinear, the position error is sensitive to the origin of reference coordinate. Therefore, the method of coordinate translation is introduced to mitigate the effect of NLOS error. The simulation result shows that this method is effective in NLOS effect mitigating and it is robust in different error magnitude distribution.

articleTitle: Cooperation Between Leader Firm and University and Knowledge Transfer: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The role of the leader firm and university in transferring knowledge in a regional automotive industry is investigated. Through surveying the suppliers located in Liuzhou, China, we collected the data of the industrial engineering (IE) department setting and the number of IE student employed in those enterprises to measure the effect of knowledge transfer. The result shows the leader firm and university spread the IE knowledge in the regional automotive industry.

articleTitle: Method Selection for Complicated Equipment R&D with Consideration of Technique, Cost and Time
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Usually, there are different objectives and units of measurement related to technique, cost and time in R&D process, which make it more complicated to select R&D methods, let alone decision making with comprehensive consideration of the balance among them. The theory of multi-objective programming, mixed integer programming and critical path is herein used to establish a multi-objective programming model. In this model, constraints are based on the respective objectives of the factors and the balance among them while the objective function is minimizing the sum of the weighted relative deviation of each object. Besides being used to optimize decision making in the R&D process of complicated equipment, this model is a general form and can also be used in the development of other projects in other fields.

articleTitle: Throughput Limits of IEEE 802.11 and IEEE 802.15.3
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.11 and IEEE 802.15.3 are wireless standards originally designed for wireless local area network (WLAN) and wireless personal area network (WPAN). This paper studies MAC throughput analysis of both standards. We present a comparative analysis of both standards in terms of MAC throughput and bandwidth efficiency. Numerical results show that the performance of IEEE 802.15.3 transcends IEEE 802.11 in all cases.

articleTitle: Target Tracking Based on Connected Dominating Set in WSN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Target tracking application in WSN should solve the problem of target status sharing well. To overcome the shortages of DCTC and cluster-based method, method using connected dominating set based aggregation tree is introduced. According to whether node has the capability of locating, target status information can be shared in aggregation tree by broadcast or unicast. Because of the structure stability of aggregation tree, target can be continuously monitored while it shift between different coverage area of sensors. The target status reaches base station after step by step data fusion in the aggregation tree, which will greatly reduce redundant packets to save node energy.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Risk and Risk Allocation in Agent-Construction System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Government investment projects play important roles in the economy of China. As one of the significant reform methods, agent-construction system is in favor for assuring the specialized management and overcoming deficiencies exit in public projects. However, the current risk allocation in agent-construction system is unreasonable and partly results in low performance of this system. The different risk of government investor, user and agent are analyzed in the paper and the risk comparison between them is presented. The reasonable risk distribution principles and suggestions are put forward according to the current administrative system.

articleTitle: The Use of Multivariate Quality Control Chart in Solving the Thin-Film Thickness Uniformity Quality Problem - a Plasma Sputtering Case in TFT-LCD Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sputtering process is very important in the TFT-LCD manufacturing processes. During manufacturing, a glass (raw material) is plated with a thin metallic coating, which serves as the color frame for the LCD panels. The sputtering coating thickness affects the final quality of products, so the thin-film thickness uniformity issue has to be considered in this process. In the measurements of thin-film thickness uniformity diagnosis, the basis of diagnosis is the mean thickness of a thin-film which is measured in fixed positions on a glass. The measurement of quality in the sputtering process is apt to generate erroneous judgment and not to conform to the quality requirement of thickness uniformity effectively in the sputtering process. The issue of quality measurement of the thin-film thickness uniformity for (plasma) sputtering in TFT-LCD manufacturing is discussed. An effective method is provided in order to diagnose the conforming and nonconforming items. The mean, standard deviation and range of the thickness are adopted as the quality characteristics, as opposed to the general approach that only considers thickness mean. In this study, the x-bar control chart and multivariate quality control chart are used to diagnose the thick quality of sputtering process separately. These application studies demonstrate that, in comparison to traditional control charts, the multivariate quality control chart is more accurate and efficient.

Index Terms: Thin Film Transistor Liquid Crystal Display

articleTitle: Trust in International Electronic Commerce: A Study of Chinese Companies Engaged in International Trade
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the role of trust in the adoption of international electronic commerce (IEC) by Chinese firms engaged in international trade was empirically investigated by a questionnaire survey of international trade professionals in Chinese firms. The major findings are that, first of all, the adoption of the risky components of IEC by Chinese firms is relatively low. Secondly, their adoption of the risky components of IEC is only directly related to positive past experience in IEC, which, in turn, is directly related to positive past experience in traditional international trade with a particular partner. The limitations of this study and directions for future research are also discussed.

articleTitle: Application of WB Electricity Transducer In the Extruder Electricity Measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By setting the ratio of current transducers and revising the active power revised parameters, the system can display the real consumed electricity and power in LDC. Also the reading is convenient and the measuring accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Study on Volatilities of Freight by Different Operations in Panamax Dry Bulk Shipping Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper aims to develop a methodology to compare different shipping operations, taking Panamax dry bulker as an example, which are of different features against risks incurred by the volatilities in shipping market. After basic statistical analysis on the volatilities, R/S (Rescaled Range) method and GPH (Geweke & Porter Hudak) method are employed to test the persistence of the volatilities. Moreover FIEGARCH (Fractionally Integrated Generalized Auto Regression Conditional Heteroskedastic) is furthered to model characteristics of the volatilities in the market, which demonstrates that different feedback against the volatilities lie in different shipping operational properties. Hereby decision makers can make an evaluation on different shipping operations and then implement the optimal one to smooth impacts of the fluctuations in shipping market.

articleTitle: Capital Supply Chain in Financial Markets: A RMB financing Case
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The methodology of the supply chain can be applied to many subjects. The capital management in financial markets embodies the characteristics of the supply chain completely. The research on the capital supply chain in financial markets using the method of the supply chain can not only broaden the range of the research on supply chain, but also contribute to the efficient capital management in financial markets. This paper is an attempt to apply the method of the supply chain to the capital management in financial markets. We define the capital supply chain in financial markets firstly, then we developed a structure model of the capital supply chain in financial markets and a quantification model of the supply chain of the RMB financing transaction by the supply chain method and black box method of the system science to lay a research foundation for the quantification of the capital supply chain in financial markets.

articleTitle: A Longitudinal Study on e-Auction Adoption
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There are 2,565 auction Web sites on online-auction list reports. Therefore, to understand consumers intention in using online auction and royalty is a critical issue. Yet, few studies have made on users intention to use online auction. Even though extensive researches focus on online shopping intention, however, we can not consider they both are same on use intention. Because online auction is involve three different counterparts: bidder, auctioneer, and online auction Web site, including dynamic bidding price. This paper is a step forward in using qualitative method trying to understand the in C2C online auction behavior. Specifically, the purpose of this study is using longitudinal approach in data collection in order to explore possible theoretical constructs to explain users schema change. The data collection involved three rounds and every round takes 5 weeks. Our findings highlight the importance of transaction cost economics perspective, trust, perceived risk, and information asymmetric after on-line auction usage. Implications of the results are discussed.

articleTitle: An Approach of Monitoring the Supply of Products in a Supply Chain Based on Hybrid Machine Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The fuzzy logic is applied to resolve the monitoring problem of products quality and products quantity which are increasingly varying as market requirement. A series of fuzzy rules are employed and the fuzzy system may generate suggested supply change rate. At the same time, the operation of supplier is also dynamically changing and the evaluation and selection for supplier are the basis of supply chain cooperation. So whether it is scientific to select a supplier is crucial for sustaining and developing a company. Therefore, in this paper the neural network is introduced to dynamically assess suppliers and recommend to substituting for new ones when necessary, only supplementing fuzzy logic system with its advantages. The methodology is described for the deployment of this proposed hybrid approach to enhance the machine intelligence of a supply chain network with the description of a case study to exemplify its underlying principles.

articleTitle: Six Sigma Management in China: Status and Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quantitative analysis of literatures indicates that organizations with better management groundwork compose the main body applying the Six Sigma Management (SSM) in China. The history of SSM in China can be divided into three periods: sprouting period, attempting period and expanding period. Quantitative analysis of literatures also shows that, in China, SSM is more frequently applied in service areas than in manufacturing areas today. Therefore, the spread of SSM in China was quite different from that in foreign countries where application of SSM in service areas was later than in manufacturing areas. Based on comprehensive literature review, an integrated strategy model which can give clews to the employment of SSM is developed. According to the model, organizations employing SSM should aim at Six Sigma organization building rather than merely the improvement of quality of their product; Six Sigma culture plays necessary role in Six Sigma organization building; Six Sigma knowledge managing, project executing and incentive system building make up the approach by which Six Sigma organization might be built; Resource and management foundation are restrictions when SSM is employed. Guided by the model, four topics have been suggested for further discussion.

articleTitle: The Frameworks and Mechanisms of Establishing the Ecological Company
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyses the consequence between "human- center doctrine" and ecologic crisis, and puts forward a new commercial mode-ecologic company which is responsible to the society and environments. And then it discusses connotation, basic mind of ecologic company, and the difference between the ecologic company and the traditional company. At last, this paper explores emphatically on main challenges, framework construction, internal mechanism and external mechanism in establishing the ecologic company.

articleTitle: Joint Sphere Detector and User Scheduling in Multiuser MIMO Uplink System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a joint design scheme between sphere decoding and user scheduling for multiuser MIMO uplink system. This is a cross layer design scheme which adopt the channel quality information based on user scheduling to reduced the search radius of sphere detector, it leads the better bit error ratio performance and low complexity than conventional sphere detection with fixed search radius.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Study of Coordinated Development of Regional Society and Economy Based on DEA/SCA Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper refers that the phenomenon of getting rid of some important DEA evaluation indicators often occurs when data envelopment analysis(DEA) method is applied in the evaluation problems of regional economy, and points out a DEASCA method of combining DEA with static comparative analysis (SCA). Taking Shaanxi province for an example, it establishes the evaluation indicators system of the coordinated development level of regional society and economy, evaluates the development status, and points out the critical factors which constrain the coordinated development of economy and society in Shaanxi province.

articleTitle: Innovative Mechanism and its Auto-Reinforced System in Chinese Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In Chinese industrial cluster, the innovation mechanism has a self-reinforced system if there is no external intervene. According to Game analysis on the self-reinforced system of companies' innovation mechanism industry clusters, the result shows that it is easy for cooperation innovation in the industry cluster to have a phenomena of 'free rider' if the its cooperation innovation is only in short term, whereas it has a self-reinforced mechanism of cluster innovation in long term. Therefore, as it normally forms self-reinforced mechanism without some external driving force, Chinese government shall provide its preferential policies to grow the innovation and gradually cease the super-treatment.

articleTitle: The Business Value of Information Technology in Product Development Process: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper establishes a multilevel business value model of information technology in the product development process by adopting the grounded theory, which not only identifies the key IT variables and pertinent intermediate variables, but also discovers the interaction and complementary characteristics of these variables. By collecting data in five telecommunication equipment suppliers, the proposed model shows that, IT affects the product profit indirectly via the interaction between IT and the intermediate variables from different levels. The complementary factors must be in good relationships for the sake of gaining more product profit.

articleTitle: Research on Seller's Shill Bid Strategy When Buyers Have Independent Private Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the rapid development of e-commerce, online auction has taken more and more proportion in the business. In online auction, bidders bid for a good on the Internet, which makes it difficult to find and bound the bidders' action, so cheating, say shilling by the seller, has become a popularity in online auction. Because it is so easy for a seller to bid in an online auction, then how to resist shill in online auction has become a problem worth studying. This paper solves this problem by studying the seller's shill bidding strategies in English auction, first-price sealed auction and second-price sealed auction, and it focuses attention on environment where bidders' evaluation of the good is independent private information. The result shows that if the online auction is an auction of second-price sealed auction, the seller's shill bid is equivalent to the seller's reserve price. Thus if the online auction is a second-price sealed auction, then it is not profitable for the seller to bid a shill price, so the seller will not engage in shill bidding. Because second-price sealed auction is not an auction which can easily be understood by the bidder, the paper gives some propositions on how to hold a second-price sealed auction on the Internet.

articleTitle: The Promoting Effects Assessment on Human Capital and Science and Technology Advancement to Economic Growth: Taking Korea As an Example
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to appraise the contribution rate of the human capital and science and technology advancement to economic growth, most of researchers have used new growth theory at present. But in this paper, there is the formidable problem no matter in theory or on the method. Takes Korea as an example, this paper approaches the contribution rate of the human capital and science and technology advancement to economic growth. It is calculated that the economic growth of Korea follows the model which takes the material capital as the main power and innovation as the secondary power between 1970 and 1997. But after financial crisis in 1997, the way of economic growth had transformed into the double impetus of investment - innovation. The contribution rate of the material capital growth to economic growth has reduced to 44.43%. The contribution rate of the innovations has achieved 41.44% (the factor of Technical progress is 24.02%; the factor of human capital innovation is 15.82%; the factor of institution innovation is 1.6%). The proportion of research and development funds that account for GDP has changed form 0.4% in 1970 to 3% in 2006. The average number of schooling years per person has changed from 4.5 years in 1970 to 12.61 years in 2000. The science and technology and the education develop so fast, which powerfully supported the Korea economy for several dozens year.

articleTitle: Strategies of Network Advertisement for Cyber-Marketing Based on User Access Paths
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The marketing theory indicates that the promulgating of network advertisement has a significant impact on the effectiveness of cyber-marketing. Therefore the proper strategy about network advertisement is extremely concerned with the network advertisement releaser. Using the technique of user identification and session identification, the access path (the sequence of visit pages) is analyzed on the Web log data from a certain e-commerce Website. The results show that there is significant difference in the purchasing probability of users in different access paths. According to the analysis of access path, two basic strategies of network advertisement are given.

articleTitle: A Profound Survey of Sensor Networks & Related Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Advances in wireless sensor networks have led to many new protocols specifically designed for sensor networks where energy awareness is an essential consideration. Most of the attention, however, has been given to the routing protocols since they might differ depending on the application and network architecture. Tiny sensor nodes create sensor network. These nodes are severely constrained by energy, storage capacity and computing power. The prominent task of this network is to design proficient routing protocols for to make the node's life last longer. In this paper, we first analyze the requirements of sensor networks and its architecture. Then, we enlighten the existing routing protocols for sensor networks and present a critical analysis of these protocols. The paper concludes with open research issues. At the end of this paper, we compare and contrast these protocols.

articleTitle: An Improved EM Frequency Estimation Algorithm for Burst Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an improved expectation-maximum (IEM) frequency estimation algorithm is discussed, in which the unknown data symbols and the known pilot symbols are exploited jointly in a recursive way. Compared with the data-aided ML estimation, the IEM algorithm can improve the performance without increasing the number of pilot symbols, and is superior in performance to the non-data aided blind estimator at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Furthermore, it avoids converging to a local maximum of the likelihood function rapidly which can deteriorate the estimation performance severely. Simulation results show that IEM estimator, which only use fewer pilot symbols, can provide a good performance close to the CRLB with a large number of pilot symbols at moderately high SNR.

articleTitle: Development of Organization's Learning Culture and its Impact on Organizational Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine the developmental stage of organization's learning culture and its impact on organizational performance. Based on the theoretical framework proposed by Watkins and Marsick, this study conducted questionnaires survey in 48 Chinese organizations and acquired a sample of 325 subjects. The results show that: (1) the developmental stage of organization's learning culture includes initiation, cultivation, growth and mature stage. The level and form of individual learning, team learning and organization learning are different in every stage of organization's learning culture; (2) different ownership types of organizations have differences in the current state of organization's learning culture; (3) organizational performance has been improved significantly with the development of organization's learning culture.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Layer Fuzzy Synthesis Evaluation Model on Scheme Selecting
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: When the power supply scheme is designed, the technical and economic factors of the candidate schemes should be calculated. Since the number of factors that power supply scheme involved is big, such qualitative ones are fuzzy, and the comparison between those factors brings factitious tentative factors. In the paper, we use multi-layer fuzzy synthesis evaluation method to solve this kind of problems, the qualitative factors and secondary factors can be computed. Factors of power supply scheme are analyzed and studied; furthermore, they are divided into two layers. Two layer mathematics model of fuzzy synthesis evaluation method are built. The membership functions of the factors are confirmed according to their different characteristics. The maximum membership value method is used to construct membership functions of the factors according to their characteristics. Then membership values are calculated and the best scheme is chosen. In the end, an application example is given.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of City Fire Control and Rescue Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper analyzes the operation flows and functional requirements of city fire control and rescue system. According to the integrated characteristic of fire alarming, alarm responding, controlling, fire extinguishing, data archiving and other rescue processes, it establishes the fire control and rescue information system model based on network environment and puts forward the corresponding computer network model. The model shows the consistency and integration of city fire control and rescue process, which can improve the speediness, accuracy and scientificity of fire control and rescue.

articleTitle: SD-MOP Integration Model and its Application in Water Resources Plan
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By integrating the system dynamics (SD) and multi-objective programming (MOP), the new approach which is the termed SD-MOP model is proposed. The model is characterized by fully reflecting the initial trends of the system development, accurately explaining both of the structure and function of the system, objectively finding the sensible points of the system, and achieving the optimum solutions of the model, the according the solutions the optimal plan can be designed according practical situation. By applying SD-MOP integrated model, the designed planning proposal can be guaranteed operable, available and optimal level. SD-MOP integrated model is a very useful support tool in optimal decision-making. The new planning approach of SD-MOP integrated model can be used in regional resources planning, especially in formulating sustainable development strategies. In addition, the model can be used to estimate the trends of the system development when the planning program has been implemented.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Replenishment and Pricing with Discount Promotion and Price-Sensitive Stochastic Demand
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Focusing on discount promotion in retailer and stochastic customer demand with price-sensitive, the paper brings forward coordinated replenishment and pricing model that simultaneously determines market price and order quantity. The aim is to maximize expected profit in selling period. The model is proved that it is concave function on price and order quantity and its optimal solution is found out. The numerical example analyzes the effect of discount rate on optimal price, order quantity and expected profit. The results show that (1) optimal price, order quantity and expected profit are concave function on discount rate; (2) expected profit is concave function on price. Under price-sensitive demand, the retailer can maximize expected profit with coordination of order quantity, price and discount rate.

articleTitle: Financial Data Checking of Bank-Campus Multi-Function Card System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The implementation of bank-campus multi-function card system has realized the multi-win among banks, merchant stations, card owners and schools. The paper explores the financial data checking relationships among various entities in the bank-campus multi-function card system, and designs E-R chart and information flow to illustrate. Finally, the paper provides processing of checking , compiling methods of reconciliation statement of balance and checking methods of long-term outstanding entry.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors on the Knowledge Application During Diffusion of Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, electronic commerce has experienced phenomenal growth. Electronic commerce is not only about technology, although a great deal of knowledge is required to apply during diffusion of electronic commerce. Hence, a model is proposed and tested showing how firms promote knowledge application during diffusion of electronic commerce. Based on survey responses from 218 Chinese firms, the results indicate that both internal social capital and learning orientation are significant channels of knowledge application. Moreover, learning orientation plays a mediating role between internal social capital and knowledge application. This finding implies that firms promote knowledge application during diffusion of electronic commerce through fostering internal social capital and developing learning orientation. Managerial implications are explored and future research directions are also identified.

articleTitle: Hypercube-Based Pairwise Key Establishment for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are wireless networks that include sensor nodes with limited resources. For secure sensor communication, pairwise key establishment between sensor nodes is essential. In this paper, we propose a hypercube-based key predistribution scheme. Compared with existing approaches, our scheme has better network resilience against node capture attack, complete network connectivity and no communication overhead.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Knowledge Management Elements of Research Team in University
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Driven by scientific research mission, research team in university, whose ultimate goal is pursuing innovation, creating new knowledge and technology, and cultivating creative talents, is a typical knowledge team. Knowledge can exist in the form of scientific research's outputs and creative talents, which are the objectives of team building. So, successful team management always equals effective knowledge management (KM). Having a core position, knowledge innovation activities happen from end to end in the operation process of university research team. This paper first discussed the knowledge creation process of university research team from the perspective of KM and then defined the systematic elements of KM in research teams. Then data was collected by questionnaire survey and analyzed by employing structural equation model (SEM). The results can be used to explore the impacts that the systematic elements have on KM of university research team and how they impact.

articleTitle: A Time Synchronization Protocol in WSN Applied in RAMR
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Clock synchronization represents a crucial element in the operation of wireless sensor networks (WSN). This paper analyzes many time synchronization protocols in WSN. According to the sources affecting time synchronization and the characteristics of remote automatic wattmeter reading (RAWR), this paper gives an improved algorithm of DMTS, called FU-DMTS and simulates it. Besides transmitting less messages, this algorithm is higher precise than DMTS, and it can meet the requirements of RAWR.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Hi-tech Human Resource Development and Demand Forecast: Based on Survey in Anhui, China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The government of China had promulgated the "Constructing the Innovational Nation" policy since 2005. Enhancing the capability of independent innovation and building an innovation- oriented country has become a major strategic objective. Under this background, developing the high-tech human resources (HR) and industries, promoting the economy of Anhui has become a consensus. According to current technology and demand of economic development of Anhui, this paper took high-tech enterprises, research institutes, and universities in Anhui as study objects, used comparison and classification methods to analyze the development actuality and forecasted the demand and changing tends of high-tech HR based on the survey, in order to provide decision-making supporting for high-tech HR development strategy of Anhui Province.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Study on the Ability of National Economy Mobilization Logistics Center Based on Fuzzy-Grey Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Fuzzy-grey comprehensive evaluation method is a way of judging things and phenomena with fuzzy factors when information is not fully known. The sorting model program established by using fuzzy set theory and grey correlation analysis can be used to deal with the fuzzy and brain comprehensive judgment of grey comprehensive analysis in the process of evaluating and ranking, providing a favorable means for the sort of quantitative analysis. This method can make full use of the fuzziness and grayness of judgment information by the experts, and lead to more objective and accurate evaluation of ability of the mobilization logistics center. When constructing the mobilization logistics center, we can select the one which has the highest ability if there are several positions to choose.

articleTitle: Stereo Video Communication Based on Unequal Error Protection Scheme of LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Stereo video is widely used because it can provide depth information. However, it is difficult to store and transmit stereo video due to the huge data amount. So, high efficient channel encoding algorithm and proper transmission strategy is needed to deal with the video transmission over limited bandwidth channel. In this paper, unequal error protection (UEP) based on low density parity check (LDPC) code was used to transmit stereo video over wireless channel with limited bandwidth. Different correction level LDPC code was used according to the importance of video stream to reconstruction at the receiver. Simulation result shows that the proposed transmission scheme increase the PSNR of reconstructed image, and improve the subjective effect.

articleTitle: IT Project Risk Assessment Using Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Risk assessment, a critical process for project evaluation and investment, is one of the most important steps in IT projects implementation. Current qualitative and quantitative methods include analytic hierarchy process (AHP), artificial neural network (ANN), causality analysis, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, etc. But most of them suffer from one of these two shortcomings: 1) the evaluation process is too subjective; 2) the calculation process of risk assessment is too complicated. In this paper, we proposed an IT project risk assessment model using principal component analysis. It could evaluate the risk with limited input data, clear indicator for stakeholders and within satisfactory calculation time. This model provides a more simple way to avoid risk for IT analyst and experts. An experiment was demonstrated to show the validness of this method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Channel Tracking Algorithm Combined LMS and KALMAN Filter
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Adaptive channel tracking algorithms are studied based on LMS and KALMAN in MIMO-OFDM system. A novel adaptive channel tracking algorithm, which combines the LMS and KALMAN filter to make use of the stabilization of LMS and the accuracy of KALMAN filter, is proposed. On the one side, the algorithm can track and estimate the channel with the optimal MSE, and on the other hand, the algorithm conquers the problem that the KALMAN filter need the transforming between learning pattern and tracking pattern frequently. For the number of training sequence is depressed, so the performance of the communication system is improved.

articleTitle: Web-Based Vertical Information Services for Mining Right Trade
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using Internet and adopting vertical information services can provide more professional, sophisticated, deep information services for mining right trade requestors. This paper proposes web-based vertical information services and constructs its basic architectural model on the basis of the present situation of mining right trade in China. We illustrate workflows of information services for mining right trade by using the Integrated Service Planning and Execution (ISP&E) approach. The proposed model provides personalized information services to fulfill requestors' various requests.

articleTitle: Antecedents and Consequences of Integration Capability on Mobile Networked Applications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although wireless networks and mobile communications can be used for many applications, particular application environments seem to be important. Trust and culture can build particular application environments. This study combines trust, culture theory and knowledge-based perspectives to develop a general model of building integration capability and improving performance. We analyze the model using a structural equation model approach, and 208 firms in China are selected as the samples of this study. The results conclude that: (1) The higher the level of trust, the higher the level of innovation culture; (2) Trust is a function of its integration capability; (3) Trust has no significantly impact on performance; (4) innovation culture is a function of its integration capability; (5) innovation culture has no significantly impact on performance; (6) integration capability will significantly impact on performance. Managerial implications are explored and future research directions are also identified.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact of Electronic Secondary Market on the Perishable Goods Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The advance of business-to-business commerce has result in the establishment of many types of electronic marketplace. This paper focuses on a market exchange as the "secondary market" for the perishable goods-that is, for the resellers to disposal and acquisition of excess perishable goods inventory. Follow the method of Lee and Whang(2002) and Yan(2005), we develop a model of secondary market with second-period selling price endogeneously determined to clear the consumer market.. In this model, one manufacturer and n resellers compose a two-stage supply chain for perishable goods. The sale season is divided into two periods. At the beginning of first period, resellers order directly from the manufacturer, and at the beginning of second period, electronic secondary market opens, resellers can trade inventory among themselves in it. The first-period selling price is endogenously given and the second-period selling price is endogeneously determined by the consumer market clearance condition. We endogenously derive the optimal decisions for the resellers, along with the equilibrium market price of the secondary market and second-period selling price. And based on the analysis of resellers' decisions, we investigate the quantity effect and allocation effect of secondary market.

articleTitle: Optimum Detection with Low Complexity for Collaborative Spatial Multiplexing in Uplink Mobile WiMAX Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In mobile WiMAX systems, uplink collaborative MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) performs spatial multiplexing with two MSs (Mobile Stations), each with one antenna. As two MSs transmit collaboratively on the same subchannel region, the overall uplink capacity will be doubled. To perform this interesting technique with high performance, most system venders demand the optimal MLD (Maximum-Likelihood Detection) in the base station which has at least two antennas. However, the MLD is difficult to implement due to its explosive computational complexity. In this paper, we propose a novel MIMO decoding scheme which achieves optimal performance with low complexity for collaborative spatial multiplexing in uplink mobile WiMAX systems having an iterative channel decoder using bit log-likelihood ratio information. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme has the same block error rate performance of the MLD with only 28% computational complexity in terms of real multiplication, when both MSs transmit with 16QAM.

articleTitle: Model for a Two-Echelon Inventory System with Neighbor Support
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A two-echelon inventory system of repairable items is considered. For the repairable items with high-value and low- demand rate that include condemnation, continuous (S-1,S) ordering strategy is adopted. Neighbor support strategy for inventory pooling is presented to obtain high service levels at a low cost. The premise of neighbor support is that it is more efficient to obtain needed stock from the nearest inventory location that has stock when the local base stocks out. Lateral as well as vertical transshipment are allowed as supplement of normal provision. Simulation algorithms are built to calculate the relevant performance measures of system. Stock optimization is implemented by genetic algorithms. Numerical experiments show that neighbor support can lead to more cost saving in comparison with emergency lateral transshipment.

articleTitle: Quality Management: A Research in the Approach of Competitive Advantage Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper aims at exploring the strategic status of quality as a source of sustained competitive advantage theory, through a critical review of the development of quality management and competitive advantage. Further more, the paper gives Chinese industry some suggestions about how to develop Quality competence to sustain an advantage over foreign competitors.

articleTitle: On the Capacity Bounds of Beamforming over MISO Time-Selective Channels with Estimation Errors and Feedback Delay
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We examine the ergodic capacity of beamforming over a multiple-input single-output (MISO) time-selective channel with channel estimation error and delayed limited feedback.
