At each frame, the receiver obtains the minimum mean squared error estimation of the channel, chooses a transmit beamforming vector, according to the error channel estimation, from a codebook based on random vector quantization design, and feeds back the corresponding index to the transmitter using a finite number of bits. We derive the bounds on the capacity, and show that the tightness of the lower and upper bounds, and the bounds decreasing with the increase of channel estimation error or normalized Doppler spread.

articleTitle: A Graph-Structure-Based Method for Chinese Document Representation towards Clustering Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a graph-structure-based method to represent knowledge for Chinese document clustering. First, we introduce a new knowledge representation method called Graph Space Model (GSM) to convert each document to a graph structure, and then we adopt Maximum Common Subgraph (MCS) to compute the similarities between any two graph structures, which can be further used for document clustering. The results show that the GSM approach can outperform VSM method in representing capability of Chinese documents.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Knowledge Creation and the Way of Knowledge Transfer in University
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In national innovation system university actually play a role to promote innovation ability of our country, and stand in the top level of national innovation. In this paper, through analyzing the classification, the model of the university knowledge creation, the attribute and the character of knowledge of university, the transfer way of the university knowledge are discussed. Therefore, the study of knowledge creation and transfer of university is the best way to satisfy multidimensional character of the quality of higher education, and improve the existing education quality of university.

articleTitle: A Study of Taiwan Takeout Beverage Franchise Chain Business Performance Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the hospitality and service industry have achieved rapid growths. The beverage franchise chain in the food service industry in particular has dominated the consumer market. The total sales of the beverage industry in Taiwan as of Year 2006 are close to US$1.7 billion. In addition, the Takeout Beverage Franchise Chain plays an extremely significant role in the overall beverage market and possesses great development potentials. Although this industry continues to undergo prosperous developments, due to changes in consumption pattern, consumer awareness and value, business operators ought to ponder upon ways to create a bright future in order to increase market share and profitability. This study has combined discussions in literatures reviews and questionnaire survey results obtained from interview conductions with beverage operators, customers, and experts in establishing this "Taiwan Takeout Beverage Franchise Chain Business Performance Mode" and in computing the weights relationships among indicators in different hierarchies. The weights classified as to aspect from high to low are: product (37.9%) , customer (35.5%) , environment (14.3%) , manpower (6.7%) and equipment (5.6%) . The study conclusions shall serve as reference for operator business performance assessment in the future. They shall also serve as reference for operators that intend to partake in takeout beverage franchise. Hopefully, it will contribute positively to the overall practical operations in the industry.

articleTitle: Compositive Test of a Platform Architecture for E-Government
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In our country, application of e-government based on the homemade platform is seldom, government support homemade platform application positively all along, But the current problem is that the homemade software and hardware is not mature, they are not compatible each other, this paper passed through combines, test, optimization repeatedly, finally has formed an e-government application platform based on Linux operation system, OpenBASE database, Tongweb middleware, and Shuguang server, and gives the key integration technology, compare the result of cut-and-try run with the current popular web technical indicates that this platform is practical and feasible. It will provide the reference to our country's e-government construction, at the same time save the cost greatly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: General Manager Overconfidence, Financial Constraints and Investment Decisions in Listed Company
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Fast Handover and Route Optimization of Multihoming Based Nested Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: NEMO basic support protocol brings suboptimal routing and long handover latency problems while supporting network mobility, especially in nested mobile network. A new route optimization solution called multihoming-LRO for mobile networks under local mobility management framework using multihoming mechanism is proposed. By extending router advertisement message and defining operation of local mobile anchor, optimized routing on forward routing path, reverse routing path and routing inside nested mobile network can be provided. By defining primary local mobility anchor and secondary local mobility anchor, and setting two thresholds of link performance, second link good enough can be established before first link is broken down, or both links can be maintained if needed. Then robustness and self-recovery capability can be improved, fast handover can be achieved easily, and the negative influence caused by topology of nested mobile network which changed dynamically can be alleviated.

articleTitle: The Research on Evaluation Model of Knowledge Worker's Knowledge-Sharing Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge sharing, which is one of the most important factors of knowledge management, plays more and more crucial role in the process of the enterprise development. The topic of how to encourage the employee to deeply share their knowledge is the direction of knowledge management field. Base on the theories on knowledge management and knowledge sharing, by using the AHP method, a model of measuring employee knowledge-sharing performance is present.

articleTitle: Timing Executive Stock Option Awards In China Listed Corporates
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Adding stock option to management compensation portfolio is an effective mechanism in aligning the interests of managers with those of shareholders. But this mechanism may be noneffective since the self-dealing opportunism of managers. This thesis analyses the managers will undertake self-dealing opportunities by choosing time and content of information disclosure to affect the exercise price of stock option. Taking the listed companies of China, which initially disclose stock option Incentive Plan as study subject, and using the events study approach to compute cumulated abnormal returns, I observe a significant decline in stock price before top executives receive the award and a significant increase in stock price shortly after the incentive plans disclosure.

articleTitle: Effects of Brand Image and Manufacture-3PL Relationship on 3PL Satisfaction: A Theoretical Framework
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The trend to use third-party logistics services becomes more prominent especially in the industrializing countries such as China where manufacturing constitutes a major part of the economy. This development poses a great challenge to channel managers in selecting the third-party logistics service providers and evaluating service levels of these providers. Unfortunately, the research nowadays does not provide a sufficient insight on these aspects. Many 3PL studies are descriptive in nature, which address the issues such as the benefits of using 3PL services and the areas to be outsourced. To resolve this challenge in the channel management, it needs to go a step forward in studying the causal relationship between logistics service quality and 3PL satisfaction. Based on the theory in relationship marketing, this paper proposes a research model that incorporates the effects of brand image and manufacture-3PL relationship aims to examine the antecedents and consequences of 3PL satisfaction.

articleTitle: Adaptive Pre-Interpolation Multiuser Detector for Impulse Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In multiuser impulse radio systems, the conventional detection methods always suffer from high complexity and poor robustness caused by dense multipath and long maximum excess delay of the nonline-of-sight (NLOS) channel. To detect the direct spread (DS) impulse signal, an adaptive pre-interpolation filter algorithm is introduced. By analysis and simulation, this adaptive interpolator applied before the decorrelator is proved to have a good steady-state performance of the adaptation.

articleTitle: VaR Model Based on SMEs Credit Guarantee Risk Pricing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Chinese government is seeking to encourage small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs) growth which requires expansion capital. Comparing with larger firms, SMEs are less access to the debt capital they need for start-up, growth, and survival. Consequently, some commercial agencies have often intervened in credit markets by taking on the role of guarantors of loans that financial institutions advance to SMEs, such as CHORIENWISE, a famous Chinese commercial guarantor, provides guarantees of loans made by financial institutions to qualifying small firms. With the development of credit guarantee industry, as a high-risk industry, it is extremely important to set a scientific price in the guarantee contract in order to cover the loss of guarantee failure. At present, the approaches of credit guarantee pricing are mainly empirical pricing method and option pricing method. Combining with the international VaR model, this thesis analyzes the limitation of the practical use of these two methods and gives out a guarantee pricing method which is based on the credit guarantee risk. By using this approach, in a certain confidence level, at least, the guarantee agency can get the risk-free profit.

articleTitle: Modified Particle Filtering for Wireless Tracking in Digital Broadcasting System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Digital broadcasting signal has the unique advantages for wireless location. In this paper, the pseudo-range measurement method based on OFDM signals is introduced. A mathematical model for wireless location and tracking is presented, which exploits the feature of continuous signal transmission at a fixed rate in digital broadcasting systems. After analyzing the disadvantage of classical particle filtering, i.e. sequential important sampling (SIR) filtering, a new particle filtering method using important sampling function based on EKF bank is proposed. Simulation showed that compared with the EKF and SIR particle filtering, the new algorithm can improve the estimation precision, and converge faster.

articleTitle: Research on the Search for Mobile Spatial Geographic Information Based on MMS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It offers a solution based on WebGIS and MMS to search mobile spatial geographic information in the paper in which there is mobile spatial search platform with various images and words via establishing multithread wireless communication net model which is mainly based on MMS and partly SMS and making WebGIS as the spatial information engine of the system. In the platform, Lucene technology is introduced to index and retrieve. What's more the solution has been proved practical via experiments.

articleTitle: Optimum Transmission Ranges in DS/CDMA Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the joint effect of PN code synchronization and BER (bit error rate) on transmission ranges for DS/CDMA (direct spread code division multiple accesses) MANET (mobile ad-hoc networks). We obtain the optimum transmission ranges to maximize throughput for a DS/CDMA MANET by taking into account the PN code acquisition. Our aim is to optimally set the number of interferers I and the PN code acquisition threshold V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Th</sub>. The results obtained show that the probability of PN synchronization decreases the expected forward progress per slot compared with previous results and that the optimum probability of each terminal transmitting a packet is different from previous results. The results obtained can be used as heuristics to set the parameter in MANET.

articleTitle: Bus Arbitration Mechanism in Embedded System Based on Trust Computing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a starriness start-up mechanism in trusted embedded system, a bus arbitration method to implement this mechanism is also designed. At last, we implement this arbitration mechanism in concrete prototype system. As experiment shows, this mechanism is agile to control, easy to expand, secure and reliable.

articleTitle: The Parallel Conversion Algorithm of Binary Tree Traverse Sequence Based on Batcher Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The parallel conversion pattern based on batcher network during different traverse sequence of binary tree is proposed, the conversion from pre-order to in-order is implemented in A-order, the conversion from pre-order to post-order is implemented in B-order, and the corresponding parallel conversion algorithm is given. At last, the conversion process of the parallel conversion algorithm is proceed with detailed description and verified analysis with an application instance. The parallelism of the conversion process of traverse sequence of binary tree provides using and reference for application in the system of tree sequence traverse and solving the parallelism problem of application program.

articleTitle: On Rural Public Service Facilities in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present the rural public service facilities in our country is scarce and human settlement allows of no optimist. This paper discusses the difference between rural public service facilities and urban infrastructures based on the connotation and attributes of rural public service facilities, and analyzes such problems in the process of building rural public facilities as backward facilities, insufficient capital investment, single investment subjects and lower marketization, and finally puts forward countermeasures in building public service facilities of new socialist countryside through making a scientific plan, clearly defining government responsibilities, broadening investment channels and promoting marketized management of construction and operation.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Dynamic Three-Stage Game Based on Standards Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on existing standard dynamic game model of negotiation and bandwagon mechanism, this paper reconstructs a three-stage dynamic game model of standard lifecycle for formation, implement, and diffusion by widening the condition of players of existing model; it attest to the consistency of conclusions for equilibrium condition of standard adoption by comparing new game model with old one, which not only relies on the coordination mechanism used by the players, but also on the relative value they attach to successful coordination, and on the formal standard's performance at the end of the game.

articleTitle: Novel Detection Method for Polarization Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel detection method was devised using the characteristic of polarization multiplexing system in mobile communication. Using this detection method, the polarization multiplexing system can increase the transmission rate twice while maintaining all most same bit error rate (BER) performance as the normal MIMO system with STBC under some channel condition.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Combine Scoreboard Evaluation (CSE) in Tender Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: CSE was usually adopted as one of the tender evaluation methods in Chinese construction market. Because of the shortage of supervision and management, CSE had become a tool of bid rigging used by some persons. Therefore, based on the data of cases from Nanjing Construction Project Exchange Centre, empirical analysis of CSE was done in order to prove whether the phenomenon mentioned above existed. The frequency of bidders' participation, the degree of quotations competition and the influences of using different quotation benchmark in CSE were tested by spss13.0. The conclusions might be drawn: CSE that adopted the average quotation benchmark could not stimulate the bidders' competition. Moreover, the owner could not share the quotation discount which was brought by bidders' competition. The owners or the tender agencies might use faulty evaluation items to conduct bid rigging, which fought against inequitable competition in China construction market. Finally, the improved CSE which adopted some advantages of LEB was given.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-Level Decision and De-Mapping Based on Nature-Coding Method in QAM Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The optimum levels were used to decide the real levels for the data input with low error rate. And the real levels could be used to get during de-mapping. For the reason above, it is very important to find the optimum levels. The joint of two parts about one-dimension decision decided the decision bounds in two-dimension space, and the points were fixed to standard constellation. The codes used for the implementation may determine the complexity of hardware. So the nature-coding method was used to simplify the implementation of hardware.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Clustering Routing Protocol for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANET) have recently emerged as a hot research topic. To solve the expansibility problem of traditional flat routing protocols in ad hoc networks, a dynamic clustering routing transition protocol was proposed in this paper. This method creates clusters dynamic by real-time apperceiving network scale which can solve the conflict between the expansibility of flat routing protocols and clustering overhead of clustering routing protocols. This mechanism takes the compatibility among different routing mechanisms into account to obtain high routing efficiency. Simulation results show that dynamic clustering protocol has good expansibility and adaptive control action. It is a correct and efficient routing mechanism.

articleTitle: Complete Extended Independent Set Collision Immune Algorithm for Wireless Channel Assignment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Single channel is a severe capacity bottleneck in wireless mesh networks (WMNs). Multiple channels enhance the wireless network capacity by simultaneous transmissions and decrease the interference among nodes. Due to the scarcity of non-overlapped channels, the way of assigning channels becomes extremely important for throughput optimization in WMNs. This article presents a channel assignment algorithm, which divides WMNs into separate multiple collision domains by setting up a complete extended independent set, maximizing the number of interference independent nodes; then assigns channels on collision immune model, minimizing the co-channel collisions in overall network. This algorithm provides more impartiality in channel assignment than in dynamic algorithms. Simulated experiments illustrate that the algorithm is more efficient.

articleTitle: Developing an Outsourcing Decision Model Based on ELECTREI Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An ever-increasing trend in today's firms is to exploit outsourcing for those activities deemed to be outside the company's core business. Given the multi-objective nature of outsourcing decision, this paper presents a decision method using ELECTREI method to help users in structuring the outsourcing problems. The proposed method generates numeric values to divide activities of a company into core activities, core-close activities, core-distinct activities and disposable activities, then the decision maker can decide which activities should adopt outsourcing strategy under consideration. Finally, it draws a conclusion that this outsourcing decision approach is very well suited as a decision-making tool for initial outsourcing decisions from the application which given to illustrate the use of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Application of a Predictive Model towards Fire Risks in Underground Metropolitan Transportation Based on Continuous Hazard Tracking
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of underground metropolitan transportation, the problem of safety risks, especially the fire risks, have always been accorded great attention by researchers and practitioners. In order to reduce the uncertainty of fire risks in underground metropolitan transportation, the main objective of this paper is to devise a proactive approach to dynamically predict and control conditions leading to fire hazards. A literature review of fire risks in underground metropolitan transportation is conducted firstly. Then, a predictive model that is based on the continuous tracking of fire hazards is applied to predict the fire risks of underground metropolitan transportation. Using the model, the certain system of underground metropolitan transportation can be identified as "under control" or "out of control" based on the methods of sampling and control charts. This research would provide us with an effective and valid method to lessen the uncertainty of fire hazards in underground metropolitan transportation as much as possible.

articleTitle: A New TOPSIS Based Methodology for Multiple Responses Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There are always more than one quality responses or characteristics in product or process design and engineers often must choose optimum parameter combination for these responses simultaneously. Taguchi method, as a cost-effective method for off-line quality control, especially the quadratic loss function shows loss of quality directly, has been widely employed by quality engineering to deal with single-response problem, but few of them pay attention to multi-response problem. TOPSIS (Technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution) method is a popular used multiple attribute decision making (MADM) methodology. In conventional TOPSIS method, responses are usually transformed into loss of quality, and then normalized by the largest quality loss. However, for nominal-the- best (NTB) problem, it's not a reasonable methodology. Based on conventional TOPSIS, the proposed method makes an improvement to adapt to NTB type response, it also takes the standard deviation of responses into consideration simultaneously for the purpose of robustness. The improved TOPSIS method is illustrated by an example from literatures, and the result indicates its reasonableness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Analysis on Agency Chain Decision-Making Based on Characteristics of Multi-Dimensional Game
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper characterizes the decision-makings in agency-chain with characteristics of multi-dimensional game. Game in the multilayer principal-agent relationships is played between participants' decision vectors rather than their single decisions. Our models demonstrate that within a decision vector horizontally, the effort choice and the incentive choice are substituted in some certain degree. Our models also demonstrate that in the agency-chain vertically, participant's utility is not only function of his own decisions, but also others'. Participant makes a "trade-off between effort choice and incentive choice, and optimizes a profile utility based on his position in the agency- chain.

articleTitle: Research on the Self-Organized Forming Process to Realize Distance-Only Node Localization in Underwater Acoustic Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Location information of nodes is very meaningful to the building of underwater acoustic network. It can be used to fulfill a lot of work, such as partition of nodes' identities, building the routing table, and so on. Because of the restrictions of using GPS, a node localization algorithm based on the distance information is given in this paper, as well as a data transmitting algorithm which achieves no-collision information exchanges among nodes in the underwater acoustic network's self-organized forming process. Finally, the feasibility of fulfilling the distance-only node localization in the underwater acoustic network using the two algorithms above is validated through OPNET simulation.

articleTitle: A Coordination Mechanism for a Supply Chain with Option Contract
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Consider a supply chain that consists of two players (i.e., a supplier (S) and a retailer (R)), who implement the "Retailer-Stackelberg" ("[rS]") game with an option contract with two price parameters (i.e., an option price and an exercise price). Under symmetric information, R can choose appropriate contract prices to obtain channel coordination. Under asymmetric information, that is when the production cost of S is private information, we examine how the option contract operates with a uniformly distribution demand. In contrast to many studies assuming the private information to be discrete, this paper investigates the coordination mechanism with a continuum of the cost type. We find that R can achieve the same goal as symmetric information by offering a mechanism of option pricing, a function of the declared cost of S, which makes S maximize his profit only by reporting his true cost.

articleTitle: An Approach for the Corruption-Aware Protocols to Work over Link Layer CRC Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Unlike in wired networks, non-congestion losses will result in significant performance degradation in wireless networks. Thus some corruption-aware transport protocols have been presented to focus on the packet loss caused by corruption. Unfortunately, the corruption-aware transport protocols cannot work in realistic networks up to now, since the corrupted packets have been discarded by the link layer checksum mechanisms before they are delivered to transport layer. This paper proposes a technique to overcome this problem without disabling the link layer checksum mechanisms. Simulation results show that the corruption-aware transport protocol can still behave far better than the traditional transport protocol while the proposed scheme is applied.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Implications for Transport Systems by Emerging Global Logistics Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract:

articleTitle: Novel Implementation Issues in Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Terminals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cognitive radios is emerging as a promising wireless paradigm, which will integrate benefits of software defined radio with a complete aware communication behavior. By detecting environments in real time and extracting interference characteristic in frequency spectrum, it can use flexible spectrum assign strategy for adaptive communications. To reach this goal many issues remain still open, such as powerful algorithms for sensing the external environment. In this paper, a novel algorithm based on twice spectrum correlation is presented and computational complexity is analyzed. Then the realization scheme is suggested and applied in frequency- hopping communication systems. Computer simulations show that it can exactly provide spectrum occupation in real time for cognitive terminals.

articleTitle: Public Project Evaluation From the Perspectives of the Stakeholders Satisfaction and Social Environmental Impacts
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A public project evaluation approach from the perspectives of the stakeholders satisfaction and economic, social and environment impacts is proposed. The evaluation system of the stakeholders' satisfaction is comprised of the dimensions of stakeholders' information, expectation, actual perception, complaint and trust. The social, environmental and economic benefits and disbenefits of the project stakeholders are analyzed to establish a multi-criteria evaluation hierarchy. And then an evaluation model is constructed and solved based on AHP (analytic hierarchy process) method. The two alternatives of Henan TV tower are evaluated using the proposed method to illustrate the method.

articleTitle: Improvement and Performance Analysis of a Scheme for the Maximum Doppler Frequency Estimation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an optimal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) which is independent from correlation-interval and mobile speed is analyzed, which is on the basis of the channel auto-correlation Doppler shift estimation algorithm. And then an optimized SNR tracking (OSNRT) algorithm on the basis of Rake receiver under multi-path fading channel is proposed. The improved algorithm calculated Doppler shift by selecting a finger whose SNR is nearest to the optimal SNR. Simulation results show that contrasted to conventional schemes the proposed approach is less sensitive to correlation-interval and velocity varieties.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation of Rural Collective Society Correlation Degree in Northeast Region Based on the RAGA-PPC Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Farmer's positive participation plays an important part in socialist new countryside construction, therefore this article takes encouraging farmers to participate in rural public product supply enthusiastically as the main purpose. This article weighs farmers' enthusiasm by the collective society correlation degree, takes Juyuan town in Dao Wai District, Harbin as the example, uses RAGA and the PPC model coupling method to carry on the appraisal and influence factor importance sort to seven administrative villages' collective society interrelatedness in Juyuan town , then according to the appraisal result and the influence factor analysis, it proposes effective countermeasures. Finally, it points out its application value and some problems which are to be solved in future.

articleTitle: Game Theoretic Research on Annual Salary System of Middle and Small-Scaled Scientific and Technical Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with the maturity of market economy in China, annual salary system has been experimented and subsequently practiced by thousands of enterprises, and then the deficiency in design of the annual salary system has gradually appeared. On the basis of a case of annual salary system of a middle and small- scaled scientific and technical enterprise, it was made that an anticipative analysis of the effect of the annual salary system of the above-mentioned enterprise, and attempted to find a set of effective improvement measures for stimulation system, which could be adopted by the similar enterprises for reference.

articleTitle: Innovation Platform and Enterprise Growth
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation platform is important to support enterprises' sustainable growth and is a stereo structure consisting of such five components as innovation network, knowledge base, learning system, technical infrastructure and innovation culture. An enterprise innovation platform can be built through organic connection among all components of innovation platform and through the interaction between the core layer which includes innovation network, knowledge base and learning system, and supporting layer which includes technical infrastructure and innovation culture. Innovation platform can help realize interaction between internal and external resources of an enterprise to improve innovation ability and to promote sustainable development.

articleTitle: A Novel Wireless Image Transmission Method Based Wavelet Decomposition Algorithm Over FH-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new scheme for wireless image transmission is proposed. Firstly, based on wavelet decomposition theory, an image source can be decomposed into different weight levels. Then, the bit streams with different weight are modulated by FH-OFDM system, which can give low frequency bits more protection with help of hop frequency graphic design in FH-OFDM. A joint system combined with source coding and adaptive modulation method is introduced to give the image bit streams with different subcarriers, which eliminate ISI in low frequency streams more effectively. Therefore, a better reconstruction image can be obtained at receiver. Simulation results indicate that the scheme with joint source coding and adaptive modulation method can outperform the system without adaptive modulation in image quality. Under the same conditions, the proposed FH-OFDM system has better BER performance than traditional OFDM and better image quality than pseudorandom pattern FH-OFDM in the process of wireless image transmission.

articleTitle: Cost Leadership or Differentiation? Empirical Study on Dominant Competitive Strategy of Xinhua Chemical
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using data collected from the Xinhua Chemical Co.,Ltd in Shanxi province, this paper mainly probed into which was dominant competitive strategy that supported Xinhua Chemical's low cost and fast development. In the mean while, we also investigated relationship between two generic competitive strategies and firm's different performance, and between two types of generic competitive strategies. The results are that: dominant competitive strategy of Xinhua Chemical is cost leadership; marketing differentiation strategy has a significantly positive impact on firm's financial performance, customer differentiation strategy has a positive impact on firm's market and financial performance, but insignificant, cost leadership has a significantly positive impact on firm's market performance; two types of generic competitive strategies can be implemented simultaneously.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzzy Overall Evaluation of Logistics Enterprises Based on DEA with Preference
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Applying DEA with preference method to the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of logistics enterprises, this paper proposes the model of fuzzy overall evaluation on logistics enterprises based on DEA with preference. The model reflects the evaluation index system of the quality of partners in the logistics alliance, and through fuzzy overall evaluation method, gets the output, then inputs the industrial and commercial enterprise's data and other output index figures into the DEA model and gets the final evaluation result. A case study illustrates the model is reasonable.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Optimization between FEC and TCP over Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Forward error correction (FEC) scheme has dual side-effects on the throughput performance for the satellite networks. One is to consume some extra bandwidth to send redundant information, and the other is to disable the corruption-aware TCP variants to differentiate the corruption events from the loss events. This may result in significant throughput jitter while satellite channel is in an unsteady state, since the existing FEC directly discards any incompletely recovered MAC frames. This paper introduces an effective cross-layer optimization between FEC and TCP to make up the drawbacks of the existing scheme. Simulation result shows that the proposed scheme can significantly reduce the throughput jitter of the unstable satellite network with a variable bit error rate and could be a better choice, compared to the existing approaches.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Traditional Congestion Control Policy and Active Networks Congestion Control Policy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the application of active networks in congestion control, this paper introduces the traditional congestion control policy and analyses their principles and feasibilities. Active networks congestion control policy introduces the active detection and the passive notification mechanism, the random early detect (RED) queue management and the load balance technology based on the traditional congestion control policy. It introduces active networks congestion control in the application of research and analysis the advantages and disadvantages of between the traditional congestion control policy and active networks congestion control policy.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Application to Motivating Tacit Knowledge Sharing Among Knowledge Workers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Managers are always seeking effective policies to encourage employees to share their knowledge with others in an organization. The appropriate organizational incentives are difficult to investigate due to human factors and other institutional complexities affecting sharing behaviors of individuals. Tacit knowledge sharing is most difficult because obstacles stem from aspects such as communication technology, knowledge elicitation and knowledge share culture. This paper, on basis of the extant researches, analyzes major motivators for knowledge sharing and, establishes a system dynamics model to explore the mechanism of knowledge transferring among knowledge workers, taking into consideration the complexity and dynamic nature. At the end of the paper a case study is provided to demonstrate how to use the established model to test the validity of concerned motivation policies. Although the paper focuses on knowledge sharing in an engineering consulting company, the model could be used in a much broader area.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Equilibrium of Human Resource Structure Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is well known that maintaining stable human resource is absolutely necessary for enterprises, so how to manage human resource hierarchical structure becomes an important content in HRM. In this paper, a model based on Markov Chain is provided for human resource hierarchical structure management. The model focus on describing the change of human resource hierarchical structure, forecasting future human resource hierarchical structure, and seeking for strategy so as to achieve some ideal human resource hierarchical structure. Lastly. I introduce an example to forecast and control human resource hierarchical structure. The result of this example indicates that the method is practical and reasonable. At the same time, some academic conclusions are drawn to improve human resource hierarchical structure management.

articleTitle: Research of Listed Company Violation Forewarning Model Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The violation of listed company doesn 't only cause loss to listed company itself but also cause great negative impact to social economy. Consequently, prevention weighs more than punishment and remedial measure afterwards. Foreseeing the violation risk of listed company by taking advantage of Support Vector Machine, the violation forewarning model established has the advantage of being highly accurate and has high generalization performance. It is a "new weapon" for supervising and regulating authority to prevent the violation of listed company in a scientific and efficient way.

articleTitle: A Microeconomics Based Radio Resource Allocation Scheme for B3G Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper brings forward a microeconomics based radio resource allocation (MBRRA) scheme to solve the joint radio resource management (JRRM) problem in the beyond 3G (B3G) heterogeneous wireless networks. The MBRRA mechanism is formulated based on game theory. Through the resource allocation game played by different operators, the radio resource is utilized effectively. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme effectively improves the operators' profit and the radio resource utilization efficiency. Besides, the game converges quickly to the Nash equilibrium, and achieves a well balance of high degree of efficiency and fairness at the equilibrium.

articleTitle: An Exhaustive Resource Discovered Method with Probabilistic Guarantees for P2P network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, P2P applications are popular and lots of applications are deployed. Because a resource discovered method is important in P2P applications, it attracts much attention from researchers. However, search algorithms face huge challenges of scalability and robustness. Based on the topology of relaxed random multigraph, a probabilistic exhaustive search algorithm for P2P network is proposed. After evaluating the desired number of data and query replicas, a new mapping atom operation called Ping-Pang mapping maps query and data replicas onto peers in the network to perform reliable exhaustive search. At last the correctness of the algorithm is proved. This search algorithm brings a number of unique advantages such as scalability, resilience and also effectiveness in coping with dynamics and heterogeneity.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Flood Disaster in Heilongjiang Province of China Based on RAGA-PPC Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dimensionality reduction technology of high dimension data, projection pursuit classification (PPC) Model, was used to evaluate flood disaster. In the case of flood disaster loss without evaluating criterion or with inapplicable criterion, real-coded accelerating genetic algorithm (RAGA) was utilized to optimize the projection direction of PPC model, and then transform multi-dimension data to low dimension subspace. Each index of flood disaster loss was evaluated based on seeking optimal projection direction and projection value, which avoided man-made disturbance of subjective weight determination and gained good results.

articleTitle: Tactic of Incentive Mechanism for Synergic Knowledge Innovation in the Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper narrates the meanings and the characteristics of synergic knowledge innovation in the supply chain firstly. Then two basic gaming in synergic knowledge innovation in the supply chain are discussed respectively and corresponding tactic of incentive mechanism are proposed. One gaming is in constructing knowledge repository, and the other gaming is "pick-up" in the procedure of knowledge innovation. By analyzing gaming of members' participation in building knowledge repository, the tactics for the design of incentive mechanism are put forward. And through analyzing evolutionary gaming of "pick-up" in the process of knowledge innovation, the tactics for the design of incentive mechanism to restrict members in the supply chain to "pick-up" in synergic knowledge innovation are advanced. In the end, the future research direction is discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Model-Driven Architecture in the Development Process of Enterprise Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information system used by enterprises at present has lower implementation efficiency and success rate. In order to make enterprise information system meet the changes of business requirements in a quick method and low cost, the deficiencies in current development methods of enterprise information system were analyzed and, for solving these deficiencies, a quick development pattern combined with the technologies and ideas of MDA (modern-driven architecture) was built. Four model types, CIM (computer independent model), PIM (platform independent model), PSM (platform specific model) and code, were included in this pattern. Moreover, for distinguishing the business requirement oriented and process oriented modeling course, CIM model was further divided into two types, CIM-business and CIM-ESA, and the model structure of CIM-business layer was studied in details. Finally, based on the structure, a graphical modeling example was constructed for validating its practicability and feasibility.

articleTitle: Rating of E-Commerce Integrity Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper e-business integrity will be discussed based on decision tree and through some cases. As well known, with the developing of the e-business, reputation and integrity are more and more important to operating e-business enterprises. Customers pay more attention to e-business company's reputation and integrity based on their experience. So, how a manager to make firm's good reputation by goods/service and integrity is very important. In the view of strategic and sustaining developing, to make a right decision to keep good reputation will be benefit the company. Here, a reputation model using the decision tree skills will be discussed. It can support manager's decision well.

articleTitle: Coordination of Supply Chain Systems: From the Perspective of Information Flow
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The supply chain plays an essential role for modern companies to retain their competitive advantages in today's business environments. As supply chain members are often separate and independent economic entities, a key issue in supply chain management is to develop mechanisms that can align their objectives and coordinate their activities so as to optimize system performance. Information is a keyword in the coordination. In this paper, we provide a review of coordination of operational information in supply chain which is classified into information types, their impact on supply chain performance, and the policy of information sharing. Then the essentials for information coordination are indicated. In the end, future research direction is pointed out.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Relationship between Independent Technology Standards and Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, technical standards play an important role in many markets, especially the hi-tech and information technology markets. Technical standards are not just a simple combination of technologies, which materialize the best practices of different technologies. Against industrial transformation and comparative advantage in China, the paper, based on the practical significance by developing the independent technology standards, puts forward the concept of independent technology standards, and further analyzes the complex relationship between technical standards and technological innovation.The results show that technological innovation can promote the development of technical standards and furthermore the whole industry; technical standards not only offer the platform to technological innovation,but also have some negative impacts on it. After the analysis, the coordinated development between them based on the active and flexible participation of different interest groups is suggested.

articleTitle: Multihoming and ID/LOC Based Seamless Handover in Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of mobile communications and NGN technologies, there is a strong need to provide connectivity for moving devices to continuously communicate with other devices or applications on the NGN infrastructure, at any time and anywhere. The key issue of this vision is how to support seamless handover in the NGN environment. In this article, we summarize the functional requirements supporting seamless handover. And then based on the overview of multihoming and ID/LOC separation, a novel seamless handover scheme carrying on the advantages of multihoming and ID/LOC separation is proposed. It provides seamless handover when terminals moving between different RATs.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Best Tone Business Model of Zhongshan Telecom
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes and generalizes the connotations of business model based on literature review, in particular, accentuating the importance of customer needs to business model's innovation. Then, it, take Zhongshan Telecom as an example, explores Best Tone's innovation and evolution on the basis of customer needs. Analysis shows that the best tone model can realize a win-win situation, for it can better satisfy both the forward and backward customers' needs and efficiently increase the enterprise's revenues.

articleTitle: The Planning and Design of the Agile Information System of the Dynamic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The supply chain management strategy of the agile virtual enterprise is presented. The important role of the dynamic alliance in the agile information system running is discussed. The design and realization technology of the logistics information platform using ASP technology to support the agile supply chain of the dynamic alliance are studied. The work principles of web database technology and the logistics information platform of the dynamic alliance are introduced.

articleTitle: Power Allocation for Decode-and-Forward Relay System Employing Space-Time Codes Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperative relay transmission is an effective way to combat multi-path fading. With proper coding scheme, the diversity and coding gains can be obtained. A two-hop decode- and-forward relay protocol using distributed linear dispersion code (LDC) is introduced and analyzed in terms of capacity gains over the system with the traditional uniform power allocation. To optimize the capacity of the system subjected to a total transmit power constraint, an optimal power allocation scheme based on genetic algorithm is explored, which distributes resource appropriately to each hop according to the channel state information (CSI) and some characteristics of distributed LDC. Theoretical analysis and numerical results indicate that with optimal power allocation, the proposed coded cooperative system will outperform the one with traditional uniform power allocation.

articleTitle: External Technology Acquisition and Enterprise Technological development -A View of the Tacit Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: External technology acquisition is an effective means to develop technology for enterprises in developing countries. However, the technology enhancement is very limited if the external technology is just for the application. So being different from the dynamic process of technological development based on technology innovation in the leading enterprises, the technological development of enterprises in the developing countries ought to be the reverse capability building from technology application to innovation and that the key to the above dynamic process is to systematically convert the tacit knowledge embedded in the research, development and application of the external technology. So on the basis of the identification of tacit knowledge above, this paper systematically analyzes the dynamic process of the tacit knowledge conversion.

articleTitle: Research on the Rational Scale of Construction Enterprise Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rational scale influences the development and the benefits of construction industry largely. Collecting 29 listed outstanding achievement construction enterprises, the paper sets up a DEA (data envelopment analysis) model to analysis their rationality. The result shows that the scales of the most collected enterprises are irrational, the large-scale constructions are big but not strong, cannot get the intensive economies of scale, and the mid-small-scale professional enterprises get high-level scale economical profit by invests saving and expenditure reducing. The profits of more than half of the enterprises are decreasing return to scale. Only a few enterprises realize the increasing return to scale.

articleTitle: Predicting Corporate Financial Distress Based on Fuzzy Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the fuzzy support vector machine (FSVM) was used to predict the corporate financial distress. First of all, a proper membership model was also proposed to fuzzy all the training data of positive/negative class. Secondly, the outliers were detected by the proposed outlier detection method (ODM). The ODM was a hybrid method based on the fuzzy c-means (FCM) algorithm cascaded with an unsupervised neural network, called self-organizing map (SOM). Finally, FSVM was applied to demonstration research of corporate financial distress prediction, and experimental results indicated that the proposed FSVM actually reduced the effect of outliers and yield higher classification rate than SVM did.

articleTitle: Study of Tacit Knowledge Spread Efficiency Based-On Professional Network Forum
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Base on the relation data of question and answer on the forum of China enterprise clusters ,we construct a network model of knowledge spread which consists of 832 users and egos Wang Ji-ci. Comparison study has been conducted between this knowledge spreading network and its social relationship network from the viewpoint of tacit knowledge that takes the communication languages as the carrier. It is discovered that the rates of connectedness, arrival rate of knowledge and extent of diffusion for this knowledge spread network are higher than the social relationship networks. Because of its indescribable features, tacit knowledge can only be communicated through the processes of interactive teaching or correspondence. As the teachers are limited by various school conditions, teaching schedules and class hours while they are trying to establish their tacit knowledge communication networks, they will be able to overcome such weaknesses and improve their communication efficiency through the construction of knowledge spread networks in the form of forums.

articleTitle: On the Dividend for the Markov-Switching Risk Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers a optimal dividend problem for a company whose asset follows a Markov-modulated risk model. In the two-state Markov-switching setting, explicit formulas for the expected discounted dividends and the expected time of ruin are derived when the dividend strategy follows a constant barrier dividend strategy.

articleTitle: Model Action Semantics Representation and its Negotiation Algorithm in Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Problem solving model is a software part in decision support system. Model action is the key part of decision making, and semantics comprehension of the model action is very important for decision support system. The representation method of action semantics and surrounding semantics are proposed for the dynamic environment in DSS. Two ontologies are defined to provide semantics, according to the characteristics of knowledge of model. Then a method of dynamic semantics is presented for models. Dynamic semantics of models are model action semantics and surrounding semantics, and the action must be supported by its surrounding. Models can detect potential collisions through a multiple layer recursive matching algorithm. A negotiation algorithm is proposed to make the interaction based on semantics extracted from ontology level and semantic level.

articleTitle: Research on Indicator Selection and Appraisal of Software Service Provider Serviceability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present many scholars and government agencies pay more attention to the level of informationization development and the related appraisals than to the appraisal of software service providers, who affect the level of informationization development and even the capacity of informationization exertion in the future. According to the self-influence factors and development demand that exit in the process of China's informationization at present, this article obtains correlative index, through the methods of construction of appraisal table, producing of entry, classification and so on. And it does the evaluation on the software service provider serviceability by the correlative indicators system.

articleTitle: Research on the Performance Reverse Logistics System for Enterprises Base on EAHP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under the economy globalization environment, enterprises and governments from home and abroad give more attention cycle economy, how to construct the Reverse Logistics System (RLS) in the global scope for acquire the objective. In view of such four factors as the infrastructure of RLS, the level of utilization of RLS, the knowledge level of staff of RLS and the level of system ensures of RLS, the Model of Performance Appraising & Optimizing of the Reverse Logistics System for Enterprises (MPAORLSE) in this article is presented. The model is solved by the means of Expanded Analytic Hierarchy Process (EAHP), The model and valuation method suggesting in the article, which can help enterprises find out the key factors by the diagnosis and analysis of the capability of RLS.

articleTitle: The Low Power Study Based on ZigBee Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we analyze the node's process of backoff countdown under working at star topology, discuss the access probability and power consume that all probability state of nodes during a superframe. The course of power consume showed that it's not feasible to reduce system power consumption by adjusting the TX power, the only way reducing the nodes in the receiving state and the sparing time to complete. Also pointed out that the following two methods can reduce power consumption of nodes, using a long frame, But long frame will increase the delay and increase the cost of system. The other is through a relatively reduced number of nodes to improve access probability to achieve the goal of reducing energy consumption.

articleTitle: AHP-Based Crucial Systems Requirement Critical Degree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper's research work mainly pays attention to the requirement consistency validation. In order to solve the consistency evaluation and multi-branch selection problem during requirement validation process, this paper proposes a kind of requirement measurement method. At first, this paper proposes a keywords preprocessing method based on keywords extraction, synonyms expansion and a certain words reducing strategy. The method eliminates the influence to requirement measurement by thesaurus, low and high frequency, non-noun keywords. This paper proposes estimation matrix establishing rules in AHP model, and proposes requirement critical degree algorithm. The above points avoid the imprecise requirement qualitative analysis, and solve the quantitative evaluation problem to the requirement property value.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of Security System for Small Town's E-Government System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyze the structure and network security strategy as well as expounding the key technologies and methods based on characteristics of small town's e-government system. Its discuss the main difficulties of database access and network security of small town's e-government system. After a case of e-government system is studied in Hengdian (a town in Zhejiang province), solutions are put forward to deal with these problems in e-government of small-town. Establish intranet architecture and an open platform forms, which uses the B / S structure, a three-tier logical one, together with the network architecture. Processing of information exchange and dispose is used ADO and ASP provide database information pages, and run the orders of SQL (structured language query) in information pages. Realize information security with information access and information transmission.

articleTitle: NOFDM System Based on Circular Conjugate Symmetry Properties of DFT
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on circular conjugate symmetry properties (CCSP) of discrete Fourier transform (DFT), a novel approach to nonorthogonal frequency division multiplexing (NOFDM) is presented. Different from other NOFDM systems, a simple estimation algorithm is exploited in the receiver instead of maximum likelihood sequence detection (MLSD) while the bit error rate (BER) of the proposed system is similar to those of other NOFDM systems in terms of the same bandwidth efficiency. We describe the proposed system model and derive the estimation algorithm. Simulation results show that the presented NOFDM system has both higher bandwidth efficiency and better BER performance than standard orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) when the derived estimation algorithm is adopted.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of LDPC Codes with EXIT Chart
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A joint optimization method of LDPC codes using EXIT chart is introduced in this paper. Based on the design method proposed by Brink, we take into account the variable nodes degree and check nodes degree together in the code design process, other than fixing the check nodes degree in advance. Compared with the non-joint design method, the joint optimization method can generate LDPC codes with nearer Shannon limit performance.

articleTitle: Research on the International Competitiveness of Chinese Textile Industry in EU Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The textile industry, as an important exporting and earning foreign exchange industry, has far-reaching effect on China's economy development. However, in the long term, the development advantage of Chinese textile industry is not obvious, many factors affecting the competitiveness of Chinese textile industry. On the other hand, the EU market occupies the most percentage of China exporting products market. Therefore, in order to deeply recognize international competitiveness performance of Chinese textile industry in specified market, this paper takes the EU market for example to make detailed researches on evaluating index and influencing factors, which lays the foundation for the further study.

articleTitle: A Study on Transactional Strategies in the Supply Chain Based on Bilateral Optional Forward Contracts
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The fluctuations of market price bring risks to supply chain enterprises, which sign some optional forward contracts in order to reduce these risks. As an effective instrument for risk management, optional forward contract has the character of flexibility and variety. This paper aims to formulate the price of the contract using the option pricing theory and obtain an optimal proportion of forward contracts and the influence factors through the risk evasion model and on the basis of the utility maximization principle.

articleTitle: Compare Beamforming with Multiplexing for Mimo Relay Network in the Low SNR Regime
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Given a multiple-antenna source and a multiple- antenna destination, a multiple-antenna relay between the source and the destination is desirable under useful circumstances. In this paper, a spatial multiplexing scheme and a cooperative beamforming scheme have been proposed for a non-regenerative MIMO relay system. In the spatial multiplexing scheme, the MIMO relay channel can be decomposed into several parallel channels each with the source to relay channel gain and the relay to destination channel gain. In the cooperative beamforming scheme, the transmitter uses all of its antennas to transmit one signal instead of multiplexing different signals simultaneously. It can be proved that the capacity of the spatial multiplexing scheme is smaller than that of the cooperative beamforming scheme in the low SNR regime. It is shown that for asymptotically large number of relays, the capacity of the spatial multiplexing scheme is converging to that of the beamforming scheme.

articleTitle: Dynamic Mechanism Design Under Multi-Unit Demand for Online Auction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents the theory of dynamic sequential auctions which can be used for pricing and inventory control in online auction. Most theoretical treatments of auctions have assumed that buyers have unit demand, which didn't conform to the real state. We characterize this model when a seller with C units to sell by the way of sequential auctions faces a finite time horizon T, buyers in each period have multi-unit demands, and each of them has uniform, independent, private value for the product.. The numbers of bidders in each period as well as the individual bidders' valuations are random but stationary over time. There is a holding cost for inventory, advertising cost component, monitoring costs, and a unit cost for ordering more stock from an outside supplier .Backordering is not allowed. The seller must decide how to conduct its auctions and how to replenish its stock over time to maximize its profits. To achieve the optimal revenue, we analyze the optimal allocation, the optimal number of products to accept the optimal number of to reorder, and find a modified second-price auctions and a first-price auctions to achieve the optimal allocation policy.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Psychology Satisfaction Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By now, the study of customer satisfaction alarm system is little, and most of the existing study was qualitative or short of mathematical analysis. The study of mobile commerce customer satisfaction alarm system was shorter, and the mobile communication user satisfaction alarm system was not found. Based on the expatiation of mobile customer satisfaction, this paper constructs a scientific and reasonable formula for calculating mobile communication user satisfaction index. Consequently, by enacting the threshold of mobile communication user satisfaction index, mobile communication user satisfaction alarm system can be established, also the frame project and material ways for realizing user satisfaction alarm are brought forward.

articleTitle: Lot-Size Model for a Recovery System with Backordering and Disposal
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses the production lot-size problem of a recovery system with backordering and disposal. For this recovery system, shortages are allowed and fully backordered, and only a portion of returned products are remanufactured and the rest are disposed off. The constant demand is satisfied by serviceable inventory which consists of manufactured items and remanufactured items. Two types of policy are analyzed, and an optimization algorithm for the optimal manufacturing and remanufacturing policies is proposed. The results are general as backordering and disposal in the recovery environment are investigated simultaneously.

articleTitle: A Method for Solving a CVaR Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a financial optimization problem with a CVaR constraint is studied, and a frame work for solving this problem is presented via Monte Carlo simulation. Moreover, a optimal condition and a confident interval of the optimal value are given. An example of portfolio optimization is presented and a numerical algorithm is given.

articleTitle: A New Shared-Path Restoration Algorithm with SRLG Constraint in ASON
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to enhance the survivability of ASON, ASON must provide efficient recovery techniques to guarantee service continuity. This paper proposed a new path restoration algorithm with SRLG constraint to handle single-link failures in GMPLS-Based ASON (RSGA), whose restoration paths are pre-computed and stored in the routing table at each node. This algorithm can efficiently find physically disjoint Label Switched Paths (LSP) with SRLG. The numerical simulations show the RSGA can significantly improve resource utilization, and reduce blocking ratio.

articleTitle: Muti-Layer Architecture of Knowledge Management in Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is trying to study and design knowledge management system for virtual enterprise. The special conditions, environments and latent capacities of virtual enterprise are considered and then all knowledge in the organization is integrated organically. Three key models were designed for knowledge management system as a relatives layer structure. That is knowledge base layer, knowledge management layer and knowledge presentation layer. For each layer, still can be divided to different sub-layer. This kind of structure for knowledge management system is suit for virtual Enterprise.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Influence of Knowledge Customization Degree to Knowledge Transfer Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the knowledge transfer between the organizations is analyzed from a new angle, namely knowledge customization, which not only expends the research area of the knowledge management study but also provides guide line for the managerial practice of the knowledge transfer. First, through analyzing, we conclude that it is necessary to introduce the conception of knowledge customization and also defined the meaning of this conception. Secondly, the empirical model is constructed on the basis of analyzing the relations among the study inclination of members, the demand of the work, the degree of the knowledge customization and the transfer performance of the final knowledge. Moreover, this empirical model is verified by the data collected from the survey. Based on the analyzing and the result of the model, the conclusion is made and the future direction of research is proposed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Dual-L Antenna Designs for Portable RFID Reader
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The development of small integrated antennas plays a significant role in the progress of the rapidly expanding commercial RFID applications. In this paper, a planar dual-L antenna is presented for a dual-frequency band application of portable RFID reader. The antenna can be used over dual frequency of 840 MHz-845 MHz and 920 MHz-925 MHz which is allocated for RFID use in China. Simulation and measurement were performed and the dual-frequency band with a return loss better than -lOdB were achieved. The overall bandwidth of the antenna is increased and the dual-L antenna can be applied to ultra high frequency of 860 MHz-960 MHz that is proposed for RFID use by ISO/IEC.

articleTitle: Why People Continue Use EC ?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the dramatically develop Internet in businesses which have become a new medium to interact with customers, the challenges for Web site companies are how to design good Web system and interaction in order to retain customers and increase sales. However, customers' shopping behaviors on World Wide Web (WWW) are still inconclusive. In the compelling online environment, understanding how online consumers act is important in today's digital economy. Therefore, it is important to know to retain consumers' to shop on-line. In this study, we use Interactive Qualitative Analysis (IQA) approach to draw experienced EC consumers' mindmap to understand why they continue to shop online. There are some finds and the implications are discussed. In addition, some managerial problem may be concerned.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient Clustering Formation Algorithm For Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes an energy efficient clustering formation algorithm for wireless sensor network, which is called ACE-CILP algorithm according to considering the energy consumption as an optimization parameter. The algorithm can divide a sensor network into a few clusters and select a cluster head base on weight value that leads to more uniform energy dissipation evenly among all sensor nodes. The simulation results show that ACE-CILP algorithm achieves its intention of consuming less energy, equalizing the energy consumption of all the nodes, as well as extending the network lifetime perfectly.

articleTitle: Special Investment, Optimal Partial Ownership and Incentive Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
