abstract: A theoretical explanation for partial ownership arrangement existing among group members is provided under the background of specific investment between vertical suppliers and buyers. Based on the models taking the specific investment degree parameter as the selective variables of the upstream firm, the results show that, the simple take-or-pay contract can not solve the low-efficient specific investment problem, and only equity participation plus simple contract can improve the efficiency of specific investment. In addition, in the case that shares are purchased at premium price, the optimal equity participation ratio of the downstream firm in the publicly traded upstream firm should increase with the increase of its bargaining power, but decrease with the increase of the upstream firm's outside option value. In final, the interactions between the optimal partial ownership and special investment efficiency are discussed.

articleTitle: Learning Rule Analysis Under Dissymmetrical-Structure Social System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Evolutionary game theory provides the appropriate analytical method for social evolving problems. This paper reviews the existing literatures about the advanced directions of evolutionary game theory, one is adaptive learning mechanisms, the other is social network analysis. It puts forward the learning rule problem under the dissymmetrical social structure and relevant analytical method, which are building the dissymmetrical structure game model and evolutionary function under the restrictions of exterior environment and interior cognitive structure. At last, as the practical application, the paper analyzes the various dissymmetrical social structures and the government handling methods during the social emergencies.

articleTitle: An Improved Parasitic Resistance Model of Nano-Scale MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The reason that existing models have underestimated the parasitic resistance of nano-scale MOSFET biased at low gate voltage was discussed. Then an improved resistance model was proposed. Finally, the influences of several technical parameters on the parasitic resistance were analyzed through numerical simulation, and some directions and measures might be taken to reduce the parasitic resistance.

articleTitle: Searching Messages Based on Semantic Context
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Clients' queries upon keywords or other informed description do not usually provide complete and unambiguous retrieval of information. Expansion of the queries based on semantic relation and phrase patterns is an effective approach to improve the retrieval. In this paper, a novel approach to queries expansion is presented. In the first step, keywords and phrases in a query are extracted, and the query is classified using Bayesian classifier. The classification defines the domain of user interest which serves as the context around the query. The phrase is then matched against fixed patterns which are automatically extracted from the set of domain documents and serve as context within the query. This is followed by expansion of the remaining keywords that are not in the phrases. This expansion is based on synonyms and hyponyms in the domain ontology, and is controlled by measuring information gain. Finally, the similarity between the expanded query and the document of the domain is computed by combining the weighted phrases and keywords. Experimental results indicate that the proposed approach improves the precision and recall of information retrieval.

articleTitle: Evaluation Information System for Land Seismic Resistance Suitability Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Systematic analysis to the land seismic resistance suitability is made in Dongying and evaluating indicator system of seismic resistance suitability is established in Dongying, we comprehensively study land seismic resistance suitability with grey theory integrated method. It causes the measure results to be more scientific and reasonably that using gray statistics method to establish evaluation matrix, determining the weight of related indexes with the gray connection analysis and carrying on the comprehensive judgement with the fuzzy method. We developed the land seismic resistance suitability information system with VB and GIS on base of this model to carry on the especial analysis and the demonstration to the region related information.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Competitive Data acquisition Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an implementation of competitive data acquisition system based on wireless network. Adopting IEEE802.11b wireless communication standard, introducing the organization and operational mode of wireless network, and discussing the B/S design thought of data collector, data control and Web server, and show the operation results at last. This resolution support flexible organization of network, reliability and stability in operation, it's enough to supply the demand of data acquisition of multi-games.

articleTitle: Modeling and Forecasting for Scientific and Technological Progress and China's Regional Energy Structure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A serious shortage of oil since the 1970s, has made people profoundly understanding that we must rely on scientific and technological progress to improve energy efficiency, improve energy structure, and promote the sustainable development of energy, population, economy, and environment."Regional scientific and technological progress and the energy structure model" established in the paper, not only in the theory contribute to clearly analysis the system relations of scientific and technological progress and energy consumption during the economic development, but also in practical application, provide valuable countermeasures for China to improve its energy structure, raise energy efficiency, and build an innovation-oriented country.

articleTitle: An Improved Data Storage Mechanism for Static/Dynamic Forms in Web-Based Workflow Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative data storage mechanism for forms of web-based workflow systems in which various forms communicate with each other quite frequently to carry out workflow handling. To realise this approach, several methods mainly about string theory as well as string variable processing are provided. Moreover, it can deal with forms both in static and dynamic kinds. The key distinction of this approach is that we would care nothing about the contents of every forms in workflow systems. This can significantly simplify the table structure and data storage of the database.

articleTitle: Study on the Government Department Integration Decision Based on Synergetics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The construction of E-Government, applications of griddized urban management model and the large department reform of government organization reform are mean to set up a govern system which is high Synergetic and the sub-system can cooperate with each other very well. This paper sets up a multi-index department integration decision model with time feature based on synergetics theory. The system measurement decision model can be calculated from the standardized treatment of the benefit and cost index. The Least-squares method multi-index Optimize Model through the Weight vectors of each index and each time slots and the Close-degree of each integration proposal to the positive-Negative ideal proposal. This model can offer theory support for the optimal synergetic government system department integration decision and improves the synergetic degree of government system.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Qualitative Simulation Research on Supply Chain Cooperation Performance Based on Knowledge Sharing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Qualitative simulation, which has developed from artificial intelligence and simulation technology, is proven to be effective for fuzzy qualitative knowledge. By setting up and solving a qualitative simulation system of supply chain cooperation performance, this paper research on the circumstance that the change of knowledge sharing level in supply chain affect the supply chain cooperation performance. It is demonstrated that overall performance level of supply chain is affected by change of enterprise individual behavior, so it's necessary to research supply chain management from overall point of view.

articleTitle: Secure Encapsulation of Non-Secure Middleware
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Unceasingly develop and the thorough development along with the software system, the use of middleware become more and more, they mutually affect by the complex way. These middle wares, because of the complex of the origin, are not extremely credible. So, before using these middlewares, we must understand the security feature of them, for instance, the secret data cannot be leaked in the network. But, it is very difficult to confirm that these middlewares can have good security feature. The paper designs the encapsulations, which let these middlewares run under secure environment, and it provides the control of good granularity among the middle wares, the middleware and other system resources. The main part of this paper is to research the expression methods of the encapsulations, through these methods we give the security and verify it. This paper uses box-pi calculus to describe several kinds of encapsulations, and discuss the security which each kind of encapsulation could guarantee.

articleTitle: Spread Spectrum Signal Synchronous Arithmetic Using Power Spectrum Estimation and Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The system complexity, detection probability and average acquisition time are the most important performances. This paper proposes a novel method to reduce false-alarm probability and improve these performances, which utilizes the changes of power spectral density between in-sync and out-of-sync, and uses the difference of signals in-band and out-of-band instead of the signals in-band as the inputs of threshold comparator. What is more, this paper also proposes an adaptive threshold adjustment technology, which bases on the average power spectral density of received signals. At last, the simulation results are given.

articleTitle: Ergometric Collaboration: On-Demand Information Acquisition Using Microcontroller, Stepping Motor, and Physiological Database
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a collaborated architecture using microcontroller, stepping motor and physiological database to obtain the stress measurement of the quizzee. We implement an ergometric equipment for the purpose of iatrical experimentations. This equipment mainly consists of three components: embedded controller, integrator and background database. By regulating the pulse duration of the stepping motor, the embedded controller dynamically adjusts the mechanical velocity in terms of the physical reactivity of the quizzee, and then transmits the digital information transformed by the A/D converters to the integrator. The integrator analyzes, displays and stores the correlative results and provides the feedback signal to the controller.

articleTitle: A Study on the Construction of Information System in "Digital Ocean"
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: "Digital Ocean" is essentially a virtual ocean world which is composed of massive, multi-resolution, multi-temporal, multi-space marine monitoring and data analysis algorithms and models. "Digital Ocean" will promote a more intelligent way which people exploit and make use of the ocean, thus guarantee the sustainable development of the sea. This thesis conducts a research to the basic principle and technical frame of "Digital Ocean" and provides a solution to ocean management information.

articleTitle: The Cognitive Model of Interfirm Trust Dynamics: How Trust Is Evolved?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study develops an integrated view that may address interfirm trust formation and maintenance, which builds a cognitive model using the theory of fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) to show how the interfirm trust is evolved. The complexity natures of trust require use of soft computing modeling techniques. The proposed approach takes dynamic nature of trust into account to analyze evolution of trust. A case study of swift trust in the virtual enterprises is presented finally. The established cognitive map illustrates the changes of different factors and their effects on the final trusts.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cleaner Technology Diffusion Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Starting from the characteristic analysis of cleaner technology (CT) in this paper, CT is divided into three types as none-profit, critical-profit and high-profit through the horizontal and vertical analysis from the microeconomic view between CT and non-cleaner technology (NCT) . It is concluded that government intervention policies such as financial subsidy, environmental tax can push CT to high-profit type. Based on the study above, two CT diffusion modes are proposed: enterprise voluntary mode and government driven mode, which provided a research framework and direction for CT industrial development mode.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamic ID-Based Remote User Authentication Scheme Using Smart cards
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In 2004, Das presented a dynamic ID-based remote user authentication scheme using smart cards. Then in 2005, Liao showed that Das et al.'s scheme has some attacks and proposed a slight modification to their scheme to improve the weaknesses of it. This paper, however, will demonstrate that Liao et al.'s scheme has also some security flaws. Therefore, we propose an improved scheme to conquer their weaknesses. The improved scheme can enhance the security of Liao et al.'s scheme and is also efficient.

articleTitle: Adaptive Multi-Path Parallel Forwarding Mechanism in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The probability of successful packet delivery in ad hoc networks can be guaranteed by multi-path routing scheme, which can enhance network reliability. With the analysis on the path number, a decision making method based on packet drop ratio is introduced; moreover, a novel adaptive multi-path routing protocol is proposed. By monitoring packet drop ratio on the links, mobile nodes estimate link status with the pre-defined threshold, thus the partial-disjoint multi-path can be established under current network topology adaptively. Simulation results show this mechanism can provide reliable transmission for data packet and enhance the performance of the entire network while utilizing the network resource effectively.

articleTitle: Hybrid Positioning Algorithm for Galileo and WCDMA Dual-Mode Receiver
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One crucial problem of satellite navigation is the reduced accuracy for location inside buildings and urban canyons. A hybrid positioning algorithm for satellite navigation and cellular radio networks can resolve the problem. This paper studies and compares satellite-based positioning algorithms and hybrid positioning algorithm. Simulation and analysis results show that although hybrid positioning is not as good as double difference in positioning accuracy, but it does not have to satisfy the condition that 4 or more than 4 satellites must be in view. At the same time, its positioning error is less than static positioning, especially when few satellites can be observed. Therefore, combining advantages of satellite navigation system and cellular system, we can develop a better receiver which can be used in both urban area and rural area.

articleTitle: The Mechanism of Transaction: Value Equilibrium Model of A Bargaining Game Between Two Rational Agents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Transactions are the most common phenomenon in market economy. But in theoretical research, modeling a transaction is a complex problem unsolved. In this paper, firstly, natural rationality (A) is defined as nonlinear function of agent's benefit (B) and cost (C), and <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A=max(</sub>B/C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">)</sub>. This mathematical model of natural rationality can be considered as one answer to Aumann's "open problem". Secondly, Three basic definitions of neutrality value system for market economy are constructed: commodity value, seller value and buyer value. Thirdly, value equilibrium of a bargaining game is modeled when the seller value is equal to the buyer value, and equilibrium price solution in a transaction is obtained. Finally, On these basis, the sequential bargaining process between two rationality agents (a seller and a buyer) is modeled in a time series by analytical geometry.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Transmission Range Optimum for Rayleigh Fading CDMA Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel approach to transmission range optimum for CDMA ad hoc networks in Rayleigh fading environments is proposed. Firstly, the concept of normalized area throughput is introduced. And then the optimal transmission range and probability of sending a packet are derived on the basis of the normalized area throughput. Compared with the metric of expected forward progress (EFP), the proposed approach focuses on maximizing the total network throughput rather than the throughput of each node. It is shown that by using the metric of normalized area throughput, we can get that the optimum probability of sending a packet is 0.555, which is bigger than the result of 0.271 based on EFP, and the optimum transmission range is shorter than the value based on EFP metric. The optimal throughput performance of the total network is improved by approximate 56.8%, through the result of each node is degraded by about 23.5%.

articleTitle: Law of Development in the Service Industry and its Use for Reference in Development of Service Industry in Zhenjiang
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The development of the service industry is a significant symbol for measuring the level of economy and the modernization. Promoting the service industry's development, especially the modern one's, is a strategic method for enhancing citizens'quality on economy and running. Meanwhile, it is an inevitable choice to realize social coordination and the sustainable development. In view of this point, it is necessary for us to analyze and study the inner law of service industry and then guide its further development. Regarding service industry as the study object, this paper discusses deeply about the law and trend of its structure on long-term evolving, which is be considered as basis on adjusting and optimizing the structure of service industry in Zhenjiang, so as to induce it to develop healthily. Generally speaking, adopting the comparative and dynamic analysis and the empirical research method, this paper draws the conclusion, which has a vital practical significance on understanding development law of service industry, hierarchical of internal structure and the readjustment and optimization of the economic structure ,economic development, and build an overall well-to-do society.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Algorithm Based on Wavelet and Rough Set in Intelligent Transport System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This research is concerned with the development of algorithmic approaches to achieve traffic surveillance data fusion in intelligent transportation system. A new image fusion method based on wavelet analysis and rough set theory is proposed in this paper to combine visible light image and infrared image into a higher performance image. This algorithm utilizes the characteristics of rough set theory to classify the wavelet coefficients of original images to obtain the fused image. Experimental results have shown that most of the final composite images have more integrated information content and better perceptual quality than either of the original images. The results indicate that application of this algorithm improves performance of intelligent transport system.

articleTitle: The Perception of the Radar Signal in the Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, two frequency measurement methods of radar signals are presented at first, and then we focus on the introduction of the FFT frequency measurement and its advantages. After that, combining with the characteristics of the radar signal, we introduce a digital frequency measurement structure for the radar signal, which is based on the generous software radio structure. Finally, we discuss about the distributed system for the sensing of the radar signal in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: Study on Project Risk Management Information System Based on Progress Schedule
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: From how to design management information system to effectively avoid the project risk then to guarantee the smooth implementation of the progress schedule, this paper analyzes the process of designing the management information system based on project progress schedule, emphatically discusses the analysis of data flow diagram and the main modules design. Based on the multilayered distributed application structure, this system realizes the effective integration of the project progress schedule management, the risk process management, the communication management, the consultation management, so as to guarantee the smooth implementation of the progress schedule.

articleTitle: A CRM Model Based on Mining Unstructured Customers' Data
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The objective of this research is to apply content analysis and decision tree criteria to analyze unstructured customer data. Base on this analysis, the hidden customer knowledge is discovered and a customer relationship management models is proposed. This could provide the best service model owing to the enounced of customer-orientation and making more effective marketing strategy. Finally, a case study will be presented to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the approach proposed in this research.

articleTitle: A Warning Model of Corporate Culture Based on Synergetics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The warning model of corporate culture proposed in this paper integrates aspects of synergetics theory and uses the related kinetic equations. The solution distributions of Fokker Planck equation and main equation corresponding with the mathematical model constructed characterize the state of corporate culture, for the different distribution curves provide evidence for identifying different culture tendency of employees, which varies with the transformation of the preference parameter delta and conformity parameter k. Based on the criterions of stability and ideality, the state of corporate culture can be classified as stability-ideality, instability-ideality, stability-non ideality and instability-non ideality. The warning model can serve as an analytic tool for identifying whether the state of corporate culture is in a sound position or in a dangerous one, and it becomes possible to estimate the gap between the goal and the actuality and find ways to bridge it.

articleTitle: The Interactive, Multi-Objective and Flexible Decision-Making Model for Investment of Water Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Water project has the characters of long investment cycle, muti-objectiveness, uncertain and so on. The traditional investment decision-making model usually only makes decision from the perspective of engineering and technical, while ignoring the impact of the above factors. The interactive idea can modify the decision-making results according to uncertain conditions during the course of decision-making, which can solve the impact of uncertain factors in water project investment. The interactive, multi-objective and flexible decision-making model is established by using the interactive idea. The model can solve the semi-structured problems and can deal with the impact of the uncertain factors for the decision-making. The South-to-North Water Transfer Project is a very large water project, which can solve the problem of water shortage in the north of China. The interactive, multi-objective and flexible decision-making model was used to make decision on the middle-east route connectivity drainage of South-to-North Water Transfer Project in Hebei province. The result showed that the model can provide decision support for the water project investment decision.

articleTitle: Development of Simulation Model Transformation Tool
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents the development of simulation model transformation tool. With it, we can convert configuration texts in one system to another, which can be used directly in the new system. It is developed in the environment of visual C++ 6.0. The software is open to user and easy to use .By using it, we can reduce the labor intensity for research worker and the period of developing simulator. It is really a new way for automatic modeling of DCS simulator.

articleTitle: Investigating Social Entrepreneurship Success: The Role of Corporate Social Capital in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, the concept of 'social entrepreneurship' has been rapidly emerging in the private, public and non-profit sectors over the last few years. Social entrepreneurship draws more and more attention as an innovative approach to achieve social mission and fulfill social needs. Successful social entrepreneurship relay also on resource allocation as economic entrepreneurship. This paper employs the method of statistical analysis to find out the impact of corporate social capital on social entrepreneurship success. The results indicates that relationship extent relationship depth and relationship frequency all have positive relationship with social entrepreneurship success but showing different effect in three aspects of success.

articleTitle: Three-Level Anomaly Disposal System Model Based on Danger Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the intrusion detection system based on traditional immune theory, a new three levels anomaly disposal system model based on danger theory was proposed in this paper. The data stream is treated with three levels anomaly disposal in the model, the first level is to recognize the danger and remove the data of non-danger which will not bring damage to the system, for the second level is all dangerous abnormal invasions which will be classified properly, and then the danger will be solved finally at the third level. The designed model improved the system's "danger" recognition, reduced the false alarm as well as failed alarm efficiently, and it has strong robustness and cognitive learning ability.

articleTitle: A New Model for Generating Scenarios in ALM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Facing with the problem of simulating the dynamic processes of scenario variables in the asset and liability management for the financial institutions, we propose a new model, vector error correction model with specified constraints, to fit the long-term dynamic process of the random vectors. Comparing with the traditional econometric methods, vector error correction model, we can conclude that the VECM with specified constraints is more superior to VECM.

articleTitle: A Novel Anti-Collusion Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the problems that sensor node-key leaking and adversaries make compromised nodes as their collusions to launch new attack, the paper proposed an efficient anti-collusion scheme based on elliptic curve cryptography for wireless sensor networks. In the proposed scheme, the group-key distribution strategy is employed to compute the private key of each sensor node, and the encryption and decryption algorithms are constructed based on elliptic curve cryptography. The command center (node) only needs to broadcast a controlling header with three group elements, and the authorized sensor node can correctly recover the session key and using it to decrypt the broadcasting message. Simulation and analysis of the proposed scheme show that the proposed scheme can resist the k-collusion attack arouse by adversary or compromised nodes efficiently.

articleTitle: A Layered P2P Network Topology Based on Physical Network Topology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the goals of P2P file-sharing system is to provide reliable and convenient sharing mechanism for users, so the resources can be gotten more quickly. However, in traditional DHT network, the problem of mismatching between the P2P overlay network and the physical underlying network has not been taken into consideration, which greatly limits the performance in various search or routing techniques. In this paper, a hierarchical physical location related DHT topology named MLC (Multi-level Chord) is proposed, and it can alleviate the mismatching problem. Through the layered topology mechanism and the role of GL (Group Leader) and SL (Slice Leader), a better balance of the load can be achieved. With the bottom-up transmitting mechanism, the routing efficiency and search speed improve obviously. PPU (Period Partial Update) algorithm can reduce some of the unnecessary traffic. Analysis shows MLC is a more efficient topology.

articleTitle: Cyclo-Period Estimation for Poly-Cyclo-Stationary Signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm to estimate the cyclo-period of a poly-cyclo-stationary signal. The algorithm is essentially based on the time-varying correlation and the variability method; a calculation of the sample variance ratio as a function of the modulated noise variance visually reveals a regular pattern, from which the poly-cyclo-period is obtained. Properties of the estimation method are analyzed and compared with the different signal models via simulation.

articleTitle: Management Model for Producer Service Outsourcing Based on QFD: A Conceptional Framework
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, characters of producer service outsourcing is analyzed, and QFD based management model of producer service outsourcing is proposed in order to have win-win results that applies QFD to deploy customer needs and decision-making factors from different levels to make tactics and to implement services according to the four elements, and finally establishes process controlling criterions to make sure outsourcing suppliers provide effective and efficient services.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Management Information System for USD Based on COMGIS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Urban sustainable development (USD) is connected with the urban spatio-temporal change, it is very important for decision-makers to rapidly look up for the development information data and analyse the harmony development trend. Supported with the component object model of geographic information system (COMGIS), urban environment, economic and social statistical database, and harmony development models, the management information system (MIS) has been developed on VB platform. The urban sustainable development MIS was designed with Map Objects to come true the function of spatial management, the different urban development layer can be loaded and removed freely, the attribution data can be acquired by spatial inquiring. Inquired data can be used in the system for further analysis with urban development models. By data binding method, the spatial analysis can be implemented with urban statistical database, to generate special map with symbols and shape. The USD model analysis function was mainly developed by VB platform to do the harmony development analysis by statistic data, calculate the harmony development trend, and display the results in line shape and table.

articleTitle: A Case-Based Comparison of East and Central Regions of China of E-Commerce Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The term "e-commerce" is becoming more popular as businesses became aware of the potential role of the Internet as a powerful medium for conducting business. Some enterprises in central region have adopted B2B business model, yet in e-commerce journals, the central region in China has received surprisingly scant attention, empirical evidence lags behind theoretical development. Combining with the current economy conditions of the east and middle regions, this paper discusses the e-commerce development in China, and picks out two typical B2B Websites China.chemnet.com in Hangzhou City and whcotton.com in Wuhan City, analyzes and compares their advantages and disadvantages, basing on the analysis results, the paper proposes six suggestions on the e-commerce development for the Central Region of China.

articleTitle: XML-Based Middleware of Quick Response System in Textile & Apparel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a XML-based middleware framework of the quick response system for textile and apparel supply chain, and describes the middleware used in the system .Through the example of the retailer estimate the delay time of a order cycle, this article introduces the XML-based process design of the quick response system, the XML documents linking mechanism for the integration of heterogeneous data the computing model of the delay time of a order cycle. The effect of the application of the system is analyzed and verified by this example ,that is members of the supply chain can effectively share information through this quick response system, reduce the delay in clothing manufacturing and delivery, decrease the enterprises' security inventory ,thus the goal of making quick response to the change of the market is achieved.

articleTitle: The Effect of Sampling Frequency Synchronization on the Symbol Synchronization of OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the sampling frequency synchronization for OFDM systems is modeled as a frequency recovery loop, and how the noise component of the frequency recovery loop affects on the symbol synchronization is analyzed. Both the theoretical analyses and numeric simulation show the symbol synchronization is necessary for the coherent detection in an OFDM system because even small noise component in the frequency recovery loop will lead to large FFT window drift.

articleTitle: A New Framework of Knowledge Discovery Based on Double-Base Cooperating Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge is an important resource to keep competitive advantage of enterprise. But traditional knowledge discovery system (KDS) is inefficient and its knowledge base is hard to maintain. Therefore this paper presents a new framework of KDS based on double-base cooperating mechanism (DCM), in which database can be restricted and driven by knowledge base whose structure can be in turn improved by database. At the same time, the precision and auto-cognition of knowledge discovery can be improved and knowledge base is equipped with the capacity of real time maintenance. At last the framework is applied to knowledge agriculture to illuminate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Adaptability and Intelligent of Web-Based Curriculum HRM to Realize the Success of Distance Training
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we applied theme-based learning model to web-based human resource management (HRM) curriculum distance training, which aims to cultivate learners' ability of knowledge integration by giving the learners the opportunities to select the learning topics in HRM that they are interested, and gain knowledge on the specific topics by surfing on the Internet to search related learning courseware and discussing what they have learned. We narrated the web-based HRM architecture and system model frame firstly. Then we studied the system key technologies in the implementation. They were asynchronous mode problem in distance learning, synchronous mode problem in distance learning and evaluation strategy in distance training. At last it is concluded that the system can enhance the adaptability and intelligent of web-based HRM. These characters play important role in Web-based HRM systems success.

articleTitle: An Efficient Joint Sub-Carrier, Bit, and Power Allocation of OFDM System in Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an efficient joint sub-carrier, bit and power allocation algorithm which tries to minimize the total transmit power for OFDM system, while maintaining the BER constraint and the rate requirement of each user. Some existing allocation algorithms allocate resources based on the "best channel gain" rule, which made some resources assigned to the users which are in deep fading. In this paper, we swap the sub-carriers between users to minimize the transmit power after the sub-carrier allocation is decided. Simulation results show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is much better than that of the other algorithms.

articleTitle: Generic On-Line/Off-Line Threshold Signatures
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On-line/off-line threshold signature schemes are used when the signers have a very limited response time once the message is presented, but they can carry out costly computation between consecutive signing requests. On-line/off-line threshold signature schemes are particularly useful in smart card applications. In this paper, we propose generic on-line/off-line threshold signatures by applying the hash-sign-switch paradigm developed by Adi Shamir and Yael Tauman, we use a Chameleon hash function based on bilinear parings. Any existing signature schemes can be converted into on-line/off-line ones by our scheme. Our scheme is fully distributed and requires no trusted dealer. Finally we prove that our scheme is existentially unforgeable against adaptive chosen message attack under the chosen-target computational Diffie-Hellman assumption.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Investment in Inter-Organizational Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Today inter-organizational information system (IOS) provides supply chains with new opportunities to promote communication efficiency and create competitive advantage. However, IOS adoption is costly and time-consuming. Enterprises that are not well prepared may run a loss from the project. Therefore, the primary concern before IOS installation is at what cost the project is fulfilled to achieve the maximal profit. To address the problem, this paper sets up a two-player model based on the profit generated by IOS. The model helps companies determine the level of IOS investment that produces the best utility. Furthermore, after figuring out the optimal amount of investment, we work out a solution to the problem of cost sharing between trading partners with different power by applying asymmetric Nash bargaining solution.

articleTitle: Cooperative Intensity of Logistics Enterprises in Region
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Logistics synergy is an effective way to reduce logistics costs and improve the quality of logistics services in region. The present researches are concentrated on the collaborative methods and the choice of partners, but never think the methods of performance appraisal. A new concept, cooperative intensity between logistics enterprises in region, is proposed. The main effect factors of regional logistics cooperation are summarized which includes collaborative gravitation and collaborative resistance. Gravity model is taken to quantify the collaborative gravitation. So the cooperation gravitation is proportional to the competitiveness of the enterprises and reversely proportional to the distance. Synergy benefits and synergy costs are taken into account to calculate the collaborative resistance. On this basis, the model to calculate the whole cooperation intensity is presented and so is the involving the calculation methods of vertical and horizontal synergy, which provides a new research method for the evaluation of logistics cooperation in region.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact Mechanism of Information Technology on Organizational Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently there has been a hot topic how the information technology impact on the organizational flexibility. Based on the conclusion of various points of view and flexible dimensionality theory, the research focuses on the evolution of flexible dimensionality under different circumstance and information technology related. Analyze, thereby, relatives between information technology and flexible potential, and between flexible potential and organizational flexibility. Meanwhile outputting the factors and preconditions how the information transformed into flexible potential, and flexible potential transformed into flexibility. All in all according to these essentials above, the mechanism module can be constructed regarding to information technology related to influence of organizational flexibility.

articleTitle: Estimating Hurst Index Based On Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Long range persistence has been observed in many fields. A variety of methods have been proposed to estimate Hurst index of non-stationary and stationary process, which has power- law decay. In this paper, non-stationary process (fractional Brownian motion) is transformed to a stationary process and the autocorrelation decay exponentially by using discrete wavelet transformation. Then a novel unbiased estimator is developed. Wavelet method not only effectively eliminates the trend of series, but also deals with the abrupt change of series. Even the series contains some noise, wavelet method can perform well. At last, by comparing with R/H method, we conclude that estimator based on wavelet is more robust and more exact than that on R/H.

articleTitle: ES-MAC: Research on Enhanced S-MAC Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a classic protocol based on the MAC protocol in wireless sensor networks, the S-MAC protocol has been arousing the people's widespread interests. According to the S-MAC data frame structure and signaling characteristics, this paper puts forward a blast-off power control mechanism based on S-MAC; modifies the competitive mechanism of the S-MAC protocol, and provides the protection to the nodes with less energy. This text is called the ES-MAC to the S-MAC protocol that used these two kinds of mechanisms, simulation test shows that ES-MAC can effectively reduce energy consumption, and improves energy efficiency; finally, it introduces the access priority in S-MAC protocol, increases support which access to different priority nodes. Through these processes, the S-MAC protocol function is improved effectively.

articleTitle: A Methodology for Evaluating Information System Development Risk-Structure Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The efficiency of collecting, analyzing and managing information will have profound influence on enterprise development in the era of knowledge economy. The successful development and application of the information system has become one of the main factors that affect the competitiveness of enterprises. Much resource has been invested to build the information system. However, presently, there are no systematic methodologies to quantify the impact of risks arising from information system development (ISD) process on the final software operation. It is imperative that enterprise management needs such methodology in place to evaluate the impact of various risks on the ISD outcome. In this paper, we introduce structure equation model (SEM) to the evaluating process, taking into account risks at the source and the composition of risks. The evaluation model of ISD risks is then constructed and tested with actual cases. The model is found to be useful in differentiating the types of risks and their impact. It serves as a powerful tool for managers in formulating risk management strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Representation Based on Ontology for Warning System and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The warning system has become the urgent demand of commercial competition, and the representation of all kinds of the monitored indexes of the warning system is the hard core. In this paper, the semantic network is applied to define the domain ontology of the system, and Dublin Core is introduced to annotate knowledge. Furthermore, the formalization based on OWL+ Dublin Core is provided. Predicate logic is combined with production KR, as a method to describe the reasoning rule in the knowledge base. We also take the warning system of technical barriers to trade for example to explain its application.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Determination of Threshold Default Risk Criterion and Credit Term in Two-Staged Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Setting default risk threshold to filter buyers eligible for credit granting is one of the key measures the supplier can take to deal with default risk issue in supply chain coordination. This paper presents a method to find the exact threshold default risk the supplier can accept by solving simultaneous equations derived from the bilevel programming modelling of the interactions between supplier and buyer. With cost function of the retailer and the incremental cost function of the supplier due to trade credit granting specified, a bilevel programming model to find the optimal trade credit policy can be set up. By solving this bilevel programming, the relationship between optimal credit term and corresponding default risk can be specified. Furthermore, the extreme situation where the threshold default risk is reached means the supplier will gain zero incremental profit at such a risk level. Thus, a system of two equations consists of two unknown variables of optimal credit term and threshold default risk can be set up. The exact default risk criterion can be found by solving these simultaneous equations.

articleTitle: A Formal Evaluation Approach to UML State Model Based on Polychromatic Sets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The United Model Language (UML) has been applied in various areas and disciplines. Among UML, the state diagram is an important descriptive means to model object state transition. But it is still lack of feasible and effective validation method which can be utilized to formalize and revise the UML state diagram. In this thesis, a new approach for this problem is proposed based on the polychromatic set theory. Based on this theory, it can be realized the mapping from state model to the PS contour matrix, and implement model revision effectively. Firstly, the transformation method from UML state diagram to contour matrix model of polychromatic sets was established. Connection types among states were recognized as the elements of polychromatic sets. Secondly, the evaluation and reduction algorithm of the state model was presented. Finally, an example of software requirement state transformation diagram was provided for application of the theory and method mentioned above. As a result, the state model can be optimized and evaluated quantitatively by the new method.

articleTitle: The Community Structure of Competitive Pressure Networks for Multimarket Industries
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Both the product oriented competitor identification method and the two-firm based multi-point competition analysis have their shortcomings in the analysis of the overall competition in a multi-market industry. This paper assumes it is possible that in some multi-market industry, firms are competing in communities (or groups). Based on the notion of competitive pressure and the community structure approach in complex network study, this paper tries to propose a method in detecting the community structure in an industry so as to find out firms and products (submarket) that should be considered in competition strategy research.

articleTitle: Fast Updating Maximal Frequent Itemsets Based on Full Merged Sorted FP-Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because of the low efficiency of Maximal Frequent Itemsets(MFI) updating methods, the MFI's updating methods were analyzed. A new algorithm UAMFI based on Full Merged Sorted FP-Tree (FMSFP-Tree) was proposed. By merging the Sorted FP-Tree and then obtaining the FMSFP-Tree, UAMFI uses the depth-first method to find and update MFI. Finally, the algorithm was tested on the mushroom and T15I4D100K database, and UAMFI's performances were compared with Mafia. The experimental results indicate that UAMFI is an efficient algorithm for updating Maximal Frequent Itemsets.

articleTitle: Directed Acyclic Graph Version Model Applied in Product Structure Configuration
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper discussed the realization of version management model in product data management. Directed acyclic graph version model is introduced into product structure configuration. The definition and correlative definitions of directed acyclic graph version model are presented at first. Secondly the operations about version model traversing, version consistency analysis, and version tracking etc in version management are analyzed. Then the single product object version model is built. The version management model in product structure configuration is built based on single product object version model. The designer can get needed product structure easily.

articleTitle: Networked Manufacturing-Based Supply Chain Operation Mode and Contract Research
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networked manufacturing-based supply chain operation model was presented in this paper. Networked manufacturing-based supply chain employs B/S(Browser/ Server) structure. It can realize the functions of product search, goods order, inventory search and customer support etc. By using revenue-sharing contract, the two- stage supply chain coordination model between the manufacturer and retailer which is based on networked manufacturing was built. Through analysis of factors such as revenue-sharing proportion Phi(0lesPhiles1), order quantity q, wholesale price w and punishment factor r, the reasonable coordination strategy can be found. From two aspects: separate supply chain and integrated supply chain, the paper analyzed the game strategy between the manufacturer and retailer and discusses the profit influence of some relevant parameters for enterprises.

articleTitle: What Affects User Adoption of Instant Messaging in China? An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Instant messaging (IM) is a popular Internet application around the world. In China, the competition in the IM market is very intense and there are over ten IM products available. However, many of these products are not well accepted by Internet users and they only have small market shares. These companies are eager to know what factors determine user's acceptance of IM. In this paper, we examine the intrinsic and extrinsic motivations that affect Chinese users' acceptance of IM based on the technology acceptance model (TAM) and flow theory. Results demonstrate that users' perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived playfulness and flow experience significantly influence their attitude towards using IM, which in turn impacts their behavioral intention. Users' intention determines their actual usage behavior. Moreover, perceived playfulness has a significant impact on the flow experience.

articleTitle: The Complex Spherical Decoding Algorithm Research in WPT-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Maximum likelihood (ML) detection algorithm is the best method for multi-user detection, but it has high computational complexity. This paper presents a view of this issue to its rapid and effective method, that is, complex spherical decoding algorithm. This algorithm not only maintains good performance of the ML detection, but also has a low computational complexity. On the other hand, the multi-carrier modulation with wavelet packet doesn't give rise to high side lode caused by OFDM technique, so that it avoids the loss of orthogonality duing to multi-path effect which leads to severe inter-channel interference. This modulation scheme also avoids the loss of SNR on account of cyclic prefix's application. We combine these two techniques to propose the complex spherical decoding algorithm in MC-CDMA modulated by wavelet packet (WPT-CDMA) system, the performance of multi-user detection has great improved from the results of simulation.

articleTitle: A Study on the Third Party Logistics Development under the Condition of Electronic Business in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Electronic business (EB) has gained more researches and fast development in recent years, which combines the information flow, the capital flow, the business, and the logistics together. Although the logistics is also a section of EB, people usually stress on the electrification or the network of information flow and capital flow but neglect that of logistics. They think that the traditional marketing channels are sufficient for most of commodities and services. However, along with the fast development and the wide application of EB, the logistics becomes more important than ever. This paper chiefly discusses the problems existed in the third party logistics under the EB environment and the countermeasures, by explaining the concepts of EB and third party logistics, and analyzing the relationship between the two concepts.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on HRM Performance by Cultural Differences
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to get the influence degree imposed on human resource management by cultural differences within strategic alliance of transnational enterprise, a special questionnaire is specially designed, and the results is analyzed so as to get the measuring value of influence. Empirical research shows that differences in systematic culture, operation idea, operation mode, and values within strategic alliance of multinational corporations have promoted human resource management performance actively in different degrees.

articleTitle: Design of Information Sharing in a Supply Chain Using SM Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For many companies, supply chain management (SCM) has become an important element of strategic advantage to gain a competitive edge over their competitors. The soar-up of economy and improvement of info-tech require the enterprises' sharp response upon the changeful market and demands from clients. The thesis mainly focuses on retail industry, and brings forward an information sharing scenario, using SM (short message) technology to realize instant information transmission among every sale unit and headquarter in a supply chain. By comprehensive research on SM coding format, AT commands and information flow, this paper presents a solution scheme and key technology. Information sharing in a supply chain can further improve cooperation efficiency of every sale unit and headquarter. Furthermore, the historical data of SM-based information exchange can help the management stuff to make strategic decisions and plans by processing and mining.

articleTitle: Model and Simulation of Channel Capacity for MIMO Wireless Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to study the basis of information theory for MIMO wireless navigation system, channel capacity formula of MIMO system which uses multi-sending and multi-receiving antennas was deduced from point of view of information theory. With a circularly symmetric complex Gaussian input signal vector and equally-distributed signal power through all the transmit antennas, a much higher capacity can be obtained compared to the traditional SISO system. Two typical MIMO systems corresponding to all 1's and the unit transmission matrix were modeled completely for their channel capacity, followed by our proposed virtual equivalent structures. The simulation results were also given to testify the MIMO channel capacity.

articleTitle: Futures Hedge Ratio Estimating Model Based on Kernel Estimator and EWMA Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the kernel density estimator approach is used to estimate the probability density function of spot logarithm return and futures logarithm return. And the variance risk of spot and futures logarithm return is calculated. The method of exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) is adopted to estimate the covariance of spot and futures logarithm return. Through using the variance of hedged portfolio measure the risk, the estimating model of the minimum variance hedge ratio is gained.

articleTitle: Trade-Off Investigation Between Diversity and Spatial Multiplexing in Practical Systems Using Numerical Results
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using multiple antennas in wireless communication systems proposes some degrees of freedom in system design, these degrees of freedom can be applied to improve the system reliability by using space time block coding (STBC) which provides diversity gain. Degrees of freedom also can be applied to increase the system capacity using spatial multiplexing (SM) methods. It is possible to achieve a trade-off between diversity gain and spatial multiplexing gain. Selecting the method which provides best efficiency for a specific system is an important issue. In this paper we will show which space-time architecture achieves the best efficiency for a specific system in practical cases. This classification depends on the desired data rate, number of transmission antennas, modulation order, SNR regime and channel state.

articleTitle: The Simulation Study of Adaline PID Control and Decoupling for the VAV System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since variable air volume (VAV) systems become more economical than other alternative systems, the building industry nowadays has widely adopted VAV systems in the building engineering to maintain the cooling and heating demands. However, because VAV system is multivariable, strongly coupled, nonlinear, and time variant, it is more difficult in design, performance and management than constant air volume (CAV) system. The paper applies the Adaline PID controller to decouple and control the AHU part of VAV air conditioning system based on the neuron adaptive decoupling control strategy. The validation was made in the paper through Matlab simulation and the results shows that this decoupling and control strategy is efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Information Services of Sustainable Utilization of Natural Resources Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sustainable utilization of natural resources is a hot topic that is concerned about in the 21st century. With the fast development of information technology, it is necessary that we should build an information service system of sustainable utilization of natural resources based on Web. After introducing the connotation of sustainable utilization of natural resources and the theory of information services base on Web, the paper designs the system framework of information services of natural resources' sustainable utilization based on Web, which will guide the construction of information services of natural resources' sustainable utilization.

articleTitle: Random Traffic Prediction in WCDMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Congestion control is considered as a key factor in radio resource management. Early detection and rapid resolution network congestion can considerably improve network capacity. Consequently, much research has been carried out on predicting traffic patterns in 3G networks. This paper introduces a random traffic forecasting method based on the weighted probability and the maximum likelihood estimation, which is able to implement a "dynamic" congestion optimization algorithm for smart antennas.

articleTitle: Exploiting a New Domain About Urban Plan Promoting Employment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Analyzing the theory of urban plan and its experiences and lessons in history, it is found that urban plan should and can promote employment directly. In China, every city is emending urban plan and the central government of Chinese communist party denotes that urban planning should consider "more employment". In such background, the traditional opinion "urban plan can not promote employment directly" should be changed and a new research domain about urban plan promoting employment should be exploited. Through exploiting this new domain, on one hand, we can find a new way about employment, decrease the serious pressure of employment in cities of China, perfect and develop employment theory. On the other hand, it redound to lead residual labor forces in the countryside transfer in a reasonable way and shun "the fault of big city" as it happened in Africa where a great deal of peasants swarm into big cities out-of-order, perfect and develop urban plan theory.

articleTitle: The Research of Value Loop in Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of Internet, the concept of Web2.0, which kernel is personalization and active participation, has popularized gradually. Common consumers can product all kinds of digital products and upload on Internet. The boundary between producers and consumers are becoming obscure. Therefore, the value chain of electronic commerce, which originally starts with producers and ends with consumers, is bending progressively to become a loop of value system. Based on the actualities of electronic commerce, this paper innovatively puts forward a value loop model of it, which is helpful to forecast and analyze the trend of Internet electronic commerce.

articleTitle: Location Choice and Industry Transfer of FDI
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Every kind of inquisition data shows, in recent years some multinational enterprises have already withdrawn from the delta of Yangtze River or the delta of Zhujiang River in China, the other some are thinking it over, and even simply trying to withdraw from China. By building up an oligopoly output competition model consists of multinational enterprises and the host state enterprises, this paper analyzes how the cost factor influences FDI location choice in the host country, moreover analyzes the large-scale industry transfer tide of FDI taking place in China which is induced by variation of cost factor.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Algorithm for Network Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed an improved ant algorithm with feedback function extension and dynamic pheromone design (dynamicAnt) for the network traffic management issue. The scheme first mapped the network traffic path delay and bandwidth metrics into the parameters of the basic ant algorithm. And then extended the network feedback function to the basic ant algorithm by simulated it as the food smell. By releasing the food smell and the ant pheromone with a dynamic design, the path selection behavior of each ant will be influenced according to their variation. The aim of dynamicAnt lied in affecting the ants' behavior to make fully use of available paths with avoiding the paths congestion in the network traffic control. Besides analyzing the effective control of the pheromone and its related transfer possibility, compared with basic ant algorithm, simulation experiments illustrate that the proposed algorithm achieved better network traffic performance in network throughput, path delay and packet loss rate.

articleTitle: The Antecedents of Employee Commitment in Hospitality Industry: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Employee commitment is an important issue for both practitioners and academicians. This paper focuses on exploring the relationships among organizational support, affective commitment and normative commitment, based on data from the hospitality industry of China. The results indicate that affective commitment had significant positive effect on normative commitment. Among the three dimensions of organizational support, managerial support had the greatest influence on employee commitment, compared with co-worker relationship and role ambiguity. Theoretical discussions and practical implications have also been provided.

articleTitle: Correcting State Error by Making Full Use of Late Packet for Prediction-Based Decoding in VoIP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Prediction-based speech codecs are known to be sensitive to packet loss because of inter-frame dependencies in their prediction states. If a packet is lost, internal states between the encoder and decoder will become automatically out of synchronization. This causes the state error propagation and will degrade the speech quality even if the decoder receives the following packets correctly. Within the context of voice transmission over packet networks, some packets arrive too late to be decoded and have to be given up. A new method is proposed to use late packets to correct the state error of the decoder, which minimize the state error propagation. The state tracking mechanism of the method can ensure the decoder's making full use of late packets without increasing the overall end-to-end delay. Simulation results show that the speech quality is greatly improved with this method at the price of additional complexity.

articleTitle: A Vehicle Peccancy Management System Based on MMS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multimedia messaging service (MMS) is developed from WAP FORUM and WAP protocol, and it pushes the multimedia information such as text, picture and sound to the mobile phone directly by using wap as the main data layer. MMS is becoming the most basic application of value added service. This paper presents a vehicle peccancy management system based on MMS. Through this platform, users can query their own traffic preccancy information easily in time. Traffic policemen can get the vehicle information at once through inputting vehicle license plate number. This information is sent in the way of MMS, which is full of images, audio, text and so on. It can effectively remind drivers to obey traffic laws and regulations, and it also reflects the concept of people-centered.

articleTitle: Design of a Cigarette Sorting System Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a design method to solve the problems of high failure rate and sorting inefficience in the current cigarette sorting system by integrating RFID technology with CAN BUS. Based on the features of high speed of data transmission, real-time and high reliability, CAN BUS intelligent node is designed. RFID technology enhances the speed and efficiency of cigarette identification. Meanwhile, using the LCD touch-screen and MCGS configuration software, the HMI operation is promoted and the visualization of monitoring processing can also be accomplished.

articleTitle: A New Mutual Authentication and Key Agreement Protocol for Mobile Communications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The key technology of mobile value-added services is to design protocol, which can meet the poor computing power as well as being security. This paper proposes an Advanced-RPC protocol by adding hash function with key to the Lowe modified BAN concrete Andrew Secure RPC. The new protocol mends some undesirable properties in the old one, enhances forward security, and improves the running efficiency. Possessing of both secure and efficient properties makes the proposed protocol suitable for the low power wireless communications.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Concentration, Efficiency and Performance: The Test of Efficiency-Structure Hypothesis in Chinese Feed-Processing Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on market power hypothesis and efficiency- structure hypothesis of industrial organization theory, the concentration, efficiency and performance of Chinese feed- processing industry were analyzed in this study, and the correlations among them were revealed. With the data of Chinese feed-processing industry, the validities of these theoretical hypotheses were tested. It shows that modified efficiency- structure hypothesis is applicable to the feed-processing industry. Comprehensive technical efficiency has positive influence on the performance and concentration of feed-processing industry. The increase of industrial scale promotes market share and at the same time improves the industrial performance, indicating the presence of certain economies of scale in feed-processing industry.

articleTitle: Design of Circular Signal Constellations in the Presence of Phase Noise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to save the limited bandwidth resource, high-order M-ary amplitude and phase shift keying (APSK) signal constellation as quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) is widely employed in modern bandwidth-limited communication and broadcasting systems. However, such dense constellation is very sensitive to the disturbance of noise, including not only white Gaussian noise but also phase noise which is caused by many nonideal factors in transmitter, receiver and channel. This paper proposed a design method of circular signal constellations which are extremely robust in the presence of phase noise. As for 64 points, the circular constellation we proposed performs at least 5 dB better than the square QAM at the error rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> under the phase noise of 0.1 rad. And compared with the existing patent constellation designed to mitigate phase noise's effect, the proposed circular constellation not only performs 1 dB better in phase noise of 0.1 rad, but also sacrifices no error performance under white Gaussian noise only. And since the circular constellation is with small amplitude fluctuation, it can be further used to mitigate the requirement of power amplifier's linear range in certain systems. Further, a reliable and easy-to-implement demodulation method is also presented.

articleTitle: Concurrent Operation of Half- and Full-Duplex Terminals in Future Multi-Hop FDD Based Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Future OFDM-based cellular radio networks like IMT-Advanced systems are planned with both frequency division duplex and time division duplex in mind. Each of these duplex schemes has its benefits and drawbacks dependent on the scenario. In short-range communication and with small radio cells TDD is appropriate. For wide area cells FDD is preferred in general. If combined with multihop, i.e. the use of fixed relays, wide area cells can be built with a reduced number of base stations. Economic rationale also leads to the requirements to produce cheaper terminal equipment. Full duplex FDD terminals can transmit and receive simultaneously, but need high quality, expensive RF duplex-filters, in order to separate uplink and downlink channels. Half-duplex FDD terminals are lower in cost and therefore an interesting solution. This paper shows how half- duplex terminals should be operated to achieve the same performance as full-duplex terminals. The coordination of half- and full-duplex terminal operation by the base station is a challenge. This paper introduces the resource scheduling algorithm located in the MAC layer and discusses implications and performance results especially for multihop cellular networks.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Dynamics Under the Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain dynamics is the key issues in supply chain management. To explain supply chain dynamics under the sustainable development, the paper will focus on its classic behavior: the inventory variance and bullwhip effect. A simple system dynamics model of an initial/closed loop supply chain system is investigated. Particularly, the effect of remanufacture, remanufacturing lead-time and the return rate on the inventory variance and bullwhip effect was studied. Our results clearly show that the bullwhip in closed loop supply chain is bigger than one in initial supply chain and have nothing to do with the collection rate, and the inventory variance in every stage decrease when the remanufacture are introduce into the initial supply chain.
