The first countermeasure is to breed high-diathesis consumers to hasten leisure consumption. The second is to cultivate spontaneous conception to advance leisure consumption. The third is to upgrade leisure industry roundly to improve the relationship between leisure supply and leisure demand.

articleTitle: Enterprise Integrated Knowledge Management System Conceptual Model: An Empirical Research
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the view that knowledge management system (KMS) in enterprise is an integrated social-technical system, this paper first defines the connotation of Integrated Knowledge Management System (IKMS), and then sets up a conceptual model of IKMS. Finally, the paper does universal test of the conceptual model using structure equation model (SEM) and analyses its possibility of practical use. The purpose of the paper is to provide a theoretical frame for enterprises requiring knowledge management (KM).

articleTitle: Strategy of Conflict Preprocessing and Reconciliation for Mobile Databases
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile computing is characterized by limited resources on mobile client, frequent disconnection and limited bandwidth of mobile communication, and the heterogeneity between different mobile database products. Aimed at the defects existed in current technologies of synchronizing replication for mobile databases, a new model of transaction synchronization and replication is proposed. The conflict processing strategy is emphatically analyzed and the implementation algorithm is presented in detail. The conflict preprocessing mechanism based on user-concerned data and transaction-related-set is adopted and executed before conflict detection and resolution in the model, which effectively saves the storage resources on mobile client and mobile communication bandwidth, reduces the workloads and error possibility of mobile server, decreases the complexity of the conflict detection and resolution algorithm. The conflict reconciliation strategy based on rule simplifies conflict processing and enhances the efficiency of synchronization and replication. In addition, the implementation method of the model using SyncML protocol has the generality and adaptability for different types of major heterogeneous database products.

articleTitle: An Efficient Greedy Algorithm on Optimizing the Architecture of Delay Limited Erasure Error Recovery
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we address the QoS issue of reliable real-time multimedia multicast services over packet-switched networks. Using a generalized architecture of delay limited erasure error recovery, we propose an efficient greedy algorithm for optimizing the parameters of the general architecture. Through the proposed greedy algorithm, the total needed redundant information can be minimized by choosing the best scheme automatically among those entire schemes integrated in the architecture. As a result, the greedy algorithm can be a good candidate technique for guaranteeing QoS requirements for real-time multimedia multicast services over packet-switched, especially over wireless networks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Psychological Contract Imbalance and Management of Enterprise Research and Development Personnel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Advances in Agent-Based Computational Finance: Aseet Pricing Models from Heterogeneous and Interactive Perspective
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This brief survey gives an introduction on agent-based computational finance (ABCF), focusing on features of heterogeneity and interaction among agents. In contrast to traditional deductive asset pricing theory with strictly defined representative investors, ABCF is characteristic of multi heterogeneous agents, making their own trading decisions in a virtual market respectively and interacting with each other evolutionally. Among a vast array of potential ABCF models, Santa Fe artificial stock model (SF-ASM) and heterogeneous agent model (HAM) are supposed to be the most prominent and prevalent. We give a simple conclusion and future directions for ABCF.

articleTitle: Customer Participation in the Service Industry: A Theoretical Discussion and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The inseparability of production and consumption means customer should participate in the delivery process when service is performed. Customer participation not only influences the productive efficiency and service quality, but also influences the participant's satisfaction to the company. This paper tries to integrate the opinions based on companies and customers, and discusses its intrinsic mechanism of customer participation and its application. In general, participant process, participant degree and psychological factors are the primary factors that customer participation impacts on customer's satisfaction. Nevertheless, increased customer participation does not necessarily result in higher perceived quality and satisfaction or greater repurchase. The design of participant detail plays a key role in the enhancement of customer's satisfaction. Furthermore, customers with different self-regulatory states are distinguishing in their general satisfied levels with participant courses. As a conclusion, we consider effective management on customer participation must be implemented to avoid its negative influence and exert its active function, such as positive service communication, reasonable design and training of customer participation and attractive customer participation.

articleTitle: Studies on the Performance Appraisal for the Software Engineers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Currently, the main issues of the performance appraisal for software engineers are: focus on the results but neglect the behaviors, ignore the synergy of individual performance and team performance, disjoint performance evaluation with corporate strategic goals, lack effective performance communication. Accordingly, combining with the characteristics of software engineers, we construct an appraisal system which is based on MBO and combine the individual performance and team performance. In this system, individual performance indicators are three dimensions, including result, capability and behavior; team performance indicators are four dimensions, including financial, customer, internal business processes, learning and growth. Then, we determine the indicators' weight and appraisal cycle. Meanwhile, the performance appraisal for software engineers also should strengthen the mutual communication and the effective application of the results.

articleTitle: A Component-Based Approach to Effort Estimation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Over the past ten couple of years, there is a variety of effort models proposed by academicians and practitioners at early stage of software development life cycle. Some authors addressed that efforts could be predicted using lines of codes (LOC) or COCOMO model, while others emphasized that it could be made using function point analysis (FPA) and others. The study seeks to develop a model which estimates software effort by studying and analyzing small and medium scale application software. To develop such a model, 50 completed software projects are collected from a software company. From the sample, components affecting effort estimation are identified and extracted. By applying them to simple regression analyses, a prediction of software effort estimates with accuracy of MMRE = 9% was constructed. The results give several benefits. First, estimation problems are minimized due to the simple procedure used in identifying those components. Second, the predicted software projects are only applicable to a specific environment rather than being based upon industry environment. We believe the accuracy of effort estimates can be improved. According to the results analyzed, the work shows that it is possible to build up simple and useful prediction model based on data extracted at early stage of software development life cycle. We hope this model can provide valuable ideas and suggestions to project designers for planning and controlling software projects in near future.

articleTitle: Application of Out-of-Sequence measurement Unscented Filtering in Decentralized Naval Ships Cooperative Engagement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Measurements can arrive in different decentralized tracker at out-of-sequence due to the sensor diversity, unsteady pre-processing times of observed data and communication delays in naval cooperative engagement. So far, most of existing solutions to this problem are based on retrodiction, linear model and central processing. To increase the performance of maneuvering target tracking and fusion with out-of-sequence measurements three efforts are made. First, a decentralized fusion architecture based on geodetic coordinate system for naval ships was presented. Second, by combining the square-root unscented Kalman filter methodology and decorrelation approach in the information filter framework, a nonlinear forward-prediction out-of-sequence filtering algorithm is developed. Third, a decentralized fusion algorithm for the naval ships is proposed. The proposed algorithm can unify tracking and fusion algorithms in short range, intermediate range and long-distance circumstances. The comparison of the simulation results shows that the presented algorithms enhance the estimation accuracy for the nonlinear out-of-sequence measurement.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis and the Theory of the Enterprise Relating the Variable Quality in Core: Based on the Dimension of Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Trust and pledge are the key influencing factor in the enterprise relating to the quality, but trust and pledge can not to be able to solve enterprise's conflict. How to solve the conflict is the key to maintain and promote relation's quality. This article through the discussion of the different way to processing conflict in the cooperation, proposed forgiving that is the new dimension of relational quality, and do the empirical study to learn each main dimension in relational quality. We draws the conclusion finally: Tolerant is a new dimension of the enterprise in the quality of relationship.

articleTitle: The Study about the Relationship of Fund Manager and Fund Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first reviews the evaluation theories and models on fund performance. There are mainly two research fields on fund performance: the evaluation and the attribution of fund performance. The attribution theories attribute the fund performance into risk-revenue compensation, fund manager's ability of stock-selection and timing-selection. The evaluation models of fund performance can be mainly divided into: the single-factor models based on CAPM (Jensen model, Treynor model, Sharpe model), the multi-factor models, and the attribution models of fund performance (T-M model, H-M model, C-L binomial model). Then this paper chooses the stock funds between 2005 and 2007 from Wind database as the samples to do an empirical study on the effect of fund managers on fund performance. The net value excess index growth is chosen as the dependent variable. Seven variables, which are The Study Major Background, Graduated College Background, Abroad Study Background, Finance Work Time, Position Fund Time, Run Fund Number and Experience Fund Company Number, are chosen as the independent variables. The result of the empirical study shows that the relationships between fund performance and Study Major Background, Graduated College Background and Abroad Study Background are not significant while the fund manager's Finance Work Time is positively correlated with the fund performance. The fund manager's Position Fund Time has an inverted U-shape correlation with the performance. The Run Fund Number and the Experience Fund Company Number are negatively correlated with the performance.

articleTitle: Knowledge Innovation: A Strategic Approach to Promoting Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge management plays a critical role in performance of enterprises in today's knowledge-based economies. Currently, knowledge management is often regarded as synonymous with knowledge sharing. This paper analyzes the value and mechanisms of knowledge sharing and innovation, and concludes that knowledge innovation is the fundamental goal as well as a desired result of knowledge management. Applying a constructivist methodology in strategic management, we construct a conceptual model, and thereby suggest a strategy for implementing knowledge innovation. We argue that the model and the strategy presented in this paper provide a strategic guideline for enterprises to promote knowledge management through managing knowledge innovation, and thereby assist them in flexibly adapting to the changeable environment and successfully achieving sustainable development.

articleTitle: Managing Patent Legal Value via Fuzzy Neural Network Incorporated with Factor Analysis Based on Patent Infringement Lawsuits
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study aimed at the basis of patent law and proposed a revolutionary valuation model for the legal value of patents. The damage awards of patent infringement lawsuits were deemed to be the legal value of patents. 65 Effective samples were extracted from 4,289 patent infringement lawsuits retrieved in U.S. district courts of Delaware, California and Texas, for constructing the valuation model via the Fuzzy Neural Network incorporated with the Factor Analysis. The proposed valuation model was validated to have the predictive power by error analysis and was accommodated to valuate the possible damage award and the settlement fee in disputing patent infringement lawsuits. It also contributed to manage intellectual property assets.

articleTitle: On Updating Service of Fundamental GIS Database
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data updating is a significant stage in the life of a geographical information system (GIS). When the fundamental GIS database has been updated by mapping organizations, the updates in it should be delivered in time to the end users for updating their own GIS database constructed based on the fundamental GIS database. However, at the present time, the updating service of fundamental GIS database is still problematic since there may be many kinds of heterogeneities between these two databases. In order to given a generic solution to this problem, two basic delivery modes for the updating information are firstly discussed and compared in this paper. Afterwards, the operations for implementing the integration of updates and their corresponding execution approaches are proposed based on the analysis of its basic requirements such as schema matching, updates extraction, entity identification, updating operators, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on Comparison of China-U.S. from Perspectives of Entrepreneurial Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses the external factors and resources, which play an important role in the development of entrepreneurship, small and medium-sized enterprises, summarizes the best practices of the U.S., and finally provide correlative advices and measures for the development of entrepreneurship in China. The paper mainly uses analytical and comparative methods. Analytical method indicates that existing problems of entrepreneurship in China nowadays are described and analyzed; comparative method indicates that the best practices of entrepreneurial environment in the U.S. are reviewed and summarized. Through analyzing entrepreneurial environment of China, it is understood that entrepreneurial environment became more difficult factors than internal factors; and it is also found out difference between China and U.S., in which best practice of U.S. should be used for reference. It is noticed that solution found in practicing by trial and error may be myopia, incomplete and time wasting, however, a long-term, complete solution could be found through comparison between China and U.S..

articleTitle: Why Talent Concentrates to Industrial Clusters?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study aim to explain why talent concentrates to IC(industrial clusters), and how HR-environment and talent growth do effects on regional attraction. Regional attraction is defined as the regional capability of attracting and retaining workers and immigrants. The sample of this study was collected from four industrial clusters in China. HR-environment consists of micro-HR-environment measured by HRM (the level of enterprise's human resource management), and macro-HR-environment measured by EE(economy environment), HRPE (HR policy environment), LSE (living setting environment), and CE (culture environment). Exploratory factor analysis and hierarchical regression were conducted to analyze data. Results of hierarchical regression indicated that micro-HR-environment and macro-HR-environment did interactive effects on talent growth. The results infer that high-quality talent-growth environment in IC is the ultimate cause that talent concentrates to IC. The paper can help to reveal why talent clusters to IC, and why talent grows better in IC than other regions. Moreover, it will offer theoretical support for government to make policies and programs to attract talent. The study illustrated how HR-environment does effects on talent growth. It also examined the immediate role of talent growth in the relationship between HR-environment and talent growth. These enhance the literature of HR-environment, regional attraction and talent agglomeration.

articleTitle: Revision Based on Traditional SCP Paradigm and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the amendment of the traditional SCP analysis paradigm with an attempt to eliminate the defects involved in the traditional SCP analytical framework in China , i.e., over stress on standard research and qualitative research but lack of empirical research as well as of quantitative analyses and statistical studies on market structure, enterprise behavior, and other industrial organization structure elements. At the same time, on the basis of research on the system reforms of China's large and medium-sized state-owned mining enterprises which are faced with crisis, an importance is attached to the study of "behaviors" of the enterprises with the focus placed mainly on the study of internal structure of the enterprises and in terms of the input-output pattern and the principle of historical analysis, the dynamic SCP analysis method has been put forward and applied in the comparison and analysis of the investment system of Yunnan Jinsha Mining Company Ltd. before and after the amendment of its investment system.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer Design Combining Adaptive Modulation and Coding with ARQ on Frequency Domain Subcarrier of OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The system model and the algorithm for a cross-layer design combining the adaptive modulation and coding with ARQ based on frequency domain subcarrier of OFDM is developed at first. And then the effect of high speed move to the performance of that is analyzed. In order to compensate the degraded performance of wireless link due to high-speed move, a novel finite-state Markov channel model is formed to represent the frequency domain subcarrier of OFDM modeled as random process with Nakagami-m fading distribution. A correction of the threshold of modulation and coding scheme and the channel quality information as well as the method for link prediction in Chase combining is investigated. On this foundation, an improved cross-layer design combining of adaptive modulation and coding with H-ARQ is proposed. The computer simulation results reveal that the improved design and modified algorithm has higher average throughput and lower FER than the original one when the terminal moves in high speed.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of Reliability Mechanisms in P2PSIP-Based Conference System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a suite of reliability mechanisms for P2PSIP-based conference services. These mechanisms can be divided into two categories. One is backup mechanism, which is designed to elect backup conference provider in a distributed and dynamic manner among all the participants of conference. The other category contains handover and failover mechanisms, which are designed to maintain continuous service for other nodes after the master conference provider leaves. Besides, the performance of proposed mechanisms is evaluated in a mixture network environment containing both wireless and wired links. The results have proved that the proposed reliability mechanisms are feasible in network environment where P2PSIP-based conference system is deployed.

articleTitle: The Formation and Risk of Government Investment Dependence under Financial Restriction in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, in China's financial market, there exists very strong financial restriction in both indirect financing and direct financing. Financing channels for private sectors are so narrow that the efficiency of capital allocation is low. Financial restriction leads to the situation that China's economic growth mainly relies on government investment. Moreover, with the enlargement of market size, the dependence degree of economic growth on government investment deepens. This phenomenon will cause an important aftermath: local governments have strong motivations to implement government investment in order to achieve various economic goals, which propels the accumulation of financial risk and supply surplus risk that finally causes a new-round economic stagnation. This would be the logic implied in several obvious economic cycles in China.

articleTitle: Efficient Importance Sampling for Utility-Based Shortfall Risk
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The objective of this paper is to study the effect of efficient importance sampling (EIS) techniques on simulating the distribution-invariant convex risk measures: utility-based shortfall risk measures (USR). We firstly introduce EIS to simulate USR based on nonlinear Generalized Least Squares and demonstrate how to choose a candidate density in the context of multi-normal distributions. After presenting the construction of our algorithm, we apply our efficient scheme for calculating Entropic risk measure under the setting of the mixed Poisson model of CreditRisk<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>. We furthermore make an improvement for EIS so that we can calculate USR with piecewise polynomial function loss functions. Finally, the method is applied to an example to demonstrate its performance and flexibility.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing Models of DM Service: Theory and Application of Two-Sided Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: DM ("device management") service is a new value- added service whose value chain has the typical characteristics of two-sided markets. Based on a review of the literature on two- sided market theory, the paper discusses pricing models for DM service with two agents on one side, which has not been addressed by previous research. The key to successful implementation of the DM service platform is the development of an optimal pricing strategy, while the key to pricing is to grasp the appropriate price structure between both sides. Considering the enhancement of network externalities and profit- maximization for the DM service platform, three basic pricing models (registration fee model, transaction fee model and two- part tariff model), as well as pricing models at different developmental stages, are discussed. The unit price for every participant is also discussed. This paper shows that using any of the three basic pricing models alone is insufficient. To address this limitation, multiple pricing models should be integrated by considering network size, cross-network externalities, number of transactions and platform matching technology, which are the main factors influencing price levels. The study finds that the unit price is influenced by network scale-utility elasticity and the ratio of network sizes.

articleTitle: Project Management Mechanism: Mediates the Influence of Business Strategy on Corporate Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the strategy-implementation theory based on project management, strategy could be implemented by project management mechanism. However, no empirical analysis has ever examined how project management mechanism acts as a mediator between business strategy and corporate performance. This study introduces three project management mechanisms such as project management office, program management, and gate review to be the tools to implement strategy, and then tests the significant of project management mechanisms as mediators between business strategy and enterprises performance. The results show that the mediate effects of three project management mechanisms between the low-cost strategy and corporate performance are significant, so is the mediate effect of project management office between the differentiation strategy and corporate performance. It is verified that the project management mechanisms, in varying degrees, can be ways to implement the strategy.

articleTitle: Effective Automated Negotiation in Electronic Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Electronic marketplaces represent new places where supply and demand aggregate and negotiations take place. New opportunities and rapidly changing environment of electronic marketplaces lead to the need of more sophisticated negotiations to support various trades. Automated negotiation is one of the most popular and promising technologies to perform such task and will be a vital part of electronic commerce in the future. In this paper we first analyze the requirements of automated negotiation in electronic marketplaces and then compare three negotiation mechanisms. After that based on these mechanisms we propose a new design perspective that negotiation processes of agents are driven by their negotiation goals. Effective automated negotiation requires agents have the capabilities to generate and achieve their negotiation goals. Agents can perform a goal-driven negotiation process. Our method can be adapted to the open and dynamic environment of electronic marketplaces.

articleTitle: Research on Fit Factors of Adoptive Management Innovation: A Cross-Case Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is necessary for modern enterprises to learn advanced management thoughts and methods in order to survive and develop. Address the problem of low success rate of adoptive management innovation, based on the innovation measurement framework of Oslo Manual and influencing factors model of management innovation of Koberg etc., a model of successful implementation of adoptive management innovation is put forward to analysis the critical fit factors between enterprises and adoptive management innovation, taking TPS for example, using cross-case study to conduct empirical analysis, and using Atlas/ti software to analyze qualitative data.

articleTitle: Mediating Effect of Information between Entrepreneurial Networks and Performance: Evidence from Chinese New Ventures
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Previous studies very rarely investigated the link between information and entrepreneurial performance. This study develops a model integrating entrepreneurial networks, information and performance to provide an entrepreneurial cognition perspective on Chinese new ventures. We examine the mediating effect of information between entrepreneurial networks and performance. Our empirical findings suggest that information plays a full mediating role between inter-firm networks and investment efficiency, while a partial mediating role between supporting networks and investment efficiency which then influences growth respectively.

articleTitle: Distribution Mechanism of SC Information Sharing Revenue Based on the Third Party Participation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The competence of supply chain depends on the cooperation of enterprises on the supply chain. And one of the main influence factors of partnership is revenue distribution. So far the problem of revenue distribution has been analyzed extensively by number of researchers. However, there are few scholars who have ever specially discussed on distribution mechanism of information sharing revenue based on the third party participation. Based on the theories of external-discipline better than self-discipline the authors try to prove how this mechanism can promote the distribution to be transparency and fair and enhance the partners' willingness to cooperate with others. To realize the distribution mechanism, a fuzzy AHP evaluation method is put forward. And an application shows that this method can effectively handle both qualitative and quantitative data in the multi-attribute decision making problems.

articleTitle: Incentive Efficiency Losses from Inequity Aversion in Optimal Contract
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A series of economic experiments have proven that many people are inequity averse and prefer a more fair allocation. Then, how will the inequity aversion influence the incentive efficiency in the optimal contract? On one hand, the inequity averse agent will surely suffer disutility when facing unfair allocation. Hence, the inequity aversion adds an incentive constraint and must reduce incentive efficiency. On the other hand, the inequity averse agent can be rewarded for good performance not only by paying more but also by paying more equitably. Thus, the inequity aversion delivers an incentive instrument and can enhance incentive efficiency. We show in this paper that the former is the dominating one. For the agent with inequity aversion, besides the risk compensation from asymmetric information as revealed in the standard contract theory, the principal has to pay the inequity rent, resulted from any possible unfair allocation, and the risk compensation from inequity aversion, resulted from the distortion of balance between insurance and incentives, both of which are the incentive efficiency losses from the inequity aversion. Consequently, to screen and evaluate the inequity aversion of employees is very important for employers to design suitable incentive systems.

articleTitle: Contractor's Environmental Impact Assessment: Adgoshu-Humera-Lugdi Road Upgrading Project, Ethiopia
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Here discussed in detail are the methodology of identifying and evaluating in advance any effect, mainly negative, which results from the implementation of a proposed road upgrading project in Ethiopia, any change to the environment or to its component that may affect human health or safety, flora, fauna, soil, air, water, climate, etc. With a review of the Ethiopian environmental policies and legislative framework, the penman presents the impending different types of environmental impacts of the road upgrading project.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Analysis of Macro Financial Risks in Brazil by Using Contingent Claim Balance Sheet
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Survey of Wireless Streaming Media Technologies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Streaming media services have been developing prosperously across cable network in recent years. Though wireless network becomes more and more popular in our lives, most of the technologies using in cable network are not suitable for wireless because of the differences between the physical layers of the two. In this survey, we summarized the wireless streaming media technologies studied in recent years, and pointed several hotspots and difficulties for our future work in this field.

articleTitle: Six-Sigma Project Selection Using National Quality Award Criteria and Fuzzy Multiple Criteria Decision-Making Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Six-Sigma is a tool of significant value in achieving operational excellence. The project selection decision is the early stage of implementation for a Six-Sigma intervention. The present study proposes national quality award criteria as the Six-Sigma project selection criteria, and proposes a hierarchical criteria evaluation process. The strategic criteria are evaluated by the management team using a fuzzy multiple criteria decision-making method. The sub-criteria which contain additional operational issues are evaluated by the Six-Sigma Champion. The proposed methodology is successfully applied in solving the project selection problem deriving from a component manufacturer. The results show that the higher a project's priority is, the greater the financial gains will be on completion of the project. Accordingly, the proposed methodology can prioritize the financial gain - which is the key performance indicator for a Six-Sigma project.

articleTitle: Sponsor or Donation: The Effect Factors of Corporate Reputation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Corporate reputation is an important intangible asset of a company in the fierce competitive market. Many companies improve their good image and build reputation through a series of charitable activities and other kinds of pro-social behavior. However, some researchers question whether philanthropic activities always lead to better business because the public often perceive it as a self-interested behavior, which can backfire the corporate image. Based on an attribution theory, this study tries to examine the different effect of two types of company charitable donation (conditional/ unconditional) on reputation. The results suggest that people perceive the motivation of corporate pro-social behavior differently, and the difference of the motive attribution lead to different effect of the two types of philanthropic activities, in which the effect of charitable donation on reputation stronger than that of sponsor on reputation.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Analysis on Negative Timing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With rapid development of communication technology, the signal integrity is impacting the system performance much more than before. So either in the IC design or in the system design, it is very important to investigate negative timing analysis and its mathematical modeling in the high speed integrated circuit. In the paper, we introduce the origin of the negative timing script in the deep sub-micrometer process. Through analyzing the difference between the negative script simulation model and the ordinary timing simulation model, negative script mathematical modeling in deep sub-micrometer process is discussed. The method proposed in this paper is very useful for the high speed IC design and the system design.

articleTitle: Capacity and Performance of Enterprise Knowledge Management: An Empirical Study in the High Tech Industry of China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The article demonstrates and puts forward the model of the relation between process, innovation, infrastructure capacities and performance of the high tech enterprise through the knowledge management process at the aspect of theoretical analysis and empirical study in China. To partition the capacity into process capacity, innovation capacity and infrastructure capacity can help us to understand the foundation that constitutes the enterprise knowledge management and consequently strengthen the construction of the knowledge management ability systemically. It points out the strategy, culture, promoting and structure can also affect the performance of the enterprise besides those direct factors including the acceptance, application, transferring and protecting of the knowledge.

articleTitle: A Decision Method of Concession Period for Build-Operate-Transfer Projects of Sewage Treatment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Concession period is a key parameter in build-operate-transfer (BOT) contract. Previous studies have provided effective methodologies and theory for the development of decision methods of concession period. Nevertheless, it appears that risk and uncertainty has been little considered in studying the way to determine the concession period of BOT projects. This paper proposes a decision method of concession period for BOT projects of sewage treatment by using NPV and Monte Carlo simulation, and discusses a list of deterministic and uncertain parameters in BOT projects of sewage treatment. A case study is given that indicates how the simulation technique is applied to determine the concession period.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of Knowledge Sharing and Commitment in Marketing Cannel: The Role of Satisfaction and Trust
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge sharing, the key point in knowledge management, becomes an important research issue gradually because of its great influence on the competitive power of enterprises. So, based on the review of the relevant researches in the field of knowledge sharing and marketing channels, this research analyzed the relationship between knowledge sharing and commitment, developed a theoretical model, and gave an empirical test. A sample of 369 distributor firms within the telecommunications carrier was used to test the model we presented. The result indicates that knowledge sharing has a positive effect on distributors' satisfaction and trust. At the same time, distributors' satisfaction and trust play important roles in building and sustaining commitment. As a result, satisfaction and trust play intermediate roles in the relationship between knowledge sharing and commitment.

articleTitle: Strategies to Improve the Utilization Ratio of CQI Channels in IEEE 802.16 Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16 systems adopt a "semi-dynamic" allocation mechanism of channel quality indicator (CQI) channels. However, low utilization ratio of CQI channels reduces the spectrum efficiency. So we propose three adjusting strategies based on a "toy brick model" to improve the utilization ratio of CQI channels. The simulation results manifest the improvement. In addition, we analyze the tradeoff between the increase of utilization ratio and the increase of signaling overhead.

articleTitle: A New Synchronization Protocol on the Convergence of 3G Cellular Network and MANET
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Convergence is the main developing trend of heterogeneous networks in the future. The convergence of 3G cellular network and MANET can provide data communication service with or without an existing infrastructure only with 3G terminals. Synchronization is a critical part for any distributed system. We propose a new synchronization protocol called GTP(GPS-aided Time-syn Protocol) on the convergence of TD-SCDMA cellular network in which air interface standard is proposed by CHINA and MANET. This synchronization protocol aided by GPS is based on SS broadcasting. This protocol solves the synchronization conflict difficulties between TD-SCDMA and MANET. At last we evaluate the performance of the protocol.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: The Study on the Effect of Introducing Stock Index Futures on the Component Stocks of the Underlying Index
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, the Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 Index Futures (300IF) will be introduced soon. This article studies the effect of the introduction anticipation of the 300IF on the component stocks of the underlying index using the event research model and the factor analysis model. The conclusions are: (1) the introduction anticipation of the 300IF brings abnormal returns for its component stocks and the stock weight is greater, the abnormal return rate is higher; (2) the factors influencing the premium of the component stocks mainly include the weight of the component stocks and the return rate of the market index. These conclusions may provide some guidance for the investors and will bring beneficial reference for the government to introducing other financial derivative products in the future.

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluating Model in Evaluating of Financial Risks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The financial risk is the representation of enterprise operating risk in the finance activity, is the feasibility which the result of finance activity deviate to the prospective result. It is an important thing is to know how much financial risks the enterprise can bear, without turn financial risks into financial crisis. So, how to recognize and evaluate financial risks become the most significant problem when operate a company. The paper build up financial risks index system, it is feasible to evaluate financial risks by using the fuzzy synthetic evaluating model. This method make up for tradition method pay more attention to quantitative index, and the accuracy is better than the tradition method. Moreover, this method can adjust the index system and the weight to adapt different industry, and also have the expansion.

articleTitle: A Group-Blind MMSE Multi-User Detector Based on Subspace Tracking for MC-CDMA Uplink
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the multicarrier code division multiple access (MC-CDMA) uplink, the base station receiver has the knowledge of the spreading sequences of all the users within the cell, but not that of the users from other cells. In this paper, we present a novel semi-blind adaptive MMSE multi-user detector based on subspace tracking for MC-CDMA systems in such scenarios. We develop an modified MMSE detector which can combat the performance deterioration induced by eigenvalues estimation errors. Moreover, the proposed method exploits the orthogonal projection approximation subspace tracking (OPAST) algorithm for adaptive subspace estimation. This proposed detector makes use of the spreading sequences of all known users to suppress the intracell interference, while suppresses the intercell interference using the modified MMSE detector. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed semi-blind multi-user detector offers substantial performance gains over the blind multi-user detection and the traditional semi-blind method in a MC-CDMA uplink environment.

articleTitle: Research on Human Resource Management Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a new form of outsourcing, human resource management (HRM) outsourcing has an important significance to reducing the cost and improving the core competence of an enterprise, and has been a new strategy used by modern enterprise in market competition. This paper summarizes the current situation of HRM outsourcing and expounds the advantages of it basing on the reviewing of international and domestic literature. It also puts forward the 3W decision mode and fuzzy analytic hierarchy process assessment method for HRM outsourcing in the paper. Finally, it comments the significance of designing the HRM outsourcing information system and the functions that the system will achieve. By designing the data flow chart and system function modules of this information system, it provides a beneficial reference for the enterprises to carry out the HRM outsourcing.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of the Vendition Management System Based On Internet
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Vendition Management System (VMS) is designed basing on WEB and J2EE. The Java programming language, XML, Internet/Intranet and the Unified Modeling Language (UML) are used in the development of the system. The object oriented software project developing model (OOA/OOD/OOP) and the professional project managing method (RUP/XP) are also involved in the project.

articleTitle: Pipelined Multi-Hop Automatic Repeat Request Mechanism in IEEE 802.16j
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16j is the standard that enjoys the most attention at present. By deploying Relay Stations (RS) in appropriate locations to enhance the throughput of the IEEE 802.16 users, and by expanding the coverage range of the wireless communications, it utilizes relaying technology to reach a uniform transfer data rate. When we use the multi-hop to transmit data on Relay Path, as the number of hop increases, any data transmission error will cause longer delay times as well as congestions. IEEE 802.16j proposed three relay network transmission methods to resolve the data transmission problems. However, these three methods have their drawbacks such as longer transmission delay times and waste of transmission bandwidth. Therefore this paper proposes a Pipelined mechanism to improve the performance of the three original transmission methods. We will use simulation to verify that the proposed method can indeed improve the shortcomings of the original methods.

articleTitle: Spatial Variability Analysis of Reclaimed Wetland Soil Nutrients in Sanjiang Plain, China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the measured sample data, geostatistics and geographic information system were utilized to analyze the spatial variability of six soil nutrients variables of reclaimed wetland in Sanjiang Plain. All soil nutrients studied had spatial autocorrelation in some extent, and kriging could successfully interpolate these variables. Thus, the combined method could accurately evaluate the spatial variability of soil nutrients in study area.

articleTitle: Data Mining Approach and Application in CRM Project for Internet-Focused Banking
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Financial institutions, esp. retail banking, have given evidence for the existence of a priority pattern of CRM system in our study. It is concluded that how to manage the relationship of customers and corporations is the core in commercial banks. The paper is to explore CRM of banks to find out if general patterns are applicable. As such, the study shows the comparison of CRM performance with different adoption of Internet-bank technology and methodology. The discussion aims at providing data mining approach and process based for bank CRM analysis. Data mining application model given in Internet-bank or ATM system can be the general goal of the CRM project from a business point and a technical point of view and further add benefit to banks' CRM.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Traceback in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: False data injection (FDI) is great threat to wireless sensor networks. Public key cryptography (PKC) is desirable to locate source nodes that are launching false data injection attacks. Because PKC is expensive to sensor nodes, they could only afford a small number of these operations. In this paper, a hierarchical traceback mechanism is proposed. A sensor field is divided into some levels, and in every step of traceback process the source node is located in a smaller level. The performance of the mechanism is thoroughly evaluated, and only O(logn) packets would be verified in order to locate a source node.

articleTitle: Knowledge Visualization of Most Prolific Countries and Hot-Topics of Enterprise Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using methods of knowledge visualization and data mining, we drew the maps of most prolific countries, top journals and hot topics of enterprise risk management to identify the current research fronts of current researches in the field of enterprise risk management. These maps illustrate the status of relationships among countries, journals, and the core research field representatives. These representatives have made great contributions in their own research fields deserving the attention of other researchers of enterprise risk management.

articleTitle: JMobile: A Lightweight Transparent Migration Mechanism for Mobile Agents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight mechanism for transparent migration of mobile agents. It introduces the continuation mechanism of the functional programming language into mobile agents, and implements the capture and reestablishment of agent's execution state by bytecode transformation mechanism. We have implemented a prototype, called JMobile, which is composed of three modules: continuation module, bytecode transformation module, and agent migration module based on Java socket. We have also measured growth in bytecode size and execution efficiency, and obtained relatively better results compared to other implementations.

articleTitle: Logistics Process Reengineering Mechanism and Measures Based on Activity Cost Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Logistics service process reengineering becomes increasingly important to all logistics firms seeking competitive advantages. But the reengineering must rely on accurate logistics cost information. However, the traditional costing approach based on volume drivers doesn't provide the information. Activity based management (ABM) can achieve great accuracy of logistics cost by using multiple drivers and is an advanced process reengineering method. According to the characteristics of business logistics activities, the mechanism of applying ABM to logistics process reengineering is analyzed amply for logistics enterprises, the logistics process reengineering procedures is designed for logistics enterprises. Moreover, the means and relevant ensuring measures of logistics process reengineering based on ABM are analyzed elaborately.

articleTitle: Case Study on the Funds-Payment of Power Construction Commissioned Management Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper took a 2times600 MW supercritical generating electricity project as an example. It analyzed the contract construction system and the funds-payment problems, compared with the other construction project. Meanwhile, this paper analyzed the advantage and disadvantage of the difference fund payment method and gave a proposal of engineering fund management. It will help owner to manage the generating electricity project under agent model that was gradually extended to the power construction project.

articleTitle: A New Segmentation Algorithm of Finger Crease Based on Wavelet and Radon Projection
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a new automatic segmentation algorithm based on wavelet multi-resolution and Radon projection. By giving the definition of ROI of finger crease, this algorithm use feature vector and regional growth to produce candidate sub-region set in high frequency sub-images, and then utilize Radon projection in low frequency sub-images to verify the candidate sub-region set. Finally, by adopting straight-line fitting technique, the location of ROI of finger crease is accurately located. Emulation experiment shows that this algorithm can not only resist noise and hand-shape affection but also robust in different situations.

articleTitle: Innovation Network and Policy Services Environment of SMEs: An Empirical Study in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation has been one of the key drivers of sustainable competitive advantage for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). On the basis of a sample of 188 Chinese SMEs, this paper attempts to: (i) explore the relative importance of the innovation network and main policy services in innovation for SMEs by using the technique of Relative Important Index (RII), and (ii) seek to highlight any differences between foreign-invested enterprises (FIEs) and wholly Chinese-owned enterprises (WCOEs). The study finds that the cooperation with "customers" is the most important innovation network for SMEs, and the "preferential tax policies" is the most favorable policy. Interestingly, the study indicates that differences are found between FIEs and WCOEs (the former emphasizing "financial policies", and the latter emphasizing "innovation network with technological agencies and service providers", etc.). Overall, these findings reveal that many Chinese SMEs have difficulties in achieving successful innovation. So, policies should be made based on constraints to innovation for SMEs.

articleTitle: A Bayesian Network Model for Optimizing Advertisements Allocation in Intermediate Online Targeted Advertising
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Intermediate online targeted advertising (IOTA) is a new business model for online targeted advertising. Posting the right banner advertisement to the right web user at the right time is what advertisements allocation does in IOTA business model. This research uses probability theory to build a theoretical model based on Bayesian network to optimize advertisements allocation. The Bayesian network model allows us to calculate the probability that Web user will click the banner based on historical data. And these can help us to make optimal decision in advertisements allocation. Data availability is also be discussed in this paper. An experiment base on practical data is run to verify the feasibility of the Bayesian network model.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Financing Order of the Listed firms on Small and Medium Enterprise Board in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The author regards 2006 fiscal year data of 113 listed firms on small and medium enterprise board as research sample, and analyze financing status of these companies. Drawing the following research conclusion: The listed firms on small and medium enterprise board have a low asset-liability ratio, but their financing order accords with pecking order theory, that is to say, firstly selecting interior fund, secondly bank loan, finally stock financing, and preferring short-term loan of bank loan. The author does some explanations aiming at the research results.

articleTitle: Intellectual Capital in the Process of Organizational Culture to Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores the interaction of organizational culture, intellectual capital and fire performance. Based on survey data from 167 companies in China, our result shows that both organizational culture hasn't positive firm performance, and intellectual capital has positive effects on firm performance, which demonstrates that intellectual capital significantly mediated the effect of organizational culture on firm performance.

articleTitle: Keep Additive or Not: Do Moderating Effects Exist in Price-Mueller Turnover Model?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Price-Mueller turnover model posits that values moderate the relationship between structural variables and two outcome variables, i.e. job satisfaction and organizational commitment. Using a sample collected from Chinese companies, the study reported in this paper explored the moderating effects. The results suggest that the relationship between structural variables and the two outcomes should not keep additive. Implications for theory and practice are discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Routing Protocol of Mobile Ad Hoc Networks at the Rate of 4G
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The performance of AODV protocol of MANET at the rate of 4G is studied. A network frame is introduced, the network model is set up, and simulations are run in NS2. After analysis the results show that AODV is suitable for the network of low moving speed at the rate of 4G, but not suitable for the network with too high speed. The work has some value in the integration of MANETs and 4G mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: Research on Web-Based Marketing Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The tendency of modern enterprise marketing is to use network. The modern enterprise must meet the contemporary marketing's need to establish marketing decision support system (MDSS) that base on network behavior, namely WMDSS. It uses the browser/server structure to design WMDSS logical organization. WMDSS is constituted by client side, Web server and database server, and increased the function of person-person interaction and the coordination decision function. The system database is used three skeletons that composed of the client-side, the Web server and the application server. The model warehouse has used Konsynski's three-base-structure.

articleTitle: An Efficient Arithmetic for Deblocking Filter of H.264/AVC Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, presented the cause of blocking artifacts and the importance of deblocking artifacts, while explained deblocking artifacts principle. Based on H.264 /AVC standard, the judgement of boundary strength (BS) is specially studied, and proposed an efficient arithmetic for deblocking filter. This efficient arithmetic can improve decoder speed and quality, and shorten about 10% of total time.

articleTitle: Optimization of Agricultural Investment Projects Based on VE and Multistage Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the growing concern about agriculture, country and farmer issue in China, the number of investment projects in agriculture is greatly increasing. As a weak industry, it will have a direct influence on agricultural development whether investment decisions of agricultural projects are accurate, so that it will affect the level of overall economic benefits in a region. Therefore, the problem that the general decision methods are difficult to solve is how to select the best agricultural investment project. In this paper, value engineering (VE) is applied, on which basis new index systems of evaluation are worked out, and then AHP-multistage fuzzy comprehensive appraisal method is adopted to analyze them for their factors are uncertain, objective and fuzzy, in order to improve the scientific decision level of agricultural projects and offer the decision basis for the decisionmaker and corresponding department.

articleTitle: The Application of an Improved Hybrid Interference Cancellation Method in the Radio Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Against eliminating the multiple access interference (MAI) and sky-wave interference under multi-path channel in the radio navigation system, an improved hybrid interference cancellation (HIC) method that combines the advantages of both the successive interference canceller (SIC) and the parallel interference canceller (PIC) is proposed in this paper. It has the advantages of low complexity and easy hardware realization. The model structure is presented and the expression of bit error rate (BER) is derived analytically, the simulation results show that the method is obviously better than the traditional receivers in the presence of the estimation error (includes the timing and phase estimation errors), especially when the estimation errors are small, the probability of BER in the second stage of the improved HIC is two orders of magnitude higher than traditional receiver. The experiment verification results show that the improved HIC can improve the signal-to-noise (SNR) of the weak signal effectively and have a good performance to eliminate the MAI and the sky-wave interference, thus the improved HIC technique we proposed has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Participatory Evaluation System and Empirical Performance for Distributor Selection
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Choosing the right distributor has evolved into a way for enterprises to gain a competition advantage and avoid risk. We take the distributors as enterprise's customers according to the Obtaining outside Resources Strategy, so assessment of the Distributor potential value is the theoretical basis of choosing the right distributor, and it is the decision reference to integrate many distributors for enterprise too. So we constructed the participatory evaluation system for distributor Selection from the two angles of consumer's demand and enterprise's demand in this paper. Extract two major factors of resource and harmonious value by creating the customer experience efficiency curve, inverse demand function and the relation curve between cost and quality from enterprise's demand angle, establish the demand progressive model for the product or service by the qualitative analysis from consumer's demand angle, extract four major factors of product, service, situation and brand. The evaluation system is constructed by these factors.

articleTitle: Research on Local Energy Multi-Path Topology Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, energy efficiency is crucial to achieve satisfactory network lifetime. Compared with other nodes, the bottleneck nodes in WSN have much more impact on network lifetime. In this paper, firstly a heuristic relative neighborhood graph-quasi bottleneck (HRNG-QB) model is presented. In HRNG-QB, the concept of quasi- bottleneck nodes and how to determine them in UDG is introduced, then a heuristic mechanism is proposed to save single node consumption. Based on this topology, a local energy multi- path (LEMP) topology control algorithm is given, which uses local energy multi-path to coordinate nodes and leverage energy consumption of different nodes. Simulation result under NS2 show that LEMP can extend WSN lifetime effectively.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Energy Efficient MAC Protocol for Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Several transmit power control MAC protocols have been designed primarily to reduce the energy consumption in wireless ad hoc networks. On the other hand, many adaptive rate MAC protocols have been mainly proposed to improve the network throughput. In this paper, we proposed a new energy efficient MAC protocol for the distributed coordination function (DCF) IEEE 802.11 b based ad hoc networks which also maximize the overall network throughput. This protocol is known as traffic sensing adaptive rate power (TSRP) control MAC protocol. The basic idea of the TSRP protocol is that, rather than just matching the channel condition, the sender sense outgoing traffic based on the traffic load and the queue condition. Then the MAC layer chooses the energy efficient rate-power combination that is suitable to deliver all the packets comes from upper layer or schedule the transmission of the packets waiting in its queue with minimum delay. Our analytical and simulation results show that, TSRP protocol can provide more energy saving and at the same time can achieve maximum throughput.

articleTitle: The Revenue-Sharing Contract Coordination of Supply Chain with Multi-Retailer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the revenue-sharing contract coordination of supply chain. Under the price sensitivity of market demand, the model of revenue-sharing contract with multi-retailer is established. We present an approach which constraints the parameters of revenue-sharing contract. The optimal profits of the supply chain are obtained with this approach. A numerical example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Research of Optimized Hierarchical Mobile Routing Protocol in Next Generation IP Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: HMIPv6 remedied the deficiency of mobile IPv6 protocol, reduced the delay and the amount of signaling during handover compared with the basic MIPv6. But duplicate address detection and the transmission time for the handover operation in HMIPv6 could cause high handover delay. So HMIPv6 still cannot reach the requirement for traffic that is delay sensitive, such as voice. Through the analysis of HMIPv6, a kind of optimized managing models of mobile IPv6 routing on the basis of hierarchical mechanisms was proposed. By NS-2 simulation, we present and analyze the performance testing for our proposal by comparing it with the basic MlPv6. The results of simulation show that the routing optimization can give better handover performance than the traditional MlPv6.

articleTitle: Customer Satisfaction Data Analysis Based on BP ANN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the most important benefits of ANN (artificial neural networks) is the free of the restrictions of the classic statistical techniques. Some literatures points to several limitations in multiple regressions that are overcome by ANN. This paper demonstrates the usefulness of ANN in customer satisfaction analysis and compares ANN and regression, based on data from a China company customer satisfaction survey. Based on the results of this study, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the application of ANN in customer satisfaction analysis is useful in identifying existing patterns in the data, and synergies between the drivers of satisfaction. The advantages of using ANN are highlighted and the managerial implications of ANN to identify the key drivers and set priorities for improvements are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Research of Pre-Controlling Dangerous Points in Power Supply Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we researched the pre-controlling of dangerous points in power supply enterprise. A method of operation risk management in electric company was put forward. Using the idea of dangerous points management, we developed a management information system which can foretell us the dangerous points and control it. All process of system analysis and design was introduced in this paper. Finally, we delineated that the system was applied in Linyi electric company and evaluated the result.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Impact of Relationship Capital, Coupling Mechanism and Innovative Capacity of Regional Innovation Network Nodes on Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper sets out to investigate the performance of innovation network from the perspectives of relationship capital, coupling mechanism and innovative capacity of regional innovation network nodes. With High-tech Development Zone and University Technology Park as the objects of investigation, the paper finally comes to the conclusion that the accumulation of previous cooperation experience and macro and microcosmic relationship capital of regional innovation network nodes is conducive to the formation of a sound coupling mechanism among nodes and the enhancement of relationship, interaction and coordination among nodes will further upgrade the innovation performance of regional innovation network.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of IPSec over WLAN and Improving of Key Exchange
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Contrast with the current WLAN (wireless local area network) security mechanism worked in data link layer. IPSec over WLAN worked in IP layer has his superiorities. But as a security mode originally used in wired network, IPSec uses IKE (Internet key exchange protocol) as default that need a large number of computation is not fit for mobile devices of WLAN. Besides, IPSec protocol does not fit mobile IP perfectly. Aiming at the limitation that IPSec applies in WLAN, the paper renames the architecture of IPSec over WLAN, and processes IKEv2 over WLAN adopting EAP (expansion authentication protocol) to reduce the computation cost of data link layer. At last it puts forward key exchange protocol on the cross-security domain of mobile IP.

articleTitle: Study on Time Lag of Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Time lag impacts quit a lot on KM, i.e. knowledge management. Organizational KM network and artificial neural network share similar character. So on micro-object point of view this article gave a target function on knowledge management with the research method of Hopfield Network, which is a better way to appraise KM performance. And based on this , the article brought up the effect time lag has on performance of knowledge management and analyzed how to improve knowledge management through reducing time lag.

articleTitle: Research of Mining the Meta-Association Rules Based on the Model of GM (1.1)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The association rule mining aims at the relationships between the items of the transaction data. Because the transaction data often has characteristics of time stamps, the support value and the confidence value of a certain rule are not quite the same in different periods of time. It is of great help to do further study and make a strategic decision to set up a Meta-association rule for the association rule, analyze and predict the change tendency of its support value and confidence value. By means of an example, this paper analyzes the usual mining process of the Meta-association Rules by the model of GM(1,1). It also evaluates the advantages and disadvantages of the model of GM(1.1) during the mining process.

articleTitle: Research on Node Relationship Management in Strategic Networks Based on Niche Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: From the systemic point of view, strategic network is a complex system. Based on niche theory in ecology, this paper proposes the concept of niche of enterprise node in strategic network, and tries to research into the measuring model for the breadth and overlap of node niche in strategic network This research shows that strategic network node not only has to choose appropriate niche, but also make right adjustment and optimization of the niche according to their goals and environmental change. At last , it promotes the evolution of strategic networks.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Analysis of Two-Hop-Relay Variable-Rate Cellular Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new architecture of two-hop-relay variable-rate cellular system was introduced, and the analytical model of this system was built. Then based on this model, we get the average downlink throughput and the call blocking probability of the system respectively. Finally, through numerical calculation, we analyze the impact of the various parameters on the performance of the two-hop-relay variable-rate cellular systems. Study results show that the two-hop-relay variable-rate cellular system can obtain more average downlink throughput than traditional cellular system, and reduce the call blocking probability effectively.

articleTitle: Study on the Capability of City Gas Network to Resists the Engineering Geological Hazard Damage
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Engineering geological hazard is one of the main factors that caused damage to the city gas network. The damage degree caused by engineering geological hazard which often happen in a short period is often much higher than that due to its long-term effects of corrosion, internal and external stress. In this paper, we have done a research on the capability of city gas network resists the engineering geological hazard damage. We did it from four aspects: the stability identification, safety design reliability evaluation, vulnerability assessment and fatalness evaluation. Through the Identification of engineering geological hazard danger sources, the quantitative treatment of relevant indicators and the establishment of evaluation models, we proposed a more comprehensive and quantitative assessment method to evaluate the capability of city gas network resists the engineering geological hazard damage.

articleTitle: Application of Catastrophe Series Method in Performance Evaluation for Government-Invested Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the widespread problems of government-invested projects currently, this paper put forward the necessity of objective and overall performance evaluation. Given the example of cusp catastrophe, it analyzes the mechanism of multi-objective evaluation by applying catastrophe theory, establishes multi-hierarchy indicator system of engineering projects by adopting catastrophe series method. The paper also introduced this method to the example of inland waterway projects. The outputs are well in line with the facts. The indicator system is established based on the inner logical relations between catastrophe model internal mechanism and performance objectives. It avoids the subjective influence of weights design. The calculation is quite convenient and well applied in government-invested projects.

articleTitle: Value Chain Analysis of Government Information Disclosure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper the value-chain theory is used to analysis the government information disclosure. This paper first analysis the structure of the value of government information disclosure; then constructs model of value chain of government information disclosure; at last explains the principles and approaches of the value activities of this model.

articleTitle: Robust Endpoint Detection Algorithm of Chinese
