publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the problem of endpoint detection in presence of multi noises, this paper presents a robust algorithm of Chinese. Without any priori information of noise statistics, this approach employs the autocorrelation of low frequency coefficients in wavelet transform to detect the endpoint of voiced signal, and combines with the power spectral density of noisy speech to determine the commence moment of unvoiced signal. Simulation results indicate that this method has the perfect accuracy under very complex background noise.

articleTitle: The Research of Rotated Quasi-Orthogonal Space-Time Block Codes for OFDM Communications Based on IEEE 802.16d
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a rotated quasi-orthogonal space-time block codes (RQOSTBC) scheme for OFDM communication based on IEEE 802.16 protocol. At the transmitter, the data streams for the OFDM tones enter separate QOSTBC coders whose outputs are then forwarded to the different antennas. At the receiver, the pairwise decoding can be employed. The SUI channel model which is recommended by the IEEE 802.16 working group is used in the simulations to compare performance of the STBC and QOSTBC. Simulations are conducted to show the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Establishing Power Selling Right Trading under Time-of-Use (TOU) Price System in Primary Power Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In primary electric power markets without real time prices, there exists prominent contradiction that hinders the GREDCO driving forward the time-of-use power price system that is very important to the optimum allocation of resources and the sustainable development of economy. To solve this problem, the power selling right trading is firstly put forward in this paper. Interrelated questions such as the trading necessity, rationality, feasibility, participants, together with the trading mechanism and procedure are discussed. It can be seen that this trading is necessary to both the market participants and the whole society, because it offers an approach to investment callback and risk management for the organizer of DSM, and stimulates the GRIDCO to drive forward more DSM policies.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis on CSFs of Enterprise New Product Development Projects: Based on NPD Process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is important for enterprise to invest more in new product development (NPD) projects and to develop their own innovative capabilities. The continuous development and market introduction of new products can be an important determinant of sustained enterprise performance. For approximately 30 years, conceptual and empirical research has been undertaken to identify the critical success factors (CSFs) of NPD project. Based on the correlative literature analysis, this paper sums up 19 Critical Success Factors (CSFs) of New Product Development (NPD) projects through the NPD process. By the questionnaire surveyed gathering data from the 97 domestic enterprises, used the SPSS software to carry on Factors analysis, the five parent factors had been found. At last this paper built a Conceptual model of NPD projects CSFs based on NPD process.

articleTitle: Union Contracts Based on Dynamic Supply Chain Network Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain alliance is a new form of organization that can benefit from the ability to effectively raise nodes. Joining enterprises and raising the competitive edge of domestic enterprises is an effective means to counter the foreign giants. The analysis of domestic enterprises is on the basis of the necessity of alliance-building in light of the factors affecting stability Union, that the contract for domestic enterprises is through the establishment of dynamic link, and making full use of information technology and network technology synergies.

articleTitle: Research on AAES Spatial-Temporal Data Model Based on Business Process of Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the business process of resource management, this paper analyses spatial-temporal characteristics, and establishes the AAES spatial-temporal data model. This model is composed of 6 tuples, which include the agent set, the agent-state set, the branching spatial data model based on point sets, the branching spatial data model based on points, the branching temporal data model and the relations among these data sets.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Personalized Information Services for Mining Right Trade
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Personalized information services have been born under the background of "information explosion" and will be the main mode of information services in the future. This paper describes the conceptual and formal models of ontology-based personalized information services for mining right trade. And it realizes precisely matching between supply and demand of information services for mining right trade by formalizing providers' services and requestors' demands in mining right trade and calculating the similarity between them. Ontology-based personalized information services for mining right trade can satisfy personalized request of mining right trade requestors.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Capability of Telecom Operators
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In business management, capability is gradually regarded as one of the most difficult and important tasks. With the development of the service sectors, capability management of these businesses is given more and more attention. This paper begins with the position and function of analysis and evaluation of capability in the enterprises' strategic planning, and then applies the thought of capability management to the strategic management processing of Telecom operators. Firstly, the definition of capability is given and the classification of the resources is built up. Secondly, capability structure model is formulated, then the paper establishes the capability system of Telecom operators referring to the theory of value-chain. The method of analysis and evaluation is also summed up finally.

articleTitle: Research on an OFDM System Using Super-Imposed PN Sequences in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An OFDM structure based on super-imposed pseudo-random sequences for time domain synchronization is proposed. A time synchronization method is proposed, which is exactly located in the first channel delay by periodically super-imposed sequences. The amplitude value of each channel path estimated with minimum mean square error (MMSE) can be easily deduced with help of periodical sequences. For depth fading channels, the proposed estimation brings the performance improvement. Simulation results show that the proposed time synchronization and channel estimation algorithm achieve good performances when the super-imposed relative power approximates to 0.1.

articleTitle: Measuring Customer Satisfaction Based on Gap Model and Structured Equation Model in Agro Tourism Industry in Shandong, China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rural tourism enterprises have been developed in rural areas as an alternative to agriculture. This study Utilizes service quality Gap model and SEM (Structure Equation Model) to reveal the gaps and path of satisfaction between expected and experienced service dimensions the path. An exploratory empirical study of 158 guests is investigated. It shows that the research can understand tourists' satisfaction in agro tourism industry and the factors that influence their choices in the surveyed areas: Shandong Province, China.

articleTitle: The Stability of Cartel: Model Improvement and Reinterpretation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper refers to transaction cost, studying the stability of cartel and comparing it to the traditional balance scale of cartel through the perspective of a regular static model. Thus, we make 2 conclusions: Firstly, after introducing transaction cost, it's hard to meet the requirements of cartel's inner stability. Secondly, transaction cost reduces the profit of cartel and decreases marginal enterprises' stimulations to join in cartel, so it greatly strengthens the external stability of cartel. The basic conclusion is that because of transaction cost, the instability of cartel results from the inner side, not the threat of marginal enterprises.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Packet Scheduling and Antenna Selection Scheme for Multi-Service MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a cross-layer packet scheduling scheme for multi-service MIMO system which adopts a unified method to select the set of users to transmit to and the antennas over which users send their packets. Our proposed scheduling scheme makes a difference between RT(real time) and non-RT (non-real time) services. It defines the utility functions of RT services according to a modified delay PF algorithm (MDPF), which could guarantee the QoS of RT services while combining the predominance of PF algorithm. And PF mapping is used for calculate the utility functions of non-RT services considering the tradeoff between throughput and fairness. Through a low-complexity antenna selection algorithm, set of users and antennas are determined at the same time according to the utility functions of every user. Simulation results reveal the proposed scheme provides better QoS guarantee to RT services while not badly deteriorating the throughput of system and fairness among users compared to the conventional PF scheduling.

articleTitle: Multi-Signature with Some of Proxy Signers Based on Two Hard Problems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After studying multi-signature with some of proxy signers and a group of digital signature schemes based on two hard mathematical problems, a new multi-signature scheme with some of proxy signers based on both elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem and integer factoring problem is presented and its security is analyzed. The analysis results show that the scheme satisfies all necessary security properties of the proxy signature scheme. Furthermore, its capability of anti-attacking is improved evidently comparing with existing multi-signature with some of proxy signers based on one mathematical hard problem.

articleTitle: A New Method for Regulating the Consistency of Fuzzy Preference Relations Matrix in Computer-Mediated Decision Making Group
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new method for consistency adjustment of fuzzy preference relations matrix in computer-mediated Decision Making Groups was advanced. This method is based on the definition of satisfaction consistency which comes out of two axioms (connexity and transitivity) advanced by Arrow. A new target matrix R was presented, as a result of iteration, the mediation matrix was provided with the satisfaction consistency. Attribute to the present of the target matrix R, the iteration steps were reduced and more preference information was saved in the calculated mediation matrix, thus, more intentions of decision-makers were saved in Group Decision. The course of the proposed method and its predominance were illustrated by an experiment example.

articleTitle: Period Analysis of Multiplier in Agent-Based Models
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present an agent-based model to verify the multiplier theory in macroeconomics and make an extension in the research of realization time of multiplier. We employ a simple model in which agents exchange money with each other and the multiplier effect is an emerging phenomenon of individual transactions. The model assumes that agents' expenditures would depend on their wealth and income. From equality of aggregate income with expenditure at macroscopic level, we can get the expression of multiplier. Then we analyzed theoretically and numerically the dynamic properties of the multiplier process, and obtained the expression of realization time.

articleTitle: Knowledge Production Modes and Its Fuzzy AHP Decision-Making Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Four knowledge production modes in China were divided in view of production management and their operation modes were pointed out; then, a fuzzy AHP decision-making approach was applied considering the complexity and uncertainty of knowledge production. In this approach, the evaluation index system and hierarchy model were established based on the analysis of influencing factors on knowledge production evaluation, the triangular fuzzy numbers were introduced to substitute the scale value of conventional AHP for determining the weights of evaluation criteria, experts' opinions from many fields and the risk index of knowledge production modes conversion were considered, the Euclid Neartude between the fuzzy evaluation value and the fuzzy ideal value was used to measure the knowledge production.

articleTitle: Coordination of Pricing Decisions in Multiple-Product Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses the pricing decisions of the decentralized assemble-to-order system. We consider an assemble-to-order system consisting of two substitute products and three components manufactured by different suppliers. Demand for the products is price-sensitive. The final selling prices for the products are jointly determined by firms in the system. We study the system under both centralized and decentralized decision making situations. For the centralized system, we demonstrate that there exists a unique optimal pricing solution. For the decentralized system, we show that there exists a unique Nash equilibrium in the players' pricing game. We show that the decentralized system can be effectively coordinated and the system performance can be improved with a simple profit-sharing contract. Finally, numerical examples are provided.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Differentiated Duopoly with Adaptive Strategies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we study a duopoly game in which two firms decide their product qualities in the first stage and set prices in the second stage. The two firms are bounded rational so that they adjust the price gradually according to the marginal profit. We examine a discrete dynamic system and analyze stability of the equilibrium. The parameter space for existence of the stable equilibrium is specified. Some numerical evidences are also presented. We conclude that the equilibrium will lose its stability when firms adjust the price unduly. Maximal quality gap will benefit both of them, but the one with high quality may not get advantage when marginal cost is large enough.

articleTitle: A Local Bus Network with Autonomous Test Ability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced a flexible bus concept and established a local test network based on this bus. The test network can be divided into three layers: single device layer, subsystem layer and system layer. The self-diagnosis and self-repair mechanism for the local net was established afterwards. Lastly a nonstop layer-analyzing test strategy was discussed deeply to improve test efficiency. The experiment of a simplified network model for a huge bridge monitoring system showed the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining in Judicial Judgment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is necessary to establish the database on case guiding system and effectively be applied, aiming at saving judicial resources, promoting judicial justice, and improving judicial efficiency. On the base of the background of putting forward the system, we analyze the meaning of the case guiding system and the necessity of setting up the database, and then combine the basic goal of the case guiding system, finally prove the functional demand of the information database on guiding cases. The article manages the overall design on setting up and its scientific management of the database, including the outline of the system, the composition of every subsystem, each function module, and the basic technical requirement of the information database and systematic operation characteristics.

articleTitle: Model and Algorithm for Inventory/Routing Decision in a Two-Echelon Distribution System of Chain Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses an integrated inventory and routing problem of two-echelon distribution system for a chain enterprise which consists of a central distribution center and a group of retail stores. Given daily demand forecasts for each store, distance, cost parameters, and various inventory and transportation constraints, the enterprise seeks to determine a short-term inventory of each member and the routing decisions among members of the enterprise, with the objective of minimizing the overall average inventory and transportation cost of the enterprise. Considering the change of total system cost resulting from the distribution plan establishment, a mathematical programming model of is proposed for the considered integrated inventory and routing problem, and a efficient two-phase heuristic algorithm solving this problem is also developed. The effect of the established model and the efficiency of its heuristic algorithm are illustrated by two set of computational experiments.

articleTitle: Throughput-Effective Scheduling with Fairness Guarantee in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless mesh networks have promised to provide high-speed access for residential or mobile customers. And concurrent transmission is an effective way to enhance system throughput in wireless mesh networks. The objective of this paper is to provide an effective concurrent transmission method to enlarge throughput with specific QoS fairness guarantee in wireless mesh networks. Firstly, link relationship is obtained by the topology transformation based on the network models adopted in this paper. Secondly, a greedy concurrent transmission algorithm which constructs the scenarios of links without interference is proposed and threshold values are designed to guarantee particular fairness index for each links in the network. At last, the simulation results demonstrate that with the requirement of specific fairness index, the system throughput can be enhanced efficiently by using the algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Virtual Home Library: Let Every Chinese Family Having Their Own Libraries at Home
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Virtual Home Library (VHL) is an integrated IT system that utilizes virtual reality technology and an IPTV set-top box (STB) to virtually construct a 'library' and the relevant reading environment on televisions in people's home. Unlike the online e-book reading applications, Virtual Home Library system can be applied on televisions - the world's most convenient and most efficient communication tool. Providing extended digital library services, it will be a perfect group reading utility for family readers. The system has been investigated by a joint research team of the National Library of China and the Communication University of China, collaborating with a Chinese IPTV equipment manufacturer. This paper presents some preliminary investigations of the VHL system performed by the research team.

articleTitle: Model-Driven Method of Information Extraction for E-Government
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Appling visualization modeling technique, builds organization model, resource model and process model, defines the relationship among them, and presents the whole business. According to the connection rules in or among models, the paper also advances the methods to check integrity of models and simulate the business process for insuring the correctness, and to resolve the problem of normalization and accuracy, especially the problem of description for inter-section business. Finally, it matches the modeling system to information system to complete business and resource information extraction for information integration and sharing.

articleTitle: A Kind of Energy Aware Routing Algorithm Based on HyperCube for ZigBee Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new a kind of energy routing algorithm based on hypercube for wireless sensor network. Each ZigBee node is assigned to one or more binary addresses. And addresses of adjacent nodes have the characteristics of hypercube. In such case, the hypercube routing algorithm for generalized hypercube is brought into the routing of wireless sensor network. The design idea of the proposed algorithm has been presented in this paper. And we have also used NS-2 for our simulation and proved the correctness benefits of the algorithm through analyzing the simulation results.

articleTitle: Forecast Modeling and Practical Analysis of Equipment Developing Scale
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The similar growth mechanism of equipment scale and single species scale was analyzed. Then, take the equipment expenditure scale as monetary measurement of equipment scale, the basic growth model of equipment expenditure scale was established on the base of Multhus model of single species growth. Next, take the equipment expenditure scale growth ratio as linear minus function, the basic model was modified. To make the model suit to forecast the equipment expenditure scale, genetic algorithm was used to seek the best parameters in model. In the end, the growth law of equipment expenditure scale in typical countries is analyzed practically. And the equipment expenditure scale in our country was forecasted. Both the results of analysis and forecasting indicate the validity and feasibility of the researching methods.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Dynamic Patterns for NTRU
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The NTRU algorithm is a public key system based on ring, its appearance opened up a new field of application and research for the public key system. In this paper, we present a new method to enhance the executive speed of NTRU algorithm. First, we analyze the polynomial coefficients to find out the distribution characteristics of patterns,such as "11", "101" and so on, which are possible to occur repetitively. Then, using greedy algorithm we determine the patterns that can be used most frequently when calculating the convolution of polynomial, and eliminating the interferential effects that polynomial coefficients would have on patterns, thereby ultimately maximize the number of patterns found in the polynomial. By using the convolution of related patterns repetitively, we speed up the key generation, as well as the encryption and decryption operation of NTRU.

articleTitle: LEO Satellite Scheduler Model and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose inline DRR (deficit round robin) scheduling algorithm due to the limitation of the satellite switch processing speed and memory capacity. We build the model in OPNET. The results show that inline DRR processing delay is 26ms lower than DRR. The inline DRR complexity is O(1). According to the traffic and network structure of low earth orbit satellite system, we adopt CICQ as satellite on board switch structure and apply inline DRR in switch. At the same time, we build the model of the satellite on board switch in OPNET. The simulated results demonstrate that inline DRR algorithm switch delay is lower than 6ms and the algorithm is applicable for satellite switch.

articleTitle: Demand of Logistics Employee to 3PL Firms in P.R.China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The industry is development very quickly in P.R.China, it need logistics services provided by third party logistics (3PL) firms to reduce the costs. Nowdays,the technology and management push logistics knowledge development, so the logistics employee knowledge needs to be renovated to a higher lever. This paper analysed the industry firm services demand to 3PL firms based on the surveyed datum, it indicated that setting up multilayer logistics high education system and building qualification certification system are a good way to improve the logistics employee quality.

articleTitle: Query Quality of Service Management Based on Data Relationship over Real-Time Data Stream Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many real-time applications and data services in distributed environments need to operate on continuous unbounded data streams with the development of large wired and wireless sensor network. Conventional one-time queries cannot be suitable to provide continues results as data and update stream into the system, and continuous queries represent a new paradigm for interacting with dynamically changing data. At the same time, many real-time applications have inherent timing constraints in their tasks, so providing data objects deadline guarantees for continuous queries over dynamic data streams is a challenging problem. A novel performance metric and quality of service management scheme continuous queries over dynamic data streams are proposed to guarantee system performance based on relationship of all updated data items. Experimental simulations demonstrate that the presented algorithm can guarantee the performance and decrease miss ratios of queries for dynamic workload fluctuations especially transient overloads.

articleTitle: Newsvendor Model with Re-Distributed Profits
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we study the newsvendor model with profit re-distribution. It is different from classical model that sale process is distinguished normal sale and promotion stages. Vendor can select to sales promotion for increasing their return when real demand is lacking. We get two mathematical expressions of traditional optimization order quantity q* and new optimization market size N*. At the some degree, we also discuss the effect of (q*,N*) as some parameter changes.

articleTitle: A UWB Pulse Shapes Modulation Scheme Based on Modified Hermite Polynomials
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Considering ultra wide band (UWB) system which transmits data information using ultra-short pulses, a pulse shape modulation UWB system based on orthogonal UWB pulse is proposed, which is on the basis of the orthogonality and non- direct component of modified Hermite polynomial function. The simulation result shows that the method can not only improve the performance, but also decrease the bit error rate.

articleTitle: Misused Pairwise Keys Detection Mechanism in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, the pairwise keys shared by non-compromised nodes could be compromised, then the adversary would misuse the pairwise keys to forge message report in order to destroy secure communication or deplete the limited resource in sensor nodes. To address this issue, in this paper, an efficient mechanism is proposed to detect misused pairwise keys. Specially, an efficient verifiable authenticator is attached to each message report, the forwarding node can detect whether the pairwise key is misused by verifying the authenticator. The security analysis and quantitative performance analysis demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed mechanism. Moreover, the proposed mechanism can be integrated with most of key pre-distribution schemes or false data filtering schemes to provide more reliable secure communication.

articleTitle: Loran-C Skywave Delay Estimation using Improved ESPRIT Techniques
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel ESPRIT technique for estimating the delays of Loran-C skywave components is presented. This provides the basis for a new generation of receivers which may adjust its sampling points adoptively to the optimal values in a constantly-changing skywave environment. The signal model is setup using spectral-division technique for isolating groundwave and skywave components of Loran-C signal. The performance of this technique is evaluated and compared with FFT, Eigenvector algorithm. The simulation results show that the ESPRIT algorithm yields good estimation accuracy and that it can also operate successfully with noisy signals.

articleTitle: A Study on Forecasting Coal Demand Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Coal is a key of basic energy in China, and it supports the rapid development of the national economy. In the coming period, coal will also play the very important role in base energy. Therefore, the prediction of coal demand is particularly important in future. In this paper, the double hidden layers BP neural network is established and simulated based on Matlab technology. After testing actual data, the coal demand for next five years is forecasted with the methods. And also some conclusion are made in the paper.

articleTitle: Research on Segmentation Implementation Process of Air Cargo Customer Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Customer relationship management (CRM) , is a sort of solution intends to promote its market competition through customer management, which is the highlights for the current enterprise management. This article carries out research binding data mining technology with customer segmentation theory in aviation freight. With the segmentation in freight customer and connection with mining theory , the article focuses on establishing data warehouse model based on the subject on cargo transaction and subject on customer service. Moreover , it puts forward customer segmentation course of aviation cargo based on data mining, then detailed describes the hierarchical design idea and functions of different levels, which will have some reference value for the airlines to start CRM.

articleTitle: An Incentive-Based Reputation Mechanism for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In mobile ad hoc networks, nodes communicate with others usually using intermediate nodes as relays; and they are expected to cooperate to make the networks reliably. In this thesis, we propose an incentive-based reputation mechanism to motivate the selfish nodes to cooperate in packet forwarding, and apply a simple reputation scheme to encourage the trustworthy behaviors; this mechanism is fully self-organized and the reward of each node is determined from a game theoretical viewpoint. We also take the cooperating probability of each node in the network into account, and prove that cooperating is the optimal strategy for each node in our system. The results of performance evaluation show that the selfish nodes can forward other's message and cooperate with each other in the general situations.

articleTitle: The Improved Multi-Objective Programming Module and Optimization Algorithm of the Three-Dimensional Layout Optimization Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the three-dimensional layout optimization problem for packing cylindrical objects into the cylindrical space. A multi-objective optimization model with performance constraints is presented. Here we introduce an improved multi-objective programming algorithm for the layout optimization model. Computational results are presented which suggest that this algorithm performs well. Moreover,we introduce a measure function to determine whether two graph elements are overlaping, touching or nonoverlapping in any way.

articleTitle: Study on Inventory Model Based on Reverse Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the latest part in the research field of the logistics, the reverse logistics always has the good reputation of environmental protection logistics. In the process of production, most of Chinese companies not only waste lost of goods and materials, but pollute the environment as well. Therefore, the dualistic significance of my studies on reverse logistics are lowering costs and improving the enterprise image. Based on the inventory law of the reverse logistics, and the specific situation of domestic enterprise, this paper takes an example by the real data of a coal mine and has have the further research on the inventory control of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Technology Innovation in China: An Empirical Study Based on New Framework
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study combines culture theory and knowledge-based perspectives to develop a general model of promoting technology innovation. We analyze the model using a structural equation model approach, and 208 firms in China are selected as the samples of this study. The results conclude that: (1) The higher the level of trust, the higher the level of innovation culture; (2) Trust is a function of its knowledge energy; (3) Trust has no significantly impact on technology innovation; (4) innovation culture is a function of its knowledge energy; (5) innovation culture will significantly impact on technology innovation; (6) knowledge energy will significantly impact on technology innovation. Since very limited empirical studies have concentrated on above issues in China, the results of this study can offer important direction to theories and practices in the developing of technology innovation.

articleTitle: Capacity of High-Rank Line-of-Sight MIMO Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A method is presented to investigate high-rank line of sight (LOS) multiple input multiple output (MIMO) channels by using matrix perturbation theory in microwave relay system. The upper and lower bounds channel capacity based on space time block codes (STBCs) technique and singular values decomposition (SVD) are also derived. Moreover, the condition number of MIMO channel matrix is studied to deduce a useful constraint for high-rank LOS MIMO channels. Our theoretical analysis channel capacity line up exactly with the simulation results, which are able to give a physical explanation of the high rank LOS channel characteristics.

articleTitle: Economic Capital Measurement of Chinese Banks: A Global Perspective
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mutual-effect and heterogeneity implied in risk create barriers to quantitative management of aggregated risk. Based on modern portfolio theory, this article employs the methodology of risk correlation, and then constructs consistent model on aggregated risk management of Chinese commercial banks. With presented model, this research investigates detailed implementation procedure and model algorithm by using data from representative Chinese regional bank. The empirical results indicate that, due to nonlinear correlation and non-normal distribution, Copula function is considered as the optimal risk aggregation approach.

articleTitle: The WiMax-Based Mobile Communication Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: WiMax (World Interoperability for Microwave Access) technology is the hotspot of wireless access technologies and attracts much attention. WiMax technology provides a wireless access method for users and do not constrained by physical position and cable restriction. A communication platform was designed under the protocol WiMax. The platform contains client (Vehicles) and server (Base stations). The platform contains 5 function modules including stimulating moving, position information transfer, sound communication, file transfer and routing selection. Building a mature communication platform is the most important precondition to improve the transfer efficiency in intelligent transport system. Intelligent transport system with the characteristic of low cost, less budget and high speed of transferring information is urgently needed by every city.

articleTitle: A Novel Channel Estimation Algorithom in Frequency Domain for FMT Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a novel channel estimation for filtered multitone (FMT) systems which is called FPEA. It implements an estimation in frequency domain with pilot sequences in subchannels. The analysis then is given for estimation and anti-frequency-offset performance. Finally, simulation results of the performance achieved by FPEA are presented and compared with other algorithms.

articleTitle: Accelerated Simulation for Coherent Risk Measure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Importance sampling is always used to modify the probabilities for rare event occurrences that govern the outcomes of the simulation in a way that allows for low probability events to occur more frequently. In this paper, importance sampling is applied to accelerate the simulation for coherent risk measure based on generalized rare scenarios. Firstly, we show how to combine importance sampling with ranking and selection method provided by Lesnevski, Nalson and Staum to accelerate simulation coherent risk measure directly. Secondly, recursive Robbins-Monro type algorithm is introduced to estimate the parameters of optimal sampling distributions. Finally, computational efficiency of simulated confidence intervals for coherent risk measure is discussed under three simulation settings: Asian call option, Asian options on partial average, down-and-in barrier call option.

articleTitle: A Study of the Relationship Between Human Resource Management System and Organizational Performance: A Role of Organizational Learning
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper constructs an organizational-learning-based research model integrating human resource management system (HRMS) and organizational performance (OP) from the perspective of organizational learning (OL). Based on a theory development, we propose hypothesis between HRMS, organizational learning, and organizational performance. We obtain 221 effective samples in a snowball sampling manner and testify the sample data with SEM, part of the hypothesis being supported.

articleTitle: Research on Development of Producer Services in Lucheng District from Demand Perspective: For Examples of IT, Finance and Human Resources
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the emergence of service-oriented tendency, producer services, which make up of the most active sector in developed countries and regions, are undergoing rapid development. Producer services industry is also an important part of industrial layout of Lucheng district in Wenzhou city. Based on the questionnaires and interviews, the paper analyzes the Lucheng manufacturing enterprises' demand for IT service, finance service and human resources service, which run through the whole manufacturing value chain. The paper also seeks to propose suggestions in terms of expanding demand, looking for breakthrough point of developing producer services and creating industrial integration environments for the second and the third industries.

articleTitle: Study on Capacity Expansion Problems on Maximum Flow
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article studies capacity expansion problems on maximum flow. The capacity expansion problems can be described as: how can the network capacity be increased as much as possible with a minimum total cost? In view of three types of expanding models: the node-expanding model, the arc- expanding model, the combination of the arc-expanding and node-expanding model; we discuss the characteristics of the problems separately. Considering the upper bound of the expansion capacity caused by every node or arc, we also present a unified capacity expansion formulation. Finally, an example is provided in detail.

articleTitle: A New Data Model on Urban Pipeline GIS: Directed-Node Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the authors proposed a new data model named directed-node and gave its related definitions, types, classification, and how to create directions. Directed-node model simplified geographical network modeling from dualistic structure with edges and junctions to unitary structure just with nodes. It emphasized nodes were the core elements and not employed lines which were represented now by connections between directed-nodes. Only directed-nodes data need to be gathered and the connections between nodes can be generated automatically by pre-assigned arithmetic. Two tables were created to store respectively attribute and connections and three tables stored result paths. So it made directed-node model homogenous with database. Thereby, all maintenance and analysis on pipeline data became operation on database tables, which made full use of standard SQL. The customized trade rules also had been introduced to enable topological integrity, validity and rationality of connection between directed-nodes, which reduced errors, increase efficiency, made data processing and analysis more simple, intelligent and friendly. We argued that directed-node model should uplift pipeline GIS to a new height.

articleTitle: Analysis of the AMC-ARQ System over MIMO Correlated Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we focus on investigating the effect that fading correlation has on the average spectral efficiency (ASE) and outage probability of the cross-layer system, combining of adaptive coding and modulation (AMC) and truncated automatic repeat request (T-ARQ) in the presence of STBC transmit diversity on fading channels. We derive the expressions for the average spectral efficiency and outage probability of this STBC cross-layer scheme over correlated fading channels. Furthermore, we show the numerical simulation results to illustrate that different correlation coefficients induce the different loss of the average spectral efficiency and probability of outage compared with the independent fading.

articleTitle: Management Decision on the Container Terminal Logistics Based on Witness Simulation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The port transport facilities are always the bottleneck in a Container terminal logistics system. A simulation model of the system based on Witness is developed. The opportunity of purchasing new crane and updating IC toll-gate is studied, when the throughput and stochastic distributing rule is fixed. The improve scheme and evaluating indicator is put forward. Four simulation situations are designed to analyze the effect of the improvement program. The principle of container terminal logistics management decision-making is then provided.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Error of the Deficit Distribution in a Markov Chain Interest Risk Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the error of the asymptotic estimation of the deficit distribution for insurer by a monotone integral operator in a Markov chain interest discrete time risk model. Further, we obtain some bounds of the asymptotic error of the asymptotic estimation formula. These bounds can improve the performance of previous models.

articleTitle: Trust in Leader and Multilevel Performance: Empirical Study Based on Knowledge Work Teams
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The present study examined the effects of trust in leader on individual task performance, organizational citizenship behavior and team performance in knowledge work teams. The survey was conducted in 68 knowledge work teams of high-tech organizations from ten cities in China. The results of hierarchical regression showed that trust in leader had a positive effect on individual-level performance, including team member's task performance and organizational citizenship behavior. cognition- based trust had stronger effect on team member's task performance, while affect-based trust showed stronger effect on organizational citizenship behavior. In team level, organizational citizenship behavior partially mediated the relationship between trust in team leader and team performance.

articleTitle: Research of Standard Competition Capacity Evaluation Based on Grey Clustering Assessment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Standard competition has been a hot topic in both theory and practice fields. The standard competition capacity and its evaluation, which are the basis and the prerequisite for decision-making of standard competition strategies and tactics, directly concern an enterprise's core competence. In the related studies, standard competition mechanism, technical innovation and innovation capacity evaluation have received more attention, whereas there are still lack of studies on standard competition capacity and its evaluation. This paper firstly tries to build up a theoretical framework for the standard competition capacity evaluation and the related evaluation indices. Secondly, an evaluation model is constructed by grey clustering assessment. Finally, the model is applied to evaluate several enterprises' standard competition capacity. The model can be used to evaluate the capacity under condition of inadequate data and hided information. The method has acquired favorable effect in practice.

articleTitle: A Decision Model for Supplier Selection under Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SCM (supply chain management) emphasizes on the strategic cooperative relationship between core enterprise and enterprise alliance. The selection of supplier is an important decision-making problem in SCM and is the key to successful SCM. In this paper a decision model for supplier selection under SCM based on AHP (analytical hierarchy process) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is put forward. The model is illustrated by solving a simplified supplier selection problem in SCM. The result shows that the model in this paper is scientific and feasible for supplier evaluation and selection in SCM.

articleTitle: Cointegration Relationship between Electricity Intensity and Power Price in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the main factors impacting electricity intensity (namely power consumption per unit GDP) in China first, which include power price, gross domestic product and the proportion of industry in whole economy. Then the relationships between power price and electricity intensity was studied based on Granger-causality and cointegration tests. The result indicates that there exists Granger causality relationship running from power price to electricity intensity, so does the Granger causality relationship between the proportion of industry in whole economy and electricity intensity which running from the former to the latter . At the same time, it shows us a co-integration relationship between them, since the electricity intensity reduces 3.695% while the power price gets a 1% growth, and electricity intensity increases 18.922% while the proportion of industry in whole economy gets a 1% growth, which indicates that the proportion of industry in whole economy has a greater effect on electricity intensity. In order to reduce the level of electricity intensity, save energy, optimize energy efficiency and promote sustainable economic development, China should raise power price properly, what's more important is to adjust the industrial structure, reducing the proportion of high-power-consuming industries.

articleTitle: Vertical Positioning Technologies and its Application of Pseudolites Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: GPS has been broadly applied in every fields of our social life, since the environment around us has been becoming more and more complicated, satellite navigation positioning technology under severe geometry, weather and jamming conditions gains more and more attention. However, It is well known that the GPS satellite navigation system lacks vertical information, which results in poor vertical accuracy. On the other hand a pseudolite navigation system provides very good vertical information thus improving the vertical accuracy which is crucial for airplane precision landing. In satellite navigation and positioning applications, pseudolite undertakes two tasks. First, pseudolite can improve range measurement accuracy by elimination the common pseudorange error between the pseudolite site and user. Second, pseudolite can reduce vertical dilution of precision (VDOP) by an additional pseudorange measurement. This paper mainly discuss the principle of pseudolite reducing VDOP and improving vertical measurement accuracy significantly. Also, the estimation of VDOP maximum values is given. With the help of simulation, the simulation results indicate that the augmentation of pseudolite can improve dramatically positioning accuracy, satisfying requirement of civil aviation APV.

articleTitle: The Influence of Management Support on Enterprise's Information System (IS) Successful Implementation: Based on Method of Field Interview
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Management support is one of critical factors influencing information systems' implementation success. Examining the relationship with management support and IS successful implementation, the paper illustrates that management support fosters enterprise's managers to institute and develop high-quality implementation polices and practices. These policies and practices engender a positive climate for IS implementation, which leads in turn to implementation success. A research method of field interview is employed to show that management support has the pivotal impact on information systems' implementation success.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Mental Mechanism of Chinese Individual Investor
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Steepest Descent Based Optimization for Distributed Regression in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a steepest descent based algorithm for the distributed optimization towards to data regression modeling in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In doing this, the junction tree based routing structure is employed to organize the nodes in coordination to accomplish the in-network implementation of the distributed iterative scheme. Experimental results are reported to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Organizational Intelligence and its Impact on Organizational Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: First of all, the definition and characteristics of organizational intelligence are analyzed. Then the model of organizational intelligence which includes intelligence members and intelligence processes is built and the model of organizational innovation is presented. Finally, the impact of organizational intelligence on organizational innovation is discussed mainly from the aspects of management innovation, institutional innovation, technical innovation and knowledge innovation.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Enterprise Investment in On-the-Job Training: Based on a Field Investigation in Wuhan, China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the status quo of investment in on-the-job training based on the field data from large and medium- sized enterprises in Wuhan City, China. Major findings include: (1) there is a lack of high-tech employees with a great demand for on-the-job training, (2) insufficient attention is paid to on-the-job training by enterprises and, (3) the methodology of training is inappropriate and simple. Relevant policy recommendations are proposed accordingly for the Chinese government and enterprises based on these findings.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperation with 3PLs in Reverse Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Reverse logistics is the logistics process of removing new or used products from their initial point in a supply chain, such as returns from consumers. In the first section, the paper gives a brief account of the reverse logistics, and several points of view about reverse logistics in literature are introduced. In the second section, it deals with the impacts of reverse logistics and factors which should be involved in selecting 3PLs as service providers. At last, the paper has a discussion over the challenges for reverse logistics.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of Remote Control System Using Bluetooth Mobile Phone with JNI Interface
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Remote control becomes the mobile phone's important application field. This article introduces a scheme which uses mobile phone to control power point play in computer. So, lecturer doesn't need to turn back to the dais to leaf over the power point, thus he can communication with the audience without interrupt. This article design and implement mobile remote control system , which uses Bluetooth technology and the JNI technology to control the windows system's function. As the result showed, the remote control system is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Frequency Synchronization Algorithm Based on PN Sequence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new frequency synchronization algorithm for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system by combining PN sequences with cyclic prefix. It is the improvement of Tufvesson's algorithm. In the new algorithm, the frequency offset is estimation with two steps. First a small step (span of the correlation) is used to estimate frequency offset which will result in a larger estimation range but less precise. After the frequency offset has been compensated, the second estimation using cyclic prefix is conducted which is a large step. The new algorithm has large estimation range and the estimation is more precise. Performance of the new estimator improved than that of the old one in AWGN channel and multipath fading channel.

articleTitle: A Mosaic Approach for Remote Sensing Images Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A mosaic method was put forward based on image wavelet transform and low-frequency area feature matching, which realized fast dynamic stitching of unmanned aerial vehicle's (UAV) sequence remote sensing images. This method made use of wavelet transform to obtain low-frequency image, searched and picked up character template image in this area, calculated and compared by using sequential similarity detection algorithm (SSDA), then obtained precise corresponding position relationship among the images. Based on the result of the image matching, the two images are stitched. Simulation experimental results show that the algorithm presented in the paper greatly improves the operation speed, while the precision remains fine, so it can be applied in real-time mosaicking of serial images from UAV very well.

articleTitle: Study on the Interactive Relationship between BPR and ERP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the common practice of enterprise informatization is integrating BPR and ERP together, which is the experience and lesson learned from the process of implementing the previous MRP II. However, the results of this practice vary from person to person, which is far from reaching its full maturity or success. This paper mainly studies the interactive relationship between BPR and ERP in the process of enterprise informatization and provides some useful views on how to apply BPR and ERP successfully.

articleTitle: Using 802.11 for RFID
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper describes how to carry out functions of RFID device, how to enhance RFID technology, and how to use Wi-Fi technology to follow real-time tracks so as to definite location. Also, this paper lists some produce newly developed using 802.11 technology. And after being inspired from this technology, we propose some ideas, which would be helpful to RFID technology in future.

articleTitle: With the Certificate-Rating System of Building Energy Efficiency, Accelerated the Progress of Building Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first examined the present situation on the global energy and the building energy consumption in China, then discussed the importance of building energy efficiency (abbr. BEE). Used for reference the certificate-rating system of BEE in abroad, the authors proposed to set up the similar system in building marketplace in China. Countered the information dispersive status of BEE, the authors suggested the certificate-rating system can availably collect the information of BEE. The article first established the system about the information collection, storage, management, issuance and utilization in BEE, then dissertated the availably use and effect on the information of BEE.

articleTitle: On Performance of Space-Time Eigenbeam Coding
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For downlink transmission channels in which fading is correlated at the transmitter but independent at the receiver, array and diversity gains can be attained simultaneously by use of Space-Time Eigenbeam Coding (STEBC) which combines eigenbeamforming and Space-Time Coding. STEBC can greatly reduce the complexity of the system and improve the performance as well. This paper is devoted to the evaluation of the performance of STEBC theoretically. The upper-bound of the average Pair Error Probability is utilized to measure the performance of STEBC. It shows that STEBC can achieve the maximum diversity gain and is especially suitable for the wireless environments with many paths around the transmitter which concentrate in several directions.

articleTitle: Construction of Short Block Length IRA Codes Based on Modified IPEG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the particular structure of irregular repeat-accumulate (IRA) codes, a weight function is given for codeword weight computing. Then, we propose a modification to the improved progressive-edge-growth (IPEG) algorithm. The modified IPEG algorithm gives degree-2 variable nodes more protection and tries to avoid low weight code-words corresponding to weight-one and weight-two encoder inputs. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm improves the performance of short block length IRA codes at high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) region with no sacrifice in low-SNR performance.

articleTitle: Genetic Neutrality in Naive Gene Expression Programming
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Gene expression programming (GEP) is a genotype- phenotype system with non-coding regions in genome where possible neutral mutations would be accumulated. In this paper, a novel concept named naive gene expression programming (NGEP) is introduced. The main contributions include: (a) proposing a novel algorithm named NGEP, which decoding method based on the complete tree, (b) discussing the role of genetic neutrality in GEP and NGEP, and (c) performing experiments to show that NGEP is faster than traditional GEP, and the success rate of NGEP is higher than that in traditional GEP.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation System of Regional Industrial Competitiveness from the Angle of Complex System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Scholars at home and abroad studied a lot about the problem of evaluation system of regional industrial competitiveness, which are mainly based on the systems of IMD and WEF, and the research objects are about international industrial competitiveness. In the paper, we study the problem from the angle of complex system, establish the evaluation system, quantize the system and discuss the problem from the source of regional industrial competitiveness according to the evolution law of complex system.

articleTitle: A Kind of Large Group Decision Making Method on the Utility Value Preference Information of Decision Member
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With respect to the problem of large group decision-making based on utility valued preference information, the paper puts forward the entropy weight method to appraise members' information, to predigest calculates. Then the paper classifies members using cluster analysis with weights, to get members' weights and concentrate members' preference information. Finally, the paper uses degree of opinion reflection index to measure the degree of members' opinion reflected by decision-making result, and compares it with threshold value that is established before decision-making. If the index is bigger than the threshold value, we can ratify decision- making result, contrarily we must amend avail vector of correlative member according to the degree of opinion difference index, and do decision-making again, until we get satisfying decision-making result.

articleTitle: Rough Set Based Algorithm of Discovering Functional Dependencies for Relation Database
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Functional dependency is an important concept in database research. It plays a fundamental role in the design of relation schema. Under the circumstance of semantics unknown or data relationship difficult to be defined, the problem we have to face is how to mine all possible full functional dependency behind datum. This paper gives top-down search algorithm based on indiscernibility relation to discover these dependencies. It improves traditional algorithm by reducing the redundant hypotheses of functional dependency and simplifying the process of verifying the hypotheses. Besides, the result excludes the possibility of partial dependency and distinguishes between direct functional dependency and transferable functional dependency.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement Model of Putting People First for E-Business Websites Based on DIT
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The realization of e-business functions mainly rely on the exchange of information. In this paper, synthesized the distance of information-state transition (for short DIT) theory and evaluation theory, we firstly studied the DIT in the e-business Websites from the perspective of putting people first (for short PPF), put forward the measurement model of putting people first for e-business Websites based on DIT theory. Then took buying a book from Dangdang Web and Joyo Web as example, we comparatively analyzed the DIT from two perspectives-not putting people first and putting people first. Meanwhile, this study can provide the necessary academic basics and data support for further analysis of the information management on e-business Websites.

articleTitle: A Differential MIMO-Beamforming Scheme for Transmission over Aeronautical Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper beamforming and differential space-time modulation (DSTM) are combined together to construct a robust system for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) aeronautical channels. A transmission scheme is developed here that combines digital beamforming (DBF) with differential multi-antenna modulation based on orthogonal space-time block coding (STBC). The minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) algorithm is modified to make it suitable for multiple transmit antenna system. The simulation results proved that the transmitting scheme is an effective way to solve the problem with performance, complexity, and transmission rate for aeronautical communications.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability of Complex Coal Mine Ventilation Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ventilation networks is the main part of coal mine ventilation system, it takes the responsibility to transfer fresh air to the underground laneways to keep the whole safety of coal mine. In this paper, we discuss about the reliability of the ventilation networks by using Boolean calculation and Shannon formula, and expatiate the application process with a real case, the result shows the highly efficiency and maneuverability.

articleTitle: On MIMO Channel Shortening For Cyclic-Prefixed Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider channel shortening for cyclic-prefixed block transmission system over multiple input multiple output (MIMO) channels. A time domain equalizer (TEQ) is necessary at the receiver front head to mitigate intersymbol interference (ISI). Melsa, Younce, and Rohrs (1996) proposed the most popular MSSNR channel shortening method for single input single output (SISO) channels based on minimizing the energy of the shortened impulse response (SIR) outside the target window while keeping the energy inside constant. Because of computational simplicity of the MSSNR method, we extended this method directly for MIMO channels unlike other MIMO TEQ design methods which perform shortening in multiple stages. We compared our scheme with other MIMO TEQ design techniques for equalization SNR energy compaction ratio, signal to interference plus noise ratio and bit rate. The results show significant improvement over some reported techniques.

articleTitle: A Modified Sphere-Decoding Based Detector for MIMO LS-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Loosely-synchronized code division multiple access (LS-CDMA) technology is an excellent CDMA technology and very suitable to be applied in the future wireless communication systems. When the multiple input multiple output (MIMO) technique is integrated, better performance and system capacity can be achieved. But the computational complexity of classical detection algorithm based on exhaustive searching, such as maximum-likelihood (ML) rule, is too high and inconvenient to realisation. Although sphere-decoding (SD) algorithm is able to greatly decrease the detection complexity due to the sphere-constrained searching, the decoding complexity is very high especially when the constellation has a lot of points and the number of antennas is large. A modified detection algorithm based on SD method is proposed in this paper, for the sake of further decreasing the complexity. It decodes according to the signal-noise-ratio (SNR). The detector outputs the zero-forcing (ZF) detection results when the SNR is relatively high, otherwise it subtracts these decoded signals from the original receiving signals and then decodes them by SD algorithm. The simulation results shows that the performance of such modified algorithm has little difference as compared with that of SD algorithm.

articleTitle: Decomposition Analysis of Industrial Power Demand of China Based on Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Firstly, the factors influencing industrial electric power demand are analyzed. Secondly, the changing law of power consumption intensity and the character of industrial electric power consumption are studied based on the power consumption and the value of industrial output. Finally, a model of power demand is established based on panel data, in which the influence of policy of saving energy is considered. Compared with other models, it is more valid and it can provide decision making support for the forecasting of industrial electric power demand and policy of saving energy in China.

articleTitle: The Application of TCM in Assessing the Recreational Value of the Leisure Farmland: A Case Study of Heping Village
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The leisure farmland mainly situated in the urban fringe is a comprehensive scenic spot which provides not only the functions of agricultural production and the life supporting, but also the amenity value of environment for human beings. With excessive urban expansion and under the pressure of the comparative benefits, the leisure farmland has a tendency of converting to the non-agricultural uses. Therefore, it is an important to use scientific method to estimate the total value of the leisure farmland precisely, which can provide scientific basis for the decision-making of farmland protection. This article constructs the ZTCM model and evaluates the recreational value of Heping village according to investigation by the research group at Heping village in Wuhan in 2006.The research results show that the recreational value of Heping village is 10,014,502 yuan in 2005.

articleTitle: Exact and Approximation Expressions to the SER of Space-Time Block Codes in Correlated MIMO Nakagami Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present the exact closed-form expressions to the symbol error rate (SER) of coherent M-ary phase-shift keying(MPSK) and M-ary quardrature amplitude modulation (MQAM), when these modulations schemes are used along with space-time block codes in spatially correlated MIMO Nakagami fading channels with arbitrary fading parameters. Using the well-known moment generating function-based analysis approach, we express the average SERs in terms of Lauricella's multivariate hypergeometric functions. Using exponential bounds for the Gaussian Q-function and for MPSK error probability over additive Gaussian noise channels, we also present new bounds and simple approximate solutions for the exact closed- form expressions to the SERs of MPSK and MQAM, respectively. The new bounds and approximate solutions can be used to compute the average SER of MPSK and MQAM. Numerical results are presented to verify the accuracy of the solutions.

articleTitle: A Study on the Operating Mode Decision-Making in Reverse Logistics of Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of operating mode selection in the reverse logistics of manufacturing enterprise. First, three operating modes of reverse logistics are introduced; then, we establish an evaluation index system by using balanced scorecard. On the basis of above, a decision-making model of reverse logistics for manufacturing enterprise is built up through fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Finally, a specific example is used to illustrate the availability of the established decision-making model in the practice of reverse logistics operating mode selection for manufacturers.

articleTitle: Intellectual Property Risks Evaluation in Tacit Knowledge Transferring on Collaborative Innovation Based on Evidential Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, setting up innovational nation requires plenty of domestic enterprises own intellectual property; collaborative innovation is an important ways for enterprises to create intellectual property. Collaborative innovation require knowledge transferring, there exists plenty of intellectual property risks in knowledge transferring. Therefore, based on the features of intellectual property risks in tacit knowledge transferring on collaborative innovation, the paper explores evaluation of intellectual property risks in tacit knowledge transferring based on collaborative innovation by evidential reasoning, which provides quantity standard for managing intellectual property risks in tacit knowledge transferring based on collaborative innovation scenically.

articleTitle: Design Time-Stamp Based State Prediction Controller for Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents a state prediction controller design method for networked control system (NCS) to compensate time-delay in the control loop based on the time-stamp information carried by the message in control network. At first, we study a time-stamp based algorithm of measuring the time-delay in NCS and apply the state prediction based time-delay compensation control to the system. Then, we propose a state prediction control approach of establishing an approximate model to object states in the controller and actuator time-driven. And, the necessary and sufficient conditions for stabilizing the system are deduced. At last, a numerical example and its state curve of prediction controller prove the validity of the given design method.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Second Industry of the Lucheng District in Wenzhou Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The second industry of Lucheng district in Wenzhou includes many sectors and their development efficiency differs widely. It is noteworthy to evaluate the development efficiency of the second industry's sectors in Lucheng district and analyze their present development situation and the inefficiency reasons. The results can help make development policies and development measures of the second industry. This paper uses data envelope analysis method, chooses right input-output indices to do the empirical study on the second industry in Lucheng district according to correlative data from the first economic census.

articleTitle: A New Coded Cooperation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: User cooperation provides transmit diversity even when mobile users cannot possess multiple antennas due to size constraints.
