Recently, a kind of user cooperation scheme called coded cooperation was proposed, in which standard channel coding methods were used to implement cooperation. This scheme achieves remarkable gains compared to non-cooperative system and other cooperation diversity scheme (such as amplify-and-forward and decoded-and-forward) while maintaining the same information rate and transmit power. In this paper, we propose a new coded cooperation algorithm. We compare the performance of our scheme with coded cooperation proposed by Hunter under a variety of conditions in slow fading, and a significant improvement is achieved.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of a CR-Based WRAN System using Spectrum Utilization Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A cognitive radio system is one of promising solutions that can relieve the spectrum shortage problem by using spectrum overlay sharing. The performance of a cognitive radio system can be evaluated by the spectral utilization efficiency. Considering net system coverage, we propose area efficiency in order to measure the spectrum utilization efficiency of a CR- based wireless regional area network (WRAN) system over TV bands. Based on a coexistence scenario between WRAN and DTV systems, we evaluate area efficiency and compare it with the conventional ones such as spectral/coverage efficiency. From simulation results it is observed that area efficiency is more useful than spectral/coverage efficiency under spectrum sharing environment such as the number of available frequency bands and the available amount of given geographical area.

articleTitle: Image Retrieval Based on Spatial Feature of Texture Primitive
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An image retrieval based on texture primitive is proposed in this paper. The texture primitive is firstly constructed according to the principle of the block truncation code (BTC). Meantime, based on the analysis of the statistical distribution of the texture primitive, the spatial distribution map of each feature is presented to describe the image texture information. Experimental results show that the proposed method has sound and robust retrieval performance by integrating spatial and texture information into image descriptors.

articleTitle: A New Time-Frequency Representation Based on Ambiguity Function Analysis and its Application in Parameter Estimation of FH Signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces a new kernel to compute time-frequency representation (TFR) of Frequency Hopping signal based on the ambiguity function (AF) analysis. By control two parameters of the kernel in time lag and frequency lag directions, the new representation makes a good improvement in time-frequency resolution and suppresses the influence of cross terms. The application in parameter estimation of FH signal is also show to validate the proposed representation.

articleTitle: Improve TCP Performance with Link-Aware Warning Method in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with the reactive routing algorithms of mobile ad hoc network (MANET), preemptive routing is a patch method which tries to warn the source node and to tell it to change route in time before a link is about to break Preemptive method was proposed to decrease packet losses and improve TCP performance in MANET. However, the precision of warning occasion is an important problem, and affects TCP performance greatly. In this paper, with an improved link status evaluation technique, we present a LAW (Link-Aware Warning)-Routing method to improve the preemptive routing by increasing the precision of warning. We also choose an appropriate Reaction Time, which is an important factor in route warning occasion, according to our LAW-Routing function. The simulation result shows that the new method can improve the performance of routing and TCP greatly, especially in high-mobility scenarios.

articleTitle: Interaction Relationship between Technological Innovation and Institutional Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Both technology and institution are important innovation factors, technological innovation and institutional innovation interact and impulse each other to attain economic growth. At present, to grasp the main aspect of the innovation system contradiction movement, to change the traditional tendency of preferring technological innovation to institutional innovation, and to quicken the step of institutional innovation, are urgently required to build innovative nation to attain innovation drive of economic growth instead of resource reliance pattern in China.

articleTitle: Interactive Learning Environment Designing for Software Project Management Teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Interactive learning environment usually offer a user- friendly interface. This allows inexperienced users fast access to the key point of knowledge, because they have experience in making decisions in simulators. Thus, they are not only able to examine the results of their decisions but also the causes of these results. This article will explain the principle and process of interactive learning environment using system dynamics for software project management training.

articleTitle: Improved Subspace-Based (Semi-) Blind Channel Estimation for Block Space-Time OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multiantenna wireless systems have been well studied in achieving high data rates. In this paper, we improve a subspace-based blind channel estimation technique for multi- input multi-output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) approach based on tracking the subspace recursively. The recursive subspace algorithm has a computational complexity of O(J<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) , where the J is the input vector dimension. The simulation results show that the improved estimator's capability is similar to the source approach, but deeply decrease the computational complexity.

articleTitle: Implementation and Time Performance Analysis of Security Suite in LR-WPAN 802.15.4
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, short-range wireless communication becomes a hotspot in wireless industry, which can be widely used in constructing the wireless sensor network of military, industrial control, precise agriculture and medical monitoring. It will play an important role with the coming ubiquitous computing age. Focusing on LR-WPAN 802.15.4, this paper introduces its security architecture and presents an input block model based on the underlying AES encryption algorithm and generic CCM mode when implementing AES-CCM security suite. An experiment compared with traditional DES on time performance is carried out and the results show better efficiency and security strength in AES-CCM.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Expressway Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Expressway maintenance is very important for the well operation of expressway which is an essential part of national infrastructure. But traditional methods could not meet the requirements of maintenance management of fast developed expressway. Intelligent expressway maintenance system (IEMS) is a new way to solve the problem of expressway maintenance. Firstly, characters of expressway maintenance work are pointed out to find out the special need compared with usual pavement maintenance. Then requirement analysis of IEMS is made according to these characters. A logistic framework of IEMS is proposed on the basis of system requirement analysis and the work flow of IEMS is described. Then the connections between IEMS and other expressway management systems are analyzed as the integration of them is critical to the success of IEMS. At last a framework model of IEMS is proposed and functions of its modules are detailed.

articleTitle: Innovation Synergy and Sustainable Growth of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation is a complicated process interacted by many factors such as knowledge, economy and society. Only by innovation synergy of market, technology and management, comprehensive profit which is higher than those done by one-sided innovation can be achieved. This paper gained conclusion that 1+1>2 synergy effect can't be realized by single innovation but innovation synergy. Based on the explanations of concepts as innovation synergy, in-generations growth and between-generations growth, a two-branch-evolvement mode is established to research on the way of preventing between-generations-recession and realizing between-generations-growth. This paper believes that innovation synergy is the motive force of between-generations-impel of enterprise.

articleTitle: An Extended EOQ Model in Production-Recycling System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we develop an extended EOQ model with used products recycling and finished products producing to satisfy the fixed demands. This model involves the repair and the continuous collection of used products and allows multiple production lot-sizes problems. Based on the present model, we present a joint policy associating with the collection of used products and the production of finished products under the minimization of total costs of the inventory system, and we deduce simultaneously the optimal economic order quantity of finished products and the optimal inventory level of repairable products models. Finally, we give several numerical examples to illustrate the validity of the models.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load-Balancing in iSCSI Systems Based on a Feedback Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multiple network cards and multiple connections in iSCSI are important ways to improve iSCSI systems performance, fault tolerance and scalability. But multiple connections technology cannot assign every task appropriately, so it cannot produce the excellent performance. This paper proposes a dynamic load balancing algorithm using a feedback control mechanism to improve the overall performance in iSCSI systems. In order to adjust the load state dynamically, this algorithm adopts a feedback mechanism to calculate multiple resources states that have been collected in this system, and then combines the results and the previous feedback. The test results indicate that with the help of this algorithm the performance of iSCSI system has been improved.

articleTitle: A Routing Metric Based On Channel Utilization for Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless mesh networks (WMNs) integrate the advantages of WLAN and mobile ad hoc network and have become the key technique of next-generation wireless network. Routing plays a significant role in WMNs. The existed routing protocols used in ad hoc network cannot fully fit the characteristics of WMNs. Based on WCETT and channel cost metric (CCM) routing rules, this paper proposes a new multi-channel path metric named weighted cumulative CCM_L (WCCCM_L) for WMNs, which selects interference-aware paths to send packets mainly based on channel utilization. Analytic results show that the proposed routing metric WCCCM_L can obviously approve the network performance.

articleTitle: The Community Website Design Based on Complementary Advantages of Web2.0 and Web1.0
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the wide adoption of Web 2.0, the community Web sites have become catching on in recent years. However, most of them are facing some problems that need to be addressed before they can achieve fast development. In this paper, we first introduce the concepts of community Web site and comparison of Web 2.0 and Web 1.0. Then, the characteristics and operation modes of community Web sites are analyzed through two successful Web sites, Myspace and Xiaonei. Finally, a model of e-commerce learning Web site is proposed to demonstrate the design ideas and architecture of community Web site based on the combination of the advantages of Web 2.0 and Web 1.0.

articleTitle: A Range-Free Localization Algorithm in Concave Areas
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Large amount of range-free localization algorithm are depended on sensor nodes densely deployed in an isotropic area. The study of localization problem is in the precondition of a mapping function between measured distance and Euclidean distance for pair of sensor nodes. If the sensors are deployed in an anisotropic network such as concave area, traditional assumption of isotropic sensor network will not hold. In this paper, we study the problem of localization algorithms in anisotropic sensor network, and propose a range-free localization method WSAN (weight-based selective anchor nodes localization algorithm) used in the anisotropic networks based on each anchor's weight. In the WSAN, all unknown nodes keep an anchor nodes' information table recording each anchor's weight, and choosing the anchors which are less affected by the anisotropic factors involved in the localization. The algorithm has been demonstrated that it has a lower localization error rate comparing with traditional localization algorithms; hence, making it suitable for anisotropic sensor areas.

articleTitle: A Management Object Oriented Solution of Knowledge Management System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of information system, there is an urgent need for enterprises to change from information management to knowledge management. In the network-computing environment, enterprises need to apply the complex, dynamic and integrated, object-oriented knowledge management system. First, this paper analyzed the essence of knowledge and knowledge management, discussed the concept and characteristics of enterprise knowledge portal. On this basis, the article proposed a management object oriented solution of knowledge management system, focusing on the framework of the system, mode of operation and the value of application with a case study. Such a solution can help enterprises to establish open, dynamic and integrated information and knowledge management systems.

articleTitle: University Library VOD System Based on Campus Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on Video on Demand and video live broadcast system in the library of Wuhan University, this paper discusses the features, structure function of the VOD system which is based on campus network. It also analyses the bottleneck on network transportation, hard disk output and server performance of the streaming media in a VOD system. At last it studies the related issues of constructing VOD systems.

articleTitle: Synchronization Algorithm Based on Pseudo Random Time-Hopping Codes for UWB Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new blind synchronization algorithm for ultra-wideband (UWB) systems based on pseudo random time-hopping (TH) codes. The synchronization parameter is acquired by using integrate-and-dump (I&D) among several segments (these segments are chosen according to a user-specific TH codes) of the observation waveform and peak-picking the outputs of the I&D device. Due to the pseudo random property of the TH codes, the maximum significantly differs from other values, thus the proposed algorithm has high immunity to noise. Owing to the periodicity of the TH codes, one symbol-long observation interval is enough to achieve synchronization, which speeds up the overall synchronization process. Simulations and comparisons confirm that our algorithm outperforms existing similar one in terms of normalized mean square error (NMSE) and bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Study on the Across Interferer of Novel Six-Port Demodulator
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel six-port demodulator composed of the Wilkinson power dividers/combiners and the 90deg phase shifters was developed in this paper. The influence of the errors of the 90deg phase shifters on the baseband signals of the demodulator was considered and the corresponding mathematic formulas were given. The results showed that the present six-port demodulator can demodulate all orthogonal modulation signals at the center frequency. A simple baseband signal processing method was suggested to decrease the I/Q across interferer of the output baseband signals in the case of the operating frequency being departed from the center frequency. The simulation results showed that the BER performances of the demodulator were degraded less within one octave band by this method. The present work is expected to be useful for the design of the advanced demodulator with high frequency and ultra-wideband.

articleTitle: Research on Product Information Organization Based on Ontology in the Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Product information is consist of product attributes and the relationships between products. Product classification is one of the relationships. Ontology can be used greatly in the formalization of product information. This article introduces the research on the application of ontology in product information organization, and preliminary discusses how to construct product ontology system. On this basis, a product ontology model is established, which solves some problems in product information organization and makes it more efficient to organize and search product information. This article explores the methods of building product ontology system mainly according to the knowledge engineering means.

articleTitle: Discrete Gaussian-Hermite Moments and its Applications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Moments are widely used in pattern recognition, image processing, and computer vision and multi resolution analysis. In this paper, we first point out the discrete Gaussian-Hermite moments, and propose a new method to represent an image compressed using the discrete Gaussian-Hermite moments. The experiment results are reported, which show the good performance of our method.

articleTitle: Mobile IPV6: Simultaneous and Consecutive Mobility Experiments on MIPL Testbed
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobility management is crucial for wireless connectivity which has become popular among mobile users nowadays. Mobile IP has been developed in order to enable mobile appliances, such as notebooks, mobile phones and PDA. One of the crucial problems that need to be tackled is mobile network handover. Handover in mobile IPv6 happens when a mobile node moves from one coverage area to another. However there are latency issues and possible packet loss during handover. This project focuses on MIPL (mobile IP for Linux) handover analysis, particularly in simultaneous mobile nodes movement and consecutive mobility in mobile IPv6, by looking at different scenarios and aspects. Findings on measurement of handover latency for Simultaneous mobility were also included in this project, together with the consecutive mobility observation. Various experiments were conducted to determine the handoff latency between the mobile nodes. The testbed network experiments also identify the differences between standard mobile IPv6 procedure and MIPL implementation in terms of return routability process, which is crucial for mobile nodes handoff latency improvements.

articleTitle: A CMOS 3.1-10.6 GHz Merged UWB LNA and Mixer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a merged LNA and mixer covering the frequency range from 3.1-10.6 GHz that able to meet the UWB communication technology. By employing the capacitive cross-coupling transconductor, the gm is boosted and the NF is reduced. A current-mode mixer shares the output load of the LNA to achieve high gain and wideband matching simultaneously.The output current of LNA flows into the mixer directly, resulting in significant linearity improvements and power saves. Designed in the chartered 0.18-mum RFCMOS technology, this proposed block achieves the maximum power conversion gain of 16 dB and input reflection coefficient (Sll) of less than -10 dB from 3.1 to 10.6 GHz.The minimum single side band noise figure is 7.4 dB.An IIP3 is -4 dBm at 5 GHz.The power dissipation is 13.6 mW from a 1.5-V supply voltage.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer Design of Optimal Contention Period for Mobile WiMAX Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In IEEE 802.16e mobile WiMAX system, since mobile stations (MSs) send bandwidth request (BR) messages to base station (BS) during contention period when they need uplink channel to transmit data in the case of multicast polling or broadcast polling, the uplink performance is affected by the size of the contention period in the uplink subframe. The access delay will be increased if the size of the contention period is too small and the resource will be wasted on the contrary. Therefore, we propose a cross-layer analytical model for designing the optimal size of the contention period. The model is simulated using OPNET modeler, and the results show that our proposed model can improve the uplink data transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Joint Relay Selection and ARQ in Cooperative Diversity Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The concept of cooperative diversity promises to offer the benefits of spatial diversity gains to handheld wireless devices with single antennas. So far the research has focused on special modulation or space-time coding in order to allow the cooperating terminals transmit simultaneously during the relay phase. In this paper, we proposed a joint relay selection and ARQ scheme in the cooperative diversity wireless networks. The simulation comparison of the direct transmission scheme, decode- and-forward scheme (DF) and joint relay selection and ARQ scheme showed that the proposed scheme can always achieve the highest throughput.

articleTitle: Applying a Multi-Attribute Metrics Approach to Detect Contents of Blog Communities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The rapid development of blogs has brought on some serious problems such as disclosure of sensitive information, spread of unhealthy information, etc. So it is very important for supervisors to detect them. The common methods based on search engines have some drawbacks such as lower efficiency and lower precision because they need to retrieve and update blog pages frequently, and to analyze all blog pages downloaded In this paper, we present a new method for detecting contents of blogs based on communities discovery. It adopts a hierarchical clustering algorithm based on multi-attribute metrics. By this method, we can monitor the whole blog community by detecting the contents of eigenvalue nodes . Our experimental result shows that the algorithm proposed is highly effective.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Contribution of Management Innovation to the Development of China's Telecommunication Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Management innovation is one of the important factors to promote the development of China's telecommunication industry except capital, labor and technology advancement. It is of significance to measure the contribution of management innovation. In this paper, we improve the production function model of Tin Bergen, and then measure the contribution of management innovation to the development of telecommunication industry's economy from 1992 to 2005. The results show that management innovation exerts great influences on telecommunication industry and its contribution degree is increasing gradually.

articleTitle: Power Allocation for the Uplink of Multi-User MIMO-OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, power allocation scheme for clusters by mobile station (MS) is investigated in the uplink of a multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing access (OFDMA) cellular system. In system level simulation works, without the knowledge of how many clusters will be assigned to a MS, it is a puzzle to decide how much transmission power should be used to calculate the signal to noise ratio (SNR) value before scheduled by the scheduler in base station (BS). Four feasible schemes are proposed for this problem. System level simulation results show that one of these schemes can improve system throughput while keeping the inter-cell interference at a moderate level.

articleTitle: Development of Meter-Reading System Building Centralized Controller in Intelligent Residential District
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a residential district, building centralized controllers are used to check the power consumed in each building, and store the data into data memory. Building centralized controller could communicate with filed data collector using CAN bus, as well as with upper computer by GPRS. Considering the data memory and reliability, FM1808 ferroelectric memory is adopted. To enhance the anti-interference ability, some measurements in hardware, such as fiber-electronic coupling, high frequency channel, decoupling capacitors settlement, are taken. Meanwhile, DS12887 is applied to reset microcontroller every 500 ms.

articleTitle: A Modified Directional MAC Protocol for Using Smart Antenna in Wireless Ad Hoc and Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Directional and smart antenna is an effective measure to improve the capacity of wireless ad hoc and sensor networks (WASN). To utilize the profit of directional and smart antenna, the MAC layer protocol has to be changed to adapt to the control of contention of the channel. A directional MAC (DMAC) protocol has been put forward before, but that protocol has some limitation which confines the MAC layer performance of WASN. To solve the problems of DMAC, a modified directional MAC (M-DMAC) protocol is designed in this paper, simulation results show that it improves the performance of DMAC.

articleTitle: A New-User Cold-Starting Recommendation Algorithm Based on Normalization of Preference
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cold-starting problem of recommender system has attracted much attention. In the case of cold-starting, the extreme sparsity of ratings would induce poor performance of traditional recommendation algorithms. This paper presents a new algorithm to deal with the issue of cold-starting by taking the preference of user's ratings into consideration. After normalizing historical rating matrix, two-stage weighted prediction with user similarity is proposed, then the predicted rating value can be obtained by inverse normalization. The experimental results indicate that the method can not only guarantee good recommendation performance in the condition of user cold-starting, but also keep the recommendation consistency when the rating matrix is in normal state.

articleTitle: Studies on the Visualization for Web Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to reduce the cost of information acquisition and improve the efficiency of information retrieval, it is very significant to integrate information visualization technology into information retrieval to help people better understand complex information space. This paper analyzes how to integrate the visualization techniques into Web information retrieval; and puts forward to an application model of information retrieval visualization.

articleTitle: Insider Attacks Study Against Mobile IPv6 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Route optimization provides a short path between the mobile node and the correspondent node in mobile IPv6 protocol and makes them communicate efficiently. Some insider attacks were found while analyzing vulnerability of the route optimization. The simulation experiment shows that the insider attacks make the mobile node fail in using optimized route, and it results in performance degradation and even communication disruption. It costs little to launch such attacks, but all the mobile nodes in a foreign network are potentially affected.

articleTitle: The Zipf's Law in the Revenue of Top 500 Chinese Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we reveal that the top 500 Chinese firms' operating revenues and their ranks completely obey the Zipf distribution with exponents of 1 in recent six years. Similar distribution can be confirmed in some other countries. It universally exists in many economic systems of the world. Based on simple multiplicative process model with the proper distribution of random multiplicator drawn from the real data, we reproduce the Zipf phenomenon after several simulation steps.

articleTitle: Solution to the "ARF" (Agriculture, Rural Land, Farmers) Problems in China: An Intellectual Capital Framework
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The intellectual capital (IC) theory is a whole new one booming in present academic society , and it provides a new view for organization development and region development. The "ARF" (agriculture, rural land, farmers) problems has been the hotspot and crux in Chinese socialist construction. We innovate in bringing the IC theory into the study of the "ARF " problems, and draw practical and dominant conclusions thereby. We hold that different strategies may be brought out when analysing the "ARF" problems from different angels. From the prospect of human capital, we should implement rural human capital engineering(RHCE) to improve the farmer' diathesis. From the prospect of structure capital, we should start systematic reformation, mechanism construction, and institution construction in rural lands. From the prospect of relational dimension of intellectual capital, we need to induce some new growth variables for economy development and promote investment. Based on above considerations, we bring forward an IC-framework model for the "ARF" problems, and further optimize and re-formulate our 4D model of rural human capital engineering (hereafter referred to as RHCE) which was brought forth two years ago, and also give birth to a new 3D systematic model of RHCE based on the IC theory. In this way, we provide a new view and practical guidance for implementing RHCE.

articleTitle: Multiple Frequency Offsets Pre-Correction Based on Enhanced Limited Feedback Precoding for Distributed MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of multiple frequency offsets pre-correction in distributed multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. In practical distributed MIMO system, each pair of transmit and receive antenna has a different frequency offset and the received signal at each receiver is the summation of all the transmitted signals. These multiple frequency offsets make frequency compensation difficult if not impossible. In the paper, taking advantage of equivalent channel matrix with frequency offsets information, an enhanced limited feedback precoding (ELFP) algorithm is proposed to pre-correct the effect of frequency offsets. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme works as well as the system without frequency offsets even if the normalized frequency offsets is as high as 20%.

articleTitle: A Novel ID-Based Group Signature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a special signature, group signature allows group members to anonymously sign arbitrary messages on behalf of the group, if case of dispute, the group manager will be able to reveal the identity of the signer. To the best of my knowledge, most of the group signature schemes available based on identity are insecure. In this paper, we propose a novel ID-based group signature scheme. Our proposed scheme has the following advantages: (I) only needs 10 exponential operators in the signing phase, (2) the size of signature and public key is independent of the group number; (3) less strong assumption restriction. (4) resisting collusion. In comparison with state-of-the-art ACJT scheme, the computation cost of signing in our scheme is further less than one of ACJT scheme. Hence, our scheme is an efficient signature scheme. Finally, we also give the security analysis to the scheme.

articleTitle: Expansion of Ramp Compensation and Comprehensive Evaluation in Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A DC/DC switching converter is a strongly nonlinear control system. The study on chaotic phenomena and chaos control is a hotspot of the power electronics. In this paper the dynamical model of current-mode controlled boost converter has been studied. Based on expansion of ramp compensation method and parametric resonance perturbation method, we used three different perturbation signals (i.e. sine wave, saw tooth wave and triangular wave) to boost converter for controlling chaos, and presented criteria of performance evaluation. Meanwhile, from the evaluation principles introduced, it is indicated that triangular wave is a suitable choice of periodic compensation signal. Simulations and analysis are presented to provide practical and theoretical evidences for the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A Model in Support of Bid Evaluation in Multi-Attribute E-Auction for Procurement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bid evaluation is an important but complex problem in multi-attribute auction. Management science techniques might be helpful tools for this kind of decision making problems. This paper focuses on the bid evaluation problem in multi-attribute e-auction for procurement. The proposed model uses an outranking-based multi-attribute decision technique, ELECTRE-III, to evaluate the buyer's preferences. It is shown by means of a bid evaluation example that the presented approach may be well suited as a decision-making tool for multi-attribute e-procurement.

articleTitle: The Demand Forecast of Spare Parts Based on Group Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As production technology advancement and product upgrading, enterprises need to purchase new equipment. Due to the use of some new spare parts in new equipment, no previous data history of these new spare parts can be used, so that it is difficult to determine the rule of failure and life of these new spare parts, and the demand for such spare parts. Then the number of storage will be difficultly decides. In this paper, the new equipment and the new spare parts will be classified and grouped according to similarity of the principle and structure. And these new spare parts demand will be inferred by the demand of similar spare parts.

articleTitle: Implementation of Distributed Kalman Filter Based on Mutual Coupled Oscillators in Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The problem of distributed Kalman filter is one of the most fundamental collaborative information process problems for data fusion in sensor networks. This paper models the nodes of sensor networks as coupled oscillators and propose a novel implementation of distributed Kalman filter based on mutually coupled oscillators. This paper firstly demonstrates that the structure of distributed Kalman filter algorithm is equivalent to the local Kalman filter with the inputs from optimal ML estimator. Then mutually coupled oscillators are used for distributed ML estimate and thus implementing the distributed Kalman filter. This method not only provides a simple and convenient implementation of collaborative information process in sensor networks, but also maintains the robustness and reliability.

articleTitle: The Beneficial Impact of Information Sharing on the Bullwhip Effect in Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bullwhip effect is a common phenomenon existing on supply chain. After studying the bullwhip effect in multi-echelon supply chains. This paper examines the beneficial impact of information sharing on supply chains. Finally, some effective IT supported platforms for the information sharing amongst supply chain are discussed.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Supply Chain Management Based on E-Commerce in Chinese Auto Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The emergence and development of E-commerce has thoroughly transformed the interactive mode and operating means of materials flow, information flow and funds flow in the logistics, which has deep influence to the supply chain management (SCM). Therefore, studying the SCM based on E-commerce has great practical meaning. This paper will, according to Chinese auto industry, study and analyze the SCM under current e-commerce environment. Firstly, we will put forward the basic thought of SCM and it' s development stages; Then, according to the existing problems in different stages we discuss the E-commerce's influence upon the development modes of SCM; Finally, we summary the main problems which Chinese auto enterprises will face when implementing SCM under the electronic commerce environment and put forward corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: Receive Antenna Selection without CSI for Linear Detection
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) receive antenna selection without channel state information (CSI) for linear detection is proposed in the presence of unknown interferences. This antenna selection technique is implemented based on training sample sequence by minimizing the Least Squares (LS) estimation error, which avoids the channel estimation. Since the high complexity of the exhaustive search, a QR decomposition-based fast selection algorithm is presented by using greedy algorithm. Simulations show that the exhaustive selection can retain the diversity benefit of the full complexity system using all the receive antennas and that the fast selection algorithm obtains most of performance of the exhaustive selection system with linear complexity.

articleTitle: Simulation and Implementation of Wavelet Packet Multi-Carrier Modulation Technique
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to save CP, improve the frequency band usage and improve the ISI situation, an algorithm is proposed that can realizes multi-carrier modulation and demodulation of signal transportation by fast wavelet packet transform. It adopts wavelet packet function as carriers which have the characteristic of good orthogonality and time-frequency limitation. It can be seen from both theoretical analysis and software simulation that multi-carrier modulation and demodulation technique based on wavelet packet transform (WPMD) has unique advantage and great potential in improving the performance of communication system. Realization methods are flexible and various. A scheme of WPMD was presented and implemented based on high-level FPGA. Real-time running result indicates that using a high performance FPGA can satisfy the requirement of large computation capability needed by WPMD and high-speed mobile communication.

articleTitle: Decentralized Supply Chain Programming Model for Remanufacturing System Involved in Third Party Logistics Provider
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a decentralized supply chain programming model for remanufacturing system based on minimal-information sharing which is composed of one manufacturer, one supplier, and one 3PL provider. The manufacturer is in charge of returning and re-disposing used products besides manufacturing and remanufacturing, while the 3PL provider is responsible for the transportation of new products and returned products. During the operation, each chain partner pursues cost-minimization, and minimal-information sharing. Lastly, we recommend an interactive multi-level programming algorithm for model solution.

articleTitle: Power-Based Routing for Two-Hop OFDMA Cellular Networks with Fixed Relay Stations
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses aspects of routing strategy of a cellular network enhanced with two-hop fixed relay nodes. The routing strategy for each user is important design parameter because the terminal is energy-limited. To enhance the radio resource utility, a utility maximization framework via pricing is adopted for multi-cell distributed power allocation. Under the optimization physical layer transmission strategy, an efficient power-based routing algorithm is proposed in reverse link which selects the best route in the tradeoff between power consumption and data rate. It is demonstrated through intensive system-level simulation that the performance of our proposed routing algorithm is superior to several known routing algorithms.

articleTitle: Infeasibility Testing and Repairing Algorithms for Job Shop Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The issue of the feasibility or infeasibility of constraints is important and sometimes is more fundamental than optimization itself. The job shop scheduling problem (JSSP) is one of the hardest combinatorial optimization problems. However, the feasibility study for JSSP is still an undeveloped area. In this paper, we present an intuitive method to diagnose the feasibility of a solution of the job shop scheduling problem. A theorem, guaranteeing the correctness of the method, is proved. Furthermore an intuitive and fast repairing algorithm is developed to reach feasibility from infeasible solutions of the problem.

articleTitle: Positioning of CODP Based on Entropy Technology and Ideal Point Principle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The performance of the positioning of customer order decoupling point (CODP) directly determines the supply chain lean degree. Focused on its positioning, basic characteristics of CODP upstream and downstream are analyzed. Based on multi-objective, consisting of product function, manufacturing cost and lead time, the positioning of CODP decision-making model is constructed. The entropy technology and ideal point principle is given to derive the optimal solutions of the proposed models. Finally, taken an example, the feasibility of decision-making model and its evaluation method is verified.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Channel State Information Effect to MIMO-OFDM System Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The researches about conditions of the resource allocation algorithm in wireless communication have been done a lot recently. An evaluation model for the adaptive algorithm of MIMO-OFDM system is built in this paper. After formulating system efficiency under static and adaptive conditions, the effect of imperfect channel state information (CSI) to MIMO-OFDM system is analyzed. Analytical and numerical results show effect to the frequency efficiency when the CSI is imperfect, and simulations show that MIMO-OFDM can resist the channel delay. At last we propose the compensatory policy for channel delay and channel estimation error.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Improving Sensitivity of GPS Receiver Based on Cross-Correlation Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An algorithm for GPS receiver performing to mitigate cross correlations between multiple satellite signals is presented. By using the known pseudosequence, the cross-correlation between every two signals can be computed, whereas this cross correlation value often changes since Doppler frequency shift and code phase difference. With aim to estimate the correct cross-correlation, a synthetical factor was presented base on analysis of the characteristics of cross correlation under the influence of Doppler frequency difference and fractional code phase difference. Simulation result shows this scheme can mitigate the interference of 75%.

articleTitle: A Study on Performance of an IR-UWB Receiver Based on Energy Detection
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An energy detection-based impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) system is proposed in this study. The related synchronization process is investigated on the pulse and frame level respectively. According to the system structure, an optimal transmission mode is described in a typical indoor environment, which could take the balance in the system reliability and effectivity. Meanwhile, the referenced frame structure and transmission rate under certain environments are given in this optimal mode. System performance is tested by practical experiments, and the results show the usefulness of the optimal mode to the UWB system design.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for 4-D Sources Parameters Estimation of Near-Field Based on Polarization Sensitive Array
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the estimation of 4-D parameters (carrier frequency, azimuth, range, and polarization) in near-field narrowband sources, a new method based on fourth-order cumulant was presented, which used a polarization sensitive array and the multiple-rotational invariance to estimate 4-D parameters of sources. Without spectral peak searching or parameter pairing, the method can be applied to additive Gaussian noise environments. Furthermore, this method can reduce the loss of array aperture effectively by using a non-centro-symmetric array. The effectiveness is verified by the computer simulations.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on The Determinants of Sales and Conversion Rate of Online Auction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the factors which affect the sales and conversion rate (the proportion which visits convert to sales) of online auction and proposed the assumptions based on previous literature study. A Logistic model and a multiple regression model are built to analyze every factor's contribution to the probability of successful transaction and conversion rate. The results show that the probability of successful transaction and conversion rate between different kinds of products indeed exist a significant difference. Some products' visits can increase its probability of being purchased. And for the other products, many visitors visit these products for the purpose of information searching and lead to high visits but low probability of successful transaction. The most influential factor which affects conversion rate is sellers' reputation. And price is found to have negative effect on the conversion rate.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation on Genetic Ant Colony Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the routing design of the wireless sensor networks, how to balance the energy consumption of the entire network to extend the life span throughout the network is a key issue. Based on the genetic ant colony algorithm, this paper proposed a design of the energy-saving, clustered routing protocol. Considering of the energy situations of the nodes, their relative positions and the energy load balancing of the whole network, this protocol makes overall clustering of the network, utilizes the distributed computing and the global path optimization of the genetic ant algorithm to realize the minimum energy consumption and the extending of the network survival time.

articleTitle: A Differential Evolutionary Based Algorithm for Multiuser OFDMA System Adaptive Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the problems of radio resource allocation for Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) systems are addressed. The main goal of this paper is to present and analyze base station allocation of subcarriers and adaptive modulation. We impose a set of proportional fairness constraints to assure that each user can achieve a required data rate. Since the optimal solution to the fairness problem is extremely computationally complex to obtain, we propose an adaptive radio resource allocation method based on differential evolutionary algorithm for multiuser OFDMA system. The performance of the described schemes is further evaluated in numerical experiments. We improve the convergence of the differential evolutionary algorithm through the method of elitist selection and adding some individuals with 'good' genes to the initial population. Simulation results show that out proposed algorithm better than static subcarrier allocation schemes TDMA in multiuser OFDMA system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms for Solving Multiobjective Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of many evolutionary algorithms for solving multiobjective optimization problems. Four main kinds of multiobjective algorithms (GA, PSO, SA, and AC) have been presented, and their merits and demerits are compared and discussed respectively. Finally, a mix algorithm is suggested as an effective method.

articleTitle: Closed-Form SINR Distributions for OFDMA Cellular System using Fixed Relays
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we derived closed-form expressions for the SINR distributions in OFDMA cellular system using fixed relays. First of all, the intercell interference at the BS and the RS are characterized and it is found that the intercell interference power is successfully modeled as the average of it. From the interference power modeling, the pdfs of SINRs for the four uplink cases are analyzed. The analytical results are verified from computer simulations. The analytical results can be applied to evaluate various aspect of OFDMA cellular systems using fixed relays such as the average system capacity, the average system capacity for a specific region, the outage probability for a given QOS and so on.

articleTitle: An Algorithm Designing for a DRM System Based on P2P
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A DRM system based on P2P whose certificate and digital production can both transmitted among users is presented to solve the bottle-neck problem of the usual system. We make the digital production transmitted quicker and the digital right of the production can be saved in security at the same time. The security proof of the system is given at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: On an Integrated RAM Aware Enterprise Process Control System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Among many phases in an enterprise process lifecycle, it is typically over process executions that various delays, sometimes even total loss of control, become inevitable. We propose key concepts and process models of an integrated enterprise process control system aiming at rectifying the common pitfalls. While preserving great simplicity and acceptability, the system integrates the Responsibility Assignment Matrix (RAM) directly into its key functional components, including work flow management, issue tracking, quality gating, document control, and access privilege management, so as to present actual process execution steps visually and insightfully to every member in all scopes in accordance with corresponding privilege assignments. Real world deployment examples demonstrate the system capability of improving enterprise process control effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Real Estate Financial Risk Prevention and Countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Fluctuations, as a property of the real estate economy, are bound to make an impact on the financial system, leading to great financial risks, and even to a financial crisis, if not under proper control or management. This paper probes into the cause and reasons for financial risks based on the analysis on loan risks involved in real estate development and mortgage risks related to housing purchase; this thesis also makes suggestions regarding policies whose purpose is to prevent financial risks.

articleTitle: A Scheduling Model Based on Communication Task Deadline for Wireless Industrial Control System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The wireless channel can influence the design of industrial applications. A majority of existing scheduling models of industry control network are designed without considering the characteristic of wireless technology. They face serious degradations in wireless industrial applications. This paper uses a secondary architecture of dual-band and presents a scheduling mechanism based on communication task deadline for wireless industrial control system. Thus the adverse effect on real-time and reliability, caused by transmission errors and other problems of the wireless channel, can be (partially) compensated.

articleTitle: Production Point Optimization with Service Level Constraints
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An optimizing model for studying production- inventory policy with service level constraints is proposed. To realize the integrative decision of service level and production point, the service level in a supply chain is defined as the probability of satisfying product demand in each planning period. Inventory variation under stochastic demand is analyzed, and the average inventory in each planning period is invited into the decision model. The planning outputs in each period are stochastic variables having the same distribution with the product demand. A numerical analysis is given to validate the approach.

articleTitle: E-Government to Combat Corruption in the Asia Pacific Region
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The introduction of ICT can reduce corruption by improving the enforcement of rules, lessening the discretion of officials, and increasing transparency. Yet, while ICT eliminates many opportunities for corruption for those who do not understand the new technology fully, it opens up new corruption vistas for those who understand the new systems well enough to manipulate them. Proper safeguards are needed. In addition, ICT specialists and public managers need to work together to ensure that e-government systems are coordinated with other reform processes, including business process re-engineering. The paper will examine the experience of Asia-Pacific countries in this area.

articleTitle: Effects of Stock Price Volatility on Listed Companies' Financing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the new risk asset pricing theory, individual stock price volatility can increase investors' required return, so it can affect the company's cost of equity capital. This study investigates the effect of stock price volatility on listed companies' financing behavior in China, and finds that the listed companies' stock price volatility has obvious effect on its financing decision; and the stock price volatility has different effects on financing behavior of companies with different size.

articleTitle: A Case Study Based on the Dynamic Balanced Scorecard in Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The balanced scorecard has become a very popular concept with the potential to improve organizational performance and an important innovation in almost all countries around the world .In order to make the bsc an apt model for predicting future financial results, the time delay problem must be considered. Due to balanced scorecard static nature, managers may be failed to select a strategy correctly confronting environmental changes. This paper aims to devise dynamics balanced scorecard a more advanced managed tool than bsc appropriate for the manufacturing industry by introducing the system dynamics concept with a focus on the effect of casual relations and taking into account the impact of time lag. According to the current situation of enterprise and the external environmental changes, managers can select an appropriate strategy and find out an effective strategy. Dynamic balanced scorecard models offer managers a dynamic management tool for selecting a right strategy. Finally we find out financial performance and customer satisfaction can be affected enormously by considering time lag.

articleTitle: Extending Wireless Network Simulators to Support Realistic Simulations of 802.11 MANETs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is shown in this paper how wireless network simulators should be extended to enable the realistic evaluation of link quality prediction algorithms for 802.11 MANETs. These extensions are a novel broadband small-scale fading model, bit/packet error modeling using this model with the Moment Generating Function of and the use of spatial correlation in the stochastic large-scale fading model. We justify and detail the extensions made. We evaluate three Link Quality Prediction algorithms from the literature by performing measurements and simulations. We conclude that the extensions made enable the accurate simulation of link quality prediction algorithms which has hitherto been deficient.

articleTitle: The Construction of a Real-Time WIP Exception Monitoring System for Semiconductor Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The agreement of due dates is the need for customer satisfaction, which is a critical factor to survive in today's highly competitive market for Semiconductor industry. However, undesirable and inevitable production variations make it difficult to maintain and improve factory's performance on due dates, especially for those back-end factories closer to customers. We, therefore, propose a WIP management model to help production managers effectively manage work-in-process (WIP) levels to compensate the impact of unexpected production variations and to achieve better due-date performance. This model includes the exception identification, detection, correction and root cause finding. A software package, Vigilance, is employed to construct real-time WIP exception management system. It is constructed to detect WIP exceptions, notify pertinent recipients and track exception resolution. Simulation experiments are conducted to evaluate the proposed exception management system. WIP correction action curtails the back-to-normal duration and prolongs the duration between two successive WIP exceptions. Therefore it provides better on time delivery and reduces the occurrences of WIP exceptions under proper Acceptable WIP deviation levels (AWDL) settings.

articleTitle: Research on the Classification of E-Government Information Resources by Categories-Theme Integrating
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Classification of government information resources is an important prerequisite of carrying on information exchange and carrying out information resource-sharing. This paper expounds the categories principle and the method and some domestic and international typical classification of information resources at first, Then on this basis, according to the characteristic and link degree analyze the adaptability between traditional classification and the classification for information resources of government affairs, and we can see that it needs classification to combine with theme law to draw the ideal categories method of information resources of government affairs from this, and then has made an introduction to analyze from such respects as the feasibility, basic principle and integrated mode, etc. in setting up the categories-theme integrated system.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Multicast Routing for Discrete Power Levels in Ad Hoc Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the energy efficient multicast problem for discrete power levels in ad hoc sensor wireless networks. The problem of our concern is: given n nodes and each node v has l(v) transmission power levels and a multicast request (s, D), how to find a multicast tree rooted at s and spanning all destinations in D such that the total energy cost of the multicast tree is minimized. This problem is NP-hard. We propose a NWMDST algorithm which has a theoretical guaranteed approximation performance ratio, and two efficient heuristics MNJT and g-D-MIP for multicast tree problem. Simulation results have shown efficiency of our proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: PAPR Analysis in OFDM Signals Based on Power Variance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The relationship among the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), aperiodic autocorrelation co-efficient and power variance (PV) is discussed. We show that low values of PV do not always correspond to low values of PAPR as has been mentioned in literature. Hence PV cannot be used as a basis for comparison and measure of PAPR for OFDM signals. Further through simulations we assert that PV can be a good criterion for high values for PAPR, while for the moderate ones it might fail. Finally, we show that PV based comparison in SLM and PTS techniques gives degraded PAPR performance compared to the actual PAPR based comparison.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Cooperative Linear System of Equations Protocol and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Privacy-preserving cooperative linear system of equations problem is an important scientific computation and widely used in many areas such as banking, manufacturing, and telecommunications. In this paper, we present a new privacy- preserving cooperative linear system of equations protocol under the semi-honest mode, which is more efficient as compared with existing schemes. The security of the newly devised protocol is also examined. Privacy-preserving cooperative linear system of equations protocol can be used to solve many privacy preserving scientific computation problems. As an example, a secure privacy-preserving polynomial interpolation protocol is developed based on the newly devised privacy-preserving cooperative linear system of equations protocol.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Enhanced CCK Modulation Under Multi-User Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Complementary codes are used in IEEE802.11b/g WLAN standard. For contention free operation with two or more users, the current CCK modulation can be enhanced by orthogonal Ear ZCZ sequence E(L,M,Z<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CZ</sub>) to provide contention free connectivity. In this paper, we simulate multi-user WLAN based on ZCZ modified CCK modulation for 11 Mbps data rate. Performance is analyzed to see the effect of zero correlation zone length (Z<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CZ</sub>) in Ear ZCZ sequence under two condition - (A) Length of Ear ZCZ sequence is fixed (B) Number of users are fixed. Simulation results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Timing and Carrier Synchronization for Burst -Mode MPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Timing and carrier synchronization methods for burst- mode MPSK signals are proposed. The improved timing recovery method performs well at low SNR. A low-complexity carrier synchronization method based on FFT is proposed, which has a wide range of carrier acquiration even at low SNR.

articleTitle: Study on Mass Customization for Knowledge Production and its Cost Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the mass customization for manufacturing, the mass customization for knowledge production is put forward with high-speeding development of network technology, and it has been studied fundamentally. This study focus on the cost of mass customization for knowledge production, as it is the chiefly problem to be considered for the knowledge production enterprises to get maximal profits. Firstly, the basic thought of the mass customization mode for knowledge production is introduced, and its operation mode is analyzed. Then, the related characteristics are discussed, where the stochastic and dynamic features are pointed out, and the objectives and constraints are explained. Subsequently, the cost model is set up based on the former analysis. Finally, the meaning of the mathematical model is analyzed.

articleTitle: The Applied Research of Convolutional Turbo Code Based on WiMAX Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because most practical communication systems need possessing higher bandwidth efficiency, this article increases the bandwidth efficiency through the two aspects of code rate and modulation mode, that is, by combining CTC(convolutional turbo code) in WiMax protocol with MSK modulation and applying them in the practical communication systems. The simulation result shows the combination of CTC and MSK modulation possesses not only a stronger error correcting capability but also a higher bandwidth efficiency, i.e. , it's more applicable in the practical communication systems.

articleTitle: An Improved Time Synchronization Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Time synchronization is an essential problem for wireless sensor networks (WSNs). The synchronization algorithms presented in were based on the constant-rate clock model, thus could not compensate the clock drift. In this paper, based on the more reasonable bound-drift clock model and, we propose an improved time synchronization algorithm of and. In the algorithm, we develop a new method to estimate and compensate the clock drift and the clock offset. Mathematical analyses and simulations are presented in this paper, and verify the effectiveness of our synchronization algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of Model-Based Code Automatic Generation of Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Model-based development environments aim to provide designers with a more systematic approach to development of management systems by using a particular design method, which can be used to generate all kinds of programming code from entity-relationship scheme automatically. This paper main introduces its system architecture, code generation model, the main technique and algorithms adopted. It can generate interaction system's source code automatically.

articleTitle: Development of an Evaluation System Software for Manufacturing Green Product Based on B/S&C/S Mode Combined
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently green manufacturing has received more and more concerns from the entire world as a model with potential of continuous development. Manufacturing green product (MGP) is a product that can satisfy consumer, enterprise, environment and society. Its lifecycle is being characterized by its obvious technicality, economization and circumstance-friendliness. Evaluation of MGP is the prerequisite for carrying on green manufacturing effectively, making decisions in developing new green products and optimizing design process. Based on the system-required analysis, we herein provide an overall design scheme for MGP evaluation system which utilizes mixed mode of B/S&C/S. Our work lays emphases on the design concept, system function, the workflow of system and the design of database & knowledge. Moreover, evaluation system of MGP has been developed by utilizing visual programming language Visual Basic2005 and senior mathematics operation tool Matlab7.0, and taking the Access database as a connecting bridge. This software system may effectively complete the evaluation of MGP.

articleTitle: Employee Satisfaction as an Important Tool in Human Resources Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this competitive business world, only the companies with satisfied customers can make a great deal of profit. What can make your customer satisfied? The answer is obviously: your product and service. But, excellent products/service are also produced and designed by your employee. So employee is the most important and valuable resources to corporation management. This study introduces a new method which is called as employee satisfaction management to conduct human resources management. The paper constructs a causal model which considers the impact of employee perceived value on employee satisfaction, as well as the impact of employee satisfaction, affective commitment and continuance commitment on employee loyalty. This method will help companies allocate their scarce resources efficiently, and make their employee enjoyable, and then bring more satisfied customers.

articleTitle: The Study on Rough Set Theory for Customers Churn
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to compress or reduce redundant features in customers churn, the rough set theory is introduced and a feature reduction algorithm based on the rough set is proposed. An example in customers churn is given to validate the algorithm. The results show that when the customers churn classification result is almost invariable, the main features which are more important to the churn classification can be searched by this algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Knowledge Worker Value Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge worker is a key factor in the innovation and enterprise competence. The evaluation of their value, which is a basis of many human resource management functions, is very important for the enterprise to manage the knowledge worker effectively. But the knowledge worker value is dynamic, connotative and multidimensional, which makes it difficult to evaluate accurately. Rough set theory, which is widely used in classification, appraisal and mode identification, has many advantages, such as no information loss, flexible, extendable, is involved in this paper. The evaluation approach is also expatiated. To test the reliability of evaluation, a case is used, which improve that rough set theory can be used in evaluation of knowledge worker value.

articleTitle: Tacit Knowledge Management in Automobile R&D Process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Starting with the introduction of the background of tacit knowledge management, this paper analyzes its meaning for automobile enterprises, discusses the essence of tacit knowledge management, and then studies the tacit knowledge run through the automobile R&D process. Based on the tacit knowledge management mechanism, this paper puts forward the tacit knowledge management model and proposes the implementation methods of tacit knowledge management in automobile R&D process. To a certain extent, this paper expands the span and depth of the application of knowledge management in automobile R&D process.

articleTitle: Study on Time Distributing of Strategic Decision-Making Process and Influence Factors About Speed of Strategic Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The first generation of time-based competition has represented the competitive advantages which has already become a necessary condition for the companies' survival nowadays, because the benefits of reducing delivery time is very limited. Meyer put forward the second-generation TBC, namely that enterprise must make decision rapidly and change strategic direction quickly. To achieve the rapidness (zero time) in response to customers' demand, the rapid strategic decision is a necessary condition for its realization. In this paper, we firstly investigated the distribution of time cost in strategic decision-making process by the empirical studies, which shows that strategic decision-making time mostly distribute to intelligence activities and design activities, but it contributes less to the choice activities. Secondly, this article has summed up the influencing factors of the speed for strategic decision-making, based on the summarizing of the correlation research. Finally, based on the full considering of these factors, this paper also put forward some measures to compress the time cost in information and designing activities.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Motivation Sources for Technological Innovation of Chinese Information Service Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Inadequate motivation is the crux of low technological innovation level and low effect for Chinese information service enterprises, while to accurately identify the motivation sources for technological innovation of information service enterprises is the premise of resolving the problem of inadequate innovation motivation. Based the empirical study relating to the motivation of Chinese information service enterprises for technological innovation and through the Factor Analysis, the Paper observed that the technological innovation of information service enterprises include five factors of motivation source: leadership of government and enterprise, corporate value and culture, interest pursuit, market environment and technological promotion. With the variance analysis, the Paper also compared the differences of these factors in terms of enterprise type and property nature. Finally, the Paper presented the countermeasures and suggestions for improving the inadequate motivation of Chinese information service enterprises for technological innovation.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Based Research on Energy Efficient Residence Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
