Based on general performance evaluation measurement, draws a frame of evaluation from perspective of BSC, and selects the indicators which are used in three hiberarchies. Finally a scheme of salary distribution is given.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management Issues in Professional Service Firm SMEs in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyses how small and medium size(SMEs) professional service firms(PSFs), face the human resource management(HRM) issues. These issues will, however, be of paramount importance for service firms as they rely solely on "human capital" as their only source of production. The intention is to focus on the issues of a human resources(HR) nature and to consider how these act as growth barriers. In this study, thirteen human resource managers were interviewed. Results show that some western HR practices are in evidence, and the HR issues become the growth barriers for PSFs. To resolve these issues, this paper puts forward measures.

articleTitle: Design of 36MHz CMOS Amplifier in the DTV Tuners
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A 36 MHz intermediate frequency amplifier (IFAMP) is designed using Chartered 0.35 um CMOS technology. The nonlinear characteristic of IFAMP is analyzed, and the technology of leading compensation and miller capacitance compensation is adopted. The circuit simulation tool is ELDORF which provided by Mentor Graphics. Simulation results show that IFAMP has greater than 28 dB gain, low noise figure (about 1.3 dB at 36 MHz). Furthermore, it can reduce the harmonic distortion efficiently and enhance the dynamic range of input signal.

articleTitle: The Study on Energy Performance Management Project Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy performance contracting is an energy saving investment mode which using saving cost of energy to pay the cost of energy saving project. The general evaluating methods are unable to evaluate objectively the managerial elastic and strategic value existing in projects while evaluating the energy saving projects, thus the real value of projects can't be reflected. In the light of this problem, the paper provides the evaluation principle of the energy performance contracting project which based on B-S model, by analyzing the uncertainty of the energy performance contracting project, at the same time, analyze the influence factors of option value in B-S model, and provides a new thinking and quantitative analyzing method for the investment evaluation of the energy performance contracting project under the uncertain environment.

articleTitle: Model of Monitoring Management for Dynamic Evaluation on Large-Scale Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The main thesis of this project is on dynamic monitoring, analysis and evaluation of large-scale projects to provide a 3-dimensional project evaluation and effective basis for investment decisions for government from nationwide to different industries. This paper presents a dynamic monitoring and evaluation system architecture, and model on comprehensive evaluation and management applications for large-scale projects. It also designs an adjustable dynamic management model based on the 3-dimensional model for different evaluations.

articleTitle: The Raise of Innovative Enterprise's Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The entrepreneurship is the important motive power for enterprise innovation and the important supporting force for launching enterprise innovation activities. This paper analyses the meaning and characteristics of the entrepreneurship, and combining with this, we analyses the existing problems in the process of entrepreneurship's cultivation, and puts forward some ways for innovative enterprise to raise the entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: The Research on the Reasonable Radius of the Network Alliance Cooperation Product in Manufactory Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the type analysis of manufacturing network alliance, this paper proposes that the manufacturing enterprise network alliance has a reasonable radius for cooperation production, and this is quite different from other kinds of alliance or mixed enterprise network alliance. When the reasonable radius is beyond the threshold, the partners' contribution to the alliance cooperation production will be zero. This paper constructs the decision-making model of the reasonable radius of manufacturing enterprises network alliance in production and gives the corresponding process and steps of analysis, providing reference for the determination of reasonable radius of the manufacturing enterprise networks alliance in cooperation production.

articleTitle: Reducing the Peak to Average Power Ration of OFDM System using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new phasing scheme to achieve the lowest peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of OFDM system is presented in this paper, which is based on a global optimization combination of the initial phases using particle swarm optimization (PSO). The particle swarm optimization is applied to search the optimal combination of phase factors, which can achieve the OFDM signals with low PAPR and reduce the computational complexity significantly. To validate the analytical results, some simulations have been conducted, showing that the proposed schemes can achieve the lowest PAPR with low computational complexity.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Reed-Solomon Decoder in Broadband Wireless Access
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the broadband wireless access technology which is applied in WMAN. And the design of Reed-Solomon (RS (255, 239)) in IEEE802.16a/d FEC based on time-domain Berlekamp-Massey (BM) algorithm is implemented. In this decoder pipeline architecture is adopted. Furthermore, finite-field constant multipliers and specially the time-division- multiplex structure used for key equation solution are referred, which reduce the bulk of circuit and simplify the hardware architecture. The RS decoder has been synthesized with Design Compiler and 0.25 mum CMOS technology and the implementation result shows a scale of 24581 gates. The circuit can detect and correct at most 8 byte errors for each data frame under the demanded working frequency of 30 MHz, which meets the performance required on QAM demodulation chip.

articleTitle: Multi-Incentive Model Between the Project Manager and the Real Estate Enterprise Based on Principal-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on analysis of principal-agent relationship between the real estate enterprise and the project manager, this paper establishes multiple incentive principal-agent model which encompasses many factors. It also illustrates the necessity of offering material incentive and nonmaterial incentive for the project managers, and analyzes effort of project manager ability, effort level, exogenous random variable and its impact extent on incentive-reward strength coefficient under condition of information asymmetry. For conclusion the paper indicates essential considering factors for designing project manager incentive mechanism of the real estate enterprise.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Collapse of E-Commerce Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the structure theory of collapse, applying swarm simulation method, this article studies the. COM companies (websites) quantity changes in e-commerce system which is deemed as a business ecosystem. The simulation repeated actually the e-commerce ecosystem collapse process. It consequently summarizes the key factors which affects the healthy development of e-commerce ecosystems and provides guiding theory and strategy recommendations for the development of similar new industries.

articleTitle: Blind Channel Estimation Based on Adaptive Noise Subspace Estimation in WPT-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because noise subspace estimation for blind channel estimation can't achieve a good trade-off between convergence speed and steady-state error, and an ambiguous complex coefficient exists between estimated and actual channel impulse response. In this paper, we propose a blind channel estimation algorithm based on noise subspace estimation algorithm with adaptive variable step-size and ambiguous complex coefficient identification technique to resolve these problems. In the meantime, combined with the advantages of wavelet packet orthogonality, we propose an algorithm of blind channel estimation based on noise subspace in multi-carrier CDMA with wavelet packet modulation (WPT-CDMA) system. The results of simulation show good channel estimation performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Independent Innovation Capability of Chinese Enterprises Based on Patent Statistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The independent innovation capability of enterprises plays a crucial role in the development process of enterprises and the country. By analyzing the key components and the embodiment forms of enterprises' independent innovation capability, this paper indicates that patents and Intellectual Property rights are two important forms which can reflect enterprises' independent innovation capability directly. On this basis, from the aspect of the relationship between patents and independent innovation capability of enterprises, and through the comparisons of patent application situation of China domestic and overseas applicants, it comes to the conclusions that currently the independent intellectual property of Chinese enterprises is weak, and the enterprises' consciousness of IP rights, especially of the invention patents still has to be strengthened. Finally The paper proposes several approaches for China domestic enterprises to implement independent innovation by taking advantage of patents, aiming to suggest a feasible way for Chinese enterprises to adapt to and participate in the international business competition nowadays.

articleTitle: Interactive Investment-Distribution Decision Model for Multi-Regional Project Considering Preference Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the reformation of project investment and finance system, multi-regional investment project, which is of great investment, long construction cycle, complex influence factors and so on, needs distribution investment among benefited regions. In view of investment-distribution decision problems, this paper introduces some concepts such as optimal expectation level, tolerating limitation, relative deviation value and relative deviation tolerating level and so on, sets up an interactive investment-distribution decision model and gets the solution by the construction of assistant model. The model takes into consider of not only the impact of investment projects on every region but also the economic development degree of regions. Furthermore, it combines preference information of decision maker with distribution result, and owns easy interactive process and low computational complexity. A numerical analysis confirms that the investment-distribution results are easily accepted by all regions.

articleTitle: Managing Cycle Quality Chain Operation and Optimizing Cost
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper builds up a network-topology model of cycle quality chain based on improved supply chain operational reference (SCOR) model, realizing cycle operation by an added quality process of reverse manufacturing. Defines the concept of cycle quality chain management , and analyzes its cost subjects in network structure according to positive and reverse quality processes. All the quality processes are connected by acceptable probability, so the optimized goal function is described as a fuzzy multi-object function comprising maximum of the total profit of quality chain and maximum of the recycling efficiency. The effects of different quality policies on fuzzy rules are compared, and a hybrid genetic algorithm is introduced.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Independent Innovation Ability of SMEs Based on Neuro-Fuzzy Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Enhancing the ability of autonomous innovation for medium-and-small enterprises have the important strategic sense to upgrade the competitiveness of enterprises. Establishing an effective evaluation system and model can provide a theoretical basis and analytical tools for medium-and-small enterprises to understand the current situation and problems. So, in this paper, neuro-fuzzy decision tree (neuro-FDT) is introduced to the research on the independable innovation enterprises . Fuzzy decision trees are powerful, top-down, hierarchical search methodology to extract human interpretable classification rules. However, they are very poor in classification accuracy. Neural networks-fuzzy decision tree improves FDT's classification accuracy and extracts more accuracy human interpretable classification rules. The fuzzy rules enable a decision-maker to decide the independable innovation ability of enterprises. Comparing with the conventional methods, the mathematical model of neuro-fuzzy decision tree can be easily established by fully utilizing the information of enterprises. The result of the positive research indicated that this mathematical model is very valid for independable innovation ability evaluation and it will have a good application prospect in this area.

articleTitle: Research of Dynamic Routing Algorithm Based on Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research work of dynamic routing based on traffic engineering is investigated firstly and a new routing algorithm with bandwidth guaranteed is introduced for MPLS networks. It is characterized by taking into account network topology, traffic distribution condition and available bandwidth of links. In this algorithm traffic engineering objective can be translated into path constraint, which combines link saturation and link criticality. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is prior to some traditional methods in optimizing network resource distribution.

articleTitle: Mining Core Group from Network Community: An Empirical Study on DONEWS Based on SNA and Informetrics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mining core group from a network community is significant for researches on information communication, since the core group impacts greatly on information controlling and information producing in network community. In this paper, we have an empirical study on DONEWS, and our approach to find out the core group involves the following considerations. First, the circumstances of internal link and external link are considered for the influence of the components in and out of the community. Second, the co-link of components is analyzed to give an objective sight on the relationship of the bloggers. Besides, the inter-link between each Blogger is mined to find out the interaction between Bloggers and the acceptance by other Bloggers. This paper mines the core group of DONEWS from various aspects and the conclusion is adoptable.

articleTitle: MR Mesh: A Multi-Radio Wireless Mesh Network Testbed
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless mesh networks (WMNs) are expected to be one of the next generation of wireless interconnection technologies. As to fully exploit the advantage of WMNs, a lot of research work has been done, e.g. new routing protocols, metrics, multiradio/multichannel WMNs, etc. In this paper we present a multiradio WMN testbed (called MR mesh) which was designed with purpose to study different routing protocols, metrics and channel selection/assignment algorithms or other strategies. MR mesh implements mesh functionality upon multiple 802.11 based wireless network cards. It is flexible to support different routing protocols, metrics, easy to implement channel assignment or radio selection algorithms, and simple to experiment network organization/management strategies.

articleTitle: Development of Mould Based on Internet Distributed and Shared Resources
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cooperative mould work in different places under internet environment is constructed on the basis of Web technology, cooperative work theory, network database, networked CAD/CAM technology; together with the analysis of the actual needs of the mould manufacturing enterprise, the development and design of B/S structural mode can be realized. The article focuses on the major issues to be solved in Internet distributed resources-sharing mould development and the plans to realize its functions. Only with the support of servers, the clients can interact by relying on Web browser such as Explorer and the main purpose is to share information, resources and experience across systems, regions and departments through inter-links, to facilitate the information query, experience sharing and cooperative work of the designers, thus speeding up the development, reducing the costs of mould development and design and increasing the operational efficiency of the enterprise.

articleTitle: The Factors Influencing Chinese Online Shopper's Satisfaction Based on Virtual Community
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on 327 data from three universities and five virtual communities in China, this study investigated factors affecting customer satisfaction of Chinese online shoppers based on virtual community. A SEM model was used. 8 hypotheses among the total 11 hypotheses in SEM model were confirmed in the final. Results show three main findings: (a) Chinese online shoppers are facing "information overload", and recommender system becomes an important factor influencing customer satisfaction of online shopping in China; (b) Logistic is a special factor influencing customer satisfaction in China; (c) a strong positive relationship exists between virtual community satisfaction and overall satisfaction.

articleTitle: A Cluster Based Adaptive Low Power MAC Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel cluster based adaptive MAC protocol for wireless sensor networks (WSN) is proposed, which is based on clustering network topology. In the proposed MAC protocol, sensor nodes can adjust the duty cycle freely according to traffic information collected by cluster head node. Meanwhile, by exploiting cross-layer routing information, sensor nodes can reduce the active period if no data need to send in a cycle, so the protocol can achieve both low energy consumption and low latency at different traffic. Simulation results based on ns-2 show that the proposed MAC protocol achieves significant performance improvements in energy efficiency, latency and delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Strategy and Endowment Effects of k-ZI Strategy in Continuous Double Auction Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is easy to understand that the strategy and the endowment will affect a trader's profit in a continuous double auction (CDA) market by qualitative analysis, but it is hard by quantitative analysis. This paper quantitatively analyzes the strategy effect, the endowment effect, and the interaction between them in computerized CDA markets with k-ZI agents.

articleTitle: Research on QoS Multicast Routing Optimization Algorithm Based on Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on QoS constraints such as delay, delay jitter, bandwidth and packet loss metrics this paper describes a network model suitable for investigating the routing problem and presents a multicast routing algorithm with multiple QoS constraints based on GA and TS hybrid strategy. This algorithm takes advantage of GA and TS and overcomes the shortcomings of GA used in solving the multicast routing problem with multiple QoS constraints-poor climbing ability and immature convergence. Simulation results show that the algorithm is an effective approach to the problem of multicast routing decision with multiple QoS constraints.

articleTitle: Building a Business Intelligence Application with Oracle e-Business Suits 12
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Business intelligence application used by an enterprise is an effective option to inform and guide your decision making to keep your products and services competitive. Oracle e-business suits 12 provides the tools used for data consolidation, data analysis and enterprise reporting, they are integrated and available from one vendor, it's true that companies deploying Oracle e-business suits 12 are armed for success. This paper systematically analyzes these phases in building a business intelligence application with oracle e-business suits 12.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Customer Loyalty of Commercial Banking Industry Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this article, an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) approach is described and applied to a fuzzy synthetic evaluation on customer loyalty of commercial banking industries. Results of the AHP show that the customer loyalty coefficient of certain commercial banking enterprise is within the "very promising" range. In addition, the results also show that repeat purchase intention, referral intention, partiality for enterprises are the three main factors among all the fifteen third indexes which influence customer loyalty, and the factor of perception in service quality is the key factor that should be improved as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Constructing a Pure-Software-Based Sanctuary for Mobile Agents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a software-only approach, based on garbled circuit, to solve the challenging problem: protecting mobile agents against tampering attempts by the executing hosts, and keeping the computation privacy. Our goal is to achieve "non-interactive computing with encrypted mobile code" in certain case, and proves that it is possible to protect mobile agent with no use oft any tamper resistant hardware.

articleTitle: The Harmonious Development between China's Foreign Trade and Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper aims to show the necessity of environmental protection in trade, and importance of China's foreign trade in recent years. It discusses the problems that exist between environmental protection and foreign trade. Furthermore, this paper solves the problems in the way of circular economy. As we know, there are some consistencies between them, but there are more discrepancies, such problems as the internalization of environmental costs, green barriers to export trade and so on. Therefore, in allusion to these problems, our country should find a suitable solution to the harmonious development between them. Exactly, circular economy is an effective way to achieve the sustainable development.

articleTitle: A Novel Agent-Based Model for Search in Distributed Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we models autonomous adaptive agents after several ecological concepts and mechanisms. We have concentrated on developing an agent-based model for controlling query messages that are represented as agent; the Ecologically Inspired Distributed Search (EIDS), which derives its inspiration from natural ecosystem, is presented.. As an experiment result, we compare its performance against the well-known k-random walker approach. We focus on the problem of actively changing the topology of the P2P network by utilizing Schelling's segregation model to improve the efficiency of search.

articleTitle: User Knowledge Requirement Model and its Generation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to describe the knowledge requirement of the user is the precondition of knowledge management. Aiming at the problem, user knowledge requirement model is proposed combining business process with characteristics of the user in the paper. The related information of the task, the related tasks and personal information are considered in the user knowledge requirement model. Knowledge requirement model is classified into three levels, which are task knowledge requirement, business knowledge requirement and user knowledge requirement. The user knowledge requirement generation algorithm can generate the user knowledge requirement based on the user knowledge requirement model. The experiments show that the user knowledge requirement model and its generation can have a better effect in generating useful knowledge to the user.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Receiver Combining QR and PIC Based on MIMO Frequency Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper extends and modifies MIMO QR algorithm to the frequency selective channel. A combining QR and PIC detection scheme was proposed. The performance of algorithm is evaluated based on computer simulation. Simulation results states that the performance of MIMO detection algorithms in frequency selective channel is better than the performance in narrowband channel, and the scheme has advantage over ZF-VBLAST in complexity and signal processing delay.

articleTitle: Money Shock and Chinese Economic Fluctuations:1996-2005
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper constructs a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model which incorporates money by MIU (Money-in-the-Utility Function) approach, and applies it to Chinese business cycle model analysis from 1996 to 2005. The comparison of simulation results and actual data implies that the model can reflect economic fluctuations. Quantitative analysis demonstrates that technology shock and money shock contribute to more than 90% of Chinese Economic Fluctuations, and DSGE model is an ideal framework for Chinese monetary policy analysis. The paper also suggests to incorporate the sticky price property and fiscal policy to explain the economy better.

articleTitle: Combination Forecasting Model of Project Cost Based on SPSS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cost estimation plays a significant role in bidding. However, the construction project cost does not remain constant for it is always influenced by various factors. On the basis of three kinds of usual forecasting models and SPSS software, this paper established a combination forecasting model to estimate the cost. The error check results indicated that the model does well in making an accurate forecasting.

articleTitle: An Initial Value Optimization Least Square Constant Modulus Algorithm for CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An initial value optimization least square constant modulus algorithm (IVO-LSCMA) is presented in this paper. The initial value of IVO-LSCMA is calculated by using the eigenvectors in the signal subspace and it is obtained by the iteration search approach to maximize the SINR(signal to interference plus noise ratio). The noise capture problem of LSCMA when the initial value is selected randomly can be solved by the IVO-LSCMA. It is shown that the IVO-LSCMA can achieve superior detection performance and fast convergence rate and it is also shown more robust performance than the LSCMA when the initial value is selected randomly. Moreover, the effect of the parameter to the algorithm is analyzed.

articleTitle: Agent Risk Evaluation in Agent-Construction System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As one of the significant reform methods to improve the management level of government investment project, agent-construction system has been applied in many places. During the process of agent construction, agent assumes considerable risk. This paper identifies the main risks of agent. Based on the analytic hierarchy process method, the main risk and relative influence factors are analyzed and evaluated. The importance degree order of main risks and relative influence factors are put forward. The research of this paper can be referred by risk management engineers in agent-construction projects.

articleTitle: Assessing the Application Value of Knowledge in the Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the prevalence and development of knowledge management, enterprises today endeavor to explore better approaches to manage their knowledge assets. Knowledge assessment is an important instrument for effective knowledge management. Because knowledge is inherently difficult to assess, we do not measure knowledge directly in this paper, but assess its application value shown in the business process. A knowledge application value assessment approach based on social network analysis is proposed. Two aspects are involved in the assessment approach: knowledge workers' power and their recognition on knowledge items in a business field. Here, knowledge workers' power in a business field is estimated through social network analysis. To validate this approach, an experiment is performed on a knowledge sharing platform which is set up upon Google Group. The result is reasonable and provides an important understanding of the availability of knowledge items.

articleTitle: On Workers Protection Policy in China Service Economy Boost
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The service economy in China has a weak foundation, late start, but its development has been relatively fast. By contrast, China labor rights in the service economy boost is constantly being eroded. The author advances the NGO monitoring model, which contains four elements and two mechanisms, that could solve the problem we raised above.

articleTitle: A Task-Based Modeling Method for Process Modeling and Automation in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By introducing "best practices" as standard process models, business process standardization and reengineering have assisted in achieving the efficiency of the project development. However, they have also resulted in many problems because a standard model has limited flexibility to suit different practices of different projects. This paper presents a Task-Based Modeling method (TBM) for modeling processes in project management. Key business tasks are defined as the basic task components. Supplementing each task with an execution method and detailed attributes, its action can be fully defined and its outcome can be measured. A business process model can then be created to meet the need of the particular business by using the task components as the basic building blocks. A request-driven approach is also proposed to instantiate an instance of a process model. A purchasing process is used as an example to illustrate the presented methodology.

articleTitle: The Value of Downstream Information Sharing on Upstream Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider a make-to-order supply chain consisting of a single upstream (one manufacture) and downstream (n retailers) which are engaged in Curnot competition and have some private information of demand. Under our assumption, we investigated the value of sharing the demand information of downstream on upstream supply chain. The results showed upstream (the manufacturer) always can get a non-negative value from information sharing, and this value will be increased by share information from more retailers. But the profits of the retailers always worse off by disclosing their demand information to the manufacturer.

articleTitle: Research of Buyer-Supplier Relationship Based on Agent Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Alliances bring firms some advantages. A good and stable buyer-supplier relationship is crucial in a firm alliance. In this study, we develop an agent-based model to study how the myopic behavior of retailer in a distributed supply chain affects the whole supply chain alliance. We investigate the effect of firm's myopic behavior both in stable and dynamic environment including competition for price and orders. Simulation results show that the retailer's myopic behavior reduces the revenue remarkably both in stable and dynamic environment. When market has more competitors the retailer should maintain the long-term relationship even further. The order's lead-time affects the relationship differently in long-term contract and short-term contract.

articleTitle: MCMC Estimation of SVDJ Model with Jump Risk
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the authors propose a new stochastic model, SVDJ model which has allowed for jump risk, to describe the dynamics behavior of spot exchange rate, and develop a MCMC (Markov chain Monte Carlo) method for the estimation of parameters, jumps, and volatility. Our empirical results indicate the significant existence of jumps in exchange rate process, and the incorporation of jump risk in exchange rate process is important for RMB forwards pricing.

articleTitle: Blind Multi-User Detection for DS-CDMA Based on FastICA
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to asynchronism of the sampling process and the transmission of the symbols, the original symbol can be estimated by use of the original symbol and the symbols around. The feedback multi-user DS-CDMA model that also had been existed was improved. The DS-CDMA blind source was seperated step by step, used the FastICA algorithm. The algorithm converges after iterates about 15 times. The result of the experiment proves that, this system can examine the user symbol more accurately, has lower miss rate, the method has been proposed is clearly better than MMSE and MF in the aspect of system energy control.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Relationship in China Excellence Performance Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the bases of both the GB/T19580-2004: Criteria for Excellence Performance of China, published by the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine of the People's Republic of China in 2004, and survey data from China Association for Quality (CAQ), this paper systematically study the relationships among 'leadership', 'strategy planning', 'customer and market', 'information, analysis and improvement', 'resources management', 'process management', and 'performance results' by using structural equations modeling. This quantitative analysis provides a guideline for organizations to identify causal linkage among core value of total quality management and to identify strengths, weakness, and opportunities to enhance competitiveness and ensure the future business success.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Management Model of Job Satisfaction Based on Fit Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on a survey, this article made an empirical study on the determinants of job satisfaction from the angle of fit theory. The article mainly analyzed the extent to which job satisfaction might be determined by the person-organization fit, person-job fit and its sub-concept. The article also compared the result with related results. Finally, a satisfaction model based on the fit theory was established.

articleTitle: A New Low-Power High Frequency CMOS Quadrature LC-VCO
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new circuit topology for quadrature voltage- controlled oscillator (QVCO) is presented and demonstrated on a 4.5-GHz CMOS differential oscillator. In the proposed circuit two identical negative-resistance oscillators are coupled to each other via diode, in such a way that quadrature differential signals are generated with low voltage and low power. The QVCO has a phase noise of-113.8 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset while dissipating 2.5 mA from a 0.8-V supply, which corresponds to a FOM of-183.8 dB.

articleTitle: On Differential Rating for Containerized Cargo of Different Weight in Liner Service
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Freight-all-kind system is widely employed in container liner service. Therefore, loading of too many containers stuffed with heavy goods at certain port(s) will probably impair the fully using of loading capacity of the carrying vessel at other(s) resulting in full but not complete loading. In this paper, according to the principles and forms of container liner rating and freight structure and calculation, the fact is proved that differential rating for containers of different weight can maximize lines' profits. Relevant models with maximum profits as objects are constructed and operating data of a Chinese container line are analyzed as a real example, in which factors affecting differential rating tactics are also comprehensively considered through assumption of fuzzy factors. In the differential rating tactics explored in this paper, the feasibility of lines' performance of such tactic and the degree of effect thereof on lines' profits are clarified.

articleTitle: Research on Planning Model of Logistics Nodes in Strategic Supply Chain Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper builds up the planning model of logistics nodes for strategic supply chain by applying the theory of complex network. A practical mathematical modeling framework has been further suggested, which is expected to focus on some significant aspects of network design problems, including the relocation of existing nodes through capacity transfers to new locations, integration of inventory, transportation and supply decisions, the availability of a given budget for investments in node location and relocation, and the generic structure of the supply chain network - while so far little attention has been received in the existing literatures. In this respect, this paper also analyzed capacity expansion and reduction scenarios as well as modular capacity shifts, which can be easily incorporated into the planning model of logistics nodes for strategic supply chain discussed here. This research aims to be of importance for future research on the planning of strategic supply chain.

articleTitle: An Improved Codebook Design for Precoding in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the analysis of preceding principle in MIMO-OFDM system, an improved codebook design method is presented in this paper. Combing direct quantization method and Householder matrix, the proposed schemes has a better tradeoff performance than traditional quantization method. Simulation result s also shows a better performance than traditional method especially in 3 and 4 transmit antennas.

articleTitle: Time Scorecard: An Integrative Performance Measurement Framework for Time-Based Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Time-based competition (TBC) has received much attention in the literature and in industry. With time being the most important competitive factor, many companies take time-based strategy (TBS) to gain competitive advantage and long-term competitiveness. New strategy needs urgently new strategy management tool-performance measurement system to manage the implement of the TBS. So the balance scorecard (BSC), as a traditional strategy management tool, should also evolve with the change of competitive environment and company's strategy. While rigorous research has been conducted in relation to the TBC and performance measurement systems, little research has been done regarding application of performance measurement systems to manage TBS. The purpose of this paper is to present an integrative performance measurement framework for time-based companies. The contemporary performance measurement frameworks are reviewed, mainly including BSC. In addition, since time is of human essence and a better understanding of the nature of time helps enhance managerial effectives, the dimensions of time for TBC is then discussed. Critical success factors(CSFs) of time-based companies are presented. According to the dimensions of time and CSFs of time-based companies, a time scorecard (TSC) is developed and a theoretical model for using the TSC to manage time effectively is put forward. The TSC helps implement TBS on six perspectives (financial, customer, internal process, learning, supplier and leadership) from three interrelated aspects (including vertical time, negative time and zero time) in two dimensions of time(vertical time and horizontal time). The TSC presented in this paper is not only a conceptual model, but also a measurement model. Furthermore, this approach has the potential to give a deeper understanding of which areas should be monitor in the time-based companies and help companies to develop, cascade and implement the ZT strategy. Finally, since the cause-and-effect relationship exists in these six perspectives and in the three aspects of time, an organization can research the true reason through the vertical and horizontal analysis if the any item has deviation.

articleTitle: State Predication Control of Discrete Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents a state predication controller design method to compensate time-delay in discrete networked control systems (NCS). We apply multi-step prediction to current state of the system based on the object prediction model and the measured state values to compensate the stochastic time-delay of NCS. Furthermore, with respect to the case of networked inducing delay and data package loss, the presented method can improve the performance of NCS too. At last, the simulation results validate the given design method.

articleTitle: PIC Receiver for MIMO MC-CDMA Systems Based on LCRLSCMA
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Parallel interference canceller (PIC) is a powerful algorithm to combat multi-user interference (MUI). In this paper, a PIC receiver for space-time block coded multiple input multiple output multi-carrier code division multiple access (STBC MIMO MC-CDMA) based on linearly constraint recursive least squares constant modulus algorithm (LCRLSCMA) is studied. Simulations indicate that the proposed algorithm has better BER performance than the traditional algorithms among different environments.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Electric Plant Construction Projects Using an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The electric plant construction projects evaluation is a complex, multi-factor, multi-index decision-making problem. In order to evaluate the construction projects scientifically and accurately, this paper proposes the evaluating model based on the adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS). The ANFIS avoids the fuzziness characteristic of the projects information itself and the circumstances of the neural network cannot express the fuzzy language. The evaluation of 10 electric plant construction projects in National Electric Company shows that the emulation results given by this model are effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis of Utility of Employee's Quality of Working Life and Assessment Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quality of working life (QWL) is one of the important content for human resources management. Based on the comments towards the research on the quality of working life, its concept is redefined from the perspective of experienced utility. According to the degree of conspicuousness of the experienced items, five utility factors of the quality of working life are put forward. It also analyzes the characteristics of isoutility curve of QWL and establishes the utility assessment model of quality of working life, which consists of expected utility level of utility factors, satisfaction level and weighting value.

articleTitle: Optimal Selection of FGD Technology Using ACA-Based Rough Set Theory and VIKOR
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sulfur in coal is converted to sulfur dioxide during combustion. SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is a precursor to acid rain which is one of the most widespread forms of pollution worldwide. To minimize the adverse impacts of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions on the environment, many flue gas desulphurization (FGD) systems have been developed over the past few decades for the control and abatement of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions by coal-fired boilers of industrial processes and power plants. However, how to select the optimum FGD system is one of essential problems facing many decision-makers. Since traditional methods have limitations in disposing deficient and noisy data, the past studies yielded in objectivity and accuracy for evaluation. In this study, the hybrid system of rough sets based on ant colony algorithm (ACA-RSs) and VIKOR algorithm was employed to dispose the problem of optimal selection, in which rough sets were used for simplifying the process of by eliminating the redundant data and determining the attributes' weighs. However, many studies have showed that attributes reduction which is the core problem in rough set theory research is NP problem. We employed ACA to solve this problem. Then, VIKOR algorithm is applied to solve the multi-criteria decision-making problem. At last the effectiveness of our approach was verified by testing the hybrid system with an example.

articleTitle: A Study of Cooperative Diversity Scheme in Ultra-Wideband System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel system based on cooperative distributed space-time block code (DSTBC)and multi-band orthogonal frequency division multiple (MB-OFDM) is proposed which works well on multiple single-antenna users wireless networks in ultra-wideband system. In this system, using MB-OFDM technology modulate data to subcarriers, can resist the influence of frequency selective fading channel effectively. Over cooperative diversity scheme based on DSTBC-MB-OFDM, a theoretical bit error rate (BER) performance expression of the system has been derived. Also its closed-form expression is derived by means of the moment generating function (MGF). Monte Carlo simulation results are given to demonstrate the BER performance of DSTBC-MB-OFDM outgoes non-cooperative MB-OFDM with distinctive gains.

articleTitle: Corporate Bond Yield Curve Estimation using Parametric Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although lots of literature has been discussed on the estimation of government bond yield curve, not much has been discussed on how to derive interest rate yield curve for corporate bonds. This paper first reviews the interest rate yield curve estimation methods and then discusses the probability of applying a parametric yield curve estimation approach to corporate bonds. Based on the perception of corporate bonds, it's believed that it would be better to jointly estimate the government bonds yield curve and the corporate spread other than directly applying the approximation methods to corporate bonds. A practicable procedure to estimate the corporate yield curve is then described. After that, I use the described procedure and UK market data to calculate the corporate yield curves for the last trading days of each month in 2007.

articleTitle: Qos Architecture for Leo Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes the complete QoS (quality of service) architecture for integration of LEO satellite with infrastructure networks. The technology, service differentiation mechanisms, network control mechanisms and user-to-networks mechanisms are discussed. The modules required in the network elements and its integration to provide end-to-end QoS in LEO satellite networks are presented. The proposed solution is based on the Diffserv architecture with some extensions to provide L2 differentiation for four traffic classes and supports the integration with infrastructure networks. The deployed hierarchical architecture guarantees scalability and make possible per-flow resource management in satellite access where scarce radio resources should be managed effectively, and per-aggregate traffic management using a DiffServ model in the core.

articleTitle: Peak Identification of Communication Signal Using Wavelet Packet Transform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a novel method for peak identification of communication signal. Using wavelet packet transform (WPT), the feature points of peak on frequency domain can be detected efficiently. The simulation results have shown that the normalized mean estimation error (NMME) of feature point position is less than 6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> when signal-noise-ratio (SNR) is higher than 5 dB. Furthermore, our method is superior to those of conventional methods based on derivatives.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Structure of Teachers' Organizational Commitment in China: Confirmatory Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Real-time Communication Based on MMS+TCP/IP+ Ethernet for Embedded CNC
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networked CNC (computer numerical control) system is the foundation for realizing automation, intelligent and globalization of manufacturing. The transparent model, real-time and deterministic communication of industrial Ethernet is urgently needed. The communication platform based on Manufacturing Message Specification (MMS), TCP/IP and Ethernet is the trend of the next industrial automation communication system. This paper put forward a reference model based on MMS+TCP/IP+Ethernet to achieve the real-time seamlessly data exchange for CNC in distributed environment. The networked CNC is constructed by main control board based on ARM microcontroller, motion controller (based DSP and CPLD), real-time OS of RTLinux and user graphic interface of MiniGUI. After analyzed the effect factors of real-time communication performance, the key technologies of the platform were discussed, such as communication tasks priority of Ethernet, TCP/IP protocol over Ethernet, real-time network communication models and event-driven scheduling. Finally, and the network experimental results are shown and discussed.

articleTitle: Decision Support System for Traffic Emergency Dispatch Operations on Expressway
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Incident is a serious problem of great concern for traffic management department on expressway, and the decision support systems (DSS) can be used to improve the quality of the traffic emergency dispatch operations. Based on the demand analysis of DSS for expressway traffic emergency rescue, the architecture, service function, model base and database are designed. The model and data integrated in the DSS base are used to minimize emergency dispatching time. The proposed DSS provides much functionality, such as location of service point, optimum allocation of rescue resources and dispatching methods. According to decision requirement of incidents, the opportunity- based rescue resource dispatching method is used. By establishing the opportunity cost-based dispatching model, "Scene Decomposition Method" is proposed to put the model into simplification and solution, and is demonstrated successfully by digital simulation. The research findings could not only provide the design scheme for developing the proposed DSS in China, but also supply the supporting of theory, technique and development environment.

articleTitle: Key Factors for the Selection of Logistics Service Provider in a Closed-Loop Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: From implementing a closed-loop supply chain, companies can generate more value and profits. However, closed- loop supply chains add complexity to overall supply chain management. It is a feasible way for companies to outsource all or part of logistics to third-party providers. The selection of a proper provider, which suits the needs of the outsourcing company, is not an easy task. The complexity of this task increases with an increase in the number of selection criteria. This paper focuses on the key factors for the selection of logistics service provider according to the different types of logistic outsourcing partnership. Based on the scope dimension analysis, the partnership is classified into three different types: transactional, strategic, and transformational. They are analyzed based on transaction cost theory, resource-based theory and resource dependence theory respectively. For different type of logistics outsourcing partnership, the key factors for the selection of third- party providers are different.

articleTitle: An Efficient Convolutional Code Information Recovery Scheme in DVB-S
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In DVB-S receive system, the decoder applies ergodic principle to auto-recover the convolutional code information. The general method makes decision by packet sync byte, and the recovery time is excessively long. An efficient recovery scheme is proposed to reduce the time: taking advantage of the property of "Secondary Encode", applying the decision-mechanism with confidence value and adopting finite state machine structure, and the reliability of the recovery process is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Treasury Bond Marketing and E-Retailing: Similarities and Pricing Lessons
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we first draw an analogy between the short- selling practice (i.e., strategies betting on price decrease over time) of bonds marketing and Internet retailers' lower-price-but-Ionger-waiting practice. As a market convention, bond prices peak when the issuance is still in preparation, and drop when actually issued and when the liquidity quickly dries out. Such a convention was once exploited by some practitioners to squeeze others. Squeezing occurs when a trader intentionally builds up a large position in a sought- after bond to keep it from being available to the rest of the market, thereby controlling the availability of the bond and influencing its price to the trader's advantage. Similarly, survey results suggested that, although timely delivery has been deemed a key indicator of perceived service quality, online customers have been underserved in that aspect. We model the underlying reason of significant late- delivery as e-tailers having been short-selling consumer electronics futures. We provided three examples to figure out the reason of delayed delivery from Internet retailers; and we generalize the three products in our examples to three classes of consumer electronics products for broader application. We believe that there are important preventive lessons to be learned from the bond squeeze to e-tailing delivery issues (actually the information asymmetry issue in disguise). Further research may provide useful insights for online consumers and their protection agencies; and for rental companies to better their pricing and sourcing strategies.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Multi-Agent System Negotiation Strategy and Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The communication between agents has some special requirements. One of them is asynchronous communication. Used communication sequence process (CSP) to descript a model of agents communication with shared buffer channel. The essence of this model is very suitable for the multi-agents communication, so it is a base for our next step job. Based on the communication model, explored the distributed tasks dealing method among joint intention agents and with description of relation between tasks we give a figure of agents' organization. Agents communicate with each other in this kind of organization. The semantics of agent communication is another emphasis in this paper. With the detailed description of agents' communication process, given a general agent automated negotiation protocol based on speech act theory in MAS, then we use CSP to verify this protocol has properties of safety and live ness, so prove it is logic right. At last a frame of this protocol's realization was given.

articleTitle: A Method for Improving the TCP Fairness in Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless ad hoc networks, fair allocation of bandwidth among different TCP flows is one of the critical problems that affect the performance of the entire system. This paper proposes a fairness mechanism - Adaptive_Pause. Adaptive_Pause is a simple and distributed scheme that only needs little communication and processing overhead. Each node monitors the occupation of the channel due to its emissions and dynamically determines whether it should pause a time interval in order to avoid channel capture. Comparing to other passive schemes in which a node limits its transmission when it receives congestion indication from its neighbors, the proposed scheme is more effective and requires less overhead. Simulation result validated our analysis result and gave the optimal parameter setting. Both analytic and simulation results show that Adaptive_Pause scheme can improve the TCP fairness.

articleTitle: A Web Services-Based Distributed Information Retrieval Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: XML Web services' distributed computing model allows applications to communicate with each other, regardless of where or how they are implemented. Thus, Web services-based distributed systems technology facilitates the development of distributed, service-oriented information retrieval system over the heterogeneous Internet. This paper presents a Web services- based model for information retrieval across different platforms. The network topology structure, service calling process, task allocating and load balancing as well as time-threshold setting are described. The characteristics of the model are briefly addressed.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination Mechanism of Mobile Service Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the backbone of Chinese mobile commerce value chain, we constructed a two-level mobile service supply chain composed of one mobile network operator and one content provider. Different from the traditional supply chain, the mobile service supply chain has its unique characteristics. This research studies the coordination mechanism of the mobile services supply chain, and establishes and analyzes a model of revenue sharing contract. We prove that under certain conditions, the revenue sharing contract can achieve the maximization of expected profit and coordination of mobile services supply chain.

articleTitle: Parametric Stereo Implementation in DRM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Parametric stereo is a state-of-the-art stereo coding method. It can efficiently encode a stereo audio signal into two parts including a monaural signal and small amount of stereo parameters. In this paper, the implementation of parametric stereo in digital radio mondial (DRM) system is presented. And the difference between parametric stereo in DRM and MPEG-4 is also discussed. Using parametric stereo, the efficiency of the audio encoder with scalable bit rate in DRM transmitter can be significantly improved. Experiment results indicate more than 33% of the total bit rate can be reduced while the audio quality maintains the same.

articleTitle: Stability for a Linear Time-Invariant System with Time-Periodic Inputs and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper researches a base for a judgment of stability control for a class of linear time-invariant systems with time-periodic inputs. By dynamic theory and methods, it is proved that in certain parameter region, for arbitrary time-periodic input, the system has a unique periodic solution attracting any bounded set exponentially. As an application, stability for a model of the forest with seasonal effects is studied.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between China's Excess Liquidity and Asset Prices
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Accompanied by increasing foreign exchanges and double-surplus balance-of-payments, China's excess liquidity and its effects on asset prices have recently attracted considerable attention. The indicators of growth rate of money (credit) to growth rate of GDP ratio could dispel seasonal influence. According to VAR model, Granger causality tests and cointegration tests reveal that there are no relationships between excess liquidity and equity prices, but there are weak relationships between excess liquidity and house prices. Therefore, it won't be useful to cut down the excess liquidity so as to squeeze equity price bubble; China should attach importance to real estate bubble and avoid its negative effects to the whole economy.

articleTitle: A Method of Identifying Cheaters in Secret Sharing Schemes Based on Signcryption
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We improve the signcryption SCS2 proposed by Zheng Y to satisfy public verifiability and forward security simultaneously. Using this improved scheme, a new method of identifying cheaters in secret sharing schemes is proposed. With the method, a private channel is not necessary between the Dealer and each participant, and anyone can verify the authenticity of the share released by any participant during reconstructing the secret.

articleTitle: Model Checking Alternating-Time Temporal Logics of Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A wireless security protocol can be modeled as a Kripke structure M. The model checking problem for a logic L is: given a formula phiisinL decide if phi holds in the states of M. The alternating time temporal logic (ATL) is expanded and the alternating time temporal logics of knowledge is considered. We propose an efficient algorithm to model-check ATL of knowledge properties.

articleTitle: Weighted Joint Inter Prediction Algorithm of Stereo Video Encoding
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a weighted joint prediction mode is proposed. It not only compares the motion prediction and disparity prediction, but also compares the motion prediction, disparity prediction and the weighted joint prediction. Then, the prediction mode which leads the least prediction distortion is chosen as inter prediction. Experimental results show that the proposed encoding scheme can solve the problem that motion prediction and disparity contribute differently in different area, even different block of the same area, and can improve the stereo video encoding performance.

articleTitle: Evolution Model of Scientific and Technical Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research on evolution law of scientific and technical innovation is significant for China to build innovation-oriented country. An evolution model of scientific and technical innovation is established according to the research from the perspective of system, evolution and case demonstration. This model contains innovation stage, innovation form, innovation mission, development trend of innovation and the relation among them. The essential characteristics of innovation stage and innovation form are discussed in this paper. The differences among scientific discovery, technical invention and technical innovation are elucidated. The development trend of innovation is pointed out as follows: cutting down the time interval of innovation, propelling innovation by large projects, multidisciplinary cross, and superposition of innovation stages.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship Between Corporate Ownership Structure and Quality of Accounting Information of China's Listed Companies in the Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of Chinese capital market in the last 18 years, recently the quality of accounting information of listed companies, which is crucial for the sustainable improvement of the capital market efficiency, has become the focus issue to investors, scholars and government. The main purpose of this paper is to test and explore the relationship between corporate ownership structure and quality of accounting information of China's listed companies. This paper extends earlier research with focusing on a particular industry, the manufacturing industry. This study uses 32 listed companies in the manufacture industry punished by China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) for their financial statement fraud (FSF) during 2002 and 2006, and employs the method of descriptive statistical analysis, correlate analysis and logistic regression analysis, in which the total assets are used as the control variable, to examine the relationship. The results indicate that the higher the proportion of state owned shares and the lower the proportion of tradable shares, the more likely FSF to happen. This study also finds that FSF is even more frequent for companies with State Assets Management Bureau as the biggest shareholder.

articleTitle: Enhanced Channel Estimation Method for DRM Receiver
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper the channel estimation methods are investigated for DRM system. Enhanced channel estimation algorithm adaptable for DRM based on Wiener interpolation is developed. The presented Wiener filter interpolation algorithm simplifies the system by composing the two-dimension filter into two one-dimension filter. Performance comparison of the proposed algorithm with the windowed DFT is also presented. Simulation and results show that Wiener interpolation algorithm outgoes the windowed DFT algorithm and Wiener filter algorithm can well fulfill the requirement of DRM systems.

articleTitle: Quality Improvements in Supply Chains and Impact on Shelf Space Allocations
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers a supply chain system with two competing manufacturers and a single retailer. Each manufacturer produces only one product. These two products are close substitutable. The market demand of each product is based on the difference of quality levels of products and shelf space of each product. The analysis shows that the retailer's optimal strategy for shelf space allocation satisfies that the ratio of products' respective shelf space is equal to the ratio of products' revenues. We study three scenarios in the supply chain. In the scenario of no quality improvement, we investigate relations of shelf spaces and market demands with the intrinsic demands, margin profits and elasticity of shelf space. In the scenario of one-side quality improvement, we show that, as the intrinsic demand increases, both the optimal levels of quality improvement and the corresponding shelf space increase. In the scenario of simultaneous quality improvement, the main results indicate that, as the responsiveness of market demand to the difference of quality levels or the elasticity of shelf space increases, the intensity of quality competition increases and the manufacturers adopt higher quality levels. The retailer and the manufacturer with a cost advantage in quality improvement will benefit from quality competition, however, the manufacturer with a cost disadvantage in quality improvement and the whole supply chain will lose. The consumers always benefit from quality competition.

articleTitle: Hybrid ARQ Scheme Using BCH Codes and Adaptive Decoding
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a Type-II flexible Hybrid ARQ (HARQ) scheme using half-rate invertible BCH codes is proposed and analyzed. According to the new scheme, the received frames which contains the same information bits are first combined according to Averaged Diversity Combining (ADC), then the parity frames attempts to recover the information frames by inversion operation. The BCH hybrid decoding is performed if the inversion fails. Hybrid decoder performs both hard and soft decoding in a single core and makes good tradeoffs between complexity and performance. Both theoretic analysis and numeric simulation are shown at the end.

articleTitle: Quality Incentive Mechanism Design of Construction Project: Quality Rank-Order Tournaments Model and Optimal Prizes Allocation in the Parallel Contracting Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the parallel contracting mode with characteristics of single client and several contractors in construction phase, quality rank-order tournaments is analyzed whether it can incentive contractors to improve quality or not from the angle of client by applying the correlation theory and technique of Game theory and Economics of Information. Quality rank-order tournaments game model is established, the optimal allocation of prizes is studied when the contractors' cost functions are convex. The result shows that in different conditions different optimal allocation of prizes should be adopted such as single prize or several positive prizes, furthermore, the optimal structure of prizes when several prizes are adopted is given.

articleTitle: Coverage Rates for Adaptive Array
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents three kinds of coverage rates, including the averaged coverage rate, the interference conditional coverage rate and the signal conditional coverage rate, to evaluate the performance of adaptive arrays. The coverage rate is the probability of the reception of the desired signal against certain interference scenarios. Numerical results demonstrate that coverage rates can describe the performance of adaptive arrays more comprehensively than other measures such as the array output signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio and the interference loss. A brief discussion on hardware measurements and measurement errors shows the usefulness of coverage rates in practice.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Entrepreneurial Intention in Transition Environment: Toward an Entrepreneurial Self-Efficacy Based Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Entrepreneurial development has been viewed as a driving force for the successful transition from planned to market economies. Based on social cognition and self-efficacy theory, this study proposes an entrepreneurial self-efficacy based model of entrepreneurial intention. The model presents the complex interaction among entrepreneurs' individual characteristics, transition environment, entrepreneurial self-efficacy and entrepreneurial intention. And it also shows that entrepreneurial self-efficacy has direct and mediating impact on entrepreneurial intention. This model contributes to better understand and have implications for entrepreneurial practice in countries undergoing the difficult process of transition to a market economy.

articleTitle: The Base Band Design for UHF RFID Reader Based on Nios II
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: RFID is now attracting many interests for its bright future in commercial and daily use. The paper introduces a base band design of UHF RFID reader, which is compatible with EPC Class-1, Generation-2 Standard. The base band contains AD, DA, modulator, demodulator, code, decode, control unit. The Nios II-based control unit achieves rapid, flexible and efficient verification and development.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Audit Model of Quality Assurance System for Network-Based Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conception of electronic audit on quality management and assurance system was brought forward for the first time. Not only the design thought was analysed and the total network and electronic structure was given, but also the visual networked auditing system of quality management and assurance system was developed by applying Web service technology, module technology and audio-video network correspondence technology, which has solved the entire process of authentication and surveillance audit among different districts and industries by Internet and electronic-platform, therefore has ensured the quality system's effective running and persistent improvement.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis of Innovative Capabilities in Universities' Academic Teams Based on Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on knowledge management perspective, this paper discusses knowledge management process in universities' academic team, and SWOT analysis of innovative capabilities in universities' academic teams in accordance with the internal strengths and weaknesses as well as the opportunities and face the external threat in universities' academic team, the best strategic option is, create learning-academic team, optimize the internal organizational structure in academic team, create an open academic team culture.

articleTitle: Application of Probability Rough set on Product Quality Decision
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
