The simulation illustrates that the proposed methods are effective in the lunar rover positioning and navigation.

articleTitle: A Fast Algorithm for Fractional Fourier Transform with Zooming-in Ability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel algorithm for FRFT with zooming-in ability, which is preferable to previous algorithms because it can freely choose computational resolution and zoom in on any interested portion of the fractional spectra, meanwhile, retains the advantage of the Ozaktas algorithm in computational speed. Its advantages in scrutinizing the fine structure of the partial spectra and improving estimation accuracy of chirp central frequency are illustrated by an application example.

articleTitle: ID-Based Signature Under the Schnorr Signature
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An ID-based signature scheme under the Schnorr signature system is proposed in this paper. Compare with the Schnorr signature, the one-way hash function is used so it is more secure. The performance analysis shows that our scheme's computation requirement is low because there are only two modular exponentiations in the signature generation, and in the signature verification phases respectively. It is simple and easy to implement.

articleTitle: Study on Financial Risk Pre-Warning of Combined Heat and Power Corporate
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: CHP (combined heat and power) corporates not only can economize energy source, but also can integrate the benefits of increasing the quality of heating supply. So CHP developed rapidly after reformation in China, especially after promulgating the Law of the People's Republic of China on conserving energy. However analysis and pre-warning about the financial risks of CHP is not found in present literature. This paper first established an financial risk index system after analyzing the characteristics of CHP corporates' financial risks. Then this paper gave an financial risk pre-warning model which was established based on set pair analysis (SPA) theory. At last, the paper gave an empirical study in order to verify the financial risk pre-warning model's feasibility in CHP corporates.

articleTitle: From Prime Codes to Quadratic Prime Codes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: From concatenation view, this paper analyzed the relationship between quadratic prime codes and prime codes. It is concluded that quadratic prime codes can be constructed by concatenating the time-shift or frequency-shift versions of prime codes sequences. Based on this analysis, two new further thoughts are deduced to construct more families of frequency hopping sequences with same properties as that of quadratic prime codes. One is by exchanging the two components of the sequence number and corresponding prime codes sequences; the other is by multiplying the time-shift step pair by integers s={2,3,hellip,P-1}.

articleTitle: Research on Contractor Selection of Telecommunication Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper summarizes the contractor selection criteria and performs an in-depth analysis about the risk of contractor selection. It constructs an evaluation system which can reduce the risks and improve the maneuverability under consideration of the characteristics of telecommunication project. Finally it applies the evaluation system to a specific project from a manufacturing company in telecommunication industry.

articleTitle: Model Research on Reforming of Chinese Agricultural Economic Growth Way
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Adopting Cobb-Douglas production function model and Lucas model to analyze traditional and modern agricultural economy, obtaining that a modern agricultural economy with investment in human capital has more advantages than the traditional agriculture relying mainly on land and labor resources, therefore, we should push forward the change of agricultural economic growth way of China. The results show that in a long-term balanced growth path, agricultural output growth at a constant speed, agricultural resources no longer constrain farmers' income, traditional agriculture in the rural labor force with the increase of farmers in the history of declining output will no longer exist. In the modern agricultural economy, farmers in the agricultural production process can use advanced agricultural technology, through improving seed varieties, fertilizers and pesticides to improve the quality of advanced agricultural machinery and equipment to improve the use of essential agricultural production levels, thereby promoting scientific progress in agriculture.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The IDS Model Adapt to Load Characteristic under IPv6/4 Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of RAGABP ANN Based on AM-MCMC in Water Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The quality evaluation is a main matter in evaluation, conservancy and protection of water resources; it can provide scientific advice for protect and cure water resources deterioration and formulate water resources management plan. So water quality evaluation can also give guidance to sustain water utilization and to build a water-saving society. Back Propagation Artificial Neural Net based on Real coded Accelerating Genetic Algorithm and Markov Chain Monte Carlo which based on Adaptive Metropolis was used to evaluation water quality. RAGA was used to optimize topology, initialize weights and bias of BP; MCMC was adopted to produce enough simulated samples for training BP net and to consider fuzziness between adjacent grades of water quality. Adaptive Metropolis method was taken as a sampling method to improve sampling efficiency of MCMC. Results of study cases show RAGABP based on AM-MCMC improve convergence velocity more 20% than standard BP, and evaluation results of RAGABP are more objective, reasonable than that of single indicator method. Further more, the RAGABP based on AM-MCMC can be used to evaluate flood disaster loss, earthquake disaster loss and so on.

articleTitle: The Research on Distributed Adaptive Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The automated categorization of documents into predefined labels has received an ever-increased attention for the exponential growth of documents on the Internet and the emergent need to organize them in the recent years. K-nearest neighbors is a widely used classifier in text categorization community because of its simplicity and efficiency among all these classifiers. However, K-nearest neighbor classification (KNNC) still suffers from inductive biases or model misfits that result from its assumptions, such as the presumption that training data are evenly distributed among all categories. In this paper, a new refinement strategy (DBKNNC) for the KNN classifier is proposed, which adopts sum-of-squared-error criterion to adaptively select the contributing part from these neighbors and classifies the input document in term of the disturbance degree which it brings to the kernel densities of these selected neighbors. DBKNNC is not sensitive to the parameter k and achieves significant classification performance improvement on imbalanced corpora according to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Geometric Evaluation Method of Human Resources Under the Mode of Reservoir Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The value of human resources is initiative and environment-dependent, the collaborative way of reservoir management makes the work of individual human resources evaluation more difficult, on the base of analysis the characteristic and the special requirements of human resources evaluation under the mode of reservoir management, integrate the evaluation of individual and the team, analysis the relationship of the value impact factors, turn the evaluation of individual human resources into the calculation of a pyramid's volume, educe the evaluation model, also discuss the determination of the parameters in the model.

articleTitle: A New Quality-Driven QoS Control Method for AMR-WB in VoIP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The quality of service (QoS) limitation of Internet is major challenge for Voice over IP (VoIP). Delay jitter and packet loss are two essential problems which impair the communication quality. Conventional quality- driven QoS control methods usually use ITU-T E-Model to maximize the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) in terms of delay and loss. However, all these methods are devised only for narrowband speech codec and only suitable for random loss. The aim of this paper is to propose a new quality-driven QoS control method for AMR-WB (a wideband speech codec) in bursty loss condition. Experimental results show that the perceived speech quality is improved with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the Capacity of Ad Hoc Networks Based on Euclidean Minimum Spanning Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The network capacity is a focus of current research on wireless ad hoc networks, and the study of capacity concentrates on two facets: one is how to increase networks capacity by using different methods and new technologies; another is to derive bounds of networks capacity with different transmission models proposed via several suppositions. Under the protocol models and physical models of communication proposed by Gupta and Kumar, we study the capacity of ad hoc networks based on Euclidean Minimum Spanning Tree (EMST), and derive the theory result of unicast and multicast capacity. We show that the multicast capacity of wireless ad hoc networks based on EMST is O(radic(n)) larger than the unicast capacity, when the group size n is small compared to the total number of nodes N in the network Finally, we verify that the upper bound is valid in simulations based on NS-2.

articleTitle: The Disruption Management in Duopoly Market With Differentiated Goods
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we consider a problem relating to a supply chain disruption management in the quantity-setting duopoly situation with differentiated productions. The market scale may lead to changes of the production quantity and retail price. We draw a conclusion that the manufacturers will increase their profits if they are able to adjust their production quantity and the retail prices in a proper manner. However the channels' profit is considered in our analysis.

articleTitle: A Three-Stage Model of Industrial Cluster and an Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the distinctions and connections among industrial cluster, industrial agglomeration and enterprise cluster, and indicates that they are three stages in the process of industrial cluster formation and evolution. Then the thesis offers a three-stage model and an empirical analysis of industrial cluster in Dalian accordingly.

articleTitle: Spreading Behaviors on the Power-Law Growth Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper discusses the dynamics of the epidemic spreading behaviors for susceptible-infected-recovery (SIR) model on the power-law growth networks, characterized by variable value for exponent 7. We give the general generated algorithm for power-law growth networks, analyze the dynamics behavior for SIR model in complex networks, and introduce the interaction Markov chains mean-field equations as well as the stochastic numerical approach to examine the threshold (steady state) and time-independent behavior for the epidemic model on such network. We have done the simulation both for the BA networks and power-law growth networks. Analytical methods and simulated experiments show there exhibits a critical threshold for the pow-law growth networks below which it cannot diffuse in such type of the system. Meanwhile, results shows the stochastic numerical approach (SNA) can save memory and get the fast exploration, compared to the Monte Carlo calculations.

articleTitle: The Effect of Patent Activity on Technical Change
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An aggregate production function of the generalized Fechner-Thurstone (GFT) form is used to analyze the impact of patent activity, on technical change in China for the period 1985- 2005. Patents should alter isoquant maps, and measuring their elasticities is both intuitively and empirically appealing. We define a technology-changer as a variable that has an impact on the elasticity of the marginal rate of technical substitution (MRTS) between inputs of the GFT production function over time. It is found that total patent applications have significant impacts on the rates at which inputs are substituted for each other over time in production.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Reliable Broadcast/Multicast MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve the efficiency and flexibility of reliable broadcast/multicast MAC protocol in wireless multi-hop network, a novel adaptive reliable broadcast/multicast MAC protocol (ARBMAC) is brought forward. The core idea of it is based on the broadcast/multicast cost function, which is proposed by analyzing different realizations of reliable broadcast/multicast. According to the function, the most efficient realization in different scenes can be found. Thus, the protocol could select adaptively the optimal realization for every broadcast/multicast packet in various scenarios. Extensive analysis and simulation results validate the reliability and efficiency of ARBMAC.

articleTitle: Study on the Performance Evaluation and Weight of Knowledge Management Based on Value-Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using the thought of the value -chain to represent the valuable activities of information management, also importing the concept of the important contribution of the knowledge activity , thus lays the foundation on the theory for the performance prism to evaluate information management, pointing out the framework of the performance prism. Point out the concrete indices of every panel. Calculate the weight of every index with the approach of the level, which is favorable to next appraisal research.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Execution Path Selection Approach for Composite Services in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service composition is a hot research topic in Web Service and a particularly important way to exhibit the advantages of nodes' cooperation in MANETs. Service execution is critical for service composition in MANETs, but there is less research focusing on this topic. In this paper, we explore the problem of service execution path selection approach for composite service in MANETs. Then we propose a heuristic and dynamic approach for service execution path selection. The simulation results show that the execution path selection approach we propose is much more efficient than the existing one and it is more close to the theoretical optimal execution path selection approach.

articleTitle: An Optimal Interpretation for Traffic Network Flow Parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we first give the representation for traffic network, and introduce the relationship between the volume delay functions and the traffic flow parameters of the existing network. After analyze and discuss the traffic network flow parameters, and present an optimal interpretation for traffic network and the flow parameters are simulated. The simulation results fit with the network parameter and the observation and choose the satisfied scenario.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Based on Laplacian Speech Modeling and Unscented Kalman Filtering
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Considering nonlinear and non-Gaussian speech signals, a novel speech enhancement algorithm is proposed based on Laplacian speech modeling and unscented Kalman filtering (UKF) using a single microphone. The probability density function (PDF) of speech signals in the time domain is better modeled by a Laplacian rather than a Gaussian density by analyzing statistical property for clean speech signals. So in this paper the PDF of clean speech signals is assumed to Laplacian density and the PDF of noise are modeled by Gaussian distributions. Speech enhancement algorithm based on UKF is used to solve non-linear property for speech signals. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm possesses good performance both in objective and subjective tests with colored noise and white noise presenting.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis on New Products Potential Profits
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: New products potential profits prediction is a quite difficult task involving a lot of factors such as market construct, pricing strategy and technique capacity performance. The principles of cybernetics and system dynamics (SD) have been used in constructing models, which is developed to analyze the factors related. The results indicate that market-skimming pricing strategy is suitable for the market with customers who behave more like innovators. In the contrary, market-penetration pricing strategy will be better used in the market with customers who behave more like imitators. At the same time, earlier to seize the opportunity of drastic cost reduction, more profits will be got.

articleTitle: System Performance Evaluation for Advanced Techniques Added in cdma2000 1xEV-DO
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The system of cdma2000 1x EV-DO is introduced to provide fast and efficient broadband wireless access. Up to now, there are three versions, mentioned as reversion 0, A and B. A great number of techniques, such as hybrid-ARQ, adaptive modulation and coding, as well as multi-user diversity, support the system to have higher spectral efficiency and better performance. In this paper, technical background and some salient features of EV-DO are summarized. In order to evaluate the DO network performance, the system level simulation is considered based on appropriate assumptions and parameters. Four hot advanced techniques, the distributed token bucket rate control mechanism, reverse link interference cancellation, forward link equalizer and multi-carrier, are deployed and judged in the existing EV-DO system. From simulation analysis and discussions, dual receive antennas, equalizer and interference cancellation may improve the average sector throughput in forward and reverse link respectively. Furthermore, multi-carrier technique could obviously enhance the overall system performance.

articleTitle: Does Interest Rate Parity Work in RMB Forward Pricing? - An Empirical Test on Rolling Sample
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The newly-born prospective market of RMB derivatives all over the world makes the pricing of RMB forward contract a hot topic in both theoretical and empirical world. This paper studies the pricing methods in both static and dynamic models and derives three main results. First, offshore NDF markets still have significant effects on the Chinese RMB forward contract market and its pricing mechanism. Second, the interest-rate-parity pricing mechanism begins to work in the determination of RMB interest rate since the revolutions in Chinese foreign exchange market from August 2005. Third, the interest-rate-parity-based RMB forward pricing mechanism is more and more important in RMB forward contract pricing, though the transition from expectation-based to interest-rate-parity-based pricing mechanism hasn't finished and the inter-banking forward market hasn't been actively involved in RMB forward pricing mechanism.

articleTitle: The Concept of Modularity Design in Software Radio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first introduce the concept of modularity design and the great promotion yielded by it to the computer industry. Then we discuss both the feasibility of introducing the concept of modularity into the design of software radio and the benefits by doing so. After that, combining with the concept of modularity, we describe the work which needs to be done to make the concept of modularity in the design of software radio come true.

articleTitle: Analysis of Top Chinese Contractors' Surplus Distribution in International Construction Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The past decade has witnessed a rapid development of the international construction market. This research aims to investigate top Chinese contractors' surplus distribution created by Value Engineering (VE). During the past few decades, VE approach has been widely used in the area of construction, which focuses on the lowest lifecycle cost consistent with performance, quality and reliability. Only each entity is satisfied with their costs and benefits that their incentives are aligned, or else they will be slack to use VE approach. In this paper the net financial benefits is defined as surplus which can be distributed between owners and contractors or designers, so the research on surplus distribution was identified as being useful both in theory and practice. This paper set a surplus distribution model based on game theory and find out the Nash equilibrium and Pareto optimality of the model. It derives some analytical results from the model such as the proportion optimization. By comparison of Nash equilibrium and Pareto optimality, this paper indicates the extremely importance of mutual coordination.

articleTitle: A Compensated EM-Based Channel Estimation for Orthogonal Wavelet Packet Modulation System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a novel iterative channel estimator for orthogonal wavelet packet modulation (OWPM) systems over frequency-selective fading channels. The channel estimation algorithm herein designed introduces linear interpolation to compensate the original value offered by expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm for iterative step. With the utilization of the coherence among both subcarriers and symbols, the performance is improved substantially. We conduct particular simulations with comparing the bit-error-rate (BER) obtained from traditional EM algorithm and our algorithm for QPSK/16QAM. Moreover, the convergence behavior of the two algorithms is also investigated through the simulations under frequency-selective multipath conditions. The results show that our method performs better than the conventional EM algorithm both in BER and convergence performances.

articleTitle: Promotion of Offshore Software Outsourcing Enterprise Value Chain Based on Knowledge Transfer Effects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, service outsourcing has been thriving all around the world, as an important part of service industry, software outsourcing, especially offshore software outsourcing has been paid more attention by many developing countries. As the cost of Indian software companies has been higher and higher, customers are turning to China for solutions. But China is still on the bottom end of the outsourcing value chain because of scale, talents and other factors. Knowledge transfer is an effective way for China's software industry to promote the level of value chain. The paper analyzes the knowledge transfer route in offshore software outsourcing by case study method, and suggests four routes for promoting the level of the value chain of Chinese software outsourcing.

articleTitle: The Project Risk Analysis Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The neural network risk analysis model for the project with fragmentary information is proposed by this paper. With plenty of adjustable parameters, the neural network risk analysis model is more flexible and shows more advantage in evaluating fragmentary information. Simulated by neurons, risk items are transferred within neural network and finally the evaluation result is obtained.

articleTitle: Value Creation Capabilities of Logistics Enterprises Based on Value Net Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Value net becomes effective operation mode for logistics enterprises to get competition advantages and to raise the capabilities of value creation. Based on value net theory, overcoming the limits of traditional supply chain, the capabilities of value creation in intranet and extranet were discussed and a system structural model of value creation capabilities was presented. Suggestions were that logistics companies should establish value net validly in order to implement low construct cost or high value return through matching resources with activities in creating value.

articleTitle: Study on Enterprise Behavior Characteristics with Transfer Matrix
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There are many factors influencing enterprises' behaviors, which are traditionally studied with qualitative economics and sociological methods. This paper brings a new technique into enterprise behaviors study. Through investigating the input and output of an enterprise, transfer matrix is used to describe behavior characteristics of the enterprise. The way to get the transfer matrix is introduced. It is proved practicable and efficient by a real-data experiments. Be there adequate history data of an enterprise, transfer matrix is possible to depict its behavior characteristics accurately enough.

articleTitle: Adaptive Bit Power Allocation Algorithm for Multiuser MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an improvement of the RA (Rate Adaptive) algorithm with alterable allocation step is proposed. Considering of the requirement on system bit error rate and the restriction on allocated bits in each channel, we compare the performance between the improved algorithm and the traditional RA algorithm. Simulation results show that the computational complexity of the proposed RA algorithm decreases a lot than the traditional algorithm while the capability of system is increased. So the proposed improved RA algorithm is a promising optimal method for implementation.

articleTitle: Design of Multiphase Decimation Filter IP Core in Software Radio Receiver
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This thesis introduces the design of multiphase decimation filter IP core in software radio receiver in detail. This soft-core could automatically generate Verilog-HDL code with optimized-structure according to input parameters. The application of this core can decrease the design time and cost, and improve reliability; it can also be combined with the dynamic reconfiguration FPGA technology to realize the aim that real-time changing filter performance in order to satisfy the flexible demand of software radio application system.

articleTitle: Study on Networked Technical Service System Oriented Product Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Problems existing in traditional technical service model was analyzed, in order to solve these problems and improve quality and efficiency of technical service, shorten the producing cycle of product, a new mode of the technical service was presented, which was the networked technical service oriented product lifecycle based on the multi agent technique, network technique and modern communications technique. Function of the system was analyzed, architecture of the system was study and workflow of the system was researched. Base on these works a prototype system of networked technical service was developed. Enterprises can provide all kind of technical service for producers and clients. Results of the system running prove its security, practicability and high efficiency. Research works provide academic and technical reference for enterprises to actualize the networked technical service.

articleTitle: Research on Top Management Team Heterogeneity, Company Performance and Strategic Changes in the Transition Economy: An Empirical Research on Chinese Listed
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the period of transition economy, enterprises, facing more and fiercer competition, need continual change strategy adjusted to the environment in dynamic environment, this paper analyzes top management team (TMT) in transition economy and probe into the relationship between top management team heterogeneity, performance and company strategic change. After analysis of the data of 182 firms from Shenzhen and Shanghai listed in stock exchange market, the result shows: Company performance plays a moderate role in the relationship between TMT heterogeneity and strategic change; poorly performing company with higher TMT age heterogeneity is likely to change strategy, on the contrary, there is negative relationship between TMT functional experience heterogeneity and strategic change.

articleTitle: A Study on Information Sharing between Members in a Virtual Team Based on the KMRW Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The rapid development of information and communication technology has been greatly promoting the practice of virtual teams. However, the issues of information sharing between members have always existed, which cause some problems or even conflicts in virtual teams. Those affect the performance of virtual teams fundamentally. To improve the cooperation of virtual teams, information sharing between members in a virtual team deserves more attention in the academic field. In this paper, the KMRW model of the game theory is adopted to analyze the existing issues of information sharing between members and the causes of these issues. Based on the detailed discussions, the study finds out the conditions of team members stepping out of "Prisoner's Dilemma", that is, the game occurs under incomplete information and their personality need to satisfy some specific conditions. At the moment, cooperative equilibrium can come forth as the Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium, thus team members are willing to share information. At the end of this paper, some suggestions are provided to improve the status of information sharing between members in a virtual team and enhance the performance of the virtual team.

articleTitle: Locating Competitive Service Facilities in Uncertain Market Using the Flow Intercepting Spatial Interaction Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, two new models based the flow intercepting spatial interaction model (FISIM), are formulated to locate competitive service facilities under the scenario-based market demand uncertainty. Service facilities compete with preexisting competitive facilities and with each other, to capture their demand from both "dedicated" customers making a special purpose trips to obtain their service and from "intercepting" customers purchasing service as part of routine pre-planned trip. Both maximizing minimum objective and minimizing maximum regret approaches can be used to treat the uncertainty in market demand. An efficient heuristic method is proposed and illustrated with a numerical example.

articleTitle: Study of the Virtual Enterprise Boundary Zone Model Based on the K-Means Arithmetic
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Boundary plays an important role in system evolvement. This paper uses self-organization theory to demonstrate the existent and blur quality of Virtual Enterprise System boundary, point that the boundary of VES is a comparatively absolute blur zone. It also provides an arithmetic whose core is K-means arithmetic, try to find the boundary zone which gradually becomes clear when VE members doing self- organization aggregation.

articleTitle: Vertical Handoff Decision Algorithm to Minimize the Network Cost
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new vertical handoff decision algorithm is proposed to minimize the cost of the heterogeneous wireless networks which comprise cellular networks and wireless local area networks (WLANs). We first calculate the block probability of new calls and the drop probability of handoff calls in cellular network and WLAN under the channel-guard call admission method, and propose a cost function which is based on the block probability and drop probability. Then we obtain the radius of WLAN by simulation annealing (SA) method to minimize the cost. All the nodes should handoff from cellular network to WLAN if they enter WLAN's scope and handoff from WLAN to cellular network if they leave its scope. Finally, we analyze our algorithm in the condition of different new call arrival rates and handoff call arrival rates.

articleTitle: Creating Flexibility in Service Center Evolution: Examples from Frequent Flier Program, a Revenue Center in the Rise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We study the evolution of popular frequent flier program, its role shift from a cost center to a revenue center. We also propose standard and creative ways to tackle the over-issuance problem and ways to facilitate the flexible redeem of the points to enhance customers' utility and loyalty and to lessen the over-issuance problem.

articleTitle: Study on Establishment of Corporate Social Responsibility System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Corporate Social Responsibility is increasingly valued by the society and businesses in China, but there has not been a complete and unified cognition in the academic field. To guide the corporation to perform the social responsibility scientifically, and at the same time reach the win-win situation of corporation economic profits and social profits, the author formulates the theoretical framework of corporate social responsibility system and analyses its structure, function and characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on Database Management Methods and Visual Thematic Map for Dynamic Information Data
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The database is the basis of environment management information system, with the spatial data and associated attribute data increasing continually, the realization of the attribute database updated dynamically is taken as the core issue and must be resolved urgently. Adopting the component object model of geographic information system(GIS), such as Map Objects, using the database connection technology, the function has been come true to add environmental information data promptly to the relational database on VB platform. Taking map rendering methods, visualization of information data can be realized by generating thematic maps, and the integration among spatial database, attribute databases and relational database has been fulfilled in order to avoid a large number of environmental information data entered the attribute database and result in data redundancy.

articleTitle: The Research of Value Loop in Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: 3G has already been put into business, but the killer application of M-commerce has not been found out. The root cause is because the value transfer system of M-commerce has not been thoroughly researched or analyzed. Through a series of empirical study, this paper points out that the value loop in E-commerce is right the key problem of killer application in mobile value-added service. Accordingly we established a related model and gave the critical factors and methods for creating the M-commerce value loop; they are referable for the development of M-commerce.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Supply Chain Management and Competitive Advantage in Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain management (SCM) has gained significance as one of the 21st century manufacturing paradigms for improving organizational competitiveness. Supply chain management has been considered as a competitive strategy for integrating suppliers and customers with the objective of improving responsiveness and flexibility of manufacturing organizations. Through demonstrating the factors affecting supply chain management and the keystones of supply chain management, this paper analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the corporate supply chain management and points out some suggestions to get competitive advantage with supply chain management.

articleTitle: Research of Investment Supernetwork Model Based on Variational Inequalities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present an investment supernetwork model with risk management. The optimality condition for the investor who try to optimize their objective function and are faced with multiple criteria such as maximize profit and minimum risk, minimum time and so on, and weight them according to their preferences is established and derives the finite-dimensional variational inequality formulation. Then the projected dynamical system is present, which describes the disequilibrium dynamics of the funds of investment on the supernetwork whose set of stationary points coincides with the set of the variational inequality problem. Qualitative properties of the equilibrium financial flows pattern are provided. A computational procedure that exploits network structure of the problem is proposed. Finally, some examples are provided to illustrate both the generality of the investment supernetworks concept and theory as well as the computational procedures.

articleTitle: Using Contextual Link Grammar to Emergency Knowledge Piece Generation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Emergency knowledge pieces are special knowledge units with context-based structures that keep comparatively sufficient semantic information for advanced knowledge reorganization; however, the primary question is how to generate knowledge pieces from textual data for more strict knowledge processing. Link Grammar is a typical method on parsing and its special link mechanism of using connectors give us an inspiration to extend this method to the knowledge piece generation. Drawing on the link mechanism, we propose a Context-based Link Grammar that extends the connectors and the application ontology slicing, and give the flow of generating knowledge pieces.

articleTitle: New Tracking Filter for Single Observer Passive Location and Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With a set of merits such as self-hiding, far-distance detection, and easy deployment, the Single Observer Passive Location and Tracking (SOPLAT) system has broad applications in various areas. Owing to the serious nonlinear problems of SOPLAT, the traditional Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is unfit for it. A new tracking filter for the highly non-linear SOPLAT system is proposed in this paper. The proposed filter uses the particle filter to locate the emitter, and then uses the EKF (Extended Kalman Filter) to track the emitter. By using this method, the convergence speed and the precision of the tracking filter can be improved, as well as the stability of the filter. And the computational cost is not out of the system ability. Experimental results indicate that the new filter has better convergence speed, tracking precision and other performances than EKF in SOPLAT.

articleTitle: Design of Platform and Interface of Digital World-Expo System Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the impending of 2010 Shanghai World-expo, it has been becoming a hot topic, how to manage huge volume of, and heterogeneous information efficiently and in security. In this paper, the definition of digital world-expo is first given. Then, we present a novel idea on general system of digital world-expo, in the interest of providing reliable and consistent service oriented toward trust and authorization. In the system, multiple relevant platforms and interfaces are designed to process the information from different sources. At the same time, the efficiency and availability about them are demonstrated in detail. Finally, we poke into some key problems encountered in the current information infrastructure.

articleTitle: Research on Internet Technological Standard Provision Basing on Evolutionary Games Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a kind of public goods, there is always disharmony between official standard and factual industrial standard about technological standard. In this paper, we choose evolutionary games theory as a visual angle, construct a equilibrium model of evolutionary game to study games between Internet industries and governments by describing the choices of using or creating network technology standards which have different strategies of groups dynamic trends and evolutionary stability. Finally this paper also demonstrates the rationality and the possibility for Internet industries to create technical standards, relying on their own strength.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Models of Coordinate Management with Large Scale System for Green Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In view of existing situation of Green Supply Chain (GSC) and the control issues of coordinate management with large scale systems for GSC, the control channels of large scale systems for coordinate development of GSC are discussed by applying the theory and method of large scale systems based on large system cybernetics. The theoretical basis and available means for the scientific design and effective application of GSC management are provided by establishing relevant mathematical models. It is a vital technology for promoting GSC management.

articleTitle: Development Prospect of Hydrogen Engine Vehicles in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Automotive industry makes great contribution to the development of human society, but at the same time it consumes huge energy resources and results in severe environmental pollution. In order to solve the crisis of energy resource and environmental pollution, it is an urgent task to research and develop vehicles that can save energy consumption and emit no pollution. Hydrogen Internal Combustion Engine Vehicle is the vehicle that we are looking for to use clean fuel (hydrogen energy) and realize zero emission. Firstly, the status and demanding trend of auto and energy in China are introduced. Secondly, the interrelation between energy and auto industry is discussed.

articleTitle: A Study on Key Technique of Product Configuration System Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to establish the configuration relation of complex product structure, a new product structure configuration model based on polychromatic graph theory was presented. Then the optimum product structure configuration mathematical model was got and the improved ant colony algorithm was employed to solve the problem. Therefore, the prototype system was developed on the basis of the model. The results showed that the solution quality got by improved ant colony algorithm was better than the solution got by traditional ant colony algorithm, and the product configuration model can exactly present the configuration information, product attribute and assembly relation for complex product. Base on the improved ant colony algorithm, the product configuration management prototype system was designed. The product configuration system makes parallelizing product design become possible. It presents a new way of cooperation design.

articleTitle: Revenue Coordination Contract Based on Stackelberg Game in Upsteam Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly discusses a problem of revenue coordination in an upsteam supply chain, in which a supplier and a manufacturer are included, based on the balance of inventory cost and transportation cost. A two-stage stackelberg game model is erected, aiming at cost optimization. The optimality and equilibrium solution of the model are analyzed, too. the interaction of decision variables as well as that between decision variables and cost parameters are analyzed and demonstrated at last. It provides theory proof to establish the manufacturer's stimulating policy and the supplier's delivery policy.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Level Grey Assessment on the Evaluation of User Satisfaction of MIS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, synthetic evaluation index system about user satisfaction of MIS is established from three aspects of system performance, direct benefit and indirect benefit. After indexes' weights are determined by using AHP, a multilevel gray evaluation model for user satisfaction of MIS is presented on its gray characteristic. Finally, example is included to prove the model is feasible and practicable. This model provide scientific basis for enterprise to evaluate the success of MIS.

articleTitle: Localization Under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Uncertainty naturally presents in the localization problem for wireless sensor networks. In this paper we address the uncertainty issue explicitly and propose a feasible, accurate and efficient location discovery scheme for wireless sensor networks. Our stochastic algorithm provides decent localization accuracy, and at the same time it does not rely on any ranging information or anchor nodes. Simulation results show that our algorithm can achieve much better accuracy than other deterministic approaches.

articleTitle: Applying of Bayesian Method in the Decision-Making Process of Strategy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bayesian method is a significant methodology in decision-making process, according to the new situation and characteristic of the current research and development, the drawbacks of conventional statistic evaluation method can be avoided while Bayesian analysis is applied in the decision-making process. Moreover, as the information collected from the simulation experiment is utilized amply, and the evaluation outcome is analyzed, hence, the expected loss is reduced, and the quality of the strategy analysis is greatly improved. Finally, this paper addressed an instance to interpret its analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Approaches of Knowledge Integration in Team
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In knowledge management research field, knowledge characteristic and knowledge subject are two important dimensions. This article presents a model of knowledge integration approaches based on the two dimensions. We discuss the approaches which the elementary knowledge transforms into structural knowledge in team. Base on this model, we put forward two approaches of knowledge integration in team-knowledge connection approach and personal interaction approach.

articleTitle: Aggregation of Heterogeneous Beliefs Under the Non-Additive Measure and its Application to Options Pricing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ellsberg paradox and Allais paradox indicate that not all the information measures are additive and can be separated from preferences. Behavioral finance points out that beliefs of people are heterogeneous. In this paper, information therefore is described through non-additive measures, and aggregated with Choquet expectation in asset pricing. Considering the heterogeneity of people, we introduce a random parameter A to represent the diversity of people's preferences and information processing methods. We then aggregate these heterogeneous beliefs by ordinary additive integral. In this way a new pricing method for European options is proposed. Simulation further proves that this method has advantages over traditional Black- Scholes method in interpreting some puzzles. This paper finally lays the foundation for empirical research that applies Bayesian updating from real market data.

articleTitle: A Key Distribution from Pairing for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The advent of Identity based encryption has enabled a wide range of new cryptographic solutions for wireless sensor network. In this paper, a scheme named KDBSP is given to distribute symmetry key in wireless sensor network KDBSP comes from Smart protocol based on pairing. After some analyzing, KDBSP has some advantage on storage, computation and communication by comparing with the other scheme for establishing share key in wireless sensor network.

articleTitle: Bayesian Analysis of Logistic Default Risk Model with Oversampling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Oversampling is a widely applied sampling method in default risk modeling. Although arbitrarily increased portions of the defaulted in sampling makes logistic estimation more efficiently, it will bring biased estimation results at the same time. We present a simple Bayesian analysis method to derive the offset logistic modeling to correct oversampling bias. It is pointed out that the real value of non-defaulted to the defaulted in the offset term is actually unknown. This will bring difficulties in direct testing of validity of the offset model. By some further analysis, we present a novel way to test offset model indirectly. The final empirical evidences convincingly support the offset logistic model we have derived.

articleTitle: Research on the Selection of Technological Innovation Pattern: the Analysis Based on the Entrepreneur's Mental Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper the author puts the selection of technological innovation pattern and entrepreneurs' mental models in a unified theoretical framework, and discusses the relationship between them. Theoretical analysis shows that entrepreneurs who have flexible mental model are inclined to choose independent innovation pattern, entrepreneurs who have moderate mental model are apt to select cooperative innovation model and entrepreneurs who have conservative mental model are prone to elect imitative innovation.

articleTitle: An Efficient FPGA-Based Turbo Decoder and Its Application in FH-SS System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on implementing an efficient and simplified turbo decoder with FPGA. The Max-Log-MAP algorithm is employed and a simplified and improved Max-Log- MAP algorithm is present. By carefully manipulating hardware, we implement the whole turbo decoder with a single-RSC structure. Comparing with the conventional decoder, our turbo decoder reduces about 60% hardware cost and operates up to 2Mbit/s. Finally, we investigate the performance of our FPGA-based turbo decoder in a FH-SS system with partial band jamming. The results drawn from this code are compared with a RS code. Results show that the turbo code significantly outperforms the RS code.

articleTitle: The Study on Ecotourism System Carrying Capacity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The writer puts forward the concept of the carrying capacity of ecotourism system; analyses its feature and effect, and the content and the present situation on its study; constructs the framework of carrying capacity of ecotourism system and then studies the systematic effect and relevant indexes system. Thus it provides the theory and method for sustainable development of ecotourism.

articleTitle: The Study of Logistics Management Theory in Material Cost Control
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the project cost control was discussed by logistics. And the constructing corporation costing management is running through the whole process of the project constructing. The project cost is composed of labor cost, material cost, mechanical cost and other cost. Among these costs, the material cost which is occupied the whole cost's 70% is affecting the integral engineering gain and loss and the corporation's beneficial result and the ability of the market competition. The project material fluxion means gaining valuable dynamic engineering supplied chain and the management of the constructing supply and the requirement's system between the corporation's Internets The management of engineering logistics which is including the whole process of constructing material procurement, transport, store, portage and so on applies the theory of logistics management in the control of the material costing sufficiently. Also it controls the whole process of the material procurement, transport, store, portage and so on, which makes various logistics realizing the best harmony and cooperation.

articleTitle: A Variable Round Mechanism for Routing Protocols Based on LEACH
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Give a new arithmetic of variable round mechanism to reduce the cluster-heads' death in a round. We analyze the classical hierarchical clustering protocol LEACH, and discuss the existed routing protocols based on LEACH and present their problems. Finally we introduce a new a variable round mechanism. A simulation comparison is made between the traditional constant round and the variable round mechanism. The simulation and comparison results show that the cluster- heads' death in a round is reduced and the durability of network enhanced in the variable round mechanism.

articleTitle: The Effect of Number Portability on Telecommunication Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of number portability on the telecommunication market. The result shows that in a static setting, number portability will make the price, market share and the profit of the incumbent decrease while those of the entrant increase. In a dynamic setting, number portability will make both of the operators take competition strategies besides cutting prices, such as improving the quality of their products, and the scale of the market will be expanded. In a word, the introduction of number portability has the effect of making the telecommunication market more competitive. In China, we can introduce number portability to promote the competition of the telecommunication market.

articleTitle: The Reconstruction Model of Virtual Logistics Based On Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The modeling of virtual logistics is very difficult due to its intuitional complexion. The agent technology, which is developed from the artificial intelligence, provides the simulation of complex systems with new methodology and idea. In this paper, the reconstruction model of virtual logistics is introduced based on multi-agent technology. And also, the functions of agents are defined, the negotiation mechanisms and communication manners between agents is analyzed.

articleTitle: An Improved Access Scheme Based on Multiple-Hop Priority and Cross-Layer Design in 802.11e
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In ad hoc networks, the end-to-end delay of packets becomes long when other middle nodes transmit these packets and the multi-hops will affect the quality-of-service (QoS) of voice and video. This paper analyzes influence of multi-hops in ad hoc network by a simulative experiment, which put forward an improved access algorithm, called as more hop first-EDCF (MHF-EDCF). The mechanisms are based on 802.11e EDCF and multi-hop characteristics of ad hoc networks with cross-layer method. MHF-EDCF offers a higher priority to multi-hops packets for voice and video. The results of simulation show that MHF-EDCF can reduce the end-to-end delay of multimedia traffic significantly and throughput of network is increased.

articleTitle: A Model of Third-Party Integration Testing Process Management for Foundation Software Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: FSP (foundation software platform) is the shoring of foundation for application system. The integration testing is the important method to ensure the quality of FSP. The integration testing of FSP would involve not only foundation software vendors, such as the vendor of operating system, the vendors of database management system and the vendors of middleware etc.; but also the users of FSP, such as application system developer and integrator. It is a reliable way to carry out the integration testing by a third-party. Concerning the problems which the third party testing organization face with, including how to deal with the problem that testing information is insufficient, how to organize collaboration among the software vendors, and how to build the integration testing environment etc., In this paper, a Third-party Integration Testing Process Management model for FSP (TITPM) is proposed. In the model, we identify the third party testing metadata, define the testing process toward collaboration of three parties, and give a method of building testing environment based on open source software. The model has been used in the integration testing and maintenance of domestic FSP in China. The successful application of the model in integration testing of FSP by the third party testing center in China proved its validity.

articleTitle: The Effect of IT-Service Capability, Marketing Service Capability, and HR-Service Capability on e-CRM Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is strong necessary for this study to extent the literature contributions for the effect of resource-based theory on e-CRM study. Based on the theory perspective, the purpose of this study is to expand and achieve a better understanding of a natural e-CRM phenomenon, namely the interaction effect of HR-service capability, IT-service capability, and KM-service capability on its e-CRM process to the performance. A total of 300 questionnaires were distributed in the summer of 2006 to four Taiwanese banks, which have applied the e-CRM system to their customer service operations. Multiple hierarchical/interaction regressions were applied to the results, and it was discovered that when an institution uses e-CRM services with Web-based applications to establish and raise the combination levels of HR-service capability, IT-service capability, and MK-service capability, these conjoint effects resulted in a favorable interaction relationship and thus can help the institution achieve the so-called "profit-maximizing portfolio" level. Excluding interaction effect among these three service assets will lead to inaccurate prediction of its e-CRM performance.

articleTitle: The Strategies of Advancing Product Innovation Capability Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Product innovation capability in supply chain which can not be imaged as the sum capability of respective produce innovation is based on enterprise product innovation capability. In this paper, from the characteristics of product innovation capability in supply chain, we analyze the factors that effect product innovation capability in supply chain, put forward strategies to construction of information transmission mechanism, form coordination technical management and implement logistics resource conformity. These are all strategies to advance product innovation capability in supply chain.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Relative Risk of Commercial Banks: Empirical Evidence of 14 Commercial Banks from 2001 to 2004
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to seek out the bottlenecks in the whole Chinese banking running process, this paper, based on the risk evaluation index system (REIS) and on the risk comparison model (RCM), compared and analyzed the risk comparison of 14 Chinese banks. In accordance with the risk level, these 14 banks could be measured off into 3 categories: the first category, consisted of Huaxia Bank China Merchants Bank Minsheng Bank, and Bank of China, has the highest level of safety; while the third category, consisted of the Agriculture Bank of China, ICBC, and Guangdong Development Bank is the bottleneck of China's banking system. Thus, the main reasons as nonperforming loans, incapability of profitability, and the illiquidity ratio of assets, which cause the risky situation of the commercial banks, are also the key points to the banking reform of whole safety.

articleTitle: Task Allocation of Web System Based on Immune Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Task allocation of Web system is a type of restrictive optimization problem. The main objective is to minimize response time while satisfying the constraint of load balance and dependency relationship among tasks. Firstly, a mathematic model of this problem is defined. Then, an immune genetic algorithm is proposed to tackle it. The algorithm can keep the population diversity, improve the intensification ability and searching efficiency without premature stagnation.

articleTitle: Programming Keynotes on J2ME-Based Mobile Map Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Analyzing the ever-growing market prospects of mobile map services and widespread applications of J2ME client techniques, the paper, firstly, discusses J2ME advantages compared with WAP and BREW in aspects of Web interaction, in-situ data storage or access, software development efficiency etc. And then, it puts emphasis on such programming keynotes as map blocking and local multi-level caching in handheld devices; three strategies of single-thread, dynamic or static multi-thread for network requests; as well as low-level terminal graphical user interfaces. It has been validated that these skills have speeded up the map roaming, geo-reference data retrieval, and improved users' experiences through the J2ME-based map service prototype. In the end, some conclusion and future-work has been addressed briefly.

articleTitle: A Markov Chain to Estimate Stochastic Risk of Enterprise Structure for Value Innovation of China Construction Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the main problems in the enterprise structure is the actual disorder of the three hierarchical schemes for the enterprise management China construction industry, which brings the stochastic risk of enterprise structure for the value innovation of China construction corporations. The principal reason is that corporation are being involved in a low-interest and severe circle competition, due to the quality management which the authority wants to use to restructure the construction industry. However, there is not the relatively recent definition of this type of risk, especially for the value innovation in China construction industry. Considering this drawback, the employment of Markov methods and simulation tools could be a natural solution to the problem. The use of Markov methods allows us to estimate the parameters about mutual transition for the value innovation of construction enterprises, and calculate the stochastic risk for the total construction enterprises in the freedom market. Besides, an original proposal is a Markov approach for modeling the stochastic risk in the China construction enterprise structure and for the computation of the type of risk to cover the three hierarchical schemes. Besides this methodological innovation a positive research, based on Markov chain, is required. In particular, the study reveals that the running of current construction enterprise structure is a real block for the evolution of the value innovation of China construction enterprises according to the stimulation value in the different hierarchical choices for the construction enterprise distributions.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer-Based MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Given the special requirements from wireless sensor networks and the disadvantages of current MAC protocol, a new cross-layer MAC protocol, which combines the physics layer and a MAC protocol, is introduced. The former layer is based on direct-sequence spread-spectrum, and the latter busy tone. First the physics layer and MAC layer were designed concretely, and then the power consumption and duty cycle of the protocol were analyzed quantitatively. Finally, the protocol was simulated on NS2 platform. Different from classic 802.11 DCF protocol, the protocol improved the efficiency ,the success ratio, the end-to-end delay, the jitter and the throughput.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of A QoS Signaling Protocol for Mobile IP Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The coupling of signaling protocols for mobility management and resource reservation plays an important role to achieve quality-of-service (QoS) in mobile environments. When performing a handover, request and allocation of resources have to be done in the shortest possible time to avoid disruptions for the user service. In this paper, we analyze the effects of node mobility on the interaction between QoS signaling protocols and mobility management protocols, and how the protocols operate in different mobility scenarios. We also propose an efficient QoS signaling protocol which operates adaptively in mobile IP networks. The key features of the protocol include crossover node discovery and local repair to achieve seamless services. Our simulation and experimental results show that the proposed protocol works well in mobile environments.

articleTitle: Study on Corporate Culture Evolution from the View of Complexity Science
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the features, the mode of evolution and the source stimulating evolution of corporate culture system are discussed by using the theory, methods and tools of complexity science. The diversity of corporate culture evolution is explained by logistic equation and the dynamic process of culture selection is analyzed by evolutionary game model. The author holds that corporate culture evolution is the result of complex interaction between internal and external environments and employees. In a corporate culture system, the complete consensus and singleness of traditional corporate culture will obstruct the development of a corporation, and the coexistence of diversified cultures is necessary for ensuring the innovation and evolution of corporate culture.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Model and Decision Support System for Top Management Team
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: TMT (Top Management Team, TMT) refers to the relatively small team of top executives with overall responsibility for the organization The group effectiveness of TMT is becoming more and more important while facing the complicated and fast changeable management environment. This paper gave analysis and summarization of the researches on TMT, and then presented a multi-agent model to study the relationship between TMT group effectiveness and its composition and configuration. Based on this model, a DSS was designed for group analysis and group optimization.

articleTitle: Can Enhanced Stock Price Informativeness Improve the Investment Efficiency of Chinese Listed Companies?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although stock price informativeness has been posited to improve investment efficiency, there has been little empirical evidence supporting this claim to date. By the use of Chinese listed companies from 2002 to 2006 as the research sample, the effect of stock price informativeness on investment efficiency was empirically studied based on corporate level for the first time. The empirical results indicate: stock price informativeness is strongly negatively associated with both firm overinvestment and underinvestment. Further, stock price informativeness also can notably decrease the sensitivity of overinvestment to free cash flow and the sensitivity of underinvestment to financing constraints. It finally eliminates the possibility that the negative correlation is caused by the case that managers decrease stock price informativeness to conceal the investment losses.

articleTitle: A Chaos-Based High Quality PN Sequence Generator
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Chaos theory has been widely used in PN sequence generator in recent years and the chaos sequence quantification scheme has great influence on the performance of a generator. In this paper, an improved stochastic multi-bits quantification scheme based on Chebyshev map is proposed to extend the period and improve the performance of chaotic binary sequence under precision restricted condition. The balance and correlation property of the generated sequence are analyzed. The sequence is proved to be a binary Bernoulli sequence and the distribution of the differences between the amounts of 0 and 1 is analyzed. The side lobes of auto and cross correlation are proved to obey normal distribution (0, 1/N). The simulation results indicate that the algorithm has excellent balance and correlation property.

articleTitle: The Integrated Intelligence Decision of Underground Metal Mine Stope Structure and Grade Indices
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The stope structure parameters and grade indices of underground metal mine are concerned to the safety, economy and sociality of the whole mine. The conventional methods to ascertain above parameters are generally according to experience and analogy, which has artificial blindness. Metal mine exploitation is a complex system engineering, the whole mine system includes many subsystems, and some of them has complex nonlinear characteristics. The paper utilizes sublevel caving simulation system and RFPA numerical program to respectively analyze the recovery index and the surrounding rock stability. The ANN model also is used to fitting the nonlinear subsystems such as concentration ratio model because of its self-learning ability, considering multi-objects including economic efficiency amount of metal and cash flow, proposes the grade indices optimization method. Combining above means, based on database, model base, knowledge base and inference machine, constructs intelligent decision support system. Using the system to appraise the stope structure parameters and optimize the grade indices of Jinshandian Ore Mine of Wuhan City of Hubei Province. It states the method of the paper is feasible, and the analysis results have guiding mean to the ore mine.

articleTitle: The Study of Integration Operation Mode between Demand Chain and Virtual Producer Services Based on Lead User
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the arrival of the era of knowledge economy, the development and application of information technology with high-speed, the global economy is moving toward integration. Corresponding to this, the leading position of consumers in the supply chain has continually increased, and the demand of consumer has gradually become the key factort which may decide the development of supply chain, which result in the competition between enterprises changing gradually from supply chain competition to demand chain competition. From the angle of demand chain survival and enhancing competitiveness, how to timely response the needs of market rapidly changing and improve the integration of the demand chain is important significance for enterprises. This paper make full use of virtual enterprise of the new type enterprise operation mode, and construct integration operation innovation mode among lead user virtual producer services based on market orientation, demand chain crunode enterprises and competitors. The core of demand chain Management is to meet the practice demand of customer and this integration operation innovation mode proposed by paper based on lead user virtual producer services which may have some decision-making reference for solving bullwhip effect produced in the course of demand chain management and reducing transaction complexity etc.

articleTitle: The Development of Travel Intermediaries in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Tourism industry, with the characteristics of not involving in logistics and production, well accommodates itself to the application of e-commerce in such an area. The paper focuses on the study of classification, function and effect of travel intermediaries, analyzing the internal and external application as well as representation of e-commerce for travel intermediaries in e-commerce environment, and further research is made on such basis for the future development trend of travel intermediaries.

articleTitle: Enhanced Signal-Strength-Difference Position Method Based on an Inversion Propagation Model in Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper develops a simple and efficient position method based on relative signal-strength prediction, which can be got from an inversion propagation model in cellular networks. The inversion propagation model can predict the propagation loss between any two points along the virtual propagation path from the base-station to mobile-station, which precision has been presented in. So the user's location can be predicted by matching the average signal-strength-difference of the neighboring list in the mobile phone to the coverage prediction differences from multiple base-stations in the appointed area. The effectiveness of the proposed method has been demonstrated by using experiments under various radio environments in Guang Dong, China. It was shown that the enhanced signal-strength-difference position method can locate the user with about the accuracy of 150 m in 67 percentage and 300 m in 92 percentage respectively.
