abstract: Large amount of experts are key asset that universities hold. In order to increase people's awareness of experts and foster collaborative opportunities, it is necessary to build an expertise repository, which enables campus and external users to identify suitable experts and their expertise. This paper proposes a methodology for constructing semantic repository of academic experts, a semantic Web application that integrates pieces of relevant expertise information from heterogeneous data sources. We also demonstrate how to apply visualization techniques to visualize the research area of academic experts. Tests on this prototype system show that SeRAE supports users browsing and searching experts more efficiently and effectively.

articleTitle: Dictionary-Based Bilingual Web Page Classification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Web page classification poses new research challenges because of the noisy nature of the pages. For the bilingual Chinese-English web pages, it also needs to be considered that how to extract the terms of different languages exactly. A new dictionary-based multilingual text categorization approach is proposed in this paper to try to classify the Chinese-English web pages in specific domain into a hierarchical topic structure more accurately. The approach can properly recognize and integrate the web page encodings by using an automatic encoding detection and integration method. This makes the feature extraction more precise for the multilingual pages. The approach can also intensify the domain concepts in the web pages based on a domain dictionary. From the results of the experiments, it can be found that the proposed approach get the better performance than the traditional classification method when classifying the bilingual web pages.

articleTitle: A Reverse Logistics Decision-making Model for Steel Industry: A Case Study of China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is focus on reverse logistics which is a part of "environmental logistics". With the development of high-tech, the "win-win" strategy that developing economy and protecting the environment has gained more and more attention nowadays. This paper is organized into 5 sections. In section 1 and 2, the motive factors of the reverse logistics implementation and the current station of Chinese steel industry is discussed. Then the model of reverse logistics system for steel industry designed in section 3, which is composed of returned logistics and waste material logistics. There is the practical application in section 4 and the conclusion at last. The purpose of this paper is to research the Chinese reverse logistics and help the relevant companies who would like to pursue reverse logistics as a new market.

articleTitle: Research on Stochastic Comb-Pilot Design for NC-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: NC-OFDM is OFDM-based spectrum pooling technique and also a transmission mode of cognitive radio. The paper models and analyzes NC-OFDM stochastic process, then designs stochastic comb-pilot pattern and analyzes its characteristics in detail. At the end of the paper simulation results prove the feasibilities of the stochastic comb-pilot strategies in NC-OFDM system.

articleTitle: The Research on Wireless Sensors Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article studys the reliability of communication of single hop link between neighboring nodes. To research the integrality of flooding routing, a mathematical model is built by means of Markov chain and possibility, then we provide an algorithm for reliability of a whole wireless sensor network via the theoretical deduction. It solves the problem of forecasting reliability of communications of wireless sensor network. It is proved via simulation that this suite of arithmetic can provide reference for designing a wireless sensor network or anticipating its reliability.

articleTitle: Innovative Effects of the Entrance of the IP Telephone on the Long-Distance Telephone Service Market in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The effects of the IP telephone's entrance into the long-distance telephone service market in China were analyzed empirically. It is the high speed expansion of the Internet users, as well as the relatively lower call fees, that has promoted the IP telephone's blast into that market in recent years. The entrance of the IP telephone has changed the structure of the market into a triangular framework led by the IP telephone, followed by the wireline telephone and the mobile telephone, and hence notably optimized the market structure. The significantly positive cross-price elasticity of the IP telephone to the traditional long-distance telephone indicates a strong substitution effect of the IP telephone on the traditional long-distance telephone. The consumers' welfare has been greatly enhanced by the IP telephone, which has remarkably improved the market's efficiency. The IP telephone will have a wide market perspective bec.ause of the transformation of the consumption trends from the traditional form to the IP form, and because of the emergence of new network communication tools.

articleTitle: Primary Research on Disaster Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Risk has always been analyzed according to two parameters, namely, probability of an event and the losses it may cause. Risk is classified into three areas in this paper. The using of probability analysis alone may give rise to some misguidance, and two new parameters are proposed to analyze the disaster risk, namely the cost of safety precautions and losses of the disaster. Without probability analysis, an intervened matrix model is developed for a preliminary test. The game theory and optimized method are employed in this paper to address the issue of disaster risk and a corresponding management mechanism is established as well.

articleTitle: An ACO Algorithm for Sum-Rate Maximization Problem in Opportunistic Spectrum Allocation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A major problem of opportunistic spectrum allocation is how to maximize spectrum utilization given a bunch of available channels, i.e. sum-rate maximization problem, which is considered as a combinatorial optimization problem in our paper. ant colony optimization (ACO) is a well-known metaheuristic in which a colony of ants cooperate in exploring good solutions to a combinatorial optimization problem. In this paper, we present an MMAS algorithm for maximizing spectrum utilization based on ACO. Experimental results show improvements over existing algorithms for the sum-rate maximization problem in opportunistic spectrum allocation.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Heterogeneous Messages Matching in Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The heterogeneity of the messages between Web services is one of the most important problems in the Web services composition. Because of lack effective solution, it reduces the accuracy of service discovery and increases the difficulty of service composition. Thus, a matching method based on ontology is proposed to solve the conflict of heterogeneous messages. This approach uses resource description framework (RDF) graphs to represent service messages, which contains more semantic information than XML language. And a framework was proposed to implement messages matching by name matcher and structure matcher with the aid of the rules repository and the existing match repository. The experiments show that this approach is effective and has well results in the recall and precision.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Mechanism for Mobility Guarantee used Location-Information in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many researches in wireless sensor networks have been exploited a geographic routing to effectively disseminate data between sinks and sources. However, the geographic routing needs that the sinks and the sources are aware of location information of each other. To know the location information, there have been proposed two manners. The first manner is a sink-initiated location information flooding that the sink floods its location information. The second manner is a source-initiated location information flooding that the source floods its location information. However, these two manners have two problems. Firstly, whenever the sink and the source move, they flood their location information. Secondly, in few sinks and few sources, their location information is disseminated unnecessary nodes besides nodes which send and receive data in actually. Therefore, this paper proposes a protocol that can solve the two problems and disseminate effectively data between few sinks and few sources. The proposed protocol exploits a location information manager that manages real-time location information of the sinks and the sources. We also compare the performance of the proposed protocol with the existing protocols through a simulation, and show the superiority of the proposed protocol in terms of network lifetime, data delivery ratio, and delay latency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How Does Service Brand Communication Influence Consumer's Psychology? A Study from the Perspective of Consumer Brand Attitude
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Disposition Effects and Investor Overconfidence: Evidence from Trading Volume in China Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Stock trading activity is very important to market volatility. The particular market environment of China makes the internal reason of trading volume change more complicated. In order to test how trading activities are driven, we use a vector autoregressive and impulse-response function methodology. First, we study the intertemporal relationship between individual stock trading volume and individual stock return. Then we extend the bivariate vector autoregressive equation to a trivariate vector autoregressive equation to see how lagged market returns as well as lagged individual stock returns impact trading activity. It is concluded that historical stock returns have significantly positive effects on trading volume, and the shocks of both individual firm return and market wide return are transferred to trading activities, and then bring a shock in the same direction to stock trading volume. And this shock can last for times. It suggests that overconfidence and disposition effect are both important factors to drive trading activities. Investors trade (or do not trade) stock not only because of the desire to increase their mental accounts, but also because of their overconfidence and cognitive error.

articleTitle: Design and Logical Analysis of Authenticated Key Exchange Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In response to the low efficiency problem in the existing authenticated key exchange protocol for mobile commerce, the paper proposes an efficient authenticated key exchange protocol based on token, which can authenticate identity of the mobile user in the foremost time, as well as the session key can be exchanged efficiently. To analyze the proposed protocol, the paper proposes an extension of the SVO logic and formally analyzes the objective and security of the protocol by using the extended SVO logic. The analysis results reveal that the protocol completes the ideal authentication goals through the definite key authentication.

articleTitle: Study of RFEC-Based Transport Protocol in Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Different from terrestrial sensor networks, underwater sensor networks use acoustic channels for communication and most sensor nodes are mobile due to water current. These distinctions feature underwater sensor networks with highly dynamic topology, high bit error rate, large propagation delay, and low available bandwidth. Traditional ARQ series are not suitable due to their frequent feedbacks, which is undesirable in underwater environment. On the other hand, pure FEC can't apply into underwater sensor networks, not only because of its complexity, but also because it needs some feedbacks. This paper studied transport protocol in underwater sensor networks, implemented a reliable lightweight RFEC-based encoding and decoding algorithm. Then combine the algorithm with ARQ to a transport protocol. In this way, take advantages of FEC to deal with high bit error, and ARQ to avoid feedbacks. Through simulation experiment on method of random sequences generation, parameters selection, and transmission strategy, some useful conclusion is gotten. It provides practical data and references on practical application of underwater sensor networks.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Early-Warning of Logistics Outsourcing Risks Based on Four Phases
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with bringing the enterprises competitiveness and beneficial advantages, logistics outsourcing also brings them a variety of risks. The risks of logistics outsourcing are caused by many factors which also have their own fuzziness. Based on the characteristics of logistics outsourcing risks, the model of early-warning of logistics outsourcing risks based on four phases is established: Firstly , identify the principle and early-warning line; secondly, use the software SPSS and factor analysis method to identify the outsourcing risks and ascertain key risk factors; thirdly, evaluate key risk factors using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; fourthly, based on the evaluation of risks, use weighted average method to determine the level of risk, meanwhile compare with the principle and early-warning line and further ascertain the alarming and beforehand control. Finally, an example using this model shows that the model is easy to operate, practical and feasible.

articleTitle: Ownership Structure and Contract Efficiency in BOT Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the game theory, this paper formulates the concession agreement as an incomplete contract model to investigate the effects of different ownership structures on the efficiency of Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) project. If the ownership is attributed to the private sector, it has stronger incentive to engage in cost reduction investment. However, the moral hazard arises from the incompleteness of contract and limited recourse. For instance, the private sector might engage in the investment of damaging the project performance. On the other hand, the government ownership can control the project performance, but provide little incentive for the private sector to reduce the project costs. This paper is concluded that the efficiency of BOT project is accomplished under the private sector ownership when the deposit system is introduced to restrain the moral hazard.

articleTitle: Description of Quantum Convolutional Codes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quantum communication system is influenced by environment noise in the whole process. Quantum error-correcting codes can solve this problem efficiently. The polynomial representation of a quantum state is defined. Based on the structure of the classical convolutional codes, the basis state of the quantum convolutional codes is transformed into the multiplication of an information polynomial by the generator polynomial. A new method is proposed to encode and decode these quantum codes and the networks can be realized with the polynomial multiplication circuits. Finally, we provide a maximum likelihood error estimation algorithm with complexity growing linearly.

articleTitle: Dynamic Business Alliance and its Construction Based on Multi-Agent System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a society of information economy, building effective dynamic alliance means a lot for businesses to improve their competitiveness. Applying information technology, especially multi-agent technology in the process of construction of dynamic business alliance can effectively share and coordinated utilization of business resources. This paper first elaborates the concept and characteristics of dynamic alliance, then explores multi-agent technology and the feasibility of its application in dynamic alliance. At last, the paper provides a framework for choice of partners during construction of dynamic alliance .

articleTitle: Research on Comparison and Application of SVM and FNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SVM and FNN are the improved algorithms of neural network, which are more popular at present. In this paper, based on the simple introduction of the two algorithms, discuss the basic principle and the learning process respectively; two cities' short-term power load forecasting in Hebei Province as examples, case 1 delegates large sample, case 2 delegates small sample, use SVM and FNN to forecast the average failure rate, through the comparison and analysis, get a conclusion that SVM is applicable to the fewer data situation, and FNN is applicable to the more data situation.

articleTitle: The Employment Effect and Policy Innovation of Financial Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a kind of service economy, the financial industry could play an important role in releasing China's unemployment pressure and promoting economic growth; especially it could have a strong active employment effect in the economic development. This paper uses the financial innovation theory to analyze the employment effect of the financial industry in China, and then focuses on analyzing the direct employment effect of the financial industry. At last, it puts out some suggestions on innovational policy choices for developing of the financial industry in order to improve its employment effect fully.

articleTitle: Research on Customer Relationship Management Application System of Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Owing to more and more competitive market, customer becomes one of the most important resources for enterprises, which results in the development of Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Customer Relationship Management is a management philosophy focusing on customer. Through utilizing IT technology, reconstituting the business function and reengineering the work flow, new customers are acquired and the existing ones retained. In this paper, a kind of whole architecture of CRM for Manufacturing Enterprises is put forward and at the same time some related key techniques of CRM and the relation between CRM and ERP are analyzed and discussed in detail.

articleTitle: An Energy-Efficient Optimal Multipath Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The significant goal of routing protocol designs for wireless sensor networks is to improve the utilization rate of nodes and to prolong the lifetime of the network. But to a specific application, some other network performances, such as robustness, reliability, end-to-end delay, should be concerned and the conventional single path schemes may not be optimal to improve all these performances efficiently. In this paper, we propose a distributed energy-efficient optimal multipath routing protocol to find maximum multiple paths between the sink and the nodes, which would improve the network performance to a great extent. Compared our proposed scheme with the directed diffusion routing protocol, the simulation results reveal that our scheme has longer network lifetime, higher reliability, lower end-to-end delay and control overhead.

articleTitle: Study on Industrial Design Outsourcing in New Product Development Process in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper aims to empirically study the management and activities of industrial design (ID) outsourcing in new product development (NPD) process in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The research uses a multi-case study methodology. Data were collected from six companies in various sectors. The study shows external ID is urgently needed in SMEs, it can effectively support the NPD process and promote innovation. The introduction and roles of design expertise diverse in different firms, few are involved in the early phases of NPD. And the interaction and communication between ID firms and SMEs in NPD are still at a relatively low level. It is implicated that SMEs should pay more attention to integrate outsourced industrial design as an innovation input in the NPD process to explore consumer and market. A mechanism with teamwork, collaboration of different staffs, and face-to-face communication is efficient for a successful design interaction.

articleTitle: Pricing and Coordination Analysis for A Closed-Loop Supply Chain Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We consider a closed-loop supply chain in which a manufacturer sells to a retailer, the retailer sells the products to customers and recollects the used products from customers. Based on the model, the price decisions such as optimal wholesale price, optimal retail price and optimal recollected price between manufacturer and retailer are studied by game theory, a decentralized system and a centralized system are studied. A non-cooperative Stackelberg game equilibrium and a cooperative game equilibrium are obtained. Finally , we develop coordination mechanism, a revenue-sharing contract, to coordinate the decentralized decision closed-loop supply chain.

articleTitle: Using Actor-Network Theory to Analyse the Competition between TD-SCDMA & WiMax
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates China's efforts to develop its indigenous standard - TD-SCDMA and mainly focuses on the subsequent competition between TD-SCDMA & WiMax. By drawing upon actor-network theory (ANT), two counter-networks are setup and the competitions on technology, IPR, industry chain are presented. Furthermore, the social and institutional elements that effected their respective commercialization in China are also considered. Finally, the possible compromises of the two and respective suggestions on Telecom policies are proposed.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: The Application of Genetic and Simulated Annealing Algorithm in FBG Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The genetic and simulated annealing algorithm (GASA) is used for optimizing the wavelength-division multiplexed (WDM) fiber Bragg gratings(FBGs) sensor network to detect wavelength detection accuracy of a few micro-strains even when the spectrums of FBGs are in partially or completely overlapped .The method could avoid some troubles of traditional methods ,such as arduous trial-and-error procedure , premature convergence in genetic algorithm(GA) and search blindness in simulated annealing algorithm(SA). Experiments show that the application of the GASA in the FBG sensor network can adjust the optimization population and seek the global optimal result .Experimental results demonstrated the strain wavelength detection accuracy up to 1muepsiv has been achieved and a linear response are presented. Also the method improves the calculation efficiency greatly.

articleTitle: Trends in Fiber Optics: Citation Analysis of the Fiber Optic SCI Papers (1974-2007)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We analyze thematic trends and challenging issues in fiber optics research based on the metadata of 4970 research papers indexed in Science Citation Index (SCI) database between 1974 and 2007. We specifically address 1) all-time prominent challenges in fiber optics, 2) a trend of progression in fiber optics 3) the structure and dynamics of the fiber optics community. We utilize CiteSpace, a progressive domain visualization tool, to identify and visualize the movement of research fronts and intellectual bases, persistent clusters of papers, and the evolution of co-authorship networks as well as citation networks. The result contributed an in-depth analysis of a major forum of fiber optics and a systematic and streamlined method to keep abreast of the history and the state of the research of fiber optics.

articleTitle: A Novel Bandwidth Degradation Scheme for Admission Control in IEEE 802.16e Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16e networks can be widely applied in broadband wireless access scenarios. Admission control is an essential mechanism in IEEE 802.16e networks to guarantee the QoS of different subscribers. In this paper, we propose a novel bandwidth degradation scheme for the admission control in IEEE 802.16e networks. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the performance of the proposed scheme in terms of service flow blocking rate and system bandwidth utilization.

articleTitle: A Multi Objective Fuzzy-Based Controller for Front Differential Vehicles by Electrical Traction System on Non-Driven Wheels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using electrical machine in conventional vehicles, also called hybrid vehicles, has become a promising control scheme that enables some manners for fuel economy and driver assist for better stability. In this paper, vehicle stability control, fuel economy and driving/regeneration braking for a 4 WD hybrid vehicle is investigated by using an electrical machine on each non-driven wheels. Fourteen degree of freedom vehicle body modeling and ADVISOR power-train/electrical components model will be used for modeling. Driving/regeneration and stability enhancement are important in low and high speed respectively. The unequaled independent torques applied to the non-driven wheels provides the ability of vehicle dynamic control to assist the driver with path correction, thus enhancing cornering and straight-line stability and providing enhanced safety. So power managing between engine and electrical machines will be provided the fuel economy and regeneration in braking condition. For these goals, power management and yaw moment control will be down in low and high speed respectively by proper fuzzy controller. Finally, a series of MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation will carried out to evaluate the performance of the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperation Profit Allocation in Three-Stage Supply Chain Based on Distribution Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, distribution channel revolution has brought about enormous channel organization form change. And the authority leader in channel may also change. Members in the downsteam supply chain struggle for the channel power and more cooperative profits during the cooperation, which seriously affects the efficiency and effectiveness of the whole channel, even the stability and evolution of supply chain. So it is necessary to allocate cooperative profit reasonably among members to improve the cooperative relationship between members and maintain the stability of supply chain. Based on the distribution channel structure change, this paper builds a profit allocation model of three-stage supply chain with mutidirection and principal-subordinate. It uses Stackelberg game to calculate the model. And it explains how every member's profit and channel profit change following the cooperation coefficient lambda. Then, according to the different situations economic meaning of lambda is analyzed. Finally, we find when lambda between 2/3 and 5/6, cooperation relationship is easy to build and develop.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Management Performance on Financial Risk in University
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of the essential connotation of university financial risk and the basic principles of setting up an index system, the evaluation index system of the management performance on financial risk in university has been established. It evaluates the management effect with the method of. It provides a scientific, practical and quantitative method for the systematic analysis and comprehensive evaluation of the management performance on financial risk in university.

articleTitle: A Global Time Synchronized MAC for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a TDMA-based Medium Access Control protocol (GMAC) for wireless sensor networks is proposed. We use global time synchronization and data gathering tree as the foundation of the protocol to form a contention free network for applications that sensors send packets to the sink. To assign time- slots and frequency channels for nodes, a distributed resource allocation strategy is designed. Furthermore, a MAC scheme is proposed to improve packet delivery reliability in the protocol. The simulations show that the protocol can reduce energy consumption and achieve higher reliability than contention-based protocols .

articleTitle: A New Dual-Band Filtering Method for Chirp Spread Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new dual-band filtering method for performance enhancement of the chirp spread spectrum (CSS) system in the IEEE 802.15.4a standard. The CSS signals are composed of low- and high-band signals which are alternatively transmitted in time. If we use only one conventional channel filter, the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) performance in the receiver is degraded, because the low- and high-band signals have a different frequency characteristics. The dual-band filtering method proposed in this paper is based on two filters which are designed to be matched well with alternatively received CSS signals and excludes the undesired noise.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligently Knowledge Integration Model of Industry Cluster in China Based on Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, research about knowledge diffusion and integration has attracted much attention. Many earlier studies argue that internal linkages are the main factors that influence innovative performance of firms operating within high-tech industry cluster, but as a matter of fact, external linkages are also important especially for clusters in developing countries. This paper investigates how a firm's external linkages have impact on its innovation performance of high-tech industry cluster. By the use of information fusion method, our basic hypothesis is that with the co-existence of high levels of both internal and external linkages, firms can extract more value for advanced innovative performance.

articleTitle: Mining Preferred Browsing Paths Based on Adjacency List Models
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mining preferred browsing paths from Web logs can help improve the structure of Web sites and increase the click-stream. In this paper, an algorithm of mining preferred browsing paths based on adjacency list model is proposed. The Web pages are denoted by vertexes of a directed graph and the topology structure of Web sites is represented by adjacency list models based on the support-preference concept. Moreover, preferred browsing paths are discovered by using depth first search method. Experimental results show that the algorithm can maintain accuracy but have better efficiency than the NPPMA algorithm does.

articleTitle: Study on Resources Location and Trading Techniques for Manufacturing Grid
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper has a discussion and research on resource trading techniques and methods for manufacturing grid (MG). It firstly introduces the economics roles of manufacturing gird. Then it analyses the relationship between different economics roles. And based on the framework of MG resource management system, upon the price-based economic theory and the game theory-based economic theory paper puts forward the matching service negotiation mechanism of economics model to realize the selection of economics model. Finally paper gives a resource bargain model for MG based on negotiation and illustrates the trading process of the model deeply. It is an effective resource trading method of economic model for MG. It gives a solution connecting MG to market.

articleTitle: Streaming Video in Cellular Networks Using Scalable Video Coding Extension of H.264-AVC
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Significant improvements have been demonstrated in video compression techniques while introducing H.264/AVC video coding standard. Scalable Video Coding (SVC) enables the extraction of appropriate partial bit streams to meet the specific target bit rate with lower temporal or spatial resolutions or quality while retaining a reconstruction quality that is high relative to the rate of the partial bit streams. With the limitation in network resources, mostly characterized by throughput variations, varying delay or transmission errors, adaptive bit rate of a video streaming, is desirable key features that need to be considered. Typically, in cellular networks the throughput, delay and errors of a connection depend on the current reception conditions, which are mainly influenced by a number of physical factors. In order to manage with the typically varying characteristics of cellular communication channels, efficient methods for enhancing robustness and achieving quality of service are desirable features. We will give an overview of SVC and its relation to delivery of video streaming in cellular networks having limited radio recourses. Moreover, various cases are discussed which apply SVC in cellular networks.

articleTitle: A New Fuzzy Adaptive Genetic Algorithm Based on Variance and Entropy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a improved genetic algorithm that was fuzzy adaptive genetic algorithm for solving premature convergence. In the new algorithm, it was the use of population variance and entropy to measure diversity of population, and in accordance with the each population of variance and entropy to design fuzzy reasoning system for adaptively controlling crossover probability and mutation probability. Through a multi-function optimization problems simulation, its results prove that this fuzzy adaptive genetic algorithm feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Block Holders, Investor Relations and Earnings Management: Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The listed companies in China are strongly controlled by large shareholders, and they have strong incentive to manage earnings upward by altering discretionary accruals to gain the rights issues and raise stock prices. This paper takes 397 2005-year firms in Shenzhen as sample, based on the modified Jones model, studies the association among discretionary accruals, the control of largest shareholder and investor relations. Results suggest that largest shareholder and discretionary accruals significantly positive correlated; higher level of investor relations, lower discretionary accruals; the level of investor relations can moderate the power of the block holders to expropriate outsider investors, and it can reduce the positive relations between equity concentration and discretionary accruals. For listed company of the different nature of the ultimate controller, its earnings management justified by the level of the investor relations impact is different. After a series of robust tests, the conclusions remained stability.

articleTitle: The Design of Folded Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Low cost, low profile and miniaturized size are the most critical factors needed to consider in the design of antennas for RFED applications. For maximum power transfer, the input impedance of the antenna must be the conjugate of input impedance of the ASIC. In this paper, we present a novel folded dipole antenna with a very simple configuration. The required input impedance can be achieved easily by choosing suitable geometry parameters. This is very useful to design antenna with special impedance.

articleTitle: A Joint Decision Model of Pricing and Inventory Control for a Distribution System in Apparel Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly introduces a distribution system, including one garment manufacturer and one retail store with the products entering into market by batch-wise in apparel industry. Under stochastic demand with price-elasticity, this paper studies price adjustment for twice. Then it gives the profit function of manufacturer and retail store separately, on the basis of this, constructs pricing and inventory profit-optimal decision model. In order to get an appropriate solution for distribution system member, the model is solved by numerical method under the condition that vendor is the leader in a Stackelberg game. Finally, we calculate with the actual date to study the value of the strategy and achieve the desired results.

articleTitle: Research on Fractal Tree RFID Tag Antenna on Papery Substrate
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the research of the fractal tree monopole antenna, fractal tree structure of dipole RFID tag antenna was proposed. Resonant frequencies, reflection coefficient and radiation patterns of fractal tag antennas were simulated with MoM, and a papery substrate tag antenna of the third iterated fractal tree is manufactured. The results of simulation and test showed that the space-filling feature of fractal antenna structure has been transformed to the size-reducing feature of RFID tag antenna effectively.

articleTitle: Joint Design of Distributed Power Control and Dynamic Channel Allocation in Scalable WLANs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Emerging high-density WLANs in urban areas and enterprises offer great potential to accommodate the anticipated explosion of demand for wireless data services. To make it successful, it is critical that the network utilizes the limited radio resources efficiently while satisfying predefined quality of service (QoS) requirements. In this paper, we develop a real time and open ended algorithm for joint design of dynamic channel allocation and distributed power control. We show that in the case of optimal channel allocation, the convergence property for power control is further strengthened. The simulation results show that the joint design can lead to substantial throughput improvement and power saving compared with the benchmark scheme, where channels are randomly allocated and transmit power is kept fixed.

articleTitle: Marketing for SME in Online Auctions Platforms
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Online auction is a field that is continuing to grow, and its concept may be defining a totally new and unique distribution alternative. Very few studies have noted online auction sellers and their internet marketing strategies. This research examines the marketing mix for SME in online auctions as it relates to the two-sided platforms. We found that there is great differentiation on marketing strategies. We analyzed characteristics of online auction and plan marketing mix strategies for SME running on such platforms.

articleTitle: Report for Simulation of Dynamic Periodic Location Area Update in Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In mobile telephony networks, the presence of a mobile station (MS) is detected through periodic location area updates (PLAU). A scheme was proposed in [1] to dynamically set the time interval for PLAU based on call activity and normal location area updates (NLAU). This paper is a discussion of the implementation and findings of a simulation of that scheme.

articleTitle: Cyclostationary LMS Beamforming Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conventional adaptive least mean square (LMS) algorithm has been utilized in array antenna beamforming to direct the radiated power towards the desired signal and null the multipath signals. In this paper, LMS algorithm is investigated for inputs from cyclostationary random processes. According to cyclostationarity of error signal, a novel cost function and recursive algorithm are presented and applied in beamforming. The simulation results indicate that the performances of the proposed algorithm are better than those of the conventional LMS algorithm and block LMS (BLMS) algorithm in respect of convergence rate and steady state mean square error.

articleTitle: The Mass Customization of Tourism Products Based on WEB2.0: A Collaboration Model by Both Enterprises and Tourists
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the tourism market, tourism enterprises provide the homogeneous products based on mass customization, which creates serious inequalities between supply and demand, which in turn leads directly to fall of related tourism enterprises' competitiveness. This paper studies the structural changes in tourist market under the current WEB2.0, it puts forward to construct a Mass Customization model of tourism products center through the "prosumer community" which is participated by the tourism enterprises and tourists jointly.

articleTitle: GA-Hopfield Network for Transportation Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the optimization of transportation problem of Wulongquan Mine, genetic algorithm and Hopfield network are integrated for solving transportation problems of stripping rock. The optimization methods of genetic algorithm in artificial neural network weight, structure and algorithm are introduced; and GA-Hopfield network method is established for solving transportation problems. In GA-Hopfield network method, global property of genetic algorithm and the parallelisms of artificial neural networks were combined, so the method remains the global stochastically searching ability of genetic algorithm and the robustness and self-learning ability of neural network The application of this method to the optimization of transportation problem of Wulongquan Mine has the advantages of calculation stabilization, prompt convergence and preferable precision. GA-Hopfield network method offers a research method and direction for solving the multi-objective transportation problem.

articleTitle: Using Filtration Mechanism of CORBA Notification Service in Network Management System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: CORBA notification service makes up shortages of event service in the communication reliability, QoS and filtration mechanism. This paper introduces some new characteristics in CORBA notification service such as structured event, filtration mechanism and QoS. A filtration mechanism is proposed to implement the event report while applying CORBA notification service based on push model in the network management system. The mechanism is more efficient in distinguishing different users and different events. Therefore, the transmission of event is more efficient, costs in processing are greatly decreased. The filtration mechanism based on CORBA notification service is not only applied in network management system, but also widely applied in other fields of CORBA notification service.

articleTitle: A Novel Cooperative NLOS Error Mitigation Method in Hybrid Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel mobile location method based on cooperative positioning using time-of-arrival (TOA) measurements to mitigate the impact of non-line-of-sight (NLOS) error in a hybrid cellular network is proposed. Our way to tackle the problem of NLOS error mitigation is divided into two steps: First, a technique is exploited to decide whether there is a NLOS path from the BS to the MS using range measurements sequence; Second, ad-hoc relaying stations (ARSs), which have single-hop line-of-sight (LOS) links with both the base stations (BSs) and the mobile station (MS), are included to establish a new position location scheme if NLOS error is present. Simulation results show that our proposed method can achieve location estimation accuracy enhancement and exhibit significant improvement over the conventional NLOS range reconstruction approach.

articleTitle: Efficiency Measurement of Financial Innovation System Based on Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The financial innovation system is one important part of the national financial system and plays a great role in harmonious development of finance and economy. Data envelopment analysis (DEA) is employed in empirical efficiency measurement of the financial innovation systems of thirty seven countries and regions in the world. It is shown that market-based financial systems are more favorable to financial innovation systems than bank-based financial systems; if financial outputs and economic outputs want to be increased, input of financial innovation system should be increased in developing countries with high growth and undeveloped finance.

articleTitle: Energy-Balancing Multicast Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, existing location- based multicast protocols deliver data packets to group members through static data paths, using the location information of group members. Routing paths in the data delivery paths are never changed unless topology changes. Therefore, the nodes on the routing paths can be dead owing to continuous energy consumption and thus the lifetime of network might be shortened. This paper proposes a dynamic location-based multicast protocol to balance the network energy consumption by changing the routing paths so that prolong the lifetime of wireless sensor networks. Finally, we prove performance improvement of our protocol on energy consumption by using simulations.

articleTitle: Applied Research on Risk Management in Mining Shaft Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Combining the engineering characteristics with actual practices in mining shaft construction project (short for MSCP), this paper analyses the main features of mine shaft construction projects. Via directly investigating some MSCP under building with emphases on risk identification and risk evaluation, this paper designs risk lists of MSCP, and makes a system evaluation to the identified risks bearing the characteristics of maneuverability, scientific and application. All of above can be used for reference to risk management of MSCP.

articleTitle: A Method of Evaluating the Emergency Response Capability of Emergency Plans
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper brings the thoughts of knowledge management to the field of emergency management, and proposes a brand-new method based on the matching of knowledge supply and demand to evaluate the emergency response capability of emergency plans. Firstly, this paper gives us the methods of abstracting the emergency knowledge demand from the work flow of emergency response and abstracting the emergency knowledge supply through performing rhetorical question on the contents of emergency plans, and then, takes the earthquakes for example to put forward the detailed flow of the knowledge supply-demand matching. Finally, the idea to locate the exact deficiencies of emergency plans is proposed. This evaluation method can not only get a comprehensive evaluation result which is similar to the traditional evaluation methods, even more important, it can also locate the exact deficiencies of emergency plans and help us to provide specific suggestions for relevant departments to revise and improve the plans.

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Sharing for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cognitive radio is a new technology which can sense the availability of local spare spectrum and be used to communicate with each other. In a multi-hop network consisted of cognitive radio nodes, the spectrum sharing for each cognitive radio node is very important. In real condition, as the number of users in different fixed regions is diverse, the dynamic spectrum sharing strategy should be dissimilar. This paper proposes a spectrum sharing strategy according to the number of users in a fixed region and the level of the quality of service (QoS). The simulation reveals that our strategy is more adaptive for the real condition than the traditional strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved Colony Clustering to Short-Term Forecasting in the Power System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an Improved Ant Colony Clustering (IACC) based on Ant Colony Algorithm is presented. In IACC, each load data was represented by an ant, and the merits of IACC were parallel search optimum and the dynamic method to adjust the evaporation coefficient, which can raise the forecast accuracy. IACC used the weighted Euclidean distance, and the residual pheromone quantity was calculated by the radius of the cluster and the weighted Euclidean distance, in the end, IACC ameliorated the warp error of the cluster canter. What's more, IACC was more sensitive to weather condition and date than the Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm (ACOA). The comparison between IACC and ACOA shows that IACC increased the short- term load forecasting (STLF) accuracy, and IACC is more exquisite to the similarity of load curve profile.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Contributions to Knowledge of the Staff Based on Performance Evaluation System for Project Management Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates how to establish a performance evaluation system mainly based on the knowledge contribution of the staff in the knowledge management information platform of project management enterprise. First, the necessity of creating knowledge-based enterprise was analyzed and many existing problems about how to value contribution to the knowledge of the staff were discussed in the current enterprise. Secondly, a performance evaluation system, which take the advantage of the existing information platform and used analytic hierarchy process and Delphi methods to value the knowledge contribution of the staff, was presented and established. Finally, it was completed with corresponding incentive measures. The investigation proves that the system was beneficial to effectively execute human resource management and knowledge management, and to enhance the enterprise's core competitiveness and sustainable development capability.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved Algorithm Based on IEEE802.11e EDCF Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Comparing with the IEEE 802.11 DCF mechanism, IEEE 802.11e Enhanced Distributed Coordination Function (EDCF) mechanism has been improved in many aspects for the increasing of the Quality of Service (QoS) in wireless networks. But there are still a few problems to be settled down in IEEE 802.11e EDCF backoff mechanism in which the transmission fairness should be improved further more. In this paper, we introduced a new algorithm that combined the algorithms of SD, MILD and FCR which may be named as SMFCR and it has been applied in the IEEE802.11e EDCF mechanism. By comparing the simulation results between EDCF and Improved EDCF, we find that, although the improved EDCF leads to a certain drop in the total network throughput, it has a great improvement in the aspect of fairness.

articleTitle: Reduced Complexity and Performance Comparison of The SISO-MMSE Receivers for MIMO Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An a posteriori probability (APP) detector for multiple antenna channels has presented in . It has the high advantage of providing good performance but has an NP complexity, we studied near capacity and near outage performance over multiple antenna channels thanks to optimized bit interleaved coded modulations (BICM) . We will now present a sub-optimal soft-input soft-ouput (SISO) detector based on the minimum mean square error (MMSE) criterion. Such a SISO-MMSE equalizer has been presented in the case of single antenna dispersive channel. We describe the direct application to MIMO channels and present supplementary complexity reductions. Comparison between the shifted list sphere decoder and the list sphere decoder centered on the received point. Performance comparison for equal performance - Performance comparison for equal complexity.

articleTitle: Knowledge Sharing Platform - Knowledge Processing Line and its Components
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Group knowledge sharing has been an ad hoc issue in knowledge management. Towards an efficient knowledge sharing platform, the Knowledge Processing Line (KPL) is developed which focuses on the problem solving and its modules. Such platform contains two main parts, one is Open Research Experiment Platform (OREP), which is a universal platform with all kinds of knowledge processing modules for knowledge workers to coordinate their knowledge, such as various types of data, algorithms and functional modules; the other is Knowledge Processing Line Manager (KPLM) which supports the integration of knowledge involved in the problem solving process for reference and reuse. Some applications have proved the effectiveness of the developed knowledge sharing platform.

articleTitle: An Agent-Based Framework for Matching Buyers and Sellers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores issues of electronic commerce as a key enabler to promote trade between buyers and sellers. The broker is processed to match buyers and sellers, which is significant in prompting the transactions between the two sides. This paper proposes an agent-based framework for matching buyers and sellers and uses the multi-objective optimization model to match sellers and buyers. The framework is processed in three layers: the interface layer, the matching layer and the database layer. The interface layer consists of buyer agents, seller agents and a broker agent. The matching layer is mainly to find the appropriate sellers to buyers. Based on the framework, a prototype system has been designed to illustrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Container Port Bilevel Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to analyze the behavior of every participant in decision making, the container transportation business process will be introduced. Furthermore, container transport supernetwork equilibrium models are established. Then it extends from the dynamic Stackelberg Game Model to EPEC (Equilibrium Problem with Equilibrium Constraints) model, in which the upper layer ports go on non-cooperation competition while the lower layer shippers compete for the path of minimum expense. Finally, a diagonalization algorithm is employed to obtain equilibrium solution.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerant Topology Control for Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In most clustered topology control algorithms of sensor networks, all the sensor nodes are clustered and the network backbone is formed by cluster head nodes and gateway nodes, while cluster nodes keep sleeping to reduce energy cost. A fault- tolerant topology control algorithm based on clustered sensor nodes is proposed in this paper, which is termed as KCCTC (K- Connected cluster topology control protocol for wireless sensor network). The main content of the KCCTC algorithm is the procedure of the clusters forming, which includes the selection of backbone nodes, redundant nodes and sleeping scheduling of cluster nodes. In the selection of backbone nodes, energy balancing, channel quality, nodes fault and mobility are taken into account in this paper. The simulation results show that the algorithm has a better performance in network topology stability and lifetime.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation Method for Networked Motion Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networked motion control system is a type of realtime system with limited network bandwidth and deadlines. Its performance not only depends on the design of control algorithm but also on the message scheduling. Because the mathematical optimization method is difficult to be used online, a dynamic bandwidth allocation method based on actual performance is proposed. Then according to the optimized bandwidth allocation, the sampling period is recomputed and the optimized system performance is obtained.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on New Generation Worker's Organizational Commitment, Motivation, Work Outcomes and HRM Strategic implications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although organizational commitment is increasingly regarded as a vital work-related attitude of enhancing employee's psychological attachment to the organization, it has also precluded an in-depth examination of particular inputs and configurations to individual attitudes and behaviors in workplace. Drawing upon social exchange theory, a model of new generation worker's organizational commitment and its work outcomes in term of job satisfaction and turnover intention was developed and tested using a sample of 392 employees working in Pearl River Delta of China. This model predicts that individual's need for growth and existence, job characteristics (skill variety, task identity, task significance, autonomy, and feedback), and perception of organizational politics have direct effects on organizational commitment. Results show the social exchange variables are strong predictors of organizational commitment and work outcomes. Implications of these findings and directions for future research are provided.

articleTitle: Study on the Vehicle Management and Control Information System Integration of Vehicle Transportation Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To meet the need of vehicle management and control in the vehicle transportation enterprise, the paper puts forward the strategy and configuration model of system integration based on the middle layer, discusses general function of the integrated system, conversion and update of the integrated information, and the solution to working process of integration control.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Loyalty Based on Winning Back Lost Customers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Our purpose of this study is to examine the relationship among price promotion, calculated commitment and customer loyalty. The fieldwork was conducted in the hotel industry, in Sichuan, Yunnan and Zhejiang Province of China (N = 1074). Via SEM analysis, the authors attempt to explore the inherent mechanisms on the formation of customer loyalty and reveal the deep-seated reasons for companies' dilemma caused by price promotion strategies. This study also provides useful suggestions for managers in charge of customer win-back management.

articleTitle: Metamodel Approach on Model Conformance and Multiview Consistency Checking
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: MDA is an approach that using modeling languages such as UML or BON to establish requirement models for the complementary of software specification, as well as for further implementation. However, models of complex information systems always require multiple views, such as static views and dynamic views to describe different perspectives of the system, thus may cause inconsistency between them. In this paper, we proposed a metamodel in which provides a unifying framework to ensure and check for model consistency, and we use B, a full spectrum formal software development method, as our foundation to specify our approach. In our approach, single view conformance checking and multiview consistency checking are separated, and we would give examples for demonstration.

articleTitle: Panel Data Analysis of the FDI Spillover Effect on Economic Growth of 12 Asian Countries
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using cross-section data relating to a sample of 12 Asian developing countries with relative higher FDI inflows from 1980-2005, we show that FDI by itself contributes to the economic growth. But the regression result of the inward FDI flows as a percentage of Gross Fixed Capital Formation, that is, the variable SHARE is not so robust related to the economic growth. Other factors also work in the economic growth.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Optimization of Cutting Parameters for Titanium Alloy's Machining
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In metal cutting, optimal cutting parameters are greatly preferred to achieve the trade-off between cost, efficiency and quality. The cutting parameters for both rough machining and finishing of titanium alloy were optimized with fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. The orthogonal experiments were designed with four factors at four levels. A multiple objective model considered for material remove rate, cutting force and surface roughness was built. The optimal values of cutting parameters are compatible with analysis of theory and reality. With the computerization of fuzzy rules, a fuzzy expert system of titanium alloys' machining was developed.

articleTitle: Electricity Industry Value Creation Strategies Based on E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-commerce represents a new way of conducting business transactions. The unique characteristics of e-commerce make it a potential value driver for electricity companies who have to focus on value creation after experienced significant structural changes. Creating value with e-commerce needs proper strategies. In this paper, we discuss three strategic alternatives for electricity companies: strengthening the supply chain, increasing product and service profile, and redefining the relationship with customers by cyber auctions.

articleTitle: Financing Strategy, Shareholder Value Creation Over Firms Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate on the capital structure especially on the external finance source. We also try to find out the correlation between the leverage and the shareholder value creation. We focus our study on the corporate life cycle that is nowadays very used in finance work. The paper employs the comparative analysis and the statistical technique of Pearson's correlation analysis. We find that the start-up and growth firms in their financing strategy rely on the equity financing. Inversely mature firms rely on debt financing. Moreover we have found for the start-up firms, there is a positive correlation between the shareholder value creation and the financial leverage though the magnitude of the relation is very small while for the growth firms and mature firms the relationship turns to be the inverse. We draw the conclusion that the overall objective when designing the optimal mixture of financing instruments is to keep investors and lenders satisfied. Lenders would want companies to issue equity because it makes them safer. Shareholders would want companies to issue more debt because it disciplines managers to effectively manage the corporation in a way to ensure value creation.

articleTitle: Efficient Id-Based Threshold Signature in P2P and MANETs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Threshold cryptography distributes the ability to provide a cryptographic service such as decryption or signing. It is an ideal choice to provide security services, such as authentication and access control, in MANETs or P2P systems. The paper proposes an ID- based threshold signature scheme, which has three attractive properties: (1) The user's co-signing key and signature share are all verifiable, which make the scheme robust. (2) The signature share ps<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> is constant and has small size; it does not lengthen with the increase of the group members. (3) The process of generating signature share pS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> is non-interactive, so it does not require a synchronous communications network. So the scheme can be efficiently used in providing security services in MANETs.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Sustainable Development Capability for Thermal Power Plant under Market Competition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The sustainable development of enterprise makes up an important part of the sustainable development of society. Influencing factors of five areas, including political and economic condition, natural resources, integrated competition, social effects and environmental impact, are considered to work out comprehensive evaluation index system for power plant. Using analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to estimate the capability of the sustainable development help the enterprise to make social or temporal comparison and potentiality exploitation and to improve management and capability of the sustainable development.

articleTitle: A Tiered Replication Model in Embedded Database Based Mobile Geospatial Information Service
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the EDBMGIS (Embedded Database Based Mobile Geospatial Information Service) architecture application, the data of embedded database in the mobile terminal is duplicated from the server. After a period's system operation, data in both the mobile client and server will be changed. In order to keep the data consistency, the synchronization of data on both side is discussed in this paper. In addition, a tiered replication model which is put forward to solve the synchronization problem under 3-tier replication architecture (Mobile client- Synchronization Server - Database Server).This model utilizes a novel double timestamp strategy to promote the efficiency of synchronization. Besides, it ensures serializability and consistency of the mobile database system through transaction-level conflict reconciliation.

articleTitle: A New Routing Protocol Based on Improving the Performance in Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The source routing (DSR) protocol is a commonly applied protocol in ad hoc network. As the expansion of network, the efficiency of DSP protocol is on the decline due to the increasing network complexity and overhead. To enhance the performance of DSR, release network congestion, balance network energy and improve scalability, this paper has introduced modification to the outgoing package structure of RREP and RREQ. A new protocol IDSR has been introduced with new sending delay mechanism, and the performance of this refined IDSR routing protocol has been evaluated by simulation.

articleTitle: Information Model of Holonic Virtual Enterprise Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Next generation of Web services aim at providing whole solution by composition of distributed services. In this paper, the information model of product family for message transfer in SIMS based on Web services is given. By analysis of Web services in SIMS of HVE, the message body structure is designed. By use of XML the supply information of product family in mass customization are expressed. Finally, the MCGBOM, MCGSPG and their description language are designed for machine processing.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Customer's Online Initial Trust Production Model Based on Consumer's Perception
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: B2C e-commerce brings many advantages for online consumers. Meanwhile online consumers face much more uncertainty in B2C e-commerce. Customers' perception has direct effect on customers' online initial trust and purchasing intention. Furthermore, customers' perception affects consumer's acceptance of B2C e-commerce. According to customer's perception about B2C e-commerce's usefulness, ease of use and risk, this paper sets up a consumer's initial trust production model based on customer's perception and puts forward 6 hypotheses. A survey was carried out and 102 valid questionnaires were colleted to test the model above. The result shows that customer's online initial trust were significantly affected by consumer's perception about B2C e-commerce's usefulness, ease of use and risk. Moreover, consumer's risk propensity also affect customer's online initial trust.

articleTitle: Dynamic Fast Authentication and Authorization During Inter-Domain Mobility
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile technologies made their headway by offering more flexibility to end-users and improve the productivities. Many businesses have quickly adopted them so as to gain and sustain a competitive edge, especially in global roaming. Within the application of ubiquitous access and pervasive communication, security, privacy and QoS becomes a critical issue during global mobility, particularly in getting smooth and seamless mobile services by decreasing handover latency. Based on single sign on and the context transfer protocol, this paper proposes a dynamic fast authentication and authorization scenario during inter-domain mobility, that can save one trip communication time consummation between administrative domains.

articleTitle: Environmental Cost Accounting of Thermal Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper studied environmental cost accounting of thermal power plant. The difficulty lies in the accounting of the environmental damage costs. According to the characters of thermal power enterprises, the paper set up some accounting models on environmental damage cost, such as the shadow price model, human capital model, opportunity cost model and production function model. Through analyzing these models, we found that due to difficulties in collecting data and using a variety of accounting methods, the process of accounting tends to be complicated, and the results are always differences in a same place. This paper put forward decomposition method of environmental accounting. At first, divide the pollution discharge into controlled and uncontrolled, the part controlled will spent cost, which is the direct environmental cost. To the part uncontrolled, we value its damage according to the treatment cost by the society. This method can reduce the data demand and simplify calculating process. So it has a great practicality.

articleTitle: Construction of Evaluation System for Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Constructing and managing an information system (IS) is a highly complex and difficult system project. It is a problem which is needed to be solved that how to measure the value which is brought to the enterprise by IS and how to make IS bring more value to enterprise. The research's emphases is the IS in enterprise. It will focus on the measurement of value the IS brings to the enterprise even to the society, and on how to evaluate IS in enterprise. Based on the analysis of the existing evaluation methods, we will find the shortages of current IS evaluation methods and construct a better evaluation system for IS.

articleTitle: Study on the Automotive Industrial Upgrading in China Based on Global Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Automotive industry is one of the pillar industries for our country. As the world's third largest car manufacturer behind U.S. and Japan, China is narrowing the gap with first echelon with an annual growth of over 20 percent. But it should not be ignored that our automotive industry is still at an infant stage. Based on the theory of global value chain and industrial upgrading, this paper analyzed the parts of global automotive industry value chain and put forward some suggestions for our country's automotive industrial upgrading. Chinese auto manufacturers should seek suitable niche in global automotive value chain to develop and upgrade, and move towards more profitable, more capital- and skill-intensive section along the global automotive value chain step by step.

articleTitle: Trusted Management for Mobile Computing Entities Enabled by Fuzzy Logic Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the mobile computing environments, such as the mobile agent system, the management for the distributed mobile entities is complicated. Some characteristic information in this environment is uncertain and could not be presented by accurate value. The fuzzy logic provides the technology to deal with this condition. This paper presents a method for trusted management of entities in mobile computing environment. A model system based on fuzzy logic rules is designed. The mechanism of the system is described and the experiment results are analyzed.

articleTitle: Theme-Based Query Expansion by Mining Log Data
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Queries committed to the search engines are usually short. They usually contain insufficient information to the IR system. Previous research has proposed the utilization of query expansion to deal with this problem. However, expansion terms are usually determined on term co-occurrences within documents.
