Sometimes the expansion terms don't represent the user's real intent. In this study, we propose a novel method for query expansion based on mining the user's intent through the click-through data. The users log builds the bridge between the queries and the user's intent. The experimental results show that the theme-based query expansion method can produce much better results than the classical search method.

articleTitle: Analysis on Server Marketplace in the Network Game Industry Based on the View of Game Theory and Hotelling Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, network game (also called on-line) industry has made great progress. Plenty of network game companys have earned good money, but there is a very important problem that threatened the prosperity of network game industry, the problem is called "illegal-server" problem. In this paper, firstly, I put forward several Base Basic assumptions in order to make a hotelling model to analyze this problem; secondly, I use Game theory to expatiate the reaction of the players and the providers under such circumstance that specific of player preference distribution is unknown; lastly ,I bring forward lots of social and economic policy suggestions to cope with the problem, these suggestions are feasible and helpful to promote network game industry.

articleTitle: Delay Performance Analysis on Pure Relay and Cooperative Transmission
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It has been well known that cooperative transmission provides a new scheme to implement MIMO spatial diversity and multiplexing in wireless networks, thus tradeoff between cooperative spatial diversity and multiplexing becomes a very important issue. In this paper, we propose to analyze the system delay behavior considering the difference between spatial diversity and multiplexing, in viewpoint of viewpoint of a pure relay system and cooperative transmission system. Theoretic analysis and simulation results show that, while a pure relay system tend to have much small processing delay, cooperative transmission systems are capable of deduce system delay to even smaller when the amount of messages exchange over the partner nodes is reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Finance Based on Ecommerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper makes a discussion on supply chain finance from the angle of commercial banking business service in E-commerce environment. First of all, supply chain is briefly introduced, E-commerce is introduced too, and then impact of E-commerce on supply chain management, supply chain finance and its solution are emphatically discussed based on epsiv-commerce. Coming up is the research on designs and processes for account receivable financing.

articleTitle: Network Structure to Tree Structure: A New Method of Project Risk Management Decision
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A project usually has several or more combination schemes of implementation. Different schemes have different advantages and disadvantages because the risk elements exist in the project implementation. How to judge the advantages and disadvantages of the schemes is very important for the project management. This paper presents a method to use the tree structure chart to make the combination schemes of the project more clear and concise. At the same time, it considers the risk elements exist in the project implementation which influent the project implementation, and the values of indexes about every activities in the project is given by expert scoring method, the values of every indexes about the project are also calculated according to the tree structure chart. The advantages and disadvantages of every schemes of project can be acquired. It is more useful and concise for the planning and decision making of the project risk management. At the end of the paper, an example is presented to prove the practicability of the method.

articleTitle: Coordinative Development Model of Resource Environment and Socio-Economic Environment and its Application: A Case Study in the Hengdian Town
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The process by which the resource environment interacts with the socioeconomic environment is one complex system composed of society, economy, resource and environment. In this process, the resource environment-socioeconomic environment system, as a whole, is a grey system. Based on the analysis of the developmental changes in a specific small town resource environment, and the relationship between the resource environment and the socioeconomic environment, this paper formulates a model of coordinative development within the grey system theory. Taking the Hengdian town-a national sustainable development experimental unit in the Zhejiang province of China as an example, the study concludes that the resource environment and the socioeconomic environment in the Hengdian town showed a trend towards coordinative development between the years 2000 and 2006. This conclusion accords with the actual development status of the Hengdian town, thereby demonstrating the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Knowledge Transfer Risks in Collaborative Innovation Based on Extension Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Collaborative innovation is an important means to enhance the competitiveness and the vitality of enterprises in the 21st century, and is an effective way to create and accumulate knowledge. The key risk factors are analyzed for the one of knowledge transfer and a matter- element model of risks is built by the extension method, and then through practical research, an application method is provided. The comprehensive assessment method for knowledge transfer risks in collaborative innovation is raised, which provides a kind of new idea and method for enterprise risk decision.

articleTitle: Oil & Gas Exploration Project Evaluation and Ranking Methods and Software Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Regional exploration, trap exploration and reservoir evaluation exploration are three phases of an exploration process. Each phase confronts a problem of evaluating and ranking many exploration projects, and then selecting the optimal ones. The projects of different phase are quite different from each other, so evaluation and ranking methods must be chosen on the base of the divergence of each exploration process. Entity method and value method are two kinds of methods of evaluating and ranking exploration projects. Entity method is based on physical index like amount of exploration investment, workload, proved reserves. It is used only for preliminary optimal selection, and it cannot directly reflect the beneficial results of exploration projects. Value method is based on the discounted cash flow method, and optimal selection of projects is after economic evaluation. Value index reflects investment benefit directly and projects are ranked according to the computational solutions. The software basing on evaluation and ranking methods, which was developed with the Microsoft OWC controls. Programming work is easy because of the using of OWC, and it is accurate in calculation. The software can be used for rapid evaluation and ranking of large amounts of projects.

articleTitle: A NSE Based Real-time Hybrid Simulation Approach for Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid simulation approach for ad hoc network based on NS-2 emulation, which can provide the ability for real-world traffic to interact with a simulation. By adjusting hybrid network parameters according to the real network, we analyze the effect of different parameter settings in various experiments and compare the results with measurements in a real network. The results show that our method enhances the authenticity of simulation with a good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Research of Service Quality Based on Process
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Performance evaluation research of service quality based on process is a common concern of the service performance management. Based on process management of service organization, the principles of performance evaluation research of service quality and logical relationship of performance evaluation system was put forward. Based on these, performance evaluation model of service quality was set up. Moreover, a case study is also provided. Finally, the important function of service quality performance research based on process for service organization is pointed out.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Layer Protocol Based on Link Contention Sensing for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless ad hoc networks, the over-fast growth rate of TCP congestion window is one of the main factors that lead to frequent link contention and routing failure. Based on recent research, this paper proposes a cross-layer design protocol that adaptively adjusts routing failure verifying policy and TCP congestion window growth rate based on link contention state sensing. Simulation results show that this cross-layer design protocol notability improves the system throughput and decreases the network delay, on the other hand, it is fit for different traffic load over different topology networks.

articleTitle: Dimension of Global Attractor for Strongly Damped and Driven Lattice Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the upper bound of the Hausdorff dimension of a global attractor for the discretized strongly damped and driven wave equation under the Neumann and periodic boundary condition is studied for any space dimension. We show the obtained Hausdorff dimension is independent of the mesh size k and keeps bounded for large strongly damping.

articleTitle: Research on CHAID Decision Tree Model Based on Rating of China's Small Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The small enterprise loan business of China has become a problem which has to be settled urgently and thus aroused the research on the small enterprise rating methods. There is a variety of exposure types under the New Basel Agreement, among which the exposure types of company are not applicable in the actual situation of China's small enterprises. Because of small enterprise scale, low loan line and small risk influence on the single transaction, and risk types having the characteristics of retail-exposure, so the small enterprises can be treated as a category of retail-exposure. Meanwhile, the credit of the small enterprises can be scored by the CHAID classification tree model in the data mining method, so as to reflect the probability of contract breach by the score table and rate the small enterprises. The article is to provide an idea for the methods of rating the small enterprises by realizing the method. The result has shown that this method has certain actual significance.

articleTitle: Innovation of Large-Scale Project Multi-Programme Construction Management Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A large-scale project is considered as a multi- programme which is a multi-level programme consisting of programmes of several levels. According to the logic relations among the projects, programme can be classified into serial multi-programme, synchro-concurrent multi-programme and asynchro-concurrent multi-programme. Based on this classification, the execution of concurrent engineering within a multi-programme is analyzed, and a project management mode for an integrated programme team is proposed.

articleTitle: Real-Time Traffic Information Service Based on Mobile Locating Service
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Location Based Service has wide market prospect; especially real-time traffic information service is becoming the research hot pot home and abroad. In recent years a series of study on Location Based Service have made by some researchers, but none is found to make use of mobile phones' location to acquire the traffic information. The major contribution of this paper is to originally introduce Location and Speed Based Traffic Information Service (LSBTIS). In this paper, LSBTIS is discussed from four aspects including present research situation, implementing principle, advantages and market prospect.

articleTitle: A Study on Technological Knowledge Internalization of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Technological knowledge is a critical asset of enterprises, enterprise usually acquires knowledge either by self- creation or by transferring from outside. From viewpoint of knowledge management, the paper analyzes the characteristics of technological knowledge and flows in transferring technological knowledge, and inquires into knowledge from outside how to be acquainted, absorbed, utilized, shared in the organization, and made it into organizational knowledge.

articleTitle: Hoteling Model with Stackelberg Game Under Uncertain Consumer Preference
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In hotelling model with Stackelberg game, the paper introduces uncertain consumer preference and research its effect on firms competitive strategy. According to the equilibrium results, market leader obtain higher market price and profit than that of market follower under uncertain consumer preference; Comparing result under certain consumer preference, uncertainty increases product equilibrium price, profit, differentiation and social welfare.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Network Security Management Policy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For purpose of managing network security policy duly and flexibly in the complex network environment, and resolving its issue efficiency, this paper proposes network security policy self-adaptive management and distribution model. An incident triggered, policy-driven and self-adaptive management mechanism is established, and the impact of safety equipment or user requests, such as system resources found on the flow control can be calculated automatically. The distribution model is given to response policy request rapidly, take the appropriate policy dissemination methods, and reduce PDP computing tasks, system resource consumption, as well as between the PDP and PEP data transmission volume, which introduces the concepts of issue affecting factors, security domain addresses allocation, etc. The effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithms is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Supplier Management Basing on Service Optimization in Automotive Supply Chain of China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supplier management is an important problem with strategic meaning in the automotive supply chain of China. However, the complexity of the auto product makes difficulty of the supplier management in the auto industry. From the view of cooperation and collaboration, the essence of the supplier management is analyzed and the concept of supplier service optimization is proposed in this paper. Also, the whole process of supplier management basing on service optimization is summarized, including supplier selection, task distribution, performance evaluation and decision adjustment. The ability evaluation index system for supplier selection is established from four aspects of finance, development, technology and service. Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and goal programming are combined together in the method model to help achieve service optimization in the supplier management. The efficiency and feasibility of the method is proved by the case study. Lastly, some discussions and conclusions are made for supplier management in the automotive supply chain of China.

articleTitle: Balanced Power Control in Uplink MIMO-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a balanced power control scheme for the uplink of cellular MIMO system. The problem of coordinating power consumption reduce with raise in capacity simultaneously is formulated and an efficient algorithm with good performance is derived. Convex optimization method is used to solve the question. In this paper, an adaptive power allocation scheme is proposed by using interior-point method. Simulation results show that the proposed approach, compared to the optimal water-filling algorithm, actually achieves significantly lower total power consumption with similar performance in throughput.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Location Service with Social Feature
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Location based service can easily locate mobile station's position, which becomes a tool for connecting the virtual world and real environment. But current location service can notify user only bases on the location or time period. In real world, when people use location service, they always need some kind of help more than just know the position. So a traditional location based service can't fit user's demand very well. As it is well known, people are in some kind of relationships, which can help people when they are in difficulty. So in this study, the author will add some social features in the location based service. Some efforts will be taken to do some social functions in pure location service. An enhance location service with Web2.0 feature in it will be proposed. The architecture, key function principle and the privacy issue will also be presented. Moreover, a demo of the idea will be presented in the paper, using an ISG Parlay Simulator to implement a enhance location based service.

articleTitle: Research on Key Issues in System Decoupling for Service Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper explored some key points on decoupling of service systems in achieving mass customization by conducting a case analysis in Chinese restaurant. It justified the effectiveness of system decoupling in achieving purpose of mass customization and reveals how to make the decoupling decisions by balancing multiple operational objectives. Technologies especially the IT, as it further indicates, play a vital role for system decoupling in delivering mass customized services and however should be carefully adopted.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Inter-Organization Learning in Regional Innovation System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge has become important resource of enterprise in the knowledge economy age. That enterprises acquire external knowledge and accumulate knowledge through inter-organization learning has become important research subject of organizational learning theory. Through establishing two stages of learning benefit modes, this paper makes game equilibrium analysis on inter-organization learning under the condition with or without difference in learning ability, then gets the equilibrium condition of carrying out inter-organization learning, and discusses the dynamic relation among knowledge sharing level, enterprise learning ability and learning benefit.

articleTitle: AIMD-TCP-Friendly Rate Control Over Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multimedia applications have been widely developed. These applications use TCP-friendly congestion control mechanisms. One of the congestion control mechanisms which multimedia applications use is the TCP-friendly rate control (TFRC). This mechanism is designed for wired networks which any packet loss indicates congestion loss and the sending rate is reduced correspondingly. In this paper, we propose an AIMD-TFRC mechanism over datagram congestion control protocol (DCCP) for improving the performance over wireless networks. The basis of our mechanism is same as TFRC but AIMD-TFRC does not use the TCP equation throughput for calculating the sending rate. Our proposed mechanism uses the capability of explicit congestion notification (ECN) marking packet by random early detection (RED) queue management scheme in routers to detect congestion. In addition, it uses AIMD mechanism for calculating the sending rate. The increase or decrease of the sending rate is based on the congestion that is detected according to the receipt of marked packets within the time when two acknowledgment packets are created.

articleTitle: Human Resources Management Based on the Coevolution
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The evolution of employees and firms is a process of interactive coevolution. This paper uses logistic model to prove the coevolution can make employees and firms break though the existing capacity constraints and gain further development and evolution. In order to improve the coevolution between employees and firms, it is necessary for managers to understand the nature of human resources and coevolution between employees and firms, combine with the rule of law, ethics and love, pay attention to the psychological contract of employees, lay stress on the recruitment of the talent, attach importance to positive and negative effects resulted from the training of employees and do emotional investment to create harmonious emotional environment to elude its risk.

articleTitle: On the Effect of Organization Structure on Group Decision and Collaboration Decision
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to study the organization structure affected the last decision making of organization was one of the most difficult problems in the management science. This paper was to indicate that how to affect two important decision making, which are the group decision making and the collaboration decision making, through their structure. This was working theory which was based on the idea of complexity such as decision making process, mechanisms and approaches. And then, the some regulation models were established by a case about the command control decision making design, and some approaches of optimization solution were given. Lastly, compared with the effects which two decision making structure modes impacted last decision making was. As a result, the effect of the collaboration decision making was more complex than that of the group decision making.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Provably Secure IBE Scheme with Short System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we build a new identity-based encryption scheme, which has short system parameters and is provably secure in the random oracle model. Comparing with the identity-based encryption scheme proposed by gentry, we all has short system parameters, but in contrast the security of our identity-based encryption scheme based on a stronger and commonly used assumption, namely bilinear decision Diffie-HelIman assumption. So informally, our identity-based encryption scheme is more secure. At last, by comparing the degree of reduction with the identity-based encryption scheme proposed by Boneh and Franklin, we can show that our scheme is efficient too.

articleTitle: Systematic Research on Adaptive NBI Cancellation of Wideband Wireless Links
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Some wideband wireless links such as unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and satellite links have much wider bandwidth than that of high power natural or artificial interference. An idea of adaptive narrow band interference (NBI) cancellation based on different algorithms and structures aiming at wideband wireless links where bandwidth of interference is relatively narrow is posed here. All these theoretically feasible adaptive NBI cancellation schemes are simulated and tested based on different environmental parameters according to the real links. Moreover, performances of different adaptive NBI cancellation schemes are compared with each other.

articleTitle: Research on Central Distribution Center Location Model under Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the specific feature of distribution center under electronic commerce, this paper establishes the central distribution center location model under electronics commerce. Then it applies the model to an example and compares the results of the traditional logistics distribution center's single-objective model and the new central distribution center's mufti-objective model. It shows the new model is more comprehensive and more thorough consideration.

articleTitle: Mobile Target Localization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To localize mobile target timely and improve the accuracy of the target state estimation in wireless sensor networks, this paper presents a novel mobile target localization algorithm. By using the mean shift algorithm to construct the proposal distribution to make use of the current measurements, and weighting particles according to the virtual hamming distances in the particle filter, this proposed algorithm improves the accuracy of the target state estimation and reduces the necessary number of samples. It has lower computation and communication cost than the conventional particle filter because of more accurate state estimate of samples. Extensive simulation results confirm that this localization scheme outperforms conventional particle filter and its localization accuracy is comparable to the unscented particle filter, but its computation cost is 50% less than that of UPF.

articleTitle: Market Timing and Capital Structure: Evidence from Shenzhen Market in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates the market timing hypothesis of capital structure for listed firms in Shenzhen over the 2002- 2007 period. We use yearly timing (YT) in Kayhan and Titman(2007)'s study as a measure of market timing which separates growth opportunities from historical market-to-book ratio (external finance weighted historical market-to-book ratio, EFWAMB). We find capital structure is inversely related to yearly timing, but not significant. The result shows that market timing in Shenzhen market doesn't have a persistent impact on the capital structure. This is inconsistent with Baker and Wurgler(2002)'s conclusion that market timing has a long-lasting effect on capital structure but consistent with Kayhan and Titman(2007) and Bie and Haan(2007)'s conclusions. The reason may be that there is market friction in time and approach aspects while China firms make use of market timing.

articleTitle: A Distributed Route Structure Based on IPv6 in P2P System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A hierarchy distributed route structure based on IPv6 address in peer to peer systems is proposed in order to solve the problems that physical topology and logical network does not match so as to inefficient search in distributed hash table at present. By building node identifier using IPv6 address and hashing different level clustering identifier to set up hierarchy route, near nodes in physical network are closer in overlay. Smaller hops across domain, lower search latency, and higher efficiency are proved.

articleTitle: Adaptive Blind Doppler DOA Estimate Algorithm Based on Doppler Orthogonalized
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new method is proposed to provide to estimation direction arrival of signal received without any Doppler frequency information. The paper propose and analyze a new algorithm called adaptive blind Doppler estimate algorithm based on Doppler orthogonalized. The efficient of algorithm is confirmed by theory analyze and computer simulations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Festival Experience: An Analysis of Value Dimensions, Perceived Value and Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: CEO Power on Corporate Performance in Chinese Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper examines the CEO power on corporate performance in Chinese market from 1999 to 2004. The empirical results indicate that CEO power and corporate performance are positively related, but CEO power and performance variability are negatively related. This conclusion is not consistent with Adams, RB.'s, because of the particularity of Chinese market system. Based on the conclusion, we suggest some solutions which combine the restraint and incentive mechanism to the high concentration of CEO power.

articleTitle: A Reliable Routing Algorithm in Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To provide reliable transmission in wireless ad hoc networks, two problems need to be solved. The first one is to find reliable routes for packets transmission. And the second one is to re-route packets as soon as possible when route failures occur. Aiming at solving these two problems, this paper proposes a reliable routing algorithm called QDSR by making two improvements to DSR. Integrating ETX (expected transmission count) into DSR, QDSR can ignore links that are apt to break down and can find high-throughput paths on multi-hop wireless networks. The new route recovery mechanism used in QDSR can help salvage packets from the failure node instead of initiating route discovery from the source node again. Simulation results demonstrate that the number of inefficient routes picked out by QDSR is much less than that in DSR, even if there are route failures, QDSR can recovery the route as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Reliability Modeling Stochastically in Electronic Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article proposes methods for modeling supply chain reliability stochastically in electronic environment. On Internet today, a supply chain becomes very complex, as simultaneously connecting the supplier, the manufacturer, the distributor and the user. Therefore, we had to consider the situation of many suppliers to many demanders instead of single to many or many to single under the electronic commerce environment. A new reliability model is promoted based on graph theory and the model supports several types of reliability evaluation of the complex supply chain. Examples in several distribution of specific analysis are illustrated.

articleTitle: Start-Up Capital Structure and its Influencing Factors: A Case of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) make a significant contribution to the development of productivity of China. This paper aims to explore the start-up capital structure and its influencing factors in Chinese SMEs. The empirical results reveal that in the start-up stage start-up capital relies heavily on owners' self-financing, lack of sufficient external finance. Results also suggest that the resulting structure of start-up capital for SMEs will be the consequence of a mixture of factors including internal and external environment factors. So the channels to solve the problem should be related to the factors.

articleTitle: The Synthetic Evaluation of Electricity Target Markets Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to accommodate the demand of electricity market and do effective evaluation, we establish the index system of evaluation, and the model based on support vector machine (SVM).The synthetic evaluation of electricity target markets in B region, proves the model is feasible and effective, shows this method can improve the evaluation precision and has good spread ability.

articleTitle: Research on Based on Ant Colony Algorithm Dynamic Product Configuration Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper the defeat of product configuration method based the problem of restriction- satisfied is analyzed. Aiming to the problem of low quality of solution, big algorithm space and low computing speed, a dynamic product configuration method based on ant colony algorithm is proposed. This method adopts ambiguous integrated judgment and other algorithm to build the filter at first. Then, through the filter, the proper sequence based on components node from the need of client and contiguous matrix are built dynamic for the logic space structure and restriction link built for the component of optimized configuration of product. The dimensions of algorithm space are lowed. From the ant colony algorithm, the optimized configuration is built and the need of client is feed. Final the feasibility and availability is approved from the instance.

articleTitle: Channel-Tolerant OFDM System for an Underwater Acoustic Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As is well known, the robust and reliable acoustic communication in adverse littoral water is a very challenging task. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is a promising technique for achieving high speed rate and combating multi-path fading in underwater acoustic communication. In this paper, the basic principle of OFDM system is firstly introduced. Then a channel estimation method based on pilot symbol assisted modulation (PSAM) is studied. Finally, the experiment results are presented to compare the channel estimation performance of three pilot patterns. It is concluded that the comb pilot pattern is not suitable for complex underwater acoustic channel.

articleTitle: An Effective Signature Scheme Based on Tate Pairing for Mobile Business
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A main concern in the public key distribution is the authenticity of the public key. Authenticating public keys provides assurance to the entity that the received public key corresponds to the sender's identity. A typical approach to guarantee the authentication of the public key holder relies on a trusted agent named Certificate Authority (CA). The signature based CA binds entity's identity ID to the corresponding public key KU. However, in the mobile business system, the CA not only adds the system's complexity but also increase the user charge. Therefore, it is the worst security problem in the mobile business systems that there is no signature so that the non-repudiation service can not effectively be protected. In this paper, an effective signature scheme based on Tate pairing for mobile business is put forward. In the signature scheme, the public key is ID of the mobile user or can be obtained by ID so that the user does not need to access the CA to obtain the public key. This feature is especially desirable for mobile applications such as mobile business, mobile government and mobile police office. Therefore, the signature scheme can effectively provide the non-repudiation service for mobile business.

articleTitle: Technology Base and Management Pattern of Agile Product Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Agile product development, which is presented by foreign scholars in recent years, is a new product-developing model based on speed competition. In this paper, characteristics of agile product development model, technology base and management pattern are explored. Also obtained are the six characteristics that the model has. They are rapid reaction quality, digitalized design, working initiative, management flexibility, market adaptability and cooperation-communication quality. Then, the viewpoint on the three technical basic of how to implement enterprise agilization is put forward, that is component generalization and standardization, product modularization and enterprise informatization. At last, the analysis to project management and workflow management technology, which are suitable for agile product development, is carried on.

articleTitle: Formulating Strategies for Stakeholder Management: A Case-Based Reasoning Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Case-based reasoning (CBR) is a problem solving technique that reuses past cases. It guarantees its ability of reasoning to continuously enhance with a self-learning function. Meanwhile, it is an important means for enterprises to deal with similar competitive intelligence. This paper will introduce CBR technology into the field of stakeholders management and build a knowledge model of stakeholder management strategy support system. This technology can be used as an important business tool for competitive intelligence by the enterprise managers and help managers to formulate and implement strategies. This method is practical and effective, will be able to help any business leader create value while navigating a multi-stakeholder environment.

articleTitle: Coordination Between Manufacturer and Retailer in Multi-Channel Setting
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The developments in e-commerce and logistics technologies have motivated manufacturers to establish a new channel for retailing directly. We consider the setting that a manufacturer operates an online store in addition to the existing retail channel. There are two segments of customers, the lower-end customers need only physical products and visit retailer's store, while the high-end customers who need physical products and also need value added service will place orders via the internet. Manufacturer sells all the products to retailer at the wholesale price and informs the retailer to deliver the products to customers once receiving orders, namely retailer shares logistics service with manufacturer. In the setting that the manufacturer and the retailer are all risk neutral, we discuss the channel coordination through pricing strategies.

articleTitle: Game-Theoretic Admission Control in Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the call admission control in wireless heterogeneous network is formulated as an extensive game with perfect information, which is solved by backward induction. Simulation results prove that this game-based scheme outperforms opportunistic one in terms of smaller dropping probability of handover connections and blocking probability of new connections in the WLAN area. In addition, the parameters of the system are flexible to adjust the priority of handover connections to new connections to protect existing connections, and achieve a balance between bandwidth utilization and QoS.

articleTitle: PWKEP: A Pair-Wise Key Establishment Protocol for Sensor Networks Providing Provable Security
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The establishment of pair-wise key between two nodes in wireless sensor network is a big challenge. We propose a protocol PWKEP including three contributions: 1) Achieve secure key exchange protocol with mutual authentication. 2) Propose a modular approach for design of secure authenticated key exchange protocols. 3) Adopt elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange and argue reasonable energy consumption on sensor device MICA2DOT. Moreover, we provide PWKEP provable security under BCK model.

articleTitle: Step into Enterprise Risk Management: A Case Study of Sydney Harbor Oil Spill Event
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper makes a theoretical and practical study on enterprise risk management based on combination of risk management theory and actual case. The article uses relevant theory and methods to analyze the risk management result of the SHELL ENTERPRISE case, and summarizes systematically the process and functions of risk identification, risk analysis, risk management and risk control, which is reference to enterprise risk management of our country. Through the analysis of specific case, it concludes that enterprise risk management is a process and using the effective measures to manage the risk timely is essential for creating and maintaining the value of the enterprise.

articleTitle: CPK-Based Key-Establishment and Authentication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are confronted with unique challenges. Key distribution is one of the most challenging security problems in wireless sensor networks, and the traditional security techniques used in tradition networks cannot be applied directly. We propose CPK-based authentication protocol as the security scheme, which can achieve the key establishment and security authentication. In contrast to previous key-establishment solutions, our approaches need small storage space, and can gain stronger security and reasonable performance efficiency.

articleTitle: Bayesian Analysis of Stock Index Return Volatility
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The stochastic volatility is a universal phenomenon in financial time series, and an important issue in risk management research. In this paper, through the statistical structure of the standard stochastic volatility model, we infer the SV model's likelihood function, design the parameters' conjugate prior distribution, obtain the corresponding model parameter according to the Bayesian theorem, and examine their condition distribution. Furthermore, in order to obtain the model parameter estimation and their confidence intervals, we use Gibbs sampling to devise an MCMC computational procedure, and carry out an empirical analysis using the Shanghai composite index and the Shenzhen component index data. The results indicate that the Bayesian method is an effective tool to explore the financial time series data.

articleTitle: The Risks from Implementing the Program of Network Organizational Joint Decision-Making and Their Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The implementation of the network organizational joint decision-making program is influenced by many kinds of risks from the nodes in the network, the relations among the nodes, the entire network organization and the external environment. The risks from the nodes include the ability risk, the liability risk and the moral hazard; the risks from the relations among the nodes include the mutual trust risk, the relational risk and the communicational risk; the risks from the entire network organization include the strategic collaboration risk, the organizational management risk and the cultural integration risk; the risks from the external environment include the market risk, the policy change risk, the technological innovation risk and the risk derived from society, economy, culture and the natural environment. The paper describes the risk evaluation model of the implementation of the network organizational joint decision-making program - Fuzzy-AHP evaluation model, constructs the risk evaluation index system, and carries out an evaluation to the program implementation risk of a specific network organizational joint decision-making by using the Fuzzy-AHP evaluation model.

articleTitle: Customer Relationship Marketing in Chinese Golf Operation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Golf is considered as a sunny industry by many investors in China, and the number of golf courses is increasing rapidly, however, few golf clubs can make profit. It was found the golf environment in China is quite special through researching. Chinese regard golf not only as a sport but also as a platform to show their social status and develop business. Therefore, Chinese golf clubs must match these special needs in their daily operation and marketing strategy. Customer Relationship Marketing is a suitable marketing theory for Chinese golf clubs to have right marketing strategy and management. Every club may have different way and considerations in real operation, but direct marketing and value-added activities are two useful and common ways can be taken.

articleTitle: Nonuniform Subband Method for Wideband Smart Antennas Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to suit with non-equal bandwidth signals which result from various services in communication applications, a nonuniform subband method with nonuniform general parameter filter banks (GPFBs) implemented by tree-structure system based on two-channel equal bandwidth filter banks is proposed. GPFBs are utilized to partition the frequency band into several subbands without aliasing between them. With subbands running at downsampling and in manner of parallel, the loads of computational processing costs, compared with conventional fullband methods, can be alleviated. Deep suppression of the interference and convergence speed of weights are also improved.

articleTitle: The Use of Propensity Score Matching to Evaluate Health Effect on China Labor Force Participation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The aim of the study is to determine the influence of health status on labor force supply in Chinese people aged over 20. We estimate the average treatment effect on labor force participation of health status using the Chinese Health and Family Life Survey (CHFLS) data of 3821 individuals. A concern when estimating the effect of health on labor supply is that health (especially self assessed health) might be endogenous, and in particular that people might use poor health to justify non- participation. This would result in the effect of health being overestimated if health was treated as exogenous. Considering covariate endogeneity and sample selection bias, we use propensity score matching to analyze the average treatment effect of health status on labor force participation. The result shows that health status significantly affects the individual labor force participation rate of China.

articleTitle: Multi-Rate Expert Systems in Supply Chain Simulation for Telecommunication Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In modern telecommunications industry, demand & supply chain management needs reliable design and versatile tools to control the material flow. The objective for efficient supply chain management is reducing inventory, lead times and related costs in order to assure reliable and on-time deliveries from manufacturing units towards customers. In this paper we present multi-rate expert system based methodology for developing tools that would enable optimal demand & supply chain management for modern telecommunication manufacturing environment.

articleTitle: Research on WLAN Performance Based on Priority Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The priority method is proposed for wireless LAN in this paper, which is that different workstations are distinguished with different business in wireless LAN, through modeling and simulation, the network performance parameters are analyzed in the priority mechanism, the results showed that the priority mechanism can achieve the better network performance. To a certain extent, it is guaranteed that a higher operational requirement of users could have better quality of service.

articleTitle: Visualising Layout of a Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The proposed paper summarises the work done in a container terminal project where the needs of small to medium sized ports / terminals with 'multi-purpose' capability had to be addressed. To this end the following had to be considered: The absence of extensive IT support and how to deal with it, Information flows to/from and within the terminal, Cargo flows to/from and within the terminal and in association with this, Layout of land and maritime approaches including berths, Position of in-and out gates, Terminal and yard layout in conjunction with selected cargo handling equipment. The above resulted in an electronic terminal planning board (TPB) with generic applicability.

articleTitle: Research on the Formation and Establishment of Consumer's Initial Trust in the C to C Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The trust research is a core content in the field of e-commerce research in C to C environment. In the course of network trust formation, the initial trust is most important. By introducing the content of initial trust, the paper established a three-stage dynamic concept model of consumer initial trust formation in C to C environment. Site quality trust, site transactions safety trust and seller reputation trust are the major initial trust factors in the formation of consumer initial trust. Based on this model, the paper gives some strategies to C to C e-commerce sites and sellers to establish consumer trust, so that to give some useful inspiration to the sites and the seller's future development.

articleTitle: Study on the Negotiation Mechanism of Multi-Agent-Based Vehicle Routing System in Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Virtual enterprise, as one of the most important and novel organization paradigm in global manufacturing, is increasingly being focused. On the basis of analysis the problem of vehicle routing in virtual enterprise, a multi-agent-based vehicle routing model is proposed. In the work, we use an autonomy vehicle intelligent agent which can improve the problem solving ability of the system. Then a discussion is conducted on negotiation mechanism between agents.

articleTitle: Study on Product Quality Collaborative Control Based on Expert System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces a theory and method based on expert system for intelligent collaborative quality control of the manufacturing controlling. The paper mainly include the structure and know-how of the expert system, the knowledge of the net manufacturing environment based on expert system for intelligent collaborative quality control of the manufacturing controlling, the introduction of the information exchanging technology based on the expert system for intelligent collaborative quality control of the manufacturing controlling and the specific method of intelligent collaborative quality control. The effective collaborative quality control method and the data model guarantees the quality of the products manufactured in the center plants and the other plants concerned, as well as the final quality of the product. It also provides some insight for the key technology of the net manufacturing, that of the large customization.

articleTitle: A Pushouts Based Knowledge Merging Method: Knowledge Reorganization in Emergency Decision-Making Support
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There is an increasing need for emergency decision-making support on the acquisition of background knowledge. However such background knowledge decision-makers needed is usually distributed with the form of heterogeneous knowledge pieces that should be reorganized according to the scenarios of occurrent emergency problems. Knowledge pieces, like micro-view ontologies, are defined as typed categories. We present a categorical Pushouts based knowledge merging method to achieve the automatic and semantics oriented reorganization on knowledge pieces. Drawing on the experiences of V-alignment and W-alignment, These Pushouts of functors are glued via merging common diagrams from typed composition rules to yield bridge knowledge pieces, and this successive process is recursive to a single, merged knowledge piece.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on the Human Resource Flexible Management of Manufacturing Enterprises by AHP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Human resource flexible management can be adapted to the trend of agiler and more flexible manufacturing. However, there are differences for various manufacturing enterprises to implement flexible management. The paper designs an evaluation indicator system and analytical model according to four flexible aspects (i.e., functional flexibility, work flexibility, compensation flexibility, and structural flexibility). Based on the model and IMSS (international manufacturing strategy survey) data, the paper compares human resource flexible management in different manufacturing enterprises by analytic hierarchy process (AHP).

articleTitle: Research on Vicious Price War and Price Floor Regulation in China Telecom Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper firstly sums up the types of various low price strategies, and then discusses the hazard of vicious price war. After that, it makes an in-depth analysis of the concerns and characteristics of price floor regulation which also takes into account of the coming 3G era in China. Finally, this paper puts forwards three kinds of price floor regulation models based on the above analyses.

articleTitle: Study on Power Allocation of Cognitive OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cognitive radio is an emerging technique to improve the spectrum utilization in future wireless communication systems. In this paper, we study the power allocation strategy of cognitive orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system, where both primary user and cognitive user have multiple channels to transmit. The mathematical optimization problem is first formulated, based on the interference temperature model. The object of problem is to maximize the capacity of cognitive user under the constraint of interference temperature at the primary receiver and peak power constraint at the cognitive transmitter. An optimal solution based on Lagrange multiplexer is proposed to solve the optimization problem. Three suboptimal solution, which requires less channel side information, are also presented for the purpose of comparison. Numerical simulation results of different algorithms are provided.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Agent in Intelligent CAPP System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Computer aided process planning (CAPP) plays an important role in the computer integrated manufacturing system (CIMS). Considering the existent disadvantage, a new intelligent agent CAPP system is proposed in this paper. The complex problem is divided into a few small sub problems, and each agent has own knowledge and reasoning. The system modeling, agent structure design and coordination mechanism are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Reader Antenna With Covering a Large Area in RFID System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to make reader read tags within a large area under the case of a finite reader's output power, a new design scheme of reader antenna that can enlarge reader's reading area is presented in this paper. In the scheme, general reader antenna coil is replaced by combination of series-parallel connection of several small antenna coils. The reader antenna designed by the scheme proposed in this paper not only can make reader read tags in a larger planar area, but also can make reader read tags in some height range in vertical. This design scheme has wide application future.

articleTitle: Detecting and Clustering Similar Results of Search Engine by Exploiting Web Page's Contents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an approach to detect and cluster similar results of search engine based on analyzing pages' URLs and their contents. A novel hash function, together with a Chinese key concept extractor module, has been used. The similar measurement on key concept overlap degree is proposed to cluster similar retrieval results. This can minimize the overlap effectively. The experimental results show the feasibility of the approach. On the basis of the above works, a search engine has been developed.

articleTitle: The Study on Spatial Decision Support Services Architecture Based on Grid GIS in Emergency Response Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The status and problems of the research on spatial decision support in emergency response is analyzed. The spatial decision support emergency response services architecture (SDSERSA) is proposed based on grid GIS. The SDSERSA is defined in detail and the relationship between SDSERSA and grid GIS is analyzed. At last, we design the SDSERSA and make description about the workflow in SDSERSA.

articleTitle: Analysis on Performance Improvement in Multiuser UWB System Under Imperfect Power Control
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Power control techniques are adopted in narrow-band systems to overcome near-far effects by varying transmitted power levels so that all signals are received with equal power level. However, since the transmission data rate is too high in ultra-wideband (UWB) in which multimedia communication is desired to realize, it is impossible to accomplish perfect power control with current technologies and hardware, and therefore performance of UWB systems will be reduced. A model of UWB system under imperfect power control is proposed, and system performance with this model is analyzed. Since system performances are different by utilizing different waveforms, to improve the performance, an optimal waveform is adopted in UWB system, and the improvement of system performance is shown by comparing to the performance using Gaussian waveform.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Factors Influencing the Development of Regional Economy Based on Research into Rough Set and Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the preceding papers of analyzing the factors of effecting region economic development, the researchers mostly select some factors by subjective experience, then analyze positively the effect of the selected factors to economic development by econometric model. This paper applicant the theories of the rough set and entropy to analyze the data without subjective experience, so can get the conclusion comprehensively and objectively. To take Szechwan province as an example, the analytic result shows that the main factors of effecting region economic development is: third industry, city ward level, freight transportation, second industry.

articleTitle: Research of the Electricity Price Linkage Mechanism of Selling Side and Generating Side Based on DSM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Successful run of the peak and valley time-of-use electricity price needs a proper method to share the lost between the selling side and the generating side. The paper studied and analyzed the generating tariff and selling tariff, considered the running conditions of peak-valley time-of- use tariff in China, and then introduced a new electricity price linkage mechanism of selling side and generating side.

articleTitle: Research on Networked Manufacturing Model and Information Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networked manufacturing (NM) is an advanced manufacturing method. The profound influence of networked manufacturing for the global industry is taking place. Based on the analysis of the requirements and technology driving forces of the networked manufacturing, the basic features and connotation of NM based on workshop NC equipment are discussed. The structure and mode of a networked manufacturing system among workshop NC (Numerical Control) equipment are presented. Aiming at the status of present Numerical Control (NC) or Computer Numerical Control (CNC) equipment of the manufacturing industry, several typical DNC communication schemes for workshops are proposed. Finally, we take the prototype system as an example to illustrate the operation process of NM based on workshop equipment.

articleTitle: Dynamic Game Analysis on Logistic Service in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Faced the fact that competition within logistic industry is getting fierce in China, this essay is based on game theory (pure strategic Nash equilibrium & admixture strategic Nash equilibrium) to analyze the relation between price of transport service and service quality within road freight transport industry. It is pointed out that making different pricing policies due to different service qualities is not only profitable for road freight transport enterprises, but also beneficial to the overall improvement of road freight transport service quality. It is also found out that different road freight transport service prices reflect the positive correlation between road freight transport service price and road freight transport service quality.

articleTitle: Printed-Circuit Elliptical Dipole Antenna for 3.1-10.6 GHz UWB Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Printed-circuit board (PCB) antenna with useful bandwidth covering from 3.1 GHz to 10.6 GHz is suitable for wireless ultra wideband (UWB) application. Firstly, we present a low profile, elliptical antenna etched on PCB with dielectric constant 4.2 achieving the above specified bandwidth. Next, to reduce the size of the product, an elliptical dipole antenna with PCB dielectric constant 10.2 has been fabricated. Swept frequency return loss, impedance and radiation patterns of these antennas have been measured. Design criteria for this elliptical dipole antenna is also investigated.

articleTitle: A Method of Saving Cost Based on Safety Floats and Minimum Cut Algorithm in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the method of saving cost in project management by making use of floats. Firstly, it puts forward the critical path theorem and the safety float phenomenon, reveals the conditions that a new critical path appears and the properties of safety float in the process of its use. It then proposes a method that can maximize cost saving without new critical path or new critical activity appearing in project management on the basis of the minimum cut algorithm, and the method is proved to be correct. The paper also gives an example of its application. The method is helpful for project managers to enhance the efficiency of the use of floats.

articleTitle: Study on an Embedded-Based Monitoring and Risk Estimation System for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the structure and theory of optical- mechanical-electrical automatic ranging system of vehicles, paper has a discussion and research of the architecture and design of auto ranging system with risk estimation and decision making basing on an embedded microprocessor, which includes hardware architecture, software architecture and key technology, etc. It has given an automatic ranging and decision making decision for vehicles.

articleTitle: Dynamic Efficiency and Performance Improvement to Service Firms Based on Integrated MRPII/JIT/TOC System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Services now account for a larger portion of the economy than manufacturing for every nation on Earth. But there is still a lack of management researches and studies to help prosper the service firms. In this paper, we investigate the functions, contents and development of methods on Production Planning and Control (PPC), then construct an integrated PPC system for service firms according to their distinctive characteristics and operational process, and set up an evaluation index system for the integrated MRPII/JIT/TOC system to improve their efficiency and performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of International Contractors Based on Niche Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Niche is one of the most important conception and theory in ecology. It is a conception that describes a species' occupation of nature resource and relationship with other species. Applying the ecological niche theory into economics, this paper defines international contractor as an organic life body and use enterprise niche to describe the contractors' position in the international market, their occupation of market resources and their relationships with other contractors. Based on the literature review of niche theory and construction industry, this paper is mainly consisted of four parts. Firstly, it introduces the condition of the international market and the conception of the niche and enterprise niche. Secondly, it establishes the enterprise niche metric models, including enterprise niche width metric models, enterprise niche separation metric models and enterprise population niche separation metric models. Then, based on the enterprise niche metric models and ENR data for international contractors from 2000 to 2006, this paper analyzes the development and competition of the major contractors in the international market and compares the results with Chinese international contractors. And at last, this paper analyzes the causes of the results and makes an effort in analyzing the development strategy of Chinese international contractors.

articleTitle: Role-Based Enhancement of Secure Authentication for RF-UCard Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Radio Frequency Universal Smart Cards (RF-UCard) open up the possibility for various attacks violating user privacy. In this paper, we propose a strong and lightweight role-based mutual authentication protocol. By employing the mutual authentication and the reader-role validation, the protocol can effectively defend against both passive and active attacks, including the invalid data access from the unauthorized readers. Through the protocol implementation, we observe that the proposed protocol is feasible and practical in RF-UCard systems.

articleTitle: A Relative Risk Model for Anomaly Detection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Localization anomaly detection (LAD) for a wireless sensor network (WSN) plays a prominent role in defending against attacks on localization services. However, it is a difficult task to evaluate the effectiveness of the anomaly detection scheme according to complexity and uncertainty in various applications. This paper presents a relative risk model approach that was proposed for ecological risk assessment (ERA) to tackle this problem. The problem formulation and model-building process is described in detail. Our numerical simulation demonstrates that this relative risk model method is quite effective to the quantitative assessment of vulnerability analysis in wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: The Hardware Design and Implementation of Space Time System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple hardware implementation scheme of the D-STBC system. According to the theory of D-STBC, the specific implementation scheme of encoding and decoding come up. In the design, one differential encoding table is set up to replace the complex computation of the encoder; two decoding tables are set up to replace the complex computation of the decoder. Meanwhile likelihood decision replaces the maximum likelihood decoding decision. The hardware simulation results prove that the design scheme is correct. Furthermore, a software wireless communication flat is discussed, which adopts EPF10K30EFC256-1X and TMS320VC5509 as the digital baseband disposal part.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of a WAP Filter Based on Bintree & Web Page Subdivision
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new WAP filter has been presented in this paper, which can convert a HTML page into an equivalent WML file by scanning the HTML page, constructing correspondent HTML tag bintree and translating it into a relative small WML file. It has been indicated by simulative test that users will feel transmission apparently faster, since such a target small size page would allow each request for reading a page to be met in short time. As a result, small size pages, which are incised from original larger one, will save the communication expense for customers if they don't want to browser a whole page.

articleTitle: Asymmetrical Information and Adverse Selection Effect in Service Interaction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the open-end production system, production service of high-quality should be the product of effective interaction involved by multi-parties. Yet in fact there is critical asymmetric information between all the parities, the service providers and customers in particular. By applying the game theory and relevant knowledge in Information Economics, this paper builds a game model between service providers and receivers and analyzes the adverse selection effect during service interaction under asymmetrical information. It further proposes to set up a visual service standard system and then demonstrates the reasonableness in introducing third parties like the government, trade organizations and consumer associations and puts forward corresponding policies and suggestions.

articleTitle: A Constructional Algorithm of Principal and Subordinate Structure Self-Set Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem of "self-set incomplete" that exists in intrusion detection system based on computer immune, this paper designs a construction algorithm of principal and subordinate structure self-set based on decision trees. The decision trees are introduced to traditional negative-selection algorithm and the candidate detectors which have been eliminated by the immune tolerance are reclassified by the decision trees, and the candidate detectors that meet the setting conditions compose the "subordinate self-set" so as to achieve the dynamic expansion of the self-set. The unqualified elements in "subordinate self-set" are eliminated according to the "conflict of matching" method. Experimental results show that this algorithm is effective and can improve the recognition performance of the detectors.

articleTitle: Knowledge Network Model of Scientific Research Achievement and its Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to promote knowledge sharing and knowledge reuse of scientific research achievements, this paper proposes a knowledge network model which acts as a direct access to the knowledge existed in the achievements. As knowledge network can be treated with a kind of complex networks, this paper then optimizes the primitive knowledge network model by analyzing its network characteristics. Figures are shown to illustrate the characteristics before and after optimization of the model. This paper also formalizes the optimization results for machine understanding and processing. The knowledge network model is suitable for specifying and representing knowledge in scientific research achievements, and its optimization result is machine readable.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Model and Application on City Land Reserve Under the Condition of Limited Reserve Funds
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Owing to the shortage of the city land reserve funds, loan funds generally are applied to reserve the lands besides the own funds. This paper aims at proposing city land reserve decision-making model under the condition of limited reserve funds based on market-oriented operation pattern of the city land reserve. The model can be used to confirm the reorder point in the process of land reserve, so as to optimize city land reserve system. Solution to the model is also presented, furthermore, the real case study on R city is applied to illustrate the application of the model, which also validates the model is scientific and applicable.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Decision Support System Based on MAS for Product Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An intelligent decision support system based on MAS for new product development is presented for enhancing the success rate of new product development. The dialogue layer, problem decomposition layer, control layer and problem solving layer in the decision process are studied; corresponding decision support apply modules are built based on the design idea of decision support system with multi-structure through the share of resource and information; the design principles of product development decision support system and general design schemes are proposed. Decision support system for product development is divided into two levels of enterprise internal management system and external management system by the function of system, linkage mode, user's level and geographical location, and the levels are combined to be a whole on the unified hardware and software platform through communication system.

articleTitle: Comparison on Contributions of State and Non-State Economy of China Construction Industry 1985-2005
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the construction industry data from 1985 to 2005 in China statistical yearbook, this paper evaluates the contribution of non-state-owned and state-owned economy of the construction industry, respectively. From the comparisons and options of the convergence equations, three main equations are established. From these equations, it is easily found that the state-owned economy is still in the predominate status of the construction industry; however, there is a contradiction within the inner of the state-owned economy in the China construction Industry. Where there is a friction, there is an inter-space. It is also true for the institute of the China Construction Industry; unquestionably, there is an institutional inter-space in the public ownership. The contributions of the non-state economy are all the positive value, especially the contribution of invest enterprise of Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan is in the dominance status, more than the double of the contribution of the foreign invest enterprise.
