With the China's access to the WTO, the share of foreign invest enterprise, should contribute a lot more than before, while it account for an unexpected little share, so there may be a long way for China Construction Industry to attract the investment of Foreign Funded. The total product of China Construction Industry have maintained a continuously fast growth tendency, from this perspective, it is true that overall the construction industry have taken an effective institution reform.

articleTitle: Impact of Store Image on Retailer Equity: Evidence from 10 Chinese Hypermarkets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper establishes a theoretical and empirical basis that shows the impact of store image on retailer equity. The authors propose a conceptual framework in which store image is related to three dimensions of retailer equity, that is, retailer awareness, retailer associations, retailer perceived quality. These dimensions are then related to retailer loyalty. The empirical tests using path analysis support the research hypotheses. The results indicate the positive effect of store image on retailer equity dimensions as antecedents of retailer equity.

articleTitle: Dynamics of the Behavior to E-Commerce's Network Effects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the one hand, in network economy era, the traditional economic growth theory cannot explain the benefits of enterprise informationization well. Every customer could easily enter the network because of the quite low costs, and then the increasing customers will push the entire network to be an exponential growth, so information technology plays a positive feedback effect on the network system. On the other hand, based on system dynamics to analysis what the network effects will go on about e-commerce, finds out the relationship between the number of e-commerce network and e-commerce's value. Therefore, the article analyses the enterprise how to implement e- commerce in order to come about network effects and then to make a great network value, thereby avoiding unsuccessful situation on e-commerce.

articleTitle: The Research on the Service Orientation Modes of Third Party Logistics in Industrial Clusters
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on abstracting the coordinate development phenomenon of the third party logistics (TPL) and industrial clusters, the article first analyzes the nature of the synergy relationship between TPL and industrial clusters: superficially, the link between the TPL and the industries clusters is that TPL is the logistics service provider while the industrial clusters are the demanders; fundamentally, TPL and industrial clusters have a relationship of functional integration. Based on this, the article abstracts that the service orientation modes of TPL are respectively the system support mode, strategy support mode, strategy remodeling mode and system remodeling mode; then the article exemplifies these orientation modes, while on the other hand abstracts their characteristics, i.e. with different orientation modes, the capabilities of TPL are different, the benefits gained by the cluster enterprises are different and the cooperation level of the two parts are different.

articleTitle: CCSL: A Connected Coverage Strategy Based on Logistic Layers in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly studies the problem of connected coverage control in wireless sensor networks and proposes a strategy called CCSL (connected coverage strategy based on logistic layers) based on the relationship of coverage and connectivity. The strategy adopts the logistic layers to solve coverage and connectivity problems independently. By doing this, CCSL can achieve the optimization of both connectivity and coverage. What's more, CCSL uses a "tree cutting" arithmetic to induce the redundancy nodes and save energy. Our research about connected coverage problem includes not only the specific algorithm of CCSL but also a framework of protocol easily extended. Experimental results show that CCSL can reduce the energy consumption by turning off the connectivity redundancy nodes and coverage redundancy nodes, so it prolongs the network lifetime effectively.

articleTitle: Modeling Admission Control in OFDMA System Using Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Admission control plays an important role in OFDMA system. However, admission control becomes rather complex along with the increase of users' demand and the diversification of service types, so building an appropriate stochastic model is especially significant. The Petri net can distinctly describe the stochastic process. In this paper we build and analyze the Petri net model of admission control in OFDMA system. The simulation results demonstrate our theoretical analysis and indicate that the PN model is effectively to analyze the process of admission in OFDMA system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Location Choice of the Host Country by the TNCs' Overseas R&D: An Empirical Study Based on Panel Data with Comparative Perspective
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Interleaving Schemes with the EXIT Chart
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The interleaver is widely used in communication and signal processing. Recently it becomes an integral part of the coding and decoding strategy as in turbo code and bit-interleaved coded modulation. The interleaver design is critical to the high performance of bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID). We use the extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) chart to analyze the effect of the interleaver design on the performance of BICM-ED. The EXIT chart analysis indicates that the interleaver which gathers more extrinsic information and is closer to the decoder's extrinsic transfer characteristic with the assumption of the Gaussian distributed a priori input has a better performance. This provides a new method for the analysis of the interleaver design. The accuracy of the EXIT chart analysis is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: The Status and Development Trend of the Development Model Based on XP Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the process of software development, the most important phase is to select a software development model and a software process which are suit to the actual situation of an organization or a project, This paper introduces and summarizes the status and development trend of the development model based on XP method, and gives the characteristics and applicable occasions of the model.

articleTitle: New Burst Modem For LEO Satellites
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Frame efficiency is key point for burst communication systems, and long-time preamble is needed for LEO satellite DSSS signal acquisition and coherent synchronization caused by large range Doppler shift. Many papers do works on shortening 2-dimension acquisition by using FFT or shortening convergence time by using adaptive loop filter bandwidth. In this paper a new modem is proposed, which eliminates the preamble spent by synchronization process definitely, and improves burst frame efficiency markedly.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Application Recommendation System in the OTA System Based on Mining Users' Interests
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, mobile network operators pay much more attention to personalized service than they used to. It is necessary to provide pertinent service to different customers who may have different demands. To meet the need of personalized recommendation system and aim at implementing personalized application recommendation, a new model in the OTA (Over the Air) system is proposed at the beginning of this paper. Then the paper focuses on the relationship between user's behavior of using this system and their preference and discusses the interests reflected by their behavior, and gives an algorithm of mining users' preference. And then the paper introduces a personalized application recommendation engine based on the methods of clustering and mining association rules to implement recommendation about valuable application items for users.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Highway Project Management Information System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the requirements analysis of highway project management information system, a technical scheme using GIS (geographical information system) technology was put forward. A study method was adopted combining GIS technology and large commercial database management skills and this system was developed. Highway project management information system was divided into seven subsystems. It adopted the framework of Client/Server, and was based on Maplnfo 7.0 edition - a basic software platform of GIS. This system used SQL Server 2000 - a large rational database management system, to manage attribute data and MapX5.0 - an active control to management spatial data. After those an attribute database was developed to store and manage the attribute data and a graph database to graph data. In this system, some professional functions were realized, such as measure payment, contract management and schedule management, and also some GIS functions including query, cruise and graph-dealing, were realized.

articleTitle: Research on IT Project Management System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: From the perspective of participants of IT projects, this literature analyzed how to design a new IT project management system. The key to it is to study on one-member management, binary system and ternary system of IT project management. Based on the above research, we found that the unreasonable relations existed in present three-member management system, thus putting forward the suggestions for dealing with the relations of three kinds of roles in the management system.

articleTitle: A Novel Power Control Algorithm for CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing

articleTitle: Credit Rating Analysis with Support Vector Machines Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we apply a relatively new learning algorithm, support vector machines optimized by genetic algorithms (GA-SVM) to the credit-rating prediction problem and expect to improve prediction accuracy by adopting this new algorithm. Based on the result, we conducted a market analysis on the determining factors in the China markets. By determining what information was actually used by expert financial analysts, these studies can help users capture fundamental characteristics of different financial markets.

articleTitle: A New Method Based on Fractals for Delay Estimation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new method for multi-scale localization. This method employs fractals to create pilot signals for localization. The localization process can be configured in function of the desired resolution (or scale). In this paper we propose also an adaptive localization receiver. The first part of the paper introduces the fractal theory, while the second part is focalized on fractal signal definition used in localization. Finally, simulation results are shown compared to CDMA pilots. The obtained performances of the new method open a real perspectives in localization.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Resource Dispatching Model with Potential Demand
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Resource dispatching is an important problem in emergency management, the objective of which is to dispose emergencies in short time. Often emergencies happen in different sites in succession and resource transporting is often impacted in different degree. In this paper the mathematical programming model is proposed considering the demand of not only the emergency that has happened but also the potential emergencies with their probabilities. Also the transporting efficiency is taken into account. The objective is to minimize the maximum time for resource from savers to all emergencies with the corresponding probabilities so that the demand can be met most quickly. Next the algorithm of the model is discussed. The numerical example and future research is given at last.

articleTitle: Modeling the Antecedents of Project Competence in Complex Products and Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores the factors affecting project competence within firms producing complex products and systems (CoPS). We developed a research framework for the analysis of factors affecting the project competence in CoPS. Literature review and Nominal Group Technique were used to identify these factors and to assist in developing a questionnaire to identify and rank their associated measured variables, five key factors were identified and extracted by using factor analysis, and these resulting factors were related to the overall project competence in CoPS by using a multiple regression analysis method, then the results of factor analysis and multiple regression analysis were valuated and confirmed by using structural equation modeling, in which corresponding tentative model was constructed and tested quantitatively. The proposed model identified five building blocks of project competence in CoPS, namely project environment, technology, innovation, organization management and operation process. The paper argues that these firms are only able to effectively harness and reproduce their project competence by integrating these five building blocks within the firm.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Safety Stock Quantity's Fractal Forecast and Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Safety stock, a very important composing of the stock management, which is significant for reducing the cost and increasing interests for an enterprise, is the base of the setting of enterprise's stocks, so it is crucial for stock management to presume a rational and exact SS. In this paper, introducing fractal theory, a new method based on the fractal collage theorem and the iterative process of fractal interpolation functions was proposed to forecast the safety stock. Based on the fractal collage theorem, it uses the iterated function system whose attractor is close to the historical data to establish the fractional function, and set the forecasting model proposed according to the iterative process of fractional function. Then by an example the rationality and reliability of this method is verified, and the result show that it is helpful indeed to set the reasonable safety stock for enterprise.

articleTitle: The Optimal Structure of Incentive in Catastrophe Risk Securitization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Catastrophe risk securitization has risen as a promising solution to the increasingly severe problem of risk financing and compensation in the recent two decades. In the special structure of catastrophe risk securitization, the relationship between the reinsurer and special purpose vehicle is a decisive yet sensitive one, as principal and agent, potential incentive disorder between them can render the securitization mechanism fail to fulfill its task. This paper sets out to examine the optimal structure of incentive between the reinsurer and the SPV, by the use of expected utility maximization paradigm, this paper developed the necessary condition for a dynamic catastrophe risk securitization mechanism, including individual rationality condition and incentive-compatibility condition, and further discovered that the optimal incentive parameter and the risk averse extent is negatively correlated. Based on these findings, this paper propose advice concerning the world risk securitization practice and suggest that the special purpose vehicle in this operation should have its independent interest and compete for the right to securitize.

articleTitle: Nonstandard Employing Knowledge Worker's Organization Commitment: A Comparative Research Based on Different Employment Types
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recent years, nonstandard employment has been coming an important method for organization to increase the flexible ability. Especial the nonstandard employing knowledge workers have been the vital part of organization's core competition. However nonstandard employing knowledge workers have their particular attitudinal situation. Organization commitment is the most important one. This research investigates the difference between standard and nonstandard employment knowledge worker's organization commitment and among different nonstandard employment types by empirical study. The results show the standard employment knowledge workers' organization commitment are higher than nonstandard employee's, and among the nonstandard employment types, the organization commitments are different.

articleTitle: Design of High-Speed Charge-Pump in PLL
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The phenomena of charge injection, clock feedthrough and charge sharing in charge pump are analyzed. A novel structure of charge pump for high-speed phase-locked loop is presented. The charge pump is designed with the Chartered 0.35 mum CMOS technology, and simulated with Eldo which is the analog circuits simulation tool of Mentor Graphics. Under 3.3 V DC supply voltage, the power consumption is 0.447 mW. The result of simulation shows that the circuit has an excellent performance for high-frequency applications.

articleTitle: A Study of Integration and Application of 6sigma and BPR In Service Enterprise: Take a Large-Scale Hospital as an Example
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: BPR has been a popular topic among enterprises in recent years. As a new philosophy of quality control, 6Sigma's continuously improving idea provides new train of thought for BPR. This article uses process priority square formation method, ASME process analysis method, five-element analysis method, IT etc. to reengineer and appraise a certain large-sized hospital's outpatient hospitalizing process, it is based on DMAIC model which solves management problems through 6Sigma and "theory of labor combination" and "customer -oriented principle" of BPR, aiming at providing references to improve service quality for our country's service enterprises.

articleTitle: The Role of 3PL in Budget-Constrained Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper examines the impact of the role of 3PL on the performance of a two-level supply chain with a supplier and a budget-constrained retailer. We define two alternative roles of 3PL in a budget-constrained supply chain: Convention and Delegation. In convention model, the 3PL offers a traditional role of logistics providers, while in delegation model the 3PL presents the role of both logistics and financing providers by allying the bank. We show that under a symmetric information, there is no difference for the payoffs of individual firm and the entire supply chain in both convention and Delegation settings, and the competitive financial market can decouple retailer's operational and financial decisions. However, in an asymmetric information setting, the payoff of individual firm in delegation model is better off than that in conventional model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Resource-Saving and Innovative Management System of Manufacturing Based on Inverse Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Improvement of the SET Payment System by Using RBAC
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a method that can improve the SET payment system using RBAC. It mainly aims at the flaws that the payment process in SET system is quite complex, and it's difficult to save and check the payment information. The method can solve the problem of saving and checking the payment information by adding a resource server to the payment system, and realizing the access control of payment information with RBAC. Meanwhile, the improved scheme abandons the technology of dual signatures, and simplifies the process of authentication, thus simplifying the whole payment process.

articleTitle: Hybrid Tabu Search Algorithm for Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Window
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A hybrid tabu search algorithm, which generates initial solution by genetic algorithm, is proposed here to solve the vehicle routing problems with time windows (VRPTW). Experimental result shows that this algorithm is better than the other known algorithms.

articleTitle: The Spectrum Allocation Algorithm of Cognitive Radio Based on OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the characteristics of cognitive radio (CR) and the transmission features of OFDM, this article offers the algorithms for the spectrum allocation in OFDM. Aiming at the probability of detection by the CR and the upper limit of the noise which can be suffered by the authorized user, CR achieves the maximal channel capability through the allocation of the sub-carriers and the power. This article provides three algorithms: the Irrigation Algorithm with the capacity optimization, the Revision Greedy Algorithm with the minimum interference to the authorized user and the Grouping Allocation Algorithm with the minimum computation load. These three algorithms emphasize particularly on different characters about CR. The simulation indicates that when the amount of the sub-channels is great, the Revision Greedy Algorithm is suited for the CR; the Grouping Allocation Algorithm has a better real-time performance, although we need choose an appropriate grouping number to balance the complexity of computation and the loss of channel capacity.

articleTitle: Margin-Setting in Chinese Commodity Futures Markets: A VaR Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Statistical theory is used to help select a margin level. This paper present a prudent margin-setting models to protect futures positions from extreme price movement. Five methods based GARCH models to estimate the current volatility are proposed to estimate Value at risk describing the tail of the conditional or unconditional distributions of two financial return series. Using backtesting of historical daily return series we show that our procedure gives better 1-day estimates than methods which ignore the heavy tails of the innovations or the stochastic nature of the volatility. Furthermore, the empirical results show that the default risk of GPD distribution is judged to the most prudential method among the three fat fail distributions.

articleTitle: The Application of the Function Point Analysis in Software Developers' Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It becomes a very important and comparatively troublesome work for software enterprises to evaluate software developers' performance in human resource management at present. Among them, the most difficult problem is to adjust accounts of software developers' workload. This paper analyzed the characteristics of software development, presented the workflow of FPA, combined with specific case, elaborated on concrete application process of FPA in software developers' performance evaluation, and achieved very good effect. Using FPA enhanced scientific nature, objectivity and justice of evaluation.

articleTitle: The Entropy DEA Model and Empirical Analysis for Measuring Efficiency of Industrial Pollution Control
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The industrial pollution control is a major concern in the socio-economic development. In this paper the author establishes an entropy DEA model evaluating the effectiveness of industrial pollution control from the angle of both inputs and outputs, namely, input-entropy DEA model and output-entropy DEA model. And it also discusses issues such as model solving, the identification of effective decision-making units and the improvement of non-effective decision-making units. Finally, by evaluating the examples about the effectiveness of industrial pollution control in every Chinese province and autonomous regions in 2004, the effectiveness and feasibility of this model is validated.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Diversity Method for Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In cognitive radio system, an unlicensed (secondary) user may share a frequency band with its licensed (primary) owner as long as the interference it incurs is not deemed harmful by the licensee. Therefore, a secondary user must take advantage of this fact by some means. In this paper we develop and analyze a cooperative diversity method for cognitive radio, which can let the secondary user to form virtual antenna arrays to achieve dramatic gains in slow fading wireless environments. A close-form expression of the upper bound of selection failure probability is given in the performance analysis. The conclusion is proved by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Accessing Non-Internet Devices Using Embedded Web Server in Ubiquitous Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The greatest benefit of Embedded Web server (EWS) is without a doubt the availability of a standard connection to non-Internet devices using the Internet. Since the use of Web server in ubiquitous computing opens new method for maintaining and supervising non-Internet devices, Web server has become a helpful tool for users to control and manage these non-Internet devices remotely. In this paper, we propose an efficient and lightweight EWS - Webit and evaluate how far it can be said to give the users fast and user-friendly ways to access, monitor, control and configure non-Internet devices with standard Web browsers in real-time. We also describe the architecture of Webit in detail and present how to design and implement it. Finally we compare the results of Webit's performance with those of other similar EWS products.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of the Ability of Value Innovation and its Stochastic Temptation: Evidenced from China Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: During the transform periods of China construction industry, the government mainly regulates and integrates the home construction market via the control of enterprise's quality. However, there are a few good effects for the added value and the continual growth of construction companies in the international construction market, especially the being "double dilemma" of the building industry in China construction industry, so, it is necessary to rebuild and re-categorize the market to realize the growth value based on the new concept of value innovation of construction products. In view of the relative literatures, we find that researchers focus on the temptation of other fields non on construction project, further China construction industry. Standing on the concept, this study has briefly described the transform from traditional market to the niche market, developed the Temptation of Institution Economic into construction project and constructed the Stochastic Temptation model of project to value innovation for construction companies. Through the diagnosis of Stochastic Temptation model of project, the relative risk range and the minimum stochastic risk have been identified. The study show that this model could make construction enterprises revolving in the construction projects pursuing the value innovation, sensibly avoid the stochastic temptation and maximize the limited resource investment of project to acquire the best benefits. Form the characteristic of quality government of China construction industry, this study make General Contract, Special Subcontract and Labor service as three disjoint sets, and based on this idea, the market contain curve of value innovation for China Construction Enterprises also has been built. The quantification of market contain curve has been confirmed as a three cubed curve, and the corresponding curve of value innovation also has been approved, which is showed that its movement are the converse double wave crests. Finally, this study provides mathematical forms to calculate the corresponding market contain capability and the ability of value innovation for China construction enterprises. It is further showed that under the current reform background and quality government of China construction industry, these models could take on the load of forewarning diagnosis of the contain capability and its value innovation for China construction market.

articleTitle: Influence Factors of Undergraduates' Perception to Service Quality of Tourism E-Commerce Website: A Case Study of CTRIP(www.ctrip.com)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper establishes the conceptual model on perception evaluation of tourism E-commerce website, frames a new investigation scale based on WEBQUAL scale and sets up following hypothesis: first, there is a significant difference between the expectation and actual perception (HI); The personal attribute has a significant influence on actual perception(H2);component dimensions of website quality system have a significant influence on its perception evaluation (H3).Then the paper launches questionnaires to undergraduates majoring tourism management in Hubei university with taking www.CTRIP.com as an example, and gets four conclusions with the aid of SPSS11.5: (1) hypothesis HI is correct, which reflects undergraduates have higher expectation to website service quality, but have lower actual evaluation and satisfaction to CTRIP; (2)Such individual factors as undergraduates' sex, member's attributes and network- using circumstance etc. make almost no significant influence on actual perception of CTRIP, so the hypothesis H2 isn't true; (3) information and business service quality factors but system management factors have strong positive correlation with the holistic quality of website, so hypothesis H3 is partly certificated.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Wireless Sensor Network Node Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we describe the concept of wireless sensor networks, and introduce a latest communication technology - ZigBee technology - for wireless sensor networks. We present the requirements, constraints and guidelines for general wireless sensor network architecture design and implementation based on ZigBee technology.

articleTitle: A Nash Bargaining Solution to Trade Credit Term Determination
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Credit term is taken as an instrument participating coordination surplus generated by credit extending by the supplier. We model trade credit determination as a Nash bargaining problem between supplier and retailer. Sensitivity analysis of a numerical example shows relativity of supplier's financing cost to the retailer's is the key determinate of credit term offered by the supplier. This result directly supports financing motive theory of trade credit.

articleTitle: Job Satisfaction and its Determinants among China's Urban Workforce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study examines the effect of age, gender, educational level, marital status, income, job level, and facet job satisfaction on global job satisfaction. Data were collected from 340 white collar urban employees in Fushun. Both global and facet job satisfaction are measured with well-validated survey instruments. The statistical analysis shows that when the demographic variables, income, and job level are used as predictors of global job satisfaction, the model is not significant. Among the nine facet job satisfactions, satisfaction with pay, with benefit, and with work itself have positive effect on global job satisfaction. When both facet job satisfaction and the demographic, and organizational characteristics variables are introduced, age also have a positive effect on global job satisfaction.

articleTitle: The Validity of Information in Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is the target of management to raise the management utilities, and the evaluation of information is also the emphasis of management. The value of information is always related to its environment called context. In the process of decision making, the players use some information, form their own beliefs, and maximize their utilities in a certain context. With utility comparison between the different information conditions, the paper points out that, in a certain context, information will bring the players more utilities if it makes the payers' beliefs approaching to the facts. In special context, information enhances the income, while it increases the cost. Information may be valid or invalid. Information is valid only when the increment of income is greater than that of cost.

articleTitle: Empirical Research in the Antecedents of Online Trust in C2C Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the C2C market, transaction are not dyadic, but triadic in nature including the buyer and seller as the consumer and the auction website as the market organizer. So there are two types of trust in C2C market. The interpersonal trust is focusing on the buyer and seller whose antecedents include competence, benevolence, integrity, reputation and disposition to trust. And the institutional trust is focusing on the consumer and website whose antecedents include Structural Assurance, Situational Normality signal and disposition to trust.

articleTitle: The Impact of Organizational Learning on Knowledge Transfer and Dynamic Capabilities: An Empirical Study in Chinese High-tech Industries
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study investigates the inter-relationships among organizational learning, knowledge transfer and dynamic capabilities. Based on 175 questionnaires from Chinese high-tech companies, this paper implements a structural equation model to test the research framework and hypotheses. The results show that organizational learning has direct positive impact on knowledge transfer but no direct positive impact on organizational dynamic capabilities. In addition, knowledge transfer plays an intermediary role between organizational learning and dynamic capabilities, and has direct positive impact on organizational dynamic capabilities, which indicates that knowledge transfer activities is very important to Chinese high- tech companies for technological and knowledge management activity under the rapid changing industrial environment.

articleTitle: A Hierarchy Management Framework for Automated Network Fault Identification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An autonomous diagnosis approach of faulty links is proposed in this paper,. Given the information by which paths a designated network node with management responsibilities can communicate with certain other nodes, and can't communicate with another set of node, with the help of building diagnosis model and computing probability of link's failure the node with management responsibilities would like to identify as quickly as possible a ranked list of the most probable failed network links, and furthermore, accurately check out which links have failed by testing. Based on this approach, a hierarchy network management architecture is designed to deal with the fault diagnosis for a heterogeneous network environment. The simulation shows that this approach has the features of real-time, higher accuracy and autonomy, especially, it will occupy a few bit of bandwidth and even require no bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Location Aid Algorithm to Eliminate Redundant Nodes for Reliable Broadcast/Multicast MAC Protocols
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve the efficiency of reliable broadcast/multicast MAC protocol in wireless multi-hop network, a location aid algorithm to eliminate redundant nodes was brought forward. Using the neighbor geographical location information, according to the principle of equivalent collision region, the algorithm could reduce redundant nodes from receivers, which is unnecessary for acknowledgement. Thus, the minimum acknowledgement nodes set is got. Extensive analysis and simulation results validate the reliability and efficiency of it.

articleTitle: Ship Dynamic and Video Monitoring System at Sea
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ship dynamic and video monitoring system at sea aims at improving safety of ship sailing and providing help for salvage. In this system, wireless communication technology of CDMA1X is used to transfer GPS dynamic positioning information and ship video. As to the special communications at sea, the actual bandwidth of single channel CDMA1X is too low to transfer video. In order to cope with this problem, this paper proposes scalable video delivery framework and uses CDMA1X multi-channel binding technology. The scalable video delivery framework is put forward to meet the requirement of complex network environment at sea. CDMA1X multi-channel binding technology is used to increase bandwidth and meet the quality requirement of video image. This paper describes the design and implementation of this system. In the circumstance of binding four CDMA1X channels, image transfer quality is perfect enough to meet the requirements of nearshore ship monitoring. This system also can adapt itself to different network bandwidths.

articleTitle: The Effects of Foreign Patent Applications and Intellectual Property Protection on Chinese Technology Progress: an Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using two related empirical models, this article estimates the effects of foreign patent applications and intellectual property protection on Chinese technology progress. The results suggest that foreign patent applications have positive effects on Chinese technology progress, but it is smaller compared with the effects of Chinese domestic R&D inputs. Intellectual property protection increases the elasticity of foreign patent applications with respect to promoting Chinese technology progress, while decreases the elasticity of Chinese domestic R&D stocks.

articleTitle: Markup Languages for Wireless Systems and a Usage Example in Wireless e-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article introduced the markup languages that can be used in wireless systems. Then it focused on one of these languages, the WML and built an example of it, a wireless online WAP grocery store simulation. Wireless e-commerce could be the trend for the near future and this showed an approach to achieve it.

articleTitle: Study on E-Learning System Reputation Service
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the reputation of e-learning system services and the evaluation arithmetic. It gives out the content of reputation in e-learning services. In this paper, it adopts fuzzy hierarchy process quantitative analysis method to analyze the reputation service levels of the e-learning system evaluation, and gives the hierarchical structure and description of e-learning system's reputation service system.

articleTitle: The Research on Fault Correlation System Based on Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyses the propagation process of network faults, applies with mobile agent (MA) in network fault management, and proposes a three layers network fault correlation system based on the intelligence and mobility of mobile agent. The system adopts proper correlation methods in each layer, can matches the timeliness and self-study demands of fault management, reduces the network load, makes full use of current network conditions, and decomposes the difficulty of network correlation problem effectively. Finally, through experiment, we prove some superiority as timeliness and network load reducing of system based on MA.

articleTitle: The Research on ERP Talents Delaminating Cultivation in Industrial Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the authors first analyze the demand for ERP talents in the society, then propose enterprise resources planning (ERP) talents delaminating cultivation in industrial engineering (IE) specialty according to students' differences in their interests and abilities. Based on the cultivation of ERP application talents, ERP research and development (R&D) talents are cultivated by constructing the ERP practice platform in enterprises, establishing ERP R&D team, and make teaching, research and industry interactive. The model has been put into practice and made good progress.

articleTitle: A QRD-Based Chase Decoding Algorithm for Quasi-Orthogonal Space-Time Block Code Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the paper, we proposed a Chase decoding algorithm (Chase-QRD-SIC) based on QR decomposition. The analysis and simulation show that the fewer number of transmit antennas, the closer performance of the proposed algorithm is to maximum- likelihood (ML) algorithm. Its performance is virtually identical to ML decoding for 2 times 2 V-BLAST systems. At the same time, the 4 times 4 QOSTBC systems can be decomposed into two independent 2 times 2 QR-decomposition sub-systems according to the Equivalent Virtual Channel Matrix (EVCM) model. The proposed algorithm is applied to each of the sub-systems. The simulation shows that the new decoding scheme is able to achieve ML performance for 4 times 4 QOSTBC systems, and the complexity of the new scheme is lower than that of the conventional ML decoding due to the reduced number of paths used for calculating ML metrics.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Semantic Query System Based on Ontology Context
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The retrieval for educational course materials is mainly based on the keyword based match, educational course materials can not be achieved in a semantic way. The paper proposed the onto-query system, a specific semantic query system for educational domain. The paper first constructs the ontology for the instructional materials titled computer network and visualizes the representation of the ontology. Then the design and implementation architecture of ontology based semantic query system for course resources is provided. At last, the paper describes the RDF metadata description binding with ontology of course materials for computer network.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Relay for Coded Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Coded cooperation (CC) allowing a pair of users to help each other with relaying part of partner's data is investigated to extend wireless channel reach by cooperative diversity. Taking advantage of a bidirectional property of data flows, instead of transmitting the each packet from each user in the second phase of CC, we propose to broadcast a joint packet with XOR-gated information of the two second packets from both users. The throughput is increased and the quality is also improved based on mathematical analysis and simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Sharing Behavior in Sino-Foreign Technical Alliances Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since the 1980s, Chinese enterprises have established a large number of strategic alliances with foreign enterprises aiming at achieving the idea of so-called "utilizing the market to introduce technology", but this is not the case. As the foreign side worries about the spillover of core technology, the Chinese side has few contacts with technical knowledge, and then both of the two sides encounter great difficulties in the knowledge transfer. To solve this problem, the paper gives a game analysis on knowledge sharing in the Sino-foreign technical alliances and determines the condition of knowledge sharing - the best ratio of income distribution-under which the benefit that knowledge sharing brings to the foreign side can make up for its loss.

articleTitle: Transplant and Optimization of H.264 Encoder Based on DSP Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Compared with other previous standards, H.264 standard has achieved great improvement in aspects of hierarchical intra/inter prediction coding, multi-frame reference, prediction accuracy. It's practical and necessary that the optimization and implementation of H.264 baseline profile encoder on the platform of TMS320DM642. Based on the architectural features of DSP and the computational complexity analysis of H.264 encoder, the H.264 encoder has been optimized from the following three aspects: algorithm, data transfer and memory/Cache use. The experimental results demonstrate that the optimized H.264 encoder can achieve the encoding speed of more than 24 frames per second for the video sequences with CIF format, which can meet the real-time requirements of the applications.

articleTitle: Discrete-Time G-Martingale and Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As we know, from some special 1-dimensional BSDEs we can get the g-expectation and g-martingale. What will it be in discretization situation? At first, some results about discretization-type backward stochastic equation are given in section 2. Then we give the corresponding definitions of g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>-expectation and g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>-martingale in discretization situation. At last an application in finance is given.

articleTitle: Approach to Dynamic Risk Evaluation for Enterprise Embedding in Cluster
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies dynamic risk evaluation for enterprise embedding in cluster. A multi-stages and multi-layers risk comprehensive estimation model is established according to evaluation principle of fuzzy mathematics, and the stage's risk affecting on total process can be calculated based on the model after the multi-stages and multi-layers risk is analyzed. In the end, a case study is given to show the applying method of the model to evaluate dynamic risk evaluation for enterprise embedding in cluster.

articleTitle: Study on Project Decision Based on Data Mining of Rough Sets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the paper, the procedure of construction project decision based on data mining of Rough Sets is discussed. This paper takes a construction project as a case study. The risk decision of construction project is sort of multiple attribute decision-making processes. It is certain that we have to deal with massive data. So data mining technology is necessary, for it can abstract implicit regularity from massive data. In this paper, the reduction algorithm based on Rough Sets is proposed as a practical data mining technology. In the paper, the procedure of construction project decision is analyzed. And a new decision method is proposed in order to solve the risk decision problem of a construction project. The factor set is established including condition attribute and decision attribute. Then experts qualitatively describe risk factors and create a decision table, and the attribute reduction algorithm based on Rough Sets is used to eliminate the redundant risk factor and its value of decision table. Finally, the minimum decision rules are created based on data mining results. And the rules with explain meanings are abstracted in the case study. We can make proper decision from the rules to improve precision and explanatory ability in practice.

articleTitle: Coordinated Development Evaluation between Electric Power Industry and National Economy Based on Grey Correlation Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Evaluating the degree of coordination between the electric power industry and the national economy accurately is the premise and foundation to promote the harmonious development of them. Existing research focused on coordination between the installed capacity and GDP, while lack overall evaluation of the coordination between the electric power industry and the national economy. This paper measures the development of electric power industry from installed capacity (generation side), the substation capacity (power grids side) and the whole society consumption (demand side), and measure the development of the national economy from the total economy, the economic structure and economic potential. We evaluate the coordinated development between the electric power industry and the national economy through grey correlation model based on the data of China from 1987 to 2006, so as to provide some policy recommendations to promote the coordinated development between the electric power industry and the national economy.

articleTitle: Combining Eigen-Beamforming and Differential Space-Time Modulation for Ricean Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper eigen-beamforming and differential space-time modulation (DSTM) are combined together to construct a robust and relatively simple system for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) Ricean fading channels. A transmission scheme with feedback link is developed here that combines beamforming with differential multi-antenna modulation based on orthogonal space-time block coding. The power loading algorithm of the eigen-beamformer is derived based on the principle of minimizing error probability bound. The optimality leads to better performance than traditional STBC transmission scheme. The simulation results proved that the combination of the eigen-beamforming and DSTM is an effective way to solve the problem with performance, complexity, and transmission rate for wireless communications.

articleTitle: Study of Chinese Real Estate Stock Daily Return Under Different Market Condition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The article studied the real estate daily risk and returns. We found the single model (CAPM) can excellently explain the real estate stock and industry daily return, The mostly betas of real estate stock and real estate industry are higher than 1 which means that the systematic risk of real estate industry is higher than the market risk, there is no significant difference of real estate daily betas between the advancing markets and declining markets.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of PN Code Acquisition Based on Software Radio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Spread spectrum technology can effectively solve the problems such as bad channel environment, multi-path fading etc between mobile station and subscribers. At present the research on the synchronization of PN code is more concentrated on how to implement fast acquisition. This paper introduces the sliding correlation method of PN code acquisition, gives out a serial and parallel acquisition method which is suitable for the mobile communication, and designs circuit under electronic design software Quartus II using VHDL. At last the accuracy of this method was verified on FPGA.

articleTitle: The Role of Process Evaluation in Creative Participation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A model that includes evaluations both on outcome and on process of creative participation is proposed. In addition to the positive effects of evaluation of outcome on the consequence of creative participation, the majority of the effects of three characteristics of the process evaluation (i.e., process importance, effort investment and emotions in process) on the outcome and the consequence of creative participation are empirically confirmed.

articleTitle: Three-Level Model for All Elements Innovation Mechanism and its Empirical Research
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed three-level model for all elements innovation mechanism in the total innovation, based on the discussion about the dimension of total innovation and its relationship. The article proposed three fundamental suppositions and eleven sub-suppositions through theoretical analysis and investigation. We have the research data by drawing the questionnaire survey, and process those data by using SPSS15.0 and AOMS7.0, thus carry on the empirical study for the above suppositions. The article finally give the following conclusions: true effects on technological innovation and market innovation firstly is institution innovation, secondly is culture innovation, finally is organization innovation; the coefficients of the function path for strategy innovation to culture innovation, institution innovation and organization innovation respectively is 0.81, 0.70, and 0.64.

articleTitle: FFT Based Superimposed Pilot Aided Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation in OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel superimposed pilot based carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimator for Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems over frequency selective fading channel is proposed. Through utilizing the properly designed superimposed pilots, the CFO estimation can be resolved by implementing the fast Fourier transform (FFT) operation on the average values of the received signals on all subcarriers within several consecutive OFDM blocks. Compared with the existing superimposed training aided algorithm, the proposed scheme can obtain more accurate CFO estimation without increasing computation complexity. The simulation results verify the robustness and effectiveness of the proposed estimator.

articleTitle: A Parallel Architecture for Sampling Rate Conversion Based on Pseudo-DFT
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A parallel processing architecture for sampling rate conversion in all-digital receiver is proposed in this paper. According to the time shifting property of the FT, the DFT of the desired output samples can be evaluated by the input samples. And the DFT-like transform in this constructed expression can be fast computed by the famous butterfly structure. To overcome the inherent saddle error of this approach, an overlapping input signal strategy is given.

articleTitle: Marketing Communications within Real Estate Enterprises of Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By studying the present situation of Chongqing's real estate marketing, the researcher finds that there is a problem of inefficient communication between marketing department and other departments, including non-marketing departments. In this dissertation, directing at the problems existing in marketing communication of Chongqing's real estate enterprises, the researcher puts forward an innovational marketing communication and management system model and process. This innovational marketing communication and management system requires people to look from the angle of consumers' need and carries out marketing activities from internal to external of the enterprises.

articleTitle: A New Method of Calculating Client Expectation Contribution: Model and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper aims to explore a method to make a regression analysis of the client expectation contribution, the central factor in calculating clients' assets, fit the calculating function for it, and use the function in the calculation to establish a measuring model. For illustration, it makes a case study of a certain branch of China Construction Bank in Hubei with its loan business of fixed assets in the catering and entertaining industry, showing how to apply the method and at the same time, offering both a goodness-of-fit test and a significance test of the results of the clients' assets calculation.

articleTitle: An Inventory Model for Intangible Deteriorated Items with Demand-Dependent Deteriorating Rate
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An inventory model has been proposed for intangible deteriorating items with demand-dependent deteriorating rate under the circumstance in which the demand rate is changing exponentially with time. The production rate is the function of demand rate and inventory level and shortages are not allowed in the inventory model. This inventory model is suitable for the situation in which the deterioration is intangible and the demand rate is changing exponentially with time. The total average inventory cost is derived and the optimal expression can be obtained for production scheduling period, maximum inventory level, total average cost and the cycle time of inventory replenishment in this paper. At last, numerical examples are performed and discussed.

articleTitle: A Novel Authentication Protocol with Soundness and High Efficiency for Security Problems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently the concern about security and privacy issues of RFID tags have emerged just because of the vital information in the operation of the RFID system at open radio frequency circumstance. To overcome these threats, this paper presents a mutual authentication mechanism, renewing the tag's key value in each process, which can solve the problem such as privacy or wiretapping, replay attack, forward security, synchronization indistinguishability or location track and ownership transfer. In view of the cost of tags, we only utilize the symmetric encryption in RFID authentication protocol. Analysis shows that this approach is of good security and privacy, low cost, and high efficiency.

articleTitle: SWMN: A Scalable Architecture of Wireless Mesh Network for Internet Accessing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless mesh networks (WMN), most flows are destinated to Internet. The IEEE 802.11s standard does not consider the flow characterization of WMN. Employing the mechanism may cause some scalable issues. SWMN, a new scalable architecture for WMN is proposed, which consists two components, one is mesh backbone, the other is mesh domain. To form this architecture, two metrics "radio metric" and "domain metric" are calculated, furthermore, two procedures are proposed to achieve the forming processing. We investigate the performance of this architecture by simulations and the results show that SWMN has better scalability and more capacity.

articleTitle: Topology Design and Performance Analysis of Hybrid Networks with Space Segments
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The design and development of future ground-space integrated networks is one of the hot issues in space technology nowadays because of the long-link delay, high bit-error-rate, asymmetric bandwidth, intermittent links compare with the terrestrial networks. The focus of this paper is to design topology for this hybrid networks with space segments, select appropriate protocols for it and analyze its performance at the same time. The paper does research on these problems based on IP technology of the ground network and CCSDS protocol that special for space communication, proposes an topology to integrate the space network and the ground network using a new mode, that is IP over CCSDS AOS mode; then it designs a data transmission configuration and protocol stack model for the ground/space hybrid network, in the end, the paper analyses the performance of this configuration in the hybrid networks. The results show that the topology and the transmission configuration proposed by the paper have a better performance than the regular configuration and worth to be applied.

articleTitle: The Research and Application of Knowledge-Based Mechanical Product Conceptual Design System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Advanced Manufacturing Technology has become an important technical support for accelerating high new technical development. Because of lacking scientific accumulation in experiences of missile design for long, there is a longer cycle of missile design and manufacturing, and efficiency is low. The process of product conceptual design is very complicated, including inheritance, integration, reuse, innovation and management of knowledge. When the design method based knowledge is leaded into, experiences and knowledge of experts in different fields can be shared, and it can make design much more creativity and predictability, moreover, due to consistency of field knowledge in a product lifecycle, successful rate of rapidly developing products can be assured, the cycle of developing products can be greatly shortened. Based on several advanced theoretical backgrounds the structure and function of the product conceptual design system based on knowledge is given in detail. We systematically integrate TRIZ and design axiomatic in a rational way to support conceptual design through creativity approach. The prototype system implement by the infrared guiding system project design software system, and infrared guiding system project design has made the good result. Thereby, the design pattern is progressing along self-adaptive direction of "design-analysis-optimization", and a leap from experiential design to scientific design can be made.

articleTitle: Service Communication Strategies Based on the Customer Perceived Risks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The unique characteristics of service mean that service has higher inherent risks than tangible product for the prospects. On the basis of previous reviews of the perceived-risk concept, a descriptive model of risk perception and reduction activity before service purchase is formulated, and consumers' risk-reduction activities are expatiated. Finally, the effective communication strategies for service providers to reduce customers' risk perception are put forward as well, including mouth-to-mouth strategy, information simulating based on service experience in promoting and advertising, providing visible or interpretative cues, making intangible service tangible through effective advertising.

articleTitle: NACS: Nodes Accessing Control Strategy for Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With low usage of physical and application flow characterizations, current WMN architecture couldn't make full use of the network capacity. Compared with conventional multi-hop wireless networks, nodes in wireless mesh networks (WMNs) are with diversity. However, current protocols for WMNs does not consider these characterizations. In order to improve the throughput of WMNs, this paper proposes a new node accessing control strategy (NACS), which provides a stable infrastructure for applications running in up-layers. Simulation results show that this new NACS works well and the average throughput of our new approach is at least 20% more than original NACSs inheriting from IEEE 802.11.

articleTitle: A Case Study of the Construction of the Auxiliary Material Order and Warehousing Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Increasing salary costs, management efficiency concern, and economic globalization provide a strong incentive for enterprise's information system construction. This paper describes the construction of the auxiliary material order and warehousing management information system in the case of the overall information development at the X cigarette factory, for the purpose of achieving sharing of information resources with other information systems and developing it into a highly-efficient supply chain-based management subsystem. The research shows that Chinese enterprises tend to develop the information system gradually and by outsourcing partly in view of IS application facilities, process stability and the quality of staff.

articleTitle: Mobile Business as a Strategic Tool to Acquire Competitive Advantages: Taking Logistics Industry in China as an Example
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes mobile business in the context of logistics industry as a strategic tool to create a sustainable competitive advantage through the implementation of mobile business. Uncertainty, risk, and open competition among logistics firms have risen dramatically, thus firms have more and more difficulties to acquire and sustain competitive advantages. Some frameworks concerning this topic have been established and in this paper we adopt these frameworks. In traditional views, critical factors for creating value through mobile business are user experience, the value contribution of mobile technology, and customer requirements. Based on this view, the most efficient and effective way found to match these factors is to enhance interaction between customers and firms through mobile business applications, which can facilitate response time and make the interaction more convenient. Additionally, the ability to integrate mobile business application into logistics industry is crucial for firms to gain competitive advantages.

articleTitle: Capacity Investments in Supply Chain under Asymmetric Production Cost Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider a supply chain consisting of two independent agents, a manufacturer and a single supplier, the latter is the only source for a customized component. Two cases are considered. When the manufacturer has complete information on the production cost of the supplier, we offer cost-sharing contracts to coordinate the supply chain. Our analysis demonstrates that the manufacturer who pays more of the install cost will get more profit. When the production cost is private information not known to the manufacturer, the supplier has an incentive to hide it. In this case, the manufacturer will obtain the supplier's true information by offering a menu of contracts. We derive the optimal quantity of the capacity under asymmetric information and compare it to the situation where the manufacturer has full information.

articleTitle: Application of System Dynamics to Enterprise Financial Scenario Planning
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Financial scenario planning plays an important role in enterprise decision-making. However, the complexity and volatility of the market environment and business system increase difficulties in the planning. The current methods used for the scenario planning depend on linear functions directly or indirectly to build forecasting models, which lead to the low accuracy of the financial planning . This paper proposes a new method for building a financial planning model based on system dynamics. Finally, this new model is applied for the financial planning of a real company. The results of simulations demonstrate the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Building Data Mining Applications with SQL Server 2005
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data mining applications used by an enterprise is an effective option to inform and guide your decision making to keep your products and services competitive. This paper systematically analyzes some main data mining tasks. SQL server 2005 provides most powerful algorithms to support data mining tasks, they are integrated and available from one vendor, it's clear that companies building data mining applications with SQL server 2005 are armed for success.

articleTitle: Research of Autonomic Software Based on Complexity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Autonomic computing (AC) is a new domain, based on AC theory to design autonomic system is not perfect and implement process is more difficult. Especially, there lack tools and models to test the autonomic system. According to above-mentioned reason, this paper mainly discusses dependability of autonomic software. We proposed a model to analyze autonomic maturity of software: First introduces software autonomic characteristics, autonomic manager; Second, summarizes the software complexity, relation between the autonomic and the complex; Third discusses problems of software autonomic and resolve technology. Finally analyses validness of the model. In the future, it is to be optimized in the application.

articleTitle: Modeling and Empirical Study on Management of Telecommunication Customer Expectation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although company's spending on marketing keeps rising, customer's expectation also becomes higher, which results in the improvement of customer satisfaction rate become more and more difficult. This paper analyzes the key constitutive factors and influencing factors of telecommunication customer expectation and builds a telecommunication customer expectation management model including constitutive regression model and influencing model. It explores the influencing mechanism of telecommunication customer expectation according to the regression coefficient of constitutive model and path- coefficient of influencing model based on empirical study. Combined with the analyzed results of the model, finally the paper put forwards proposals for telecommunication operators on effective management of customer expectation.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Concurrent Circumstance in Development of Military Equipment Logistics Information System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By analyzing the characteristics about development of military equipment logistics information system, concurrent circumstance was applied to development of military equipment logistics information system and a development method of military equipment logistics information system under concurrent development circumstance was put forward. By establishing of system integrated development groups and design of information exchange platform, the development method was discussed.

articleTitle: Performance of DTC-OFDM of the LMS Channel in Ka Band
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Differential turbo coded OFDM(DTC-OFDM) scheme was presented, together with a differential soft-detection method for Ka-band satellite communications. DTC-OFDM combines Turbo codes, orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation and differential detection, which has the advantages of high spectrum efficiency and suppression of multipath fading, jamming and noise. The DTC-OFDM system model and Ka-band satellite communication system simulation model have been found, then we also analyzed the bit error rate (BER) performance of OFDM with N-QAM modulation technique. The results show that DTC-OFDM system gives the best performance compared to convolutional coded (CC) and trellis coded OFDM systems. In the case of 256-QAM, DTC- OFDM system can provide 1 dB coding gain at a BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> compared with TCM-OFDM system and 4 dB compared with CC-OFDM system.

articleTitle: The Transmission Performance in HF Crypto Communication
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Speech quality evaluation of traditional way is using subjective tests such as mean opinion score (MOS). The transmission performance of the characteristics of ciphered MELP encoding information is reviewed, when the information of a cipher system is transmitted over a wireless HF fading channel. As such, a designed scheme for deciding the interleaving depth over a HF environment is described, and simulations confirm that the proposed efficient algorithm with a variable interleaving depth produces a better performance using MOS test method than a static depth with a fixed interleaving depth. Experimental results showed that the bit error rate performance of the proposed efficient interleaving scheme is higher than that of the fixed interleaving depth scheme.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Non-Orthogonal Multi-Modulation MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An obstacle of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) multiple-input multiple-output system is using cyclic prefix (CP) which leads to loss of bandwidth. It is a challenge of the high utilization rate for modern communication systems. In order to eliminate the impact of CP of OFDM, non-orthogonal multiple-modulation (NOMM) is introduced for MIMO system. Relevant error probability and bandwidth efficiency are meliorated because of the breakthrough constraints of orthogonal. A novel constellation design is proposed for NOMM, which enhances the performance resisting interference and obtain the capacity gain. NOMM offers a more effective method in practice and indicates a broad development for modulation techniques in theory as well.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Interaction Between Oil Price Shock and World Economic Activity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although the research on the relation between oil price shock and economic growth have emerged in a large amount since the 1970s, there has been little empirical research on the interaction between oil price shock and world economic activity. In this paper, the unit roots test with two structural breaks and VAR model are used to study the interaction from the first quarter of 1970 to the fourth quarter of 2007.
