UWB technology as one of the transmission techniques suitable for implementing a Cognitive Radio system is discussed. A SATCOM downlink employing the multiband UWB signal transmission is considered. The total bandwidth is assumed to be 500 MHz in the allocation of the satellite downlink and it is divided into multiple subbands. The link budget calculation and the estimation of the signal transmission speed are reported assuming multiband UWB signal transmission from a GSO satellite to the earth's surface. The initial results show that the UWB SATCOM towards CR has broad application prospect.

articleTitle: Lower Bound on the Ergodic Capacity of MIMO Relay Channels in Rayleigh Fading Case
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the ergodic capacity in Rayeigh fading case and derives the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions for achieving the lower bound on ergodic capacity when nodes have different number of antennas, especially when the number of source antennas is larger than that of the destination's and the relay transmitter and receiver's. Then we verify it through simulations. Besides, simulation results show that with the increase of the number of the transmitter antennas, the lower bound on ergodic capacity raises linearly. Because the source node and the relay node can function as a "virtual" transmit antenna array when the relay node is located close to the source node.

articleTitle: Novel study on Cooperative Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In cognitive networks, cooperative spectrum sensing is employed to detect the presence of primary user quickly. In this paper, we study the improvement in sensing performance of a cognitive user U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> by allowing another cognitive user U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> to act as its relay. We derive the expression of SNR, and exploit the improvement in SNR to explain why the sensing performance may be improved by using cooperation. For the situation where there is power constraint for U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> when acting as a relay, we pay more attention to studying which parameter affects the sensing performance significantly. We first develop a new numerical model for sensing performance analysis, then we address that, the product of transmission power of cognitive radio and channel gain (between cognitive users) is tightly related to the value of SNR. Further, we propose an important parameter beta that can be predetermined in a practical cognitive network, and show that beta impact the sensing performance greatly.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Deployment of RFID Readers in EPC Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology has much potential to automate business processes and improve visibility across the supply chain, especially in target tracking problems. So the deployment of RFID readers is very important. This paper focuses on the optimization of RFID readers' deployment for target tracking in Electronic Product Code (EPC) Network performed by Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. The simulation results show that the PSO algorithm maximizes the tracking precision and minimizes the reader consumption.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Green Supply Chain Logistics Model with Uncertain Reverse Pameters
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the problem on global warming, green supply chain management, in particular, logistics, has drawn the attention of researchers. Although there were closed-loop green logistics models appeared in the literatures, most of them did not consider the uncertain environment in general terms. In this study, a generalized model was proposed when the uncertainty is expressed by fuzzy and interval numbers. A solution procedure was developed and illustrated by a numerical example. The resultant solution provides useful information of the expected solution under a confidence level.

articleTitle: On the Broadcast Storm Problems of Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks: A Cross-Layer Design
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) normally consist of large number of sensing nodes that organize themselves into multi-hop wireless networks. It is desirable for communication protocols to minimize the communication overhead and hence the energy consumption while keeping the data delivery relatively reliable. In this paper, we present a new routing protocol, called cross-layer AODV (CAODV), based on a cross-layer design and Ad hoc on-demand distance vector (AODV) routing protocol. The proposed protocol adopts two mechanisms, called delaying transmission (DT) and efficient broadcasting (EB), to address the broadcast storm problems in WSNs such as high probability of collisions and redundancy of broadcasting. Simulation results show that CAODV can improve the performance of the routing protocol in WSNs by reducing the routing overhead and the latency of route discovery without degrading the packet delivery ratio.

articleTitle: Research on Value Stream Analysis and Optimization Methods
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the concept of value, waste and value stream, value stream analysis process is presented. It can delete wastes and optimize information flow and value stream in product development. A new kind of DSM optimization method is proposed to achieving seamless value flow with decomposition and integration, thus, to shorten project cycle and cut cost of project. Finally, the new optimization method is applied to a design process of a construction project, it shortens the design period by 33%.

articleTitle: Standardization and Integration of Information System in International Container Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Container logistics plays a significant role in today's international trade. Advanced information system and equipments have been more and more employed in international container logistics in line with thriving international commerce and stricter regulations on anti-terrorism. Study on integration of information system in international container logistics is made based on the standardization of logistics information and e-tag, RFID, GPS and GPRS technology to avoid redundant information processing and unreasonable utilization of current equipments. Topology structure is brought forward on the basis of ebXML.

articleTitle: Dam Deformation Monitoring Model and Forecast Based on Hierarchical Diagonal Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To solve the problem that the forecast accuracy is too weak when adopting former monitoring models to deal with dam monitoring data, a new deformation monitoring model has been put forward based on hierarchical diagonal neural network that can approximate any nonlinear function. The model takes water pressure, temperature and age factors as the input and dam deformation as the output. And then the series-parallel model identifier and dynamic BP learning algorithm play an important role in modeling. The dam deformation data fitting analysis and forecasting research show that the model is not only convergent quickly enough to improve the efficiency of the algorithm, but also has a good effect in fitting with monitoring data. In a word, hierarchical diagonal neural network has great validity and superiority in the dam safety forecast analysis.

articleTitle: The Impact of Website and Offline Equality on Relationship Quality: An Empirical Study on E-Retailing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the advancement of technology, many aspects of the face-to-face interpersonal dynamics in service encounters between sellers and customers have been replaced by technology-based Web interfaces. E-retailing has the dual nature of Web- based application system and traditional shopping mall. This paper examines the relationship among Website quality, offline quality and relationship quality dimensions (satisfaction, trust and commitment). Based on an empirical study of 223 customer questionnaires, the authors conclude that: (1) the offline quality has a direct positive impact on the satisfaction and trust dimension of relationship quality, and the Website quality has a direct positive impact on the satisfaction dimension of relationship quality; (2) satisfaction dimension has a direct positive impact on both trust and commitment dimensions.

articleTitle: Congestion Control in Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Congestion is a natural phenomenon in any network queuing system, and is unavoidable if the queuing system is operated near capacity. In this paper, we study how to set rules of a satellite queuing system so that all the users have self-interest in controlling congestion when it happens. Most of the mechanisms proposed to accomplish this in terrestrial Internet involve complicated packet scheduling algorithms. These algorithms may not be implemented in satellite router due to satellite hardware constraints or performance differences; thus, finding more easily implemental variants of such algorithms may be of significant practical value. After investigating characteristics of satellite traffic traces, we propose PA (Penalize heavy volume unresponsive flows and Avoid unnecessary bandwidth waste) to allocate bandwidth fairly and eliminate unnecessary bandwidth waste. PA is a simple packet dropping scheme and discriminates against the flows which submit more packets/sec than is allowed by their fair share. Game-theoretic analysis shows that PA could impose Nash equilibrium on selfish agents. Simulation results suggest that the design provides a good tradeoff between efficiency and fairness in a wide variety of operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Decision Model for IS Outsourcing Based on AHP and ELECTREIII
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information systems (IS) outsourcing decision is a complex problem that is often faced by the decision makers involved in the planning process. There is a few of literature that addresses the IS outsourcing decision making process in a quantitative way. Given the multi-attribute nature of IS outsourcing decision, this paper argues that five factors, including, strategy, economics, risk, environment and quality, should be considered for IS outsourcing decisions. Furthermore, the paper applies a hybrid AHP and ELECTREIII methods to the IS outsourcing question in an effort to demonstrate one quantitative approach to this complex decision. In applying the model, it shows that the model is very well suited as a decisionmaking tool for the IS outsourcing decision. Finally, potential issues for future research are presented.

articleTitle: Dynamic Research for Term Structure of Repo Interest Rate Based on TGARCH
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the process of China's marketization of interest rates, researching the term structure of interest rates has very important theoretical and practical significance to the development and improvement of China's financial market. In the paper, time series theories, such as GARCH and TGARCH model, are respectively applied to estimate the term structure of repo interest rate based on the basic model. The empirical results show: 1) As to the fitting results, the TGARCH model is better than the GARCH model for fitting the term structure of one day, 7 days, 14 days, one month, and two months repo interest rate. 2) The 7 days, 14 days, one month, and two months repo interest rate have very strong mean-reversion characteristic. But one day repo interest rate does not have remarkable linear mean- reversion characteristic. 3) Diffusions of term structure of the one day, 7 days, 14 days, one month, and two months repo interest rate have obvious asymmetry.

articleTitle: A Study of EILS: Providing Semantic Interoperability through Ontology Hierarchy in EIS Integration
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Enterprise information systems (EIS) often face difficulties in linking various components and external systems. Interoperability is necessary when integrating EIS, with enterprises-partners according to existing EIS. However, interoperability among collaborating participants is hard to tackle in the interaction between business and IT problem domains during EIS integration process. The integration of EIS needs to be considered from an architectural point of view on issues around business, organization and information technology. Enterprise Isomorphic Architecture (EIA) was built as an effective architectural solution to coordinate powerful technologies with business applications to enable seamless inter- organizational integration. As the core part of EIA, Enterprise Isomorphic Layer Structure (EILS) studied in this paper is to provide structural and semantic identification of integrating EIS entities based on the ontology hierarchy for interoperability in problem domain. EILS allows reaching desired interoperability level of existing EIS by realizing business agility and IT infrastructure, consolidating processes between them, and facilitating business changes with simultaneous evolution of the IT infrastructure. Application of interoperable EIS based on EILS will give valuable positive practical effect in EIS integration.

articleTitle: Optimization of Vehicle Routing Problem with Load Balancing and Time Windows in Distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Vehicle route scheduling is an important activity in supply chain management. It is virtually a kind of vehicle routing problem with time windows (VRPTW). An improved model of VRPTW with load balancing was built up. It aims to achieve minimum vehicles, the shortest distribution distance, load balancing and customer's time demand. The algorithm was designed to two-stage. The first Stage was used to find the vehicle route schedule through particle swarm optimization. An improved inertial coefficient was considered to enhance the search speed. The second Stage was implemented for load balancing. The optimal or sub-optimal solution can be found efficiently through the proposed model for medium size vehicle routing problem.

articleTitle: On-Demand Reliable Routing Mechanism for MANET Based on Link Lifetime Predicting
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One critical issue for routing in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANET) is how to select a reliable path that can last longer since mobility may cause links to break down frequently. Based on the estimated link lifetime, a novel routing mechanism is proposed in this paper. In order to describe the received signal strength continuously, the Newton interpolation polynomial is constructed according to several sample values; thus, the link lifetime can be estimated with reference points calculated from polynomial. With the manner of maximum link lifetime, the source nodes set up route hop-by-hop. Simulation results show that the received signal strength can be described by Newton interpolation polynomial accurately; moreover, the route discovery times and packet drop ratio can be reduced obviously by our mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on Control Scheme of Reservoir Limited Water Level Based on Water Supply Risk
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The benefit of dynamic control of limited water level is gained by reducing the abandon water and making best use of flood water resources, which goes with risk. For a dynamic limited water level, the different scheme will receive the different benefit. Therefore, it has theoretical and practical significance to choose a reasonable and feasible method to calculate the risk and benefit. In this paper, taking Biliuhe reservoir as a case, according to water supply system risk and its process in Dalian city, the utilization and benefit of excessive store flood water is analyzed. After analysis of submerge loss owing to the elevation of limited water level of reservoir, the control range is determined by using the marginal cost method. The results indicate that the limited water level of Biliuhe reservoir can be raised suitably, with increasing of water consumption in Dalian city.

articleTitle: MIMO-OFDM PAPR Reduction by Space-Frequency Permutation and Inversion
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) has attracted much attention as a solution of high-quality service for next generation wireless communications. However, like OFDM, one of main problems of MIMO-OFDM is the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR). In this paper, a novel method to reduce the MIMO-OFDM PAPR is proposed. This method applies space and frequency two-dimensional subblock permutation and inversion to the multiple antenna OFDM signals based on STBC. Two suboptimal schemes, termed successive suboptimal SFPI (SS-SFPI) and random suboptimal SFPI (RS-SFPI) are presented to reduce the complexity of the proposed scheme. Simulation results show that SFPI improves PAPR reduction performance compared with existing PAPR scheme, and the suboptimal schemes can significantly reduce PAPR on all transmit branches at the same time with low complexity.

articleTitle: The Improved Public Key Encryption Algorithm of Kerberos Protocol Based on Braid Groups
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since the limitations of Kerberos authentication protocol for symmetric algorithm, there are many improved Kerberos protocol of RSA public key encryptions. However, the existing public key encryption system resistance in the analysis of quantum encryption has brought tremendous challenges. Braid group is a new considerable public key cryptography platform for the quantum computer ages. The new intractable problem is proposed by combing the non-conjugate transformation and multi-variable equations on braid groups, whose intensity is strengthened by increasing the number of variables. The public key encryption algorithm based on braid groups is proposed. The novel algorithm is used to improve Kerberos protocol, which can be very good resistance to various attacks. Therefore, it has more security and practicality.

articleTitle: A Robust Localization Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most of localization algorithms in wireless sensor networks need the location information of reference nodes to locate the unknown nodes. When the location information is tampered by the attacks or errors, the accuracy of these algorithms will degrade badly. An improved existing typical APIT algorithm -AVNRP (APIT based on Von Neumann rejection principle), is proposed in this paper. The experiment results demonstrate that AVNRP has better robustness than original algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influence of Synchronous Blinking Jamming to Radar Seeker Antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Synchronous blinking jamming is an effective countermeasure against radar seeker. It causes line-of-sight angle to step continuously between the two angular positions through jamming resources emit by turns. Seeker antenna always adjusts to track the line-of-sight angle in synchronous blinking jamming, so the oscillation of antenna is produced. According to angle tracking circuit model of radar seeker, the relation between the parameters of jamming resource and seeker antenna is studied. In the end, the antenna response curves is simulated in different jamming parameters.

articleTitle: Earned Value Project Management of Model-Centric Software Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper describes an approach to managing software projects with earned value (EV) combining with function point. We improve function point count rules for software models to calculate EV parameters and indexes, and use function point as software project baselines and performance measurement in the software project. We propose an evolutionary work breakdown structure (WBS) that is able to flexibly orient to software development processes instead of premature and stiff software design. Both the project plan and WBS are made and refined iteratively as more information available from the project development. The method of controlling model-driven software projects is presented. A controlled experiment shows the usefulness and effectiveness of the method for monitoring schedule and costs in software projects.

articleTitle: Explaining Virtual Community User Knowledge Sharing Based on Social Cognitive Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: User active knowledge contribution is crucial for virtual community development. Social cognitive theory (SCT) argues that individual behavior is influenced by both environment and personal cognition. Based on SCT, this paper analyzed the effect of trust as an environmental factor and self-efficacy, community-related outcome expectation and personal outcome expectation as personal cognitive factors on user knowledge sharing. We collected 250 valid papers and analyzed the data with LISREL. The results show that trust strongly affects self-efficacy, which in turn affects community-related outcome expectation and personal outcome expectation. Trust, self-efficacy and personal outcome expectation significantly affect knowledge sharing. We did not find the significant effect of community-related outcome expectation on knowledge sharing.

articleTitle: China's Generation Y: New Trend-Setter in the Workforce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Economists project that China could overtake the United States as the world's biggest economy by mid-century, yet even after The Reform Era in China, little is known about China's Generation Y, the future leader and backbone of the China's workforce. Constituting approximately 204 million young individuals born between 1980 and 1989, China's Gen Y is beginning to make waves. Growing up in the age of economic boom, technology development, educational availability and parents who want to give it all to their children has made the members of Generation Y is a product of their environment. By bringing new ideas and values into the workplace, Generation Y is a great challenge to those employers across all industries. In this article, generational Y in China's workforce will be first defined, their traits, strengths and weakness in workplace will be analyzed, on the basis of which the suggestions for managing Generation Y will be put forward.

articleTitle: Identifying Corresponding Entities Based on Attribute Entropy in Heterogeneous Databases
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With progress of information technology, it is necessary to access multiple heterogeneous databases in order to get the desired information from different sources. One main problem encountered constantly among heterogeneous databases is entity heterogeneity, which arises when the same real-word entity type is represented using different identifiers in different application domains. So identifying the heterogeneous entities and resolving conflicts are critical when realizing interoperability in multiple heterogeneous databases. In this paper, we examine the entity heterogeneity problem and propose an approach based on attribute entropy to identifying corresponding entities. The experimental results on real-world data show our proposed approach is very effective.

articleTitle: A Robust Transform Domain Narrowband Interference Suppression Technique in Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a robust narrowband interference excision technique in wireless communications based on modulated lapped biorthogonal transform (MLBT), including the Malvar's MLBT and the MLBT constructed by Matviyenko's optimized window. First, we study the bit error rate (BER) performance of the MLBT-based exciser in direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) system theoretically. Then we study the application of MLBT to narrowband interference suppression in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing spread spectrum (OFDM-SS) and multiband (MB)-OFDM-based ultra wideband (UWB) communications by simulations. Simulation results show that the Matviyenko-MLBT-based narrowband excision technique has the improved BER performance and increased robustness with respect to the interference frequency offset relative to the modulated lapped transform (MLT)-based technique in DSSS. It is also superior to the fast Fourier transform (FFT) and the MLT-based interference suppression technique in OFDM-SS and MB-OFDM-based UWB communications.

articleTitle: Scalable QoS Provisioning and Service Node Selection in Relay Based Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The increasing popularity of wireless communications and the different QoS requirements of new types of service lead to higher demands on cellular mobile networks. With central control and multi-hop communication, relay based cellular networks are seen as an effective way to meet users' increased bit rate requirements while still retaining the benefits of a cellular structure. However, the more complex architecture and topology make the provision of optimal QoS more challenging. The objective of this paper is to illustrate an effective and efficient approach for scalable QoS provision in relay based cellular networks. Primary concerns are, firstly, the selection of the node to service the mobile user with QoS that guarantees the time delay requirement for multimedia services and eliminates bottleneck links; and secondly, the choice of the optimal slot allocation scheme that optimizes the radio resource allocation to maximize user satisfaction level and balance the QoS requirement. The performance evaluations use a Mobile WiMAX network.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a DPA Resistant AES Coprocessor
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve the DPA resistance of cryptographic device in intellectual cards, a power analysis platform is constructed for AES. After analyzed the AES encrypt process, a MASK circuit, disturbance circuit for clock and disturbance circuit for power are designed and implemented in an AES coprocessor of ZTEIC Corporation's intellectual card. The AES coprocessor can process data with 900 Mbps at 100 MHz frequency. The DPA test result shows the proportion of best DPA results is less than 5%, and with mask information. The AES coprocessor can defend DPA better than other products with a higher throughput.

articleTitle: Two Effective Attack Detection Algorithms in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the model of resilient data aggregation in wireless sensor networks, two attack detection algorithms by means of % -testing were proposed in this paper according to clustering uniformly or not, namely the CTUC (chi-square test for uniform cluster) algorithm and CTUUC (chi-square test for un-uniform cluster) algorithm. By applying % -testing with some priori knowledge about the system, the novel algorithms may effectively detect the attacking behaviors in the network and have a higher detection probability compared with the SC (split and check) method presented in the literature. In addition, the CTUC algorithm is suited well to the situation of an unknown distribution function or a larger variance of the sample data, while the CTUUC algorithm has a better detection performance when the variance is smaller. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the presented algorithms.

articleTitle: Wireless Networked Security System Based on ZigBee Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The existing security systems show many shortcomings such as difficult to extend and severe time-consuming because it is based on wiring network technology. In this paper, we present a wireless networked security system based on ZigBee technology. The system adopts hybrid topology structure based on cluster, which consists of many micro-sensor nodes, network coordinator nodes, network gateway (router), communication network and monitor centre (computer). For short distance transmission, the micro-sensor nodes collect data from the monitoring surroundings and transmit to the gateway using ZigBee communication. For long distance transmission, from the gateway to the monitor centre, system uses TCP/IP protocol. The gateway in this system is the protocol conversion used to transform a data package in ZigBee protocol to TCP/IP protocol before transmitting. A modified routing protocol based on LEACH is adopted in the system. The simulation result shows that the modified LEACH protocol has superiority on survival time. The wireless micro-sensor can be scattered to the surroundings that human unable enter. Then the sensor nodes self-organizing networked security system and realize security monitor task. The system also can be used to forest fireproofing and environment pollution inspection after modification.

articleTitle: Security Analysis for IEEE802.11
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper analyzes the security of IEEE 802.11. Based on the discussion of IEEE 802.11 security requirement, the three security technologies-SSID (Service Set Identifier), MAC(Media Access Control), WEP(Wired Equivalent Privacy) in WLAN standard IEEE802.11 are introduced, especially the encrypting algorithm and the integrity check algorithm in WEP. The security flaws caused by RC4 algorithm, key management, initialization vector Space, CRC algorithm and authentication mechanism in WEP are analyzed mainly in this paper. At the end of the paper, some advices and strategies to these flaws are given.

articleTitle: Examining the Determinants of Mobile Commerce User Repurchase Behavior
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile service providers often invest heavily on attracting new customers. If these new customers cannot be transformed into loyal ones, service providers will bear great loss. To improve user repurchase behavior, service providers can take measures to directly promote user repurchase on the one hand. On the other hand, they need to curb users' switching behavior. From these two perspectives, this paper examined the effect of trust, satisfaction as "enablers" and switching barriers as "inhibitors" on mobile users repurchase behavior. The results showed that these three factors had significant effect on user repurchase intention. Service quality and perceived value strongly affected trust and satisfaction, while switching cost determined switching barrier.

articleTitle: Management of the Relation Between the Enterprise and Supplier Based on the Chinese GUANXI Culture: A Case Analysis from SRM of SX Illumination Company
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supplier relation management (SRM) is an important link in enterprise management. The keen competition makes the relation between the enterprise and supplier is no longer simple buying and selling relationship, but should be intimate colleagues with mutual trust and contribution. This paper takes SX Illumination Company as the case to study its improvement of the SRM. It starts from the Chinese GUANXI culture, through establishing, maintaining and promoting the relation, to form RENQING (human feelings) resources, in order to reach a win- win situation.

articleTitle: Sidelobe Suppression in NC-OFDM Systems using Phase Shift
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: High sidelobe power could cause strong interference to primary users in the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) based cognitive radio systems, i. e. non-contiguous (NC) OFDM systems. In this paper, a phase shift method for sidelobe suppression for NC-OFDM systems is proposed and investigated. Instead of multiplying the phase shift sequences with all the active subcarriers, we consider applying these sequences to the subcarriers on the border of cognitive user's band since they affect the primary users most. Simulation results show that significant gain is achieved in sidelobe suppression and little change is introduced to the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) in the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Two-Hop Cooperative MIMO transmission with Relay Selection in Rayleigh Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless relaying is one of the promising solutions to overcome the channel impairments and provide high data rate coverage that appears for beyond 3G mobile communications. In this paper we present an end to end BER performance analysis of dual hop wireless communication systems equipped with multiple decode and forward relays over the Rayleigh fading channel with relay selection. We select the best relay based on end to end channel conditions. We apply orthogonal space time block coding (OSTBC) at source, and also present how the multiple antennas at the source terminal affects the end to end BER performance. This intermediate relay technique will cover long distance where destination is out of reach from source.

articleTitle: Twice-Cooperative Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The sensing performance of local detection in cognitive radio systems will be degraded when the channel experience fading and shadowing, and hidden terminal problem is inevitable for the primary transmitter-sensing. To overcome this problem, cooperative spectrum sensing has been proposed. We propose a twice-cooperative sensing algorithm to improve the sensing performance. By comparing to the single-cooperative, the simulations show that the proposed algorithm can enhance the sensing performance and the proposed algorithm can also save the band width of the control channel.

articleTitle: Hard Real-Time Communication Based on Shared Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ethernet with CSMA/CD mechanism is not suitable for time-bounded service. This paper presents a hard real-time communication protocol based on shared Ethernet named TTEP to solve the problem. It is unnecessary to change the hardware of Ethernet. TTEP is based on TDMA approach with master/slave scheme, and provides on-line admission control and on-line scheduling. This protocol uses CSMA/CD mechanism to send node addition requests and non-real-time traffic. And it transmits real-time traffic under the TDMA mechanism. Because production requirements, communication requirements and scheduling algorithm are localized in the master, it is easy to calculate when to produce the messages and when to transmit them. The messages are scheduled according to the calculated result within each EC. Therefore, this protocol has the ability to provide the guaranteed hard real-time communication.

articleTitle: Considering Lifetime Optimal Rate Allocation and Power Control in Wireless Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes and presents an optimal rate allocation and power control mechanism for wireless ad hoc networks. Using network utility maximization (NUM) framework and multiobjective optimization theory, we formulate resource allocation in the network as an optimization problem which takes into consideration both network utility and energy consumption. Meanwhile, the original optimization problem is vertically decomposed into two subproblems with Lagrange dual decomposition: a rate control problem at the transport layer and a power control problem at the physical layer. Both our theoretical analysis and simulation results prove that the proposed algorithm can converge quickly and be implemented in a distributed manner.

articleTitle: Self-Management Functions of Fisheries Associations
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the reform and opening-up policy, fishing villages transformed into a mode of individual production and operation, which not only encouraged fishermen's working initiative but also contributed to the economic transformation from government-orientation to marketing-orientation. However, in contrast to the previous collective one, the new mode is more difficult in management because individual economic interests have no longer been related to each other. Hence, relying on the government solely for direct management in the fishing sectors will be of great difficulty. In addition, fishermen's different quality also hinders the implementation of the national policy on fisheries management. Therefore, the liquidity in the fish resources and ambiguity in property rights characterized by this special industry are to make fishery associations play a good self-management role and self-management by fishermen can be the best implementation approach of administration.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Simulation to Support Decision Making in Software Development Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Almost all of the software development managers have to face such dilemma: recruitment or overwork to meet the deadline. How to place the right number of people at right place at right time to fulfill project objects is a great challenge to them. Furthermore initial estimation of project parameters base on their work experiences often lead to counter-intuitive results. In this work, we investigate a system dynamics simulation to capture the impact factors of recruitment and overwork on the degree of project completion. Through exposing dynamic behavior, simulation results can guide managers to evaluate different project policies and then make the best decision.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Analysis on the Technological Innovation Based on the Chain-Loop Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using system dynamics, the paper has studied the chain- loop model and drawn the causality graph. In the paper, the chain- loop model is improved and the paths and the main feedback relationships in the process of enterprise technological innovation are confirmed through the analysis on the causality graph.

articleTitle: Speculation and Closed-End Fund Puzzle in Chinese Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new approach has been proposed to give explanations to closed-end fund puzzle. The price of an asset can be decomposed into two parts: fundamental value and speculative value. Speculative value can be viewed as an American option value and comes from heterogeneous beliefs between investors. Generally, speculative value of trading closed- end funds is less than that of trading stocks, so discounts on closed-end fund NAVs occur. Empirical study shows that the new approach gives well explanations to closed-end fund puzzle in Chinese markets.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive Preemption Policy in MPLS Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new preemption policy is proposed to minimize rerouting in MPLS networks. It is complemented by an adaptive scheme that selects lower priority LSPs that can afford to have their rate reduced. The selected LSPs will fairly reduce their rate in order to accommodate the new high-priority LSP setup request. Simulation results indicate that our policy can improve the network resource utilization while minimizing LSPs' rerouting. Moreover, the computational complexity of our algorithm is acceptable for router's online computing in large scale networks.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Knowledge Integration Based on New Products Development
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Customer knowledge has increasingly been recognized within marketing as a significant resource, and it is the base of successful new product development. This paper analyzes the meaning and classification of customer knowledge, discusses the process of customer knowledge integration based on new product development, and then polices of customer knowledge integration for new product development to be successful.

articleTitle: The Development and Validation of Organizational Cohesion Inventory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The authors of this paper developed and validated a scale measuring cohesion at the organizational level. The scale, organizational cohesion inventory (OCI), includes six dimensions with 18 items. The discriminant validity and convergent validity of OCI were assessed by several methods including CFA, alternative models comparison, AVE, confidence interval, and Fisher's Z- transformation. The results suggest that the OCI has good psychometric properties. Implications and further research directions were discussed.

articleTitle: A Data-Aided Equalization Scheme for the FMT System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new wideband wireless communication technique is introduced in the article. The basic theory of the technique and performance was analyzed. The intersymbol interference (ISI) in FMT system and data-aided equalization method was studied. The simulation result show that it has better performance than decision feedback equalization (DFE) algorithm and the computational complexity is proximately equal.

articleTitle: Optimization of Cooperative Design Green Plan Oriented Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on cooperative knowledge management system, the necessity of green design was analyzed, and the characteristic of cooperative products green design was researched. After analyzing the system workflow of cooperative products green design, the shortest path decision-making model to support cooperative product green design evaluation based on ant colony optimization (ACO) approach was presented. Furthermore, the ACO approach was improved by Bayes theory. The Bayes decision can adjust the transfer probability of the ACO, and it can compress the search space effectively, improve the search speed, so that it can prevent the stagnation effectively. As a result, the better contraction results can be obtained.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Classification Based on BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Customer classification refers to a process in which customer information is divided into several sets of same characteristics by certain rules. According to different customer sets, we acquire different customer sets' behavior, and provide them with individual service. Thus customer's satisfaction and loyalty will be promoted highly. This paper employs BP neural networks to classify customer, and finds out different customer behavior of each set, then offers special service strategy, so as to make the service quality and enterprise resource optimized and allocated efficiently.

articleTitle: Study on Collaborative Innovation Management Model of Automobile Complex Products Based on Product Total Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Faced with the quick development of advanced scientific techniques and manufacturing techniques, China must speed up its complete change process from ldquosuper manufacturing countryrdquo to ldquoinnovation powerful countryrdquo. As one of the national pillar industries and the representative of complex product, automotive industry has already marched towards complete independent innovation. Nevertheless, automotive manufacturing enterprises always keep the innovation process tightly sealed in its internal environment, and would not like communicate and cooperate with other organization, especially with their competitors. Current product R&D systems flood with such phenomena as confused processes , obscure guidance, department barriers and trust crisis. Undoubtedly, they will restrict the optimized and controlled effects of progress, quality and cost factors of innovation process. Firstly, this paper summarized the problems of the current innovation management system of Chinese automotive manufacturing enterprises, and then made analysis to mutual relationship and collaboration factors of enterprises' internal departments and enterprise external organizations in R&D process. Finally, this paper built up the collaborative innovation management model of automobile complex product based on total product lifecycle. This model will be of momentous significance for product R&D process of Chinese automotive manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Estimate of Quality of the Ad Hoc Network Proactively for Video Transmission
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Real time Video transport over ad hoc network poses a great challenge due to the high variability of the network bandwidth. In this paper, to adjust rate in time according to the change of the quality of the channel of ad hoc network, we propose a scheme which judge the quality of the wireless channel proactively. The value of signal strength is used to be an important factor for judging the quality of wireless channel. Experiment results show that the averages of BER and PER can be reduced by employing this scheme.

articleTitle: Research of an Innovative Light Distributed Workflow Management System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, most of WfMSs (workflow management systems) in the market are based on centralized defining in the organization. Further more, they have poor ability to describe the complex process, and have difficulty to deal with the business process share between cross-organizations. To support virtual and cross-organizational workflows in distributed environment, WfMSs must realize cross-organizational and distributed management to improve the dependability and extensible etc. To solve these issues, a Web-based lightweight process modeling system has been developed in this paper. This system is based on Java and XML technology, and provides friendly GUI which is easy to be used. The model document can be saved in XML format, so the interoperation between different workflow products becomes easy. This system establishes the base for enacting the WfMSs.

articleTitle: A Performance Evaluation Model for E-Government Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Proposed a performance evaluation model for e-government project management based on the investigation on 15 various projects in Shanghai government from 2005 to 2006. The model includes: (A) a performance indicator system consists of 5 domains, (B) a nonlinear evaluation algorithm based on project risk theory. The model has been verified and applied in related departments in Shanghai government since 2007. The paper discussed the indicators design and the evaluation algorithm, and compared the evaluation results between the model and professional groups'.

articleTitle: A Novel Fast Link Setup Method Based on Mobile Agents for Mobile IP Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel fast link establishment method based on the combination with Multi protocol Label Switch (MPLS) and mobile agents(MA) for handoff during the mobile IP communication proceeding is proposed. By using the mobile agents for fast automatically information transforming the method can reduce the delay time dramatically. Simulations show that the transmission delay can be reduced to 27 to 41 percents in switching time.

articleTitle: A Media Usage Comparison of Office Workers in IT and Consulting Companies Between China and Japan
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Communication is important for successful services, and media selection is the key for communication. However nearly all previous research focused on qualified researches. In this research, quantified analyses on media selection in IT and consulting companies are made using media fitness framework (MFF). Moreover, selections from China and Japan were compared. FTF and email are found to be two of the most important communication media in office works. Furthermore, the selection of email is found to be the most similar one between China and Japan among all candidate media. Detailed differences and implication of these differences are discussed.

articleTitle: Organizational Learning, Organizational Structure, and Knowledge's Transfer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation, as an important corporate strategy, is the key activity that contributes to building core competitive advantage. During the process, the organizational learning decides the level of company's gaining innovative knowledge. This paper, based on learning theory and knowledge management theory, explores the relationship between knowledge's transfer, organizational learning and the organizational structure which impacting on the relationship with knowledge's transfer and organizational learning.

articleTitle: The Impact of ICT on the Information Economy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The information and communications technology (ICT) is the lifeblood of the information economy, as guarantee of sustainable economic growth and especially as a driver of productivity growth. Information technology has the potential to transform entire industries, so in this paper, the research emphasizes on the impact of ICT on the information economy at the industry level. Firstly, through analysis of ICT industry's contribution to GDP, we assess how ICT industry affects information economy. Secondly, we analyze the importance of ICT and the substitutability between ICT and the traditional production factors (capital and labor) with improved Cobb-Douglas function. We utilize the proposed method to Shanghai ICT, which provides solid support of positive ICT contributions to the information economy.

articleTitle: A Study on Content Delivery of Tourism Web Sites
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Content delivery is the key factor in development and application of the tourism Web sites. This paper employs the Rachman and Buchanan's research method to study the content delivery of the top three famous tourism Web sites in Chinese mainland, the result shows that their content delivery exist some default and insufficiency. Some improving ways also discussed for these tourism Web sites.

articleTitle: Rock Mass Deformation Analysis Based on Immune BP Network Model with Partial Least Squares Regression
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the correlation among variables, the non-linearity between independent variables and dependent variables, and the deficiency of traditional BP neural network in monitoring data analysis, a new model is proposed based on partial least squares regression method, BP neural network and immune clone algorithm. The model deals with the correlation according to least squares regression, settles the non-linearity with BP neural network, and moreover it applies immune clone algorithm to search of BP neural network Take rock mass deformation as the dependent variable and six factors of rock mass as the independent variables, a practical project are analyzed based on the model. The analysis result shows that the model is effective in overcoming the effects of correlation and nonlinearities, with a speedy and stable convergence. Therefore it has superiority in practical applications.

articleTitle: Valuing American Options by Weighted Least-Squares Quasi-Monte Carlo
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: American options pricing has the backward nature of iterative search feature. Based on the least-squares Monte Carlo(LSM), this paper employs Faure sequences and doubles the sample's number by antithetic variate method to decrease the variance of simulation. Then, underling assets are valued. Thus, weighted least-squares quasi-Monte Carlo (WLSQM) is proposed by weighted least-squares regression. Comparing the two methods with option value, standard error and computation cost, WLSQM is better than LSM, which validates WLSQM is efficient on pricing American options.

articleTitle: The Applied Analyses of the Stackelberg Model in the Competition of the Regional Hub Port
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Stackelberg model is often used to study on the suck cost and the barriers to entry between the enterprises competition. The paper analyzes the situation of two port enterprises competition in the intra-regional by means of the Stackelberg model. It studies on two port enterprises competition under the hypothesis of non-fixed entry cost and with the fixed entry cost based on the features of them. The former reflects the first-mover advantage of the leading port; the later analyses the monopoly condition of the leading port. The paper studies on the competition of the regional hub port between Dalian port and Yingkou port in the Northeast of China. It can be got that Dalian port has the first-mover advantage significantly, and with the strengthening in the separation of enterprise from government, this advantage will make Dalian port take the monopoly position in the future.

articleTitle: A New Scheme for KEM Supporting Cryptographic Workflow
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cryptographic workflow is a special cryptography system working model in multi-user occasions, in which to encrypt a message according to a certain policy so that only entities fulfilling the policy can perform the decryption of the message. Based on the idea of signcryption a new scheme for KEM supporting cryptographic workflow is proposed. The proposed scheme also is proved secure on receiver security and external security in standard model.

articleTitle: Efficient Spatial Interpolation Using a Simplified Up-Sampling Filter for Chrominance Component
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an efficient spatial interpolation scheme for spatial scalability in the joint scalable video model (JSVM) which defines a scalable extension on top of the H.264/AVC. In order to increase coding efficiency of JSVM, we adopt a simplified up-sampling filter. It is only used to magnify the chroma components of an image due to the less importance of them. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme causes negligible quality degradation in image PSNR performance and much more improvement in computational complexity, so it outperforms the interpolation method in current JSVM scheme.

articleTitle: A Novel Relaying Scheme for Improving Capacity of Non-Regenerative Coded Cooperation System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the wireless networks, utilization of terminals distributed in space can significantly improve the performance of wireless communication systems. In this paper, we investigate two-hop non-regenerative coded cooperation system and propose a novel design of employing linear dispersion codes (LDC) at the source node and a linear processing matrix at the relays. The relay stations make use of the knowledge of the first hop and second hop channel to assign power among the relay stations adaptively. We deduce and analyze the capacity of the proposed scheme. Numerical results show that the proposed scheme can achieve higher capacity gains over employing LDC on conventional Amplify-and-Forward (AF) system.

articleTitle: Research Field Discovery Based on Text Clustering
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the need of revealing the structure and dynamics of science, text mining technologies have been widely used in extracting technical intelligence from research literature. To analyze the status of research fields, this paper applies text clustering to Chinese national science research proposals. By using vector-space model to represent the proposals, an improved Newman fast clustering algorithm has been carried out to explore the clusters of each year, which indicate the yearly research fields. After that, the paper gives an insightful representation of the whole status of the research fields. Then the similarities of clusters of different years are calculated to discover the groups, which identify the major research fields and illustrate their stability and changes over the time. These analyses will be helpful to discover the development trends of basic research fields.

articleTitle: Collusion and Contract Efficiency in BOT Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper formulates the BOT concession agreement as an incomplete contract model to analyze the inefficient problems arising from the collusion between government inspector and project company. The main advantage of BOT project is that the cost externalities could be internalized in the form of consigning both construction and operation to the project company. However, the moral hazard is caused by the collusion and the limited resource financing. A competitive tender mechanism which endogenously determines the service fee might lead low-quotation, which is not effective to restrain the moral hazard. The paper is concluded by the remark that the contract efficiency is attained when the government keeps the relevant deposit from the project company in advance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Transmission for Mobile Streaming over WCDMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As Third generation (3G) systems growing, Mobile streaming is regarded as a main 3G service of network operators. The solution of streaming that has successfully been deployed on the internet doesn't meet the need of wireless networks circumstance, Because of varying bandwidth and error rate characteristics of mobile networks, it is important to adapt transmission to available resources to guarantee the maximum level of quality. In Release 6 specification, the 3GPP standardization body has extended the RTCP message and multi- rate file format for mobile streaming services. This paper describes these extentions and puts forward some new methods to estimate the state of networks and terminals according to the information in detail. At last strategies are given to fulfill self- adaptive transmission. Results show the proposed methods and strategies can effectively adapt transmission to the available resources, consequently achieving very high video quality.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of Concatenated Turbo Coding Scheme over the DVB-T Transmission Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper outlines the application of orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) in digital communication channel, then studies the turbo codes, mentions the concatenation of turbo codes and Reed-Solomon (RS) codes and analysis the performances of the new concatenated forward error correct (FEC) scheme applied to an OFDM system based on the digital terrestrial video broadcasting (DVB-T) scheme. The results are compared with the standard DVB-T convolutional codes performances on added white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channels. The simulation results shown that performances by employing turbo codes with only a few numbers of iterations the overall system can be improved significantly. These results are obtained applying an appropriate interleaver technique in the concatenated FEC procedure.

articleTitle: Predictive Linear Quadratic Power Control Algorithm in WCDMA Wireless Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Combining the approaches of optimal control theory and linear prediction technique, the user's transmitting powers are minimized and the system capacity is maximized with the quality of services (QoS) being satisfied simultaneously for all mobile terminals. A linear quadratic form of power control problem in wideband code division multiple access (WCDMA) systems is established and the fading channel path-gain is predicted. Simulation results show graphically that the proposed predictive linear quadratic power control (PLQ-PC) algorithm converges faster no less than 7 percents and makes the system support about 1.2 times users compared with those obtained by auto-tuning fuzzy power control (ATF-PC) and signal-interference ratio based power control (SIR-PC) algorithms, respectively.

articleTitle: Securitization of Longevity Risk in Pension Annuities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Longevity risk is an important risk factor for payments of pension annuities. Securitization of this risk can offer great opportunities for hedging. The purpose of this article is to design longevity bonds, payments of which depend on the survival index of a certain population. Considering characteristics of the people survival and interest rates market, Feller process with jumps is used to model the death intensity to get a survival function. And the interest rate is described with Cox-Ingersoll-Ross(CIR) model. Due to the CAPM pricing methods rarely suit to the hypotheses of complete market, the paper uses Wang transform to value the bond in an incomplete market framework Finally, empirical study is conducted with data of Chinese life table.

articleTitle: Evaluation for University Scientific Research Capability Based on FCE
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper conducts a research on university scientific research capability, in which an evaluation index system and evaluation model of university scientific research capability is constructed. The university scientific research capability consists of three aspects, i.e., scientific research input capability, transformation efficiency capability and scientific research output capability. The approach adopted in the paper is a quantitative technique based on use of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. In the end, a case is pulled into to illustrate the feasibility of the methodology from the empirical perspective.

articleTitle: Small and Medium Enterprises Two-stage strategic Decision Making Model Based on AHP and Fuzzy Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Small and medium enterprises (SMEs) are different from big enterprises. SMEs have their own special attributes and management keystone, and their enterprise strategy also has a fuzzy attribute. This article scientifically established an index system on core competitive competence of SMEs, in view of the special attributes of SMEs strategy and based on a deep understanding of the essence of SMEs' core competitive competence. Using Analytical Hierarchy Process and fuzzy control theory, it established a two-stage strategic decision making model for SMEs. This model can develop the core competitive competence for SMEs, make enterprise development strategy clearer and enhance the effectiveness and scientific attribute of the SMEs decision making strategy.

articleTitle: A Location Programming under Stochastic Travel Time through Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers a location-optimization problem where the classical facility location model is recast in a stochastic environment with several risk factors that make travel time from facility site to customer site probabilistic. We present a Stochastically Travel Time Location Problem (STTLP), a more general set covering problem than classical set covering location problem. Given a discrete network G(V,A), we formulate STTLP as an integer programming under the goal of minimizing the sum of set up cost of selected facilities and opportunity cost of the unserved customers, and then provide a mixed genetic algorithm strategies to solve the variety of size of the problem, the result was analyzed after computational experiment and compared with two greedy-based heuristic algorithms which have proven to be overall the best in solving set covering location problems. The computational experiment shows a good performance of our mixed genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of LDPC Codes over GF(q) Based on Filling with Circulant Matrices
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced a construction for LDPC codes over GF(q) based on filling with circulant matrices. After expanded the cycles in the check matrix by filling circulant matrices, the error-correcting performance of the codes can be improved with a low constructing complexity. The simulation results shows that the codes constructed can achieve better error-correcting performance.

articleTitle: Government Pricing in a Competitive Air Transportation Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a game-theoretic model for the government pricing in the air transportation industry of China. The interaction between the government and airlines and the competition among airlines have been considered. A two-stage non-cooperative Nash game is developed to model the government's and airlines' decisions. Equilibria of the game are computed by an iterative algorithm, and a numerical example from the China's airline market demonstrates the feasibility of applying the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Near Optimal Diversity-Multiplexing Switched MIMO Systems Based on Variable-Rate MQAM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel diversity-multiplexing decision switched algorithm is proposed for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system based on variable-rate MQAM. The proposed scheme is a closed-loop system, achieves adaptive bit and power allocation according to real-time channel state information (CSI), and the tradeoff between the diversity and multiplexing gains that can simultaneously achieved over a low-rate feedback channel with a little bits. The proposed algorithm takes minimum bit error rate as object, has lower cost can be easily implemented, improves the performance of the receivers, and achieves better bit error rate performance than the traditional suboptimal algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed decision algorithm achieves excellent performance.

articleTitle: Discuss on Construction of Local Portal Network Platform Based on the E-Government
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Internet is new tool which the information age must master and use, network publicity is a natural outreach channel in the background of information, as a new media, by virtue of its unique advantages, network is quickly occupied the position of traditional media by a phenomenal speed. Portal concept is birth in the context, but the rise of professional website, making local comprehensive portal operation models and survival face the serious challenges, facing such challenges, traditional local portal based on the e-government must begin to change for their own.

articleTitle: Order Degree Evaluation of Large-Scale Coal Enterprise Supply Chain Structure Based on Entropy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the theory of structure entropy, an analysis model was put forward from two aspects of time-effect and quality of information flow to evaluate the order degree of the supply chain structure. In the comparative research, this paper took a large-scale coal enterprise for example, and applied the model to evaluate the order degree of the supply chain structure between the single central coal preparation plant and the multiple coal preparation plants. The results illustrates that the time-effect and quality entropy of the supply chain structure in the single central coal preparation plant is lower than that in the multiple coal preparation plants. From the view of information, the supply chain structure of the single central coal preparation plant is better than that of the multiple coal preparation plants. This study offers qualitative and analytical methods of supply chain structure optimization for large-scale coal enterprise.

articleTitle: A Model of Building Networked SMS Platform Services Based on Mobile Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new model of SMS platform is proposed in this paper. Based on this model, with the techniques of the Bluetooth, socket, embedded operation, remote control, and database processing, a system is designed as an example. With this efficient model, the system can be mainly buildup by the hardware of mobile devices and networked computers. This SMS platform can be easily integrated with OAS (office automation system), and many other applications. The study of this paper also gives a further insight about the limitation of the system and discusses what should be improved in the future.

articleTitle: The Importance of Social Capital and Learning Orientation for Leveraging Knowledge Capabilities in Transition China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study combines social capital, learning and knowledge management theory to develop an integrated model in transition China. We analyze the model using a structural equation model approach, and 198 manufacturing and service firms in China are selected as the samples of this study. The results conclude that: (1) The social capital is positively relative learning orientation; (2) Social capital is a function of knowledge energy; (3) Social capital will significantly impact on knowledge integration capability; (4) Learning orientation is a function of its knowledge integration capability; (5) Knowledge energy will significantly impact on knowledge integration capability; (6) Knowledge integration capability will significantly impact on organizational performance. Finally, implications for researchers and practitioners are presented.

articleTitle: Function Analysis of Information Technology in Service Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service industry is facing increasingly more pressure with the rise of status of service in social economy. In order to make service industry unlike manufacturing industry, which is vulnerable in face of foreign competition, service industry has to rely on information technology innovations and high-tech management to continuously improve the quality of service products and productivity. Starting with the analysis of information technology's impact on service industry, service industry's investment in information technology and the reasons for depending on it, this paper proposes the concept that information technology in the management of service has the functions of innovativeness, value and competitiveness, and carries out deep and microscopic analysis in these three aspects. Hopefully, this concept can make a little contribution to the consecutive enhancement of service management level in service industry.

articleTitle: Overview of Business Games
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The modern business games originated from war games exhibit salient advantages for participants to learn and accumulate their experience in a simulated world The usage of business games in teaching, training and research has obtained unprecedented growth. However, the effectiveness of business games has a significant impact on the development of business games. Based on the related works, this paper introduces and discusses the elements, the design, the application, and the trends of the business games. We find that the effectiveness of business games mainly depends on non-human factors (the game system function) and human factors (the game leader and the game players). Therefore, the design of the game system function should be highlighted in the process of a successful game design. Meanwhile, the characteristics of the players such as team cohesiveness should be taken into account during the game play.

articleTitle: The Effect of Difference in Service Qualities on a Dual-Channel Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The rapid development of E-commerce has prompted many manufacturer to distribute their products through Internet directly to consumers as well as traditional retailers. In this dual- channel supply chain the manufacturer decides the wholesale and the direct channel's price and the retailer decides the retail price. We provide the equilibrium pricing strategies of the manufacturer as well as the retailer and study the effect of the difference in service qualities of the two channels on the equilibrium prices, demands, profits and total profit of the supply chain and find that when the difference increases these equilibrium levels of the retailer all increase and these of the manufacturer, except for the direct price which is unchanged, all decrease, furthermore the change of the total profit of the supply chain depends on the relative value of the difference in service qualities to difference in selling costs of the two channels.

articleTitle: Energy-Balanced Variable Transmission Range Adjustment in WSNs with Quality Coverage
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers a circular high-density WSNs, which is divided into several homogeneous sectors. For a sector, the route nodes transmit data to base station (BS) along the sides of the sector and the radio of nodes can cover all areas of target area. The paper presents an energy-balance solution to balance the energy consumption, by adjusting transmission range with quality coverage under a FSCTA (full sensing coverage of target area). Our scheme is called energy-balanced variable transmission range adjustment in WSNs with quality coverage (EBVTC). Simulation results show the efficiency of our approach.

articleTitle: A Research on the Evolvement Model of Intellectual Capital Value Increase Based on BASS Model
