publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dynamic ability is the core of intellectual capital. The realization of its value relies on process. The increase of enterprise intellectual capital value roots in two dimensions. One is the devotion of intellectual capital and the other is the endogenous intellectual capital comes from the increase of enterprise income. This study deduces that the effect of enterprise intellectual capital value on enterprise performance operates on different rules by BASS model. The conclusions are as follows: Intellectual capital value takes on increasing rules through organization learning, knowledge creation and social capital cultivation. However, enterprise intellectual capital endogenous contribution value, which, arises out of the effect of intellectual capital on enterprise performance, weakens gradually with exogenous knowledge and takes on slowly increasing rules.

articleTitle: Preventing Free-Ride Phenomenon in Team Knowledge Sharing Based on Secondary Principal-Agent Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the increasing keen market competition, knowledge capital is gradually becoming important resource. Knowledge sharing can make organizational knowledge freely flow in definite range and save the cost of knowledge acquisition to enhance knowledge productivity and benefit for knowledge application and innovation. The difficulty in knowledge sharing is how to avoid free-ride phenomenon. The purpose of this paper is to solve free-ride problem in team knowledge sharing through setting secondary principal method. In this paper, we firstly analyze the cause of free-ride phenomenon and the key to solving the problem in team knowledge sharing. The free-ride phenomenon depends on the characteristics of business organization, both inside and outside environment of organization and the characteristics of knowledge. The key solution to this problem lies in how to design incentive coefficient. By setting the secondary principals (supervisors), the manager can strengthen the supervision management of team, assess effectively personal contribution of every team member and give corresponding fair return to each member. Thus it can make that the optimal choice of each employee in team is sharing knowledge actively. On the basis of secondary principal-agent model, we discuss the team scale further. The paper supplies theoretical basis and practical guide to promote staff knowledge sharing performance for enterprise manager.

articleTitle: Research on Strategy of Web Service Composition Based on Software Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Web Service technologies are becoming increasingly popular for integrating systems and services. Web service composition as an important value-added function provides an application foundation for reusing Web services and automating composition. After brief analysis on the service composition concept and the eliciting process of functional requirements, a strategy of Web service composition based software life cycle is presented and the function-driven service composition process is described. This strategy may help effectively composing Web service based on software life cycle and provide a comprehensive support for SOA.

articleTitle: Inventory Control in Hybrid Manufacturing/Remanufacturing Systems with Fuzzy Demand and Return
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Two fuzzy models for inventory control in hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing systems were developed on the basis of the assumption that the demand rate and the return rate are characterized by triangular fuzzy numbers. The signed distance method is employed to derive the estimate of total cost per unit time. In addition, simple modifications of calculated lot sizes were proposed to make the number of lot sizes be a positive integer. Finally, the validity of the models is demonstrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: The Research of a Reputation Assistant Decision Model in Mobile Commerce Based on Optimal Combination Determining Weights Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Reputation evaluation in mobile commerce (MC) is a complicated system issue. After analyzing deficiencies of decision model in existing reputation management system, and combining with characteristic of MC, the paper presents a new reputation evaluation model (REM) used in MC. The model improves the reputation fraud prevention ability, for example, the cahoots fraud, the cumulating the reputation fraud which is used in large amount dealing after getting enough reputation from small-value transactions, and so on. AHP method is used to compute pre-transaction user's preference weight, objective weight is determined by using the entropy-weight coefficient method, and an optimal combination weights model is proposed based on maximal deviations. Finally, a MC reputation evaluation case is given to illustrate the availability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: UWB Signal Detection Based on Wavelet Packet Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Impulse radio ultra-wideband signal is difficult to detect due to its low power spectral density. Moreover, its extreme wide band makes it hard to digitalize. In this paper, a channelized blind detection based on wavelet packet decomposition is proposed and its detection performance is investigated. Based on the analysis of the detection performance, we develop a new detection threshold. Simulation results show that the detection performance based on wavelet packet decomposition maintains a good performance while it is easy to be implemented. Furthermore, within a fixed alarm probability, the new threshold obtains solid performance improvement.

articleTitle: Narrow-Band Interference Suppression Algorithms of DS/CDMA Based on CYC-QRD-LSL Interpolators
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The imperfect statistic and spectrum characteristics of direct spread spectrum signals will effect on the performance of narrow-band interference (NBI) suppression in DS/CDMA. To resolve this problem, an improved QR-decomposition-based least squares lattice (QRD-LSL) interpolator based on cycle-counteract (CYC) nonlinear processing is proposed. Applying the discrepancy of cycle correlation characteristics between DS signal and the ambience noise, the improved interpolators can efficiently remove the DS component from the input signal of NBI suppressor. Theoretic analysis and experimental results indicate that the improved interpolator can suppress NBI in DS/CDMA effectively. Both the convergence rate and the precision achieved by CYC-QRD-LSL interpolators outperform its QRD-LSL counterparts, especially when the spectrum of DS signal is non-white.

articleTitle: Cointegration Analysis on the Relationship of China's Industrial Structure Change and the Oil Demand
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to understand the law of China's oil demand growth, we use cointegration method and build up the vector error correction model to do quantitative analysis on the relationship among China's three industries' output values and its oil demand. Our results can be summarized as follows: i) the growth of China's oil demand is relatively inertial; ii) the impacts of three industries' output values on the oil demand are not the same in the short term; iii) China's oil demand has the capacity to adjust its growth reversely in the long term. Knowing these clearly will help us to take more specific measures to balance the oil supply and demand.

articleTitle: Research of Graph Interactive Based on Web
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article analyzes the current Web graphic processing technique, and then it puts forward a new model of object grouping database and technology of rapid graphic refreshment based on the incremental data. Later on it discusses collaborative graphic editing technology to organize GIS data more effectively and improve graphics interaction processing efficiency under network environment.

articleTitle: Adaptive Enterprise Management and Implementation Approaches
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is difficult for enterprises to survive and develop in dramatically changing environment. The Adaptive Management (AM for short) theory brings out a new way to deal with the dilemma. On the basis of the relevant achievements abroad and domestic, the author provides new notion of adaptive management and implementation approaches.

articleTitle: The Research on Synergetic Model of Supply Chain System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper tries to apply the core ideas of synergetics theory to construct supply chain system synergy model, which includes the order parameter model, self-organization model and synergetic dynamic model. These three models elaborate the solution of order parameters, the formation principles of self-organizing, as well as the influence of order parameters on the extent of self-organizing system (size and direction) in turn, and reveal the basic collaborative operation mechanism of supply chain system together. The purpose of the study on supply chain system synergetic model is to provide a new perspective and conceptual framework of thinking for the the supply chain management practices, and provide some basic information for the further theoretical research on the supply chain management applications.

articleTitle: A Learning Material Management Model for Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Traditional learning material management model based on courseware caused many problems includes common redundancy, the overlapped and desultory construction of the learning materials, and hardly adaptive to the diversity of the learning objectives and teaching methodologies. The paper proposes a material-framework-objective model which can improve the efficiency and quality of learning material management in the distance education by separating and recombining the basic materials, courseware, knowledge-points and learning goals. The model can also achieve the unification of the reuse, mobility and pertinence of the learning materials. The management system based on this model has been developed and taken into practice in Dongbei University of Financial and Economics.

articleTitle: A Practical Adaptive Transmission Scheme for Spatial Multiplexing MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose in this paper a practical adaptive modulation and channel encoding scheme for spatial multiplexing multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems. The proposed scheme aims not only to maximize the average spectral efficiency (ASE) for a given bit error rate (BER) constraint but also to lower the computational and hardware complexity. First, an adaptive transmission principle for spatial multiplexing MIMO systems is presented under the assumption that the channel state information (CSI) is available at the receiver; Furthermore, we propose not only an adaptive modulation scheme for different transmit antennas but also an adaptive scheme which combines channel encoding and modulation. Finally we demonstrate from the simulation that the proposed scheme is of practical significance since it provides a well-behaved tradeoff between the ASE and complexity in comparison with the singular value decomposition (SVD) based adaptive transmission scheme with the optimal ASE performance and high computational complexity.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment System of Industrial Clusters Based on Gray Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Measurement and evaluation of industrial clusters risk is an important aspect of the industrial cluster theory research. In the paper risk of industry clusters is analyzed. The gray theory was used and a multi-layer industry clusters risk evaluation model based on gray relationship degree was set up. Industry cluster risk comprehensive evaluation conclusion was reduced. The aim was to provide basis for industry cluster avoiding risk and improving its competition ability.

articleTitle: The Theory of Implementation When the Planner Is a Player: Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the usual implementation problem agents are asked to play a game form-a mechanism which is designed by the planner and the outcome is determined by the outcome function of the mechanism. In the problem the planner can force agents to play the game, but she has to obey her commitment to the agents, thus she cannot change but have to accept the outcome. In this paper we study the situation where the planner can select an outcome arbitrarily after agents have send a message profile, based on the posterior belief she has on the state profile of the agents. We assume (i) agents have private information and play simultaneously and (ii) given the messages announced by the agents, the planner updates her belief about the probability distribution of the state profiles of the agents and chooses the best outcome for her according to the strategy profile of the agents. This transforms the implementation problem into a signaling game with agents as senders and the planner as receiver. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for interactive implementation by using the refinement concept of FGP- equilibrium as the solution of the problem.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of MMSE-BLE Joint-Detection Based on Block-FFT and Cholesky Factorization for TD-SCDMA
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To increase the capacity and performance of TD- SCDMA system, the receiver will contain a joint detector. Joint detection is equivalent to solving a least squares problem with a block-Toeplitz system matrix. Therefore, algorithms and implementations must be developed that lower this complexity as far as possible without degrading the performance. In current TD-SCDMA system, MMSE-BLE detectors are the main choice because of its small computational complexity. Among the various algorithm to solve the MMSE-BLE, Block-FFT and Cholesky Factorization algorithms are widely used in practice. In this paper, we compare the two methods on the basis of simulation performance and computational complexity. The simulations show that Block-Fourier algorithm need low computational amount while yielding a better bit error ratio performance. So we recommend the Block-FFT joint detector as the best choice for TD-SCDMA system.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Power Bidding Market Based on Extreme Value Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes three econometric AR-EGARCH models, whose error is governed by normal, students' t and GED distribution respectively, to nine o'clock spot price serial of Nordpool power market from 2001 to 2005 year. In addition, POT method of extreme value theory is adopted to model the tails of the return distribution, and the parameters of GPD distribution are estimated, then VaR and CVaR are measured under 1% and 5% confidence level. In the end, factual return serial consisted of 175 datas in 2006 year is adopted to test the proposed models, the statistical test shows that CVaR, not VaR, is a good tool to measure risk, and the hypothesis of AR-EGARCH models' error are students' t and GED distribution provides appropriate estimate, which one is better estimate factual return lies on confidence level.

articleTitle: A Study on Upgrading Competitive Advantages for the Modern Service Enterprises Based on the Customer Value
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is the general descipline that, instead of industry economy, service economy has become the main power which promotes the rapid development of the whole society and economy. Especially, modern service industry, whose development is mainly based on the high technology including electronic information technology and the idea of modern management, operation and organization, is of great significance for advancing the alteration of the way of economic growth, finding new economic growth points, realizing full employment and helping building a harmonious society. The key factor which makes modern service enterprise develop further is whether it can meet customer's demands, create value for customer and gain competitive advantages by providing the customers with latest products or service value which can satisfy the customers.This article discusses the relationship between the customer value and the competitive advantages of modern service industry, and how to build and increase the competitive advantages of the modern service enterprises based on the customer value.

articleTitle: Recursive Partitioning Based Spatial Join Strategy Between OGC's Web Feature Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: OGC-compliant(OGC, Open Geospatial Consortium Inc.) Web Feature Services (WFSs) have gradually become an important kind of spatial data sources over the Internet. In such a distributed environment, a user may issue a query that relates two spatial datasets that are provided by two services at different sites. Because of the sheer volume and complexity of spatial data, spatial joins between two spatial datasets by different services are expensive in terms of transmission cost. This paper examines the problems of spatial joins between WFSs, based on the spatial semijoin strategy and partition based spatial join strategy, this paper presents a spatial join processing strategy between two OGC-compliant WFSs. The experimental result illustrates that when in the query window there are enough spatial features from the two related datasets, the proposed strategy can greatly reduce the expensive of transmission cost and thus time cost.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of 3G Terminal Authentication Service
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through analyzing the 3G security services structure, we found that 3GPP did not offer effective authentication services to the terminal client in application domain. On the base of analyzing the Kerberos authentication method and the 3G security mechanism, we first put forward a three-tier security authentication service model for 3G terminal application. The model assembled and encapsulated the 3G security algorithm, and offered a reliable. Proactive and convenient authentication services to the 3G terminal application. This research provided strong support with 3G terminal application.

articleTitle: Conditional Mean and Conditional Variance for Ali-Mikhail-Hap Copula
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A copula is a function that links univariate marginals to their full multivariate distribution. This paper derives the conditional means and conditional variances for the well-known Ali-Mikhail-Hap (AMH) bivariate parametric copula whose marginal is standard uniform distribution U(0, 1) . In addition, this paper compares and expresses its corresponding figures of the conditional means and conditional variances with different parameter values.

articleTitle: The Supply Chain Uncertain Programming of the Manufacturing/Remanufacturing Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Remanufacturing the return products can improve the customer service level and reduce the supply chain cost. The integrated supply chain uncertain programming model of the manufacturing/remanufacturing hybrid system was proposed. The distribution centers distribute the manufactured products and remanufactured products to customers, and also collect the return products. The return products can be remanufactured up to the quality standard of new products satisfying customer demand. The optimal manufacturing production strategy and the optimal distribution inventory strategy considering the reverse logistics were studied under the grey fuzzy uncertainty and grey uncertainty. The proposed grey fuzzy simulation methodology can generate input-output data for the uncertain functions. The designed neural network trained from the input-output data can expedite the simulation process of the uncertain functions. The hybrid intelligent optimization algorithm integrating the grey fuzzy simulation, neural network and genetic algorithm can optimize the uncertain programming model. One numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation of Construction Project Based on Utility Function and Maximized Deviation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Risks of construction project are aroused by a series of factors with hierarchical structure, which includes main risk factors and sub-risk factors. Using the multidimensional features of risk factors to form utility function, and according to the evaluations of values of sub-risks given by experts to calculate the weights and then get the evaluations of main risks. Then we could use the results to assess the risk of whole construction project. The utility function and maximized deviation are employed during the whole process of calculation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Common-Plot Action During Putting on Records of Completed Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The institution of registration about putting on records of complete projects is carried out in China. Decisions on registration about putting on records of complete projects is an important measure for government supervision organizations construction quality to carry out their functions of enforcing the law. Because the organizations and owners seek usually outstanding achievements and potential benefits in supervision industry, which is a monopoly market, there are common-plot actions of registration about acceptance of completed projects. Latent reasons for choice of action tactics for registration about acceptance of completed projects between the organizations and owners are revealed by game analysis. Solving the question of common-plot action needs to introduce the market competition mechanism, and to enhance transparency of supervision jobs.

articleTitle: The Effect of Internet on Service Industry Growth and its Spillovers: Spatial Econometrics Evidence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The aim of this work is to investigate how Internet affects regional service industry and examine the influence of spatial effects of the interregion. We apply methods of spatial econometrics to examine the effect of Internet on service industry growth and its spatial spillovers between provinces. Using cross-province data for 2006, the empirical results indicate that the Internet improves the service industry growth, and spatial spillovers of the province to its neighbors are obvious which means a particular province has spatial spillover effect through the exogenous lag variable on its neighbor territory.

articleTitle: Bayesian Analysis of Supply Chain Diagnosis Using Dynamic Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The supply chain is the central organizing unit in today's global industries and has gained significance as one of the 21st century manufacturing paradigms for improving organizational competitiveness. In this paper, we propose a dynamic Bayesian network to represent the cause-and-effect relationships in an industrial supply chain. Based on the Quick Scan, a systematic data analysis and synthesis methodology, a dynamic Bayesian network is employed as a more descriptive mechanism to model the causal relationships in the supply chain. Dynamic Bayesian networks can be utilized as a knowledge base of the reasoning systems where the diagnostic tasks are conducted. We finally solve this reasoning problem with stochastic simulation.

articleTitle: To Explain Why AEO's Always Suffer from Credit Rationing in China by a Comprehensive Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this article, the interest rate and non-interest cost are brought into an analytical framework to model a synthetic credit rationing model, under market conditions of a formal finance and an informal finance sector. The research context concerns credit rationing towards agricultural economic organizations in China. Our research indicates that, in order to reduce the loan risk, the formal finance market uses a mechanism which is 'the interest rate - non-interest cost' to implement credit rationing. As a result, more and more agricultural economic organizations have been excluded because of the high credit risk. Existence of the informal financial sector may alleviate the credit rationing, but due to its non-official market status, it will inevitably cause higher financing costs of the agricultural economic organizations. This consequence may help to explain the reason why agricultural economic organizations are in economic difficulties in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Management of Education & Training Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Today, with the development of education & training industry in China, great risk of the project has arisen by the reason of stronger competition. This paper has a qualitative and quantitative study on the risk of education & training project, based on the basic knowledge of project risk management and the analysis of education & training industry, as well as according to the four-stage management of risk identification, risk assessment, risk response and risk control. In addition, some managerial measures are proposed by the use of statistics for the project managers to forecast and avoid the risk.

articleTitle: Mobile Geographical Information Services for 3G Phone User
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With development and deployment of information and telecommunication technologies integrated with lightweight mobile devices, pinpointing location on the move has become a common exercise. The integration of geospatial information and mobile Internet is simultaneity driven by market demands and technologies. Mobile geographical information service extends unlimited information on the Internet and the powerful service functions of GIS to mobile devices users. Supported by 3G data technologies/services, mobile GI services create a new channel of business practice, and thousands of potential applications and services. A complete end-to-end mobile GI services solution is described for organizations interested in offering mobile GI services to consumer or business subscribers.

articleTitle: The Spatial Diversity Algorithm of Sampling Clock Synchronization in MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sampling offset estimation and sampling clock recovery are crucial in MIMO-OFDM systems. In this paper, a novel spatial diversity algorithm of sampling offset estimation in MIMO-OFDM systems is proposed. In addition, a lower complexity sampling clock recovery design is presented. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is accurate and robust against fast time-varying frequency-selective fading channel.

articleTitle: Property of the Free Float and its Application in Seeking the Secondary Critical Path in CPM Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The secondary critical path plays a very important role in the project scheduling and time/cost trade-off problems. The property of the free float is studied in this paper, and the preceding main chain theorem and free float theorem are proposed. Based on these theorems, the paper presents a simple method to seek the secondary critical path in a CPM network using the free float. That is, seeking the non-critical activity with the minimum value of free float in all activities immediately preceding the critical nodes, and then connecting its preceding main chain and the critical path segment between the finish node of that non-critical activity and the termination node. Finally, this method is proved to be correct, and an example is given to describe the method.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Forecasting Analyzer in Grammar Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: LL(1) grammar is obvious and can be determined easily. LL(1) grammar is used widely, but LL(1) grammar can only express little language information. LL(1) grammar cannot meet practicality request in most circumstances. The LL(k) grammar can express much more language information than LL(1) grammar in compiling principles, but LL(k) analyzing program is much more complex. It is not be used widely in practical syntax analysis programs. The improved LL(2) analyzing method greatly simplifies primary syntax analyzing program. The method only adopts to see a sign ahead with a part of regulation formulas, which enhances the practicability of LL(2) analyzing program. Therefore, improved forecasting analyzer has easier and higher efficiency. If a grammar is LL(2) grammar rather than LL(1) grammar, above improved forecasting analysis method may be adopted to get better results.

articleTitle: Data Mining-Based Marketing Support System for Telecom Operators
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the application of operations support system (OSS), the telecom operators increasingly have the capability to accumulate huge amounts of customer data in large databases. However, much of the useful marketing insights into customer characteristics and their purchase patterns are largely hidden and untapped. Current emphasis on customer relationship management makes the marketing function an ideal application area to greatly benefit from the use of data mining tools for decision support. In this paper a systematic framework of marketing support system (MSS) that uses data mining techniques is proposed to support marketing decisions and manage the marketing process. This methodology can be the basis for enhancing customer relationship management.

articleTitle: A Synchronization Scheme Based on Entire Time Hopping Code in Multiuser TH-UWB System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A synchronization scheme based on entire time hopping (TH) codes in multiuser TH-UWB system is proposed in this paper. A novel timing with dirty template (TDT) coarse synchronization scheme is presented, which is based on the synchronizing of the entire time hopping pulses on the premise that the users' TH codes are orthogonal each other. And all the possible synchronization referential positions can be found for multiuser after only one single search. Then the coarse synchronization positions are used as the starting points to acquire fine synchronization for each user by few sliding correlations with its template (user synchronization sequences). The analysis of the performance and the simulation results show that the scheme is feasible. And it provides a new method for the synchronization of the impulse UWB system.

articleTitle: A Highly Accurate Iteratively Interpolated Frequency Estimator
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the "half stock fence"-interpolated FFT coefficients of a single-tone sequence, this paper presents a novel frequency estimation iteration algorithm starting with the Rife-Jane's estimator, which develops a symmetry frequency offset estimator and employs adaptive adjustment technique of the symmetric center. Computer Monte-Carlo simulations show that the algorithm is effective and the proposed estimator outperforms the traditional Rife-Jane's estimator in both accuracy and the CRLB-approximate RMSE of estimation over the whole frequency range. It is also shown that the Rife-Jane's initialized iteration has as lower SNR threshold as to about -12 dB.

articleTitle: A HTML to WML Translating Model Based on Information Extraction for Mobile Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the fast development of mobile commerce, the information conversion from Hyper Text Markup Language (HTML) to Wireless Markup Language (WML) is becoming an important issue for end-user information acquisition. But some existing conversions can't satisfy the demand of mobile electronic trading. Based on the comparative analysis of HTML and WML, through the analysis of conversion process and the structure of Web pages about commodities, a translating model from HTML to WML which is based on information extraction for mobile commerce was proposed in this paper. Due to the technology of information extraction adopted, it improved the conversion effectively in speed and accurate rate, whilst presented the useful information conveniently to the users.

articleTitle: Information Technology Implementation Module Study on System of Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Effective supply chain management is built on the basis of the high quality of information transmission and sharing, This will rely heavily on information technology to provide reliable support. In this paper, against the characteristics of the supply chain information flow, the text puts forward an module that it is a three - dimensional and it can support decisions, then we build a SCMS module by utilizing IT (such as Internet, date ware, data mine, electronic commerce, etc).

articleTitle: The RBF Method of Pricing Two-Factor Convertible Bonds with Default Risk
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The focus of this work is on numerical solutions to two-factor partial differential equation for pricing convertible bonds with default risk. The model includes three impact factors: stock value, stochastic interest rate and default risk We interpolated convertible bonds using radial basis functions, and gained numerical solution of convertible bonds with good precision.

articleTitle: A Pulse Coupled Neural Network Based Approach for Frequency Assignment Problem in Non-Homogeneous Cellular Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Frequency Assignment Problem is a NP problem. Separation of frequencies assigned to cells needs to avoid causing interference and fit minimum span constraints, because the cost of unnecessary assigned frequencies will be high. The aim of our work is to find optimal solution in frequency assignment with minimum cost function and number of channels in non- homogeneous cellular networks. Compared with the work presented in the literature, this paper presents a novel algorithm based on pulse-coupled neural network (PCNN) model to solve the frequency assignment problem in non-homogeneous cellular radio networks, by highlighting the frequency causing interference to fit the interference and minimum span constraints.

articleTitle: An Implementation and Study of OLSR Protocol in Linux OS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on an implementation named OLSRS (OLSR scheduling implementation). OLSRS provides a concrete scheme and several key techniques on the implementation of OLSR protocol. This paper first considers the general framework of OLSRS according to the routing architecture of Linux OS. Besides overall framework, this paper discusses the difficulties encountered in OLSRS and provides proper solutions. Finally, two testbeds are built and corresponding results are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on the Model of Transportation Mode Selection Based on Green Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Resources shortage and environment deterioration force logistics to weigh benefits between economics and ecosystem, as a result of which green logistics has become its necessary choice. In such a context, this paper firstly analyzes the relations between environment and logistics. And then combining environment tolerance capacity and demands of logistics along with the social development, this paper establishes two transportation mode selection models and their assessment index system based on "green logistics" adopting Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) together with Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP). In the end, we testify the model with an example and analyze the results.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction with Sub-Channel Sorting for OFDM-CDM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider an Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing-Code Division Multiplexing (OFDM-CDM) system. The noise reduction method based on Least Squares (LS) is introduced into the OFDM-CDM receiver to improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), while the system does not work under full load. In this paper, Walsh code is considered to be used in CDM module. The relationship between the spreading codes and the variance of the noise after noise reduction is investigated. Based on this relationship, a simple noise reduction after channel frequency response (CFR) sorting is proposed to improve the Bit Error Rate (BER) performance of system further. Simulation results suggest that good performance can be achieved with proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment Strategy for Defined Contribution Pension Plans under the CEV Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the optimal investment strategy for an investor who seeks to maximize the expected utility of the terminal wealth in a defined contribution pension plan. The portfolio consists of a risk-free asset, and a stock whose price dynamics are governed by a constant elasticity of variance (CEV) model. We derive the explicit solutions for the CARA utility function via power transform technique and variable change method. The solution consists of a moving Merton strategy and a correction factor. The moving Merton strategy represents the classical Merton strategy but with an updated volatility at current time and the correction factor denotes the supplement part resulting from the change of the volatility. Furthermore, in order to better understand the influences of the correction factor on the optimal investment strategy, we examine the property of the correction factor. Finally, we present a numerical simulation to illustrate the dynamic behaviors of the correction factor and the optimal strategy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fair Payment Protocol in Mobile DRM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The presented mobile DRM are short of an efficient payment protocol to guarantee that participants can engage in the exchange without the risk of suffering a disadvantage. Even the latest DRM standard of the open mobile alliance (OMA) did not give a detailed transaction scheme in mobile DRM. In general, the fair payment approaches in mobile DRM rely on the service of an external trusted third party (TTP) or add the fees to the phone bill which renders the TTP a bottleneck or just adapts to micro-billing. Therefore, referring to the architecture of OMA DRM, in this article we present a practical fair payment protocol in mobile DRM without TTP by using the concurrent signature scheme. In this protocol, the keystone embedded in the input of protocol by the customer, and if not revealed, the protocol has the deniability; otherwise the transcript of protocol is binding for the identification. So, it reduces the cost of all parties' computation and decreases the communication passes. This protocol is analyzed and compared with other payment protocols used in mobile DRM, the results show that the proposed payment protocol satisfies the requirements of the fair e-transaction and its communication cost and customer's computation are reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of M-ary Multi-Orthogonal Keying
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Modulation-hopping (MH) system is a new kind of communication system. In order to meet the needs of MH system in various kinds of modulations and a common frame, m-ary multi-orthogonal keying (MMOK) is presented in this paper. The performance of MMOK on multipath fading channels is evaluated in term of average SNR for both the symbol error probability and bit error probability. We adopt Channel Matched Filter (CMF) to remove the multipath channel effects. Numerical results show MMOK has special performance on multipath fading channels. It concludes that MMOK can be applied in higher data transmission to perfect performance and improve bandwidth efficiency, which is beneficial to many systems.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Relevance between US FDI in China and Sino-US Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since 2005, the US have been the third largest foreign direct investment (FDI) entity in China, next to Hong Kong and Japan. Based on the related literatures at home and abroad, this paper analyzes empirically on the interrelation between the US FDI in China and Sino-US economic growth. The studying result shows that economic growth in China is an essential cause for the US FDI in China, both in the short and long run. While the US FDI in China is enhancing the US economic growth, there is little evidence showing that it has promoted China's economic growth. Finally it is concluded that the introduction of foreign capital should be organically combined with the promotion of economic growth. Relative suggestions are given on the better use of the US FDI to boost the economic growth in China.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm for Optimization of Muti-project in Limited Resources
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, the optimization of muti-project in condition of limited resources is very hard to obtain the satisfying computation result by using traditional methods. However, genetic algorithm is better than the traditional optimization methods in getting the optimization solution. Therefore, it is necessary to combine genetic algorithm with this problem. Genetic algorithm and adaptive genetic adaptive are applied for the optimization problem, and the feasibility and efficiency of the methods are verified by a case. Therefore, the method has its application value for the resource optimization of muti-project management.

articleTitle: Financing and Operating of Singapore's Urban Rail Transit Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Urban rail transit system development is important in public transport of compact cities such as Singapore in particular with rising population and limited land space. Due to its high frequency, capacity, reliability, speed and comfort, a comprehensive rail transit network is a better solution than bus network. However, a comprehensive urban rail transit system development often faces the bottlenecks in both financing and operating. Due to the high investment and relatively long operating period, with the consideration of public affordable fare price, private sector financing alone is mostly not favored by financing institute. These will affect the sustainable development of public transport system. One of the key to successful sustainable development of the Singapore's urban rail transit, represented by its MRT (Mass Rapid Transit), is the financing and operating framework This paper will highlight the financing framework, operating and fare policies, and roles played by both public and private sectors in the urban rail transit development and operations.

articleTitle: The Mobile Node ID Kademlia for Multimedia Stream Transmission in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Coming with the development of the wireless equipment, more applications can be transplanted onto a mobile platform. So the transmission of multimedia in the wireless network enters our sight. In order to improve the efficiency of system, we propose the p2p structure. For peers in the wireless network are less stable than normal, we use the mobile node ID instead of the static node ID in Kademlia and design a filter to choose the believable node for the first time. We also design the virtual channel caching mechanism and the motion estimated caching mechanism to guarantee the fluency of the multimedia transmission.

articleTitle: Modeling Nonnormality of Chinese Stock Returns: Jump, GED Distribution or T Distribution?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Modeling the dynamics of stock returns is very important for derivatives pricing and risk management. Nonnormality is one of the most important stylized facts of stock returns. This paper applies the nonparametric specification test and compares alternative ways of modeling nonnormality in Chinese stock market, including jump models, the models with GED distribution and the models with t distribution. Empirical results show that the models with t distribution could effectively model the stock return dynamics in China.

articleTitle: A Semantic Approach for Knowledge Sharing in Collaborative Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: C-Commerce (Collaborative-Commerce) is a new generation business model. In C-Commerce, enterprises collaborate closely with each other on the basis of knowledge sharing. Although previous research have designed knowledge management systems for C-Commerce, existing systems are mostly centralized for intra-organizational knowledge management, which might not manage and share knowledge in a dynamic and inter-organizational C-Commerce environment effectively. In this study, we develop an ontology-based knowledge sharing framework based on semantic web technologies, describe major knowledge sharing processes in the framework, and design a knowledge exchange format as knowledge sharing foundation for the framework. We have implemented these methods and developed a prototype, and experiments are conducted to test the performance of our system. Our work will facilitate knowledge sharing among enterprises in C-Commerce and can be widely applied in e-marketplace, supply chain integration, virtual organizations and other business collaboration across organizations.

articleTitle: Chain Stores Location Problem with Bounded Linear Consumption Expansion Function on Paths
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many customers purchased service as part of routine pre-planned trips nowadays, instead of making a special-purpose trip to obtain service. With the assumption that the customer flows at most be serviced for one time, the decision objective for service providers is to find the optimal locations for such service facilities to maximize the number of customers "captured". This sort of problem is called flow interception problem (FIP). This paper proposes utility of each facility and concerns the FIP with bounded linear consumption on the path which is proportional to total utility of same path. Two FIP models with linear bounded expenditures under competitive and monopolistic cases are formulated. Two heuristic algorithms for two cases are developed and computational experiment is described.

articleTitle: A New Equalization Scheme for OFDM Systems with Insufficient Guard Interval
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conventional one-tap equalizer for OFDM based communication systems fails to eliminate the ISI and ICI introduced by multipath propagation when the Channel Impulse Response (CIR) length exceeds the duration of Guard Interval (GI). We propose, in this paper, a new equalization scheme for the suppression of insufficient GI generated interference using redundancy provided by the guard bands. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can effectively recovers the contaminated OFDM signal.

articleTitle: The Behavior of Stock Prices and Valuation by Continuum Percolation Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We investigate the statistical properties of fluctuations of the stock price process in a stock market by continuum percolation theory. The methods of continuum percolation are applied to construct a financial model that describes the behavior of a stock price, specifically the continuum percolation is used to describe the "herd effect" of investors in a financial market. In this paper, we show that the characteristic function of this stock price process converges to the corresponding characteristic function of Black-Scholes model. Further, we discuss the valuation and hedging of European contingent.

articleTitle: Group Decision Making Method Based on Linguistic Information for Selection of Booksellers in University Library
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, using uncertain linguistic Information to deal quantitatively with the selection and ranking of booksellers about public bidding for purchases of books in university library. Firstly, linguistic evaluations are presented by experts according to their linguistic preference scale, and are normalized. Then the linguistic evaluations are aggregated utilizing ULA operator, and synthetical linguistic evaluation of group decision making is aggregated using ULOW operator. The order of booksellers is obtained according to complementary matrix theory. Finally, an example is given to show the practicability and validity of this method.

articleTitle: The Budget Management Framework Based on Corporate Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since the 1920s, budget management has always played a central role irreplaceable in corporate management. After the mid-1980s, the environmental changes that many companies experienced have already shaken the foundation and prerequisites for the operation of traditional budget management, the deficiency of traditional budget management gradually emerges, especially the incoordination between budget and strategy which brings a direct consequence: corporate strategy can not be truly implemented. One study shows that 60% of organizations do not link budgets to strategy. More than half of the surveyed enterprises show: its budget and performance evaluation process is operated completely independent from its strategic planning process. This paper proposes a corporate strategy based budget management framework which is structured on the Balanced Scorecard as well as some advanced ideas from operating budget. A strategy based budget management model can provide an effective system of strategic management and control methods, which will help the company use strategic tools to obtain future competitive advantage. With no doubt it is of great significance for the truly implementation of corporate strategy and the budget.

articleTitle: Analysis of Stable Availability of Organizations in Emergency Management of Ship Oil Spill
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the early study of ship oil spill, more attention are paid to pure technology than to administration. In this paper, organization structure of administration is discussed through empirical and normal analysis. This paper gives a simple organization composed of one decision department and several executing agencies. Through analysis and simulation, we get that the stable availability of an organization with executing agencies in parallel is higher than that in series. And at last we give some opinions to improve the reliability of the organization in emergency management of ship oil spill.

articleTitle: Technical-Economic Analysis of Wind Energy Projects in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The renewable energy consumption has been increased rapidly with high economic growth in China. As one of the most promising renewable energy resource, wind energy has become a major part of the plans for sustainable development. The technical-economic analysis of the project reveals that the revenue from certified emission reductions (CERs) of clean development mechanism (CDM) project can increase the profitability of the project but it doesn't play a decisive role. The sensitivity analysis of single parameter shows that investment, electricity price and production are the key parameters influencing the effectiveness of projects. The status of wind energy projects in China is elaborated and the four approaches of developing wind energy projects are proposed.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Nodes Placement Problem
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper discusses placement of sensor nodes in wireless sensor networks. Since the large number sampling points in sensing range of the sensor, the traditional methods, such as greedy algorithm or linear programming model, do not work well. Thus, we create a new method, the grid-based algorithm. First we determine the number of the selected sensor nodes based on the probability theory. Then an effective selection algorithm is established. Numerical examples is given to show the efficacy of the propose algorithm.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Viterbi-Like Detection Algorithm Based on Sorted QR decomposition in V-BLAST System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Vertical Bell labs layered space-time (V-BLAST) is designed to exploit the capacity advantage of multiple antenna system in rich-scattering environments. In this paper, we propose a low complexity detection algorithm with respect to the maximum-likelihood (ML) criterion. This algorithm deploys sorted QR decomposition to construct a ML trellis. A Viterbi-like algorithm is used to find a near optimal solution in the trellis. The complexity of this algorithm is lower than that of full ML. When small size constellation is used, the proposed algorithm is less complex than MMSE-OSIC. The performance of the proposed algorithm is close to that of full ML.

articleTitle: Method of Risk Management in Realty Item Based on Decomposition of Process and Variable Weight Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Real estate development is a high-input, high-return and high-risk business activity. As the characteristics of realty itself, make the risk management even more crucial. In order to make the risk management of realty investment effective, scientifically and rationally evaluate real estate projects is particularly important. Therefore, before invest commencing, the investors need to accurately understand and predict the potential risks by making scientific analysis. This paper puts forward the method combined with the real estate project development process and variable weight fuzzy synthetic evaluation to improve the accuracy of risk evaluation. And then proves its validation and practicality.

articleTitle: Analysis on Optimal Model of Short-Life-Cycle Products Supply Chain Based on Two Ordering Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the problem of quantity decision and production planning in a supply chain, which is composed of one manufacturer and one retailer to meet the random demand of short-life-cycle products. To study the coordination of two ordering strategy, an optimization function aiming at maximizing total expected profits is established. Then the model is analyzed by the use of the numerical method, and the results of one ordering opportunity with those of two ordering opportunities under different parameters are compared. Then we show that two ordering opportunities strategy can not only improve the expected profits of the supply chain, but also effectively coordinate the supply chain system.

articleTitle: Framework of Realm Experts Wisdom Meta-Synthesis in Complex System Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an integration framework of wisdoms of experts with different field knowledge and experiences for complex system analysis . We call these experts as realm experts in the paper. Hall for workshop of meta-synthetic engineering (HWME), proposed by QIAN Xue-sen, is an accepted important method for complex system analysis. After briefly reviewing the research situation of complex system analysis, the paper points out the extraordinary important function of realm experts in the HWME. Then the paper discusses the effective interaction among the realm experts in the analysis of complex system and presents four interactive stages in the workshop of experts and the interactive model of wisdom integration of realm experts as well. The integration framework of wisdoms of experts, which is described in flow diagrams, is put forward on the basis of this discussion and presentation. The practice shows it is an effective approach for the complex system analysis.

articleTitle: Methodology of Stamped Metal Parts Retrieval Using Feature Combination and User's Feedback
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Case based reasoning(CBR) is becoming widely used in computer aided process planning system. It requires a mechanism for retrieval of similar parts from a case database which in turn requires a method for case similarity measurement. This paper presents a new approach of stamped metal parts retrieval, which is based on the multi-feature combination and user's feedback. The stamped metal parts information consists of 3D part model and material which includes material thickness, strength and hardness. The parametric feature relation graph(P-FRG) extract from 3D stamping part model to captures the geometric, topological, and domain specific used to measure the similarity between stamped metal parts. Integrated similarity assessment is achieved by the amalgamation of feature count, feature topology, feature parameter and material. Weight values of Feature and feature component is adjusted based on a statistical analysis of the similarity feature values by user's feedback.

articleTitle: Duration Based on Term Structure Using Exponential Splines
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The duration of a bond measures its price sensitivity to a change in its yield. It can thus be used to evaluate the risk exposure of the portfolio with respect to a change of the term structure, and it is useful for how to regulate the risk. The paper addresses the simple duration measure, which supposes that the term-structure curve is "flat" and shifts in the term-structure curve are parallel. Then, the paper introduces term structure of interest rate model using exponential splines and applies it to the calculation of the duration. Then the paper presents empirical applications in China, and the empirical results indicate that the duration based on term structure using exponential splines is more rigorous than the simple duration, and the simple duration underestimate the interest rate risk In the end, the paper provides a summary of the paper, and contains some concluding remarks.

articleTitle: The Study of Intrinsic Mechanism that State-Owned Commercial Bank Credit Rationing Influences the Capital Allocation Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The capital allocation inefficiency has become an important factor that restricted China's sustained economic growth, long-term macroeconomic stability and low financial system risk. Along with the further reform and opening policy, the commercial bank credit rationing phenomenon is more obvious, it is easily viewed that, on the one hand there is over investment even malignancy capital increase in the state- owned major industry, on the other hand it is extremely difficult for the small and medium enterprise to get loan. This paper firstly establishes a two-stage state-owned commercial bank credit rationing model which is based on the bank manager and loan officer's utility maximization, then analyzes the intrinsic mechanism of capital allocation inefficiency, finally on the base of the theoretical analysis, this paper proposes the related conclusion and suggestions of improving the capital allocation efficiency in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Business Risks for the Software Outsourcing between Hongkong and Guangdong
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper identifies the risks of a company which is working at software outsourcing projects between Hongkong and Guangdong, discovers the causal relationships among the risk factors, and constructs corresponding risk structure model with Interpretive Structural Modeling. Five original risk factors are discovered, including contracts risk, requirements definition and change, lack of communication, political and legal environment differences, and exchange rate fluctuations. Finally, three advices are proposed for software outsourcing business operation: project planning, project requirements, and communication.

articleTitle: Weak Signal Detection in Multiplicative and Additive Noise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A general model for complex electromagnetic environments incorporating multiplicative and additive noise is proposed. The locally optimum detector is derived for weak signal detection and shows that the influence of multiplicative noise in its mean multiplied to the statistics. The finite sample performance is evaluated by Monte-Carlo simulation with the comparison of other detectors and the result indicates that the LO method provides best performance for weak signal detection in non-Gaussian noise.

articleTitle: The Impact of the National Culture on Team Learning
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper reviews the literature of team learning about the concept, behavior characteristics and the influence factors of team learning. It also introduces the theory of national culture. The purpose of this article is that try to analyze the impact of the national culture to team learning and raise the propositions at the same time. At last, contributions and future research are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Representation of 3PL for Supply Chain and the Fuzzy Integrated Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Logistics has been concerned in every industry today. And it also plays a key role in the success of E-business enterprises. More and more 3PL enterprises are showing up as the information technology develops. However, how to represent the evaluation problem and how to evaluate and choose from the many 3PL enterprises still remain difficult problem under the supply-chain management circumstances. This paper adopt tree- view knowledge representation firstly, and then constructed an evaluation-index system, finally adopted a fuzzy integrated evaluation method, which combines both qualitative and quantitative analyses and is hence valuable theoretically and applicably.

articleTitle: A Novel PMI Feedback Method for EUTRA TDD Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method to feedback PMI (precoding matrix index) in EUTRA TDD (Time Division Duplex) systems. The proposed method groups the precoding matrices which have opposite phase rotations into one precoding matrix group and feedback the PGI (precoding group index) to the transmitter. The transmitter will utilize the reciprocal channel state information to recover the selected precoding matrix from the received PGI. Numerical results show that even under very unideal channel reciprocity assumptions, the proposed scheme can save feedback bits without performance loss.

articleTitle: Partners' Resource-commitment Decisions in R&D Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is studied that the resource-commitment decisions and the profits of the outsourcer and the supplier under three profit sharing arrangements and different market environments, and the impact of market return and profit sharing arrangement on their resource commitments. The mixed sharing arrangement is improved, and the optimum profit sharing arrangements are found out, each of which suits a certain market environment best. It is discovered that the outsourcer can't raise the possibility of R&D outsourcing by giving the supplier partial payment in cash in advance, it will be lowered on the contrary, and therefore, the outsourcer should substitute specific assets for cash; the outsourcer should adopt improved mixed sharing arrangement in R&D outsourcing when market return is small, and fixed sharing arrangement when market return is large, especially when the proportion of R&D investment to the total investment is large.

articleTitle: Designing and Pricing Stock Income Associated Float Interest Rate Insurance Bonds
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bonds and stocks are all investment tools. Both have different income. Stocks have uncertainty yield. Yet, bonds have fixed income relatively. In respect that stocks income has the same stochastic change characteristic with the benchmark interest rate of float bonds. It is feasible that the benchmark of float interest rate bonds consider some stocks yield function. The paper designs a kind of float interest rate bonds correlation with stocks income. Use jump stochastic volatility interest rate term structure model price the bond. It can devote into insurance products design.

articleTitle: A Utility-Based Centralized Self-Configuration Algorithm in Heterogeneous Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A utility based centralized self-configuration algorithm (UCSCA) is proposed to improve global quality of service (QoS) performance in heterogeneous radio network. The radio access technology (RAT) limitation, together with the base stations restrictions, makes it difficult to achieve a high-performance network reconfiguration solution (base stations load-allocation and terminal access schemes) in heterogeneous radio network The UCSCA's self-configuration solution, which takes account of cognized network environments factors such as terminal distribution, QoS demand, and base station capacity, is obtained by using the utility-based mixed strategy. The simulation result shows that the overall network utility performance, in terms of low blocking probability and high QoS satisfying, is significantly improved by using UCSCA's self-configuration solution.

articleTitle: Quantitative Evaluation and Analysis for Advantage Industry of Lucheng District
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a certain period, there is one or more industry in a country or region whose economic efficiency is better, growth rate is higher, and development is faster. We call these industries as advantage industry. They have strengthening trend and prospect. According to the definition to advantage industry and development situation of the Lucheng district, we adopt qualitative and quantitative method, principal components analysis, to evaluate industries in the Lucheng district. At last we choose respective advantage industry.

articleTitle: Study on Finite Horizon Life Cycle Model of Consumption by Scenario Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multistage optimization problems are common occurrence in the economic literature. Scenario aggregation method is a widely used in solving dynamic programming problems. It is adopted as an alternative to describe the decision making process of an optimizing agent in economic models. Decisions made by scenario aggregation provide more accuracy and less risk in multistage stochastic optimization than traditional methods. Specifically, the scenario aggregation method is used to obtain a solution to a finite horizon life cycle model of consumption. The characteristics of the methodology and the comparison of its solution to the analytical solution of the model should be discussed in future research.

articleTitle: Ethernet-Broadcasting-Based Distributed Load Balancing Technology of Server Cluster
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The common method to solve performance bottleneck problems of network service nodes is to take use of server cluster systems. At present, the schema which uses centralized load balancer to do management of system load is dominant. But the load balancer used may become a bottleneck of the system. This paper first analyzes and compares the existing load balancing technologies, and then proposes the Ethernet-broadcasting-based distributed load balancing technology.

articleTitle: Studies on the Knowledge Energy of Learning Organization and its Movement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the learning organization's knowledge energy movement from the angle of quantum- mechanical theory, with the application of literature methodology and analogy methodology. The following conclusions were reached. Learning organization's knowledge energy is the sum total of work done by learning force to transfer learning organization system through knowledge sharing and innovating; the learning force is the reason of knowledge field energy movement. Learning knowledge leads to the breakthrough of the boundary of learning organizational knowledge energy and the lifting of energy level. The knowledge resonant promotes the organizational knowledge energy accumulation.The knowledge energy kernel reaction has impact on the management ways of learning organization.

articleTitle: A New Evaluation Way of Government Leaders' Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Government Leaders' performance (GLP) is the representative reflection of organizational performance (OP). Because leader is the main body of organizational system, we can not totally regard OP as GLP, and not treat all as equals by equalitarianism. In former researches, leaders' performance evaluation mostly adopted ratio of total yearly increments to measure absolute contribution degree. In this paper, leaders' contribution is not an abstract factor, which must be reflected on the dynamic change of GLP, which is divided from OP based on the method of data envelopment analysis (DEA). Its results actually present relative contribution effectiveness (RCE) of GLP which organizational system continuously seeks optimal strategy to optimize, and lay a solid foundation for further study on leaders' performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Harmony Monitoring Mechanism of Government System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The harmony monitoring mechanism of government system is put forward for improving the synergetic effect and harmony of the government system and to construct the one-stop high-synergetic services-oriented government. The direct disharmony matrix and total disharmony matrix of each element of the government system can be calculated through the concept of disharmony. And the disharmony degree, restricted degree and total disharmony degree of each element can be calculated through the two matrixes. The D-C space distribution structure map which describing the controllable degree and harmony of each element also can be generated in this method. The implementing of the harmony monitoring mechanism will be demonstrated in a data analyze case. This monitoring mechanism can help the government system to discovery the disharmony factors in the department and to improve the elements that located in the disharmony district. Also this mechanism offers the decision support to the high-synergetic services-oriented government.

articleTitle: An Optimal High-Order-Phase Chirp for DS-UWB Ranging
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The UWB (ultra-wideband) communication system occupies very large bandwidth of 7.5 GHz. This enables high-precision ranging that provides correct position information. In this paper, we analyzed each of high-order-phase chirps from 2nd-order to 4th-order for DS (direct-sequence)-UWB ranging and investigated to find out the optimal phase based on the mainlobe-1st sidelobe ratio which determines the ranging accuracy. Simulation results confirmed that the 3rd-order-phase chirp is optimal for ranging.

articleTitle: Consideration of Task Circumstance in Service Matchmaking
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Web service matchmaking is an important aspect of interaction between modern enterprises. At present, many service matchmaking methods are proposed. However, most of them only consider function compatibility of service, yet ignoring the compatibility of task circumstance. In fact, a service description should contain semantics of task circumstance, which can improve the precision of service matchmaking. Based on domain shared ontology, this paper proposed a service compatibility matchmaking algorithm based on task circumstance, which takes task circumstance description pattern as the uniform semantic basis to describe the task circumstance in service request and service provision precisely, completely and conveniently. Our experimental data show that this novel service matchmaking method outperforms others in terms of precision.

articleTitle: Performance of a Queuing Model With Hyper-Erlang Distribution Service for Wireless Network Nodes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research finds within the last decade on network measurement have shown the classical assumption of exponentially decaying service distributions does not apply in a number of sources - Ethernet, ISDN, CCSN and VBR video. Recent research has shown that self-similar nature of traffic still exists in the traffic of wireless networks. Appropriate service distribution of these sources may be heavy-tailed service distributions. A difficult with heavy-tailed service distribution queuing model is that they may not have closed-from, analytic results. This paper proposes a method for analyzing the self-similar CMWAP traffic via HErd (Hyper-Erlang distribution) fitting technique and matrix geometry method.
