Analytical results and Numerical results of queuing performance effectively describe the self-similar nature of wireless network node against traditional Poisson process.

articleTitle: 2-D VESPA Algorithm for Multiuser and Multipath DOA Estimation in DS-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose an effective two dimensional (2-D) direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithm for the synchronous DS-CDMA systems in multi-user and multi-path channels. The algorithm can be applied in CDMA base station receiver with arbitrary array antenna. In order to effectively suppress multiple access interference (MAI), multiple parallel code-matched filters and a decorrelating multiuser detector are used to detect each path of desired signal for each mobile user. In the output of the detector, a cumulant-based 2-D Virtual ESPRIT Algorithm (VESPA) is employed to estimate each resolvable path direction-azimuth/elevation. In the method, 2-D DOA of each sub-path signal is accurately estimated with higher resolution than the previous methods because array aperture is extended by the use of higher order cumulants. It also has advantage of eliminating the spatially colored Gaussian noise and being available in arbitrary array geometry.

Index Terms: Direct Sequence Code Division Multiple Access

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Multi-Skill Call Center Considering Call Abandonment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Focused on a classical multi-skill call center design model, a method for describing state space was given first. While considering the process of call handling as a Markov process and taken the phenomenon of call abandonment into account, the state-transfer equation based on birth-and-death process was generated. A process of calculating steady-state probability and using steady-state probability for performance analysis was presented. A compare with simulation method and was done at last to show the effect and efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Design and Test of ZigBee Network in Storehouse Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the problem in storehouse management, this paper proposed a wireless communication network infrastructure based on ZigBee technology. CC2430 is chosen as the kernel chip of node hardware and MSSTATE LRWPAN is used as network communication protocol. Test result indicates the network has low communication latency, high data transmitting efficiency and the ability of self-organizing and self-healing is good.

articleTitle: A Study of Deadlock Avoidance Strategy in Knowledgeable Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the finite automata theory, a thinking of distributed deadlock supervisor is proposed to avoid deadlock in Knowledgeable Manufacturing Systems, which is insensitive to system size and improves the efficiency of automata modeling and operating. The conception of the auto-correlation operation is presented, then the corresponding distributed deadlock supervisors are constructed, and thus the deadlock-free strategy of the knowledgeable manufacturing cell is obtained, which can be used to monitor status of the knowledge manufacturing cell in real-time and guarantees safe running of the system. Finally, a case study is presented to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Enterprises' IRM Based on Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, value chain is regarded as a kind of strategic tool of E-commerce enterprises' information resources management (IRM). By reconstructing value chain, value-added links and approaches are identified. As a result, the efficiency of IRM is improved and core competence & competitive advantage of E-commerce enterprises is strengthened.

articleTitle: Research on Granulometry Approach to Measuring Microbubbles Size Distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The definition of flat fading and frequency-selective fading channels is extended to low-rank and high-rank channels to include the angular domain. By physical reasoning a generic channel model is introduced incorporating directions of arrival and a set of parameters is given for its configuration. The time evolution of the scattering processes and directions of arrival is taken into account. Analytical expressions are derived for space-correlation coefficients and frequency-correlation coefficients. Spatial correlation decreases with increasing angular spread and decreasing angle of incidence, measured from array broadside.

articleTitle: The Evolution and Determinants of Skill Premium in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: China experienced a sharp increase in wage inequality between unskilled and skilled workers in the late 1990s. Multiple factors lie behind the notorious skill income inequality. This paper describes the evolution of skill premium during the last two decades and analyzes the reasons leading to the result in a simple supply and demand framework. Finally, this paper comes up with some proposals on decreasing skill premium and income inequality.

articleTitle: Error and Outage Performance of STBC MB-OFDM UWB
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bit error performance is investigated in this paper for orthogonal space-time block coded (STBC) multiband orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MB-OFDM) ultra-wideband (UWB) systems. As the channel model considers the log-normal fading, the resultant signal to noise ratio (SNR) follows a chi- squared log-normal distribution. Based on this, the bit error probability and the outage probability are derived. Simulations demonstrate the theoretical solutions.

articleTitle: Study on the Segmentation Method of the Air Freight Customers Based on Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On condition of limited resources, businesses should put resources on those lucrative customers. So it is necessary to carry out customer segmentation, especially for the air freight industry being in the fierce competition. Drawing on the theory of customer value, and combining it with the management features of the air freight customers to construct the forecasting model of customer value, on the basis of these, this article puts forward the method of customer segmentation based on the technology of business intelligence and then talks over its implementation steps.

articleTitle: Doppler Shift Estimation for Low Signal-Noise-Ratio Environment in Mobile Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel iterative Doppler shift estimator is proposed in this letter for the Doppler shift estimation in very low signal- noise-ratio (SNR) environment. The proposed method exploits the logarithm envelope (LE) of the mobile propagation channel, and iteratively finds the minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimation of the Doppler shift. Extensive simulation results conducted under a wide range of the noise corruption clearly show that our proposed Doppler shift estimation method substantially outperforms all existing estimators.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Customer Asset Management Capability: Measurements and Performance Implications Based on China Firms
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the High Availability Storage Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper introduces an IP-based high-available storage network (for short HASN), featured by the following advantages: firstly, it integrates multi-NAS and SAN with OSD through a global multi-protocol file system (for short GMPFS), with greater capacity and better scalability than each of them; secondly, it simultaneously serves both the file I/O and the block I/O by an iSCSI module, with all the advantages of a NAS and a SAN; thirdly, with a storage agency (for short SA), the HASN I/O performance is improved and server bottlenecks are reduced; fourthly, high availability is attained by way of a high-available file system. In addition, in the experiment concerned, the HASN has proved to be a network storage system with great capacity producing an ultra-high-throughput for both the file I/O and the block I/O.

articleTitle: Layered Service Discovery Approach for MANETs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a layered service discovery (LSD) protocol in Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANETs). Service discovery is the key challenge for the pervasive personal environment for the lack of limited resources and high mobility. While a couple of existing service discovery protocols have been developed for the infrastructure-based wireless environment without considering the volatile characteristic of the multi-hops wireless network. We propose a layered service discovery protocol that utilizes directories acting as cluster head nodes and DHT to perform comprehensive service discovery in MANETs.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis for Complex Information System Based on Nested Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The analysis for complex information system includes both the structural system aspects and the system behavior, which can be achieved by nested Petri nets in the paper, i.e. Petri nets in which tokens can be nested relational data. Firstly, each place of a net represents a nested relation scheme, and the marking of each place is given as a nested relation of the respective type. Secondly, insert and delete operations in a nested relational database are expressed by transitions in a net, and the arcs of a net are inscribed with filter tables, which allow conditions to be formulated on the specified tuples. Then, the occurrence rule for transitions is defined by the operations union and intersection lattices of nested relations. Finally, the model is demonstrated on an example of an information system for planning and controlling projects in an enterprise.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Application of Traffic-Flow Complexity Measure in Traffic Control
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The study about how to estimate and measure the complexity of traffic flow system is in the ascendant. The application of complexity measure methods in traffic control is becoming a research frontier. In this paper, the simulation tests were used to study the application of complexity measure in traffic control. First, the improved Lempel-Ziv algorithm was introduced to scientifically depict the complexity of a traffic flow system. Then, the follows were validated by simulation: i) whether there is some influence of traffic control on traffic-flow complexity and to what degree the influence is if it exists; ii) the effect of complexity as a control index on the output of traffic control. The concludes are as follows: i) the complexity of a traffic flow is different under different green split, which indicates that the complexity of traffic flow can be changed by traffic control; ii) the information quantity of performance function is enriched by the accession of a new variable, i.e., complexity, which shows that complexity can and should be used in traffic control.

articleTitle: Binomial Tree Method for American Options in a Regime Switching Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We derive the binomial tree scheme for pricing American put options in a regime switching model. An explicit formula is obtained for one-period binomial tree model. Furthermore the pricing scheme is established for multi-period binomial tree model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Threshold Proxy Authenticated Encryption Scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The authenticated encryption schemes can be used to provides integration, authentication, and non-repudiation for the signing message while keeping the message secret from the public. In this paper, we propose a new (t, n) threshold proxy authenticated encryption scheme, in which at least t out of n proxy signers delegated by the original signer can sign messages on behalf of the original signer. This scheme not only has the advantages such as unforgeablity, nonrepudiation and secrecy, but also provides flexibility. We can announce the parameters to change the threshold value t. Once the combined proxy signers of threshold value t and announcing parameters that can generate a legal proxy signature, this result can enable the security to increase or reduce the threshold value flexibility. Therefore, the scheme in this paper provides an easy and convenient way to delegate the power of digitally signed message.

articleTitle: Security Analysis on Tripartite Authenticated Key Agreement Protocols
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nalla and Reddy proposes ID-based tripartite authenticated key agreement protocols from Weil pairing. Security analysis on passive attack for Nalla-Reddy's ID-AK-2 and ID-AK-3 protocols is proposed in this paper and the protocols are proved to be not secure on passive attack.

articleTitle: Study on Evaluation Model for Government Objective Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve government objective performance, the Shenyang's government objective performance is taken as research background, the objective performance evaluation model for government is established. On the basis of analyzing goal location for performance, the index system for performance evaluation is established, varied disposing modes driven by varied goal location for weighting coefficient and multiindex integrating is analyzed. The disposing method for single index value of economic and noneconomic category index are respectively introduced, the combination technique of absolute value and relative value is especially studied, and the dimension eliminating method for index value is given. During the integrating of multiattribute evaluation, rank correlation analysis method is studied, and the conventional 'scatter degree' method is especially adapted, and they are respectively applied to generate weighting coefficient for level one and level two index; Then, the integrating method of multiindex is studied. The above performance evaluation model is applied to the practice of Shenyang's objective performance evaluation, and the result validates the validity of above model.

articleTitle: An Improved Data Completing Algorithm Based on Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ROUSTIDA algorithm is used to data completing in rough set for incomplete information systems, however its coverage is not good enough. To solve the problem, an improved algorithm is proposed from the angle of group decision. Direction-area of attributes on columns and simple-majority-rule ratio of objects on rows of decision table is defined respectively, and they are combined with ROUSTIDA algorithm, thus the coverage of improved algorithm surpasses than that of original algorithm, and the problems of multimode or no mode are avoided. The result of an instance shows the availability of proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive Playout Algorithm Based on Wavelet Transform and Kernel Estimation in VoIP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Adaptive playout algorithms are used at the receiver to combat jitter problems in voice over IP (VoIP). The playout algorithms rely on short term estimations of the characteristics of network delay that would be experienced by up-coming voice packets. This paper proposes a new adaptive playout algorithm based on wavelet transform and kernel estimation. The proposed algorithm uses wavelet transform to decompose non-stationary delay series into several stationary components, and then predicts all these components with kernel estimation. Finally, the overall end-to-end delay is obtained by wavelet reconstruction with these predicted components. Experimental results show that the prediction precision of the new algorithm is about 6-17 dB higher than that of the conventional auto regressive (AR) algorithm, about 2.5~8 dB higher than that of the differential auto regressive (DIAR) algorithm and 1~3 dB higher than that of our latest proposed wavelet transform based auto regressive (WTAR) algorithm.

articleTitle: The Incentive Mechanism For Truth-Telling in Information Sharing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a three-stages game model between one manufacture and Yl retailers which engaged in Cournot competition. If the retailers share their forecasts truthfully, the manufacturer always benefits; however, the profits of the retailers always worse off by disclosing their demand information to the manufacturer. However, we show that the retailers have an incentive to understate their forecasts while sharing information. The information distortion phenomenon is the direct result of each party exploiting its private information to appropriate the gains from information sharing. If the manufacturer and the retailers can agree on their relative profit margins or profits prior to information sharing, the retailers will share their information truthfully and both parties may benefit from information sharing.

articleTitle: An Analysis Model of Industrial International Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The analysis model of industrial international competitiveness is a basic theory and analytical framework to guide the research on the industrial international competitiveness. This paper discussed the relationship and difference between industrial international competitiveness, product competitiveness, enterprise competitiveness, and national competitiveness. Moreover, this paper brought forward a new analysis model of industrial international competitiveness, which is constituted by eight basic elements. All eight factors drive the wheels of industrial international competitiveness roll forward, so the model is named "round wheel model".

articleTitle: Why Delay in Adoption of New Technology in the Presence of Network Effect
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The networks literature suggests a network's value increases in the number of locations it serves (the ldquonetwork effectrdquo) and the number of its users (the ldquoproduction scale effectrdquo). In this article we discuss one of the technology innovation in optical industry- photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology. We show that, in one hand, consumers (traditional carriers) would be very careful to adopt a new technology or product in presence of network effect, which results in new technology adoption delays increasing in the size of traditional networks. In the other hand, if benefit from this new technology is not certain, dominant suppliers (equipment vendors) prefer waiting and collecting information to make further decision, so in some time network effect reduce innovation incentives.

articleTitle: The Design and Evaluation of a MIMO-OFDM Benchmark
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The combination of MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) and OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) is considered as a key technology of next wireless communication. In this paper, a MIMO-OFDM benchmark compliant to IEEE 802.16e standard is developed and evaluated on YHFT-DSP/700. We provide a detailed a detailed analysis of computation requirement, parallelism, memory requirement and intrinsic operations of the core algorithms along with the interaction between the components. The goal of this paper is to provide a high-level analysis of the architectural implications of one protocol that need to be accommodated in a programmable platform for software defined radio.

articleTitle: Time-Cost Tradeoffs Method for Hydropower Project Construction
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of the enactment data and information in workout plan, there are some traditional time-cost tradeoff methods, which optimize time-cost in the practice projects. It is difficult for these methods to achieve anticipate purpose as a result of the changes of construction conditions. Aiming to the above shortage, on the basis of discussion relative between time and cost, some problems of relative between time and cost in hydropower project construction schedule are analyzed. The paper presents a fuzzy optimizing time-cost tradeoffs method to realize dynamic management by fuzzy cut set, which is a standard for the degree of risk.

articleTitle: The Effects of the Impulsive Noise on a Rayleigh Fast Fading Channel with the Intersymbol Interference
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we present the performance analysis of a binary transmission on a Rayleigh fast fading channel in the presence of intersymbol interference and a mixture of Gaussian and impulsive noises. The impulsive noise is modeled as an alpha-stable process. The average probability of error is derived based on the characteristic functions of the noise random variables.

articleTitle: Queue Theory Based Algorithm for Material Lean Scheduling in Heavy Weight Parts Workshop
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The extensive management manner and the severe wastes have become the barriers to the development of the heavy weight parts machining workshop. The article advances a new heavy weight parts machining workshop material lean scheduling method under the guidance of lean production principles and queue theories. The new scheduling method considers the impact factors such as respective machining time of all the work areas, the service time and the velocity of the material-handling equipment synthetically. Select the total latency time of all the work areas, the answer times and the total moving distance of the material-handling equipment in a whole workday as target values of the material lean scheduling system. A simulation study is performed to compare the new heavy weight parts machining workshop lean scheduling scheme with the traditional scheduling methods. The ultimate simulation results show that the designed new scheduling method is superior to the traditional ones evidently.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research of Bohai Rim Container Terminal Based on PDEA Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the appraisal methods of efficiency of container terminal, this study designs an evaluation index system of efficiency of container terminal, and sets up a preferable data envelopment analysis (PDEA) model of Bohai Rim container terminal. The result indicates that PDEA model can reflect designers' inclination, which carries out a reason test by projective analysis so as to make terminal operators design effective measurements.

articleTitle: A MADM Alternative Ranking Approach under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The individual preferences for gains, losses, and uncertain events, which are first proposed by prospect theory, are rarely considered in current MADM methods. To solve this problem, a MADM alternative ranking approach under uncertainty is presented. The presented approach proposes a method for eliciting individual preferences for gains, losses and uncertain events by using the trade off method and the certainty equivalent method, based on which, the individual overall utilities of alternatives on each attribute are determined by incorporating the utilities of gains and losses with their corresponding decision weightings of uncertain events, and finally alternatives are ranked by using swing weighting method to balance relative dominances of attributes. By comparing with other approaches on a simulation example, the presented approach is proved to be scientific, reasonable, and well applicable to MADM alternative rankings under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Bottle-Neck Diagnosis System of the Regional Economic Development Based on Fuzzy Adaptive Inference Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents new bottle-neck diagnosis method in a regional economic system based on fuzzy adaptive inference. This method can partly solve the problems such as many obstacles, complicated influence factors, and fuzzy characteristics in the regional economic development. It combines the fuzzy logic with neural network and has all the advantages which they both have. It can realize bottle-neck diagnosis in a short time. It has obvious advantage in terms of knowledge acquisition, parallel inference, adaptive learning, memory recalling and generalization of knowledge. Simulation results show that the application of fuzzy neural network inference in the regional economic bottle-neck diagnosis system is in accordance with the local authority's usual practice. Thus, this method is more valid than the method based on rules.

articleTitle: An Algorithm Based on In_phase and Quadrature Channels for USB/LSB/DSB Recognition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the traditional P parameters algorithm based on single channel, a certain carrier residual excursion must be retained. However, the residual excursion is not beneficial to the later recognition and demodulation process at a low-frequency stage. In order to overcome these shortcomings, an algorithm based on inphase and quadrature channels for USB (upper sideband modulation), LSB (lower sideband modulation) and DSB (double sideband modulation) recognition is presented. The new algorithm needn't reserve a carrier residual excursion. So it avoids the disadvantages of the traditional algorithm. Computer simulations indicate that the algorithm based on inphase and quadrature channels can discraminate from USB, LSB and DSB signals effectively at SNR=0 dB.

articleTitle: Setting Optimal Markdown Timing for Competitive Products
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with a kind of specific retailing that sells a fixed stock of perishable goods over a finite horizon. Under the case with the set of discrete available prices and given demand rates, Gallego and van Ryzin provides a two-price policy, which are easy for consumers to interpret and for firms to manage. However, if there exists competition in the market and competitors both adopt two-price policy, different markdown timing will certainly lead to customers' transfer. In this paper, we discuss how to determine the markdown timing for two competitive suppliers. A Cournot game is proposed based on Gallego and van Ryzin's two-price policy and the equilibrium point is found with the help of illustrations. Compared with the pricing policy without consideration of competition, the optimal markdown timing of the leading product will be delayed and that of the following product will be advanced. The numerical example shows that the leader's revenue is increased and the follower's revenue is decreased. We also analyze the effects of the customer transfer probability between two products on the equilibrium of the game through the example.

articleTitle: Analysis of EPQ Model Based on Activity-Based Costing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To analyze the effects of activity-based costing (ABC) on the economic production quantity (EPQ) model in production-inventory system, a new EPQ model based on ABC is developed in this paper. In the new model, based on ABC perspectives, we analyze the cost drivers other than conventional ones specified in the production-inventory system, and then revise the cost functions according to these cost drivers. In this paper, numerical examples are also given to illustrate the new model by comparing with the classical EPQ model. The results show the new model is more effective than the classical EPQ model in cost control.

articleTitle: Improved R/S Algorithm Based on Network Traffic Self-Similarity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the Internet, the distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack is the most frequently used and most deleterious attack which aims at a single target and causes denial of service for users of the targeted system. Today, network security has become the key for the popularization of all kinds of network applications. In this paper, a model against DDoS attack based on detecting the network traffic character is proposed and the method of detecting DDoS attack by computing the self-similarity parameter of network traffic is studied emphatically. The R/S algorithm is adopted to calculate the on-line Hurst parameter through data reusing, and then the implement is given. The experiment results show that this method can detect the DDoS attack accurately and in time.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Coordination Involving Risk-Averse Agents
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain management seeks to enhance competitive performance by closely integrating supplier, manufacturer and other channel agents. The supply chain agents' behavior features will be influenced by their attitudes on risk. In this paper, we consider the cooperation contract about a risk-neutral manufacturer as a core enterprise coordinating the downside-risk-averse supplier and retailer in a three-tier supply chain. The mutual influence of risk-controlling and benefit-sharing of supply chain agents is modeled. We show that by designing a risk-sharing contract to the risk-averse supplier and retailer, the manufacturer provides the desired risk protection to the risk-averse agents, the restriction of downside-risk is satisfied and the supply chain achieves coordination. Moreover, the more profits produced by this supply chain cooperation can be allocated arbitrarily according to their bargaining power and reservation profits.

articleTitle: Particle-Swarm-Optimization-Based Minimum-BER Detection for MIMO Systems with Time-Reversal Space-Time Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present an efficient adaptive minimum bit error rate (MBER) detection approach for multiple-in-multiple-out (MIMO) systems with Time-Reversal space-time block codes (TR-STBC), which have attracted enormous attention in recent years. In general, the popular minimum mean square error (MMSE) receiver can be employed due to its good performance and amenability to adaptive implementation. However, it is not optimal in terms of the bit error rate (BER) performance. In this proposed approach, the main idea is to directly minimize the BER by employing an particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm on the estimated BER function in order to adaptively adjust the weights of the MBER detectors. Simulation results demonstrate that this adaptive minimum- BER detection using PSO algorithm (MBER-PSO) can achieve significantly superior performance, which is very close to that of the optimal maximum-likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE) detector.

articleTitle: Effects of Competitive Alliance Based on Knowledge-Sharing and Knowledge-Spillover
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conceptual model of the knowledge-sharing and the knowledge-spillover was constructed according to the knowledge voluntary proliferation and the non-voluntary proliferation characteristics between the individual members in the competitive alliance, and a three-stage gambling model was established based on the cost decreases effect of the knowledge- sharing and the knowledge-spillover. The findings indicated that, the knowledge-sharing level, the knowledge-spillover level and the output of alliance exert positive effects on profit; the knowledge, output and the profit that each individual obtains increase along with the enhancement of knowledge-sharing level beta and the knowledge-spillover level delta.

articleTitle: Self-Adaptive Choosing the Copy-Frame Number of Selective Mapping
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At numerous methods of reducing peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), the selective mapping (SLM) is a well effective method, but it needs more IFFT process whose number is equal to copy-frame, this causes the high complexity of the system. A self-adaptive choosing the copy-frame number model of SLM is proposed in this paper. At the basic of the BER meet some qualification, it can choose out the very reasonable copy-frame number of system though the self-adaptive choosing the copy-frame number arithmetic. This makes the systemic complexity keeping in the lowest floor, and at the same time reduces the PAPR effectively. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed self-adaptive choosing system.

articleTitle: Developing an Assessment Scale for Residents' Perceptions on Tourism Impacts
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The term of "tourism impact" has been gaining increasing attention in the literature of tourism. Given the inconsistent study scale and measure criteria about, no study on and unreliability and invalidity of the research methodology of residents' perceptions on tourism impacts in anterior studies in China, this paper, through interviews of domestic and foreign experts and case studies of tourism sites in China, develops an assessment scale by means of statistical analysis, involves 3 dimensions and 11 items of residents' positive and negative perceptions on tourism impacts respectively. It is demonstrated that this assessment scale can be used to measure Chinese residents' perceptions on tourism impacts.

articleTitle: Smooth Handoff with Relay Router in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supporting user mobility is an important requirement for wireless mesh networks. We propose a relay-router buffering- and-forwarding scheme for supporting smooth handoff in the infrastructure wireless mesh networks. Our proposal is based on buffering packets at intermediate relay routers in the packets forwarding route and neighboring relay routers working in promiscuous mode which can overhear the packet transmission from neighboring relay routers to APs. With the help of relay routers, the forwarding path of buffered packets is shortened greatly. The relay routers selection is based on multipoint relays of OLSR protocol. Simulation results show that this scheme improves the data availability and results in reducing the packet loss significantly.

articleTitle: The Influence of Online Store Perception on Customer Behavior in the Experiential Marketing Context
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Customer experience is an important consideration in the establishment and maintenance of long term relationship between firms and their customers. The purpose of this study was to propose and test an integrative model for examining the relative influence of online store perception on customer behavior. The empirical results showed that physical presence, competence, and enjoyment were the important variables to enhance utilitarian value, experiential value and trust. It is important to afford enjoying experience even if the product seems to be utilitarian. The findings also revealed that utilitarian value, experiential value, and trust combine to determine the online store loyalty. Thus, creating and maintaining customer experience is an appropriate and necessary strategy for increasing customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Improved Grey Relation Analysis Based on AHP and Shannon Entropy for the Evaluation of Thermal Power Enterprise's Coal Supplier
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A grey relation analysis mould used to evaluate the thermal power enterprise's coal supplier was proposed. To overcome the problems of weights allocation and determination which exists on the mould of traditional grey relation analysis, a weight grey relation analysis method was modified to solve the problems. The weight was used to estimate the effect of the evaluated index on the evaluated subject , and weight was determined by using Shannon Entropy combined Analytic Hierarchy Process in order to avoid objective influencing factors therefore , the evaluation was more objective, scientific and rational.

articleTitle: Ontology Based Coordination in RFID Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Coordination mechanisms using semantic Web rule languages are being studied. But we haven't found any job is specific for the coordination of RFID network. This paper intends to explain the theory and processes of this coordination mechanism used in RFID network with multi-agent system (MAS) framework. It firstly defines an ontology prototype in RFID field; and then gives the basic principle of the mechanism which is used to deal with the collaboration and conflict among agents. This ontological method for coordination in RFID network is proved to be feasible, effective and promising. Our job is a preliminary groundwork for the implementation of ontology based RFID coordination mechanism.

articleTitle: Optimal Unicast Path Selection Algorithm in the Overlay Multicast
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a two-layer overlay multicast framework for building an application-layer multicast(ALM) system model. The framework employs an optimal unicast path selection (OUPS) algorithm, which can select QoS-satisfied multicast tree path for stream applications. This algorithm is proposed to compute the QoS weight values of paths in overlay network, and to select optimal unicast path for ALM. This approach balances delay and bandwidth available requests using path weight adjuster. Compared to random unicast path selection algorithm, our approach achieves better minimized delay and maximized bandwidth available. Large-scale simulations demonstrate the efficiency and performance of the multicast framework The results can be used for a variety of live real-time distribution stream applications, such as IPTV, VOD and so on.

articleTitle: A CI Supporting Model for Software Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the increasing development of software outsourcing (SO) in many countries, the competition between different software outsourcing vendees is very fierce. This paper provides a nontechnical analysis of ways that competitive intelligence (CI) system can be used by SO receivers to acquire information of the competitors, market and industry in order to gain perpetual competitive advantages. A conceptual model is designed with an insightful structure of both intangible and tangible measures. Detailed measures are enunciated in 3 parts: environmental analysis, competitor analysis and SO contractees analysis. Finally, the significance and creativity of this research are concluded.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Traffic Mode Choices in Urban Railway Passenger Hub Based on Combined RP/SP Data
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Railway Passenger Station is the joint which link the inside and outside of passenger transportation. The study on how the passenger to choose the traffic modes when they leave the station is the basis of study on transfer behavior in hub. According the survey and data analysis, this paper discussed the characteristics of tradition railway and PDL (Passenger Dedicated Lines) and then gave some suggestion about the problem of transport in urban railway passenger hub. It analyzed the passengers' transfer attributes including trip purpose ,, structure, travel time, and the transfer characteristics between the train and other traffic modes as urban rail transit, bus, long-distance bus or intra-city car. Considering the HanKou Train station without urban rail transit, the paper built the model of traffic mode choices in urban railway passenger hub based on combined RP/SP data, using the survey methods of the RP and SP data. The result can provides the theory foundation for the most reasonable arrangement of traffic capacity and the optimal combination of traffic modes.

articleTitle: Manufacturing and Remanufacturing Lot-Size Model with Backordering and Disposal
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A manufacturing and remanufacturing system with backordering and disposal is investigated. Returned products from customers are kept in remanufacturable inventory, but only a portion of them are remanufactured and the rest are disposed. Constant demand is satisfied by either manufactured items or remanufactured items which compose serviceable inventory. Excess demand is completely backordered. Two types of policy are analyzed, and the optimal manufacturing and remanufacturing policies are found. The results generalize the models proposed by Konstantaras and Papachristos (2006) and Dobos and Richter(2004).

articleTitle: Capon Beamforming-Based Method in IR-UWB imaging System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently, many studies have been focused on impulse radio UWB (IR-UWB) imaging system as the advantages of IR-UWB, such as penetrating ability and high resolution. However, it is difficult to reconstruct the information of target by antenna array in IR-UWB imaging system. Several imaging schemes, such as Capon beamforming-based method have been applied in ultra sound imaging. In this paper, the Capon beamforming-based method is proposed to apply to the IR-UWB imaging system to reconstruct a point target in free space. A circular antenna array was used for signal transceiving. According to the results, the Capon beamforming-based method is feasible for IR-UWB imaging system. The performance of the Capon beamforming-based method is better than the traditional DAS method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Tourism to the Tourism Destinations Social Influence Research Summary
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Simulation System of Chinese Gasoline Demand and its Long-Term Dynamic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, according to the analysis of the demand system of gasoline in China, we set up and ran a dynamic simulation system of Chinese gasoline demand with Vensim, the software on dynamic system. In this system, we designed different scenes of world oil price and analyzed the changes on the demand and supply of China's gasoline, its domestic price, the growth of China's gasoline vehicles and so forth.

articleTitle: Concurrently Delivering and Retrieving Multicast Data in Parallel Channels for Mobile Users
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, the backbone network is capable of delivering countless information at extremely high performance and high throughput. However, the abundant information in the backbone may not be retrieved by the mobile users' fingertips. This paper developed the parallel channels content delivery and concurrent retrieval mechanisms so as to support timely and reliable access to the multicasting information on the mobile terminals. The mechanisms proposed can deliver information, contents and services to larger mobile user groups in a high efficient way. The benefits include scaling up as the number of users increases, eliminating the need to multiplex the bandwidth among users accessing the air channel, and achieving shorter response time, lessening power consumption.

articleTitle: Study of Wireless Ad Hoc Network Based on MS/TP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: BACnet (building automation and control networks) is a standard data communication protocol for building automation and control systems. BACnet adopts master-slave/token-passing (MS/TP) as one of its local area networking options. The MS/TP protocol is designed specifically for building automation and control systems. In this paper, the authors firstly analyze the feasibility of MS/TP protocol used in wireless ad hoc network, and then resolve the key technologies of MS/TP protocol implemented in wireless network, finally propose the specific hardware and software design program of MS/TP protocol applied in wireless network. This is of great significance to promote MS/TP and even BACnet standard to be used in other areas and develop wireless smart home system further.

articleTitle: Improved Authentication Procedures of PBOC 2.0 Based on SVO
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we analyze PBOC 2.0, the specifications for China financial integrated circuit card. We abstract the whole security mechanism, including initialization, personalization and transaction, to graphics and symbols. Modifications are suggested to enhance the security of authentication scheme based on SVO logical format analysis.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Environmental Pollution Efficiencies of China's Manufacturing Industries
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In general, data envelope analysis (DEA) assumes that inputs and outputs are "desirable goods", but the undesirable waste should be considered from the perspective of environmental pollution. This article utilizing "total assets", "energy consumption" and "number of employees" as the input variables, and "volume of waste water discharged", "Volume of waste gas emission" and "volume of solid wastes produced" as the output variables, calculated the pollution efficiencies of China's 28 manufacturing industries from 2001 to 2006. Results show that the industries of "smelting and pressing of ferrous metals", "nonmetal mineral products" and "papermaking and paper products" have been keeping the highest pollution efficiencies in all the industries during the six years. More strict and effective measures are necessary.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of On-line Bank Customer Management System Based on Mainframe
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper proposed a system which combined on-line bank system with the customer relationship management system (CRM) for the bank to search trace and analyze every customer through the internet in the most convenient way. History record is used to get a general idea of the customer behavior and to dig the customer need. In this way, it can reduce much time that disturb the customer, to win a greater satisfaction of the customers. The system achieves the functions of a basic on-line payment business, customer information management, customer complaints management, customer allocation levels, personalized custom services and customer information analysis. The system uses the loosely coupled SOA solutions. The core business-critical applications run on the traditional mainframe platform, the other expansion of the application build on open platform. Data, business and logic are completely independent, so it is easy to maintain and extend for the system.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Independent-Innovation System of Chinese Market-Oriented Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An enterprise's independent-innovation is a systematic process, which demands joint efforts by departments in the enterprise, users, suppliers, upstream and downstream enterprises, colleges and research institutes. Taking Chinese electrical enterprise- Haier Group for example, the paper proposes the analytic framework for market-oriented enterprise's independent-innovation system and expounds its essential features for the purpose of setting good examples for enterprises in developing countries to follow in their independent-innovation.

articleTitle: A Novel Analytical Approach to the Handoff Management for Hierarchical Mobile IP
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We use the Boring professor movement model to propose a novel analytical approach to the handoff management for hierarchical mobile IP. Applying the Laplace transform and Residue Theorem, we get the general probability of number of moving cross FA. It is very useful for handoff management in hierarchical mobile IP.

articleTitle: Distribution Centers Site Selection Based on KPCA-SVRM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Distribution centers site selection has become a popular problem in recent years. Fine distribution centers site selection can ensure the supply and reduce the cost. By studying the methods proposed by other scholars, a mew method, KPCA (kernel principal component analysis) -SVRM (support vector regression machine) is proposed by this paper. The first step of this method is to apply KPCA to SVRM for feature extraction. KPCA first maps the original inputs into a high dimensional feature space using the kernel method and then calculates PCA in the high dimensional feature space. These new features are then used as the inputs of SVRM to solve the site selection problem. By learning and training, we use the data of this subset to get the solution and find interrelationship of input and output by the SVRM. Practical examples are cited in this paper to illustrate the process. The KPCA-SVRM method can also be used to solve other selection and decision problems.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Bid Evaluation of Construction Project Based on the Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The bid evaluation of construction project is a multivariate evaluation. Based on the principal component analysis which is included in multivariate statistical analysis, this paper establishes the multi-index comprehensive bid evaluation model of construction project, and proposes that how to calculate the evaluation index weight by introducing the variance contribution ratio, and that how to determine the number of principal components by making comprehensive consideration with an introduction of accumulated contribution ratio and factor load. Finally, an example is given to prove the convenience and feasibility of this bid evaluation method. This method has some characteristics: It overcomes deficiencies like large number of evaluation indexes, the overlap of the information that contained in evaluation indexes, and the determination of weight is artificial. The results of bid evaluation are objective and reasonable, which are suit for the evaluation of multi-index systems of large construction projects.

articleTitle: Wireless Embedded Monitoring Network System Research Based on Radio Frequency Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There is no mobile phone devices or wire net line equipments for real-time control in some industrial fields such as metallurgy, mine, transferring port. Therefore, the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) monitoring platform system is investigated for these industrial fields in the paper. Using radio frequency (RF) wireless distributed network and the embedded technology, the monitoring platform's module structure has been established. The hardware and software of monitoring system have been analyzed. The configure mode of the wireless monitoring devices has also been given. Using the given control modules, RF wireless transmitting, data acquiring and processing of signals, as well as equipment states diagnosing can be implemented. The research shows that the system platform can solve the communication and monitoring problems in such no cable net line equipments and no mobile phone field-working environments and that the control system given has the characteristic of reliability and flexibility. More ever this system is economic, and is auspicious for further applications.

articleTitle: Parallel Imports in Pharmaceuticals and Social Welfare
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper makes the empirical study on parallel imports in pharmaceuticals and social welfare. It shows that the regime of international exhaustion of IPRs and parallel imports of medicines can facilitate the optimal utilization of global resources and benefit more people in the world. Parallel imports can drive competition and make consumers obtain the pharmaceuticals at lower prices. It can bring health care savings for consumers and health insurance organizations. And no evidence shows that manufacturers' and IPRs holders' profits may be hurt. It can also speed up regional trade integration by improving resources allocation between member states and provide a new approach for developing countries to eliminate significant infectious diseases.

articleTitle: A Measure of Knowledge Sharing in Marketing Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the review of the relevant researches in the field of knowledge sharing and marketing channel, this research analyzed the essence and process of knowledge sharing, developed the framework of knowledge sharing in marketing channel. Knowledge sharing in marketing channel consists of four dimensions: suppliers donating behaviors, distributors donating behaviors, suppliers learning behaviors and distributors learning behaviors. The measures of the framework are tested by the sample collected from the telecommunication industry. The development of the scale can increase operability for knowledge sharing implementing in enterprises. There is correlation between knowledge sharing in marketing channel and the trust of the suppliers and the distributors each other. Finally, the limitation and future research of this study are discussed.

articleTitle: Dynamic Ranging Codes Allocation Scheme in IEEE 802.16e Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16e is a rapidly developing standard with high transmission rates, wide cover ranges, and the ability to support users moving at high-speed. This standard adopts code division multiple access (CDMA) as the multiple access protocol. It utilizes 256-ranging codes and allocates these 256 ranging codes to four types of messages. When the mobile station (MS) is ready to send a message to the base station (BS), it will select a ranging code, among the ranging codes allocated to that message, to transmit to BS. After receiving this ranging code, BS will find out what the corresponding message is by reading the value of this ranging code. BS will then execute the corresponding responses. Although the standard provides parameters to allow the BS to determine the numbers of ranging codes allocated to each message, it does not describe how to determine the number of ranging codes allocated to each message. Therefore, in this paper we will propose a scheme to calculate and allocate the appropriate numbers of ranging codes to these four messages. It was verified by simulations that this proposed scheme can indeed reduce the probability of occurrence of collisions and improve the overall network performance.

articleTitle: Research on Relation between Stock Index Futures and Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The article examines the lead-lag relationship in returns on stock index futures and spot market from the Asia practice; the trading volume change relationship between stock index futures and spot market; the impact of stock index futures on stock price fluctuation. The conclusions drawn are that stock index futures may not enhance the spot market fluctuation. Stock index futures can strengthen the marketplace stability; they can perfect our countries capital market structure and function.

articleTitle: On the Optimal Dividend Problem for the Dual Jump-Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to distribute dividends to shareholders of a company so that the expectation of the discounted dividends can be maximized is a classical actuarial problem. Different from many papers which focus on the insurance company, this paper discusses the optimal dividend problem for another kind of company, which specializes in inventions and discovers and thus has occasional gains and constant expense rate. The reserve of such company is described as a dual jump-diffusion model. We find the optimality conditions under which a barrier strategy is optimal among all admissible policies. Moreover, in the special case that gains jumps come from a compound Poisson process with mixtures of exponential distributions, the optimal policy is proved to take the form of a barrier strategy. Finally, some sensitivity analysis to the model parameters is provided.

articleTitle: Blind Detection and Parameter Estimation of Multiuser and Multipath DS-CDMA Signal Using Cyclostationary Statistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Communication signals are appropriately to be modeled as cyclostationary stochastic processes. The most significant advantage of cyclostationarity is its suppression on the stationary noise and interference. Therefore, cyclostationary theory has been a powerful tool in LPI (Low Probability of interception) signal processing. In non-cooperative condition, blind detection and parameter estimation of DS-CDMA (Direct Spread Spectrum code division multiple access) signals is the first step of PN (Pseudo Noise) codes extraction and information recovery, which has been a challenging problem for a long time and has much theoretical and practical values. The main work of this paper is to deal with multiuser DS-CDMA signals in multipath entironment. Method based on second order cyclostationary statistics was adopted to detect whether the modulated signal exists in background noise. The close formula of SCF (spectrum correlation function) for complex DS-CDMA signals was derived, chip rate can be achieved from the section of SCF where alpha = f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (alpha is the cyclic frequency and f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the carrier frequency ). Simulation results containing the alpha = f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> section and the ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristics) curve have been shown, which proves that the proposed method can achieve good performance even when signals are buried in strong background noise.

articleTitle: The Financial Effects of ISO 9000 Certification for Chinese Firms
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study explores the hypotheses that implementing effective total quality management (TQM ) programs improves the operating performance of Chinese firms. The winning of ISO 9000 certification is used as a proxy for the effective implementation of TQM programs. Changes in various performance measures for a test sample of quality award winners are compared against a sample of control firms. The statistical tests provide evidence that firms that have won ISO 9000 certification outperform the control firms over a six-year period, starting from two years before ISO certification to three years after. Due to the complex nature of performance measurements and limitation of this study, further investigation is still needed.

articleTitle: Competency-Related Pay on a Banding Platform: Creating a High-Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In increasingly global and hyper competitive markets, to relate competencies and pay is a growing trend. This paper analyzes the key elements to link competence to pay. Establishes a model of an integrated approach to using competencies. Takes an example to show why it's difficult to differentiate the ability of different researchers and motivate them by designing appropriate reward mechanism. And summarizes the primary criticism of competency pay.

articleTitle: CMOS Low Voltage Down Conversion Mixer Design
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on traditional Gilbert Cell prototype, a low voltage and low power down-conversion mixer which conclude class AB transconductor is demonstrated in this paper. The RF, LO and IF port frequencies are 2.4 GHz, 2.2 GHz and 200 MHz, respectively. With SMIC 0.13 um process, simulation results show -4.8 dBm of P-1dB compression point and 6 dBm of IIP3 with -10 dBm LO power and IV supply voltage.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Support Chain Visualized Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Now the logistics activities in equipment support are not researched independently as an integrated system. In addition, the management mode and management system are relatively backward. This hinders the development of equipment support. For this, according to the modern advanced logistics theory and visualized management ideas, the concept of Equipment Support Chain (ESC) and the Visualized Management of ESC are put forward and expatiated by reconsidering equipment support. And preliminary research on Equipment Support Chain Visualized Management System is made including ESC information characteristic analysis, visualized model construction, key technologies and architecture of the management system. The research on Equipment Support Chain and its visualized management system can improve the suitability, efficiency and benefit of equipment support, increase the timeliness and scientificity of decision-making and facilitate the equipment support management.

articleTitle: Analysis on Spatial-Temporal Changes of Arable Land and Its Driving Mechanism Based on RS and GIS: A case study of Daye County
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on RS data, statistical data and field survey, the paper analyzed the characteristics of arable land changes in Daye County from 1991 to 2000, and researched its driving mechanism from 3D perspective of natural basic-action mechanism, Socio-economic development-oriented mechanism, groups and individuals' decision-making mechanism. In the process of study, both quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis are used.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Quality and Technology on Chinese Construction Material Exports: 1992-2006
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The gravity model has been used frequently to analyze bilateral trade flows between countries. This paper proposes three gravity models to explore the impacts of quality and technology attributes on the construction material export of China from 1992 to 2006. According to the estimation results, a positive relationship can be found between export unit values and export flows. Moreover, the finding reports that export unit values are positively related to the Chinese construction techniques use to produce them and construction technique has a positive relationship with the construction export trade flow.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on a New Scheduling Algorithm in IEEE802.16 MAC Layer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE802.16, as a wireless MAN broadband access standard, defines a flexible QoS mechanism in MAC layer for wild variety classes of services. However, it dose not define specific admission control strategy and scheduling algorithm, which are becoming the research hotspot in recent years. In this paper, we focus on the features of services defined in IEEE802.16, including UGS, ertPS, rtPS, nrtPS and BE, and develop a new scheduling algorithm adapting these services. Finally, we validate the performance of the algorithm through a simulation experiment on NS2 platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Right Allocation Patterns and the Corporate Performance of Chinese Private Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper concludes 18 control right allocation patterns, and uses descriptive statistics and ANOVA of numerical descriptive statistics to find out that the best control right allocation pattern of Chinese Private Listed Companies with the highest corporate performance is pattern SbCMm.

articleTitle: IISA: An Inter-Cluster and Intra-Cluster Scheduling Algorithm Cluster-Based for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The MAC based on competition doesn't do any contribution in the energy savings, because it will lead to conflict, crosstalk, idle intercept and control expenses in communication. TDMA scheduling system based on the structure of cluster can effectively improve the scalability, save energy and does not increase node costs, but it also brought transmission interference between clusters. We proposed an Inter -cluster and Intra-cluster TDMA scheduling algorithm cluster-based (USA), each round of data collection time is divided by layers along down the data aggregation tree, each cluster node in the pool tree preserves its initial allocation work time and time control of the son tree. Nodes in accordance with their own work TDMA initial time can transmit data without any collision conflict. The simulation results show that, in the larger nodes density circumstances, the performance of USA is better than that of HEED.

articleTitle: Research on Relationship Between Employees' Psychological Contract Breach and its Organizational Effectiveness in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the through review of the past research, this paper firstly explored the construct dimension of organization's obligation in employees' psychological contract with investigation of total 415 employees of SMEs at two samples. The results show four-dimension model: development, transaction, relation and working conditions factors. The correlation analysis identify that psychological contract breach of SMEs' employees will influence organizational effectiveness negatively. And hierarchical regression analysis showed that the transactional factor is most important to the employees in SMEs. Finally the application to human resources management is also discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Application Model of Supply Chain Coalitional Game with Side-Payments Based on Fuzzy Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Considering the fact that is the core of a coalitional game can not exist always and the more realistic situation which is delicate work division in modern production, an application model which can match reality better and is more maneuverable is established based on the fuzzy coalitional game theory and the concept of epsiv-approximate core of deterministic coalitional games with side-payments. The different expressions of the application model in two different conditions are investigated.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resource Management in Multi-Service Mobile Wireless Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a predictive controller based on adaptive resource management techniques for multi-service wireless cellular networks to keep the handoff failure rate (HFR) below a target value regardless of the traffic dynamics and bandwidth requirements of the service types. In this paper, we propose a neural nod feedback algorithm to control the reserved resource. Simulations results indicate that this algorithm can maintain target HFR for any service type even when the traffic load rapidly fluctuates and system parameters vary over a wide range. This algorithm has superior performance in terms of total carried traffic.

articleTitle: A Research of Optimizing Techniques for the 3D Scene Model Based on Creator
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most visual simulation systems are developed based on Vega. They are unable to make smooth operation because of large volume of data. In this paper, some key techniques about how to optimize the 3D scene model are proposed in order to improve the operating efficiency of the visual simulation system. Including simplifying the 3D model, cutting down the data stream of texture, techniques for creator modeling, setting LOD node, Optimizing the hierarchy structure of the database...etc., An experiment show that compared with the original system, the EMS memory of the optimized one is less, the data stream is smaller, and the time to load is shorter.

articleTitle: The Innovation of the Central Bank of Ecuador and its Influence to the Remittance Market Structure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After the Ecuadorian crisis in 1999, the country showed deterioration in the economic, financial, social, and labor sectors. These conditions encouraged a significant number of the unemployed and sub-employed population to make the decision to migrate to other countries. This decision was taken basically in order to find new income sources. According to the Ecuadorian Foreign Affairs Ministry, there are around 2.83 millions Ecuadorians spread around the world who send remittances to their relatives. This made a lot of business for Couriers companies in Ecuador who charged high commissions for this service. Due to this scenario it was important to design structural policies in the finance industry in order to involve the banking system in the remittance process. The Central Bank of Ecuador (CBE) in conjunction with local banks designed a strategy that allowed remittances transfers at a minimum cost. Using information and bulletins from the CBE, market investigations and other's research, the paper describes the effects of the government involvement and financial innovation through the CBE in the Ecuadorian remittance market which was considered an oligopoly market.

articleTitle: System Level Evolutionary Model Based on Agent Study Mechanism and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: When faced with scientific problems, complex adaptive system theory has two obstacles. Firstly, the agent modeling method based on constrained generating procedures lacks foundations for quality solutions. Secondly, it is difficult to apply with echo model because echo model is relatively simple compared with actual problem. Therefore, a new model for complex adaptive system is put forward based on agent study mechanism. The new model lies on three key considerations. The first is that complex adaptive system is hierarchy and has different agents in different levels; the second is that agents have study ability and different agents have different study model; the third is that system evolution results emerge from agents study behaviors. The new model is applied with the study of water resources allocation of the east route of South-to-North Water Transfer Project and three kinds of results are derived.

articleTitle: Using the BSC-AHP-FCA Method to Evaluate IT Performance of Construction Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To evaluate the information technology ( IT ) performance of construction companies, this paper presents a combined method which applies the Balanced Scorecard (BSC), the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and Fuzzy comprehensive Assessment (FCA) methods into measuring the performance improvement resulting from IT by a construction organization. A performance evaluation framework with two tiers (i.e. enterprise and project tiers) is built according to the characteristics of construction enterprises. At each tier, a group of performance indicators and measures are given. The proposed framework applies the AHP to facilitate aggregating the obtained diverse performance measurements, then uses the FCA method to give rise to an overall IT performance improvement score at each tier.

articleTitle: New Thought on Two Phases Inductivity Strategy of China Dairy Products Consumption Base on "Single Stroke, Multiple Wins" Rule
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aims at the problems in process of carrying out nation's "students' milk" plan, this paper firstly brings up the " government voucher of price-lowered milk" plan for both cities and villages. Guided by "administration rule quoted by developed countries", it also brings up the suggestions on government financial subsidy for price-reduced milk Existing researches are all about the necessaries for subsidy without the "how" and "much" questions in depth. This paper carries out the calculation and makes up the blank space of the research.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Cooperation Game of Wintel Alliance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Nash equilibrium point of Microsoft and Intel alliance is (cooperate, cooperate), so the optimal state of the alliance system can be automatically achieved. In static viewpoint, the monopoly profit is the boundary of the negotiation set in one cooperation cycle. In dynamic viewpoint, with the advancement of the technology and the increasing of the demand, the transition of Microsoft and Intel Alliance's negotiation set will be continuous.

articleTitle: Adaptation Combined Spatial Multiplexing and Diversity Techniques for Adaptive MIMO-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) and adaptive antenna grouping (AAG) architecture for multi-input multi-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexed (MIMO- OFDM) system was proposed to effectively eliminate or resist various fading in wireless channels and to offer best tradeoff between transmission reliability and capacity. This combining scheme is not only adaptively to modulate to transmit more information over subcarriers but also adaptively to find the optimal STC/SM grouping scheme according to the estimated SNR. The simulation shows that the BER and throughput performance of the AMC and AAG MIMO-OFDM system outperform the conventional MIMO-OFDM and the AMC MIMO-OFDM system.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Fault Diagnosis Based on ANN for the Short-Wave Radio
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
