abstract: Artificial neural networks (ANN) are an information-processing method of a simulation of the structure for biological neurons. This paper makes a research on the approach of the artificial neural network for fault diagnosis of short-wave radios and constructs a fault diagnosis system of short-wave radios with ANN. And the system can analyze fault phenomena and detect radios fault. It will greatly improve the response to the radio fault diagnosis and maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on Lane-Based Network Model for Regional Emergency Evacuation Routing Plans
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because of the shortcomings existed in traditional node-link model, this paper presents a lane-based network model. The objective of the model is minimizing the whole evacuate cost, and the constraint conditions are eliminating crossing-conflicts, reducing confluence, flow conservation and non-negative, restricting the traffic capacity of the nodes as well as arcs, and so on. The model is aimed to assist traffic decision-makers to utilize the available road infrastructure to the greatest extent through some traffic management and control measures, and also to improve the whole evacuation ability. Finally, after researching the studying algorithm of the model, a mixed- integer programming solver and the software of Lingo are utilized to derive the solution which shows that the model and algorithm both are effective.

articleTitle: Formation and Innovation of Industrial Networks under the Transitional Economy: The Cases from Chinese Old Industrial Regions
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The research about industrial networks need attend to the formation of industrial networks under the transition economy, which is not only the process of interaction of inter-organizations, but also the process of interaction between institution, organization and technology, which is the drive of evolution from the large SOEs to industrial networks. Industrial organization of networking, specialization and conglomeration will accelerate the transformation and renewing of old industrial regions. The paper analyzed the path and types of transformation from SOEs to industrial networks, used the method of double cases study, i.e. bearing industry in Wa Fangdian city and bicycle industry in Tian Jin city, which try to beyond the single cases study by classification and comparison. The empirical research tested the hypotheses of the formation of industrial networks in transitional countries or regions and supposed the recommendations for them.

articleTitle: The Adaptive Scheme and Relationship Between Traffic Load and Optimal Duty Cycle Based on Best Traffic Efficiency in S-MAC
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a classic protocol based on the MAC protocol in wireless sensor networks, the S-MAC protocol has been arousing the people's widespread interests. From the view of energy efficiency and large simulation test, this paper analyses the relationship between traffic load and duty cycle in S-MAC and gets the relationship on known MAX energy efficiency. According to the relationship, this paper proposes the adaptive A-SMAC which can confirm best abundant evaluation based on service flow. It shows that A-SMAC can improve the performance effectively and have good compatibility.

articleTitle: Forward RTO-Recovery (F-RTO) An Algorithm for Detecting Spurious Timeouts with SCTP in Wireless
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SCTP has been found to perform poorly performance in the presence of spurious timeouts (ST) caused by delay spikes which are especially frequent in today's wireless mobile networks. Spurious timeouts cause unnecessary retransmission for several segments and congestion control back-off. There are some proposals for avoiding unnecessary retransmissions after a spurious RTO for require use of SCTP options. We introduce a new SCTP sender algorithm for recovery after a retransmission and show that unnecessary retransmissions can be avoided without SCTP options. The algorithm effectively avoids the unnecessary retransmissions after a spurious RTO, improving the SCTP performance considerably.

articleTitle: The Effect of Media on Applicant Impression Management in Computer-Based Assessment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study investigated the effect of computer-based vs. face-to-face assessment on impression management in different kinds of tasks. Seventy-two 3-person groups of university students worked in either computer-based or face-to-face assessment on both cooperation and competition task. Results showed significant difference between computer-based and face-to-face groups in impression management. Furthermore, this study also found that there is no significant difference between medium when applicant performed in the cooperation task. However, differences in impression management for the competition task, with computer-based groups reporting lower levels of impression management. Results are discussed in terms of the implications of using computer-based assessment for personnel selection.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Key Technology of Improving Transmission Performance and Stability of Information Exchange Platform
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper studies the key technology of improving the transmission function and stability of information exchange platform, relevant technology of realizing function improvement in JAVA, the impact of polling interval of IIP engine upon system transmission rate and relevant technology of improving performance of IIP, and the relation between sending sliced data of varying size and the data transmission rate and so on. The whole technology that has applied to the development and test of large-scale e-administration system has made good application effect.

articleTitle: A Quasi-Two-Dimensional Threshold Voltage Model for Fully Depleted SOI LDMOS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The potential distribution for the channel depletion layer of fully depleted SOI LDMOS was obtained by using quasi- two-dimensional approach, and an analytical threshold voltage model was established. The accuracy of the model is verified by comparison with the results of 2-D semiconductor device simulator MEDICI. From this model, we can find how the channel length, channel doping concentration, the thickness of silicon film and gate oxide influences the threshold voltage. Otherwise, the variation of threshold voltage is independent on back-gate bias.

articleTitle: Probability Model Based Hidden Databases Sampling Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A great portion of data on the Web lies in the hidden databases of the deep Web. These databases can only be accessed through the query interfaces. Efficient and uniform data sampling approach is very important to other research work, for the data samples can give insight into the data quality, freshness and size information in the databases. However, the existing hidden database samplers are very inefficient, because lots of queries are wasted in the sampling walks. In this paper, we propose a probability model based sampling approach to solve this problem. First, we leverage the historical underflow walks to calculate the underflow probability of the attribute values. Based on the underflow probability, we give priority to execute the attribute values with largest underflow probability. The experimental results indicate that our approach can improve the sampling efficiency by detecting the underflow earlier and avoid many wasted queries.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study on the Relationship of Conscientiousness, Justice Perception and Organizational Citizenship Behavior
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Formal Verification and Improvement of a Secure Protocol for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile ad hoc network (MANET) has become an exciting and important technology in recent years because of the rapid proliferation of wireless devices. MANETs are highly vulnerable to attacks due to the open medium, dynamically changing network topology, cooperative algorithms, lack of centralized monitoring and management point, and lack of a clear line of defense. Security is as important in ad hoc networks as it is in more traditional networks like the Internet. Sensitive data should be protected from malicious eavesdroppers and network services should only be provided to eligible users. In this paper, we research the methods of formalization for security routing protocol. Based on BAN like logic to analyze the security of Ad Hoc routing protocols. Considered the character of mobile Ad Hoc network, the BAN like logic was improved to judge the security. Some flaws of the Security-Aware Adaptive Dynamic Source Routing Protocol (SADSR) were found and adapted it.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Freight Market in China Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of China economy, the freight market continues to increase, which is shown by the freight amount rise of roadway, railway, and waterway. Therefore, forecasting accurately the future trend of freight amount has a very important strategic meaning. This paper uses BP neural network method to build the freight market forecast model in China. The predication error is just 0.02~0.04% based on the data of 1994-1996, which shows that the model is feasible and practical. In addition, the paper discusses systematically inside and outside factors of the development of freight market and provides some useful advice from the point of view of macro-economy development.

articleTitle: Partner Cooperation: Based on Relationship Investment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Keeping a good relationship of cooperation between enterprises and suppliers has a strategic meaning to enterprises' innovation in research and development in fierce market competition today. This paper expounds that relationship investment is an effective means to facilitate cooperation between enterprises and suppliers from the viewpoint of enterprises' strategic relationship investment. And it also defines the connotation and components of relationship investment, having given a model of effecting mechanism that relationship investment plays in the process of cooperation between enterprises and suppliers. And through theoretic analysis it further holds that relationship investment can enhance suppliers' trust, satisfaction, and loyalty and raise the barrier of substitute suppliers. And all these will contribute to the realization of lasting cooperation between enterprises and suppliers.

articleTitle: A Load Balance Based Sleep Mode Management Strategy for VoIP Services in IEEE 802.16 Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16 standards define the power saving of class (PSC) II to save energy for voice over IP (VoIP) services. But the system performance, such as throughput and delay, is affected by load imbalance caused by the parameter setting of sleep mode of VoIP users. To solve this problem, we propose a strategy to balance the load. We arrange the sleep cycle of each VoIP user alternately in this strategy. Through the simulation results, we find that the throughput is improved and the delay is decreased largely compared with the conventional strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the N²C² Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper has studied and developed the N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (Neural Network Controlled Communication) Processor applied to RBN (Reverse Baseline Networks).The throughputs of the N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> processor are shown by the simulation results to be better than the conventional algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of Methodology and Theory of Non-Technical Innovation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation theory and TRIZ are widely used in engineering and technique field. It is very difficult to express and solve a non-technical innovation problems without a complete theory system, the innovation is difficult to realize with an existing method. It is possible to develop TRIZ to non-technique field, but the methodology is necessary. With studying of methodology of TRIZ, we proposed the non-technical field innovation theory and constructed the framework for the non-technical innovation problem solving based on developing the theory and technique of TRIZ.

articleTitle: Study on the Optimization Implementation Framework of E-Government Based on Resource Integration
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the organic combination of information technology and government management function, E-government has created a kind of new management fashion and method. In this article, the resource integration idea of E-government including the idea of requirement management and the idea of information resource management are suggested. Then, the advanced management thoughts and methods such as ERP and CRM are introduced into the integration study on the government inner resource and outer service. The optimization implementation framework and its function of E-government are suggested from the inside network and outer network of government. We hope it can accelerate the construction and implement of E-government.

articleTitle: Study on the Trust Degree of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of supply chain in theory and practice, trust among enterprises in supply chain becomes the focus as the basic mechanism to realize cooperation. Based on this, the article, firstly, explains the meaning of trust among enterprises in supply chain, analyses the main affected factors of trust among enterprises in supply chain. Then, it calculates the trust degree of supply chain with fuzzy - synthesis appraise. Finally, it develops a pre-warning mechanism based on the trust degree of supply chain.

articleTitle: Event Region Fault-Tolerant Detection Based on Distributed Weight for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A number of faulty sensors would lead to inaccuracy of event region detection and deterioration of network quality of service in wireless sensor networks. This paper proposed a distributed weighted fault-tolerant algorithm (DWFA) for nodes regular deployment and an optimal fault-tolerant mechanism based on weighted distance (WDOFM) for nodes irregular deployment. Both of them exploit spatial correlations among nearby sensors, and syncretize the total weighted information of dual-neighborhood nodes, so as to conduct effective estimation on the central sensor node. DWFA produces different weights from the respective of danger dissimilarity while WDOFM yields diverse relative weights on the basis of variable distance between nodes. Simulation results demonstrate that both DWFA and WDOFM enable higher detection precision and superior fault-tolerant performance compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis and Checking of Multi-Actor Liveness Rules from Fairness
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Liveness properties are important in model checking. We put forward multi-actor liveness rules based on Lesilie Lamport's TLA (temporal logic of actions) and liveness rules, then prove them, which involve existential or universal quantification under weak and strong fairness., At last we formalize the Internet banking system with TLA+ and check them with TLC. The results show these rules are appropriate.

articleTitle: An Experimental Overlay Network Simulation Platform Based On Object-Event Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An overlay network simulation platform (ONSP) based on object-event scheme is presented in this paper. ONSP provide simulation methods for application-layer overlay network system. It can be used to simulate logistical environment based on wired/wireless mixed fundamental network The platform abstracts components of application-layer network into object models, and expands capability of node and link by inheriting characteristic. The objected-based framework makes overlay network become services resource cluster. We also propose an event strategy to emulate user sessions, which will help to study end-to-end QoS assurance research. Some experiment examples show that, ONSP will provide powerful function for distributed multimedia application, application-layer QoS, and overlay service network.

articleTitle: Research of Production Logistics System in Car Factory Based on Advanced Planning and Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In car factory, each production unit has its own objective so the different goals may be contradictory. It is important to design a production logistics system to meet the change. This paper proposes to apply advanced planning and scheduling (APS) technology to design a coordinated production logistics system. Firstly, this paper analyzes the structure and characteristics of car factory. Secondly, facing the optimistic questions of push/pull hybrid production planning and control model in car factory, this paper constructs a coordinated production logistics system based on ERP, JIT and APS. Lastly, the paper provides an integration framework and the integrated technologies for enterprise information system.

articleTitle: Utilizing Scale Down and Restoration to Reduce PAPR in OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The high peak OFDM signal out of the linear region of the power amplifier is compressed with fixed scale down ratio instead of clipping. The compressed signal is transmitted using the additional subcarrier and can be restored if the tone detector at the receiver indicates the presence of additional subcarrier. This method shows the better BER performance than the normal clipping method. And also the comparison in the view of throughput efficiency shows that the proposed method is better than SLM.

articleTitle: Delay Estimation in DS-CDMA Communication Using Conjugate Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a method for DS-CDMA delay estimation through the use of the downlink channel character. This method is based on Independent Component Analysis using the conjugate descent algorithm to estimate the multi-path mixture matrix and find the delay information which is embodied by the column vector of the mixture matrix using both the independence of information source and the known spread spectrum code. The simulation results show that it has better estimated effect and enhance the performance of traditional detector comparing with MMSE and Fast-ICA algorithm.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of VoIP over WLAN via Packet Segmentation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Today's IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN (WLAN) is an excellent solution for the broadband wireless networking. However, it lacks of the capability to support real-time services such as Voice-over-IP (VoIP) properly. In this paper, a novel link-layer packet segmentation method is proposed to promote the performance of VoIP which do not influence non-real-time application much. In this method the channel utilization is used to decide the factor of the segmentation. This method is verified through simulations.

articleTitle: Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Relative Value at Risk Constraint
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A portfolio optimization with downside risk based on benchmark is investigated. The expected relative terminal wealth is maximized under a new risk constraint, RVaR, which is defined by a relative wealth process. In a Black-Scholes setting, stochastic analysis method and nonlinear programming theory are used to obtain explicit solutions of the optimal strategies, which include the riskless asset, revised market portfolio and benchmark portfolio. The results exhibit three-fund separation theorem. Numerical examples are presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Hardware Platform of WSNs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sensor node in WSNs is basic bottle neck which restricts realization of WSNs, because of their very limited processing, communication ability and power source supply. With the advancement of IC design and fabrication technology, release of microcontroller (MCU) with more powerful processing, lower power consumption and cost is expectable. So this paper introduces a novel sensor node based on 32 bits MCU LPC2138, wireless communication unit of the sensor node is composed of CC2420 which is the first kind of radio frequency chip compatible with IEEE802.15.4. A brief review of sensor node in different stage shows that single chip sensor node is coming true, and more and more 32 bits microcontroller used in WSNs should be a trend. This paper presents design of this sensor node, including processing unit, RF unit, power supply unit and sensor unit, and gives some solutions which avail design process. At last, power consumption measurement of sensor node is done and the results are given.

articleTitle: Joint QoS-Aware Time Slot Assigning and Dynamical Adjusting Algorithms for 802.15.3-Based WPAN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A QoS-aware time slot assigning algorithm and a time slot dynamical adjusting algorithm are proposed in the paper in order to improve the channel utilization and fairness in the IEEE 802.15.3 MAC protocol. The joint algorithms adopt different adjusting scheme for CBR and VBR streams. By using 5 unused bits in the frame header, the joint algorithms can work compatibly with other ordinary 802.15.3 MAC without any modification in the standard frame header. The simulation results show that the joint algorithms can achieve higher efficiency and fairness with a lower overhead compared to existing dynamical time slot adjusting algorithms.

articleTitle: Does Heterogeneous Investment Horizon Effect on CAPM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper study on the multi-period portfolio GPH model. We study on the GPH mean-variance efficient frontier. We show how to realize the GPH linear efficient frontier and prove that the GHP frontier is not efficient. The paper also suggests a stochastic dominance GHP rebalance strategy allow the CAPM holds for each single period.

articleTitle: A Study on Progress Risk of IUR Commissioned R&D Project Based on GERT
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To study the progress risk of IUR commissioned R&D project, this paper identifies progress risk source first, then forecasts the R&D time required in total by constructing GERT network model of R&D flow. In the quantitative analysis, the mason formula is used to compute the transfer function of the GERT, and the moment generating function is used to compute the probability distribution of the R&D time and costs. This analytical solution is used to describe the risk of the commissioned R&D project. An example is given to illuminate how to use this analytical algorithm in the end.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm Based Optimization Technique for Design of On-Chip Antenna for Contact-Less IC Card
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The physical model, design and optimization technique of CMOS compatible on-chip antenna for contact-less IC card are discussed. This paper proposes a genetic algorithm(GA) based optimization technique for the design of on-chip antenna. GA is used to find out the optimal parameters to enhance the loop quality factor, and meet the constraints at the same time. The simulation results demonstrate that GA can improve loop quality when the process condition is fixed, and the technological characters can be optimized to find even better result when the process condition is not fixed.

articleTitle: Study on JIT Distribution System Based on Web for the 3rd Party Logistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Just-In-Time (JIT) distribution is to distribute product or service to the clients according to the needs of the clients on the minimal stock. It ensures the supply of right parts in right quantity in the right place and at the right time. For the construction projects, the JIT distribution of the materials on the construction site is the precondition to realize the lean construction. This paper considered that the 3rd Party Logistics (3PL) is a distribution mode suit for the JIT distribution and the trend of logistics development in the future. Therefore, this paper researched the JIT distribution problem in terms of the 3PL on the basis of web environment. We analyzed the elements of the 3PL distribution system and structured the 3PL distribution system that actualized the mode of combination distribution, and then expounded the general process of the distribution system and how to realize the management to the distribution system.

articleTitle: Business Process Modeling for Software Acquisition: A Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Business process modeling can be used as an effective tool to understand requirements of software acquisition. This paper examines the current literature on the practices and their associated benefits and challenges in making software acquisition decisions with business process modeling, and demonstrates the need for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Commercial Web Sites: An Exploratory Study of Hotels in Mainland China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To establish a valuable Website is a big challenge facing many service firms of China. This research evaluated the hotels' Websites in Mainland China from a functionality perspective. Three categories (state-owned, foreign-funded and private) of hotels were selected separately for study. Content analysis was used to analyze and compare the performance of these hotel Websites in terms of site design characteristics (interactivity, functionality and navigation) and marketing practices on Internet. The results showed that domestic brand hotels were not utilizing the Internet to its full potential and effective e-marketing compared to international brand hotels. Corresponding suggestions for hoteliers and future research were provided in the end.

articleTitle: Establish on Automobile Parts Integrated Logistics Systems and Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper has discussed the results of an integrated logistics systems(ILS) and supply chain management(SCM) model adoption in automobile parts products manufacturing logistics. The integrated logistics systems allows a firm or supply chain to exploit the following revenue enhancing opportunities. It includes offering direct sales to customers, providing 24-hour access from any location, aggregating information from various sources, providing personalization of information, speeding up time to market, implementing flexible pricing, allowing price and service discrimination, facilitating efficient funds transfer etc.

articleTitle: A Confidence Interval Banding Taboo-Level of Data Aggregation Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data sending model in cluster has great impact on life of wireless sensor networks. In this paper, the data sending models were researched and a novel CIBT (Confidence Interval Banding Taboo-level) of data aggregation in cluster was formally described, designed, implemented and evaluated. The algorithm includes two stages. In first stage, the sampling data is used to set confidence interval to compare with total model. In second stage, taboo algorithm is adopted to avoid tandem duplication sampling. The performance of CIBT algorithm is evaluated from different aspects. Simulation results show that CIBT can better handle the energy efficiently and satisfy the desired accuracy given by different users. Comparing with similar methods, CIBT can better prolong network life.

articleTitle: An Approach of the Grey Modeling Based on Cotangent Function Transformation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the method of trigonometric-power function transformation against modeling standardized data is put forward. It has been proved that the smooth degree of data sequence can be improved. This function transformation can greatly improve the smooth degree more than logarithmic function transformation and power function transformation. So the method can widen the range of application of grey modeling. At last, the practical result shows the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A BP Neural Network Diagnosis Based on Fuzzy Classification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper proposed an new diagnosis algorithm of back-propagation combine with fuzzy classify approach. For some complexity environments, the classic BP neural network appear limitation on classify issues. The paper imposed fuzzy model on neural network structure, which using classify variance and energy function to adjust convergence of the network. With the improved nonlinear mapping property, the diagnostical processing, in our experiments, shows perfect results with identify ratio of 100%, while classical experiment is 50% accordingly.

articleTitle: On Measuring Non-Life Insurance Output in China Using the Expectation Approach
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the fantastic development of insurance, insurance accounting has become more important and requests to be improved and perfected continuously. In China the current method to measure non-life insurance output leads to an absurd result because the output of non-life insurance is negative in 2006. This paper reviews the expectation approach and the accounting approach, which were used to improve the estimation methods of insurance output in the System of National Accounts (93SNA), and uses the annual data of Guangdong province in China to estimate the output of non-life insurance. At last, this paper proposes some suggestion on insurance accounting in China.

articleTitle: A Fast Binary Search Anti-Collision Algorithm for Multiple Tag Identification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a fast wireless anti-collision algorithm for radiofrequency identification (RFID) systems. The proposed algorithm introduces a new kind of inquiry round to gain the request prefixes from tags. It also has the advantages of jumping and dynamic searching algorithm (JDS) and prefix-randomized query-tree protocol (PRQT). Analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm needs about 1.2 iterations to identify one tag, consuming 40.0% less iterations than JDS and 47.8% less iterations than PRQT.

articleTitle: Production Scheduling Model and Flexibility of its Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the uncertainty of the environmental factors of production scheduling in enterprise, model and its optimization algorithm with flexible decision mechanism is constructed. Job-shop scheduling problem (JSP) is a NPC problem. On the foundation of modern intelligent algorithm, and embedded Agent function, on-line identification, self-learning, and self-adjustment are realized in scheduling. Its decision efficiency is improved, and the practical application problem of JSP is solved.

articleTitle: Multiparty Game Credit Loan Model with Dual Default Risk
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the interaction of credit loan game. In our model with subjective and objective dual credit risk, multi-channel financial mode, we present game equilibrium relationship of the enterprise, the non-banking financial institution and the bank. Then we give corresponding investment and financing policies, and in detailed explain following problems such as the impact of the enterprise's absolute risk-aversion degree and bank's loan interest on enterprise's income, the relationship between optimal financing structure and moral hazard, loan interest rate. We give each of the optimal strategies under the game equilibrium condition. Then by empirical analysis we explore the root cause for the financing difficult. Finally, we give some policy suggestions for this point.

articleTitle: Correctness of Sampling Bias on Internet Router-Level Topology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the data samples authorized by CAIDA, we analyze the Internet router-level topology. By extracting several features of network property, we found obvious disparity distinction between the comparing results measured by single monitor point and multiple monitor points respectively, which approves that the sampling bias caused by single monitor point take primary effect on the Internet topology. The comparison of specific nodes' degree and its distribution after complement has been performed, and the link distribution between cores give the fitting formula to correct the sampling bias.

articleTitle: A Study on Relationship of Person-Corporate Culture Fit, Organization Commitment and Work Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Work performance is a micro foundation on which organizational performance is built. It is also a focus of organizational behavior researches. It is meaningful for improving employees' efficiency to discuss the relationship between work performance and other organizational variables. This article discusses the relationship among performance , person corporate culture fit and organizational commitment, establishes a model of them finally in order to afford important advice for corporate to improve work performance and strengthen corporate culture.

articleTitle: Functional Orientation of Governmental Informationalization in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The functional orientations provide a guide for the construction of governmental informationalization in China. Based on the scope of organizational boundaries and the direction of information flow, the functional orientations of governmental informationalization in China are divided into four kinds of important types: e-procurement, the integration of governmental information resources, the open of public affair information and e-government. The content of four functional orientations and their operation mechanism are analyzed elaborately. And their managerial implications are proposed eventually.

articleTitle: Analysis of Network Lifetime in Hybrid Sensor Networks with Wired Shortcut
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We investigate the use of limited wires as shortcuts for increasing the lifetime of hybrid sensor networks. The routing strategies and wiring schemes for this hybrid sensor network are designed. Using analysis and simulation, we evaluate the length of network lifetime when varying the network size, cluster size and node densities. The analytical results show that wires can increase the network lifetime significantly. Cluster size is the fatal factor that affects the lifetime of this network, whereas network size and node density of network affect the network lifetime slightly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Regional Disparity of Foreign Direct Investment in China and its Dynamics 1984 -2003
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study of the Repair Strategy of Scale-Free Network Under Durative Attacks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because of the inhomogeneous topology structure of the scale-free network, it was short of security and prone to collapse under attacks. In this paper, we present a repairing strategy under durative attacks, each time it reconstruct the connections of the node which has the highest degree according to a certain ratio, thus, the security of global network is improved. This strategy is an available method to ensure network operations.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Short Range Wireless Communication Performance Using Adaptive Frequency Hopping
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a typical commercial short range wireless communication module which has weak immunity to interference has been tested and its performance has been evaluated with test bed. An adaptive frequency hopping scheme has been proposed to improve its immunity to interference and therefore enhance the wireless communication performance for reliability and delay-critical applications. Such scheme can be easily adopted to similar short range wireless communications.

articleTitle: Model of Allocating the Emission Rights: Based on the Incentive, Fair and Efficient Measure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Environment pollution problems attracted many attention in recent years. How to solve the problems by using the market power is the main study to which the scholars devoted much. In this paper, we have a brief retrospect about the process of permit emission right problems study in which the researchers draw much attention on confirming the price or studying the efficiency of the transaction market. However, we build up a model in which we allocate the emission rights to the users who produce the products to create benefit as well as discharge the pollution to cut down this profit. We try to include the factors of impartiality, benefit, incentive and so on, which could make the distribution more suitable to the society. Following the Stackelberg leader-follower model, we try to describe the real situation by using the incentive measure and at the same time, we do not neglect the fair and benefit factors. At last, we give a simple numerical example to explain this model concretely, and some improved advices are given at the end.

articleTitle: Team Social Capital and its Impact on Team Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: First of all, the structure characteristics and evaluating indexes of the team are analyzed. And then this paper defines team's internal social capital on the framework of definition of social capital which Ghoshal made, and defines team's middle social capital on the framework of the position of team on network inside the organization, and defines team's external social capital on the framework of relations with external entities. Finally, the impact of the internal/middle/external social capital on team performance is discussed respectively.

articleTitle: Mobile Data Management Model Based on Service Ontology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with the development of mobile communication systems, it is important to integrate massive heterogeneous data and provide flexible and seamless services. Based on related work, we proposed a novel mobile data management architecture model combined with ontology, service and agent. We discussed the architecture of this model, analyzed the key technologies, and pointed out the existent issues. At last we made a conclusion and put forward future work. The model MDMMBSO can provide mobile data service effectively, integrate heterogeneous distributed data, manage mobile data and provide business interface in a unified form. Furthermore, it can be reasonable and feasible to provide a seamless mobile data management.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Synthetical Evaluation on Model of Core Enterprise's Core Competence in Knowledge Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article analyzes the characteristic of core enterprise's core competence in knowledge chain based on describing the core competence, then it brings forward the evaluation index system of the core enterprise's core competence. Then builds up the evaluation model used analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy mathematic. Finally, a simulation is carried out to illustrate the feasibility and validity of the method.

articleTitle: A Complex Adaptive Supply Chain Framework Based on Message Transfer
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Complex adaptive system (CAS) approach is effective for modeling supply chain system with structural and behavioral dynamics. This paper proposes a complex adaptive supply chain framework based on information message transfer in terms of the forming mechanism of supply chain. The dynamical growth of the whole network is simulated: isolated nodes randomly distributed in the environment build connections by sending messages to each other; each node decides how to build connection based on priority degree of nodes. This framework forms a complex adaptive supply chain network which will adapt the dynamic environment quickly and optimally from bottom to top. The simulation results that illustrate the superiority to the random framework are also given.

articleTitle: Technology Gaps: A New Index of Technology Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Technology gaps can be used to measure the technology heterogeneity or the difference in technology and production techniques employed by different firms. In this paper the gap between the metafrontier and the firm-specific frontier is defined to be this new index. In order to obtain the production frontier and the index for each firm, the varying coefficients regression model is used on the reproduced input-output data, which is shown to be an approximate piecewise Cobb-Douglas. Then the proposed method is applied in the analysis of panel data on Chinese 33 industries from 2000 to 2003, and the result shows that the difference of technology gaps between industries is quite considerable in China.

articleTitle: A Novel Quasi-4PPM Modulation for UWB Systems with Corresponding Synchronization Scheme
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel quasi-4PPM modulation is presented firstly for UWB systems, and then the corresponding synchronization and demodulation schemes are proposed. Due to the nature of the unique signal structure, the information bits are transmitted and demodulated by twos, which doubles the transmission efficiency compared with conventional existing methods under the same condition. Besides, the blind synchronization and noncoherent demodulation have dispensed with the training sequence and local template, which ensures the high throughput and the low complexity. Simulations are performed to demonstrate the promising performance of the presented algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Remote Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis System for Equipment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the techniques of power electronics, fault diagnosis and network, a remote monitoring and fault diagnosis system with combination of a three-layer C/S structure and Internet is presented, which achieves with high compatibility between different equipment. Furthermore, the paper focuses on the discussion about the structure of compatibility between systems, the compatibility design of remote monitoring and the realization of field control equipment, such as the data collection sub-system, the real-time monitoring sub-system, the fault diagnosis sub-system and the data disposal and management subsystem, and the design of the data transferring sub-system and the data disposal and management sub-system, and the design of the data transferring sub-system and the communication protocol format.

articleTitle: Industry Ecosystem Development at the Firm Level: A Case Study of Nanning Sugar Group in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to give a deep analysis on the strategy pathway of the industrial ecosystem development, this paper takes the Nanning Sugar Group, a Chinese sugar complex, as a case to study. On the basis of a brief introduction of the concept of industrial ecosystem, the paper describes the Nanning Sugar Group and its ecosystem model. After summarizing experiences of the application of the Group's model, it analyzes challenges and then introduces possible solutions. Some conclusions are developed on the basis of this analysis.

articleTitle: Robust H-Infinity Filtering on Stochastic Uncertain Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is concerned with the problem of robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> filtering on stochastic uncertain systems subject to parameter uncertainties in both state matrix and output matrix of the state space model. The parameter uncertainty is assumed to be time- varying norm-bounded The aim is to design a filter by auxiliary systems, which ensures both the robustly stochastic stability and prescribed level of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> performance for the filtering error dynamics for all admissible uncertainties. The derivation process is simplified by introducing auxiliary systems and the sufficient condition and necessary condition are obtained for the existence of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> filter. During the study, the main results were expressed as LMIs by employing various matrix techniques. Using LMI toolbox of Matlab software, it is very convenient to obtain the appropriate filter. Finally, a numerical example shows that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Disintegration and Future Telecom Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Telecom world is changing rapidly. Traditional telecom companies used to be vertically integrated based on silo approach. Internet Protocol (IP) has revolutionized the telecom network providing uniform interface and a separation between infrastructure and services. Next Generation Networks are built around this separation. In these networks service creation will be independent of the infrastructure making it fast and economical. Technological advances are forcing disintegration of telecom companies at vertical level and integration at horizontal level. Telecom market is evolving towards a collection of companies working in different segments of the value chain. Service market is going to fall apart from the infrastructure segment. Such a service market will not only be feasible but also economically efficient. The future is a service market with more focused niche players doing business in a completely competitive manner and an access market having limited players.

articleTitle: An Adaptive N-Stage Markov Chain Combined Model for Collaboration Trust Maintenance in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Collaboration trust in supply chain is one of the necessary factors to improve the whole efficiency of supply chain. This paper presents a comprehensive model for collaboration trust maintenance in supply chain, integrated adaptive N-stage Markov chain. The lifecycle of collaboration trust is divided into six stages including expedition, conformation, growing, stabilization, degeneration, and dying from a dynamic viewpoint. The transferring process of collaboration trust is interpreted with Markov chain. This paper improves the efficiency of collaboration trust maintenance by numerical example using an adaptive n-stage Markov chain. The result shows that the model combined with n-stage Markov chain for collaboration trust is superior at high effect level.

articleTitle: Reducing of Peak-to-Average Power Radio of OFDM System with Pseudorandom Sequence
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new method for reduction peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems is proposed in this paper. The PAPR characteristics are analyzed. From the foundation of the analysis, a pseudorandom sequence matrix is adapted to reduce aperiodic auto-correlation of the transmitting sequence. Simulation results verify the improved performance of PAPR using this approach. The method is simple, low complexity and it is easier to combine the method with other PAPR reducing technique so as to further reduce the PAPR in OFDM system.

articleTitle: Performance of Antenna Selection Algorithm Based Cost Function for MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, two novel antenna selection algorithms based cost function for multiple-input multiple- output (MIMO) wireless system are introduced, which are named Increasing selection Based Cost Function (IncBCF) and Decreasing selection Based Cost Function (DecBCF), respectively. The proposed antenna selection algorithms are only considered at the receiver, which aim at maximizing channel capacity. Through the simulation results, it can be seen that the DecBCF algorithm obtains almost the same capacity as the optimal selection algorithm while retaining lower computational complexity. Further more, the results show that the proposed algorithms provide better performance than the existing suboptimal antenna selection algorithms.

articleTitle: Product Development Processes Management Based on Design Structure Matrix (DSM) Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The design and development of complex products require the efforts and collaboration of hundreds of participants from diverse backgrounds resulting in complex relationships among both people and tasks. One method for reducing both time and cost is to develop an understanding of the flow of the product development processes and the effects of the iterative subcycles that are found in complex product development processes. Once these aspects are understood, the manager can make decisions that take advantage of decomposition, concurrent engineering, and parallel processesing techniques to reduce the total time and the total cost of the design cycle. One tool that can aid in this decision-making processes is the design structure matrix(DSM). This article will show how the tool works and how you can use the DSM to improve the management of complex product development projects using partitioning algorithms.

articleTitle: A Scalable Streaming Media Secure Communication Protocol Based on Bi-Direction Authentication
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a communication protocol of streaming media to ensure secure live transferring of scalable quality video programs over network. In our protocol, client, authentication server and video server collaborate for authentication, generation of session keys and transferring of encrypted streaming media. Bi-direction authentication is carried out by bi-direction challenge method and method base on public-key cryptography. Perfect forward secrecy is provided by adoption of Diffie-Hellman key exchange steps.

articleTitle: Research on the Emergent Management of Disaster Crisis and its Grey Relation Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper discusses the form of geological disasters and triggered crises in Wanzhou district of the three-Gorge reservoir area, probes into the major achievement and successful measures of natural disaster emergent management in the U.S., and concludes that China has owned the complete emergent organizing management and command system, improved the rescue and secure system for emergent project, coordinated mutual support system, agile supply system, as well as experienced emergent rescue team in natural disaster emergent management. It gives the examples of the ten typical landslide disasters in Wanzhou district of the three-Gorge reservoir Area can well-illustrate, and through interviews and research of experts, this paper establishes grey relation model of the three-Gorge reservoir area in Wanzhou district where there is a cyclic crisis chain of social stability-property loss-project time extended, a two-way acyclic crisis chain of land loss - ecological destruction-traffic congestion-safety-political event, and a acyclic crisis chain of panic - land loss. In the end, this paper proposes the idea that the focus on the emergent work of Wanzhou district of the three-Gorge reservoir area shall include the detailed regulations and resolutions of disaster crisis emergent management, the improving efficiency of disaster crisis emergent management, and the early-warning programs of disaster crisis emergent management.

articleTitle: Call Admission Control for Multiservice Radio Access Network Using Mechanism Design
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, in order to guarantee QoS of CAC for four classes of new calls (i.e., conversational service, streaming service, interactive service, and background service with distinct QoS requirements are considered , which defined by 3GPP). We first propose a mechanism design framework based on VCG mechanism for CAC, we model the CAC problem as a game played among four classes of new calls. Importantly, the call admission control game is coordinated by an admission Moderator in base station (BS) or access point (AP), which deploys a novel call admission control based on the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism, the VCG mechanism also ensures the users truthfully declare their call admission request by charging them for the used channels in the cell. The simulation result indicate that the CAC based on VCG mechanism can decrease the new call blocking probability, guarantee QoS of different types services, enhance flexibility and control in meeting QoS constraints, and results in better overall performance.

articleTitle: Differentiated Traffics Network Selection Algorithm for IMT-Advanced System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In face of heterogeneous RATs coexisting in next generation communication system, the network selection is related to Cooperative Radio Resource Management (CRRM) and QoS requirements of traffics and users' preference etc to give the best choice for the users. Based on the proposed MAC layer architecture which set Cooperative RRM manager, in this paper the Differentiated Traffics Relative Band Request (RBR) - based algorithm-DTRA is proposed, which is not only a low complexity, centralized network selection scheme aiming to optimally distribute the end users to the networks of the heterogeneous wireless system in the sense of maximizing the global spectrum efficiency, but also considers the priorities of various traffics to decrease the loss rate of real-time traffics.

articleTitle: Contracts-Based Research on Competition Between Symmetric Products' Manufacturers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is common for a retailer to sell products from competing manufacturers. How then should the firms manage their contract negotiations? Different from market structures researched before, contracts serve as a tool for competition tools rather than coordinating the whole supply chain in our paper. We study our models between competing manufacturers who sell symmetric products, and a common retailer facing stochastic demand. We allow the manufacturers to compete for the retailer's business using one of two types of contracts, a wholesale-price contract, a buyback contract. We find that some key conclusions of our settings are inconsistent in other market structures discussed before. We show that in our market structure the buyback contract forces the manufacturers to compete more aggressively than when they only offer wholesale- price contracts, and this may leave them worse off and the retailer substantially better off.

articleTitle: Research on Assessment of Logistics Service Quality Based on Fuzzy TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is significant to appraise service quality of logistics enterprises. In this paper, based on analysis impact factors for service quality of logistics enterprises, we proposed a set of assessment indexes, given the method of determining the assessment indexes weights using fuzzy AHP, and put forth a comprehensive assessment model based on TOPSIS. Finally, a numerical example shows that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: The Double Helix Model on Human Resources Management of High & New Tech SMEs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After high & new tech SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) walk out their start period, they perhaps suffer pains of pullulation in growth stage. This paper analyzes some problems which they are faced with in their growth. Through an empirical analysis on human resource demand of high & new tech SMEs, this paper deems that the root of "pains of pullulation" is the lack of excellent human resources, especially R&D personnel. Therefore, this paper sets up a double helix model to illustrate how can SMEs overcome these difficulties and grow up. Furthermore, this paper puts forward some helpful countermeasures, such as perfect HRM system, draw human resource plan, improve personnel recruiting job, reinforce enterprise study atmosphere and employee training, establish long range incentive mechanism through stock option, care for knowledge type employees, etc.

articleTitle: Effects of Producer Service on the Added Value of Manufacturing Industries: An Empirical Research of Different Industries in Various Countries
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article makes an analysis in the mechanism that how producer service promotes the added value of manufacturing industries. Producer service is regarded as an important source of scare factors for value creation in manufacturing. Therefore, the rapid development of producer service leads to cost cut and efficiency promotion in manufacturing industries. Added value rate is then chosen as the measurement to the influence of producer service on manufacturing. An empirical research is made based on data from China, the Czech Republic, France, Japan, South Korea, Norway, the United Kingdom and the United States. It shows that more producer service is used as an input, higher rate of added value can a manufacturing industry gain from it.

articleTitle: Power Allocation Algorithm in Amplify-and-Forward Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the problem of power allocation in the amplify-and-forward (AF) cooperative network is investigated based on the achievable maximum signal-to-noise ratio at the destination node. With assumptions that the source node has the perfect channel state information, optimal power allocation algorithms are developed for the relay networks under two scenarios: the full cooperative scheme with direct transmission (DT) from source node to destination node and relay cooperative scheme without DT. With the proposed optimal power allocation algorithm, simulation results demonstrate that the performance of AF relay networks can be significantly improved.

articleTitle: Effective Implementation of Spatial Topological Operations Based on Anticlockwise Triangle
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a new approach to implement spatial topological operations for GIS data, which is based on anticlockwise triangle. Since the spatial topological operations of triangles are much easier to develop, so we first divide the vector- based GIS data into a set of non-intersected anticlockwise triangles, and then implement spatial topological operations for common GIS data through the sets of anticlockwise triangles. We first present a smallest set of 2-D spatial topological operations, and then the triangulation algorithm for a region is discussed, as well as the spatial topological operations of triangles, based on which the algorithms for spatial topological operations on points, lines, and regions are defined. Finally, the implementation of the spatial topological operations in a spatiotemporal database extending module is discussed. The querying experiments show that the anticlockwise-triangle-based approach works effectively.

articleTitle: Indirect Financial Solution of Small and Medium Enterprises Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With supply chain as the entry point, three credit modes of indirect financing to small and medium enterprises based on supply chain are proposed in this paper, according to status and characteristics of small and medium enterprises in supply chain. Research is carried out on the operational procedures, products and parameters of these modes, and proposals are made on how to ensure the effective operation of these modes through the adjustment of business philosophy, and renovation of ideas on products research and development.

articleTitle: Cross-Component Power Management in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) consists of tiny nodes with sensing, actuating, computation, wireless communications capabilities. Because of node's limited energy, many routing, topology control, media access control (MAC) protocol have been specially designed. This paper discussed power management of topology control, media access control protocol and routing protocol in wireless sensor network. Based their relationship, we proposed cross-component power management in wireless sensor network to improve management efficiency.

articleTitle: Achieving Fair Performance by Power Allocation in Opportunistic Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We consider a wireless opportunistic network where one of the lucky users gets the opportunity to utilize the whole radio resource. However some of unlucky users keep silent during an unexpected time resulting from serious wireless environment. In this paper we propose an opportunistic cooperation protocol that can achieve equal performance measured in terms of outage probability, in which scheme the opportunistic user helps to relay what need retransmitting indicated by the destination and selects the appropriate power allocation to pursue fairness. We utilize superposition coding and successive interference cancellation at relay and destination, respectively. To improve the spectral efficiency we give a modified cooperation architecture involving two opportunistic users which work in turns. The simulation results have proved that the protocol obtains better performance compared with the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Real-Name Access Mechanism in the Next Generation Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Pollution Externality, Endogenous Labor Supply and Environmental Policy Choice
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By developing an endogenous growth model on the base of Lucas (1988) embodying the endogenous labor supply and pollution externality, this paper aims to examine the interaction between negative pollution externalities, endogenous leisure- labor choice, human capital investment and sustainable development. Within this framework, we first study the optimum in the planned economy and derive the conditions under which the sustainable growth path is both feasible and optimal. Furthermore, we show that an increase in the productivity of human capital sector, in the abatement expenditure elasticity of pollution damage reduction and in environment consciousness will stimulate the long-run growth rate. But a rise in leisure consciousness and in the output elasticity of pollution damage incremental will lower the long-run growth rate. Finally, it is also revealed in our model that a government could intervene and bring the market economy onto a sustainable and optimal growth path through conducting public abatement policies or levying Pigouvian taxes.

articleTitle: The Study on the Choice of Multinational Enterprises Organization Structure Based on MNL Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper develops and tests a model of the structure choice of multinational company. The model is built under the framework of the contingency, integration-responsiveness, and organizational economics. Under the assumption that both the multinational company and its managers make decisions on the basis of their self- interests, this model combines above three frameworks. The model looks the exposition of knowledge-based resources as a key determinant of multinational company structure. The model is tested on a sample of 80 multinational companies using a multivariate regression approach. The results confirm the role of knowledge-based resources in influencing multinational company structures.

articleTitle: A Multifunctional Grid-Algorithm-Base with Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Grid computing is a new arising technology which gets computer from different locations to work together with various data resources. Because of its high capability, grid has contributed to a plenty of areas. When computing for a special objective, typically a series of algorithms are needed. As conventional algorithm bases were built for just specific areas, a multifunctional grid-algorithm-base (MGAB) providing a suite of kernel algorithms is proposed in this paper. In this base, each algorithm is deployed as an individual grid service. A predefined execution of a sequence of available algorithms/grid services is controlled by a workflow engine which serves as a means of orchestration of services composed into workflows described by the BPEL standard language. Based on the grid, equipped by an appropriate workflow engine, the sequence of algorithms will be executed easily and fluently. Non-invasive glucose measurement is the first application of the MGAB, which shows that this approach is very efficient. In the future, more and more applications in numerous fields can benefit from the MGAB.

articleTitle: Automatic Passenger Train Water Supply System with Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With wireless communication technology and modularization design strategy, a novel automatic passenger train water supply system is proposed. Three combination schemes of the proposed system is expatiated, and the design principle, working principle and wireless coding and decoding circuits of the corresponding remote control solenoid valves module, portable remote control module, sensors and special connector module are presented one by one. The application effect and the further research project are finally presented as a conclusion.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and Realization of Security Guarantee System of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Model of Enterprise Strategic Risk Assessment: Based on the Theory of Multi-Objective Fuzzy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to use the Analytic Hierarchy Process to build up a model on identifying the strategic risk. The new model is based on Baird and Thomas' Contingency model which is in accord with the strategic management of the traditional mode of thinking. At the same time, on the basis of systematology we use the multi-objective fuzzy optimization theory as strategic risk measurement methods, to enable the enterprises from the perspective of the overall strategy to identify and measure strategic risk, to determine or measure the quantity of risk of strategic management.

articleTitle: Measuring the Impact of Entrepreneurial Competencies on Development: A Study of Private Manufacturing Businesses in Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper examines the empirical impact of private entrepreneurial competencies on business development by drawing upon the resource-based view (RBV) of the firm and the theory of core competence. Data are collected via questionnaire from 400 private manufacturing businesses in Wuhan, China and the main methodology used is LISREL (Linear Structural Relations). The convergent LISREL model shows: (1) As a set of rare resources, private entrepreneurial competencies have made the direct contribution to business success; (2) Private entrepreneurial competencies indirectly affect business success through promoting the formation of core competence of the business.

articleTitle: Modeling BitTorrent System in a Network Circumstance with Bottleneck Links
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: BitTorrent file-sharing is one of the most prevalent P2P applications. An improved fluid model is proposed in this paper. It can be used to analyze the evolution of peers and predict the average file download delay of BitTorrent system in a network circumstance with bottleneck links which previous works seldom focus on. The main contribution of this model is that the underlying network structure is also added into modeling consideration and the estimate results are closer to the practical BitTorrent system than the simple fluid model in a network circumstance with bottleneck links. Experimental results based on simulation are also given out to validate the correctness and availability of this model.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Model of the Entrepreneurial Opportunity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper sponsored by the NSFC 70702020, summarized previous opportunity recognition literature with two main approaches. According to the integrated approach, the authors provided a new comprehensive model of the entrepreneurial opportunity recognition characterized as one sort of entrepreneurial innovation process. Four stages comprised in the new model were described in details. In the end, several contextual factors were mentioned in order to increase the holistic validity of the model.

articleTitle: 802.11-Based Multihop Ad Hoc Network Implementation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By far most of the experiments on ad hoc network research have been done by using simulators. Although easier than a real implementation, simulation can not yet reflect the real network environment entirely. Hence, in-depth research on ad hoc network requires a real implementation. To date, some Linux-based ad hoc network implementations have been proposed. In this paper, we present a multi-hop wireless ad hoc network implementation on Windows system based on 802.11 single-hop ad hoc mode. In the implementation we have adopted ad hoc on-demand distance vector (AODV) protocol as the routing protocol. In this paper, we first introduce the background, and then analyze the key implementation problems we have faced. Aiming at those key problems we propose a design framework based on NDIS intermediate driver and discuss some key techniques to solve them. Finally, some experiment results on our implementation was demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Field-Based Semantic P2P Overlay Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper puts forward a field-based semantic P2P overlay network model. We applied the field theory to the overlay network construction. In the process of overlay construction, peers with identical semantic resources were connected together to form an equipotential line. The whole overlay network consisted of a certain amount of equipotential lines. In the process of query routing, the model would purposefully route the query to identical or similar equipotential lines according to the query semantic information. Then, only the peers on these equipotential lines would respond to the query. Results of simulated evaluation have shown that field-based semantic P2P overlay network could improve recall, accelerate query routing process, and reduce the number of messages in the network.

articleTitle: Factor Analysis of Enterprise Performance Based on Complex Science Management and Synergetics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Enterprise is a kind of complex systems and enterprise operation is the process of complex system operation, which involves many factors such as enterprise resources, the operation mode and the external environment of enterprises. The factors affecting the performance of enterprises are analyzed based on the theory of complex science management and synergetics. The theoretical analysis indicates that the integration model of enterprise resources is the key factor of enterprise performance, which is a slow variable and the main order parameter in the enterprise system evolution process. The self-organization model of system elements related to the initial system state has a great influence on enterprise operation performance, which is the minor order parameter.
