publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In 2005, Sui et al. proposed two separable and anonymous identity-based key issuing schemes, but the impersonation attack is proposed to show that Sui et al. 's second protocol is not free from the key-escrow problem. In order to solve such problem, Feng Cao et al. proposed an improved scheme in 2006. However, in the paper, we find that Feng Cao et al. 's scheme is still vulnerable to the impersonation attack. According, the current paper first shows the weakness of Feng Cao et al's improved scheme, and then proposes our improvement which reaches the goal of avoiding key escrow problem and enhances efficiency.

articleTitle: A Parameter Estimation Method for Graph Based Semi-Supervised Classification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Semi-supervised learning have been successfully applied in many applications by the use of unlabeled data to help labeled data in classification. In recent years, graph based semi- supervised learning approaches show great promising. However, the performance of these approaches depends heavily on some estimated parameters for the affinity weight matrix of the graph. We propose a path based maximum effective similarity (MES) method which can estimate parameters according to the path between data points along some low dimensional manifold in feature space. Experimental results show the significant improvements in performance over the existing graph based approaches.

articleTitle: The Electric Power Enterprise CSI Study and Upgrade Strategy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the requirements of the State Grid Corporation's document and the local actual situation, this paper establishes the customer satisfaction evaluation indicator system. And it has carried on investigation in an area, and carried on the analysis of the investigation result. It proposes an appropriate customer satisfaction index structural equation model, and uses Amos software obtaining the CSI of the customers in this area. In order to enhance the customer satisfaction Index and make the enterprise keeping sustained development, this paper proposes some upgrade strategies.

articleTitle: The Research on Formation Process of Business Incubation Network Based on Games Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper theorizes a stabile and compressive mutual mode between the membership of business incubation network, and successfully simulates the incubation process based on Game theory. In the model, we analyzed the business incubation network not only specifies the playing partners but, crucially, also determines how relevant strategic information diffuses or new cooperation opportunities are found over time and incubatees interact according to a collection of infinitely repeated Prisoner's Dilemmas played on the current business incubation network under the condition. The results of research indicated that the underlying payoffs of incubation network units randomly change, display some volatility, which leads units to react by creating new links and more effective trade mode in the business incubation network.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Production Scheduling of Semiconductor Probing System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In view of semiconductor probe system's production scheduling problem, with the thought of object-oriented, a probe behavior model is set up in terms of the figuration of UML which is a model tool. It uses the SimTalk brought by EM-plant to transform behavior model directly into simulation model. By analyzing the experimental result of simulation model, the influence of the wafer releasing speed and machine dispatching upon system performance indicators such as system capability, production cycle, utilization of machines and quantity of work in process are got. It supplies the decision maker with evidence.

articleTitle: Research on Semi-Cooperation Game and Strategy Choice of Shenzhen Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this essay the author analyses the competition on Shenzhen container ports; compares the efficiency difference between non-cooperation and cooperation game; studies the cooperation originating mechanism through semi-cooperation game theory and conversion of game structure; and analyses the stochastic stability of semi-cooperation game equilibrium path; at last concludes a strategy solution to Shenzhen port Agglomeration Semi-cooperation based on competition essence of semi-cooperation game.

articleTitle: The Effects of Market Weights on Betas and Cost of Capital
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzing the case of Sinopec, we study the relationship of beta between market weight of the listed companies and the beta of the residual portfolio. The result shows that the market weight and the cost of capital changes in the same way. But the relation of the market weight and the beta of the residual portfolio changes in a reverse way. The market weights influence the beta, and lead to a reduction in estimates of the cost of capital for small cap firms.

articleTitle: A Fast Equalizer Algorithm Based on an Array Pattern Synthesis Technique
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel adaptive equalizer algorithm is proposed based on an array pattern synthesis algorithm, which provides a fast convergence speed with low complexity. By incorporating an interference suppression mechanism in the iterative procedure, the algorithm is able to achieve a performance that is very close to that of RLS algorithm. The proposed algorithm is demonstrated through computer simulation.

articleTitle: The Influence on Value Driver of Customer Equity Exerted by Culture Factor
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research on customer equity has already become a hot spot in marketing field. Marketing scholars have carried out studies on customer equity drivers, measurement and promotion widely and deeply. However, the research results from cultural influence on customer equity drivers are rare. In this paper, value driver of customer equity and culture element are analyzed and the differences in value driver between Chinese and American typical culture patterns are discussed. On the basis of theoretical analysis, research hypotheses about the influence on value driver exerted by culture factors are proposed, in addition to which an empirical research is carried out in the mobile communication market in China and America. The log linear model is used to analyze the result of investigation. This achievement will provide theoretical basis for cross-culture customer equity management and it will lay a foundation for further study.

articleTitle: Study on the Formation Mechanism of the Synergetic Marketing Force System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper, on the basis of proposing the concept of synergetic marketing force system, has an analysis of the characteristics, the components of Synergetic Marketing Force System (SMFS). Then, the article researches the internal and external factors which influence the Formation of SMFS. It has made an in-depth exploration on the causes of the formation of the system from different respects, on this basis the paper constructs the generation path model, and reveals the formation mechanism of the system.

articleTitle: Study about Dynamic Abstract Algorithm of Search System on Website
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced several abstract algorithms and analysed the existed problem, which the keyword's position was not enough considered in Lucene software package. Then this paper developed the dynamic abstract algorithm in Lucene software package. The new algorithm referred to the keyword's position in the content. The new abstract is exact. By testing, the developed algorithm is more effective.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Dynamic Coordination under Reference Effect
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduced reference effect into supply chain composed with manufacturers and retailers, and built the game-theoretical model to decide the optimal discount price and order quantity. Considering the situation where the market demand is affected by spot price and reference price, we adopted dynamic programming and classical variation method to analyze the dynamic game equilibrium between manufacturer and retailer under reference effect is symmetric information and not, respectively. Finally, this paper analyzed the effect the reference to price, order quantity and profit of manufacturer with data analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive Sub-Carrier and Bit Allocation Algorithms for Multi-User OFDM Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-user orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) with adaptive sub-carrier and bit allocation are considered in this paper. Assuming having the knowledge of the instantaneous users' channel gains, three typical dynamic sub-carrier and bit allocation algorithms are analyzed and compared. All the algorithms' goal are to minimize the total transmit power with the user data rate constraint. Here, an improvement method is proposed for Zhang algorithm. Finally, performance comparisons between adaptive schemes and static ones are given. The results prove that adaptive algorithms' performances are greatly better than that of the traditional fixed sub-carrier allocation method.

articleTitle: Corporate Diversification Discounts: Asymmetric Information and Investment Misallocation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper builds a basic model of studying diversified corporation discounts from information asymmetry in internal capital market. Divisional managers exaggerate the project information to corporate headquarter, which lead to misallocation investment resources and harm corporate value. By using Chinese listed firms as study sample, this paper testifies the proposition of the model.

articleTitle: Rijndael Arithmetic Analyse and Optimize
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the expert encrypting standard Rijndael arithmetic acquiring the extensive support and application in every walk of life, the problems of the safety and quick implement of the Rijndael arithmetic seem to be particularly outstanding. This paper carried on an analytical research to the Rijndael arithmetic, which can carry out to crack to that arithmetic in validated time; through several transform rounds, the encryption arithmetic to achieve rate is not high . This paper carried on optimize to the S-boxes and transform round, and enhanced the security strength and efficiency of the algorithm; finally, verified this paper to give of optimize methods.

articleTitle: Study on Location Selection of National Economy Mobilization Logistics Center Based on Fuzzy-Grey Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The location selection of logistics center is an investment decision-making issue with strategic meaning in the national economy mobilization logistics system. Based on correlative literature, this paper establishes the index system of location selection of logistics center, and then constructs the model of location selection of national economy mobilization logistics center based on combination of fuzzy set theory and grey analysis. The ability sequence is determined according to each location's relative approximation. We can select the one which has the highest ability if there are several positions to choose when constructing the mobilization logistics center.

articleTitle: Analysis of Two-Step Frequency Offset Estimators for OFDM
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conventional two-step carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimator using L identical parts is analyzed. It turns out that the conventional two-step CFO estimator is not optimal in terms of MSE. A novel two-step CFO estimator is proposed in this paper. In fist step, a fine estimate is obtained based on the principle of minimum variance. The fine estimation has ambiguity since its estimate range is limited. In second step, a coarse estimation is obtained which results in a larger estimate range but less precision. Using the coarse estimation, the ambiguity of fine estimation is resolved. Finally, the fine estimation resolved the ambiguity and the coarse estimation are optimally combined to improve the estimate performance. Analysis and simulation results demonstrate that the novel two- step estimator outperforms the conventional two-step estimator in terms of estimate performance and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Joint Source Coding and Channel Estimation for Video Transmission Over Wireless LAN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose a mechanism in which the feedback channel state information (CSI) can be sent to the rate control unit for adapting the encoding rate and doing the selective ARQ at the transmitter periodically. We consider a general framework for the real-time transmission of video data over a channel subjected to random burst packet losses. It is an intuitively appealing result that the rate for the encoded video is changed smoothly with the channel capacity when the channel conditions is time-varying, so we can get a proper quality video.

articleTitle: Residual Energy Extraction Using Centralized Scheduling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks consist of small size, low cost, low power sensor nodes. Due to its limited power source, energy consumption has been concerned as the most critical factor when designing sensor network protocols. Facing this challenge, several approaches to prolong lifetime of the sensor networks, including scheduling where active nodes provide essential k-coverage have been investigated. Here we use centralized scheduling scheme in which the base station determines and issues the scheduling decisions. To extend the network lifetime and to extract the useful energy further from the network, we go for compromise in the area covered by nodes.

articleTitle: The Factors of the Urban System Influenced Post-Development of the Olympics' Venues
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Post-development of the Olympics' venues is a big challenge which the Games host cities should face with the continuous development of the Olympic Games. Based on the interactive mechanism between the urban system and the Olympics' venue projects, as well as the demand theory, with the relevant statistic materials of the recent Games host cities in the Games year, this paper explores the factors of the urban system which influence post-development of the Olympics' venues, meanwhile, applies two methods of ward cluster analysis and It- mean cluster analysis to verify the validity of the factors, per capita GDP, population, ratio of the service industries of the urban system which influence post-development of the Olympics' venues. And the conclusion is given that these 3 factors are the important determinants of the urban system which support post- development of the Olympics' venues, and also the base of making the strategic and tactical plans to improve the venues after the Games.

articleTitle: On Performance of Combining Methods for Three-Node Cooperative Diversity Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analysis the performance of the ad-hoc network with a base station, a mobile and a third station acting as a relay. Three combining methods for the Amplify-and-Forward (AF) protocol and the Decode-and-Forward (DF) protocol are compared. Simulations indicate that the Amplify- and-Forward (AF) protocol beats the Decode-and-Forward (DF) protocol under all these three combining methods. To combine the incoming signals the channel quality should be estimated as well as possible, more estimation accuracy requires more resource. A very simple combining method can obtain the performance compared with that by optimal combining methods approximately. This indicates the implementation of cooperative diversity in future wireless network. All these three combining methods for both diversity protocols can achieve the maximum diversity order.

articleTitle: The Study of Price Risk Management in Supply Chain Based on Financial Engineering
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The risks exist in the supply chain management inevitably. These risks are created by the market demand indefinite, the price undulation and other reasons. The study of the risk management gradually expands from the financial service industry to the supply chain. The finance property risk can be controlled by using financial engineering theory. And this theory is also effective in the risk management of the capital flow in the supply chain. The methods of controlling finance property risks by financial engineering is applied in this paper under the environment of the supply chain, then this paper study the ways of each kind of financial tools to reduce the price risk in the capital flow of the supply chain in detail. The financial engineering can prevent risks through the financial tool combination. This paper establishes the reasonable model of the financial tool combination which effectively reduces the risks that exist in the supply chain.

articleTitle: An Efficient MAC Protocol Based on Hybrid Superframe for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Designing low energy consumption, high efficiency media access control (MAC) protocols are one of the most important directions in wireless sensor networks (WSN). In this paper, we proposed a new contention reserve MAC protocol, named CRMAC, under the inspiration of IEEE 802.15.4's superframe structure. CRMAC is a MAC protocol suitable for intra-cluster WSN that combines the advantages of contention and schedule-based MAC protocols. We introduce the mechanism and superframe structure of CRMAC in detail and verified the performance of this protocol through simulations. Our results show that CRMAC performs better than IEEE 802.15.4 in energy consumption, system delay and network throughput. CRMAC is especially suitable for short packet transmission under low load networks, which is the main situation in WSN.

articleTitle: Two Algebraic Methods for Constructing Efficiently Encodable Quasi-Cyclic LDPC Codes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present two algebraic methods for constructing Quasi-Cyclic LDPC codes. The first method is based on the quadratic residues modulo p (where p is a prime), the second method is based on the multiplicative inverses in finite fields. The codes constructed based on these methods are efficiently encodable and have a girth at least 6. Simulation results show that with SPA decoding, the constructed codes based on our methods perform very well over the AWGN channel compared to some other types of famous codes, such as random Mackay code or extended EG-LDPC code recommended by NASA.

articleTitle: Research on Listed Firms' Financial Distress Pre-Warning Based on a Longitudinal Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As listed firms' financial distress is not always occasional, it is necessary to consider dynamic change of the firms' financial condition when the firms' financial distress is pre-warned. In this paper, a longitudinal data envelopment analysis is employed to consider dynamically the listed firms' financial condition, and every listed firm in various periods is viewed as various decision making unit. Firstly, make certain a window which means one period. Secondly, evaluate the decision making units in every window with data envelopment analysis and make an estimate of dynamic change of every decision making unit's financial condition to pre-warn decision making units' financial distress. And then an empirical case shows the feasibility and validity of the method that is put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: Timestamp Vector Based Optimistic Concurrency Control Protocol for Real-Time Databases
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Optimistic concurrency control (OCC) protocols have been shown to be better suited than locking protocols for real-time database systems, but they have the problems of late conflict detection and transaction restarts. Although time interval based OCC protocols reduce the number of transaction restarts by dynamic adjustment of serialization order, there are still some problems with them which result in unnecessary restarts. In this paper, we propose a new optimistic concurrency control protocol called the timestamp vector based optimistic protocol, which can solve these problems and reduce more unnecessary restarts than time interval based OCC protocols. Experiments show that it outperforms time interval based OCC protocols.

articleTitle: The Lower Shifting of the Thresholds between 802.11a PHY Rate Modes Selection over Frequency Selective Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to channel fading effects, the SNR (signal-to-noise ratio) of receiving packets forms a probabilistic distribution with the target SNR of the mobile station as the approximate mean. Performance of the packet error rates (PERs) of different received SNR values, given that the target SNR is fixed, is investigated over frequency selective fading channels. Both an analytical upper bound and a statistical average (via simulation) of the PER of individual received SNR value were obtained. This paper demonstrates that lower target SNR values gives better PER performance under the same received SNR This observation has a significant impact on the determinations of the SNR thresholds for 802.11a link adaptation. Numerical results have shown that the link adaptation thresholds between two comparative rate modes should be decreased with the lowering of target SNR values. Finally, the lower shifting of the thresholds between PHY rate modes selection of 802.11a link adaptation for different target SNR values over ETSI/BRAN channel-A model is presented.

articleTitle: Modelling Cost from Customer Perspective and its Implications in Build-to-Order Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the process of order fulfillment in build-to-order supply chain (BOSC), one of the most important problems in the corporations is how to improve the cost-effectiveness of BOSC while increase of customer satisfaction is achieved. Meanwhile, the explosion of e-business, especially the Internet-enabled supply chain mode, makes it more cost-effective for manufacturer and customers to interact with each other, and makes it more efficient for customer to understand his/her needs and to express them. However, existing literature to the cost modeling of BOSC is scant. Furthermore, some existing cost models of supply chain are from a perspective of corporation without or with little consideration of some customer factors-such as customer maturity-except customer preference, which is inconsistent with the fact that the present market full of informed and powerful customers is stepping into a customer-concentric and Internet-driven era. This paper has two contributions as follows: Firstly, it develops a cost model based on customer preference in build-to-order systems, from which optimal base product outsourcing policy is inferred. The policy may offer production managers some evidences for their decision-makings. Secondly, from a customer perspective, it shows a cost model involved customer maturity in build-to-order systems. We introduce level of customer maturity as an important independent variable, which is contrast to existing literature. One important inference from the model is that the increasing of customer maturity reduces corporation's building cost and improves customer satisfaction. This may theoretically provide an explanation for the fact of increasingly close interaction between corporations and customers.

articleTitle: A Grouping Method of Bit Loading for Real-Time OFDM-Based Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A Grouping method of bit and power allocation in orthogonal frequency division multiplex (OFDM) system is presented in this paper. The complexity of BABGS algorithm, as bit allocation based on grouping subcarriers (BABGS), is lower than suboptimal algorithms. This algorithm aims to minimize the total transmitted power under the constraint of bit error rate (BER) and total bit rate, so it is based on margin adaptive (MA) principle. The structure of the proposed algorithm includes two stages. In the first stage, the subcarriers are divided into several groups according to the channel characteristics and the initial bits are assigned to per subcarrier in each group at the same time. The second stage is to adjust bits of each subcarrier in order to minimize the total transmission power. Compared with the Nader algorithms, this algorithm is reduced computing complexity by 20% and suitable to be utilized in deep fading frequency selected channel of the real-time systems. And its performance is still close to suboptimal algorithms.

articleTitle: Constructing Quasi-Cyclic LDPC Codes For Efficient Encoding Based on Fast Gauss Elimination
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a fast gauss eliminating algorithm for parity-check matrices of Quasi-Cyclic LDPC codes is proposed firstly. Enlightened by the gauss elimination, some Quasi-Cyclic square matrices with full rank are constructed. By proper matrix extension based on the full rank square matrices, we construct a kind of parity-check matrices whose column weights are either two or three. It is suitable for efficient encoding procedures in with a linear complexity. Simulation results show a better performance compared to array based LDPC codes and LDPC codes in 802.11n standard.

articleTitle: A Study on Hotel Service Quality Gaps
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The service quality gap is a principal factor influencing the implementation of service quality strategy in hotels and the degree of guests' satisfaction. The research reveals the existence of different degrees of expectations and perceptions of service quality amongst hotel managers, the front-line staff and guests, and remarkable gaps between their expectations and perceptions of service quality, based on which an extended 12-gap model of hotel service quality gap is constructed in place of the traditional 5-gap model. Meanwhile, the authors propose that hotels should enhance market investigation and communication for the reduction and elimination of service quality gaps.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm in Optimization of Function
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper points out defects of the traditional genetic algorithm (TGA), and has made improvement in it. An optimization strategy of combination is described. The improved genetic algorithm (IGA) is used to search the better answer in the whole feasible domain, and TGA is used to find the best answer in the local domain. The example shows the rationality and efficiency of this algorithm. This algorithm improves population diversity in the process of evolution, adapting bigger probability of crossover and mutation.

articleTitle: A Novel Microstrip Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents the simulation and experimental investigations of a special printed microstrip slot antenna, which is formed by cutting a Log Periodic meandered dipole slot in the microstrip patch. According to the special configuration of the Log Periodic meandered dipole slot, we estimate the new microstrip slot antenna has the similar characteristic of Log Periodic antenna, such as wide bandwidth. Then, some simulations and experiments have been performed, the results show that the impedance bandwidth is adjustable by variation of slot's parameters, and the bandwidth of the Log Periodic meandered dipole slot antenna is better than the normal dipole slot antenna in certain conditions. It affords a new approach to design microstrip slot antenna.

articleTitle: Research on the Price Decision Mechanism and Model of Service Projects Based on ABC
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Prices of services are the increasingly important decision factor to all firms seeking maximum service profits, but it is a very difficult to estimate the prices of service projects, so service price becomes the controversy focus of firms. Activity based costing (ABC) is the optimized method of costing services cost, and the accurate cost information provided by it is playing a very important role in service project price decision. The paper firstly analyses the price decision mechanism based on ABC for service projects, and according to the basic mechanism and the operation process of service projects, the concrete price estimating process and model of service projects based on ABC are deduced. Moreover the price decision strategies of service project based on the different competition conditions are analyzed and put forward for services price decision-makers, and the applicable conditions of the price decision model are elaborated.

articleTitle: An Ambiguous Strategic Form Game Based on Nonadditive Probabilities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although classic game theory has achieved excellent success in economics, it is often criticized for its weakness while describing real-world conflict situations, for its basic assumptions, such as complete rationality, common knowledge, etc. are not always consistent with real person in real conflicts. This paper reviews literature of criticism to classic game theory and researches on boundedly rational game first, then introduce nonadditive probabilities into strategic form games, which can describe players' attitude of risk-aversion in strategy selections. We also present a payoff function which can be considered as a weighed summarization of vNM utility and max- min decision criterion in strategic form games. We also show the existence of equilibrium in such games.

articleTitle: A Flexible Reversed Multicast Tag Collective Scheme in Base Station Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Select the close-to-optimal collective algorithm based on the parameters of the collective call at the run time is an important step in achieving good performance of collective operation in base station wireless network. In this paper, we present our Reversed Multicast Tag Collective (RMTC) scheme to optimize the collective routing in base station wireless network. We verify our mechanism in a simulation platform which is implemented according to the message passing mechanism of base station wireless network and analyze the result and expect run time performance penalty. The results indicate that our Reversed Multicast Tag Collective scheme is flexible and feasible in base station wireless network with its high efficiency and wide applicability.

articleTitle: Optimization of Routing Protocol Robustness for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the limitation of existed routing protocol in balancing the tolerance to failures and attacks towards wireless sensor network, we design a robust routing protocol based on complex networks theory, which can adjust the self organization clustering evolution in terms of a threshold function with three coefficient alpha, beta and lambda, where a represent number of hops from source node to base station, beta characterizes the signal intensity dependent on path loss coefficient. Since the construction of scale-free networks differs from that of random networks in that it involves preferential attachment, it means the new nodes are prone to connect with the heavy node with more degree of connectivity. To control the clustering coefficient of WSN, we introduce another parameter, lambda corresponding to preferential attachment. The parameter lambda governs how nodes are selected for connection once they have already been added. Therefore we can regulate the random and scale-free property of WSN under the constraints of energy resource through adjusting a, beta and lambda. Simulation results show that our protocol can increase survivability of WSN facing different sorts of failures.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Nodes

articleTitle: The Effects of Core Employees on Hi-Tech Firm's Capabilities and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This research tested the effects of core employees (CEs) on gaining high-tech firm's capabilities and efficiency. Seven hypotheses of relations among the value and uniqueness of CEs and firm's capabilities and efficiency are proposed in the article. The research used a sample of Chinese high-tech firms. Three senior managers of each sample firm assessed the value and uniqueness of employees and firm's capabilities and efficiency. A variance analysis indicated that core employees were associated with very valuable and very unique human capital; and very valuable and very unique CEs are positively associated with firm's capabilities and efficiency, and then positively associated with firm's competitiveness.

articleTitle: The Rising of Mid-China and Human Resource Development Strategy of Professionals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: While the rising of mid-China has been strategically planned, the facts show that human resource development (HRD) of professionals in mid-China is still one of the biggest obstacles. The stakeholders now focus on how to realize the basic role of HRD strategy of professionals for the strategy. This paper analyzes the urgent status quo of HRD strategy of professionals of mid-China from strategy, resource, brain-drain and structure perspectives. Secondly, the author analyzes the macro conditions from human capital theory and endogenous growth theory perspective. Thirdly, the author analyzes the micro bases from human resource competitive strategy perspective. And finally, some relative suggestions are discussed. This study is of both organization and public policy relevance and, in additions, attempts to fill the gap in the HRD literature.

articleTitle: Connectivity and Principal Component Analysis Based Network Decomposition for the Vehicle Navigation Path Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is necessary to decompose a large map into small pieces while performing vehicle navigation path analysis in an onboard device. A principal component analysis based network decomposition is constructed to solve this problem. An index of connectivity is proposed in this method, by which the most correlative vertices relative to the destination vertices can be extracted from the complete road network to compose smaller sub-maps. Thus the computation complexity of path analysis on these maps is greatly reduced without much accuracy loss. This method is applied in the distribute computing between logistics monitoring center and in-vehicle devices. Experimental evaluation shows that this method can effectively improve the computation performance of onboard devices.

articleTitle: The Performance of Space-Time Spread Spectrum LS-CDMA System over Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Loosely-synchronized code division multiple access (LS-CDMA) system is able to completely eliminate the inter-symbol interference and multiple access interference because of the good autocorrelation and crosscorrelation property of LS codes, which results in great enhancement of system performance and potential capacity as compared to ordinary CDMA systems. By combining such LS-CDMA technology with the space-time coding technology, space-time spread spectrum LS-CDMA system can get more advantages such as spatial diversity when more than one antennas are installed in the system. Both the transmitter scheme and the receiver structure of such space-time spread spectrum LS-CDMA system using multiple transmitting antennas and only one receiving antenna are put forward in this paper. In case of fading channel, it is possible for the system to achieve both temporal diversity and spatial transmit diversity. Some simulation results, as well as a few conclusions are given.

articleTitle: The Project Risk Assessment Based on Rough Sets and Neural Network (RS-RBF)
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The risk assessment of project is the important content for project management. This paper combines rough sets theory and neural network. Using the calculation method for reduction of rough sets theory method, we can obtain the compendious attributes and rules from sample data, then according to the attribute which had been reduced develop the neural network. The model overcomes the shortcoming that when neural network inputs too much dimensions, the structure of the network is too big. This method makes the neural network structure simple. The results of Matlab simulation show the superiority of the model. The model based on rough sets and neural network can effectively help project managers for management of project risk.

articleTitle: Study on Cost Forecast Method of Power Projects Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on cost data of certain zone history power transmission line projects, applying data mining technology including relative analysis, clustering analysis and support vector machine theory, one kind of new cost forecast methods of power projects is presented. Firstly, applying relative analysis and partial correlation analysis in SPSS15.0 software package, cost forecast index system is built after simplifying technical conditions of power projects. Next, using, clustering analysis, noise information of cost data of history projects is deleted. At last, using support vector machine theory, cost forecast model of power projects is designed. Simulation results of real power transmission line projects in Matlab7.0 software package show such model is valid and feasible.

articleTitle: Dynamic Game Analysis of Motivity of Technological Innovation Based on Spill-Over Effect
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first gives the definition of the technological innovation spill-over, then discusses the measurement of spill- over effect of the technological innovation: the parameter of technological innovation spill-over effect, that is, innovation spill- over rate can be described as the difference between social marginal revenue rate and marginal revenue rate of enterprise. The static game-theoretical analysis on the reigning and entrant shows that, when marginal revenue rate of enterprise is greater than capital interest rate, the enterprise has motive of technological innovation; when spill-over effect of innovation is high enough, the possibility of the reign to innovate will be decreased; the three-stage dynamic game-theoretical model which is based on technological innovation spill-over effect indicates the motivity of the enterprise prefers to be the leader and follower of technological innovation in the first stage and the second stage.

articleTitle: Grid-Based Enterprise Unstructured Information Resources Management Software Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Some challenges must be confronted when unstructured information is to be efficiently managed. Firstly, the lifetime process which includes obtaining, analyzing, labeling, saving and applying of unstructured information should be supported. Secondly, the dissimilar and uncertain user's requirements should be fulfilled. And finally the quickly changing enterprise application environments should be adapted. To solve these problems, one kind of grid-based unstructured information resources management software infrastructure is designed. The software infrastructure uses grid technologies to share organization's CPU abilities and realize open, agile and integrated information system , uses UIMA to integrate unstructured information analysis technologies, and insists using intelligent process to increase veracity of information analysis. The system architecture of that infrastructure is presented and one kind of prototype system is used to prove it's feasibility.

articleTitle: Analysis of Questionnaire on Time and Cost of the China's South-to-North Water Diversion Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The China's South-to-North Water Diversion Project is the largest water transfer project in the world which was paid more attentions on by thousands of peoples. The important task of project manager is to control project cost and duration. It is the most concerned question with the project managers which factors seriously affect the duration and cost. In order to study the problem, a questionnaire survey among the participants in the project was conducted. Firstly, this paper examined the reliability of the questionnaires by Statistical Package for the Social Science. Secondly, on the basis of ensuring the reliability of the questionnaire, this paper adopted the mean of each impact factor to make an importance evaluation of 94 influences encountered in the project. In addition, this paper has also applied rank and the Cox-Stuart trend increase test method in examining the variance corresponding to every mean. It was showed that the former 6 factors that played a leading role on the duration and cost. Meanwhile, the two of these factors are made a key analysis and elaboration.

articleTitle: Reduced Complexity Equalization of General Multicarrier System in Time and Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Joint equalization of general multicarrier transmission systems is investigated. The optimal two-dimensional maximum likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE) receiver uses delay spread in time and spectral overlap in frequency as diversity to jointly equalize all carriers. The optimal equalization is computationally intensive, therefore different suboptimal equalization schemes are studied. Simulation results show that reduced complexity schemes in frequency domain (reduced group size of carriers, sequential detection and variants thereof) perform better than conventional one-dimensional receiver, however computational overhead and error propagation are major problems. Reduced complexity schemes in time domain truncate the length of ISI and ICI channel impulse response. It is concluded that latter provide better performance/complexity tradeoff than former.

articleTitle: Study on the Development Mechanism of Organizational Integrated Capability Based on Resource Structure
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In these days, organization operation has changed from product operation to capability operation, and systematical capability management has been an important part of organization management, and it is important for systematical capability management to understand capability and its evolution mechanism correctly. So, based on system theory and fractal theory, this paper puts forward the concept of integrated capability (IC), analyze the resource structures of integrated capabilities, then according to resource structures it sorted the organizational integrated capability (IC), finally it analyzed the development mechanism of organizational integrated capability (IC) based on above sorts: this paper argues that integrated capability (IC) is driven by internal drive and external drive, and puts forward the functioning mechanism of the evolution drives of integrated capability (IC), based on the functioning mechanism, the paper puts forward the two-kind dynamic cycle evolution mechanism of the resources structure of integrated capability (IC), which uncovers the evolution mechanism of the space structure of integrated capability (IC) form resource level. In a word, the results gotten have important theory values for capability management and especially for systematical capability management.

articleTitle: Research on TCP Acknowledgement Mechanism in the Multi-Hop Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The TCP acknowledgement problem in the multi-hop wireless network is analyzed in the paper, and a TCP acknowledgement mechanism by the combination of the sender and the receiver is proposed. The mechanism stipulates that the receiver decides whether to respond acknowledgement according to the group frequency received, also conduct the fast acknowledgement according to the demand of the sender. Compared with other similar algorithm's performance, the algorithm is able to further reduce the number of ACK and improve the performance of TCP in the multi-hop wireless network.

articleTitle: Relationship of Human Resource Investment, Human Capital and Hi-Tech Firm's Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This research tested the effects of human resource (HR) investment through human capital (HC) to hi-tech firm's performance. Eleven hypotheses of relations among HR investment, HC and hi-tech firm's performance are proposed in the article. The research used a sample of Chinese hi-tech firms. A variance analysis indicated that HR investment is significantly related to higher level of HC in a hi-tech firm, and HR investment is indirectly related to overall hi-tech firm performance through firm-level HC.

articleTitle: Binary Group Decision-Making Model of Shapley Value for Enterprise Alliance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The core of establishment of enterprise alliance is the profit allocation of the member, and enterprise alliance is the result of group decision-making of all members. The paper advances a method combined with Shapley value and group decision-making model to solute the problem that how to get the function of enterprise alliance in Shapley value model. On the basis of these, the solution of model is presented and new kind of binary group decision-making model is put forward. An example of three enterprises alliance is given to show the structure, solution and significant of the method.

articleTitle: Agilize Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radios
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In cognitive radio (CR) networks, cognitive users need to continuously monitor spectrum to detect the presence of primary users, yet attain a reasonable throughput. In this paper, we exploit a scheme to detect the primary transmitting signal as quickly as possible using energy detection, besides a necessary transmission rate of CR networks is sustained. Also the relationship between time and frequency sensitivity in spectrum detection is given, whose product is a function of effective receive signal to noise ratio (SNR) of CR user.

articleTitle: Performance of Inter-Domain Routing Protocol in Aeronautical Telecommunication Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The mechanism of inter-domain routing protocol (IDRP), its structure of protocol data unit, transmitting and dealing with the process of routing updating information and flow control mechanism are specifically analyzed. Based on these introductions, IDRP protocol is simulated and modeled for the specific scenes under OPNET Modeler environment. Under different minimum broadcasting cycle, cycle of path connection overlapping and BIS-BIS connecting cycle, the performance of centralized and distributed ATN topologies are assessed from convergence delay, the route unavailability period and routing updating rate. This simulation proves the validity of our IDRP's process model. In addition, the IDRP's model and simulation provides good preparation for configuration of ATN model and simulation.

articleTitle: Research and Development on the OAM for Minimum Error Probability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the OAM (optimal accept model) for minimum error probability is successfully researched and developed. It can be used in modern digital communication system. The implementation of project is also presented in this paper. Test proved that the OAM is practical and feasible, steady reliable.

articleTitle: Comparative Research on the Evaluation Method of External Environment of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: External environment is one of the crucial factors in the development of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The paper establishes an evaluation system of external environment of SMEs. Then it uses structure equation model (SEM), fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and principal component analysis (PCA) to evaluate external environment of SMEs respectively and gets the best method with nonparameter test.

articleTitle: Information Integration System of Enterprise Distribution Innovation Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, enterprises operate in a tremendously competitive environment characterised by a number of changed business conditions. These comprise the trend to global and transparent markets, the rise of mass customisation, and reduced product life cycles. Competence in the optimal use of information and communication technologies supporting a global distributed innovation will be a future key to industrial countries remaining competitive in both the race for bringing new products to market and in sustaining a profitable presence in the market. Therefore, how to transform disorder, and distributed heterogeneous information into orderly and integrated situation, and support interactive information and collaboration among enterprises, which is an important prerequisite for achieving distributed innovation effectively. This paper firstly brings forward the conception of enterprise distributed innovation, describes features of enterprise distributed innovation, then, discusses about the Web service technology, at last, establishes information integration system of enterprise distributed innovation.

articleTitle: Avatar Based EGovernment Portal Service in Way of Multi-User Shared 3D Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper gives an overview of EGovernment and EGovernment portal. The current issues amongst EGovernment Portal are lacking motivation, collaboration and usability. To solve the collaboration and usability issue, the paper proposed a different approach for the integration of different Government service. Rather than stacking up government online service in 2D web portal, Multi-user shared 3D virtual environment could be a better embeddedness solution for online service It provides not only intuitive interface and excellent navigation, but also better interaction with citizens.

articleTitle: A Study on Supply Chain Optimization Based on Customer Relationship
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, the competition between enterprises is the competition between supply chains. As a result of management development, many more companies today are actively seeking effective solutions to adapt more flexible needs of their key customers. However, many researchers have described various models on single company or the partial in order to minimize supply chain costs and maximize profits, not considering the customer value. This paper is to contribute to the optimization modeling in supply chain on customer's variable need. Based on customer behavior and customer value, customers are classified to the key, the potential and the normal. Furthermore, mainly depending on what are mentioned above, this paper presents a model to analyze factors influencing customer satisfaction and a discussion of the model and results to optimize the supply chain.

articleTitle: Node Localization Algorithm Based On Dual-Restricted-Area for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To reduce the localization error by Concentric Anchor Beacon (CAB) algorithm in wireless sensor networks, a node localization algorithm based on dual-restricted-area (DRAL) is proposed. In the proposed algorithm, all the perpendicular bisectors of the lines which connect each pair of anchor nodes are used to obtain another kind of possible location area for unknown nodes. Based on the new possible location area, less valid intersection points can be obtained, and the average value of all these valid intersection points is taken as the estimated location of the unknown nodes. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has less estimation error than Centroid, Convex and CAB localization algorithms.

articleTitle: The Study on the Cycle of Technological Innovation Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There are some problems in China's technical innovation activities. Such as the elements can not flow smoothly among the subjects of technical innovation activities, the objectives of technological innovation activities are not consistent and the efficiency of transformation and utilization is low. Building a target system of the cycle in a technological innovation chain is proposed in this paper. The role of the system is to study the recycling chain that starts from the invention, by the first commercial use of technology and technology diffusion, then return to invention and key path of the technological innovation chain cycle. Through the study, we can promote the knowledge, information, talent and capital flowing circularly in the subjects of technical innovation, and form the specific modality and cycle effect about the recycling chain, which is from the knowledge innovation to the technological innovation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation on the Relationship between Public Information and Market Activities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The authors investigate the relationship between public information and market activities by utilizing event studies and employing data from the stock markets in Mainland China. The major findings are: (1) Public information has significant impact on market activity in Chinese stock markets. (2) Both pre-disclosure and lagged reactions exist or the markets are not efficient. (3) Pre-disclosure of public information by insiders may result in pre-disclosure reaction. And pre-disclosure of information in B-share market is less serious than in A-share market. (4) Lagged reactions of both markets turn out to be over-reactions to public information. (5) Good news is published early and bad news is postponed. (6) Both A-share and B-share markets have different reactions to different news. (7) EPS, book value per share, book-to-market value ratio and ROE have significant impact on accumulative abnormal returns.

articleTitle: Application of Phase Correlation Algorithm in Material Identification
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the market competition becomes more and more fierce, the advanced logistics technology has been introduced in all kinds of occupations. Under the background, the barcode technology was created. As phase correlation algorithm based on FFT has less computing matching, high precision, high noise tolerance and anti-geometric deformation capacity, it is a widely used method of image registration. In this paper phase correlation algorithm is applied to the barcode identification, so as to increase speed of items recognition and robustness of the algorithm. And in order to identify the barcode which is partly destroyed or inversed in the process of moving goods, there is the rotation-invariant phase correlation algorithm combining polar coordinate transform with phase correlation, which can recognize the correlated image and detect translation and rotation angle between two correlated images.

articleTitle: The Modified Traditional Customer Equity Driving Model and its Influence on Measurement
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a kind of competitively strategic resource, customer equity is increasingly paid attention to by the firm. This paper analyzed the traditional customer equity three-dimension driving model, and at the same time, we developed the four-dimension driving model by adding two important perception drivers: republic reputation and cross purchase, and explained the reason of modifying the traditional model. What's more, the return on marketing model, which is also modified a little, is taken as an example to analyze the positive influence that the four-dimension driving model brings to the customer equity measurement.

articleTitle: Impact of Popular Organizational Culture on Knowledge Creation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) has been the most important initiative part in organization innovation. Along with research thorough development on KM, knowledge creation (KC) causes the scholar to take seriously. This paper examines the knowledge creation process and highlights the creation, transfer and utilization of tacit knowledge. Based on other scholars' research, combined with nowadays managerial situation in China, organizational culture is carried on the full discussion which is looked as the crucial restriction factor for tacit knowledge utilization. At last, the paper gives detailed suggestion to reconstruct a human-based organizational culture responding to the request of knowledge creation.

articleTitle: Study of the Intra-Product Specialization of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the trend of the globalization of production, the intra-product specialization of supply chain is also undergoing profound changes. On the original vertical and horizontal specialization, there is a new model which is the intra-product specialization of supply chain. This model is the inevitable result of specialized production constantly refining. The paper is from this perspective to analyze the causes of the intra-product specialization of supply chain. On the basis, it analyzes the influence of the new model to China's industrial development.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Debt Governance, Agency Costs and Performance: Evidence from Hunan Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: More studies have focused on the theoretical and empirical aspects of corporate governance; however, debt governance transfer effect has not yet received as much attention as the debt-equity choice. With making use of 152 samples which consists of panel data (2003 - 2006) from 48 listed companies in Hunan, we empirically studies the effect of debt governance of Hunan companies. The results show debt in Hunan listed company only reduces explicit agency costs, and doesn't act on implicit agency costs. However, debt increases the agency costs on the whole, which means the effect of debt governance of Hunan companies is negative.

articleTitle: A Packet Marking Algorithm Based on the Path Identification of Autonomous System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new packet marking algorithm which is based on the path identification of autonomous system (AS). The algorithm mainly marks the packets with AS numbers through border gateway protocol (BGP) routers. According to the marked information in the packets, victims can not only reconstruct the AS path that the attack packets have passed by and trace the attack source to the original AS, but also can filter the packets which have the attack path, hence making it possible to alleviate the impact caused by attack traffic on the victims. It solves the disadvantages of the traditional packet marking methods with heavy computational overhead and high false positive. At the same time, it doesn't need all the routers' participation in marking in the attack path, which greatly reduces the overhead of routers.

articleTitle: A Research of Timing-Error Estimation Method for BPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly aims at BPSK signals to establish and validate a timing estimation method named as WP.Z algorithm that uses two samples/symbol sampling rate and its modified algorithm. Both of them have been carried on modeling and simulating in detail and their performance is evaluated under various parameters. It is not only discussed the accuracy, astringency and applied bound between two algorithms, still simulated and verified each parameter's influence to algorithm, the result is that in a low SNR and short interval length environment, the modified algorithm can be improved significantly compared to the basic algorithm.

articleTitle: OA Running Speed Analysis Based on 6 Sigma
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the structure of OA which is based on B/S framework, and then measures the risk of key factors which affect the OA running speed by Fishbone chart and FMEA matrix . According to the size of the risk, we can find out the key points of managing and controlling OA speed, and suggest the measures to improve the efficiency of file-auditing electronically. IT project can be improved by the 6 sigma tools, of which we can expand the scope of application, and then put forward the new method to measure the risk in IT project, the method can be validated correctness and validity by the example in this paper.

articleTitle: A TDD IDMA Downlink With MRC Pre-Equalization
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is shown in the paper that by employing a maximum ratio combining (MRC) pre-equalizer, the complexity of the receiver in an Interleave-Division Multiple-Access (IDMA) downlink is reduced, while similar or even slightly better performance is achieved, compared to that using Log Likelihood Ratio Combining (LLRC).

articleTitle: An Approach of Optimizing Power in WSN with Random Topology under Rayleigh Channels
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper proposes an approach of optimizing transmit power in wireless sensor networks with random topology in order to prolong node lifetime. It defines optimal transmit power as the minimum transmit power used by all nodes necessary to guarantee end-to-end bit error rate (BER) requirement. Assuming Rayleigh fading channels and two- dimensional Poisson topology, we bring nearest with forward progress (NFP) routing strategy and enhanced Aloha protocol into the SINR model. On the basis of the SINR model, we derive the expression of optimal transmit power and investigate the tradeoff among the average lifetime of nodes, transmit power and node density. The numerical results demonstrate that optimal transmit power can try its best to prolong node lifetime in the precondition of guaranteeing end-to-end bit error rate (BER) requirement. Besides, increasing the forwarding angle epsiv can decreases the optimal transmit power.

articleTitle: Study on the Theory Frame of "Tri-Party Engineering Contract"
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The concept of contract in the law of contract bases on the two-party contract relationship and most of construction contracts are two-party contracts. Because of this status, the workers undertaking engineering contract management gets used to two-party contract and people tends to understand gradually springing up tri-party contract. This way easily causes tri-party contract misunderstood. This paper plans to analyze the tri-party contract systematically and put forward concept, types and characters of the tri-party contract. And it lists the problems needed to be dealt with in the further study of tri-party contract.

articleTitle: A Performance Study of Multi-Node System in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we give an investigation on the performance of cellular dual-hop cooperative communication systems with regenerative relays over flat Rayleigh fading channels. M-ary phase-shift keying (M-PSK) is considered. Two linear diversity reception techniques are adopted in the destination, i.e.,maximal-ratio combining (MRC) and selection combining (SC).We first derive the symbol error rate (SER) expression of dual hop communication with MRC scheme and all relays randomly distributed between the source and the destination. We then derive asymptotic SER expression. With the aid of the a symptotic analysis, asymptotic-optimal power allocation(A-OPA) strategy provides more significant performance improvement compared to equal power allocation (EPA) strategy. Next, we analyze the performance and the asymptotic performance of dual-hop communication with SC scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Benchmark on the Design of Fund Incentive Contract Based on the Effort and Risk Choice of Manager
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper the ability of effort and risk choice of fund manager are considered simultaneously and both are related together by model settings. Under the case of observable effort and unobservable effort respectively, the influence of benchmark on the parameters selection of incentive contract is studied. The research discovers that under the case of observable effort of manager the benchmark has not any effect on the parameters of contract, but the contract based on benchmark can help investors to screen the ability of manager. Under the case of unobservable effort of manager, benchmark introduced into contract has the incentive effect. The paper indicates when the risk of benchmark increase, owing to the risk aversion the manager demands to enhance the sharing proportion of absolute return of fund and reduce the sharing proportion of relative return to benchmark, through which the risk-taking by manager decrease. The research proves that under the condition of asymmetric information benchmark introduced into contract also can help investors to understand the manager.

articleTitle: Design of the Wireless Tilt Sensor Network Node
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel design method of the wireless tilt sensor network node is presented. Firstly, acceleration is measured by the MEMS-based biaxial acceleration sensor ADXL202, so, there are several advantages, such as low power consumption, simple external circuit and so on. Then, tilt could be calculated from acceleration. In the software development, calculating tilt signals and point-to-point wireless communication are realized, based on the famous wireless sensor network embedded operating system TinyOS. Experimental results have showed that the node could meet the performance requirements of the wireless tilt sensor network.

articleTitle: A Space Time Block Code from Quaternion Quasi-Orthogonal Design
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we introduce a new kind of space time block code based on quaternion quasi-orthogonal design. The new code can transmitted through dual-polarized antennas and received through dual-polarized antennas. Compared with quasi-orthogonal space-time block codes, the new code can reduce bit error rate.

articleTitle: A New Engine Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the problem of bad reliability in self-propelled gun engine fault diagnosis method based on single sensor information, a fault diagnosis model based on improved least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) is presented. In the model, the quadratic programming problem is simplified as the problem of solving linear equation groups, and the SVM algorithm is realized by least squares method. When the LSSVM is used in fault diagnosis, it is presented to choose parameter of kernel function on dynamic, which enhances preciseness rate of diagnosis. The Fibonacci symmetry searching algorithm is simplified and improved. The changing rule of kernel function searching region and best shortening step is studied. The best diagnosis results are obtained by means of synthesizing kernel function searching region and best shortening step. The simulation results show the validity of the LSSVM model.

articleTitle: The Economic Effects of Central Bank Communication
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information disseminated by the central bank is public information. Macroeconomic environments are often characterized by positive externalities. In these environments, public information serves as a focal point for higher-order beliefs and affects agent's action more than private information. It is efficient to provide public information with highest possible precision. In addition, social welfare may depend on the monetary policy credibility. The higher the credibility is, the less is the requirement of the relative precision of public information. It is important for People's Bank of China to persist in improving monetary policy credibility and increasing its communication skill.

articleTitle: Value Creation Based Cost Management of Real Estate Project
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the increasingly competitive real estate market, the cost management of real estate enterprises has become more and more important. However, in the cost management and cost control, the goal should not be to minimize the cost of every activity during the real estate development, but to consider the contribution of every cost to the project's value, and as a result, to maximize the efficiency of the real estate project. This paper is based on a value-creation view, from which cost management is considered to be systematic, dynamic and diverse. Using AHP (analytical hierarchy process) method, we find that five activities, which are location selection, layout plan designing, developed planning and promotion, land using right acquisition, market research and initiate planning, contribute more to the project value creation by cost-adding. In the cost management practice of real estate enterprises, investment during these activities should be increased to make the project more cost-effective.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Relationship Between Knowledge Sharing in Virtual Communities and Consumers Brand Switching Intention
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is designed to explore the relationship between knowledge sharing in virtual communities and consumers brand switching intention by empirical methods. The results show: brand use experience has no noticeable impact on consumers brand switching intention in virtual community environment; the degree of sharing through expectation, perceived product quality, perceived value and brand reputation affect consumers brand switching intention; the contents of sharing has no noticeable impact on the consumers brand switching intention.

articleTitle: Adjustment of Transmission Radius in Linear Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The transmission radius that affects the consumption of energy in WSNs is an important design parameter. In this paper, we define the expected cost of energy as the product of the average hops of packets that sensor nodes intend to transmit to sinks and single-transmission energy consumption. We use mathematical methods deriving a constrained programming model by which the optimal transmission radius can be selected to minimum the expected cost of energy while guaranteeing reliability requirements in linear wireless sensor networks where the location of sensor nodes follows one-dimensional Poisson point process. From analysis we can get that the value of transmission radius is related with the distance between two neighboring sinks, nodes density and path loss exponent. Simulation results are presented to examine our analysis.

articleTitle: More Goppa Geometric Codes Achieving the Gilbert-Varshamov Bound
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the present correspondence, by constructing a system of linear equations, computing the inverse of Vander-monde matrices and solving two counting problems, a condition of Xing used to choose specific divisors, using which one can get Goppa geometric codes achieving the Gilbert-Varshamov bound, is improved. Consequently, more Goppa geometric codes achieving the Gilbert-Varshamov bound can be obtained.

articleTitle: A Model for Evaluating Service Quality Competitiveness Based on Linguistic Information
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service quality competitiveness is the focus of services quality management under economy globalization. This paper introduces a method based on linguistic approach to evaluate service quality competitiveness. Firstly, a service quality competitiveness evaluation index system is proposed, which is composed of five aspects such as quality stratagem, quality resources, quality capability, customers' satisfaction and quality performance. The linguistic information of evaluation is transformed into two-tuple linguistic information representation, and the multi-attribute decision-making model is developed to obtain the values from comprehensive group evaluation, further, service quality competitiveness evaluation and decision making can be achieved on the basis of above analysis. Finally, an example is shown to illustrate above method.
