Finally three challenges for open source competence centers (OSCC) are put forward for discussion further. The ten knowledge creation principles are self-organizing, code sharing, dissemination and adaptation, ease of use, sustainability, talent, interaction, collaboration, happiness and the democracy. These ten principles assure the smooth implementation of process of knowledge and a favorable organizational contextual, and make OSS development be superior compared traditional software development in knowledge conversion, sharing, and attracting talents. These are to be globally respected knowledge leader just as Linux and IETF, cultivate knowledge intensive-business services (KIBS) for OSS in the world to empower the knowledge economy in information economy and fostering innovations.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Management for Remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Remanufacturing is an important approach for sustainable development and environmental protection, and reverse logistics provides cores for remanufacturing industry. According to the logistics development of restoring phase for end-of-life product remanufacturing, this paper analyzed the reverse logistics connotation, management characteristic and operating flow mode for remanufacturing.

articleTitle: Adaptive Scheduling for VBR Traffic in Wireless LANs
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the critical issues in multimedia applications is the support of quality of service (QoS) at an acceptable level. IEEE802.11e has proposed a simple scheduler but it proves unable to support QoS in variable bit rate traffic. This paper presents a novel scheduling algorithm named adaptive transmission opportunity (ATX) to support variable bit rate in multimedia services. In the proposed scheduling algorithm, the channel allocation is based on hybrid estimation and error correction according to the actual queuing duration of each mobile station. Compared with other existing scheduling algorithms, it is shown that the introduced novel scheduler enhances channel utilization and significantly improves performance.

articleTitle: Capacity Bounds of Dual-Polarization Correlated MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we first derive a lower bound for the capacity of MIMO system employing dual-polarization diversity. An upper bound is also derived in the high SNR regime. In a second part, the tightness and validity of the bounds are analyzed by a definition named pseudo condition number. We conclude that the correlation matrices of antenna array have a great impact on the tightness of bounds. The impact of polarization diversity on the capacity and the robustness of MIMO system are analyzed at last.

articleTitle: A Non-Linear Programming Model for Funds Allocation in Software Development Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to effectively avoid risks that might result in loss of failure in software development process, based on the experiences of software development and project management, this paper identifies 4 potential risk factors specific to software development projects which are integrated with 6 stages in software development process, and proposes a non-linear programming model to optimize funds allocation to reduce the risks. The paper provides an example to validate the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: The Research for Security of Logistic System Based on Service Oriented Architecture
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of logistic system and the depth of the research of SOA, the requirements to the security of logistic system based on SOA are growing. On the basis of analyzing these requirements, a security solution which can solve the security problem is proposed. So the solution can provide the logistic system with the information security, authority access control, digital signature and intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Research on the Collaborative Manufacturing System for Chinese Automobile Enterprises Orienting to SDN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As one representation of typical complex products and national pillar industries, Chinese automobile product and industry is falling into more intensive competition. To be the winner of the marketing competition which is full of native and overseas competitors, all member enterprises should cooperate each other to pursue the maximum integral profit to realize the win-win status and long-tern sustained development of their SDN (supply-demand network), instead of seeking their own maximum profits. Manufacturing process, which is related to the whole product lifecycle from product design, production arrangement, order confirmation, production plan work out and optimization, production dispatch, manufacturing implement to automobile product delivery to their customers or final consumers, is the most important and complex part of the whole automobile SDN. The smooth operation of manufacturing system through the whole SDN could be realized only by the collaboration of its all member enterprises. On the basis of systematic investigation of current manufacturing system of several automobile manufacturing enterprises, this paper puts forward a resolve proposal which is composed of such functional modules as technology planning, flexible production plan, manufacturing implement and optimization, production dispatch and process control. This proposal is also of great reference value and strong usability for the collaborative manufacturing system of other complex products.

articleTitle: MOOA: An Object Oriented Formalism for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN) involve with a large amount of sensing devices. For a complex WSN system, establish a model before implementation could help find potential errors before deployment. We introduce a formal modeling language, MOOA, to specify WSN systems. Under the framework of MOOA, sensing devices is represented as objects, and communications is represented as messages among objects. We present the operational semantics of MOOA, so the properties of WSN systems can be verified.

articleTitle: Wireless Communication Design in Water Factory Monitor System by Sockets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the research, it present a wireless communication method for water factory environment monitor system. It sends and receives wireless data by GPRS, and processes the data in sockets software, which setup both in server and client computers. In the research, it designs the remote terminal, the wireless TCP/IP protocol, SMS (short message serve), and C/S (Client/Source) model. Also a VC++ program for wireless communication by socket in server computer and client computer was written in the research, which realizes the wireless communication by the VC++ socket program.

articleTitle: Study on Execution Capability Evaluation of Nodes under Quality Chain Operation Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Discuss the connotation and the implementation process of quality chain model, think that quality chain node identification and evaluation is the key to the effective implementation of the quality chain operation model. In the perspective of quality chain node, design the evaluation index system of quality chain nodes task execution capability, and use semantic-based fuzzy evaluation method and analytic hierarchy process to evaluate, which provides basis for decision-making for the effective formulation of quality chain operation mechanism.

articleTitle: Grey-Fuzzy Evaluation of the Cooperation Effects Between Human Resources Management Outsourcing Enterprises and Their Outsourcing Service Providers
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Effective evaluation of the cooperation effects between human resources management outsourcing enterprises and their outsourcing service providers is of great realistic significance. This paper analyzes the enterprises' motives in choosing the human resources management outsourcing from the perspective of its advantages, establishes an evaluation index system for the cooperation effects between human resources management outsourcing enterprises and their providers, and constructs a comprehensive evaluation model for the cooperation effects on the basis of the grey-fuzzy theory. An empirical analysis is finally provided in joint with case studies.

articleTitle: Software Product Pricing Strategies Study Based on Dynamic Stochastic Wealth Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The authors investigate cobweb type software product price fluctuations with adaptive learning, and put forward a dynamic software product pricing method based on the dynamic stochastic wealth model (DSWM). In this model, price of software product is divided into two parts, initial purchase price and post-implementation price, and the software product market is treat as an expectation feedback system, where the current market equilibrium price of software product determined by aggregated individual software product provider's expectations of next period's yield. After several rounds of price adjustment, optimal pricing strategies can be conducted. In order to describe the fluctuations of price in future, authors also developed a set of market impact functions with the technique of dynamic harmonic regression modification to simulate the market impact.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Logistics Based on E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, with the development of knowledge economy and the construction of information highway, E- commerce has become a global trend and is booming on the internet. E-commerce is quickly seeping through every industry, linking enterprises, associations, governments and individuals together. E-commerce has been changing the traditional industrial structure, which certainly influences logistics. Nowadays, E-commerce and logistics are closely interrelated. On one hand, E-commerce produces a great influence on logistics, which should adopt new development strategies under E- commerce environment. On the other hand, the influence of logistics upon E-commerce can't be neglected. Therefore, how to manage logistics based on E-commerce is a new realm which needs special research. The paper commences with the relationship of E-commerce and logistics, then analyzes the existing problems in the development process of our E- commercial logistics and finally, according to the problems, puts forward corresponding countermeasures for implementing our E-commercial logistics.

articleTitle: The Design and Implement of Time Synchronization Between Base Station and Sensor Node in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Time synchronization may play a key role in wireless sensor networks to meet real-time and energy-saving requirements and improve data-fusion and multiplexing efficiency. In this paper, we introduce a clock synchronization algorithm between the base station and sensor node used in wireless check meter system. The algorithm can not only been extended more conveniently, but also less affected by environment. The algorithm is implemented in the platform of s3c2410 solidified OS of Windows CE.Net. So the most important interrupt delay contributor, ISR and IST, can not be ignored, A result for the maximum clock skew of the hardware-based synchronization is presented, which can fulfill the need of wireless sensor networks built for wireless check meter system.

articleTitle: Real Estate Prices Forecasting Based on Gray Correlation Analysis and Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to find out the main causes of reai estate price' changes, the gray correlation analysis was used to quantify the influence degree of each factor of real estate price. In order to modify the residuals of GM (1, 1) model, the gray neural network is established. First, the simulated values and residuals of real estate price sequence are produced by GM (1, 1) model, then, put the residuals which produced by model GM (1, 1) as inputs to the neural network. The effectiveness of our methodology was verified with an empirical study that compared GM (1, 1) model with the hybrid approach. And the results show that this method can be an effective tool to predict the real estate price, the precision of this method is advantage to GM (1, 1) model, which is useful to provide a scientific basis for the Marco control of government, investment decisions of real estate developers and purchase strategy of consumer.

articleTitle: Network Traffic Classification Based on Message Statistics
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Accurate and efficient network traffic classification is an important network management task. Two way messages in a session follow the underlying application protocol to exchange information. In this paper, we propose a novel application classification method based on message statistics, concisely representing the protocols' unique characteristics. We present algorithms using SVD-based and information gain based algorithms to select the proper message feature set. As shown by the evaluation experiments, using the selected message features, a simple decision tree is able to reach the classification accuracy over 99%, which is comparable to other more sophisticated machine learning results.

articleTitle: Novel Parallelogram Based Pose Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new pose estimation method from parallelogram correspondence is proposed in this paper. This algorithm is simple to solve. It has good real-time characteristic. Furthermore, we could obtain unique solution for three-dimensional object pose from parallelogram to locate. Thus, it has good application value in practical engineers. At last, experimental results demonstrate this method is logical and has good real-time characteristic.

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of Behavior Management and Behavior Probability
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to describe probabilities of behaviors under certain expectation of return, the mathematical model of behavior probability is set up. The inputs of the model are expected returns; the outputs of the model are behavior probabilities. In the case of colonies, the behavior probability can be regarded as the proportion of those who take the behaviors. The parameters in the model can be calculated from the data collected. The rational rules and the warps in cognition can be also reflected in the parameters. The model will be helpful in making management policies and designing the institutions, which is meaningful in both practice and theory.

articleTitle: The Role of the Government in Electronic Participation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Electronic government (e-government) is the provision of government information and services through Internet to citizens and businesses and among government agencies. Though this electronic manifestation of government offers new approaches of access to government information and services and clearly has the potential to become an institution that promotes citizens actively to participate, it also presents new and serious potential impediments to democratic process, such as illegal e-participation, irrational e-participation and unbalanced developing e-participation. After diagnosing the matters of the process of e-participation, this article detailed illustrates the role of the government in the process of resolving these problems.

articleTitle: Simplified Maximum Likelihood Channel Estimation Algorithm for Impulse Radio UWB
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The maximum likelihood (ML) approach is a classical approach to the channel estimation problem. However, without reducing the number of parameters, the complexity is prohibitive. This paper proposes a (data-aided) DA simplified ML channel estimation algorithm based on unstructured channel model and time-hopping binary phase shift keying (TH-BPSK) modulation for impulse radio (IR) UWB systems. This approach need not estimate the multipath propagation delays and its complexity is reduced evidently. The computer simulations have been run to verify this approach proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Approach Based on Agent to Predict Stock Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Predicting stock performance is a very large and profitable area of study. A large number of studies have been reported in literature with reference to the use of artificial neural network in modeling stock performance in western countries. However, not much work along the approach to neural network based on agent has been reported. This thesis focuses on the development and the simulation of a stock market performance model of utilizing a neural network approach base on agent. This model is easy to understand, and can be easily implemented as a software simulation. First we will discuss the basic concepts behind this type of neural network based on agent, then, we'll get into some of the more application ideas.

articleTitle: GPS Timer Transfer Smooth Based on Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Precise time synchronization is the precondition of precise navigation in radio navigation system, high frequency stability cesium atomic clock is used in this system as frequency reference and GPS time receiver is used. To solve the problem of system synchronize error caused by low quality of GPS time receiver in short time, shift average method and Kalman filter is introduced in this paper. The results of simulation indicate that Kalman filter can decrease the error caused by GPS time receiver jitter effectively.

articleTitle: Approach for Camera Self-Calibration Based on Five Straight Lines
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a new method for five lines in one image to self-calibrate. The first group lines are three lines which are parallel to each other and the second group lines are two lines which are parallel to each other. At the same time, the first group lines are perpendicular to the second group lines. Line configurations for self-calibration of this method are new. In addition, the solution process of this method is also different from traditional self-calibration method. It is linear and stable. This paper presents the realization process of this method of self-calibration. The experimental results show this method works well.

articleTitle: Water Resources Economic Analysis of Heilongjiang Province Based on Input-Occupancy-Output Technique
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Water resources is one of important factors to affect the social economic sustainable development, so it is becoming more important to consume water rationally and to improve the economic benefit of water use. Heilongjiang province was taken as a case study in this paper, the input-output table of water resources based on input-occupancy-output technique was designed, then the water use efficiency and the water use benefit were calculated. On the comparison of the two factors, the characterization of water consumption was evaluated. The study result showed that the water consumption of agriculture was higher, but the water use efficiency was lower, the cost was higher, the economic benefit was bad; and water use efficiency of industry was higher, economic benefit was good. So it was proposed that the inside water use efficiency of agriculture should be enhanced and that of industry should be developed even more. In order to improve the total economic efficiency of water use, the structure of water consumption departments should be adjusted to provide scientific decision-making references for building saving-water society.

articleTitle: The Study on Innovation Mechanism of Open Source Software Community
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper intends to analyze the innovation mechanism of open source community in view of system engineering, economics and ecology. Firstly, the concept of open source production is proposed and defined on the basis of system engineering, and then the economic characteristics of open source are put forward and summarized through the analysis of the difference of production structure between open source software and proprietary software. Subsequently, the "innovation entropy" is proposed to measure the efficacy of community innovation and the mechanism is further revealed according to dissipative structure and complex science theory.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Approach Based on RS and PSO Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Utilizing the advantages of RS (rough set) theory in processing large data and eliminating redundant information, the enormous historic data of power load were pre-conducted. Then the training data for the SVM (support vector machine) were reduced. Next, the PSO(particle swarm optimization) is used to optimize the parameter of the SVM, the result is that the SVM has even more global optimization ability. Using this model for the load forecasting, the result showed that it is a precision and speedy forecasting model.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Paid Placement in Chinese Web Search Engine Results
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Web search engines provide information access to millions of users per day. For many people, Web search engine are now the primary method for finding information, news, and products. Major search engines offer at least two types of results on the results page, non-sponsored and sponsored results. The goal of this study is to get a better idea of how much of the entire first Web page displays non-sponsored results as compared to sponsored results in China. Results are that, for general search tools like Google China, 85.07% of the first Web page results are non-sponsored results. For search engine Baidu China, 56.43% of the first page contains non-sponsored results. If take the inconspicuous sponsored results (sponsored results that are integrated with non-sponsored results that appear similar to non-sponsored results and are unlabeled) into consideration, it makes a significant difference in the percentage of non-sponsored results returned by both two Web search engines. Other results include that query term length can also have a significant effect on the percentage of sponsored results displayed by both two Web search engines. The research may be useful supplements to other studies of compare search engines that are being tried by search engine researchers.

articleTitle: Research on the Relation of the Inventiveness Standard in the Patent Law and R&D Activities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The inventiveness standard in the patent law is termed the ultimate condition for patentability, so the inventiveness standard plays an important significance for R&D activities. A change of the inventiveness standard causes a static effect and a dynamic effect for the profits of firms. The static effect is profits associated with a change of the probability that inventions qualify for patent protection. The dynamic effect is a weighted average of the profits associated with the next patentable discoveries and the economic life of patents. These effects cause the changes of gains of firms, thus affecting their R&D activities. The net effect on the inventiveness standard change depends on the relative strength of the static effect and the dynamic effect. When the two effects are exactly equal, there is a critical inventiveness standard, and R&D activities and the rate of innovation are maximized.

articleTitle: The Notion and Characters of Knowledge Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first focuses on the studies the status quo of knowledge network based on paper analysis, then analyzes the connotation and extension of the notion of knowledge network put forward, and the authors bring forward its notion with different aspects in information science. Finally, it makes further discussion and analysis about the characters of knowledge network.

articleTitle: Application of Law of Requisite Variety in Inter-Organizational Information Processing Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By the application of law of requisite variety, this paper analyzed manufacturing inter-organizational processing management under environmental uncertainty. Data were collected from six companies. The results show that environmental uncertainty can determine the information processing management behavior significantly, Inter-organizational information processing management can determine the inter-organizational performance significantly, and marginal performance caused by inter-organizational management decreases in high environmental uncertainty. This paper testifies the validity of law of requisite variety, and explores its application in organizational research. It also presents management implications for inter-organizational management practice.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Transmission Strategy using Hierarchical Modulation
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel forward link cooperation scheme using hierarchical modulation is proposed. We define a cooperative unit cell as a unit which includes base-station (BS), fixed relay-station (FRS) and two types of mobile-station (MS) being the relay-assisted mobile-station (RAMS) and the non-relay-assisted mobile-station (NRAMS). We describe how to exploit the hierarchical modulation for the proposed cooperation between BS-FRS-RAMS link and BS-NRAMS link in the unit cell. The proposed scheme yields an improved throughput due to the characteristics of hierarchical modulation such as simultaneous transmission and multi-level protection layer. Simulation results and simple throughput analysis show that the proposed cooperation scheme outperforms the conventional cooperative and non-cooperative communication schemes with respect to the throughput performance.

articleTitle: Structural Model for Oil Price: Explanation of the Skyrocket from 2003
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we set up a structural model to explain the recent trend of oil price, and find out that the supply (demand) over 80 million barrels per day is the main reason for this skyrocket. Finally, we predict the future price using Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Appraisal and Risk Control of Knowledge Chain
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Risk is an inherent attribute of knowledge chain. Firstly, the article articulates different risks in knowledge chain. Secondly, it puts forward five steps of risk appraisal in knowledge chain and analyzes the steps. Ultimately, it establishes three risk control tactics according to the result of risk appraisal, that is, controlling the risks by all the knowledge chain members, transferring the risks to a third party and adopting no measures on the risks.

articleTitle: Researches of Tripartite Indenture in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the analysis on the background and origin of tripartite indenture which exists in engineering practice largely, the definition and correlative content of tripartite indenture are put forward in this paper. And the tripartite indenture is in contrast with the conventional both-side contract in order to indicate the particularity of tripartite indenture. Finally, the proposals for tripartite indenture's performance in engineering practice are given according to particularity of tripartite indenture.

articleTitle: Multicasting Approach in Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks and its Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile nodes in ad-hoc network operate under a lot of constraints chief among them being limited battery power. A lot of study has gone into developing efficient routing strategies within mobile ad-hoc network (MANET). A MANET by itself is of limited use. Nodes within a MANET have limited storage capacity. In order to extend its capability and usefulness, a MANET may have to communicate with a minimum number of nodes. The paper proposes a multicasting approach for calculation of minimum connected dominating set (MCDS) for entire network based on neighbor's node knowledge. MCDS is a subset of node in the network such that every node in the network either lies on the MCDS or is adjacent to it. Proposed algorithms based on maximum neighbor's node so, maximum neighbor's node covers maximum number of graph nodes. So, existing algorithms reduce steps and complexity also. The mobile nodes lying on the MCDS from the virtual backbone for the network and only these nodes are allowed to rebroadcast. This approach significantly reduces the total number of rebroadcast nodes in the network resulting in considerable reduction of contention and collision.

articleTitle: The Study of Relations Between Commercial Development and Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Commerce is an important part of national economy and it plays an influential role to national economic growth; our country (China) also pays more and more attention to commercial development, for example the commercial affairs department decided to start establishing works of the commercial network plans of cities in 2008. This article wants to explain the importance and present situation of commerce through the research to the law of commercial development and economic growth. The empirical study of this article mainly centers on the law of commercial scale and economic growth. By selecting national data and 4 sample provinces and cities' local commercial data-commerce and Gross Domestic Product rate, total retail sales of consumer goods, per capita Gross Domestic Product and other relative data, using the method of correlation analysis to verify the law of commercial scale and economic growth, and comparing our country's industrial structures with those in other countries, it draws an conclusion as follows: Our country's commercial scale and area commercial scale have both already developed to a relatively stable level, but this level is low, under such circumstance, if we want to increase commercial economic benefit further, we must adjust commercial internal structures and expand market demand or make use of other methods to promote commercial development.

articleTitle: Study on Grid Technology and its Application
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The current grid technology can be viewed as an extension or application of this framework to create a more generic resource sharing context. Grid technology is widely emerging. Still, there is an eminent shortage of real grid users, due to the absence of two important catalysts. A widely accepted vision on how applications can substantially benefit from grids, and second a toolkit of higher-level grid services, tailored to application needs. The grid aims to provide fundamentally new capabilities for applications to exploit the power of grid computing. We present a architecture of grid, middleware and its application technology, a large-scale, grid-empowered applications and then discuss grid general architecture and its grid application. We illustrate how applications can be grid-enabled and discuss grid as an tool for computing services.

articleTitle: Supervision of Board of Directors, Management Compensations and Earnings Management: The Empirical Evidences from China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper focuses on the relationship between the boards of directors, the management compensation incentives and earnings management in China. We take the discretionary total accruals calculated by using the cross-sectional adaptation of the modified Jones model as the proxies of earnings management; and then examine the relationship between the management compensations, the supervision of the board of directors and earnings management. After controlled the firm size and debt levels, we demonstrate that the compensation incentives is one the most basic motivations of earnings management in China. At the same time we also find that the board of directors does not hold a significant role on constraining and monitoring the earnings management under the current Chinese capital market environment, although we find the larger boards are more possibly to be an efficient monitor for earnings management.

articleTitle: A Distributed Time-Footprint Spectrum Allocation Strategy for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To investigate how to support user communication sessions in cognitive radio (CR), the radio technology should jointly perform power control, scheduling, and flow routing, which are generated by a multi-hop wireless network. With the adjustments of migrating nodes to neighboring nodes, a bandwidth footprint tree (BFT) is defined in this paper. Based on reducing hot spots approach, the distributed protocol is proposed to address spectrum allocation problem and to maximize the discovery of spectrum opportunities. With the derived model, different scenario schemes are compared based on their influence on traffic effect and low load flows limitations. The possible benefit from growing trees iteratively is clarified. In addition, a Chebyshev sum metric is utilized for sensing/monitoring of spectrum availability. With a cross-layer design approach, more evenly distributed sessions among the networks are achieved. Experimental and simulation results are provided as verification of the analyses and solutions.

articleTitle: A Design Flow of Special Customization Based on Similarity Evaluation of Functional Design Schemes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A design flow of special customization is put forward with a view to meeting customers' specific needs as well as reducing difficulties in subsequent design and manufacturing. As the basis of this design flow, a similarity evaluation method is put forward which includes the following steps: (a) establishing customization product families; (b) constructing product conceptional function matrix; (c) evaluating matrix elements for customer requirements importance value; (d) constructing benchmark product and figuring out the similarity indexes of various design schemes.

articleTitle: Research on Project Resource Allocation Models Based on Optimal Software Qualities
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: First, this paper introduces present software quality mathematical models and analyzes a three-dimensional model framework of software project development. Second, the paper constructs optimal software quality mathematical model, which allocates the limited time and costs to every stage of software project development to make optimal software qualities, and it suggests a quantifying basis for project managers to make plans and allocate resources. Finally, we illustrate the correctness and validity of the mathematical models we have constructed by a specific data and instance.

articleTitle: Shared Vision, Innovational Mechanism and Product Innovation: An Empirical Research in South China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study combines shared vision theory and innovational mechanism perspectives to develop a general model of product innovation. We analyze this model using a structural equation model approach, with 218 manufacturing and service firms in China are selected as the samples of this study. Our results indicate that internal shared vision positively affects innovational mechanism, and innovational mechanism has significant effect on product innovation, but shared vision does not have direct impact on product innovation. The results suggest that significant benefits can be achieved for the firm's product innovation by fostering innovational mechanism.

articleTitle: Analysis Framework Study of Relationship Value: Theory Foundation, Antecedent and Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Business relationship between firms is an increasingly common way for firms to find and maintain competitive advantage. A partnership occurs through extensive social, economic, service, and technical ties over time, but requires mutual commitment, trust, and common goals, as well as communication and cooperation. "Relationship value", as a new concept origin from "relationship marketing perspective", is becoming popular in business partnership research. The value of a business relationship is clearly a multidimensional concept that goes beyond the prices, quality, tradeoff prevalent in consumer research. According to analysis of relationship origin and its theory foundation, this paper proposed an analysis model of relationship value in which a three-dimensional coordinate system is constructed to express relationship value based on relationship quality, structure and degree.

articleTitle: Optimal Time-Domain Training Pattern for ML Channel Estimation in MIMO OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: High peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) is a disadvantage of comb-type frequency-domain training pattern (FDTP) in MIMO OFDM system. To deal with such problem, an excellent orthogonal time-domain training pattern (TDTP), based on circularly shifting Chu sequence and satisfying that optimal condition derived by us, is proposed for maximum likelihood (ML) channel estimation. From theory analysis and simulation, we find: 1) This TDTP achieves the same optimal mean square error (MSE) performance as comb-type FDTP; 2) For bit error ratio (BER) , it performs as well as comb-type FDTP for low and medium signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) whereas it behaves slightly better than comb-type FDTP for high SNR Thus, this pattern may be used as an alternative solution for ML channel estimation in MIMO OFDM system.

articleTitle: Research on the Radiation Field of Leaky Coaxial Cable Using FDTD
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is a direct solution of Maxwell differential equations. It changes the Maxwell curl equations that involve time variable to the difference equations in the gridding space, and changes all kinds of problems to the initial problems, and this change reflects all the time specialty of the electromagnetic wave, so the FDTD method can settle electromagnetic dispersion and electromagnetic radiation of the complex objects and the objects of heterosphere. Here the radiation fields of coaxial cable with one slot, three and five vertical slots are simulated, and set the base for research on the radiation field of the whole leaky coaxial cable.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing of Airline Tickets in Competitive Markets
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The benefits of dynamic pricing methods have long been known in airline tickets. To date, many dynamic pricing models have not modeled competition explicitly. This paper provided a foundation game-theoretic model to describe a competitive problem and predicts the dynamic pricing behaviour of the two flights. We show that the pure-strategy Nash equilibrium when the selling period began is the lowest price. Finally, We propose the open loop control, which can make the various computationally feasible heuristic approaches for the multidimensional pricing problem.

articleTitle: Social Network Construction of Entrepreneurs: Dynamic Perspective from Chinese Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After decades of rapid economy growth in China, the importance of social capital and social network for entrepreneurship has been recognized in recent years. The main purpose of this study is to explore the changing social network construction of entrepreneurs with a dynamic perspective. This paper extends earlier research with focusing on service industry and with taking the process-oriented view. By investigating 125 entrepreneurs from service industry, this study employs the method of statistical analysis to find out the difference of social network construction in three entrepreneurship stages. The results indicate that the density and scale of entrepreneur's social network does vary in different entrepreneurship stages. The results also indicate the heterogeneity of network members' professional background does vary in different entrepreneurship stages while heterogeneity of network members' social status does not. In the end of this paper, some reasons for the results are discussed.

articleTitle: The Supplier Relationship Management Applying Management Thoughts of Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the analogy method, applying management thoughts of customer relationship management to the supplier relationship management. The paper presents the definition and function of SRM firstly, then classifies the materials, on the basis of the class categorize the suppliers, adopting reverse auction or reverse marketing to different suppliers, bring forwards supplier sort and management in SRM system, including the criterion and performance evaluation of selecting supplier, so the enterprises can avoid the adverse selection of suppliers to develop the win-win status.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Dynamic Correlation between SHIBOR and NDF Implied Interest Rate
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Unlike exist study on the spill-over effect between RMB exchange rate and interest rate, this paper is the first study on the spill-over effect between money market and RMB NDF market. Two multivariate GARCH models including diagonal VEC and BEKK are employed to analyze the dynamic correlation between SHIBOR and Non-deliverable forward implied interest rate (NDF IR). Two short-term interest rates with maturity of 1-week and 3-month are studied here. The results show that there exists dynamic correlation between NDF IR and SHIBOR. In term of volatility, 3-month NDF IR shows significant time varying variance characteristic and volatility persistence, and affects 3-month SHIBOR more significant than the effect on 1-week SHIBOR by 1-week NDF IR On the contrary, SHIBOR has little effect on NDF IR. 3-month SHIOR and NDF IR shows strong co-movement, but weak between the term of 1-week By studying the relationship between NDF IR and SHIBOR, we conclude that RMB NDF has a strong spill-over effect on Chinese money market, especially on 3-month market.

articleTitle: Study of Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the network attack become more and more widespread and difficult in against. The traditional technique, such as Firewall is good, but when malicious traffic originates from inside network or enters through a hole in the firewall you may need another line of defense to protect you. This is a article introducing the concepts of IDS, what they do, the functions they serve, the classification of IDS, how you might use an IDS to monitor for and detect suspicious or malicious activity on the network and the different methods of intrusion detection that they may employ.

articleTitle: ARCA: An Algorithm for Mining Association Rules Based Concept Lattice
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Association rule discovery is one of kernel tasks of data mining. Concept lattice, induced from a binary relation between objects and features, is a very useful formal analysis tool. It represents the unification of concept intension and extension. It reflects the association between objects and features, and the relationship of generalization and specialization among concepts. There is a one-to-one correspondence between concept intensions and closed frequent itemsets. This paper presents an efficient algorithm for mining association rules based concept lattice called Area (Association Rule based Concept lAttice). Area algorithm uses concept-matrix to build a part of concept lattice, in which the intension of every concept be put into one-to-one correspondence with a closed frequent itemset. Then all association rules are discovered by 4 operators which are defined in this paper performed on these concepts.

articleTitle: A Distributed Transmission Power Control Protocol for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy limitation has become a performance bottleneck for mobile ad hoc networks. IEEE 802.11 has been adopted as the current standard MAC protocol for ad hoc networks. However, it has not the ability of adjusting power level dynamically, that reduces the performance of network. A novel power controlled MAC protocol based on SNR in mobile ad hoc networks is presented in this paper. Simulation results demonstrate that compared to the IEEE 802.11 MAC protocol, the proposed protocol can decrease the power consumption greatly, and improve the energy utilization of mobile terminals while maintaining the throughput performance.

articleTitle: One Multi-Attribute Logistics Exchange Model Based on Reverse E-Auction: Simulation from Market of Fresh Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the high-speed development of the agricultural products logistics market, how to build a highly effective agricultural products logistics service exchange platform becomes a valuable study. In this paper, through the use of the Internet, a powerful tool for improving operational efficiency, we apply an online logistics auction method. In the agricultural products industry, the logistics of fresh agricultural products is unique and complex which requires very high standards and the trading mechanism that set the lowest cost as the single goal will not meet its requirement. In this paper, we use the multi-attribute model of logistics service transactions to study the logistics of fresh agricultural products and present a new transaction mechanism with more practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Stratification and Grouping in Hierarchical Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A design method is proposed with network physical stratification and logical grouping for hierarchical network. Mathematical models of functions of stability measurement, multiple queuing transmissions, constraint function of optimization and logical weight of nodes are introduced to describe the hierarchical network. According to the functions of stability measurement, the physical stratification is proposed to separate the hierarchical network into subnets. Based on the multiple queuing transmissions, the logical grouping is proposed to optimize the scale of subnets and the location and number of gateways. By simulations, the effectiveness of stratification and grouping is verified.

articleTitle: Emotions of Management
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Corporate Life Cycle> written by Adizes analyzes enterprise from angle of chronic succession, obtaining its different life stages. Similarly, enterprise can be discussed from angle of emotions. Combined with life cycle theory, the result may be effective tool of management diagnosis. Enterprise in courtship stage is possibly influenced by entrepreneur's anger. Regulation on it should be the focus of this stage.

articleTitle: An Uneven Probabilistic Flooding Algorithm for Small-World Wireless Multi-Hop Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Concept of small-world is applied in the context of wireless multi-hop networks in this paper. We build a network model by selecting a small part of nodes and magnifying their communication distance. It is proved that this model behaves small-world character, mainly in average path length and clustering coefficient. Based on this model we put forward an uneven probabilistic flooding algorithm. Simulation results show that small-world model outperforms general multi-hop wireless network model greatly in both network coverage and hop count.

articleTitle: The Device Management Platform in Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to manage and control the different devices in Ethernet, a monitoring and control platform is designed. The platform include data processing, clock management, queue management, state monitor, data channel agent. A software interface to lower machine is provided. The structure of platform and load balance of system is presented in the paper, the Petri Net model of communication is described.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Online Third-Party Payment Based on Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the online third-party payment developed very rapidly in China and its growth rate in the volume of transactions continued to 100%. In this paper, the online third-party payment services are classified as their content and business mode based on the comparison of some major domestic enterprises. Then according to the maturity model theory, an evaluation system is proposed to analyze the characteristics and industry trends of online third-party payment in the different stage of development.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Supply Chain Model Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Waiting Queue Based Bandwidth Allocation Architecture for nrtPS and BE Services in IEEE 802.16 PMP Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a new wireless network access technology, IEEE 802.16 can provide broadband Internet connection to user. Five types of services that can provide QoS support for a wide range of applications had been defined in IEEE 802.16 standards. Some papers had discussed the QoS architecture of WiMAX, but little attention had been thrown to nrtPS and BE services. In this paper, a novel waiting queue based bandwidth allocation architecture had been proposed to improve the performance of nrtPS and BE services without any impaction to the others. We evaluated the proposed architecture with truncated binary exponential backoff which is the mandatory scheme for collision avoiding in the standards. The analysis and simulations results show this architecture greatly improves the QoS of nrtPS and BE services in IEEE 802.16 network.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Automatic Recognition of MPSK and MQAM Signals Using LVQNN and RBFNN
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, two kinds of artificial neural network have been combined, and used as recogniser to complete the hierarchical automatic recognition of MPSK and MQAM singals. They are learning vector quantization neural networks (LVQNN) and radial-basis function neural networks (RBFNN) respectively. The former is used for classes of signal, and the latter is used for subclasses. Simulations show the performance of LVQNN and RBFNN classifiers is satisfying for six different digital modulation schemes, even at signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) as low as 6 dB.

articleTitle: Concept Lattice in Incomplete Knowledge System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with formal concepts in incomplete information systems(IIS) using rough set theory. The maximum distribution reducts based on attributes IIS are first proposed. The relationships between the reducts in the source system and in its selections are investigated. We can acquire concept lattices from incomplete systems by their optimal selections. Empirical studies on UCI data sets demonstrate a significant accuracy obtained from this new approach.

articleTitle: On the Technology Spillovers of International Outsourcing of Services
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper discusses the technology spillover effects of international services outsourcing by developing a model of endogenous technical progress represented by the increase of the varieties of intermediate inputs. Through the competitive equilibrium analysis, we conclude that the technology spillover of services offshoring can positively promote the growth rate of the undertaking country's productivity and technology, but the spillover effects are determined by the undertaking country's trade openness, the stock of human capital and technology gap relative to the outsourcing country.

articleTitle: Analyses to Signal Detecting Capability of Two Chaotic Oscillator Systems
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Chaos theory is a new method of studying nonlinear system. With the development of society, the theory has been applied in many aspects of radar system and signal processing. In this paper, signal detecting capability of two chaotic oscillator systems is analyzed from detecting sensitivity and stability. It proves that the performance of detecting system with higher power is better but more questions will be considered when it is used. And in general, system 2 is a good select.

articleTitle: A Minimum Mean Square Error Estimator for 3GPP's Spatial Channel Model Based on OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with the minimum mean square error estimation (MMSEE) of spatial channel model (SCM) in the Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system. In particular, we focus on MMSEE on the basis of maximum likelihood estimation (MLE). Since statistical information is the critical element of MMSEE, we derive the generation of coefficients of autocorrelation in SCM with different data rates. Utilizing Monte Carlo method, the prior channel information is gotten. Simulation results validate the accuracy of MMSEE over MLE in terms of mean square error, and better BER performance in three typical wireless environment of SCM.

articleTitle: The Effect of Match Between Capability and Strategy on Logistics Companies' Performance
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study focus on the influence mechanism of logistics capability, supply chain management strategy and enterprise performance. Data was collected from empirical researches of 74 logistics enterprises, and was analyzed with quantitative research method. The results shows that: there are evident positive correlations between logistics capability, service performance, and financial performance of Logistics Corporation. And there is also significant moderating effect of supply chain management strategy on the relationships between logistics capability and service performance, as well as logistics capability and financial performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of TD-SCDMA Basestation Using Ring Network on Chip
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a case study of the complete baseband part of basestation that is designed and implemented using ring network on chip (ftNoC). By combining general-purpose and application-specific hardware, it is possible to integrate the complete baseband part of TD-SCDMA basestation on a single chip. In ftNoC, links are divided into two groups of ring, one of them used for fault-tolerance. Each group contains a control-ring and a data-ring. Control-ring propagates routing, link error and error control information of all nodes by packet-switching and data-ring propagates data by circuit-switching. Ring network adopts time-division multiplexing (TDM) and priority mechanism to implement space division multiplexing (SDM) of bandwidth and fair routing. Simulation results show the baseband part of TD-SCDMA designed using ftNoC perfectly accords with the requirement of TD-SCDMA at a network clock frequency of 200 MHz. And the architecture can efficiently avoid traffic congestion, deadlock and starvation and ensure full use of bandwidth.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: How to Solve the Cross-Regional Transitivity Problem of Key Leak in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cross-regional transitivity problem of key leak exits in the most key management protocols. It's harmful to the security of system. CUT, a new key management protocol in WSN is presented. The results of simulation show CUT can solve the cross-regional transitivity problem of key leak and is scalable.

articleTitle: Distributed Linear Dispersion Space-Time Code
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new distributed space-time code incorporating linear dispersion propriety used in cooperative diversity system is introduced. After a CRC detection, each cooperative node applies distinctive transmit method according to its CRC result. Based on PEP upper bound analysis, we deduce optimal power allocation for this system. Besides, theory analysis demonstrates that our proposed Distributed Space-Time code can almost achieve full diversity. Simulations further verify our theory deduction and demonstrate an obvious improvement over some other Distributed Space-Time code under the same circumstance.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurship, Innovation and the Transformation of Economic Development Mode
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: President Hu Jintao set the transformation of economic development mode as the nation's new economic strategy in 2007 to replace the one formulated in 1995. This paper holds that the new economic development mode is essentially dependent on the innovative activities of entrepreneurs. By analyzing the inner connection between innovation and entrepreneurship and the transformation, this paper illustrates the important role of entrepreneurship in the transformation and suggests some measures for China to foster entrepreneurship.

articleTitle: Hybrid ARQ Scheme Based on TCM and Concatenated Codes
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new type-II hybrid ARQ (HARQ) scheme based on TCM and concatenated codes is proposed and evaluated. The new scheme is divided into two major steps which are BCH processing and turbo processing. Firstly, information bits are transmitted using TCM and then the incremental parity bits based on BCH codes are transmitted upon the reception of NAK. Secondly, the incremental redundancy (IR) based on rate compatible punctured turbo (RCPT) codes is transmitted using BPSK if the decoding of BCH codes is failed. Averaged diversity combining (ADC) technology is used through all the (re)transmissions of the same packet. Performance is evaluated via computer simulation and the results are compared with the popular RCPT scheme. Simulation show that our scheme has higher throughput in medium to high SNR regions and the gains are considerable. Moreover, the average computational complexity of our scheme is lower than the pure RCPT scheme.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian Inference in the Structural Modelling of Operational Risk of Chinese Commercial Bank
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the increase of the financial crimes in Chinese commercial banks, to measure the operational risks and build the comprehensive framework of operational risk management become increasingly urgent. In present study, Bayesian inference, which combines the expert opinions and the dynamic risk factors, has been applied to the measurement of the operational risk based on its construction, initiation, parametric learning and scenario analysis. The internal and external frauds were characterized by the Pareto distribution, while the business disruption and the system failures were fitted by logarithm normal model in the process of initiation and elicitation. The results of the scenario analysis showed that the operational risk could be discovered in time and controlled by enhancing the construction of the incentive mechanism and consummating the audit system.

articleTitle: System Thinking Mode of Complexity Science Management: The Forefront of Management Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Beginning with the supposition that organization is a brain capable of system thinking, this paper researches the system thinking mode of complexity science management. System thinking, combining science with art, includes thinking mode of solving complicated problems, observation of interrelation between cause and effect, structural and modularized analysis, and visual thoughts of both logic and image. Basing on the point that system thinking is mainly through researches of perspective maps, this paper also puts forward the tools for system thinking: circular map, exploring map, structural map, and some examples for the research.

articleTitle: The Optimal Level of Intellectual Property Protection in Presence of Network Effects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the progress of technology, intellectual property protection has evolved from a pure public policy to a combination of technical means and policy measures. The existence of network effects makes the issue even more complicated. Through mathematical and analytical tools, this paper seeks to analyze the optimal level of intellectual property protection in presence of network effects. Overall, it addresses two questions. What is the optimal technical protection level of an individual firm who maximizes its profit? What is the socially optimal protection level from the perspective of policymakers, who shoulder the obligations of stimulating innovation and technological progress? It is found that the optimal level is affected by a variety of factors and cannot be simplified as "the strong, the better".

articleTitle: A Study of Privacy Preserving Joint-Ordering Policy
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The development and deployment of privacy preserving joint-ordering policy could allow supply chain collaborations to take place without revealing any participant's data to the others, reaping the benefits of collaboration while avoiding the drawbacks. In this paper, we develop and apply secure multi-party computation protocols to the joint-ordering policy between a single supplier and a single retailer.

articleTitle: Inventory Decision Models under Stochastic Demand with Two Order Chances
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Consider a two-echelon supply chain with one supplier and one retailer, and the products are perishable and sold over a single selling season. According to the classical newsvendor model, the retailer traditionally can only order products before the selling season. This paper discusses a situation in which the retailer can place a second order in the selling season. And supply chain members' optimal decisions are obtained. We also study how to improve the performance of the supply chain. All our findings are illustrated by a numerical example at last.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Path Routing Protocol in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), multi-path routing can find multiple paths from source node to sink node for achieving high reliability and high energy-efficiency. However, the existing multi-path routing protocols in the literature construct multiple paths with long latency and high overhead [C. Intanagonwiwat et al., 2000] [D. Ganesan et al.] [B. Deb et al., 2003]. In this paper, a novel multi-path routing protocol in WSNs is proposed, which can discover multiple paths with short latency and low overhead. Performance analyses and simulation results show that our proposed protocol has much better performance than the existing ones in terms of both latency and overhead.

articleTitle: Performance Research for Regular LDPC Codes in TD-SCDMA System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently, low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes have attracted much attention especially in mobile communication system as a good simple error correcting codes achieving the data throughput near Shannon limit with lower complexity. In this paper, we design some regular LDPC codes with very low bit error rate (BER) and frame error rate (FER) according to the downlink parameters in TD-SCDMA system. We construct the downlink physical layer emulation model with matlab according to TD-SCDMA system's baseband signal disposing flow chart, and execute the link simulation with the performance analysis for some available channel codes and the designed regular LDPC codes based on the proposed emulation model. Passing the simulation, we obtain some conclusions that the regular LDPC codes are better than the convolutional codes or turbo codes in error rate performance.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Optimizing the Bonus-Penalty Structure of Large-Scale Project Scheduling Problem: A Flexible Resource-Constrained View
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we optimize the bonus-penalty structure of large-scale project on flexible resource-constraint with a Stackelberg model, and propose a parameter of Optimization-Level to analyze the impact about the Hire-Index influences on the degree of the optimization. We find that the optimization of Incentive-Intensity can make the bonus-penalty structure more effective, and the client will gain their maximal benefits. However, the project scheduling and the bonus-penalty structure can be optimized better, because of the flexible resource. The Hire-Index of the resource influences the degree of the optimization very much, and the lower the better, whereas the worse.

articleTitle: Research on Manager Training Effectiveness Evaluation Based on Kirkpatrick Model and Fuzzy Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Training is a process which enterprise provides the knowledge and skill to the staff, and is important content which deepens the organization development, carries out enterprise management behavior and cultural practice. Based on the analysis of the training importance and the present of training effectiveness evaluation, this paper establishes an effectiveness evaluation system combined with Kirkpatrick model and describes the evaluation mechanism based on fuzzy algorithm and BP neural network. The effectiveness evaluation of 10 managers in a certain enterprise shows that the results given by this model are reliable, and this method to evaluate manager training effectiveness is feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Remanufacturing Logistics System Based on Multi-Agent Theory
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, based on multi-agent technology, a remanufacturing logistics model was proposed according to the features of remanufacturing logistics system. This model implemented the intellectual interaction among re-manufacturer, waste disposer, and customer. Then in order to enhance the operation efficiency and effectiveness of the whole logistics as well as reduce the total costs, we integrated the model system from the perspective of agent-mediated decision and coordination, and lastly the mechanism of decision and coordination was discussed. It is worth mentioning that the multi-agent constraint-based approach was firstly introduced during the integration.

articleTitle: Application of Phased Array in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a computer simulation of a MIMO system comprising phased array antennas (PAA) in all receiving branches is presented. In order to examine the system performance under relatively realistic conditions, a ray-tracing simulator was applied to generate a baseband channel impulse response matrix H. The PAA consists of L antenna elements where a variable-gained low-noise amplifier and a 360deg continuously adjustable phase shifter are inserted in each antenna element and an adder for the array output is connected into the RF front-end of each receive branch. The phase shifters are adaptively controlled to increase the total channel capacity of MIMO systems.

articleTitle: Experience of Collaborative Requirement Management in Dual-Shore Software Maintenance Projects
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There may be much gap of the scope and requirement among distributed teams in dual shore software projects. Collaborative requirement engineering is essential so as to keep consistent not only among distributed teams but also among the entire software life cycle. This paper is intended to introduce a workflow for collaborative software requirement engineering including requirement gathering, requirement analysis, requirement evolving, and requirement management for change or bug fixing. The suggestion solution can be helpful especially to the dual-shore software maintenance project.

articleTitle: Research of Collaborative CAD System Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A multi-agent based architecture is bring on to improve the collaborative feature of traditional CAD system for those designers need collaboration each other but locate on different place. Three levels is are included in this proposed system framework, namely real-time monitoring agent, conflict detection agent, conflict solution agent, user communication agent and knowledge management agent. Detail flow architecture of the user agent is given in this paper. An experiment system presents the efficient cooperation among two designers on Internet.

articleTitle: The Research of the Highway Bridge Management Information System Based on Delphi
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The present highway bridge management which to a large extent relies on managers and technical personnel's experience is incompatible with the information age. The highway bridge management departments must rely on modern management thinking and advanced means of information processing. The highway bridge management information system taking Delphi evaluation as support model integrates data management, appraisal analysis, condition prediction, investment decision, dynamic image, multimedia and the GIS geography information processing. It can meet the highway bridge managers' needs as a whole. We elaborate the system constitution, the database design, as well as functional module design emphatically. Through the application of the system in Heilongjiang Province, the management of bridges has become highly effective, automated and systematic.

articleTitle: Data Manager for Integrating Business and information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: While investment projects to information system development for survival of enterprises have been initiated every year under today's severe environment, a problem that their success rate is quite low compared to other fields such as plant or building construction has been pointed out. Information systems have become more global, gigantic and complicate. Meanwhile, the shortening period for development has been requested. In spite of such a situation, they have been individually developed by project control in most of the fields. It might be valid in the midst of complex system environment to put a data manager (DM) as a central core of program management cycle in information management, in order to carry out without contradiction between multiple projects of system development. This paper studies on what roles should be achieved essentially by DM and what roles could be achieved by DM in the program management of system development.

articleTitle: An ID-Based Key Predistribution Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Providing a suitable key establishment scheme in wireless sensor networks is challenging due to all the characteristics of these networks, such as limitations of power, computation capability and storage resources. This paper presents a new key predistribution scheme for wireless sensor networks. By applying the ID-based technique, the proposed scheme can establish a unique pair-wise between two nodes and authenticate each other by fewer messages. In this scheme a sensor needs not to transmit its implicit certificate, so it not only provides the explicit key authenticate but also offers low power.

articleTitle: Would Number of Firms Affect Agglomeration of Horizontally FDI in the Host Country?
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under assumption of labor force relatively overmuch, this paper investigates agglomeration of horizontally FDI in host country in view of limited number of firms or much enough number of firms. The research indicates: Number of firms will affect agglomeration of horizontally FDI in the host country; horizontally FDI won't invest and agglomerate in host country under the market construction of firm's number much enough, horizontally FDI would invest and agglomerate in host country only under the market construction of firm's number limited. Rapid increases of economy and huge scale of market are important factors for the host country to attract horizontally FDI. The adjustment of industrial structure, growing up of market and gathering of technology power in the host country, which will be beneficial to acquire more horizontally international direct investment for the host country.

articleTitle: Research on Analysis and Evaluation Methods of Social Capital in Competitive Strategic Alliances
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Defining the social capital in the structure of competitive alliance, this paper presents analysis and evaluating system of social capital. Based on four-dimensional elements: information volume, information diversity, information richness, information adaptation, the paper establishes evaluating model of social capital in competitive alliance and method of multilevel fuzzy evaluation, which well describes the ranking degree of social capital value. Furthermore, the paper introduces a better operable method which is used to prove the certain relativity between evaluating rank of firm's social capital and benefit in terms of competitive strategic alliance.

articleTitle: A Non-Parameter Analysis of Energy Use Efficiency in China
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper employs the DEA method to measure energy use efficiency in Chinese provinces from the perspective of energy-saving and emission-reduction. Concretely, an index that reflects energy-saving and emission-reduction is introduced to analyze a cross-section of data that cover 30 provinces in China. This index is more instructive in showing a measure of energy usage in different provinces, compared to a method that does not use this type of index. This method gives a different outcome compared to the previous method for Beijing, Hainan and Qinghai. This conclusion is an important reference for the measurement of the actual result of the practice of energy-saving and emission-reduction in China, and this method may be preferable by providing us with additional insights.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of BI Based on ERP System
publicationTitle: 2008 4th International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To maintain competitive edge in the market, more and more enterprises have been adopting ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning). Now every ERP manufacturer begins to show the slogans that the BI (Business Intelligent) will bring into effect, offering their own BI products or adding the advanced tools to the ERP system. Thus, it is easy to confuse BI with ERP. What is more, one thinks BI is based on ERP when one refers to BI. Therefore, in order to get further difference and make it clearly, research on the application of BI based on the ERP system is necessary and the relationship between BI and ERP is introduced into the paper. Further more, the new state of trend which BI combined with ERP is brought forward as well as the trend of BI.
